ESP.ORIGINAL: GREETING
ESP.TRADUIT: 问好

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Camp Willow, in Arizona. The river was only the first leg of our journey. We still have a long hike ahead of us before we reach the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是亚利桑那州的柳树营地。这条河只是我们旅程的第一站，在到达堡垒之前，我们还有很长的路要走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_greeting_000019f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should make haste. Caesar does not like to be kept waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该抓紧时间，凯撒不喜欢等人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_greeting_000019f3_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Save your strength for the road and your words for Caesar. We can talk more later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的力气留在路上，把你的话头留给凯撒。我们可以以后再谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_greeting_000019f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should keep moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该继续走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_greeting_000019f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fortification Hill is not far from here. Just a short ways up the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要塞山离这里不远，沿着这条路走不远。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_greeting_000019f6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice day we're having.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们今天过得很愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about the election. Calvin's got this in the bag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心选举。加尔文稳坐胜券在握。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not quite anything like this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全不像这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knees giving me a fit lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的膝盖最近不舒服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say we understand you. Just don't do anything stupid while you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能说我们理解你。只要你在这里别做傻事就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make trouble in this town, and you will end up dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这镇上捣乱，你就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just watching the caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是在看大篷车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024E3C]AZChlorideGenericDialogue) 06024E3C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you're new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你是新来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kam yuu, fresh face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷猴啊，新面孔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need? Are you hurt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？受伤了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid you'll need to wait. I have other patients.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕你得等一等，我还有其他病人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc Clay's with another patient right now. Poor guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生现在在照看另一个病人。可怜的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please come back another time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次再来吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi again! Please go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了！请离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw you coming. What are you here for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看见你来了。你来这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I told you to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我叫你走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一次警告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not one for conversation. Please leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是个健谈的人。请离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's you again. What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你。你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have returned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Flavius Constantinus, Optio of Malpais. You must be the one sent bearing the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯，马尔帕的执行官。你一定是那个带着凯撒徽记被派来的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cursor Lucullus was meant to be escorting you. Return to him, and complete your business with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传令兵卢库卢斯本该护送你的。回到他那里去，把你和凯撒的事办完。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Complete your business with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完成你和凯撒的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I give my thanks on behalf of the Legion for your service to Caesar. Do you have further business in Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表军团感谢你为凯撒所做的贡献。你在马尔帕斯还有别的业务吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Flavius Constantinus, Optio of Malpais. I give my thanks on behalf of the Legion for your service to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯，马尔帕的执行官。我代表军团感谢你为凯撒所做的贡献。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a Legion military installation on an active frontline. Provide a reason for entering or face death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个处于活跃前线的军团军事设施。提供一个进入的理由，否则将面临死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have returned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A fellow Legionary? A welcome sight in this savage frontier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的战友？在这片蛮荒的边疆，这是一个可喜的景象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move along, Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧，浪荡子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awfully far from the road, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 离大路太远了，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you have the intel, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有情报了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the bastard dead yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那杂种死了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你没什么好说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it obvious, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 说得明显点，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quiet Man [06024B13] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not in my hands anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不在我手里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quiet Man [06024B13] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seriously, leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，离我远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quiet Man [06024B13] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there. Need anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好啊，需要什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [06008BC6] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My cargo's not for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的货物是非卖品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [06008BC6] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave me alone. I'm trying to enjoy my break.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别打扰我。我在享受我的休息时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [06008BC6] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. I'm all sold out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我全部卖完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [06008BC6] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't move or I'll shoot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动，否则我开枪了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, you don't look like one of those wastrels. What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你看起来不像那种二流子。你在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha! That was exhilarating. You're quite resourceful for a Profligate. You'd make a fine Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈！真是令人振奋。作为一个浪荡子，你还真是足智多谋啊。你会成为一名优秀的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: But my Decanus...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我的什长...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I go back to him now, he'll have me beaten for deserting. Or crucified. To have been taken captive by a band of savages like that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我现在回去找他，他会因为我擅离职守而打我，或者被钉在十字架上。竟然被一群野蛮人抓走...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you speak to my Decanus? We can tell him the truth together. He'll be more likely to believe me that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能和我的什长谈谈吗？我们可以一起告诉他真相，这样他更有可能相信我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go finish them off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去收拾他们吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the butcher of my people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是屠杀我人民的刽子手吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy there, newcomer. The name's Slippery Will, pleased to make your acquaintance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊，新来的。我叫"滑头"威尔，很高兴认识你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back, got good news for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来，有什么好消息吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are the one Callum spoke of. Where did you find my Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是卡卢姆提到的那个人，你在哪里找到我的军团士兵的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Decanus Quintus. What is your business here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是什长昆图斯，你来这里干什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are entering Legion property. State your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你正在进入军团的军事领地。陈述你的来意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may have the Mark of Caesar, but don't presume you have free reign to act as you please. You are watched. Remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也许有凯撒的徽记，但不要想当然地认为你可以随心所欲。你被监视着，记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assume you have business here. This is a military outpost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你来这里是有事吧，这里是个军事前哨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the one Caesar has given his Mark? Very well. Please make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是凯撒给了徽记的那个？很好，请快点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say your piece so I can get back to my work.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asshole, I know it was you who blamed the graffiti on us. Leave us alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 混蛋，我知道是你把涂鸦赖到我们头上的。离我们远点。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Red Rivers is dead. Thanks a lot, asshole.

ESP.ORIGINAL: You blew up the deal. I got nothing for you.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're on our way back east. I won't have anything for you until we get back.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you! Good to see you again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你！很高兴再次见到你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hands up! Hands in the fucking air, or I'll blow your brains out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 举起手来！把手举起来，不然我一枪崩了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really want to talk anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不想再说话了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Staying long?
ESP.TRADUIT: 待很久了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8de_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like things are always gettin' worse, but at least the water stays good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 似乎情况总是越来越糟，但至少水是好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f902_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't with a caravan? That's unusual these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这儿不常有新面孔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f3_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mind your own business and we'll get along just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把头低下，眼睛向前看，你就能很好地融入其中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f4_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Buzz off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f901_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let the deputy catch you out by yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一点建议？除非军团士兵先靠近你，否则不要接近他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f5_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You picked a bad time to visit Dolan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你拜访多兰的时机真是太糟糕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f6_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No offense, but I don't want to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无意冒犯，但我不想和你说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: In case you hadn't heard, the road north is closed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能还没听说，往北的路已经封闭了。严重的地震，至少他们是这么说的。整个连环道都倒塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f8_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ain't from around here...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是这附近的人...你是商队、信使还是难民？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got my own problems to deal with. Go bother someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己也有问题要处理。去烦别人吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8fe_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want any trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想惹麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f900_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever your business is here, leave me out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你来这里有什么事，都别把我们扯进来，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f7_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't stray too far from the roads. Lots of nasty critters are active this time of year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是你，就不会离开镇子太远。最近所有的动物都被激怒了，甚至连道路也变得糟糕起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last thing this town needs is more strangers...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个小镇最不需要的就是更多的陌生人...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8fc_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard someone say you was coming in from the north. But that couldn't be true...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到有人说你是从北方来的。但这不可能是真的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8ff_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I wouldn't give for a whiskey...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿为一杯威士忌付出一切...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult01defaultb\azdialogue_greeting_0000f8fa_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, you're a woman? The fuck is the Legion doing letting a bitch walk around free?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你是女人？操，军团为什么要让一个婊子自由活动？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm a deputy. You got some sort of problem? Quickly, before I lose my patience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我是副警长。你有什么问题吗？快点，在我失去耐心之前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spit it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说出来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good day. If you are here concerning a legal dispute, please speak to my Centurion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 日安。如果你是来处理法律纠纷的，请找我的百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you are here on business, you should seek out one of my Scribonii to schedule a meeting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是因公而来，你应该找我的书记官来安排一次会议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were warned once. Deputies! Kill this Profligate!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我警告过你一次。代理人们！杀了这个浪荡子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are back, and judging by the way you carry yourself, with purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了，从你的表现来看，你是有目的的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have something to report?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么要报告的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good day. How may I help you, amicus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 日安。有什么可以帮你的吗，朋友？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This diner is only for Legion and Legion recognized merchants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家餐厅只对军团和军团认可的商人开放。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave. Do you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。你有什么需要吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oooh! Hello, hello, hello! Lookie here, Nixon. We've got a visitor!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢噢！你好，你好，你好！看这里，尼哥生。有客人来了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like you've a discerning eye, so tell me, customer: what think you of Nicodemus' collection?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的眼光很敏锐，所以告诉我，顾客：你对尼哥德慕的收藏有什么看法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up, man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了，伙计。 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the woman who has been summoned by Caesar? I am the Priestess Calventia. I'm honored to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是那个被凯撒召见的女人吗？我是女祭司卡文提亚。很荣幸认识你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the man who has been summoned by Caesar. Ave. I am the Priestess Calventia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是被凯撒召见的人。万岁，我是女祭司卡文提亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave, domina Venus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，女神维纳斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave, domina Concordia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，女神孔科耳狄亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave, domina Augusta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，女主人奥古斯塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave, domina Invicta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，女神因维克塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Salute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: True to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忠于凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars guide you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯指引你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hello sir. My name is Tex. It's a pleasure to meet you. What can I do for you today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你好先生，我叫特克斯，见到你很高兴。今天我能为你些做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! I see your Mark of Caesar. That is fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！我看到你的凯撒徽记了，这太迷人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hello ma'am. My name is Tex. It's a pleasure to meet you. What can I do for you today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你好女士，我叫特克斯，见到你很高兴。今天我能为你些做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! I see your Mark of Caesar. That is fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！我看到你的凯撒徽记了，这太迷人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Luke. I'm currently running an election, so I'm pretty busy, but I might have some time to chat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫卢克。我现在正在竞选，所以我很忙，但我可能有时间聊聊天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't seen you before. New in town? I'm Doc D.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前没见过你。新来的？我是D医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I guess I can chat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我想我可以聊天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you! I never expected to see you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你！没想到还能再见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to thank you for everything you did for me. I still don't have much to my name, I don't make any money as a maiden, but that's no excuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想感谢你为我所做的一切。我名下的财产还不多，我做女侍时也没挣到钱，但这不是借口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I've been cultivating this plant, a broc plant, and it has the prettiest flowers I've ever seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我一直在培育这种植物，一种布洛克植物，它的花是我见过的最漂亮的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The petals curve up into a kind of bowl shape, and the orange is the richest orange ever, like the sunset.
ESP.TRADUIT: 花瓣向上弯曲成一种碗状，橙色是有史以来最浓郁的橙色，就像日落一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I wanted you to have it. I know it's barely anything, but it's really all I have, and I wanted to give you something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我想把它送给你。我知道这不算什么，但这是我的全部，我想给你点什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stanley Hartford, Radio New Vegas. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯坦利·哈特福德，新维加斯电台。很高兴认识你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What brings you to Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么风把你吹到马尔帕斯来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, good, you've made it. I assume the good captain passed along my message. I'm Helena Devic, one of the auxiliary heads of the Rangers in the Mojave sector.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle is dead. I almost can't believe it. I'll never have to fear him ever again.

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I'm the leader of the Hooks now. For that, I can't thank you enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我现在是钩子的头头了。为此，我感激不尽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You slimy fuck! You told me Bear wouldn't hurt Kyle!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个王八蛋！你说过大熊不会伤害凯尔的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.TRADUIT: 我绝对不会让一个保留地的变种人来管事。希望你开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊真的认为他能取代凯尔吗？那混蛋只是在等机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔死了，我没理由再待在这里了。我才不会把自己拴在沉船上，工程师供不应求。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be seeing you, I guess.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Newt isn't so bad, for a town full of women. It's been nice to get away from the Fort for awhile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于一个满是女人的小镇来说，纽特还不错。能离开堡垒一段时间也挺好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me know if you find any pretty girls around here.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Newt Resident [06020D4C] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you hanging around here for?

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of these days I'm gonna take a dip in the lake. I can't swim, but drowning beats this heat.

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fish shipment isn't ready yet. Please give us a few more days.

ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这是件大事，真的很大，而且非常危险。我们被选中去采访多米尼库斯·勒克斯。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你给我滚远点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I still have the notes from our interviews, and I'm hoping to get your biography published. I'm still working on a title.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我还留着我们采访时的笔记，我希望能出版你的传记。我还在写一个标题。

ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到了，索利泰尔。我不介意承认我很害怕。

ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，这里曾经是东部的中心。现在看起来不像了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll strip-search you, you know.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, we have to talk with Dominicus Rex. We really shouldn't be keeping him waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们得和多米尼库斯·勒克斯谈谈。我们真不该让他等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, are you ready to visit Dominicus Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你准备好去拜访多米尼库斯·勒克斯了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's the news on the slavers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，奴隶贩子那边有什么消息吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, did you finish the Chainway assignment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你完成连环道的任务了吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 当我说我有个提议的时候，我以为你不会在他莫哈维帝国的中心杀死那个强大的军阀。请离开。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance you changed your mind?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay. That just about concludes the interview. Wow! An absolutely thrilling story full of intrigue, twists and revenge. It's almost unbelievable.

ESP.TRADUIT: 我，呃，鉴于严格的审查制度，我可能暂时不能发表这篇文章，但等我发表了，你就会和新维加斯先生一样出名了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! I actually do have a final question, what are you doing in Legion territory? It's a long way from Goodsprings and New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！我还有最后一个问题，你在军团领地做什么？这里离清泉镇和新维加斯很远。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the interview.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢你接受采访。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay. That just about concludes the interview. Wow! An absolutely thrilling story full of intrigue, twists and revenge. It's almost unbelievable.

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey there, friend. My name's Benjamin. Don't worry about the others. They'll warm up to you eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，朋友，我叫本杰明。别担心其他人，他们最终会喜欢上你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, welcome to Freihafen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，欢迎来到弗赖哈芬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome back, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欢迎回来，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey hey!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，嘿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from the armory. First and last warning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离军械库远点，第一次也是最后一次警告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, that that's out of the way, my name's Serwa. You're from up top, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，那就说到正题，我叫瑟尔瓦。你是从上面来的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been a while since this place has had a visitor. My name is Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方已经有一段时间没有访客了，我叫维尔茨波夫斯基。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've come at a terrible time, but you're welcome here nonetheless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来得不是时候，不过还是欢迎你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not speak to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing them was not a good idea. I'll have to report it to the next caravan that comes through. Why shouldn't I name you as the culprit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了他们不是个好主意，我得把这件事报告给下一个路过的商队。我有什么理由不指认你就是罪魁祸首呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perfectly executed. Just don't make a habit of this. Or I'll kill you myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完美执行。只是别把这当成习惯，否则我会亲手杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's focus on the caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们专注于商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're coming from the south, I would avoid the SMART Array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你从南方来，我建议你避开智能阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a patient man. I really don't have time to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是一个有耐心的人，我真的没时间和你说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave again, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次致敬，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hands. Put 'em out and up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 手，把它们举起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing to see here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没什么可看的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I better not find out you've been punking anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好别让我发现你跟谁鬼混。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the fucking law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是他妈的法律。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Piss off, degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开，堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: True to Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 忠于凯撒 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You cause any trouble and I'll make sure you regret it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要是惹麻烦，我保证你会后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0601CDC5]AZDialogueLegionDeputy) 0601CDC5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks again, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次感谢，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks again, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再次感谢，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that Sedonus is dead. I can't believe that. It's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说塞多尼乌斯死了，我真不敢相信。都结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave. True to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁，忠于凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, there, stop!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，站住！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am under express orders from Sedonus to ban any new sources of Sunset Sasparilla.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我接到塞多尼乌斯的命令明确禁止任何新来源的夕阳沙士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better not punch me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好别再打我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave. What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking for Natalie, she and the children have already moved on from here. They've gone West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在找纳塔莉，她和孩子们已经离开这里了。他们向西走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see if they'll do better in the Boneyard. I hope they will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们将拭目以待，看看他们在晒骨场的表现会不会更好。我希望他们会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, everything's ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，都准备好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，见鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I can't be seen talking with a First Recon guy. Get him out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我不能被看到和第一侦察队的人说话。带他离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, there. Look, I'm pretty busy. If you're here to help, go to Gilles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好。听着，我很忙，如果你是来帮忙的，去找吉勒斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard that you've been helping Gilles out around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你一直在帮吉勒斯的忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those medical books you got for Markland are working great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给马克兰买的那些医学书籍很有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for taking care of the killer. I know the kids feel a lot safer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你解决了凶手，我知道孩子们感觉安全多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you wouldn't happen to know any way into Arizona, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，你不会刚好知道去亚利桑那的路吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, find out anything about my friend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，找到我朋友的消息了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，又是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you ready to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你准备好出发了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, here comes the hard part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，最难的部分来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I've got several weeks of therapy to work through. I'm not going to have time to talk until I'm done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我还要接受几周的心理治疗。在我完成之前，我是没有时间说话的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. Yeah, I'm back from Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊。是的，我从亚利桑那回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we're back. Are you going to kill me? That was a bluff, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我们回来了。你要杀了我吗？那是虚张声势，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. Fuck off and die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊。滚开，去死吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away, asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开，混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey, there. Name's Gregory. If you need supplies and healing, speak to Julie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嘿，你好，我叫格雷戈里。如果需要物资和治疗，可以找朱莉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready whenever you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我随时准备好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, is the secret mission ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，秘密任务准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that was a total failure. The only saving grace is that we're alive, and the children deserted, I think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那完全是失败。唯一值得庆幸的是我们还活着，而孩子们被遗弃了，我想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, I can't stay here. My cover's blown. Desmond and I are heading back to Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我不能待在这里。我的身份暴露了，我和德斯蒙德要回苦泉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for your help, even if things didn't go how we wanted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助，尽管事情并没有如我们所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did it really have to be this way? We've just reinforced their Legion indoctrination!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的有必要这样吗？我们刚刚强化了他们的军团教义！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if they'll ever be able to reintegrate into society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他们是否能重新融入社会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just....
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if we can truly save them, but they are safe with us now. Thanks for your all help. Desmond and I are heading back to Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道能不能救他们，但他们现在和我们在一起很安全。谢谢你的帮助，德斯蒙德和我要回苦泉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They actually left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们真的离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't how you did it, but you better believe I'm grateful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你是怎么做到的，但你最好相信我很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Desmond and I are heading back to Bitter Springs, children in tow, thanks to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 德斯蒙德和我要回苦泉了，还带着孩子，多亏了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see if we can resolve this without violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看能不能不用暴力解决这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, good, you made it, thank goodness. The only thing left is to load the kids onto the raft.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，很好，你来了，谢天谢地。剩下的就是把孩子们抬到筏子上了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, we have to hurry before any passing Legionaries.... Oh, no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们得抓紧时间，赶在路过的军团士兵...之前。噢，不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's their first time killing Profligates. I knew they'd handle it pretty well.

ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。如果你打算过河，晚上再来。如果我们白天行动，NCR会抓住我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [0601FE0F] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you must cross the river, give the word and I will take you.

ESP.TRADUIT: 一个有凯撒徽记的女人，我想知道现在的文明将走向何方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave. I am Asher. Don't prevent me from watching these cows, and we'll get along just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。我是阿舍，不要妨碍我看这些牛，我们会相处得很好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're the one with the Mark of Caesar. You don't look all that impressive to me, but I'm sure Caesar sees something in you that I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你就是那个有凯撒徽记的人。在我看来你并没有什么了不起的，但我相信凯撒在你身上看到了我没看到的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave. I am Asher. Don't prevent me from watching these cows, and we'll get along just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。我是阿舍，不要妨碍我看这些牛，我们会相处得很好的。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our business is finished. Stop irritating me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的生意结束了，别烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. You're back. It's time for the next job. This is my colleague from The Reservation. His name is Marty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，你回来了，该做下一项工作了。这是我在保留地的同事，他的名字叫马提。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's brought us a fantastic new drug. It's called Smooch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给我们带来了一种神奇的新药，叫做污吻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your job is simple: Marty is going to give you a supply of the new drug. I want you to take it to Malpais. Spike the water supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的工作很简单：马提会给你一些新药，我要你把它带到马尔帕斯去，切断供水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once that's done, you will take the package to Malpais and introduce it into the water supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完成后，你要把包裹带到马尔帕斯把它放进供水系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and don't get caught. That will ruin everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，别被抓住了，那样会毁了一切的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There must be some good reason that Clark let you in. The last intruder, we killed and made it look like animals did it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克拉克让你进来一定是有原因的。上一个闯入者，我们杀了，还伪装成是动物干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm currently very busy. If you have business, you should speak to Niemann.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在很忙。如果你有事，你应该找尼曼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe Niemann made himself quite clear.

ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是他的使命，我们生来就是为他服务的。我希望你也能明白你的使命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e0b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: If what you say is true, why are the Legion's methods so brutal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的是真的，为什么军团的手段这么残忍？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you have seen or heard, know that we only punish those who deserve it. Our justice brings peace and order for those who would have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论你看到什么，听到什么，你都要知道，我们只惩罚那些应得的人。我们的正义为那些希望得到它的人带来和平和秩序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e0c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me more about yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能多介绍一下你自己吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you know, I am Lucullus. I serve with the speculatores as a cursor. My duty is to conduct reconaissance and facilitate transport across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所知，我是卢库卢斯。我为密探充当传令兵，我的职责是进行侦察，为过河提供便利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e0d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. Just stay close to me until we reach Fortification Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。在我们到达要塞山之前跟紧我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1c_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. Just stay close to me until we reach Fortification Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。在我们到达要塞山之前跟紧我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1d_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and uh... don't worry about the other legionaries. You are under the protection of Caesar, and I will make sure of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，还有呃...不用担心其他军团士兵。你受到凯撒的保护，我会确保这一点的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1d_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I've changed my mind. Take me back to Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我改变主意了。带我回棉白杨湾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you serious? You waited until - *Eugh* Very well. I will escort you back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真的？你等到 - *呃*好吧，我会送你回去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1b_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know that Caesar views indecisiveness as a fatal weakness. When you return, and you will, do not expect this to earn you any favors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要知道凯撒视优柔寡断为致命的弱点。当你回来的时候，而且你一定会回来，不要指望这会给你带来任何好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1b_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...既然你这么说的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is natural for the Dissolute to struggle with uplifting themselves out of ignorance. You will learn our ways or ultimately perish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浪荡子自然要挣扎着提升自己，摆脱无知。你要么学习我们的方式，要么灭亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1f_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please make them quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e1a_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有一些问题要问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can take a short break. What did you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以休息一下。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e19_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, we shouldn't waste any more time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我们不应该再浪费时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e20_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you answer some more questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能再回答几个问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was all I needed to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只需要知道这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Are you ready to go now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你现在可以走了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e18_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do we have to go to the Fort right now? I'd like to look around a little.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须现在就去堡垒吗？我想四处看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My orders are to escort you safely to the Fort without delay. If you choose to wander off on your own, I cannot harm you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我接到的命令是立刻护送你安全抵达堡垒。如果你选择独自游荡，我不会伤害你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019f2_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: But to defy Caesar in his own territory is beyond foolish. It is suicidal. You would do well to remember that even his patience has its limits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但在凯撒的地盘上反抗他是愚蠢至极的，这是自杀。你最好记住，即使是他的耐心也是有限度的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019f2_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Camp Willow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说柳树营地吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We battled the Profligates at this camp only a season ago. It was one of their last remaining outposts this side of the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在一年前，我们还在和这个营地里的放荡者作斗争。这是他们在河对岸仅存的前哨阵地之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019f9_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has since been repurposed as a depot for offloading supplies we ship upriver, from Bullhead and Dry Wells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后，它被重新用作一个仓库，用来卸载我们从上游的布尔海德和枯井运来的物资。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019f9_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That must have been quite a battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那一定是一场相当激烈的战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was not there to see it. The camp commander Decanus Caro could tell you more if you ever get a chance to meet him. He's usually quite busy though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时不在现场。如果你有机会见到营地指挥官什长卡洛，他会告诉你更多。不过他平时很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019fb_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can I be sure that you all aren't just going to kill me as soon as it's convenient?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么能确定你们不会一有机会就杀了我呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Caesar wanted you dead, you wouldn't be standing here right now. If he only wanted something you had, he would have simply taken it from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果凯撒想让你死，你现在就不会站在这里了。如果他只是想要你拥有的东西，他早就从你手中夺走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_000019fd_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything I should know about Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于凯撒有什么我应该知道的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is efficient, cunning, noble, and merciful. The son of the god Mars who blew fire across the land so that he would be born with it in his blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有能力、狡黠、高贵、仁慈。他是玛尔斯神的儿子，神把火焰吹向大地，使他出生时血液中就流淌着火焰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00001a00_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's deeds speak for themselves. You will understand soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的事迹说明了一切。你很快就会明白的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00001a00_2.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like a crock of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像一堆废话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pretend I didn't hear that. No Dissolute would survive to finish such an utterance without the protection of that Mark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会假装没听到。没有那个徽记的保护，任何一个浪荡子都不可能说完这样的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cursor Lucullus [0012B515] (mod) Quest : ([060019F0]AZLucullusEscortQuest) 060019F0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral Audio : \Sound\voice\novaarizona.esm\maleadult04\azlucullus_azlucullusescor_00000e06_1.ogg

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just an old saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是一句老话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that. What do you want, Come-from-away?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了。你想要什么，从外地来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在有点忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Gum... You?" What does that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: "雷猴？"这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did I just say? I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚才说什么来着？我很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See that human-shaped scab over there? Poor guy decided he couldn't take it amymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到那边那个人形结痂了吗？可怜的家伙觉得他再也受不了了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Waited until the middle of the night, then tossed himself on the bonfire when he was on sentry duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一直等到半夜，然后在放哨的时候就一头扎进了篝火里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Worst part is, he survived. Barely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟糕的是,他活了下来。勉强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's in a coma now, but the last few days have been promising. Motor response is good. Eyes are opening to speech. He's coming to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他现在处于昏迷状态，但前几天情况不错。运动反应良好，眼睛正在张开，可以讲话。他快醒过来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His Commander wants him alive. "To live a long and excrutiatingly painful life in the Legion", he said. Talk about irony.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的指挥官希望他活着，“在军团度过漫长而痛苦的一生”，他说。这才叫讽刺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hurt, can you heal me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受伤了，你能治好我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm here to collect a bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我是来领赏金的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm here to collect a bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我是来领赏金的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm here to cut you down to size.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我是来给你点颜色瞧瞧的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们说得没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion says that someone in this area has been attacking caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团说这一带有人一直在袭击商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I work alone. Still, I can see that you mean it. You can stay for a bit, if you want. Stay away from the gated section. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我独自工作。不过，我看得出来你是认真的。如果你愿意的话，可以再待一会儿。远离门控区域，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion says that someone in this area has been attacking caravans. Wanted to join.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团说这一带有人一直在袭击商队。我想加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就谈呗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not until you've answered my questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你回答我的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appear to have wandered into the wrong cave. I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我走错洞了，我先走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, forgive me if I don't believe you. Wait, what's that around your neck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，如果我不相信你，请原谅我。等等，你脖子上那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not with the Legion, if that's what you're asking. Far from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是军团的人，如果你是想问这个的话。相差甚远。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Curiosity killed the cat. But, I believe you. Have some water.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好奇害死猫。但是，我相信你。喝点水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, run along and never come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，走吧，永远不要回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not here to hurt you. I just saw this cave and was curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不是来伤害你的。我只是看到了这个洞穴，有点好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You made a beeline straight for this cave, and you expect me to believe that?
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你直接冲进了这个山洞，你以为我会相信吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. What the hell is that around your neck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。你脖子上挂的是什么东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just passing through. Kind of stumbled on this place by accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是路过而已，偶然发现了这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you saying...? You are. You killed him. No way you're a friend of the Legion. Tell you what, you're welcome in this cave anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说...？你是，你杀了他。你不可能是军团的朋友，跟你说，这个洞随时欢迎你来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from the gate. I've rigged it with traps, and there's nothing in there anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离大门远点，我在门上装了陷阱，里面什么都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Mark of Caesar. It's the mark of a dead man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是凯撒的徽记，这是一个死人的徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like you hate the Legion as much as I do. You can use this place as a stopover if you want. Stay away from the gate. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你和我一样讨厌军团。如果你愿意，你可以把这里当作中转站。离大门远点，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Mark of Caesar. I don't think it's valid anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是凯撒的徽记，我认为它已经失效了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么弄到的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是凯撒的徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it isn't. You're not leaving this cave alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是的。你休想活着离开这个洞穴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> It's just a family heirloom.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>这只是一件传家宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's assume that you're not Legion for the moment. You didn't have to come to Arizona, so why did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们假设你暂时不是军团成员。你不是非得来亚利桑那，那你为什么要来呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it after visiting the Strip. He had business to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我参观完长街后买的，他有生意要谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't have to come to Arizona, so why did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是非得来亚利桑那，那你为什么要来呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it after visiting the Strip. He has business to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我参观完长街后买的，他有生意要谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wasn't so mighty, was he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他并没有那么强大，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wanted to meet the mighty Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想见见强大的凯撒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wanted to hear the guy out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想听听那家伙怎么说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Barker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴克。
