ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你叫什么名字？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the bootlickers of the Legion. Every single one of them is in bed with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是军团的马屁精，他们每个人都和他们同流合污。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every single one of them is bringing new supplies that the Legion is using to terrorize its enemies. Killing the caravans hurts the Legion, and that's good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们带来了军团用来恐吓敌人的新物资。击杀商队会伤害军团，这是好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you attacking caravans?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要攻击商队？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I start talking about the Rangers, I don't stop, so I hope you're ready for some stories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我开始谈论游骑兵时，我不会停下来，所以我希望你已经准备好听故事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. What specifically did you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。你具体想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really like talking about myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太喜欢谈论我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess we can talk. The Legion hates you as much as they do me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们可以聊聊。军团像恨我一样恨你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really like talking about myself, but you did kill Caesar. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太喜欢谈论我自己，但你确实杀了凯撒。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're from all over the place. Nevada, Utah, Colorado, Texas, Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们来自四面八方。内华达、犹他、科罗拉多、德克萨斯、亚利桑那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They predate the Great War and were established to help with hostage negotiations, riots and some of the first raider gangs in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们早在战前就成立了，是为了帮助处理人质谈判、骚乱和亚利桑那的第一批掠夺者团伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the war, we continued to uphold those values wherever we went. The values of personal independence, survivalism and samaritanism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战后，无论我们走到哪里，我们都继续坚持这些价值观。个人独立、生存主义和撒玛利亚主义的价值观。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are the Rangers from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers were badly depleted as a result of the Great Raider War. Every victory against the raiders made us weaker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵在大掠夺者战争中元气大伤，对掠夺者的每一次胜利都让我们变得更弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every victory the Legion had against the raiders made them stronger. They broke the tribes and absorbed them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而军团对掠夺者的每一次胜利都使他们变得更加强大。他们打破部落并吸收了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whenever things got too hot, they raided New Mexico for new slaves and new recruits. When they came back, they were stronger. And no one resisted them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦局势变得紧张，他们就会突袭新墨西哥，搜刮新的奴隶和新兵。当他们回来的时候，他们就会变得更强大，没有人反抗他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The raider alliances fought us instead of them, Flagstaff barely fought back, Two-Sun outright surrendered, and the Confederacy folded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者联盟与我们而不是他们作战，旗杆市几乎没有反击，双日城彻底投降，邦联瓦解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In addition, we never held territory. Even if we could, it just wasn't our way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，我们从未占领过领土。就算我们能，那也不是我们的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers don't form nations from the top-down, we let others build their own states.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵不会自上而下建立国家，我们让其他人建立自己的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never seemed to work out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 似乎从来就没这么成功过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did the Rangers lose to the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是怎么输给军团的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Six years between our declaration of war and the fall of Quartz Site. From 2264 to 2270.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从我们宣战到阔茨赛特的覆灭，整整六年。从2264年到2270年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the Ranger Unification Treaty, the war paused until 2274, when the NCR finally got off their asses to help us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 《游骑兵统一条约》签订后，战争暂停了，直到2274年，NCR才开始帮助我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been going on 15 years now. A long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到现在已经15年了。很长时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long did the Rangers fight the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵和军团战斗了多久？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! That fucking treaty is bullshit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！那个该死的条约就是扯淡！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I lost my temper. The answer's no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我发脾气了。答案是否定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are not an NCR creation, but many of them joined with the NCR following the Unification Treaty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵并不是NCR创建的，但他们中的许多人是在《统一条约》之后加入NCR的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are Rangers NCR or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是否属于NCR？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you no. Like I said, the Rangers in the NCR are not real Rangers, but the real Rangers were forcibly put into the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉你不是了。就像我说的，NCR的游骑兵并不是真正的游骑兵，但真正的游骑兵是被强制加入NCR的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are Rangers NCR or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是否属于NCR？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way I understand it, the Rangers were vital in helping to defeat the Master's Army about a century ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，大约一个世纪前，游骑兵在帮助打败主教军队方面发挥了至关重要的作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the NCR was established, they made their own version of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当NCR成立后，他们组建了自己的游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those NCR Rangers are not real Rangers, even if they use our name, they wear our armor and have a watered-down version of our training.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些NCR游骑兵并不是真正的游骑兵，即使他们使用着我们的名字，穿着我们的盔甲，接受了我们的弱化版训练。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the NCR has its own Rangers, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但NCR有自己的游骑兵，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real Rangers trace their heritage to before the Great War. The NCR's Rangers can't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的游骑兵可以追溯到战前，NCR的游骑兵不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real Rangers never took orders from anyone. They had leaders they respected and took advice from. The NCR's Rangers follow orders to a fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的游骑兵从不听命于任何人，他们有自己尊敬的领袖，并听取他们的建议。NCR的游骑兵过分服从命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And most importantly, real Rangers aren't about states or subordinating yourself to higher power. It's about doing the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最重要的是，真正的游骑兵不是为了国家，也不是为了服从更高的权力。而是做正确的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's Rangers aren't, and that's why they can't see good and bad clearly anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而NCR的游骑兵则不然，这就是为什么他们再也分不清善恶了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like real Rangers to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这才是真正的游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't get it. Seth just picked the name because it sounded cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白。赛斯选这个名字只是因为听起来很酷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was totally unaware of the trials you needed to overcome to earn that armor and of the ideals that armor represented.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他完全不知道需要克服多少考验才能获得那件盔甲，也不知道盔甲所代表的理想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not honor. That's erasure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是荣誉，这是抹灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like the NCR is honoring the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来NCR是在向游骑兵致敬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, and that's the problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，这就是问题所在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't see a difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看不出有什么区别。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR has in its constitution that it is a "most perfect union". The NCR holds that it is the savior of the Wasteland, destined to civilize it.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR在其宪法中称自己是一个“最完美的联邦”。NCR认为自己是废土的救世主，注定要让废土变得文明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the NCR ever needed help or there was someone better, it weakens that myth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果NCR需要帮助或者有更好的人，就会削弱这个流言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the NCR Rangers are the only Rangers that ever existed. All the other Rangers are to be forgotten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，NCR游骑兵是唯一存在过的游骑兵。所有其他游骑兵都将被遗忘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why doesn't the NCR teach the difference?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么NCR不讲授其中的区别呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know Josh. He was a Desert Ranger like us, but one who headed west instead of east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我认识乔什。他和我们一样是沙漠游骑兵，但他向西而不是向东前进。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was an abolitionist who fought the slave trade in Nevada. Brought his ideals with him to NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一位废奴主义者，曾在内华达州反对奴隶贸易。把他的理想带到了NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used friends in high places to secure a ban on slavery in the NCR and took part in raids against the Slavers' Guild in the Den.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他利用高层的朋友在NCR争取到了奴隶制的禁令，并参加了对奴隶行会窝点的突袭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was vital in organizing supplies for the NCR Rangers' expedition in Baja, and the Great Raider War in Arizona. He was a good friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在为NCR游骑兵在巴哈的远征和亚利桑那州的大掠夺者战争组织物资方面发挥了重要作用。 他是我的好朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met Chief Hanlon. Is he a Ranger like you or an NCR one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过汉隆军士长，他是像你一样的游骑兵还是NCR的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the treaty. The Ranger Unification Treaty. The blackest day in the history of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 条约，游骑兵统一条约。这是游骑兵历史上最黑暗的一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When our Rangers unified with the NCR's, Hanlon became our handler. Chief of the Bureau of Ranger Affairs. We all had to take orders from him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们的游骑兵和NCR联合时，汉隆成了我们的联络人。游骑兵事务局局长，我们都得听从他的命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that bastard kept sending us to fight NCR fires instead of them helping us fight our own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个杂碎一直派我们去救NCR的火而不是帮我们救自己的火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said Hanlon was a good friend. What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说汉隆是你的好朋友。发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Quartz Site fell, it was like a switch flipped in the leadership. It's like they just gave up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当阔茨赛特陷落时，就像领导层的一个开关被打开了。就像他们放弃了一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They fled to the NCR, and left us Rangers still in Arizona to operate alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们逃到NCR去了，留下我们游骑兵在亚利桑那州独自行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only found out about the negotiations when the treaty was signed at the Mojave Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是在莫哈维邮政签署条约时才知道谈判的事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the Rangers sign the Treaty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵为什么要签署条约？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I was talking with my brothers and sisters at Camp Golf in '76, they were so upset with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 76年我在高尔夫营地和我的兄弟姐妹们交谈时，他们对他非常不满。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They told me how he kept ordering us to help fight the Brotherhood, Baja, protests in Vault City, tribals in Oregon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们告诉我他一直命令我们协助打击兄弟会，巴哈，地下掩体市的抗议活动，俄勒冈州的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, I talked to Hanlon, and he seemed just as upset as them. I could tell that he fought for us at every opportunity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，我和汉隆谈了谈，他看起来和他们一样沮丧。我看得出来，他抓住一切机会为我们而战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He just kept failing to stop his bosses from leaving us out to dry. I almost pity him. To answer your question, I don't know if he's a good man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就是没能阻止他的老板把我们晾在一边，我几乎要同情他了。回答你的问题，我不知道他是不是个好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think he tries to be, though. Maybe that's all that matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我觉得他是在努力，也许这才是最重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think Hanlon was a good man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得汉隆是个好人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR was supposed to help us fight the Legion if we integrated and bolstered their armed forces. We upheld our end of the bargain. The NCR didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们整合并加强他们的武装力量，NCR就会帮助我们对抗军团。我们遵守了约定，NCR没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR promised us specifically that they would help us hold Hoover Dam and would station more troops at Fort Aradesh for anti-Legion operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR明确向我们承诺，他们将帮助我们控制胡佛大坝，并将在亚拉德什堡部署更多部队，以开展反军团行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the NCR refused to make a deal with the Tall Pines that they didn't involve leaving them the hell alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，NCR拒绝与高松达成协议，让他们自生自灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They did the bare minimum at Fort Aradesh and only moved once the Legion attacked in public.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在亚拉德什堡只做了最少的工作，只有在军团公开攻击时才会行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did the NCR leave you out to dry?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR是怎么把你晾在一边的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A tribe that operated in this area a long time ago. They're gone now, wiped out by Joshua Graham.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个很久以前在这一带活动的部落。他们已经完了，被约书亚·格雷厄姆消灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the Tall Pines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 高松是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because they're assholes, that's why! The NCR has never made an agreement that they followed through on ever!
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们是混蛋，这就是原因！NCR从来没有达成过他们会遵守的协议！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They pick fights with every single group they encounter. They force you into the NCR whether you want it or not!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会与遇到的每一个群体发生冲突。不管你愿不愿意，他们都会强迫你加入NCR！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They roll over everyone, do whatever they want, consequences be damned!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们碾压所有人，为所欲为，不计后果！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All they saw when the treaty was in front of them was having more troops to throw into their meat grinders!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当条约摆在他们面前时，他们所看到的只是有更多的军队可以投入他们的绞肉机！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They didn't stop even one second to think about their obligations! And they are always like this!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们甚至没有停下来哪怕一秒钟想想他们的义务！而且总是这样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. I need to calm down. Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，我需要冷静下来。我们聊点别的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the NCR wait to help the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么NCR迟迟不帮助游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Already told you why. I don't want to go into it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉你原因了，我不想再谈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the NCR wait to help the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么NCR迟迟不帮助游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a sore subject. I'm not going into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个令人痛心的话题。我就不深入了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't the Rangers help the Tall Pines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么游骑兵不帮助高松？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's going to depend on your band. There's lot of Ranger groups out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这取决于你的价值，外面有很多游骑兵组织。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Nevada and Utah, you're born into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在内华达和犹他，你是天生的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you come of age, you complete a rite of passage. After that, you're sent out into the Wasteland to help other communities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你成年的时候，你要完成一个成人礼。在那之后，你会被派往废土去帮助其他社区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Arizona, you spend years of your life training to physical perfection. When you're ready, you take the test of endurance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在亚利桑那，你要花费数年的时间训练身体以达到完美。当你准备好了，你就会接受耐力的考验。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How you do become a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For five days, five Rangers hunt you down. If you're captured, found or heavily injured by them, you fail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五天内，五名游骑兵追捕你。如果你被他们捕获，发现或严重受伤，你就失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You also fail if you die or kill the other Rangers, but that's obvious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你死了或者杀死了其他游骑兵，你也会失败，但这是显而易见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if you pass, you earn the black armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果你通过了，你就会获得黑色盔甲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does the test of endurance entail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 耐力的考验包括什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers' war against the raiders of Arizona. We'd always fought them, but we decided to get organized in 2243.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵对亚利桑那州掠夺者的战争。我们一直在与他们战斗，但我们决定在2243年组织起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mobilized an army of 10,000 Rangers. You should have seen it. 10,000 suits of black armor. It was like something out of a fairy tale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 动员了一万名游骑兵。你真该看看，一万套黑盔甲，这就像童话故事一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was us against the horde of nearly two million raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们与近两百万掠夺者的对决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It began with an attack on King Devil's fortress at Quartz, putting us at war with every raider group in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这始于在阔茨赛特对魔王的攻击，让我们与亚利桑那的每一个掠夺者组织都陷入了战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Great Raider War?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大掠夺者战役是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers had been fighting the raiders for a century and a half. They turned around and saw that the NCR had grown from a little town to a major power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵已经和掠夺者战斗了一个半世纪。他们转过身来，发现NCR已经从一个小镇成长为一个大国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it inspired them. They sent out the call from California to Texas. Rangers never turn their banks on other Rangers, and so we came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这激励了他们，他们从加利福尼亚向德克萨斯发出了呼叫。游骑兵从不背叛其他游骑兵，所以我们来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you should have seen it. An army of 10,000 glorious troops in black armor. The best and brightest of the New West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你真该看看。一支一万名身着黑色盔甲的光荣军队，新西部最优秀最聪明的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once we were ready, we launched an attack on Quartz Site.We took out King Devil and moved to secure the rest of 'Zona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 准备就绪后，我们对阔茨赛特发起了攻击。我们干掉了魔王，并占领了这一地区的其余部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Great Raider War?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大掠夺者战役是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was more like a spirit. We saw the NCR doing so well, and if the NCR could succeed, then so could we.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这更像是一种精神。我们看到 NCR 做得那么好，如果 NCR 可以成功，那么我们也可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We thought that the NCR had got their shit together, and we felt we needed to the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们认为，NCR 已经振作起来了，我们也需要这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you just started a huge war just because of, what, a feeling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你只是因为一种感觉，就挑起了一场巨大的战争？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arizona was always infested with raiders, even before the Great War. Poor soil, little water and lots of guns are a bad combination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甚至在战前，亚利桑那就一直有掠夺者出没。贫瘠的土地，稀少的水源和大量的枪支是一个糟糕的组合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's also the crossroads of the Mojave and the Sonora, so the raiders came from everywhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里也是莫哈维和索诺拉河的交汇处，所以掠夺者来自四面八方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR pushed a bunch east, but the worse problem was Mexico. I have no idea what happened down there, but it must have been bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR向东推进了一些，但更严重的问题是墨西哥。 我不知道那里发生了什么，但肯定很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We spent the entirety of the 2250s pushing back the hordes from the south. Left us blind to the Legion in the north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在 2250 年代的整个时间里都在击退来自南方的部落，使得我们对北方的军团视而不见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the topic of the Legion, when they came back from New Mexico, they pushed raiders to the west, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说到军团，当他们从新墨西哥回来的时候，他们也把掠夺者赶到了西部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad situation over all. Our bad luck that we launched the war when we did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总体来说情况很糟糕。不幸的是，我们发动了战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why were there so many raiders in Arizona?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么亚利桑那州有那么多掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was once the Caesar before Caesar. He led the largest raider alliance in Arizona out of Quartz Site. His empire crumbled in a year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经是凯撒之前的凯撒。他带领亚利桑那州最大的掠夺者联盟离开了阔茨赛特，他的帝国在一年之内就崩溃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'll be a minor footnote in the history books. Just like most of the raiders we wiped out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他将成为历史书中的一个无足轻重的注脚，就像我们消灭的大多数掠夺者一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was King Devil?
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔王是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to understand that we were at war with every raider group in Arizona for over two decades before the Legion became the threat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要明白，在军团成为威胁之前，我们和亚利桑那州的每一个掠夺者组织都打了二十多年的仗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion was small potatoes compared to King Devil or the Blood Moons or the Army of Vengeance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与魔王、血月或复仇军团相比，军团只是小巫见大巫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't until the fall of Window Rock that the Legion became the primary target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到温多罗克陷落，军团才成为首要目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By that time, our army had been reduced to 2,000 fighters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时，我们已经减员至2000名战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't the Rangers stop the Legion instead of the raiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么游骑兵不阻止军团而要去阻止掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was the capital of the Great Southwest Confederacy, a powerful union of tribes older than the Great War. Was once the most powerful entity in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是大西南联盟的首都，这是一个强大的部落联盟，历史比世界大战还要悠久。曾经是亚利桑那州最有权势的实体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We tried to get them to join our war, but they refused. Apparently, they were having some problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们试图让他们加入我们的战争，但他们拒绝了。显然，他们遇到了一些问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion caught them with their pants down and made them a puppet state. It was then that we realized that the Legion had to be stopped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团抓住了他们的把柄，把他们变成了傀儡国家。那时我们才意识到，必须阻止军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Window Rock?
ESP.TRADUIT: 温多罗克在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are scum. The NCR might have fucked over the Rangers, but the Legion put us in that position.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团都是渣滓。NCR可能耍了游骑兵，但是军团把我们逼到这个地步的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me clear, if you're entertaining any notions of the Legion as equal to the NCR, dispel them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我先声明，如果你认为军团与NCR不相上下，那就打消这个念头吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to see both sides of the issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看这个问题的正反两面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanted me to blow up some stuff in a vault under the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想让我炸掉堡垒下面的避难所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is? No, you're not lying, I can tell. Have a drink on me. You're welcome in this cave anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他吗？不，你没说谎，我能看出来。我请你喝一杯，随时欢迎你来这个山洞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from the gated section. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远离门控区域，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter. He's dead now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，他现在死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kill bootlickers like you, and I'm going to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要杀了你这样的马屁精，我一定会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Definitely as mighty as I thought he would be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 果然和我想象的一样强大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normal for a warlord, you mean? Leave and don't come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说对一个军阀来说很一般？走吧，别再回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seemed pretty normal to me, to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，对我来说很一般。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! They always are. You've got a good sense of humor. I'll let you go for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！他们一直都是。你很有幽默感，我先放你一马。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was shorter than I thought he'd be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比我想象中要矮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you. I guess you're not completely stupid. You can stay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你，我想你也不是完全愚蠢。你可以留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from the gated section. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远离门控区域，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Next time I see him, I'm going to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次我再见到他，我会杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Utah. I was born in a survivalist community in the Wasatch Range. I spent about half my life there before traveling to Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 犹他，我出生在瓦萨奇山脉的一个生存主义者社区。在去亚利桑那州之前，我在那里度过了半生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I became a Ranger twice. I was a Utah Ranger first, but that's a long story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当过两次游骑兵。我一开始是犹他游骑兵，不过说来话长了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I became an Arizona Ranger long after that, after passing my test of endurance at Quartz Site.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后很长一段时间，我通过了在阔茨赛特的耐力测试，成为了一名亚利桑那游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I failed the first time, but I passed my second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我第一次没及格，但第二次通过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think about the Legion. I kill them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对军团没看法，我要杀了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might as well be. Everyone else has gone and left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。其他人都离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it just you fighting the Legion in Arizona?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你在亚利桑那和军团作战吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. That was a long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。那是很久以前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who else was there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有谁在那里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'd rather talk about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我更想谈谈这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of the ones from outside Arizona did, yeah. It's one thing to be able to fight like a lion against certain doom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多来自亚利桑那以外的人都是这样，能够像狮子一样对抗厄运是一回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's another to do that for five straight days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连续五天这样做是另一回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the people I trained failed 15 times due to bad luck. The last time was very nearly fatal, and I forbade him from trying again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我训练的一个人，因为运气不好，失败了15次。最后一次几乎是致命的，我禁止他再试一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was so upset. I made him an honorary Ranger to try and calm him down, but I don't think it helped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很沮丧。我给他授予了荣誉游骑兵头衔，想让他冷静下来，但我觉得没用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do Rangers fail the test a lot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵的测试经常不及格吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a long story and one I don't feel like going into, even with you. Maybe some other time, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说来话长，即使是你我也不想说这个。也许改天吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're interested, sure. When I was 21, I came of age and was given my first assignment as a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你感兴趣，当然可以。当我21岁的时候，我成年了，作为一名游骑兵，我被分配了我的第一个任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The village of Hogup was being terrorized by a great beast called "King Komodo". It looked like a giant gecko the size of two or three school buses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 霍格普村被一种叫做“科莫多王”的巨兽吓坏了。它看起来像一只巨大的蜥蜴，有两到三辆校车那么大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It breathed fire and had spikes all over its back. When I saw it in person, I was so scared. I froze in fear, and for some reason, it turned away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它会喷火，背上布满了尖刺。当我亲眼看到它的时候，我非常害怕。我吓得僵住了，不知什么原因，它转身走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone hailed me as a hero, and I couldn't just abandon them. So, I stayed there for four years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都称赞我是英雄，我不能就这样抛弃他们。所以，我在那里呆了四年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was convinced that the only reason that the beast hadn't destroyed the village because it didn't feel like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确信野兽没有摧毁村庄的唯一原因是因为它不喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about becoming a Utah Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说当犹他游骑兵的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another Ranger passed through. She told me that she determined to get some valuable piece of technology that the beast had been guarding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一个游骑兵经过。她告诉我，她决心要得到那头野兽一直守护着的一项有价值的技术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She told me that, if I didn't fight it, she would. Rangers never turn their backs on each other. So, I found my resolve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她告诉我，如果我不反抗，她就会反抗，游骑兵永远不会背弃对方。 于是，我下定了决心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She and I fixed up an artillery piece to use on the beast. I gave her my gun, fully expecting to die. I took an old fire axe lying around and prepared to fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和她修好了一门大炮用来对付那头野兽。我把枪给了她，满心期待着自己会死。我拿起一把躺在地上的旧消防斧，准备战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fight was a blur, but I'm fairly sure I was thrown into the air at one point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打斗的画面模糊不清，但我很确定自己曾被抛到空中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After I was sure that 30 seconds had passed, I screamed her to open fire and kill the thing. She simply stared at me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我确定30秒过去后，我尖叫着让她开枪杀死那东西。她只是盯着我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I looked and saw that I had killed it in one blow. In that moment, I realized that my becoming a Desert Ranger wasn't a fluke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一看，发现我一下子就把它打死了。在那一刻，我意识到我成为一名沙漠游骑兵并不是侥幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's when I truly earned that armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那才是我真正获得那件盔甲的瞬间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Four years is a pretty long time. What changed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 四年是相当长的一段时间。发生了什么变化？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Leave and don't come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。走吧，别再回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You clearly can't be saved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你显然已经没救了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion has some good qualities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团有一些好的品质。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So am I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm tired of this shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我受够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他关于游骑兵的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope you've satisifed it. Leave this cave while you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我希望你已经满意了。趁早离开这个山洞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have to stop that from happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须阻止这种事发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to serve the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来为军团服务的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kill bootlickers like you, and I'm going to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要杀了你这样的马屁精，我一定会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm convinced he has it right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You clearly can't be saved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你显然已经没救了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He made some good points.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他提出了一些很好的观点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obviously. It's good to know that you understand that. You can leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然，很高兴你能理解这一点。你可以走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was talking out of his ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是在胡说八道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're smart enough to get one over on Caesar, I guess you can stick around. Stay away from the gated section. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你够聪明，能骗过凯撒，我想你可以留下来。远离门控区域，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He thinks I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他认为我是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't tolerate bootlickers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能容忍马屁精。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why you're lying about that. I'll let you leave, though. Run along now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你为什么要撒谎，不过我会让你离开的。快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't tolerate bootlickers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能容忍马屁精。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> No.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My patience has run out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的耐心已经耗尽了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Nothing important.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>没有什么重要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. So, what specifically did you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。那么，你具体想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then why did you ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么要问？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better not, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那还是算了吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got tired of me talking your ear off, I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是受够了我的喋喋不休。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵的事到此为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Ranger never stops fighting until he runs out of ammo. When he runs out of ammo, he uses his fists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵永远不会停止战斗，直到他的弹药耗尽。当子弹耗尽时，他会使用拳头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When his fists are broken, he uses his teeth. When his teeth are broken, he's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他的拳头折断时，他会用牙齿。当他的牙齿折断时，他就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers don't stop fighting ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵从不停止战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I convince you to stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能说服你停手吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Arizona, having such an idiotic stance would have gotten you killed by the age of ten. I don't have time for this. Get the fuck out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在亚利桑那，这样愚蠢的立场会让你在十岁之前就被杀。我没时间跟你废话，滚出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you kill them, you're just as bad as them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你杀了他们，你就和他们一样坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样最好不过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I have other questions, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我还有别的问题要问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It should.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes sense to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说很有意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every real Ranger does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个真正的游骑兵都是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you believe that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't, because you're not a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白，因为你不是游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that makes sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是有道理的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a wonderful place, isn't it? If magic exists, it's there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是个很棒的地方，对吧？如果魔法存在，就在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Miles of untouched wilderness, honest-to-god rain and herds of wild animals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绵延数英里的原生态荒野，令人敬畏的雨水和成群的野生动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been to Utah before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前去过犹他州。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. I was amazed at the time, but the stories I heard from the other Rangers.... They're even more amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。我当时很惊讶，但是我从其他游骑兵那里听到的故事....它们更神奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常神奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lots of things are unbelievable. That's why the Wasteland is such a wonderful place. Whether a legend is real or not isn't the point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多事情都是难以置信的，这就是为什么废土是一个如此美妙的地方。传说是真是假并不是重点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last person I told this story to missed the point, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上一个听我讲这个故事的人也没有抓住重点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that true? It sounds unbelievable to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是真的吗？这听起来让我难以置信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if that's possible without being a Ranger, but I think you're as close as you can get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道如果不当游骑兵还能不能做到，但我觉得你已经很接近了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I get the point of this story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我明白这个故事的意思了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably not. But, it's not meant to be impressive. It's meant to make a point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能没有。但是，这并不是为了给人留下深刻印象，这是为了表明一个观点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not that impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没那么令人印象深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Arizona. You're walking in a land full of legends. You're nothing special. Neither am I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是亚利桑那，你行走在一片充满传奇的土地上。你没什么特别的，我也没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't become a legend until you're gone from this earth, anyways. And then it's up to who's left. Not me. Not you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，在你离开这个世界之前，你是不可能成为一个传奇的。然后就看剩下谁了，不是我，不是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm something of a legend, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是个传奇人物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A mercenary. I have distaste for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雇佣兵，我讨厌他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I do. Presently, my orders are to mobilize the maximum amount of manpower before our march on Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我有。现在，我的任务是在向胡佛水坝进军前调动最大限度的人力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As such, I am in need of a bounty hunter to avoid stretching ourselves too thin. Are you interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，我需要一个赏金猎人来避免我们累垮。你有兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that mean you don't have work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是否意味着你没有工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在感兴趣了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask about bounties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问一下悬赏的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about my bounties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对悬赏有疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born into the Fingers del Mesa tribe in southern Arizona and taken as a slave by the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我出生在亚利桑那州南部的芬格·德尔·梅萨部落，被军团当作奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After years of training, hard work and discipline, I was elevated to the coveted rank of Recruit Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经过多年的训练、辛勤的工作和严格的纪律，我被提升到令人垂涎的军团新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I served dutifully in every campaign in Arizona from Malpais onwards, including the civilization of my former tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从马尔帕斯开始，我在亚利桑那州的每一场战役中都尽职尽责，包括面对我以前部落的文明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By 2265, I was recognized as a Veteran Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到2265年，我被认定为一名老兵什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have answers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My tribe was degenerate in culture, spirit and tongue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的部落在文化、精神和语言上都很堕落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was not until I was forced to confront my own lack of discipline that I understood the level of my depravity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到我被迫面对自己的缺乏自律，我才明白自己堕落到什么程度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is a liberating force, who allows man to flourish in the way he was meant to. The Legion liberates us from ourselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是一种解放的力量，它允许人类以其应有的方式蓬勃发展。军团将我们从自我中解放出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't it bother you that you slaughtered your own tribe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你屠杀了自己的部落，难道不觉得困扰吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to claim a bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要领取赏金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you like to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you wish to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the commanders on this front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说前线的指挥官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the uniform of an Optio. Ah, I don't believe we have any posted on the other side of the river in this theater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是执行官的制服。啊，我不相信我们在河对岸的战区里有这个职位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An Optio is the second-in-command to a Centurion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官是百夫长之后的二把手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is that uniform you're wearing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你穿的是什么制服？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do wish to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Optios.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说执行官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Optios are tasked with providing logistical, intelligence and administrative support to Centurions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官的任务是为百夫长提供后勤、情报和行政支持。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They also move information around between Centurions in the midst of battle to help coordinate offensives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还在战斗中在百夫长之间传递信息，以帮助协调进攻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the duties of an Optio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are no Centurions in Malpais. I represent the Centurions that are assembling at the Castra Legatus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯没有百夫长。我代表正在特使军营集会的百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They have continuous demands for supplies, which I pass on to Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们对物资有持续不断的需求，我把这些交给了马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What Centurion are you representing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你代表的是哪个百夫长？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aurelius of Phoenix was supposed to have an Optio, but he took a shot from snipers at Camp Willow and died of his wounds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凤凰城的奥勒留本应该有一个执行官，但他在柳树营地中了狙击手的一枪，伤重不治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aurelius then informed us that he didn't need one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后奥勒留告诉我们他不需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't the Centurions on the other side of the river have Optios?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么河对岸的百夫长没有执行官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aurelius of Phoenix was supposed to have an Optio, but he took a shot from snipers at Camp Willow and died of his wounds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凤凰城的奥勒留本应该有一个执行官，但他在柳树营地中了狙击手的一枪，伤重不治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a moot point now that he is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然他已经死了，那就没有意义了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't the Centurions on the other side of the river have Optios?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么河对岸的百夫长没有执行官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The late Sedonus was a competent commander and administrator whose actions spoke for themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已故的塞多尼乌斯是一位称职的指挥官和管理者，他的行动说明了一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's two legates this place has claimed. Him and the Burned Man. Perhaps Rex was right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方已经有两位特使了，他和火烧人。勒克斯也许是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I have to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我要说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Malpais Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得马尔帕斯特使怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll assume that you mean Marcellus Sedonus and not the previous one. Sedonus is a competent and able commander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你指的是马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯而不是前一位。塞多尼乌斯是个能干的指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is skilled in administration and has a truly awe-inspiring record of service in the name of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他善于管理，在凯撒的名义下，有一个真正令人敬畏的服务记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Malpais Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得马尔帕斯特使怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the new legate of Malpais following the fall of the Burned Man. He is a competent commander and administrator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是火烧人死后马尔帕斯的新特使，他是一位称职的指挥官和管理者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is skilled in administration, and has a truly awe-inspiring record of service in the name of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他善于管理，在凯撒的名义下，有一个真正令人敬畏的服务记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar gave him this post to help him come to terms with his age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒给他这个职位是为了帮助他适应自己的年龄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His experience is best served in these types of posts rather than in the heat of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的经验最好用于这些类型的职位，而不是在激烈的战斗中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seeks a noble death. I fear he is under the impression that he needs to die in battle to complete his service to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他寻求高尚的死亡，我担心他认为只有在战斗中牺牲才能完成对军团的服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is an administrative position. What is he doing here instead of the front?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个行政职位。他为什么在这里而不是在前面？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, the Legate. Legatus Lanius is a mighty warrior. He was the sole survivor of a Legion attack on his tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，特使，拉尼厄斯特使是一个强大的战士。他是军团袭击他的部落时唯一的幸存者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He rose as a slave through the ranks of the Legion military after stopping an attempt on Caesar's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在阻止了一次刺杀凯撒的行动后，他以奴隶身份在军团中晋升。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar allowed him to prove himself in the field of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒允许他在战场上证明自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Legate Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说拉尼厄斯特使。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, the Legate. Legatus Lanius is a mighty warrior. He was the sole survivor of a Legion attack on his tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，特使，拉尼厄斯特使是一个强大的战士。他是军团袭击他的部落时唯一的幸存者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He rose as a slave through the ranks of the Legion military after stopping an attempt on Caesar's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在阻止了一次刺杀凯撒的行动后，他以奴隶身份在军团中晋升。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar allowed him to prove himself in the field of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒允许他在战场上证明自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Legate Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说拉尼厄斯特使。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was once a trusted ally of Caesar and helped unite Arizona under his rule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他曾是凯撒信任的盟友，帮助凯撒统一了亚利桑那州。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, during the first battle at Hoover Dam, he foolishly walked into a trap laid by the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，在胡佛水坝的第一次战役中，他愚蠢地走进了游骑兵设下的陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR obliterated an entire town to stop the Legion and used sharpshooters to pick off our leaders.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR为了阻止军团，摧毁了整个城镇，用神枪手射杀了我们的领袖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This resulted in a rout, but the NCR was apparently unable or unwilling to follow up their victory, a grave mistake that we will exploit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这导致了一场溃败，但NCR显然无法或不愿继续他们的胜利，我们将利用这一严重的错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Burned Man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说火烧人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais is the logistics hub of the Legion in this theater of the war with the NCR. It provides supplies to The Fort and the Castra Legatus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯是军团在这个战场上与NCR作战的后勤中心，它为堡垒和特使军营提供补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It also possesses a gold mine for the production of currency, which will need to be utilized to fund the greater war against the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它还拥有一个用于生产货币的金矿，这些货币将被用于资助对抗NCR的更大战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the purpose of Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯的目的是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Malpais is far from the frontlines. The only trades we shot are between NCR snipers from Camp Forlorn Hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，马尔帕斯离前线很远。我们唯一需要对付的是在飘零希望营地的NCR狙击手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Malpais see much combat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯有很多战斗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not since Camp Forlorn Hope fell. NCR snipers no longer threaten us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从飘零希望营地陷落后就没有了，NCR的狙击手不再威胁我们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Malpais see much combat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯有很多战斗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于马尔佩斯就说到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is my suboptio and is posted in the town of Solitare. He is a skilled and able commander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是我的副手，被派驻在索利泰尔镇。他是一个有经验、有能力的指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Often times, my duties at both here at the Castra Legatus keep me busy enough that I have been required to delegate work to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多时候，我在特使军营的工作让我很忙，以至于我不得不把工作委托给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe that he will be elevated to rank of Centurion before the end of next year. He has certainly earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他会在明年年底之前被提升为百夫长。这当然是他应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'll be the youngest Centurion in Legion history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他将成为军团历史上最年轻的百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Dominicus Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说多米尼库斯·勒克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about the commanders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于指挥官的事就说到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not believe that he was a traitor as many of my soldiers do. I also do not believe that this was the judgment of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不像我的许多士兵那样认为他是叛徒，我也不相信这是玛尔斯的判决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were out-battled, plain and simple. Perhaps, if Caesar were personally commanding, it would have been different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们被打败了，就这么简单。也许，如果凯撒亲自指挥，情况会有所不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a mistake to underestimate our enemies, and the NCR is the most dangerous Profligate force we have ever faced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 低估我们的敌人是错误的，NCR是我们所面对的最危险的堕落的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our troops will need to be at peak performance to defeat them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的部队需要达到最佳状态才能打败他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看火烧人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sound like Dominicus Rex. He told me that it was bad luck the last time I visited Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听起来像多米尼库斯·勒克斯，他告诉我上次我去索利泰尔的时候运气不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He tried to convince me to relocate there, but its distance from the camp's unfortunately precludes this possbility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他试图说服我搬迁到那里，但不幸的是，那里离营地太远，排除了这个可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're posting another legate in Malpais despite your previous defeat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说，尽管之前失败了，还是要在马尔帕斯再派一个特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is not for me to say. His name has been stricken from the record.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是我该说的，他的名字已从记录中删除了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Burned Man have a name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人有名字吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about the other commanders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有关于其他指挥官的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was during the war with Rangers. I helped salvage supplies for my Centurion outside Sentinel, which proved decisive in holding off their assault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是在与游骑兵作战期间。我在哨兵城外帮助我的百夫长抢救物资，这对挡住他们的进攻起到了决定性的作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Given my long record, it was only natural I was promoted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到我的长期工作记录，我被提升是很自然的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become an Optio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为执行官的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A fearsome group of demonic warriors who wore black armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一群身穿黑色盔甲的可怕恶魔战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were the supreme Profligates of Arizona, holding themselves to be the arbiters of order, but never achieving it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是亚利桑那最堕落的人，自认为是秩序的仲裁者，但从来没有做到过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After they were broken at Quartz, they fled to the NCR. Our scouts have reported that they have begun returning to the rest of the front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在阔茨赛特被击溃后，逃到了NCR。我们的斥候报告说，他们已经开始返回前线的其他地方了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A bad omen, in my view.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，这是个坏兆头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every tribe from Arizona that you see in the Legion fought them at some point. Every Legionary fears them and rightly so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在军团中看到的每个来自亚利桑那的部落都曾与他们作战过。每个军团士兵都害怕他们，这是理所当然的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The most devoted Legionaries believe that they are Mars' fallen angels. Others believe that they are evil spirits from before the Great War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最忠诚的军团成员相信他们是玛尔斯的堕落天使，其他人则认为它们是战前的恶灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The younger Legionaries view them as no different than the common NCR dregs. They are fools and will have to educated accordingly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 年轻的军团士兵认为他们与普通的NCR渣滓没有什么不同。他们是傻瓜，必须接受相应的教育。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I confess that I have no desire to fight them again. I am not sure we will win, especially since they have stirred the NCR against us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我承认我不想再和他们战斗了。我不确定我们会赢，特别是他们已经煽动NCR反对我们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We must drill intensively and continuously to defeat these demons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须坚持不懈地刻苦操练，打败这些恶魔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do your Legionaries feel about the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的军团士兵对游骑兵有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye bye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜拜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the war, the Legion spent the past two decades building up its strength to take on the major powers of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战争开始之前，军团花了过去二十年的时间来增强自己的力量，以对抗亚利桑那州的主要力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, we launched a continuous push westwards. The Rangers had been weakened by their own continuous war with the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，我们开始持续向西推进。游骑兵已经被他们自己与掠夺者的持续战争削弱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unlike us, the Rangers never exterminated or fully assimilated the tribes they warred with. It proved to be their weakness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与我们不同的是，游骑兵从来没有消灭或完全同化与他们交战的部落。事实证明，这是他们的弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ultimately, we took Quartz, forcing the Rangers to flee to the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，我们占领了阔茨赛特，迫使游骑兵逃到NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the war was long and costly, killing so many Legionaries that we thought it might be the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这场战争旷日持久，代价高昂，牺牲了太多的军团士兵，我们认为这可能到此结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the Rangers are returning. They may wear different uniforms now, but it's them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而游骑兵也回来了。他们现在可能穿着不同的制服，但就是他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did the Legion defeat the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是怎么打败游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵的事到此为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have four contracts available. Two deserted Legionaries named Serratus and Screaming Eagle. And a lost caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有四份合同。两名逃跑的军团士兵，名叫锡兰杜英和啸鹰，还有一辆丢失的大篷车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring back the heads of the Legionaries, and the caravan safe and sound. Each head is 75 denarii, provided I can tell who I'm looking at.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把军团的人头带回来，让商队安然无恙。每个人头75第纳尔，前提是我能认出我看到的是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have four contracts. Two deserted Legionaries named Serratus and Screaming Eagle. And a lost caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有四份合同。两名逃跑的军团士兵，名叫锡兰杜英和啸鹰，还有一辆丢失的大篷车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring back the heads of the Legionaries, and the caravan safe and sound.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把军团的人头带回来，让商队安然无恙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might be, if you give me their names.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有可能，只要你告诉我他们的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？
