ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Velvet Ditch. Moletown's Mushroom Coffee Cafe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是天鹅绒沟，鼹鼠镇的蘑菇咖啡馆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just make the coffee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是煮咖啡的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you build this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方是你建的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the face of it, the NCR is as good as it gets. Clean water. Good harvests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从表面上看，NCR已经很好了。干净的水，好收成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion? heh. I try not to think of them at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团？呵呵，我尽量不去想它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不知道自己在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我一些东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seeya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clean water's a monopoly. Good harvests are for the Barons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干净的水被垄断，好收成是贵族们的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: For a mighty few, it's a paradise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对少数人来说，它是天堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the face of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 从表面上看？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Have you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，你呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever been?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much is worse than a hole in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有什么比地上的洞更糟糕的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's certainly not perfect, but it's better than here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它当然不完美，但比这里好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sound like you're speaking from experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你很有经验。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Shady Sands, maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在沙荫镇，也许吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: People in the countryside might disagree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 农村的人可能不这么认为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wrong. The NCR is the best nation on earth. Everyone has the same opportunity to succeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你错了。NCR是世界上最好的国家，每个人都有同样的机会获得成功。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Did you have further business to discuss?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你还有别的事要谈吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dont worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Used to be country doctor. Seen all sorts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前是乡村医生，见过各种各样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a lot of success stories out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有多少成功的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: The countryside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 农村？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they're struggling, it's because they're not trying hard enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们在挣扎，那是因为他们不够努力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, the frontier towns aren't as developed, but they'll catch up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，边境城镇没有那么发达，但他们会赶上来的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Long days. Lots of walking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漫长的日子，要走很多路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was hard, but I liked it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然很难，但我喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways....
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You used to be a doctor? What was that like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是个医生？是什么样子的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: None that you'd want to hear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有一个是你想听的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anywho. How can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。我能帮你什么忙吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any stories from the countryside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有关于农村的故事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No can do. Too shaky nowadays.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无能为力，现在太不稳定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hurt. Can you treat me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受伤了，你能给我治疗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lets talk about something else
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing wrong with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这没什么不好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I left my hometown too early. I sure wish I spent a bit more time there when I could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我离开家乡太早了，我真希望我能在那里多呆一会儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. Up until recently, I never really left my home town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不完全是。直到最近我才真正离开我的家乡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry kid, but you'd need to be a centenarian to have done all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，孩子，但你得是个百岁老人才能做到这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you're President Tandi, or me, I doubt you've seen even a tenth of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你是坦蒂总统，或者我，否则我怀疑你连其中的十分之一都没看过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've traveled through most of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大部分地区我都去过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Small towns are the real heart of the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小城镇是NCR的真正核心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ive been to some of it. Mostly smaller towns
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去过一些地方，主要是小城镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just making conversation, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是随便聊聊，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not very good at this, are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不太擅长这个，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thats none of your business. Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's hoping you screw up less than I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你能比我少搞砸一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know the feeling. I'm on my own sort of adventure right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道那种感觉，我现在正在进行自己的冒险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not important. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不重要。你要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that. Where's your home town? Close by?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这个消息我很难过。你的家乡在哪里？近吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: More like running to something. New lands, adventure. Strange undiscovered cultures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更像是奔向什么东西。新的土地，冒险，陌生的未知文化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was a long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是很久以前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why'd you leave so early? Were you running from something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么离开得这么早？你是在逃避什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Until you have proven yourself worthy of it, the fourth contract will be withheld from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你证明自己配得上它之前，第四份合约将不会给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's three.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是三个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is, unfortunately, unacceptable. The legate's word is the law. Go back and kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，这是不可接受的。特使的话就是法律，回去杀了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Screaming Eagle wants to return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啸鹰想要回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the deserters. He was due to be punished for delivering a cargo of Sunset Sasparilla to the legate's tent too early in the morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃兵之一。他本应受到惩罚，因为他一大早就把一批夕阳沙士送到了特使的帐篷里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is likely in the vicinity of the Rusty Hooks. Ask them about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能就在锈钩帮附近，问问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Screaming Eagle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啸鹰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is, unfortunately, unacceptable. The legate's word is the law. Go back and kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，这是不可接受的。特使的话就是法律，回去杀了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serratus wants to return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡兰杜英想回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the deserters. He fled north after demanding a post closer to battle and being denied by the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃兵之一。他要求在离战场更近的地方驻防，但遭到了特使的拒绝，于是逃往北方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He possesses blond hair and green eyes. Search around the Arizona Spillway for where he might have gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有金色的头发和绿色的眼睛。在亚利桑那泄洪道周围搜索他可能去了哪里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serratus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡兰杜英。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's a simple job. The caravan was probably attacked by hostile wildlife in the vicinity of Tres Leches Caravan headquarters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这是份简单的工作。商队可能在三人行商队总部附近遭到了敌对野生动物的袭击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Long enough, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够久了，我猜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, pal. I believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，伙计，我相信你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling the truth. I've been all over the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是实话，我到处都去过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they're old lands now. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，它们现在是旧土地了。你要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: "New lands?" Where'd you go?
ESP.TRADUIT: "新的土地？"你去哪了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A whole lot of walking. Slightly less violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走了很多路，稍微不那么暴力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most times it was self-defense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数时候是出于自卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Adventure?" What did you do?
ESP.TRADUIT: “冒险？”你做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter. They're long gone now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，他们早就没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了，你想要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Strange new cultures?" Who did you meet?
ESP.TRADUIT: "陌生的新文化？"你遇到了谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't control me. I come and go as I please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们控制不了我。我想来就来，想走就走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这重要吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long ago was that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是多久以前的事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big ones, small ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大的，小的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about me, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说我了，你想要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of screw ups? Anything bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 出现了什么问题？什么坏事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too many to count.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太多了，数不清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you hurt people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你伤害过别人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't. I'm sure you won't mean any harm, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。我相信你也不会有什么恶意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't make much difference to the people getting harmed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对受到伤害的人来说也没什么区别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you didn't mean any harm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你没有恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is me getting over it. Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是在克服。现在你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've hurt people too. It happens. Get over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也伤害过别人。这种事时有发生，克服它吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想谈这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've hurt a lot of people, haven't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你伤害过很多人，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drop it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of things. Things I don't have time to talk about right now. Another time, perhaps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多事情，有些事我现在没时间跟你说。也许下次吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm telling you. Drop it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过了，停。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。现在你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll drop it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我不提了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too many. I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太多了。我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think I'm holed up here? You think I want to be living in a cave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不然你以为我为什么躲在这里？你以为我想住在山洞里吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea, do you? You're heartless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不知道，是吗？你真没心没肺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个懦夫。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're just going to die here in this hole?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你就死在这个洞里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You disgust me, I hope you die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我恶心，我希望你去死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, pal, I'm sure you won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，伙计，我相信你不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a total bum. I'll never be like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是个废物，我永远不会像你一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I lost the last of it once I started this conversation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想当我开始谈话的时候，最后一点都没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you have any respect for yourself? Any integrity at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一点都不尊重自己吗？有诚信吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Says the person interrogating me. You're pretty nosy, you know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 审问我的人说这种话。你很爱管闲事，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just cut the conversation off here. Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就到此为止吧，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's pretty rude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太无礼了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我努力做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about all that, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不说这些了，你要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a funny guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个有趣的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's because I don't want to answer it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是因为我不想回答这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're dodging my question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在回避我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Answer me this: What's the worst thing you've ever done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 回答我：你做过的最糟糕的事情是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点也不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's irresponsible to worry about them all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总是担心他们是不负责任的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad for your mental health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不利于你的心理健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you think thats a bit irresponsible?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不觉得那有点不负责任吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to be the same. After awhile you get used to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也是这样，过一段时间你就习惯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How could you possibly not think about them? They're a constant threat on my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么可能不去想他们呢？他们一直是我脑海中的威胁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should be worshipping them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该崇拜他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their bite certainly hurts. Seen the Legion sink its jaws into plenty people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们咬人确实很痛，我见过军团把很多人咬死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that, what can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了，你想要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is more bark than bite. You've got the right idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团就是爱叫的狗不咬人，你的想法是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a reason you're reaming me out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么理由在这里训斥我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You live a pretty sad life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的生活很悲惨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not hiding, but I also dont exactly want them to find me. Does that make sense?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是在躲，但我也不想让他们找到我。明白了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clear as mud, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 清清楚楚，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you hiding from them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在躲他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's worked so far.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止，这是有效的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep running your mouth and I'll start ignoring you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你再胡言乱语，我也会开始无视你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They control all of this territory. You can't possibly ignore them forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们控制了这片土地，你不可能永远无视他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nowhere's safer than here, friend. Thanks for the offer though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有比这里更安全的了，朋友。不过还是谢谢你的好意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about me, whats a puppyheaded berk like you doing with something like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说我了，像你这样的蠢货怎么会有这种东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. I could get you somewhere safer if you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记。如果你愿意，我可以带你去更安全的地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice try pal. That's either a fake or a find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，伙计。要么是假的，要么是偶然找到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: King Ed dont just give those things out for free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱德华国王可不会免费提供这些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was given it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是别人给我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Earned doing what? Fastest crucifixion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 做什么挣来的？最快上十字架？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cleanest toga?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最干净的长袍？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't earn shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么都没挣到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anywho. What can I grab you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。你想要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我挣来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? To hang on your wall? The thing is useless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？挂在墙上？毫无用处的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It won't protect you if they want you dead. You know that, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们想置你于死地，它也保护不了你。你知道的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must've been a pretty high-profile fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那一定是一场备受瞩目的战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who won?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁赢了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fought for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为它而战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It just sort of happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。事情就这么发生了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only a stupid asshole would carry the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有蠢货才会带着凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you just call me a stupid asshole?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚才叫我蠢货吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think we're expecting any mail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为我们会收到任何邮件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a mail monkey doing here, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 邮递猿在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a courier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个邮差。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. We're all nobodies here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们在这里都是无名小卒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a nobody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个无名小卒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, why would you serve someone like Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你为什么要服侍像凯撒这样的人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a servant of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是凯撒的仆人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you end up doing that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么会这么做？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paying back a gambling debt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 偿还赌债？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a representative of Mr. House.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是豪斯先生的代表。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Pretty far from Shady Sands. You go AWOL?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？这里离沙荫镇很远。你擅离职守了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an agent of the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是NCR的探员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all it takes to win you over, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样就能赢得你的芳心，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar is the strongest in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒是废土上最强大的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure they do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他们会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion pays well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团给的挺多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Profligate Scum" huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: "堕落的人渣"是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me ask you something. What makes a Profligate a Profligate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我来问你个问题，是什么让一个堕落者成为堕落者？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar will cleanse the wastes of Profligate scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒将清除那些堕落的人渣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm indebted to him. He saved my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我欠他一个人情，他救了我的命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Simple as that, huh? How's the pay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这么简单，是吧？工资怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's he paying you in? Caps or Casino Chips?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他付给你什么钱？瓶盖还是赌场筹码？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He contracted me to do a job. Simple as that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他委托我做一项工作，就是这么简单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what might that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in his vision for a better future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他对美好未来的憧憬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did I forget to pay my taxes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我忘记交税了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm here on official orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我是奉官方命令来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that working out for you? Get good intel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对你来说怎么样？得到好情报了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm spying for them behind lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在后方为他们做间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means whatever you want it to mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是你想让它是什么就是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that supposed to mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Damn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？该死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd sure like a love letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很想要一封情书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm not here to deliver a package.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不是来送包裹的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to forgive me for not fully believing that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请原谅我没有完全相信你的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're telling me wandered out into the desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说我跑到沙漠里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Walked into an abandoned mineshaft with a big ol' sign that says "DEATHCLAWS AHEAD" out front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我走进了一个废弃的矿井，前面有个大牌子写着"前方有死亡爪"。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Walked past *another* sign saying the same thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又走过*另一个*牌子，上面写着同样的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Opened up a locked gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打开一扇锁着的门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Squeezed past a metal shelf...
ESP.TRADUIT: 挤过一个金属架子...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...another sign...
ESP.TRADUIT: ...另一个指示牌...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...and somehow talked your way past our doorman.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...不知怎么就绕过了我们的门卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All by accident?
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是偶然？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just sort of stumbled upon this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是偶然发现了这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, uh, what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，呃，什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you sure know how to bumblefuck your way into places.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你还真是知道怎么混进别人的圈子啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll give you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得承认。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear. I really have no idea how I ended up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓。我真的不知道我是怎么来到这里的。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便了。你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't that difficult to find this place. Whoever tried to cover it up didn't try hard enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到这个地方并不难，想掩盖真相的人还不够努力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡扯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You missed three whole signs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你错过了三个指示牌？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you read?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你识字吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You *can* read, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你识字，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Must have missed the signs....
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>肯定是错过了指示牌...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有道理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would anyone send mail to some old hermit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么会有人给老隐士寄信呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calls em as I sees em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到什么就说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you calling a mail monkey?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你管谁叫邮递猿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you found one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你找到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was looking for somewhere to hideaway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想找个地方躲起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Except I'm different. Getting shot in the head only made me stronger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是我与众不同，头部中枪只会让我更坚强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You already told me your job, pal. It ain't anything luxurious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经告诉过我你的工作了，伙计，并不奢华。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, if you're so famous, then how come I don't give a damn about you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说，如果你这么有名，那我怎么一点都不在乎你呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not some errand boy. I'm *the Courier*. I'm famous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是什么跑腿的，我是*邮差*，我很有名。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right about that. I have *no* idea who I'm talking to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我完全*不*知道我在跟谁说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea who you're talking to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不知道你在跟谁说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's supposed to make you special?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就能让你与众不同吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any idea how many people I know that have been shot in the head?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我认识的人中有多少人被爆头吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did not get shot in the head doing my job just to be called a mail monkey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在工作中被爆头可不是为了被称为邮递猿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh. Some of em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵，有几个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Modern medicine at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现代医学在起作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many of them got back up after?
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后又有多少人站起来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Customer's always right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。顾客永远是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not a mail monkey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是邮递猿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. It's not important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，这并不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just not interested in your sob-story. Keep it to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是对你的哭诉故事不感兴趣。不要告诉别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you trying to one-up me? It's not a competition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想胜过我吗？这不是比赛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't tell you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能告诉你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't underestimate them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要低估他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I've learned that the Legion is weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我知道军团很虚弱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As mighty as they are, they have their weaknesses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然他们很强大，但他们也有弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A system built around one man is inherently unstable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以一个人为中心建立的体系本质上是不稳定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once King Ed's out, what then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦爱德华国王出局了，接下来怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you tell state full of warlords that their god is dead and his throne is up for grabs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要怎么告诉一个军阀林立的国家他们的神已经死了，他的王位正在被争夺？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I've learned that the Legion is strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我了解到军团很强大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not a very good spy, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你不是个好间谍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't found anything useful yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，还没找到有用的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The big guy. What's his name...
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个大块头。他名字叫什么...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ky Sar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 开撒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: King Ed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱德华国王？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That ain't his name. His name is Edward. Did you know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不是他的名字。他的名字叫爱德华，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turns out he's just a guy. "Ky Sar" is just a title or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来他只是个普通人，“开撒”只是个头衔什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you seriously just forget his name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的忘了他的名字吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're probably right, one of his cronies would likely take over. But for how long?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是对的，他的一个亲信可能会接管。但能维持多久呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And who? and where?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁呢？在哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens if some upstart in Two-Sun decides to muscle themselves in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果双日城的一些新贵决定强行加入，会发生什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's going to stop Legatus Lorem Ipsum out East deciding he wants his own slice of the cherry pie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁能阻止东方的乱数假文特使决定自己分一杯羹呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one, that's who.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人，就是那个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legate Lanius would take over for Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯特使将接替凯撒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're likely right. It'll endure until it doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是对的。它会一直存在，直到它消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing lasts forever, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有什么是永恒的，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar won't die. Even if he could die, the Legion is strong enough to endure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒不会死的。即使他会死，军团也足够强大，可以承受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I am. I hope so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我是。我希望如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're no fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你真没意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I don't know anything about politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我对政治一窍不通。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's pretty reductive, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不觉得这太简单了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's pretty reductive, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不觉得这太简单了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You haven't cracked open a history book recently, have you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最近没读过历史书吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just too big to collapse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它太大了，不可能垮掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You like it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The Velvet Ditch"? That's quite a name
ESP.TRADUIT: “天鹅绒沟”？这名字真好听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brewing coffee. Talking to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 煮咖啡，跟你说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should try it, it's good for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该试试，对你有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We use a house blend of Turkey Tail, Chaga and Golden Teacher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们用的是云芝，白桦茸和黄金老师的混合配方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dry those out, grind, 'em, mix 'em with some Cuppa Joe, and you got a brew going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把它们弄干，磨碎，然后和咖啡混合在一起，就可以煮了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mushroom coffee? I've never heard of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蘑菇咖啡？我从来没听说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's mighty kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那真是太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, keep your opinion to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你的意见还是留着吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just poking fun at my compatriots here. This little hole in the ground seems like a nice place to get stuck in. Comfy to stay, hard to leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是在这里取笑一下我的同胞。 这个地上的小洞似乎是个不错的栖身之地，呆着舒服，走着难受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A velvet ditch, heh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天鹅绒沟，呵呵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, right. What can I get you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，没错。你要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like hell I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不干呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm serious, you need to pay me your taxes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的，你得把税交给我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trametes Veriscolor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变色栓菌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a whiterot fungus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种白腐菌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turkey Tail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 云芝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Inonotus Obliquus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 桦褐孔菌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Grows on Birch and other woods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生长在桦树和其他树木上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the primary source of the coffee taste of our... er... coffee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是我们...呃...咖啡味道的主要来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chaga?
ESP.TRADUIT: 白桦茸？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Psilocybe Cubensis
ESP.TRADUIT: 古巴裸盖菇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Comes in a few varieties. Any'll do the trick though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个品种，任何一种都可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's potent stuff. We use just a bit in the brew. Just enough to keep us peppy and present.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种烈性物质。我们在酿造时只用一点点，足以让我们保持精力充沛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Golden Teacher?
ESP.TRADUIT: 黄金老师？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't doubt that he kept you alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不怀疑是他让你活下来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt that he saved your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑他没救过你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From what I heard, Mr. House don't care much about saving lives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，豪斯先生不太在乎拯救生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He literally pulled me from a grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他真的把我从坟墓里拉了出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well that was mighty kind of him I s'pose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想他真是个好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's true! He sent a robot to save my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是真的！他派了一个机器人来救我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a mighty fine dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个非常美好的梦想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who benefits though? Vegas is already strong enough to help the rest of the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但谁会受益呢？维加斯已经强大到足以帮助莫哈维的其他地区了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last I heard, all those caps from the Strip are staying on the Strip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上次我听说所有从长街来的瓶盖都要留在长街。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He believes in a Mojave that is independent of the NCR and strong enough to resist the Legion
ESP.TRADUIT: 他相信莫哈维可以独立于NCR，强大到足以抵抗军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how exactly does he plan to do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他到底打算怎么做？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a ruthless business man who will outflank the NCR and outsmart the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个冷酷无情的商人，他会包抄NCR，智取军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A free market?
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由市场？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing free about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么是自由的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who'll stop the Three Families from moving their Caps into local farms? House already controls the strip. You want him to control food as well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁来阻止三大家族把他们的瓶盖搬到当地的农场？豪斯已经控制了长街，你还想让他控制食物吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the water? The trade routes? Hope you've got the caps to pay tolls on every highway, road and dirt path in the damn Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那水呢？贸易路线呢？希望你有足够的瓶盖来支付莫哈维的每一条高速公路，道路和土路的通行费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's going to allow local commerce to flourish in a true free market.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他将允许本地商业在真正的自由市场中蓬勃发展。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of order?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么样的秩序？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what happens if folks out in the Sticks disagree on what "Order" ought to mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果偏远地区的人们对“秩序”的含义有分歧，会发生什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's going to send his Securitrons to bring order to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要派他的电子保安去废土恢复秩序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tricks can only take you so far. What sort of trick stops the NCR or the Legion knocking at the Strip Gates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妙计也只能到此为止了，有什么妙计能阻止NCR或者军团去敲长街的大门？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's got some tricks up his sleeve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他自有妙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should probably figure that out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你应该弄清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know exactly what his plan is, but he's a smart guy and must know what he's doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他到底有什么计划，但他是个聪明人，肯定知道自己在做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No such thing as "playing both sides".
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有所谓的“渔翁得利”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not for long anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正也不会太久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, one side puts their foot down and forces you to choose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，一方会坚持己见，迫使你做出选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's going to pit the NCR and the Legion against each other. Profiting from both sides.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要让NCR和军团自相残杀，渔翁得利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good for the brain. Good for the soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对大脑有益，对灵魂有益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're brewing Coffee with Magic Mushrooms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在用神奇蘑菇煮咖啡？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only it were that simple. Right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是有那么简单就好了。对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Folks don't always like being told what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们并不总是喜欢被告知该做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they know what's best for them, they won't resist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们知道什么对自己最好，他们就不会反抗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's law? House's?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁的法？豪斯的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes walking into town and telling everybody what to do so lawful?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么让走进镇上告诉每个人该做什么是合法的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those that refuse to comply are breaking the law. They'd be treated like criminals of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些拒绝遵守的人就是在犯法。当然，他们会被当作罪犯对待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't believe that, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不相信，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. House is a good man. He would never abuse his power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 豪斯先生是个好人，他决不会滥用权力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like banditry under a different name to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像是换了个名字的强盗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter if people get hurt in the process. Order is better than banditry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有人在这个过程中受伤也没关系，秩序比强盗行为好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what might that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I also believe in Caesar's mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我也相信凯撒的使命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least you're honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少你很诚实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. But it doesn't hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，但也无伤大雅。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might makes right. Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 强权即公理。当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard that plenty of times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经听过很多次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Whoever is the strongest deserves to rule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。谁最强大，谁就应该统治。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny you say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么说真有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, it's the weak ones saying that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常都是弱者这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. The weak should fear the strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。弱者就应该畏惧强者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you calling me weak?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说我是弱者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe not weak in the physical sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许在物理意义上并不弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're weak in brains, that's for sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们的大脑很弱，这是肯定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you calling the Legion weak?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说军团很弱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，别担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everybody's got their own little nickname for this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都给这地方起了外号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mine's moletown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我起的就是鼹鼠镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moletown?
ESP.TRADUIT: 鼹鼠镇？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about Optios.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于执行官就说到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never suggest that again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再提这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcellus Sedonus has his irregularities, but he is a trusted and valued member of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯有他的不合规行为，但他是军团中值得信任和重视的成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems very erratic. Would you be opposed to having him removed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他看起来很古怪。你会反对让他离开吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. He's been moving in and out of the Castra Legatus for the past two weeks. Or, so I've been told.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确如此。在过去的两周里，他一直在特使军营进进出出。或者，别人是这么告诉我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will Lanius be the one to march on Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯会是那个向胡佛水坝进军的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, this is him. Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，就是他。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to claim a bounty on Serratus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想申请对锡兰杜英的赏金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not be able to dispense the full bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不能给你全部的赏金了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to claim a bounty on Serratus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想申请对锡兰杜英的赏金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, this is him. Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，就是他。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to claim a bounty on Screaming Eagle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想申请对啸鹰的赏金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not be able to dispense the full bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不能给你全部的赏金了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to claim a bounty on Screaming Eagle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想申请对啸鹰的赏金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ominous. Did you happen to recover their cargo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不祥的预兆。你有没有找到他们的货物？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've dealt with the caravan. They've gone mad and were attacking other caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商队的事我已经解决了。他们疯了，开始袭击其他商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the thanks of the Legion. Rangers have killed scores of Legionaries over the past two decades. I only wish I had more work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对你表示感谢。在过去的二十年里，游骑兵已经杀死了许多军团士兵。我真希望有更多的工作给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ranger is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You appear to be serious. There is, unfortunately no way for me to grant you the full bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你是认真的。不幸的是，我没有办法给你全部的赏金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ranger is dead. The head's a little mangled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵死了，头有点碎了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is he dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found the Ranger. He's in a cave by Elephant Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到游骑兵了，他在象山旁边的一个山洞里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. This warrants a further reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。这值得进一步奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunate. Nevertheless, the situation has been resolved. Did you have further business with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很不幸。然而，局势已经得到解决。你们和我们还有生意来往吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunate. Nevertheless, the situation has been resolved. Did you have further business with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很不幸。然而，局势已经得到解决。你们和我们还有生意来往吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> No.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I.... You have the thanks of the Legion. You can trust me when I say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...军团对你表示感谢。你可以相信我说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all the bounties I have for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你的赏金就这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is his head? Difficult to say if you're telling the truth, but if you are, you show far more initiative than the average mercenary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他的头？很难说你是否说的是实话，但如果是的话，你比一般的雇佣兵表现得更主动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the interest of continued use of your services, I will dispense the full bounty anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了继续使用你的服务，我无论如何都会给你全部的赏金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two Rangers killed an entire cohort of Legionaries during the Solitare Insurrection with practically no assistance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在索利泰尔叛乱中，两名游骑兵在几乎没有任何援助的情况下杀死了一整群军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every Ranger has killed many, many times their number. Take them seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每一个游骑兵都杀过比他们多很多倍的人。重视他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ranger's exact location is unknown, but it is likely that Ricamore at Elephant Hill might be able to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵的确切位置尚不清楚，但象山的里卡莫尔可能会帮到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should be no problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Take the Ranger seriously. Speak to Ricamore at Elephant Hill to pinpoint his location.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，认真对待游骑兵吧。跟象山的里卡莫尔谈谈，确定他的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see why you waited.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你为什么等了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ye referrin' to the Ranger? It is a Ranger, just s'ye know. I saw him staring down from the hills. I've seen me share o' Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的是游骑兵？他是个游骑兵，你知道的。我看见他在山上盯着下面看，我见过很多游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if ye want more, that'll cost ye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你想要更多，就得付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for information on a bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找赏金的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ready to pay up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 准备好付钱了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for information on a bounty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找赏金的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Denarii is the currency o' the Legion. I'll giveya the information ye looking for in exchange for 50 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第纳尔是军团的货币。我给你你想要的信息，交换50第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much we talking here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们说的是多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This must be about the Legionary we reported in this area. Yes, he's still where we said he was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一定是我们报告过的这个地区的军团成员。是的，他还在我们说的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais sent me. They have a bounty on a Legion deserter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是马尔帕斯派来的，他们悬赏一名军团逃兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion deserters are pretty rare. Plenty of bounty hunters have attempted to kill Legionaries and pass them off as deserters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团逃兵很少见。很多赏金猎人都试图杀死军团士兵，并把他们伪装成逃兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Usually, they're crucified for that when the Legion inevitably finds out that they weren't deserters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常，当军团不可避免地发现他们不是逃兵时，他们就会被钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, he's right outside of the camp, down there. You can't miss him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，他就在营地外面，就在那里。你不会错过他的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How come you haven't taken up this bounty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不接受这个悬赏？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, figured that they would send someone eventually. Yes, he's still where we said he was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我就知道他们迟早会派人来的。是的，他还在我们说的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais sent me. They have a bounty on a Legion deserter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是马尔帕斯派来的，他们悬赏一名军团逃兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the Legion are bunch of assholes. I've never heard of a Legion deserter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为军团都是一群混蛋，我从来没听说过什么军团逃兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it is one, then how hard is it to send one guy to get one other guy? I'm keeping out of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是一个人，那派一个人去抓另一个人有多难？我不会插手的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How come you haven't taken up this bounty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不接受这个悬赏？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've no use for 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们对我没用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you take caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你收瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Ye.... Okey. The Ranger is in a cave to the south of here. I'll mark eet on ya map.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好...好吧。游骑兵在南边的一个山洞里，我会在你的地图上做个标记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance I can talk you down to 35?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能把价格降到35吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] The heck? No. 50, take it 'o' leave it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]搞什么？50，要就要不要就算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance I can talk you down to 15?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能把价格降到15吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, good luck to ye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just find him on my own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己去找他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? That cannot be. Yes, it is true that the legate was angry, but I have been a loyal Legionary my entire life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这不可能。是的，特使确实很生气，但我一生都是一名忠诚的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a bounty on you. You have angered the legate of Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被悬赏了。你激怒了马尔帕斯的特使。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Screaming Eagle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是啸鹰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am guarding this canyon for the Legion, of course.
