ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然是在为军团守卫这个峡谷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only Caesar can order my death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有凯撒才能下令处死我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> Good news! Your life is over.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>好消息！你的人生结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would appreciate that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I could ask if you could return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以问问你是否可以回去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make a choice or don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要么选择，要么放弃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Recruit Legionary [06006E21] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3F]AZFreeformSpookyCanyon) 06006E3F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会考虑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Administer the punishment as you see fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你觉得怎么惩罚就怎么惩罚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have already done that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经这么做了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not die for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会白白死去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I don't need his permission.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我不需要他的允许。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am. If my absence from Malpais was unwarranted, I would be willing to return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是。如果我离开马尔帕斯是没有理由的，我愿意回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem like a loyal Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来像个忠诚的军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I would. Come back if you have any news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想。有什么消息就回来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like me to ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我问吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brothers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> You can ask him in the hereafter.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>你可以来世再问他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah. I knew this day was coming. You are here for the bounty, correct? You should know that I am under the protection of Centurion Rufo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我知道这一天迟早会到来。你是来领赏金的，对吧？你应该知道我受到百夫长鲁夫的保护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he deems it necessary, then I am willing to let you take my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他认为有必要，那么我愿意让你夺走我的生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blond hair? Green eyes? You are Serratus, are you not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 金发？绿眼睛？你是锡兰杜英，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're back. What of the bounty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回来了，悬赏怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have no business, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就没我们的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Prime Legionary [0600634F] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Rufo, Centurion of the Arizona Spillway. So, you should know what position you are in....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是鲁夫，亚利桑那溢洪道的百夫长。所以，你应该知道自己所处的位置...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see the Mark of Caesar now. You must be that third-party that Caesar summoned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我看到凯撒的徽记了。你一定是凯撒召来的第三者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can answer questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以回答问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just a friendly courier. Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个友好的邮差。你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I am Rufo, Centurion of the Arizona Spillway. Although, I would advise you to learn more about the Legion at the Fort and Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我是鲁夫，亚利桑那溢洪道的百夫长。不过，我还是建议你多了解一下堡垒和马尔帕斯的军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This sector of the front is isolated from the rest of the front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前线的这一部分与前线的其余部分是分开的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. I am taking the opportunity to learn about the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记。我想借此机会了解一下军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good news, but unfortunately, I have nothing for you. This sector will likely not see combat until the battle for the dam continues.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好消息，但很遗憾，我没有什么可以给你的。在大坝争夺战继续之前，这一地区可能不会出现战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Rufo, Centurion of the Arizona Spillway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是鲁夫，亚利桑那溢洪道的百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am here to serve the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来为军团服务的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He deserted?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他逃跑了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a deserter from Malpais by the name of Serratus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个马尔帕斯的逃兵，他叫锡兰杜英。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A pity, but I understand. He's over there. My men will not interfere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾，但我能理解。他在那里，我的人不会干涉的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus has marked Serratus for death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯已经把锡兰杜英标记为死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guarding this spillway, fool. My forces are preparing for the upcoming battle with the Profligates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 守着这个泄洪道，傻瓜。我的部队正在为即将到来的与放荡者的战斗做准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR spread itself thin during exercises, and were weak to a night attack. Morons.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR在演习中分散兵力，在夜袭面前不堪一击。白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good question. I have been expecting this for the last week. I believe that doing so would require diverting enormous amounts of power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好问题，我上个星期就盼着这个了。我认为，这样做将需要转移大量的电力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR must be refusing to do so due to political pressure. Their lack of discipline regarding and dependence on power will be their undoing.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR一定是迫于政治压力而拒绝这么做的。他们缺乏纪律和对权力的依赖将导致他们的毁灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why doesn't the NCR just open the spillway gates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么NCR不直接打开泄洪道的闸门？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The exterior of the spillway is a poor defensive position. The NCR were fools to hold it for so long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 泄洪道的外部是一个糟糕的防御位置。NCR真是愚蠢，竟然坚持了这么久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius has recognized it as such, and he has so ordered a withdrawal from the space between the spillway and the Castra Legatus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯已经意识到了这一点，并下令从泄洪道和特使军营之间的地方撤退。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There aren't any Legionaries on the surface.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地面上没有任何军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rufo [06006E1D] (mod) Quest : ([06006E3E]AZFreeformArizonaSpillway) 06006E3E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion guards and caravaneers have been removed in the area around Elephant Hill for the past three weeks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在过去的三周里，象山附近的军团卫兵和商队已经被撤离。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All reports indicate that it is a black demon, a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的报告都表明那是一个黑恶魔，一个游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I've completed the initial three bounties. What was the fourth one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我已经完成了最初的三个悬赏。第四个是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, forgive me if I don't believe you. Wait, what's that around your neck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，如果我不相信你，请原谅我。等等，你脖子上那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really did just wander in here by accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的是无意中进来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ranger is in a cave to the south of here. I'll mark eet on ya map.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵在南边的一个山洞里，我会在地图上做个记号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Here's your coin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这是你的硬币。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有了再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那么多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By Mars! This is.... The full reward will be dispensed at once. It's a pity that I don't have any further work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯在上！这是...全部奖金将立即发放。很遗憾，我没有进一步的工作给你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have his armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有他的盔甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A pity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真遗憾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I have no further proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我没有进一步的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A pity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真遗憾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no further proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有进一步的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unacceptable. My Legionaries are precious. Every single one of them will be needed for the march on Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无法接受。我的军团士兵很宝贵，他们每一个人都需要参加胡佛大坝的战役。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back and kill the Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回去杀了游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, but you have the location, so my work here is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，但你知道地点，所以我的工作结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not. You're a mercenary. You are expendable. I will not spare even a single Legionary. Let alone the entire cohort I would need to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不。你是个雇佣兵，你是可以牺牲的。我不会放过哪怕一个军团士兵，更不用说杀掉他所需要的所有人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go back and kill the Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回去杀了游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I'm not precious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不珍贵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Let me be clear here. Go back and finish him, or your life is forfeit. This should be no issue for Caesar's chosen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样吗？我先说清楚，回去杀了他，不然你就没命了。这对凯撒的选民来说应该不是问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Complete your duty and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。完成你的任务，回到我这里来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll go back and kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会回去杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries! At arms!
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵！拿起武器！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm not doing it, and that's final.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不干，就这么定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. You have served Caesar in other ways. I will consider our business at an end. Just know that I consider you a coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你也曾以其他方式侍奉过凯撒，我认为我们的交易就此结束。你要知道，我认为你是个懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm not doing it, and that's final.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不干，就这么定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is still around, and your Rangers aren't.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR还在，你的游骑兵却不在了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... What to say about it? It's the annihilation of our culture, our way of life. How's that for what I think about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...该怎么说呢？这是对我们的文化，我们的生活方式的毁灭。我对它的看法如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even consider it a treaty. How can it be a treaty when the NCR didn't hold their end of the stick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不认为这是一个条约。当NCR没有履行他们的义务时，它怎么能成为一个条约呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm told that the NCR put a statue of us out west. Never been. Don't think I ever will. It'll probably just piss me off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说NCR在西部建了一座我们的雕像。从来没去过，我想我永远也不会去。这可能只会让我生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Ranger Unification Treaty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说游骑兵统一条约。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The New California Republic, as represented by Chief Elise and Josh Hanlon, do solemnly swear to accept the Desert Rangers into the ranks of the NCR Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: “新加州共和国，由伊莉斯军士长和乔什·汉隆代表，郑重宣誓接受沙漠游骑兵加入NCR游骑兵队伍。"
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In exchange for their agreement to follow orders from, and subordinate themselves to, the NCR, the NCR will hereby support to the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: “作为他们同意服从NCR的命令并从属于NCR的交换，NCR将在此支持游骑兵。“
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the preamble. I have the whole fucking thing memorized. Fat lot of good it does me. I don't think the NCR even read it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是序言，我他妈的都背下来了。这对我一点好处也没有，我觉得NCR根本没读过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somehow, we held up our end of the deal, and the other side didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知怎么的，我们遵守了协议，而对方却没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the treaty? Like, what's in it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 条约是什么？比如，里面有什么内容？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想谈政治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to cook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想做饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这次选举有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's what the Legion tells me to do, so I do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团让我这么做，我就这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll beat me to death if I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不，他们会把我打死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you only cook for merchants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么只给商人做饭？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dolan Springs is the edge of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰泉是军团的边缘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's sandwiched between two mountains, Perkins and Tipton, on either side. To the north, is some old war ruins. Legion says it's a no-go zone though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它被夹在珀金斯山和蒂普顿山之间。北面是一些古老的战争废墟，军团说那是禁区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说多兰泉。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR are nothing but a bunch of weak liars.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR只不过是一群软弱的骗子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They pulled out of Arizona like it was nothing. Left us, me, for dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们若无其事地撤离了亚利桑那。丢下我们，丢下我，等死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll get what's coming to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会有报应的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been West of the Dam. I barely know anything about the man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没去过大坝西边，我对这个人几乎一无所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If a real customer comes, the conversation ends. You understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果真正的客户来了，对话就结束。你明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask you some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问你几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult controls the food in town. Before the merchants started settling in, if you wanted to eat, you had to pray in the temple.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上的食物都是教团控制的。在商人们安顿下来之前，如果你想吃东西，你必须在神殿里祈祷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard there's a Super Mutant lurking up in the hills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说有个超级变种人潜伏在山上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wonder where he's hiding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道他藏在哪里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head to the Big Dog if you're hungry. It's not as good as my food, but it's all you can buy in town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你饿了，就去大狗餐厅。虽然比不上我做的好吃，但在镇上也只能买到这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay away from the tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远离高塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up north, there's some Pre-War facility, some folks say it's haunted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 北边有个战前设施，有人说那里闹鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've had a big Mole Rat problem lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最近有个很大的鼹鼠问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All these new folks in town rile them up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上新来的这些人把它们激怒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend at the quarry nearby told me the road to the Fort is out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近采石场的一个朋友告诉我，去堡垒的路断掉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't imagine the Legion likes that too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢想象军团会喜欢这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some old guy built a junk bunker just outside of town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个老家伙在城外建了个垃圾掩体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never met him, but I wouldn't cross him if I were you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从没见过他，但如果我是你就不会惹他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, nothing new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，没什么新的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not for squeamish outsiders like you. But, I'll say this. His attempts to make new ghouls aren't through radiation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不适合像你这样神经脆弱的外来者。但是，我要说的是，他制造新食尸鬼的尝试并不是通过辐射。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, I think that.... Nevermind. Not like I can do anything while I'm here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候，我觉得...算了，我在这里也做不了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What type of eccentricities?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么类型的怪癖？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, Belle? Supposedly, some nutjob from Colorado eloped with her. Can't imagine anyone wanting to play with a smoothskin like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，贝儿？据说有个科罗拉多的疯子跟她私奔了，无法想象有谁想和你这样的滑皮一起玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes me sick just thinking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想就觉得恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen some of those new Born Ghouls the good doc trots around, though. They don't look "born" to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是见过一些医生带着的新出生的食尸鬼。在我看来，他们并不是 "天生"的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the ghoul girl you mentioned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的那个食尸鬼女孩后来怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is. I'm honestly surprised that a dumbass smoothskin even knows what New Mexico is, so good for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的。我真的很惊讶一个蠢蛋竟然知道新墨西哥是什么，真不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Los Alamos is in New Mexico, right? I've been out that way before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 洛斯阿拉莫斯在新墨西哥州，对吧？我以前去过那里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just call it ABQ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就叫ABQ好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Alb...? An Albu.... An Albuq....
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是阿尔巴...？阿尔布...阿尔布克...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen close. Only going to say this once. Albuquerque's got a crapton of names now. Albuquerque is its correct name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细听，我只说一次。阿尔伯克基现在有一大堆名字，只有阿尔伯克基是正确的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since the city got overrun by tribals, it's been called Albosqkayqe. The final syllable can be said as "key," "kay" and "kuh".
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从这座城市被部落占领以来，它被称为Albosqkayqe。最后一个音节可以说成“key”、“kay”和“kuh”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The people who lived there were lazy, and sometimes, they just called it "El Burque".
ESP.TRADUIT: 住在那里的人很懒，有时，他们就叫它“艾尔伯克”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion took it over and is Latinizing it to "Albus Quercus," which is just a stupid name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团接管了它，然后把它的名字拉丁化为"阿尔布斯奎勒库斯"，这名字太蠢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, actually, sometimes the military still call it "High River". So, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，实际上，有时军方仍然称其为“高河”。所以，无所谓了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of the other traders can keep up with all this shit. They just it call ABQ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他商人都跟不上这些破玩意，他们就叫ABQ。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got all that, smoothskin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了吗，滑皮？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay? But what is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，好吧？但它是什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh.... I once had a brother like you, before I was a ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢...在我变成食尸鬼之前，我也有个像你这样的兄弟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay, kid. Just call it ABQ. I promise no one will make fun of you for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没事的，孩子。就叫ABQ吧，我保证没有人会因此而取笑你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me no understood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没搞懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Stick to calling it ABQ. Idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能。就叫ABQ吧，白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, ABQ is also called Albosq.... Albosqk.... I'm sorry, but can you go over it again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，ABQ也叫阿尔伯斯...阿尔伯斯克...对不起，你能再说一遍吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it isn't. Maybe, you're one of the good ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不是的。也许你是比较擅长的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes sense to me. Albuquerque isn't that hard to say once you know how.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说很有意义。只要知道怎么念，阿尔伯克基也没那么难说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在感兴趣了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that job offer....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于那份工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go talk to my partner Beth. She'll give you the lot of displacer gloves -- if she's in a good mood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和我的搭档贝丝谈谈。如果她心情好，她会给你一堆置换拳套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, why did you ask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么要问？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's this again. I don't have any need for unarmed weapons. The Praetorians already have enough ballistic fists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，又来了。我不需要徒手武器，禁卫军已经有足够的暴怒钢拳了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would we downgrade to inferior weapons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们为什么要降级使用劣质武器？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank and Beth sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克和贝丝派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank and Beth sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克和贝丝派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We already trade the space and comfort that guns provide for instilling inner strength that the blade gives us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经用枪支提供的空间和舒适感换取了刀剑赋予我们的内在力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unarmed weapons are useless. And Displacer gloves? Profligate technology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 徒手武器毫无用处，还有置换拳套？堕落者的技术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen the Legion use melee weapons. Can't they use these?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过军团使用近战武器，他们不能用这些吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar wears one of these. I've seen it for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒就戴着这个，我亲眼所见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are parasites. They supply us the bare minimum as tribute. If only we had beaten them, then things would be different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是寄生虫，他们只提供给我们最低限度的贡品。如果我们打败了他们，事情就会不同了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your deal with them, anyways?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和他们到底是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh, sure, why not? The market price for a Mark II BeatCo Hi-Power Displacer Glove is, the hell you wastelanders use, caps? 3,500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，当然可以，为什么不呢？BeatCoⅡ型高功率置换拳套的市场价格是，你们这些废土人用的是什么来着？3500瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I'll give you a markdown for, I dunno, 3,200. More than fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我给你打个折，大概3200吧。非常公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to buy a Displacer Glove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买一个置换拳套。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 感兴趣？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to buy a Displacer Glove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买一个置换拳套。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我就要它了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, come back when you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那就等你有了再来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am interested, but I don't have the money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感兴趣，但是我没有钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, that's that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Reservation is surrounded by an invisible death that kills through the air.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保留地被一种无形的死亡包围着，它通过空气杀人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They worked to spread it, contaminating our slave stock. So, we marched to stop them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们散播病毒，污染了我们的奴隶。所以，我们进军去阻止他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The air killed scores of our troops. The ghouls brought out thunder-shells that destroyed the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天空杀死了我们几十名士兵，食尸鬼发射的雷弹摧毁了地面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, we did take control of the rail lines outside the toxic air. They couldn't leave, but we couldn't enter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们确实控制了污染空气之外的铁路线。他们无法离开，但我们也进不去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we negotiated a treaty. It won't last. This is obvious to everyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我们谈判了一个条约。这不会持续太久的，这显而易见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beaten them in what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 打败他们什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's difficult. None of the targets' exact locations are known to us. Well, except the caravan, they radioed in their position.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很难，我们还不知道这些目标的确切位置。嗯，除了商队，他们用无线电报告了自己的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, tell me about my targets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，告诉我我的目标是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only reason I'm humoring you is because of your personal service to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我迁就你的唯一原因是你为凯撒效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Tell me something that the ghouls didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，跟我说点食尸鬼没说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, this is a deal in which the Legion can only benefit. Just hear me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，这是一笔只会让军团受益的交易。听我说完。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if you're interested at any point, I'll be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果你有兴趣的话，随时都可以找我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have a stock of Power Fists that I'm reserving for the battle at Hoover Dam, but that's it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为胡佛大坝之战准备了一些动力拳套，但就这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unarmed is a special technique that requires time for specialized training that we simply do not have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 徒手是一种特殊的技巧，需要时间进行专门的训练，而我们根本没有时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you really not have any unarmed weapons in your stock at all? This is high-end equipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的库存里真的没有任何徒手武器吗？这可是高端装备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] As a preventative measure? That argument has merit. I will purchase half of your lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]作为一种预防措施？这个观点有点道理。我会买你一半的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't buy them, then they'll sell them to someone else, possibly outside the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不买，他们就会卖给其他人，很可能是军团之外的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] We're not in Santa Fe, and if it's such a great deal, then why haven't they sold it already? Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我们又不在圣菲，如果真的很划算，那他们为什么还没卖出去？不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a great deal. Best in Santa Fe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的很划算，这都是圣菲最好的货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Ah.... Very well. The whole lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]啊...很好，所有的都要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've already agreed that the gloves have merit. Why not the whole batch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都认为拳套是有价值的，为什么不直接买整批？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Don't think you can browbeat me into submission like one of our slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]别以为你能像吓唬奴隶一样吓我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, deal's off. Inform the corpses that I'm not interested. Any further attempts to sell here will be stopped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 准确的说，交易取消。告诉那些尸体我不感兴趣，任何在此出售的企图都将被阻止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With force.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用武力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the whole lot or nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要么全买，要么全不买。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Is that really it? We've already practiced a number of those techniques for melee training.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]真的是这样吗？我们已经在近战搏击训练中练习了很多这些技巧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Centurions would be familiar with those, at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少百夫长应该对这些很熟悉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will purchase half of your lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我会买你一半的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am very familiar with the use of unarmed weapons. The techniques are not so complicated. Observe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常熟悉徒手武器的使用，这些技巧并不复杂。仔细观察。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Spoken as a man who has never been in close-quarters combat. Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]作为一个从未参加过近距离战斗的人来说，不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, you run up to the enemy and punch them. Not hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，你跑到敌人面前，给他们一拳。不难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't. Leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你没有。离我远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do have business acumen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实有商业头脑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't give a rat's ass who you know. Asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不管你认识谁呢。混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look here, bitch. I have a goddamn in with Caesar. Are you really going to throw that away?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，婊子。我跟凯撒有关系，你真的要扔掉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The hell you are. You try that, and I will fry your ass into next Sunday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈谁啊。你敢试试，我让你看不到下周日的太阳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just going to steal the damn gloves and sell them myself. Make a nice deal with Hank.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去偷那该死的拳套然后自己卖掉，跟汉克好好做笔生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dr. Clark give me strength.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克拉克博士，给我力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you really so deadset on this? I'll give you the damn gloves. Talk to the armorer. Name of Red Rivers. When you're done, go bother Hank.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的这么死脑筋吗？我把那该死的拳套给你，你去跟军械师谈谈。他叫红河，完事了去烦汉克吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, leave me alone!
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，离我远点！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Except you can't do that. I have the Mark of Caesar. Killing me is off-limits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你不能这么做。我有凯撒的徽记，杀我是不允许的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Inform the corpses that we have an accord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，告诉尸体们我们达成协议了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Half the lot works for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一半对我有用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I can make an exception for someone like you, but I am not happy about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我可以为像你这样的人破例，但我对此并不高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will purchase half of their stock. No exceptions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将购买他们一半的存货，没有例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion Rep] Look, I have the best interests of the Legion in mind. Buy these weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]听着，我是为军团的利益着想的。买这些武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! How did it go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！怎么样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've spoken to Red Rivers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和红河谈过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better than I could have asked for. I was right about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我想的还要好，我没看错你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let my partner know. Maybe, smoothskins aren't so bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会告诉我的搭档的。也许，滑皮并没有那么糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever become a ghoul, look us up at The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你哪天变成了食尸鬼，到保留地来找我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be coming back and forth. You might see us at the old checkpoint to Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会来来回回，你可能会在去金曼的旧检查站看到我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He agreed to purchase the whole lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他同意买下整批货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better than I could have asked for. I was right about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我想的还要好，我没看错你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let my partner know. Maybe, smoothskins aren't so bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会告诉我的搭档的。也许，滑皮并没有那么糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever become a ghoul, look us up at The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你哪天变成了食尸鬼，到保留地来找我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be coming back and forth. You might see us at the old checkpoint to Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会来来回回，你可能会在去金曼的旧检查站看到我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and about the graffiti artist, you can find him at the Legion camp near the billboard at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，关于那个涂鸦艺术家，你可以晚上在广告牌附近的军团营地找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He agreed to purchase the whole lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他同意买下整批货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Half? That sucks, but we're probably not going to get a better deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一半？这太糟糕了，但我们可能找不到更好的生意了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be back and forth. You might see us at the checkpoint to Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会来来回回，你可能会在去金曼的检查站看到我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He agreed to purchase half of the lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他同意买下这批货的一半。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Half? That sucks, but we're probably not going to get a better deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一半？这太糟糕了，但我们可能找不到更好的生意了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll be back and forth. You might see us at the checkpoint to Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会来来回回，你可能会在去金曼的检查站看到我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and about the graffiti artist, he's some kid from Newt. I've seen him sneaking around the billboard up there at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，还有那个涂鸦艺术家，他是纽特的一个小孩。我看到他晚上在广告牌附近鬼鬼祟祟的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He agreed to purchase half of the lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他同意买下这批货的一半。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. My partner was right about you. Lack of business acumen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我了解了。我的搭档没看错你，缺乏商业头脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm heading to Dolan Springs. Don't expect any further work. Prick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去多兰泉。别指望有更多的工作了，讨厌鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The deal went bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生意失败了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the Bighorners?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大角羊怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obviously not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't know how, it's because you're a smoothbrain and a smoothskin. Actually, that's redundant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不知道怎么做，那是因为你的大脑和皮肤一样光滑。实际上，这是多余的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any other stupid questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么愚蠢的问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't Bighorners impossible to tame for caravan work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大角羊不是不可能被驯服来做商队的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I told Finturus about this. I bet it was Flemus! He's a painter. Let me know when you get some proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我跟芬图勒斯说过了。我打赌是弗勒慕斯！他是个画家。有了证据就告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finturus is looking for someone leaving anti-Legion graffiti. Any thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 芬图勒斯在找留下反军团涂鸦的人，有什么想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, darn. Well, he must be up to something else. Keep looking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，可恶，他肯定另有图谋。继续找。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looked into the graffiti. Wasn't Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看了看涂鸦，不是弗勒慕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll look into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我会调查一下的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, of course not. You need to go find it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然没有。你得去找。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, do you have any proof?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你有证据吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't have time to gossip with smoothskins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的没时间跟滑皮闲聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for leads on a graffiti artist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个涂鸦艺术家的线索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care about rumors, let alone smoothskin rumors. Now buzz off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不关心谣言，更不用说关于滑皮的谣言了。快走开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything about Flemus and Arceus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道弗勒慕斯和阿尔克修斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My memory ain't what it used to be. It needs some persuading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的记忆力大不如前了，需要一些说服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for information regarding a graffiti artist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找关于涂鸦艺术家的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Change your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 改变主意了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for information regarding a graffiti artist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找关于涂鸦艺术家的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have time to keep tabs on every two-bit Legionary. Nobody except the kids have time for gossip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没时间盯着每一个微不足道的军团士兵。除了孩子们，没人有时间八卦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything about Flemus and Arceus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道弗勒慕斯和阿尔克修斯的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, this is about Finturus, isn't it? I already told him that it was more likely for it to be one of the kids in Newt than one of the soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是关于芬图勒斯的事吧？我已经告诉他了，更有可能是纽特的一个小孩，而不是士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for information on someone leaving anti-Legion graffiti?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找有人留下反军团涂鸦的信息？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flemus? Graffiti is not his preferred style. It's neoclassical. He's much more mature than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯吗？涂鸦不是他喜欢的风格。那是新古典主义，他比那成熟多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't have trusted him to paint my flag otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则我也不会让他来画我的旗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Flemus? He's a painter. Maybe he knows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那弗勒慕斯呢？他是个画家，也许他知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caps? No. The currency at The Reservation is the American dollar. Only valid form of currency, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瓶盖？不，保留地的流通货币是美元。唯一有效的货币形式，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell you what you want to know for 250 fat stacks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我两百五十美元，我就告诉你你想知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many caps do I need to rattle that information out of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要用多少个瓶盖才能让你说出这个信息？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a kid from Newt who leaves graffiti at the Legion camp near the billboard. You can catch him there at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个纽特的小孩在军团营地附近的广告牌涂鸦，你晚上可以在那里找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢您的惠顾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your money. What do you know about the graffiti artist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你钱。关于那个涂鸦艺术家，你知道些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need some cash, then I have some work for you. Got a delivery I need help with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要现金，我可以给你点工作。我有个快递需要帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那么多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want this information before I go feral, you'll pay up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想在我发飙之前知道这些，你就得付钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll find it out myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己会弄清楚的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been to Base Camp. My mom won't let me go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没去过大本营，我妈妈不让我去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Tix might know! Talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！蒂克斯可能知道！跟他聊聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking information about a slave from Base Camp. His name is Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在查一个来自大本营的奴隶的信息，他的名字叫弗勒慕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's my friend. We used to play together, but he's busy being a soldier. He's so cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是我的朋友。我们以前经常在一起玩，但他现在忙着当兵。他很酷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Tix?
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂克斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt it. The slave's joints are bad. He is probably not sneaking around at night because of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。这个奴隶的关节不好，可能是因此才在晚上看起来鬼鬼祟祟的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia's a good slave, but she doesn't know what she's talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅是个好奴隶，但她不知道自己在说什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why she's a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么她是个奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia thinks Flemus is up to something. Maybe, he's the vandal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅认为弗勒慕斯在密谋什么。也许，他就是破坏分子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Finturus sent you. I don't really want to get anyone in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是芬图勒斯派你来的。我真的不想给任何人惹麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for information about a graffiti artist here at the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找营地里一个涂鸦艺术家的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for information about a graffiti artist here at the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找营地里一个涂鸦艺术家的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but I didn't do it. I haven't left the camp at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，但不是我干的。我根本没离开过营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a painter. You're a slave. That makes you suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个画家，你是个奴隶。这让你很可疑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that's good. I think it's such a big thing over nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那就好。我觉得这件事太小题大做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it isn't one of the other slaves. Arceus showed me the graffiti and asked what I thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道不是其他奴隶干的。阿尔克修斯给我看了那些涂鸦，问我有什么想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The paint for the graffiti was synthetic. Uh, oils. Our dyes are crushed bugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 涂鸦用的颜料是合成的，呃，油。我们的染料是碾碎的虫子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very precise, though. Doesn't look like it was hand-painted, so maybe a paint gun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过非常精确，看起来不像是手绘的，所以会不会是喷漆枪？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I don't know anything else. And I have to get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我不知道别的了。我得回去工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you need to tell me everything you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你得把你知道的都告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, this. Finturus has come through a couple of times asking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这个，芬图勒斯已经问过好几次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think it's anyone here. No one would be that stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得不是这里的人，没人会那么蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a graffiti artist about. Any thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近有个涂鸦艺术家。有什么想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you no one here would be that stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过了，这里没人会那么蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a graffiti artist about. Any thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近有个涂鸦艺术家。有什么想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Painters? Tix used to be a painter, but he's in the Legion now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 画家？蒂克斯以前是个画家，但他现在加入了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So did Timothy, but he's not here anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂莫西也是，但他已经不在了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Other than that, no one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there any painters in Newt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特有画家吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to say. Legion came in and demanded soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么可说的，军团进来征兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Promised they would take care of the kids' families. Tix volunteered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们承诺会照顾孩子们的家庭，蒂克斯自告奋勇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His mother died a month ago of heat stroke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的母亲一个月前死于中暑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I told him, he only looked sad for a minute before he said that he would kill as many Profligates as he could for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我告诉他的时候，他只难过了一分钟就说他会为了她杀死尽可能多的放荡者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't want to know about the Legion did to him to make him that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不想知道军团对他做了什么让他变成这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Tix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说蒂克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Timothy is Pablo's father. Or was. He was conscripted by the Legion and sent to a place called Nelson.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂莫西是巴勃罗的父亲，或者说曾经是。他被军团征召到一个叫纳尔逊的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to sell his paintings to the Mormons up north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他过去常把画卖给北方的摩门教徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isabela's been forced to pick up more farm work. Poor thing, but it's not like I can tell her to stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊莎贝拉不得不承担更多的农活。可怜的孩子，但我又不能让她停下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Timothy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说蒂莫西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finturus really needs to learn to relax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 芬图勒斯真的需要学会放松。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like the graffiti. The soldiers like the graffiti. Mars likes the graffiti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢涂鸦，士兵们喜欢涂鸦。玛尔斯喜欢涂鸦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's art. It's beautiful. It's pleasing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是艺术，很美丽，很令人愉悦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know who leaves it, and I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道是谁留下的，我也不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like you're in charge here. Someone's been leaving graffiti around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来是这里的负责人，有人在这附近涂鸦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another ignorant Dissolute. We may not see battle here, but we keep watch on the Profligates. That is enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又一个无知的浪荡子。我们在这里可能看不到战争，但我们在监视那些放荡者。这就足够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here? This seems a pretty slow post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？这似乎是一个升迁相当缓慢的岗位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another Dissolute needing education on their place in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又一个需要教育他们在这个世界上的地位的浪荡子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, I will educate you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我会教你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is the Legion. All soldiers in Caesar's service are Legion, from the lowly child to the high legates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是军团。所有为凯撒服务的士兵都是军团，从低微的孩子到高阶的特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion, of course, elevates wastelanders, even those not in the Legion. Caesar is generous. Those in our territory are Liberti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，军团也会提升废土人的地位，即使他不是军团成员。凯撒很慷慨，在我们领土上的人是自由民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, there are those Caesar has yet to teach. Those outside his mortal realm. They are the Dissolute. Some Dissolute may be elevated. Some may not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，还有那些尚未受到凯撒教导的人，那些在他的尘世之外的人，他们是浪荡子。有些浪荡子可能会被提升，有些可能不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those who can be elevated can become Liberti or Legionaries or even slaves. Slaves can find honor as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些可以被提升的人能够成为自由民、军团士兵甚至奴隶。奴隶也能获得荣誉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, there are those Dissolute who believe themselves civilized and actually view us as evil. They have to be reeducated with greater difficulty. Those are Profligates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，还有一些，他们认为自己是文明的，实际上却把我们看成是邪恶的。他们接受再教育的难度更大，那些就是放荡者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And finally, there are those that can only be killed. No redemption, no honor, nothing of value. Degenerates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后，有些人只能被杀死。没有救赎，没有荣誉，没有任何价值。堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on. Is there a difference between the Dissolute and Profligates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，浪荡子和放荡者之间有区别吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of my brothers haven't been properly educated like I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一些兄弟并不像我一样接受过良好的教育。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sent here when I corrected my Centurion on the proper words to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被派到这里是因为我纠正了我的百夫长说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He called a Profligate a degenerate, and that was obviously wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他把放荡者称为堕落者，这显然是错误的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But some Legionaries call me degenerate and others Profligate. What is the difference?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但有些军团成员叫我堕落者，有些人叫我放荡者。有什么区别？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't humiliation! It was education. I educated him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是羞辱！是教育，我教育了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you to be clear, you were sent to this post because you humiliated a superior?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你得说清楚，你被派到这个职位是因为你羞辱了上级？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh.... You cannot show this to the Legion. People will get killed because of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢...你不能把这个给军团看，会有人因此丧命的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you hand this over to me, I'll pay you. 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你把这个交给我，我就付钱给你。100瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I found Pablo's paint gun. Pretty sure this is being used to leave the graffiti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我找到巴勃罗的喷漆枪了，我很确定这就是用来涂鸦的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance I can stop you? 100 caps isn't so bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能阻止你吗？100瓶盖也不错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about the paint gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈喷漆枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? I, uh, don't know what to say. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？我，呃，不知道该说什么。谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can have it. I don't need a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以拿走，我不需要报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad you could see reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你能明白事理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很公平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, I beg you to reconsider. Or, are the very least, don't tell the Legion it was Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，我求你再考虑一下。或者，最起码，不要告诉军团是纽特干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just like putting things back together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是喜欢把东西重新组装起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a medic *and* a mechanic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你既是医生*又是*机械师。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's no point moping around, is there? Just gotta keep on keeping on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，闷闷不乐也没有用，不是吗？只要坚持，坚持下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem... chipper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来...挺活泼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing, really. Not much of anything at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，真的。什么都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't stop me from finding something to do, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过这也不妨碍我找点事做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do in town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 城里有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, no. I'm from Nevada.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不是。我来自内华达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came here to trade with some of the local caravans. By the time I got here, the local caravans had all pulled out and the NCR had gone home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里是为了和当地的商队做生意。当我到达这里的时候，当地的商队已经全部撤离，NCR已经回家了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, well, water off a gecko's back. The Legion aren't so bad, as far as customers go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，好吧，水过蜥蜴背，毫无影响。就顾客而言，军团不算太坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you from around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这儿的本地人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do, actually!
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我有！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend of mine went missing on the 16th of October. I've been counting the days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一个朋友在10月16号失踪了，我一直在数着日子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pretty sure he's in town, but, well, you can see that there aren't many people around anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很确定他在城里，但是，你可以看到附近已经没有多少人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有工作给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is August. He's about normal height, maybe 50 years old.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的名字叫奥古斯特，他大概正常身高，50岁左右。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to live around Newt. The last I heard, he was supposed to be here in Solitare. Except, well, he's not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他以前住在纽特附近。据我所知，他应该在索利泰尔，但是，他没在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这位朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ernest. He's also a friend of August. I guess Ernest would be the last to have seen him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欧内斯特，他也是奥古斯特的朋友。我猜欧内斯特是最后一个见到他的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you hear that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪儿听说的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, don't say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，别这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The roads are pretty darn safe, specially around here and Newt. Because of the Fort, and all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道路非常安全，尤其是这里和纽特附近。因为堡垒，还有所有的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe he got killed on the way here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他在来的路上被杀了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you! If you find him, I've got some juicy gossip in it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！如果你能找到他，我可以告诉你一些有趣的八卦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll look for your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去找你的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Crap....
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？胡说...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, thanks for looking into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，谢谢你的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for that gossip I promised, maybe it isn't such a good idea. It wouldn't do any good to spread rumors about the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于我答应过的那个八卦，也许这不是个好主意。散布有关这位特使的谣言是没有任何好处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll spare you the details, but August is dead. For sure. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不告诉你细节了，但奥古斯特已经死了，肯定。我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh...I had hoped, but I guess it is rather obvious....
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...我曾希望，但我想这是相当明显的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, thanks for looking into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，谢谢你的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for that gossip I promised, maybe it isn't such a good idea. It wouldn't do any good to spread rumors about the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于我答应过的那个八卦，也许这不是个好主意。散布有关这位特使的谣言是没有任何好处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only person who really knew is gone, but what little I've got says he isn't coming back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一知道真相的人已经走了，但据我所知，他不会再回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, well. Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，好吧，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcellus Sedonus, the legate in Malpais... I think he's an addict. Or he used to be. Not anymore. I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯，马尔帕斯的特使...我觉得他是个瘾君子。或者他曾经是，现在不是了，我也不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sent his assistant here one day, a while ago. He said he wanted to make sure I didn't have any forbidden chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不久前的某一天，他派了他的助手来这里。他说他想确保我没有任何违禁药品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He threw open all my drawers and started rifling through them, but he was looking for something, I could tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他把我所有的抽屉都翻了个底朝天，但我看得出他在找什么东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to Fat-Eye, in Elephant Hill. He would know more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该去跟象山的肿眼谈谈，他知道得更多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me. I'm interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我，我很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, agreed. Thanks for your help, anyhow. Here, some denarii as thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，同意。不管怎样，谢谢你的帮助。给，给你一些第纳尔以示感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Whatever it is, you should keep it to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。不管是什么，你都不要说出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gets me ethanol. The Legion has its own supply but they keep it locked down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给我乙醇。军团有自己的供应，但他们把它锁起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Healing powder is great and all, but sometimes you need to disinfect a wound and you can't wait for the Legion to deliberate on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 治疗粉确实很棒，但有时你需要给伤口消毒，而你不能等着军团来仔细考虑。
