ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Fat-Eye?
ESP.TRADUIT: 肿眼是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely! Let me take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！让我看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need something repaired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有东西需要修理。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure! But if you're dealing with radiation poisoning, I won't be able to help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！但如果你遇到的是辐射中毒，我就帮不了你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you patch me up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我包扎一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, you seem fine to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我觉得你挺好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much to heal my wounds?
ESP.TRADUIT: 治我的伤口需要多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, wow. That looks pretty bad. That'll be 25 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，哇，看起来很糟糕。一共25第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much to heal my wounds?
ESP.TRADUIT: 治我的伤口需要多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not too bad. 18 denarii should do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还不算太糟，18第纳尔就够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much to heal my wounds?
ESP.TRADUIT: 治我的伤口需要多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, um. I don't think I can help you with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，呃，我想我帮不了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jem [0601365E] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'm addicted to something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我好像对什么东西上瘾了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Frumentarius, in the glorious Caesar's Legion. I carry out his will, just as everyone else here does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一名特务，光荣的凯撒军团的一员。我执行他的旨意，就像这里的其他人一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A recent recruit to the Legion, from the Colorado campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近刚加入军团，科罗拉多战役的新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He will make Centurion, assuming nothing happens that stains his career before it can begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他将成为百夫长，前提是在他的事业开始前不会发生任何玷污他职业生涯的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about Dominicus Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得多米尼库斯·勒克斯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not consider myself to have come from a tribe. Certainly not the sort of Profligate so-called tribal you see out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为自己来自某个部落。当然不是你在这里看到的那种放荡者的所谓部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My people were a small nation that joined the Great Southwest Confederacy. I was conscripted into the Legion after the Treaty of Window Rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的族人是一个加入大西南邦联的小民族，我是在温多罗克条约之后被征召加入军团的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What tribe are you from originally?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来自哪个部落？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. In the meantime, I have discovered something that may be of interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。与此同时，我发现了一些你可能会感兴趣的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a barrel at the Solitare landfill, just north of here. Acid inside. And bones. Perhaps your man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在索利泰尔垃圾填埋场有个桶，就在北边。里面有酸，还有骨头，也许是你要找的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered that holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把全息磁带送来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, good. Now, if there's nothing else, here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，很好。现在，如果没有别的事了，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered that holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把全息磁带送来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Cross the river, and my man will find you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。过了河，我的人会找到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind. I'm willing to help you on whatever you're planning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变主意了。不管你在计划什么，我都愿意帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Did you kill him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？谁杀了他？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things went south. The contact near Searchlight is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情变糟了。探照灯营地附近的联络人死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, good, first, your information. Fair is fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，首先，你的信息。公平就是公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for your missing person: Alba Nox served as Dominicus Rex's advisor during the interrogations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于失踪的人，阿尔巴·诺克斯是多米尼库斯·勒克斯审讯时的顾问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If August was interrogated by the Frumentarii, Alba Nox would be the one to have handled it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果奥古斯特是被特务审问的话，那一定是阿尔巴·诺克斯来处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that leads me to my second, worrying conclusion, which is that Nox is involved some way in the sabotage of the Confederate weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这引出了我第二个令人担忧的结论，那就是诺克斯在某种程度上参与了对邦联武器的破坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like your help in my investigation of this matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望你能帮助我调查这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered the Legion shipment like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的吩咐把军团的货送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. While you were away, I've been investigating the supply line through which the shipment passed through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你不在的这段时间，我一直在调查这批货物通过的补给线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No deviations from its path. Some of the most reliable assets we have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有偏离路径。我们拥有的最可靠的资产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, the only time that the shipment appeared to not have been documented is here. No paper trail for the shipment's arrival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这批货物似乎唯一没有被记录在案的时间是在这里。没有货物到达的书面记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Given your initiative, I was hoping you would help me in this endeavor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于你的主动性，我希望你能在这件事上帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered the Legion shipment like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的吩咐把军团的货送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. You have the Legion's thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，军团会感谢你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for your missing person: Alba Nox served as Dominicus Rex's advisor during the interrogations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于失踪的人，阿尔巴·诺克斯是多米尼库斯·勒克斯审讯时的顾问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If August was interrogated by the Frumentarii, Alba Nox would be the one to have handled it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果奥古斯特是被特务审问的话，那一定是阿尔巴·诺克斯来处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered those weapons like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的要求把武器送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. You have the Legion's thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，军团会感谢你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been reliable. I have concerns about the security of Solitare, and I have need of an operation across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直很可靠。我担心索利泰尔的安全，我需要在河对岸展开行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cross the river, and I will send someone to meet you if you are interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过了河，如果你感兴趣，我会派人去接你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered those weapons like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的要求把武器送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got off the radio with Red Rivers. The weapons were broken. He blamed you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和红河联系上了。武器都坏了，他指责你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I do not believe you to be stupid to insert yourself as an intermediary and then break the package intentionally or accidentally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不相信你会蠢到主动插手来当这个中间人，然后又不管是故意的还是不小心的把包裹给弄坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, this has led me to believe that something is wrong in Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这让我觉得索利泰尔有些地方出了问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered those weapons like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的要求把武器送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got off the radio with Red Rivers. The weapons were broken. He blamed you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和红河联系上了。武器都坏了，他指责你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I do not believe you to be stupid to insert yourself as an intermediary and then break the package intentionally or accidentally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不相信你会蠢到主动插手来当这个中间人，然后又不管是故意的还是不小心的把包裹给弄坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, this has led me to believe that something is wrong in Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这让我觉得索利泰尔有些地方出了问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered those weapons like you asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我按你的要求把武器送过去了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: August...
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That name is familiar, though I cannot recall where I've heard it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个名字很耳熟，但我想不起来在哪里听过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a package the Frumentarius Alba Nox asked me to deliver - a crate of weapon parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个包裹是特务阿尔巴·诺克斯让我送的，一箱武器部件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a great many things to do here, and I understand that you were a courier before entering Caesar's service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里有很多事情要做，而且我知道你在为凯撒服务之前是一名邮差。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deliver the package for me and I will try to remember what I know about this August. Deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我把包裹寄出去，我会试着记起我对这个奥古斯特的了解。成交？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did the Frumentarii interrogate a man named August?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务有没有审问过一个叫奥古斯特的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I asked you to do something. Do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让你做点事了，去做吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about August again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再来谈谈奥古斯特吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have nothing to say. Make yourself useful, and I may remember something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无话可说。如果你能帮上忙，我也许会想起些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about August again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再来谈谈奥古斯特吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. In the meantime, I have discovered something that may be of interest to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。与此同时，我发现了一些你可能会感兴趣的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a barrel at the Solitare landfill, just north of here. Acid inside. And bones. Perhaps your man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在索利泰尔垃圾填埋场有个桶，就在北边。里面有酸，还有骨头，也许是你要找的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fixed the holotape situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我解决了全息磁带的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, good. Now, if there's nothing else, here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，很好。现在，如果没有别的事了，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fixed the holotape situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我解决了全息磁带的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Part of a Frumentarii's job is cultivating relationships with the nations outside the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务的部分工作是培养与军团之外的国家的关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These weapons are from the Great Southwest Confederacy. A gift for the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些武器来自大西南邦联，给军团的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what's the deal with these weapon parts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，这些武器部件是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Take them. Deliver them Red Rivers at the Base Camp. He is in the War Room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。拿去吧，送到大本营的红河手上，他在作战室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll deliver those weapons parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把武器部件送过去的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Then we have nothing more to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。那我们就没什么好谈的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to deliver anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会送任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Faulty? That's worrying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有问题？真令人担忧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Great Southwest Confederacy has a strong relationship with the Legion. It's highly unlikely they'd intentionally sabotage a shipment meant as a gift.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大西南邦联与军团关系密切，他们不太可能故意破坏作为礼物的货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those weapons were Alba Nox's responsibility. Thank you for bringing this to my attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些武器是阿尔巴·诺克斯的责任。谢谢你提醒我这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those weapons you asked me to deliver were faulty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我送的那些武器有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last person willing to admit it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一个愿意承认见到他的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jem told me you were the last to see August.
ESP.TRADUIT: 捷姆告诉我你是最后一个见到奥古斯特的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went over to Newt to visit August. Came up to his house, and it was empty. Asked around town and they said he came here, to Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去了纽特拜访奥古斯特，我来到他的房子，发现里面空无一人。我问了镇上的人，他们说他来了这里，大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about what you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我你知道些什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did they say anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还说了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Reed, maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。里德，也许吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a shitheel. Loves Legion boot. But he's always got his eyes open, watching for things. He might have seen something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个混蛋，喜欢军团靴子。但他总是睁大眼睛，留心观察。他可能看到了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anyone else around here that might know more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近还有谁知道更多吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry I'm not much help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉我帮不上什么忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was - is - a good man. I hope you find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特...是...一个好人。我希望你能找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有什么要补充的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I felt the same way when I first crossed into California. You'll adapt quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我第一次进入加州时，我也有同样的感觉。你很快会适应的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone is so weird on this side of the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 河这边的人都很奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see why Caesar chose you. It is so rare to meet a levelheaded Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白凯撒为什么选择你了，难得遇到一个头脑冷静的堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm impressed with what I've seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对自己的所见所闻印象深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, spare me the lecture. All men are monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，别跟我说教了，所有人都是怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You people are monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这些人都是怪物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smart move. Keep your cards close to the chest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 聪明的举动。守口如瓶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather not say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是不说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a Frumentarius. Currently, I'm on leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一名军团特务。目前，我正在休假。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was in the Divide, shortly before the incident that tore it apart. I was working as a trader for Far Go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大裂谷事件发生前不久，我就在大裂谷。我当时是远行商队的商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was my job to make sure things went missing in large enough quantities to supply our soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的工作就是确保物资损毁时还有足够的数量供应给我们的士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not to self-aggrandize, but it was quite ingenious. The Frumentarii's baby, though Caesar signed off and gave us free reign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我自吹自擂，但确实很有创意。特务们的孩子，尽管凯撒签字同意给我们自由统治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It took months for us to move all our men into place. It had to be done covertly, not as marching soldiers, but as drifters and travelers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们花了几个月的时间才把所有的人都安排到位。它必须秘密进行，不能像行进中的士兵，而是像流浪者和旅行者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our most discreet Frumentarii filtered into the town undercover and established a presence as logistics leaders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最谨慎的特务以卧底的身份潜入镇上并以后勤负责人的身份出现。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside the town, our men amassed in the mountains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇外，我们的人聚集在山上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I returned to Caesar before the offensive was launched. A pyrrhic victory, perhaps, but for whom? It is not our supply lines that were crippled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在进攻开始前回到了凯撒身边。也许这是一场得不偿失的胜利，但对谁来说呢？瘫痪的又不是我们的补给线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Legion's campaign in the Divide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说军团在大裂谷的战役吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We Frumentarii are allowed certain privileges that other Legionaries are not. Education is one such privilege.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们特务被允许享有一些其他军团士兵没有的特权，教育就是这样一种特权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem different from the other Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来和其他军团成员不太一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're taught history. The history of the NCR, of the Legion, of the Wasteland, and even what came before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们学习历史。NCR的历史，军团的历史，废土的历史，甚至是更早之前的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In order to be Dissolute, one must learn dissolution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了变得放荡，一个人必须学会分裂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of education do Frumentarii receive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务接受什么样的教育？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it would.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why we're not meant to spend much time over here. Certainly not spend that time talking to the rank and file.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我们不应该在这里花太多时间。当然也不要把时间花在和普通士兵谈话上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't it threaten the Legion's power to introduce Dissolute ideas into its soldiers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 向军团的士兵灌输浪荡子的思想，难道不会威胁到军团的实力吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are the Legion's intelligence. We pool our knowledge, analyze data, and then act decisively on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是军团的智慧。我们汇集知识，分析数据，然后果断采取行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our best men work undercover out west, but the bulk of our work is parsing through reports from the Speculatores.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好的人在西部做卧底，但我们的大部分工作都是分析密探的报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vulpes doesn't have actual authority over any other Frumentarius, but we listen when he advises. Otherwise, we report only to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔普斯对其他的特务没有实际的权力，但我们会听取他的建议。另外，我们只向凯撒报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Vulpes Inculta the leader of the Frumentarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔普斯·因库塔是军团特务的领袖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Snow. A snowy night. Literally, yes, it would mean white.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雪，一个雪夜。从字面上看，是的，意思是白色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Frumentarius has many names. We assume and discard them at will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个军团特务有很多名字，我们可以随意假定和丢弃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox? Your name means White Night?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯？你名字的意思是白夜？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. No, I don't see an August in our interrogation logs, but we do have a file on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。不，我们的审讯记录里没有奥古斯特，但我们有他的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I remember him. Suspected ties to Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我记得他。疑似与胡佛支援小队有关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I finished that SMART Array job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完成了智能阵列的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deal with the satellite array and then we'll talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定卫星阵列之后我们再谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did the Frumentarii interrogate a man named August?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务有没有审问过一个叫奥古斯特的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I knew, I would not say. If I did not know, it would be the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我知道，我不会说。如果我不知道，那也一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did the Frumentarii interrogate a man named August?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务有没有审问过一个叫奥古斯特的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are Dissolute. Why should I share intel with you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个浪荡子，我为什么要跟你分享情报？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll cut you a deal. There's a Pre-War military installation just east of here. It's likely that it houses dormant weapons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你做个交易。这里东面有个战前军事设施，那里很可能藏有休眠的武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want whatever's in that military depot destroyed. If you do that, I'll crack open the books and tell you if there's an August on file.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要销毁那个军事仓库里的东西。如果你这么做了，我会打开名册告诉你是否有奥古斯特的记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, that's it? You're not going to tell me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以就这样？你不打算告诉我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's some sort of satellite array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是某种卫星阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lower-ranked Legionaries aren't allowed to enter such sites, and the veterans who investigated never came back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 级别较低的军团士兵不允许进入这样的场所，调查过的老兵再也没有回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to the Rusty Hooks. They're a gang we've kept around as subcontractors. Tech is their field of expertise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找锈钩帮谈谈，他们是我们作为分包商保留下来的帮派。技术是他们的专业领域。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this military installation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个军事设施。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not a threat. Together, they're weak and ineffectual, but individually, they each have skills that make them useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不是威胁。他们合在一起是脆弱而无力的，但单独来看，他们各自拥有让自己有用的技能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you keeping a gang around as subcontractors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要留一帮人做分包商？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. When you're done, we can discuss August.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好。等你搞定了，我们再讨论奥古斯特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I'll go talk to these Rusty Hooks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去和这些锈钩帮谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes. The McCarran operation. That was good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，对。麦卡伦的行动，干得不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, let me check.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，让我查一查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. No, I don't see an August in our interrogation logs, but we do have a file on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。不，我们的审讯记录里没有奥古斯特，但我们有他的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I remember him. Suspected ties to Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我记得他。疑似与胡佛支援小队有关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've done work for Vulpes Inculta. Isn't that enough to earn a little trust?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为沃尔普斯·因库塔工作过，难道这还不足以赢得一点信任吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A small band of anti-Legion rebels, or an urban legend, depending on who you ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是一小群反军团的叛军，还是都市传说，这取决于你问的是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, they're so small-time that their acts of sabotage could be reasonably explained as bad luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，他们都是小人物，他们的破坏行为可以合理地解释为运气不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August wasn't on my radar, but someone must have been monitoring him, using him as bait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特不在我的监视范围内，但肯定有人一直在监视他，拿他当诱饵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he's gone, that means someone acted out of line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他死了，那就说明有人越轨了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛支援小队？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That simply isn't done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这根本就做不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interrogations are highly documented. We keep detailed accounts, transcripts, and even autopsies in the event that the prisoner expires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 审讯都有大量文件记录。 我们会保留详细的记录、笔录，甚至在犯人死亡时进行尸检。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if August was interrogated and not recorded in the logs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果奥古斯特被审讯了却没有记录在日志里呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In my estimation, August is dead. You probably won't find a body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我估计，奥古斯特已经死了。你可能都找不到尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: People disappear out here. It's a big Wasteland, and we're at war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们在这里消失。这是个大废土，我们在打仗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hard to say. Maybe he killed himself. But, if I *were* concerned about foul play, I would say the same thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很难说，也许他是自杀的。但是，如果我担心谋杀，我也会说同样的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cards close to the chest. You understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保守秘密，你懂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I think that will be all. Dismissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我想就这些了。解散。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you suspect foul play?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怀疑有人谋杀？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pfft. Make weapons. Do repairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啐。制造武器，进行维修。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. The Phoenix Steelworks do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，凤凰城钢铁厂做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you craft armor here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这里制作盔甲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [He looks at you strangely.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [他奇怪地看着你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is my home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是我家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does it feel to be so close to home?
ESP.TRADUIT: 离家这么近是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, let me see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，让我看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... No, these parts are bad. Cracked receiver. Broken spring. We can't use these. Everything here is junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...不行，这些部件是坏的。机匣裂了，弹簧断了，我们不能用这些。这全部都是垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a shipment of weapon parts. Can you check that there's nothing wrong with them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一批武器部件，你能检查一下它们有没有问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: These are Pre-War. We don't have the machinery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都是战前的，我们没有机器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't repair them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能修吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的，拜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, thanks for the help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，感谢你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strange how?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么个奇怪法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever seen anything strange around camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在营地附近见过什么奇怪的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are probably intimate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们可能很亲密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strange like a Legionary and a slave sneaking off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像军团士兵和奴隶偷偷溜走一样奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, then I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那我就不知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a male slave, if that matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是个男奴，如果这有关系的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, good. I'll put these to use right away. Dismissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，很好，我马上把这些拿去用。解散。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some weapon parts for you from Alba Nox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从阿尔巴·诺克斯那里拿了些武器部件给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you've delivered broken parts to me... why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还把坏掉的部件送来给我...为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I will see if there's anything worth salvaging. Dismissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去看看有没有值得抢救的东西。解散。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some weapon parts for you from the Frumentarii in Solitare, but most of the parts are broken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从索利泰尔的特务那里带了一些武器部件给你，但大部分部件都坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're here for that? You don't look like the type of person who'd get involved in this... predicament.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你是为这个来的？你看起来不像是会卷入这种...困境的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called the SMART Array. Pre-War eggheads thought they were fuckin' clever I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它被称为智能阵列，我猜是战前的书呆子们觉得自己很智能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, place is crawling with robots. Huge robots with lasers and shit. It's impossible to get close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，这个地方到处都是机器人。带着激光之类的巨型机器人，不可能靠近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox sent me here about a Pre-War satellite array...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯派我来的，是为了一个战前的卫星阵列...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pre-War tech. Untouched goodies. The whole shebang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战前科技，没人碰过的好东西。所有的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way I figure it, there's gotta be a master switch for these bots. A terminal somewhere, right? You get to that, you shut 'em off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，这些机器人肯定有一个总开关。某处有个终端，对吧？如果你找到了，就把他们关了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your interest in this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这个地方有什么兴趣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, man. Just think about it. These are gnarly bots, seriously crazy dangerous tech.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，老兄。你想想看，这些都是极好的机器人，非常疯狂危险的技术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jillian's a hacker, you see. And me, I'm a leader. Think of what we can do with these robots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，吉莉安是个黑客，而我，我是一个领袖。想想我们能用这些机器人做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody will be able to push us around again. Not even the fuckin' Legion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 再也没有人能摆布我们了，连该死的军团都不行！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's what I'm after. I'm after something that'll make sure the Legion doesn't kill us. A force equalizer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我所追求的。我在找能确保军团不会杀了我们的东西，一个力量均衡器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it? Your interest in this place is purely as prospectors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这？你粹是作为淘金客对这地方感兴趣吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you know how it is. This and that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你知道是怎么回事。这个和那个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to run a shop with my buddy, but I've been out of work since the Legion killed him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前和朋友一起开商店，但自从军团杀了他我就失业了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get back to it once the Legion's finished cleaning up the streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等军团清理完街道我再回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a good guy. His name was Pritzker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好人，他的名字叫普利兹克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the Legion needed information out of him, so they brought him in for questioning and he didn't survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜大概是军团需要从他那里得到情报，所以把他抓去审问，结果他没能活下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fine. The Legion did what they had to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。军团做了他们必须做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，听到这个消息我很难过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's fine. You don't need to care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你不需要在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不在乎呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe he did. I just can't imagine that he was ever an NCR-lover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是吧，我只是无法想象他曾经是NCR爱好者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can't trust your friends, who can you trust? Scary thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果连自己的朋友都信不过，还能相信谁？可怕的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like he got what was coming to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来他是罪有应得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm from the Boneyard. Then I left because the crime problem was just out of control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是从晒骨场来的。后来我离开了，因为犯罪问题已经失控了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I moved to Oak Creek, but then the NCR basically annexed it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我搬到了橡树溪，但后来NCR吞并了它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just got tired of the bullshit, so I came east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是厌倦了这些狗屁，所以我来了东部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you from around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这儿的本地人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. And I'm still here, talking to you. See? Worked out fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。而且我还在这里，和你说话。看到了吧？结果很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just a bunch of fearmongering, y'know. The NCR needs an enemy so they can justify their tax hikes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道的，这不过是在制造恐慌罢了。NCR需要一个敌人，这样他们才能证明增税是合理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, the Legion treats you well as long as you behave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说了，只要你乖乖听话，军团对你很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You crossed over into Legion territory on purpose?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是故意越界进入军团领地的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know anything in particular about it, but I know a lot of things about other things, if you catch me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道什么特别的事情，但我知道很多其他的事情，如果你能听懂的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the Ranger uprising?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对游骑兵起义了解多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know how the NCR operates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道NCR的运作方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They never do things themselves, you see. They send money, guns, mercs, bribes, whatever else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，他们从来不自己动手做事。他们送钱，送枪，送雇佣兵，送贿赂什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They operate in the realm behind elections and the normal rules of war. Covert domination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在选举和正常战争规则的背后运作，秘密统治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you do understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你不明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know how the NCR operates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道NCR的运作方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They never do things themselves, you see. They send money, guns, mercs, bribes, whatever else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，他们从来不自己动手做事。他们送钱，送枪，送雇佣兵，送贿赂什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They operate in the realm behind elections and the normal rules of war. Covert domination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在选举和正常战争规则的背后运作，秘密统治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ranger uprising is just one facet of the NCR's covert warfare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵起义只是NCR秘密战争的一个方面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the Chainway? That big highway west of here? How do you think it collapsed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道连环道吗？西边的那条高速公路？你觉得它是怎么坍塌的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really, actually think that? A critical supply line used by an army engaged in war, and it just naturally fell over?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的，真的这么认为吗？一条军队在战争中使用的重要补给线，就这么自然的坍塌了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me a break.
ESP.TRADUIT: 饶了我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was probably just because of natural wear-and-tear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可能只是由于自然磨损。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Exactly. The NCR was in this region before. Who's to say they didn't leave a sleeper cell of Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全正确。NCR以前就在这个地区，谁敢说他们没有留下一个潜伏的游骑兵小组？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the NCR could have collapsed it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜NCR可能把它毁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then who? The Legion? Come on, don't make me laugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？军团？拜托，别逗我笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone collapsed it, but it wasn't the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人把它弄塌了，但不是NCR。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just that you shouldn't trust them. The rules aren't how the game is played.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是你不应该相信他们，规则并不是游戏的玩法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else you'd like to tell me about the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于NCR你还有什么要告诉我的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be honest, some of the Legionaries are pretty scary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，有些军团士兵挺吓人的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I respect what Dominicus Rex does, but he freaks me out. Wherever he came from, I wish he'd hurry up and go back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尊重多米尼库斯·勒克斯的做法，但他把我吓坏了。不管他从哪里来，我都希望他快点回去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just a humble trader. Name's Sandy Rhodes. Pleased to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是一个卑微的商人。我叫珊迪·罗兹，很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure is. Funny, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了。很有趣，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your name is... Sandy Rhodes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的名字叫...珊迪·罗兹？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. My parents named me Alexander. I guess you can tell they wanted a boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我父母给我取名亚历山大，我猜你能看出来他们想要个男孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did your parents name you Sandy Rhodes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你父母给你取名珊迪·罗兹吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好嘞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gotcha, let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了，我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little bit of everything. Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么都有一点，看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么要交易的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not too bad, now that I'm a trader. Traders get respect that most people don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还不错，我现在是商人了，商人能得到大多数人得不到的尊重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't say it's good, though. Some of the Legionaries are downright nasty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我不会说它很好。有些军团士兵非常恶劣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like being a woman in Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个女人在军团的地盘是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm on my own, and I wouldn't have it any other way. Compared to working a farm, this is the most liberating job on Earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我靠自己，没有别的选择。与农场工作相比，这是世界上最自由的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sandy Rhodes [06008B12] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What caravan company are you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪个商队公司的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should talk to Kyle about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该跟凯尔谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox sent me here about a Pre-War satellite array...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯派我来的，是为了一个战前的卫星阵列...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, the SMART Array. It's a ways east of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，智能阵列。在这里东边很远的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's swarming with robots, so we've been unable to get close, but places like that invariably have something valuable inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里挤满了机器人，所以我们无法接近，但那样的地方总是有一些有价值的东西在里面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox sent me here about a Pre-War satellite array...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯派我来的，是为了一个战前的卫星阵列...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that would be the sensible thing to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这是明智的做法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox wants me to destroy those robots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯要我摧毁那些机器人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle was convinced he could use those robots against the Legion. With Jillian, hacking them would have been easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔坚信他可以用这些机器人来对抗军团。有了吉莉安，黑掉他们很容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that she's gone, I'm not so sure that plan is feasible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在她走了，我不太确定那个计划是否可行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you have something else in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有别的想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep them. They don't need to be used. As long as we have them, the Legion will think twice about their plans for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 留着呗。它们不需要被使用，只要它们还在我们手里，军团就会重新考虑他们对我们的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're a hacker, maybe you could figure out a way to override their current programming. Otherwise, just destroy them and be done with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是一名黑客，也许你可以找到一种方法来覆盖他们当前的编程。否则，就把他们毁掉，一了百了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you do if you had those robots on your side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这些机器人站在你这边，你会怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, good luck. Just come back and let us know when the bots are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，祝你好运。等机器人死了再回来告诉我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去检查一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back in one piece.
ESP.TRADUIT: 全身而退吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go check it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去检查一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been reliable. I have concerns about the security of Solitare, and I have need of an operation across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直很可靠。我担心索利泰尔的安全，我需要在河对岸展开行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cross the river, and I will send someone to meet you if you are interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过了河，如果你感兴趣，我会派人去接你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do this for me, and I will have further information when you get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我做这件事，等你回来我再告诉你更多信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will that be all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Here. Deliver it and then return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。给你，送完之后再还给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone is dead. Go see for yourself, and make your own decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人死了。你自己去看看，自己做决定吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean he's dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是说他死了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。这就是我有的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [06008BC6] (mod) Quest : ([06008B14]AZTravelingMerchantDialogue) 06008B14 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to see your wares.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看你的货物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You’re one brave Dissolute, what about the raiders out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是一个勇敢的放荡者。外面的那些掠夺者呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just exploring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在探索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! In Legion lands the courage and tact of Caesar spreads even to the Dissolute. I'm lucky I didn't kill you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！在军团的土地上，凯撒的勇气和机智甚至传播给了放荡者。还好我没杀了你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm killing raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在杀掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Praise Mars! I'm just glad to see someone else alive down here. It's been days. I thought I'd be trapped here forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赞美玛尔斯！我只是很高兴这里还有人活着。已经好几天了，我还以为我会永远被困在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! In Legion lands the courage and tact of Caesar spreads even to the Dissolute. I'm lucky I didn't kill you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！在军团的土地上，凯撒的勇气和机智甚至传播给了放荡者。还好我没杀了你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I snuck past them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我悄悄溜过来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! In Legion lands the courage and tact of Caesar spreads even to the Dissolute. I'm lucky I didn't kill you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！在军团的土地上，凯撒的勇气和机智甚至传播给了放荡者。还好我没杀了你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What raiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not by choice. I was stupid. I stumbled into this place while foraging. I would have never expected to find raiders here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我的选择。我太蠢了，我在觅食的时候偶然发现了这个地方。我从没想过会在这里发现掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: They captured me. Eventually I managed to slip free but couldn't find an exit. I thought you were one of them so I hid when I heard you coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们抓住了我。最后我设法逃脱了，但找不到出口。我以为你是他们中的一员，所以一听到你来我就躲起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you down here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did. We do. Wherever we find them, we destroy them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做了，我们在做。无论在哪里找到他们，我们都会消灭他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This group must be new. There were women. Perhaps they're Profligate tribals. They may be different stock from the usual chem-addict trash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个团体一定是新成立的。有女人，也许他们是堕落的部落民。他们可能跟一般的垃圾瘾君子不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: If my contubernium were here, we'd have these degenerates nailed to crosses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我的十人队在这里，我们会把这些堕落者钉在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Worse than that! We'd break them and parade them all the way back to Flagstaff to show everyone what happens to the Profligates who resist Caesar's will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比那还糟！我们要让它们流着血，一路游行到旗杆市让大家看看反抗凯撒意志的放荡者会有什么下场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought the Legion got rid of all the raiders in its territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还以为军团已经消灭了领土上所有的掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help? No, of course not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮助？不，当然不用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if we were to fight our way out of here together, our chances of leaving in one piece would be much greater. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果我们一起杀出一条血路，我们毫发无损地离开的机会就会大得多。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you need help getting out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要我帮你离开这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About getting you out of here...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于带你离开这里...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Depends. Are you going to rob me again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看情况。你又要抢劫我了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you still want help getting out of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还需要我帮你出去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! Let us trust each other like brothers. You lead the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！让我们像兄弟一样相互信任。你带路吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The leader of these animals has a key to get out of here. We should rip it from his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些畜生的首领有一把钥匙可以离开这里，我们应该把它从他的尸体上扯下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Let's get out of here together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。我们一起离开这里吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! Let us trust each other like, well, you're not one, but as a brother. You lead the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！让我们彼此信任，就像，你不是兄弟，但像兄弟一样。你带路吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The leader of these animals has a key to get out of here. We should rip it from his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些畜生的首领有一把钥匙可以离开这里，我们应该把它从他的尸体上扯下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Let's get out of here together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。我们一起离开这里吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drag you down? You're talking to a Legionary. My strength comes from Caesar, from Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拖你后腿？你在和一个军团士兵说话。我的力量来自凯撒，来自玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I find it more likely *you'll* be unable to keep up with *me*.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得更有可能的是*你*无法跟上*我*的步伐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can get out of here on my own. I don't need you dragging me down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以自己离开这里，我不需要你来拖我后腿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't be gone long. I've tired of this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要离开太久。我已经厌倦了这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather keep exploring. I'll come back for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我更喜欢继续探索。我会回来找你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! I could be of use to you. You'd be a fool to leave me behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！我能对你有帮助，你要是丢下我就太蠢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I'd rather let you rot down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我更喜欢让你烂在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, do you want me to beg? I won't debase myself. Just know that friends of the Legion are rewarded handsomely, and word spreads quickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，想让我求你吗？我不会贬低自己的。你要知道军团的朋友会得到丰厚的奖励，而且消息会很快传开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Convince me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说服我。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't work with Legion. Have fun eating roaches and drinking cave water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不跟军团合作。尽情享受吃蟑螂和喝洞穴水的乐趣吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're crazy! Okay, take whatever you want, just don't kill me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了！好吧，想拿什么拿什么，只要别杀我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: It can always get worse. Give me everything you have or I'll break your legs and leave you down here to starve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情总是会变得更糟。把你所有的东西都给我，否则我就打断你的腿，把你丢在这里饿死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the circumstances were different, I'd kill you for daring to threaten me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果情况不是这样，你敢威胁我，我会杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me have your stuff or you'll... I'll give you a knuckle sandwich!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的东西给我，否则你会...我要给你的嘴巴来上一拳！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I don't have much choice. Fine. I'll follow your lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我没有太多选择。好吧，我听你的指挥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't rob you again. Just stay close to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会再抢你了。跟紧我就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had enough!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受够了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, yes, I am going to rob you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，是的，我又要抢劫你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Camp Willow. The Profligates used this as a staging ground for raids east of the river. Then we took it from them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是柳树营地。放荡者们把这里作为进攻河东的集结地，然后我们从他们那里拿走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was easy. The river makes this position impossible to reinforce from the west. When we attacked, the men here were stranded on our side of the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很容易。这条河使这个阵地无法从西边增援，我们进攻的时候，这里的人被困在科罗拉多河的我们这边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some threw themselves into the water. We shot them as they fled. The rest stayed and fought. They were braver, but they didn't last long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人跳入水中，他们逃跑时我们向他们开枪。其余的人留下来继续战斗，他们更勇敢了，但并没有坚持多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you take Camp Willow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么拿下柳树营的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We coordinate supplies coming up and down the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们协调河流上下游的补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You say that as if there is no glory in keeping the Legion supplied. Supply is the lifeblood of an army. This river is ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得好像保证军团的补给不光荣似的，补给是一支军队的命脉。这条河是我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Profligates don't dare touch us. We took from them the most valuable supply route in the whole Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些放荡者不敢碰我们，我们从他们手中夺走了整个莫哈维最有价值的补给路线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're glorified delivery men?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你们是光荣的快递员？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are. But we manage. A supply line that cannot function under pressure was never fruitful to begin with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看水那边。你看到NCR了吗？他们会在哪里设立前哨？在那些山上？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you get this close to the river? Isn't the NCR on the other side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能离河这么近？NCR不是在另一边吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look across the water. Do you see the NCR? Where might they set up an outpost? On those mountains?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看水那边。你看到NCR了吗？他们会在哪里设立前哨？在那些山上？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were foolish to let us take this place. With Cottonwood Cove and Nelson under our control, the Colorado is ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让我们占领这个地方真是愚蠢。棉白杨湾和纳尔逊都在我们的控制之下，科罗拉多河就是我们的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We feed our army right in their backyard. Dozens of their men lie beneath the water surface. Should they assault us again, there will be dozens more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就在他们的后院喂养我们的军队。 水面下躺着几十个他们的人 ，如果他们再次袭击我们，还会有几十个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you get this close to the river? Isn't the NCR on the other side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能离河这么近？NCR不是在另一边吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes I am aware of that now. But there is nothing I can do about it. That would be the responsibility of our men in Nelson.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我现在意识到了。但我对此无能为力，这是我们在纳尔逊的人的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a whole Ranger station up the cliffs there, you know? They've got Veterans, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 悬崖上有个游骑兵站，你知道吗？他们也有老兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You’re clever. The terrain on the western side of the river is too treacherous for anybody but a Ranger to navigate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很聪明。河西侧的地形太危险了，除了游骑兵，任何人都无法驾驭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers do take potshots at us from time to time, but our Cursors have learned the route well enough to make the trip at night, under the cover of darkness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵确实会时不时地向我们开枪，但我们的传令兵已经很好地掌握了路线，可以在夜幕的掩护下在夜间行进。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But surely the NCR could disrupt your use of the river without sending a whole army. Even one sniper could shut the whole operation down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但可以肯定的是，NCR可以在不派出整支军队的情况下破坏你对河流的使用。一个狙击手就能让整个行动中断。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would be wise refrain from interrogating military officers on questions of tactics. I am a Decanus for a reason. This supply line is quite fortified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好不要询问军官关于战术的问题，我成为十夫长是有原因的。这条补给线戒备森严。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just seems really risky to use the Colorado to transport supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是用科罗拉多河运送物资太冒险了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Profligates' obsession with commerce may be their undoing but it won't be ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放荡者们对商业的痴迷可能是他们的毁灭，但不会是我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a military outpost. Take your degenerate currency and get out of my sight before I send your head downriver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个军事前哨。在我把你的脑袋扔到河下游之前，拿着你的破烂货币滚出我的视线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sign out front says you rent boats. Can I rent one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面的牌子上写着你租船，我可以租一艘吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. You’re wise to submit yourself to the Legion willingly. See Scribonius Prentus. He should be in the office building, sulking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你心甘情愿地服从军团是明智的。去见书记官普伦图斯，他应该在办公大楼里生闷气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything I can do to help out around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He’s morose and lazy. Whatever fire he had is long put out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他孤僻又懒惰。他身上的火早就熄灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he were a normal soldier, I’d have him beaten or replaced, but he’s not. I can’t touch him. Caesar favored his intelligence, his attention to detail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他是个普通的士兵，我会把他揍一顿或者换掉，但他不是，我不能碰他。凯撒喜欢他的智慧和对细节的关注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now he rots here, angry and bored. I pity him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他在这里腐烂，愤怒又无聊。我怜悯他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you get along with the Scribonius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和书记官相处得如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Scribonius. I keep record of the supplies going in and out. It’s easy work as long as everything gets here on time and in the correct amounts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一名书记官，我负责记录物资的进出。只要每样东西都按时到达，而且数量正确，这是一件容易的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. This is an easy position for us to defend and a difficult one for the Profligates to take, so we largely have free reign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。这里对我们来说是一个很容易防御的位置，而对那些放荡者来说是一个很难接受的位置，所以我们在很大程度上是自由的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, it also puts us out of the action. There won’t be any fighting here when it comes time to take the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，它也让我们置身于行动之外。到了攻陷大坝的时候，这里不会有任何战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you see much trouble here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这里有什么问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I’m a soldier. It’s an honor to serve the Legion but I’d have preferred to do it on the battlefield, where I can be granted a respectable death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个士兵。为军团效力是一种荣誉，但我更愿意在战场上做这件事，在那里我可以得到体面的死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, I’m likely to die in bed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，我很可能会死在床上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sound disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听起来很失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Food, ammo, water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食物、弹药、水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn’t our most important supply route but it’s been vital in keeping Malpais supplied since the Chainway collapsed. We’ve had a much stronger hold on it since we took Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我们最重要的补给线，但自从连环道坍塌后，它对马尔帕斯的物资供应至关重要。自从我们占领了棉白杨湾以来，我们对它的掌控力增强了很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It’s still not ideal. We have to carry supplies out of here on foot, since the NCR collapsed the main road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还是不太理想。我们得步行把物资运出去，因为NCR把主干道都毁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps they meant to cut us off from reinforcements. Instead, they only trapped themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他们是想切断我们与援军的联系。结果却相反，他们只是把自己困住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of supplies come through here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么样的物资会经过这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don’t dislike the man. He takes this post seriously. I think he takes it too seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并不讨厌这个人。他很认真地对待这个职位，我觉得他太认真了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It hasn't been three months since we captured this camp and already the fight has left us behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们占领这个营地还不到三个月，战斗已经把我们抛在了身后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see the smoke on the other side of the river, the fires burning in Nelson, and I can't help but feel we're being wasted here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到河对岸的烟雾，纳尔逊的大火，我不禁觉得我们在这里被浪费了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paperwork is for women and slaves, not soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 文书工作是女人和奴隶的事，不是士兵的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you get along with your Decanus?
