ESP.TRADUIT: 你和你的什长相处得好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? No!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？不！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care. I'm going to go see her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎。我要去看她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeping this dummy alive. Tending to his burns, monitoring his pulse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让这个笨蛋活下去。照料他的烧伤，监测他的脉搏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He requires 24/7 care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他需要全天候的照顾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Busy with what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 忙什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's you. You come from away, don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你。你是远道而来的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Come-from-away"?
ESP.TRADUIT: "远道而来"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see! You must be lost or blind!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，原来如此！你一定是迷路了或者是瞎了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't give you a proper eye-test right now. Just take these and get out before you waste any more of my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在没法给你做正确的视力检查。在你浪费我更多的时间之前，拿着这些赶紧离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what's the problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那有什么问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need to stop being so sensitive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不要太敏感了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is my Clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是我的诊所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you mean the town, just call it Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是指小镇，就叫它纽特吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one but me remembers the old name anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我，没人记得旧名字了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call me Dr. Clay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫我克雷医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Born in Peach Springs, came here along with the first expedition in '51.
ESP.TRADUIT: 出生在桃泉，1951年随第一支探险队来到这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been here ever since, basically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 基本上从那以后就一直在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't work for them. They just tell me what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不为他们工作。他们只是告诉我要做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you working for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为军团工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Depends on how you define "medicine".
ESP.TRADUIT: 这取决于你如何定义“医”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My grandmother taught me all sorts of remedies from a young age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的祖母从小就教我各种各样的疗法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd say that's when I started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说我就是从那时开始的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was maybe 30 when I picked up an old world textbook on the topic for the first time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我第一次拿起一本关于这个主题的旧世界教科书时，我大约30岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been practicing medicine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你行医多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but no. I can't risk you killing him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，不行。我不能冒险让你杀死他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he dies, I'm dead. You understand me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他死了，我也就死了。你明白我的意思吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help you with your patient?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你照顾你的病人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was founded under a different name. Most folks couldn't pronounce it though, it was a Tall Pines word, I think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是以另一个名字创立的。但大多数人都不会发音，我想这是一个高大的松树的词。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the Legion wiped them out, gutted the town, it started going by all sorts of names. Eventually, people settled on Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团消灭了他们，摧毁了小镇之后，它开始被冠以各种各样的名字。最终，人们选择了纽特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure why. Don't care, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道为什么，我也不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Its old name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 旧名字？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to tell you about, unfortunately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很不幸，没什么可告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Trading Post is staffed, but short on supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贸易站人手充足，但物资短缺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most homes around here have already been raided and emptied out. So don't bother looking for anything of value.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的大部分房屋都已经被洗劫一空了，所以不要费心去寻找任何有价值的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nowadays we're nothing more than a work camp with flowers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们不过是一个带着鲜花的劳改营。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the village?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我讲讲这个村子吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to tell. I've always found healing to be spiritually fulfilling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么好说的。我一直觉得治病是精神上的满足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just made sense to open my home as a place of healing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把我的家作为一个疗伤的地方是有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're low on supplies, but there's nothing a splint, some bandages and ibuprofene can't fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的物资短缺，但没有什么是夹板，绷带和布洛芬治不好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说诊所吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: About 3-4 hours a day. Here and there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天大概3到4小时，随处睡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I ever need to do a longer sleep I'll get one of the kids in town to watch him while I nap on the couch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我需要多睡一会儿，我会让镇上的一个孩子在我睡沙发的时候照看他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 24/7 care? Do you sleep?
ESP.TRADUIT: 全天候护理？你睡觉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't know. The patient is in real bad shape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我不知道。病人的情况很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc Clay stays up with him day and night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生日夜守护着他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When will she be free?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她什么时候有空？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rae.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been helping Doc Clay run the Clinic lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最近一直在帮克雷医生管理诊所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc Clay's clinic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生诊所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're full at the moment, sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在客满了，抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw them once when I was little.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我小时候见过一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I liked the bear on their uniforms, I think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我喜欢他们制服上的熊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I uh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我呃...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I grew up here...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里长大...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then the Legion came to town... uh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后军团来到了镇上...呃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rae [0600929A] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me break it down for you then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我来给你解释一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His commander wants him alive, and he doesn't like being told no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的指挥官想要他活着，他不喜欢被拒绝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meaning, if this idiot succumbs to his injuries, I'm going to be put on a cross or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是，如果这个白痴因伤而死，我就会被钉上十字架，或者更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't risk some two-bit Wasteland surgeon infecting him with who knows what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能冒险让一个二流的废土外科医生用不知道什么东西感染他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白你的意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Sorry, I don't need your help with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]抱歉，我不需要你帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, you seem competent at least. I need you to run an errand for me, think you can do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你至少看起来很有能力。我需要你帮我办件事，你能行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not an amateur. I can help you stabilize his condition if you let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不是业余的。如果你愿意，我可以帮你稳定他的病情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah right, may as well shoot me now to save everyone some time.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]是啊，为了节省大家的时间，不如现在就杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not an amateur. I can help you stabilize his condition if you let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不是业余的。如果你愿意，我可以帮你稳定他的病情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赶紧吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm stuck here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被困在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The road's out, and the way back without it is too dangerous for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 路已经断掉了，没有路回去对我来说太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have enough money to stay at the Roadhouse, and, as of today, I'm out of food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有足够的钱住在路边旅馆，而且，从今天开始，我没吃的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please....
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, they don't care if I can't pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，如果我付不起钱的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please....
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't the Legion help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不能帮助你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars blesses you, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯保佑你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much can a kind soul like you spare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样善良的人能施舍多少？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare some caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以腾出一些瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks I guess....
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，我想...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd really prefer some caps, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我真的更喜欢瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's some water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有一些水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Alright, alright. You caught me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好吧，好吧。被你发现了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just trying to make some money while I wait for the road to be repaired. Sue me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想在等路修好的时候赚点钱。告我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can see your stash of caps just behind you, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能看到你身后藏着的瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILURE] I am!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please....
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You definitely look like you're poor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来真的很穷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take it, but I'm a bit insulted to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收下了，不过说实话，我觉得有点受辱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare 1 cap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以给你1瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's barely anything....
ESP.TRADUIT: 这几乎算不了什么...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare 50 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以给你50瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'll last me a day or two at most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那最多只能维持一两天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please....
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare 100 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以给你100瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh, thanks sucker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵，谢了，笨蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can spare 500 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以给你500瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? That's pretty messed up to get my hopes up like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？这样让我抱着希望真是太糟糕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm starving, and you're acting like it's a game or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我快饿死了，你却表现得像在玩游戏一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Norm [060092B2] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, I can't spare any caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 转念一想，我没有多余的瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. We are not who we once were, it was not our choice to make.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。我们已经不是曾经的我们了，这不是我们可以选择的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your people attacked me first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的人先袭击了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suspected as much. Why did you return?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么怀疑。你怎么回来了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lying. I'll ask again: are you the butcher of my people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在撒谎。我再问一遍：你是屠杀我人民的刽子手吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't know what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不知道你在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are all monsters now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在都是怪物了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you return here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么回到这里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't want to dwell on it? Fine. That is the luxury of the victor. He can move on. The defeated never do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不想纠结于此？很好，这是胜利者的特权。他可以继续前进，失败者永远不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now answer me this: why did you return here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在回答我：你为什么回到这里来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have anything to say to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你没什么好说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evidence? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 证据？为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need evidence that there were raiders here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要这里存在掠夺者的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a sickness in you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有一种病态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to come back and admire my handiwork.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想回来欣赏一下我的杰作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are savages. Let them kill and maim each other. What difference does it make to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是野蛮人，让他们自相残杀就好了。这对你有什么影响？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your people kidnapped a Legionary. If I can't prove that he was held captive here, he'll be crucified for deserting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的人绑架了一名军团士兵。如果我不能证明他曾被囚禁在这里，他就会因为擅离职守而被钉上十字架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how do you intend to help the Legion dog by returning here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回到这里，是为了帮助军团的狗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not guilty of what he's being accused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他被指控的罪名并不成立。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how do you intend to help the Legion dog by returning here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回到这里，是为了帮助军团的狗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's too pathetic not to help. I would feel bad if I let him get punished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他太可怜了，我不能不帮忙。如果我让他受到惩罚，我会很难过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yet you do anyway. Like a fly drawn to carrion. If even your reasons are inconsequential to you, how did you expect to find any evidence?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你还是这么做了，就像苍蝇被腐肉吸引。如果连你的理由对你来说都无关紧要，你怎么能指望找到任何证据呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are blind to the world even as you tear it apart. Like a tornado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使你将世界撕裂，你也对它视而不见。就像龙卷风一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If only you had decided that before you destroyed what remained of my people. Is it done then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在毁灭我剩下的族人之前决定就好了。那结束了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I don't care what happens to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我不在乎他会怎么样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You confound me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把我弄糊涂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: What evidence did you intend to return with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算带什么证据回去？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care what happens to the Legionary, but I'm still going to help him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎那个军团士兵会怎么样，但我还是会帮他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then go. Let me mourn in peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就走吧，就让我安静地哀悼吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to help the Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会帮军团的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wakeem's head? It would be an abomination for one of my people to be buried this way, I will not allow it while I still breathe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瓦基姆的脑袋？如果我的族人以这种方式被埋葬，那将是令人憎恶的，在我活着的时候，我不会允许这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been told to bring the head of your people's leader back to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让我把你们族人领袖的头带回军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will fall before you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会先倒下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was asked to bring back a head, and that's what I'm going to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被要求带一个人头回去，这就是我要做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing here for you to plunder that will save your Legion friend. All that matters to us was left in the east when we fled Ceasar's men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有什么东西可以让你去掠夺来拯救你的军团朋友。当我们逃离凯撒的手下时，对我们来说最重要的东西都留在了东方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I was going to look around and find something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我想四处看看，找点什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will fall before you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会先倒下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was asked to bring back a head, and that's what I'm going to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被要求带一个人头回去，这就是我要做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you were going to do such a thing, it would be stupid to tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你要做这种事，还告诉我就太蠢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can bring you back with me and let the Decanus decide what to do with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以把你带回去，让什长来决定如何处置你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Ha. You deal in ironies. The butcher of the Selig-Men wants to carry on our legacy? You want to honor us by turning our culture over to the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]哈，你很擅长讽刺。塞利格人的屠夫想继承我们的遗产？你想通过把我们的文化交给军团来纪念我们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you are right. This is the end of us. The things we shared, our love, our bond, it isn't in our possessions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你是对的，我们的末日到了。我们分享的东西，我们的爱，我们的纽带，都不属于我们的财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. When you give it to that Decanus, tell him we survived every Legion rat they sent after us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着这个。当你把它给什长时，告诉他我们躲过了他们派来的每一只军团老鼠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you give me something to show the Decanus, I can carry on your tribe's memory. Otherwise, no one will, and your struggle against the Legion will be forgotten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你给我一些东西给什长看，我就可以把你们部落的记忆延续下去。否则，没有人会知道，你们和军团的斗争也会被遗忘。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] No. Even if there was something to give, I will not turn our culture over to Legion roaches.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不。就算有什么可以给的，我也不会把我们的文化交给军团的蟑螂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't you just give me something to prove to the Decanus you were here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就不能给我点东西向什长证明你来过这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to think about it some more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还需要再考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: At last you see reason, you are not like most in this land. Now go, butcher of my people, I can't bear to be around you any longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你终于明白了，你和这片土地上的大多数人都不一样。现在走吧，屠杀我人民的刽子手，我不能再忍受和你待在一起了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't take anything from you. The Legionary will have to accept his punishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会从你那里拿走任何东西，军团士兵将不得不接受他的惩罚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then go find some scrap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去找些废铁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your tribe's culture is that of a pack of dogs. I could tape some scrap together and it would be worth as much as anything you could offer me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们部落的文化就是一群狗。我可以把一些废铁粘在一起，它的价值和你能给我的任何东西一样高。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were the Selig Men. We roamed the land freely with our horses and bighorners, hunting and herding in the lands of our ancestors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是塞利格人。我们带着马和大角羊在这片土地上自由地漫步，在我们祖先的土地上打猎和放牧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This was all out that way, out east, where there's more grass than sand and where the birds still sing about the beauty of the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都是在那边，在东边，那里草比沙多，那里的鸟儿仍在歌唱世界的美丽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With our mounts and our herds, we could outrun most trouble. But during times of strife we became like a storm when we rode together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有了我们的坐骑和畜群，我们就能躲过大多数麻烦。但在冲突的时候，当我们并肩作战时，我们就像一场风暴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We slept under the stars and rested at the base of trees. We traded with the settled people on occasion, but it wasn't in our nature to stay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在星空下睡觉，在树下休息。我们偶尔会和定居下来的人进行交易，但我们的天性不愿留下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I don't wish to continue. I don't want to think any more about what Caesar took from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我不想继续了。我不愿意再去想凯撒从我们这里夺走了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about your tribe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说你的部落吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the Legion came they demanded our men for their cruel army, we were herders who take no joy in war so our hunters refused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团到来时他们要求我们的人加入他们残酷的军队，我们是不喜欢战争的牧民所以我们的猎人拒绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We said to Caesar's emissary "Why should we be stolen from our home and made to kill? Why should we be made to leave our lives behind?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们对凯撒的使者说：“为什么要把我们从家里偷走，让我们去杀人呢？为什么要让我们抛弃自己的生活？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those of us who remained after Caesar culled our herds and burned the plains of our ancestors fled into the desert. Now we hide in caves like rats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒宰杀了我们的牲畜，烧毁了我们祖先的平原，我们这些幸存下来的人逃进了沙漠。现在我们像老鼠一样躲在山洞里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么到这里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A land to the east called Prescott, it is beautiful and green and nothing like this wretched place. It is all Caesar's land now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 东边有一块叫普雷斯科特的地方，景色优美，绿意盎然，跟这个可怜的地方完全不一样。现在全是凯撒的地盘了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many years ago, we were only one family with a herd of Bighorners. We wandered the plains as if we were lost. When we found Prescott, we were reborn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多年前，我们只是一个家族，有一群大角羊。我们在平原上徘徊，好像迷路了一样。当我们找到普雷斯科特，我们就得到了新生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of the people in that land lived similarly to us. They joined us and we were made anew, not just the men from Selig, but the Selig Men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那片土地上的许多人与我们的生活方式相似。他们加入了我们，我们焕然一新，不仅仅是来自塞利格的人，而是塞利格人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A people deserving of a name. We were fearsome, too. Even the 66ers knew our herds would never be easy pickings while we drew breath.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个名副其实的民族。我们也很可怕，就连66人都知道只要我们还活着，我们的畜群就不会轻易被吃掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion destroyed the 66ers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团摧毁了66人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is your tribe from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的部落来自哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a snoozefest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 极度无聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every morning the Skirts come by, line us up and yell at us for an hour or two.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天早上，短裙们都会过来，把我们排成一排，对我们大喊大叫一两个小时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of that we mostly sit around gettin' sunburnt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，我们大部分时间都是坐在那里晒黑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Especially with the road out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特别是在道路被切断的情况下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like being a Rusty Hook?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当锈钩帮是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: See that Highway down the way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到那边的高速公路了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shoot everything and everyone that tries to jump off it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我射杀所有想要跳下去的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That checkpoint you see is the last stop for Human Cargo before they reach Malpais and the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到的那个检查站，是人类货运到达马尔帕斯和堡垒之前的最后一站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They get desperate during their processing, and jump off in a last ditch attempt to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在处理过程中感到绝望，并在最后一搏中试图逃跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would anyone try to jump off the highway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么会有人想从高速公路上跳下去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter. I shoot em' whether they look dead or alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。不管他们看起来是死是活，我都会开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if they don't survive the fall?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们掉下去没活下来怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Skirts have a work camp around here. Able-bodied human cargo are confiscated and sent there when they're in need of workers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 短裙在这附近有个工作营地。当他们需要工人时，健全的人类货物被没收并送到那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Processing? Like they're cattle or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 处理？就像牛一样吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No such thing as property around here, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有什么财产可言，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion lays claim to basically everything in the Four Corners. They can take what they want for any reason, any time. If you fight back...
ESP.TRADUIT: 四周的一切基本上都归军团所有，他们可以在任何时候以任何理由拿走他们想要的东西。如果你反抗的话...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...well, you know...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Confiscated? Aren't those slaves the property of their owners?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没收？难道这些奴隶不是主人的财产吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not a fan. But what else am I to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不喜欢。但我还能怎么办呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I don't shoot, I'll be hanged and replaced with someone that will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不开枪，我就会被绞死然后被另一个会开枪的人取代。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not exactly free myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己也不是完全自由的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe you murder them for trying to break free. They're people, not cargo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信你因为他们试图挣脱而杀了他们。他们是人，不是货物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Says you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I don't do my job, they'll hunt me down. Ain't no town nor ruin that they won't leave unturned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不做好我的工作，他们会追杀我。他们不会放过任何城镇和废墟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: The thing about the Legion? They're petty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的特点是什么？他们很小心眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An escapee is a personal affront to their God. A denial of His ownership of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个逃犯是对他们的神的侮辱，否认了他对你的所有权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pardon me if I commit a handful of attrocities to avoid that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请原谅我为了避免这种情况而犯下了一些暴行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You always have a choice to say no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你总是可以选择说不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Usually the boys'll do a sweep of the area to double-tap any stragglers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常他们会在这一带扫荡一遍，给掉队的人来个双连击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever miss?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有失手过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...and waste my ammo? No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...浪费我的弹药？不，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll just come back, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正它们还是会回来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why just target slaves? Can't you clear out all the critters over there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么只针对奴隶？你就不能把那边的小动物都清除掉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wish I knew pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真希望我知道，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably just collapsed under it's own weight. The thing is ancient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能只是被自己的重量压垮了，这东西很古老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what happened to the road?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这条路怎么了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's sand, dirt, concrete and corpses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到处都是沙子、泥土、混凝土和尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Mag [060074DD] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not much of a view, is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这景色可不怎么样，是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The one and only Atilius Caecus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独一无二的阿提利乌斯·卡阿苏斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veteran Atilius [06009558] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The butcher of Santa Claus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣特劳斯的屠夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veteran Atilius [06009558] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why wouldn't I be here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么我不能在这里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veteran Atilius [06009558] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Balneum is the best place to prepare oneself for the glory of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浴场是为战斗的荣耀做好准备的最佳地点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veteran Atilius [06009558] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After my soaks, these joints will be ready to take the Dam and usher in Nova Roma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我泡完澡，这些关节就能准备好占领大坝，迎接新罗马了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Veteran Atilius [06009558] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a good person to ask, I'm afraid. I haven't been here long, just passing through you could say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕我不适合这个问题。我来的时间不长，可以说只是路过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说这个地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh that name goes way back to when I was a young'un. You see, old Slippery Will always gets himself out of binds, at least I did back when I had my health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这个名字要追溯到我年轻的时候。你看，老"滑头"威尔总是不受约束，至少我身体健康的时候是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon folks took notice to it and the name stuck. Now why they chose 'slippery' instead of 'lucky' I can't rightly tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我估计大家都注意到了，于是这个名字就流传下来了。为什么他们选择了“滑头”而不是“走运”，我不能告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Slippery Will?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么他们叫你"滑头"威尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you asked, stranger. I've got myself a lead on one hell of a salvage claim, only issue is I'll need a partner. You looking for work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你问了，陌生人。我得到了一个打捞财宝的线索，唯一的问题是我需要一个搭档。你找工作吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here, Slippery Will?
ESP.TRADUIT: “滑头"威尔，你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever hear of Big Spar Mine, wastelander? It's a big one, got passages that run all over like some kinda maze. They say no man's seen all of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过大晶石矿吗，废土客？这是一个很大的地方，到处都是通道，就像迷宫一样。他们说没有人见过全貌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I learned of it on account of a dying man I met baking in the sun in the Utah years back. Told me he would reveal his treasure for a sip of water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几年前，我在犹他州遇到一个奄奄一息的人，在太阳下晒着，我从他那里得知了这件事。他告诉我只要有一口水他就会揭示他的宝藏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me this, a map of the mine with an 'X' where he buried a cache of silver. I swear on my mama's mama that's what he said it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给了我这个，一张标有“ X ”的矿区地图他在那里埋藏了一批银子。我以我妈妈的妈妈发誓他就是这么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, Slippery Will ain't who he used to be, so I'll need you to hike out there for the silver. Bring it back for 50 percent of the split. Sound fair?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在“滑头"威尔"已经不是曾经的他了，所以我们需要你去那里拿银子。把它拿回来，五五分成，听起来公平吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested, what's the job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感兴趣，是什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever hear of Big Spar Mine, wastelander? It's a big one, got passages that run all over like some kinda maze. They say no man's seen all of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过大晶石矿吗，废土客？这是一个很大的地方，到处都是通道，就像迷宫一样。他们说没有人见过全貌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I learned of it on account of a dying man I met baking in the sun in the Utah years back. Told me he would reveal his treasure for a sip of water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几年前，我在犹他州遇到一个奄奄一息的人，在太阳下晒着，我从他那里得知了这件事。他告诉我只要有一口水他就会揭示他的宝藏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me this, a map of the mine with an 'X' where he buried a cache of silver. I swear on my mama's mama that's what he said it was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给了我这个，一张标有“ X ”的矿区地图他在那里埋藏了一批银子。我以我妈妈的妈妈发誓他就是这么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now Slippery Will ain't who he used to be, so we'll need you to hike out there for the silver. Bring it back for 50 percent of the split. Sound fair?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在“滑头"威尔"已经不是曾经的他了，所以我们需要你去那里拿银子。把它拿回来，五五分成，听起来公平吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我更多关于财宝的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear ya, partner. You come back if you change your mind though, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道了，伙计。如果你改变主意了就回来，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not interested in taking on work right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在没有兴趣接受工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew I could depend on you, friend. You had the look of a real go-getter to ya. Here's the map - oh, and take my shovel with you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道你靠得住，朋友，你看起来很有干劲。这是地图...哦，把我的铲子也带上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll want to keep your head on a swivel while you're down there, critters love old mines because of the cool air. Good luck to ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在下面的时候要保持头脑清醒，因为凉爽的空气让小动物们很喜欢老矿井。 祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got yourself a partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给自己找了个搭档。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear ya, partner. You come back if you change your mind though, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道了，伙计。如果你改变主意了就回来，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not now, maybe later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不行，以后再说吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't that just like a young'un, no respect for their elders. You'll be back, though. If you're lucky I'll still be here with a job when you wise up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是一个年轻人的作风，不尊重长辈。不过，你会回来的，如果你幸运的话，等你醒悟过来的时候我还在这有份工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Save the goose chase for someone who cares, old man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁有兴趣让谁白费力气吧，老家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, hold on, you aren't gonna want to leave before you hear my offer. How would you want to work a bonafide salvage claim? I'm in need of a partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，在你听到我的提议之前你不会想走的。你想如何进行真正的财宝打捞？我需要一个搭档。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye for now, Slippery Will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那再见了，“滑头”威尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Until next time, amigo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次见，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye for now, Slippery Will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那再见了，“滑头”威尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that old claim of ours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的旧主张怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk about Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈大晶石矿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look who’s got their prospecting legs! You can bet you’re britches I’m still looking for help on that, interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 快看谁已经准备好去探矿了！我现在还在找人帮忙，有兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk about that job you mentioned earlier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈你之前提到的那份工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just follow the map, partner. Should lead you right to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟着地图走，伙计。应该会引导你找到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still working on finding the cached treasure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在努力寻找宝藏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot darn, that's not good. That's not good at all. You and I can get in big trouble getting seen with that around these parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，这可不太好，这一点都不好。你和我带着这个在这附近被人看见会有大麻烦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you hold onto those, I ain't too keen on spending my twilight years on a cross overlooking the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你留着吧，我可不想在俯瞰科罗拉多河的十字架上度过我的晚年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found the treasure, but your dying friend was mistaken about the silver. It's all chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了宝藏，但你那位垂死的朋友搞错了银子的事。都是化学药物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You already found it? You've got a hell of an eye for prospecting, partner. I can't say this news isn't a bit disapointing to hear, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经找到了？你的勘探眼光可真准，伙计。不过，听到这个消息我不得不说有点失望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you hold onto those, I ain't too keen on spending my twilight years on a cross overlooking the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你留着吧，我可不想在俯瞰科罗拉多河的十字架上度过我的晚年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I recognize this map, I've already dug this up. It's all chems by the way, no silver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认得这张地图，我已经把它挖出来了。顺便说一下，都是化学药物，没有银子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You’re one brave Dissolute, what about the raiders out there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是一个勇敢的放荡者。外面的那些掠夺者呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was brought here by a prospecting claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是被一个探矿权人带到这里来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then go. Let me mourn in peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就走吧，就让我安静地哀悼吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Leti [0600A4A3] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought I was being helpful, but I've stopped caring. I'll be leaving now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为我是在帮忙，但我不再关心了。我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not be long, Legion justice does not wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要太久，军团的正义不会等待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still searching for evidence of the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在寻找掠夺者的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're speaking to a proud Member-Owner of the Alamos Co-Operative Trading Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你面前的是一位骄傲的阿拉莫斯合作贸易公司的老板。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Hank. What's it to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫汉克。有什么事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not Legion. What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是军团。你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do my civic duty and answer all your questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会尽我的公民义务，回答你所有的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some more questions about your trade outfit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的商队还有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't deal with small fry. That'd be why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不跟小人物打交道。这就是原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alamos Co-Operative? Never heard of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿拉莫斯合作社？从没听说过你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the Los Alamos Co-operative Trading Company. We're a group of changed souls from The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是洛斯阿拉莫斯合作贸易公司，我们是一群从保留地来的被改变的灵魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We trade all over the Four Corners. I'm here on contract delivering supplies directly to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的生意遍布四方，我是按合同来直接给凯撒运送物资的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Alamos Co-Operative?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿拉莫斯合作社是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A nation for all Born Ghouls to congregate and share our millenia of collective experise and knowledge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个让所有天生食尸鬼聚集在一起分享我们千年来的集体经验和知识的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or so they say. I spend most of my time outside the radiation blanket these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少他们是这么说的。这些天我大部分时间都待在辐射毯之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Reservation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是保留地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about the Reservation again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想再谈谈保留地的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, small fry. Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，小人物。现在你想怎样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who're you calling "small fry?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你管谁叫"小人物？"

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说得对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all right there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Owner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 业主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Member.
ESP.TRADUIT: 会员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take some time, you'll get it eventually, champ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 花点时间，你最终会明白的，冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Owner-Member?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是业主会员？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a trader? Can I buy something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是商人？我可以买点东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything good for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么好东西卖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A nation for all Born Ghouls to congregate and share our millenia of collective experise and knowledge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个让所有天生食尸鬼聚集在一起分享我们千年来的集体经验和知识的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or so they say. I spend most of my time outside the radiation blanket these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少他们是这么说的。这些天我大部分时间都待在辐射毯之外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Reservation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是保留地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's place for ghouls to gather, survive and thrive. It's we achieve our rebirth and recognize our rightful place above our inferiors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是食尸鬼聚集、生存和发展的地方。在这里，我们实现了重生，并认识到自己高于下等人的合法地位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a giant radiation blanket surrounding the place. Only the waste's chosen may enter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里被巨大的辐射毯包围着，只有被选中的废土人才能进入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about The Reservation again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再给我讲讲保留地吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was once called Los Alamos National Laboratory, outside Albuquerque. Got hit good by the Chinese back before the war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经叫做洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室，在阿尔伯克基郊外。在战前被中国人打得很惨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been led by a man named Dr. Clark for as long as I remember. He's got his...eccentricities, but we've got strict rules and clean streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从我记事起，一直由一个叫克拉克博士的人领导。他有他的...怪癖，但我们有严格的规定和干净的街道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last recorded feral was two years ago. And we're mostly free of the Legion, so that's nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一次有记录的狂化是两年前。而且我们基本上不受军团的影响，这很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did The Reservation begin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 保留地是怎么开始的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sure is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不可思议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Folks say the same about your so-called nations over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边的人也这么说你们所谓的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny coincidence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣的巧合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A nation of ghouls? Disgusting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食尸鬼的国度？真恶心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The place is surrounded by radiation. The whole way around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方被辐射包围着，整个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's softer in places, and there are some safe pockets. But one wrong step and you're taking 30,000 Millisieverts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些地方比较软，还有一些安全的口袋。但只要走错一步，你就会受到30000毫西弗的辐射。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough to make your bones explode.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这足以让你的骨头爆炸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keeps the freaks out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把怪胎挡在外面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, radiation blanket?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，辐射毯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means I'm delivering goods on behalf of The Reservation as a formal tribute before Caesar launches his offensive at the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是在凯撒向大坝发起进攻之前，我要代表保留地运送物资作为正式的贡品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're obligated to because of the treaty we have with them. In exchange, they stop making us pollute our backyard with their corpses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有义务这么做，因为我们和他们有协议。作为交换，他们不再让我们用他们的尸体污染后院。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What type of contract do you have with the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和军团签了什么合同？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't that the question? Supposedly, Dr. Clark made one after years of experiments. Got a whole church with her a saint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不正是问题所在吗？据说克拉克博士经过多年的实验制造了一个，把整个教堂都变成了她的圣地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what all the pamphlets say, anyway. I've never seen her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正所有的小册子上都是这么说的，我从没见过她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ask me. I'll tell you that a Born Ghoul is anyone that recognizes their place at the top of the human evolutionary chain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你问我。我要告诉你，任何认识到自己在人类进化链上处于顶端的人都是天生尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A new man for a new age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新时代的新人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls are sterile, aren't they? How can a ghoul be born?
ESP.TRADUIT: 食尸鬼是不育的，对吧？食尸鬼是如何诞生的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, Belle? Supposedly, some nutjob from Colorado eloped with her. Can't imagine anyone wanting to play with a smoothskin like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，贝儿？据说有个科罗拉多的疯子跟她私奔了，无法想象有谁想和你这样的滑皮一起玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes me sick just thinking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想就觉得恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen some of those new Born Ghouls the good doc trots around, though. They don't look "born" to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我倒是见过一些医生带着的新出生的食尸鬼。在我看来，他们并不是 "天生"的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the ghoul girl you mentioned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的那个食尸鬼女孩后来怎么样了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you're named Caesar and sit in a big throne at the top of a hill, that's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你的名字叫凯撒，坐在山顶的大宝座上，否则这不关你的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you delivering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提供什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, aren't you special? Eh, why not? I'm not going to antagonize Caesar's little pe.... His protege.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你不是很特别吗？嗯，为什么不呢？我可不想和凯撒的小宠...他的门徒作对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The usual. Manifest mostly lists, let me see here.... Ammunition, artillery, grenades, some thermic lances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老规矩，货单主要记录，让我看看这里...弹药、火炮、手雷、热力长矛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stuff to kill people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 用来杀人的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just came down from Fortification Hill. What are you delivering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚从要塞山下来，你要送什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a smoothskin sweet talker, can't you tell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个滑皮奉承者，你看不出来吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, it ain't all that cushy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说，这也没那么轻松。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you land that gig?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么找到这份工作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a lot nicer than your partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你比你的搭档友善多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clearly you haven't spoken to my partner over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很明显你还没跟我那边的搭档说过话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem like a sweet talker to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，你不像是一个擅长奉承的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The manifest is property of The Reservation. I get my normal payout the same as every other Member-Owner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 货单是保留地的财产。我和其他业主会员一样，可以获得正常的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion squeezes me dry. I'm trying to make some side deals while I'm here to make the trip more worth my while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团把我榨干了。我想趁我在这的时候做些附带交易让这趟旅行更值得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, you want some cash?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说，你想要现金吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're trading directly with the Legion. How is it not cushy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你直接和军团交易。怎么会不轻松呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, the Displacer Glove thing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，置换拳套的事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'm interested in that cash thing you mentioned earlier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，我对你之前提到的现金很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The skirts over there don't like dealing with us unless it's official business. They think we're tryin' to rip em off with junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边的女人不喜欢和我们打交道，除非是公事。他们认为我们想用垃圾来敲诈他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some Displacer Gloves that Beth and I picked up somewhere near Santa Fe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和贝丝在圣菲附近捡到一些置换拳套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can arrange the sale of these to their guy up in the armory, I'll split the sale with you. 80/20.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能安排把这些卖给我们在军械库的人，我就和你分这笔生意。八二开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'll respect your less-evolved complexion. What do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他会尊重你不太进化的肤色。你觉得呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, hot stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，高手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3BD]AZBaseCampHankDialogue) 0600B3BD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and every other hog breathing our air. Now leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和其他猪一样呼吸着我们的空气。马上走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you calling "swine?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在叫谁"猪猡"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course he did, he loves fratting with the unwashed masses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他当然会这么做，他就喜欢和那些下层民众打成一片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does he want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克让我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Buzz off, shrimp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。滚开吧，小虾米。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance I can change your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有可能改变你的想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That idiot's dimmer than I thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那白痴比我想的还蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way I'd work with a smoothskin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不可能跟滑皮一起工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hank cut me into your displacer glove sale. He said he'd cut me in if I help with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 汉克让我参与你的置换拳套销售，他说如果我帮军团他就给我分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have the business acumen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有商业头脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't waste my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别浪费我的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't bother me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I come and go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来了又走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not as much as I used to, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过没有以前那么频繁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you live here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你住在这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does it need an owner?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么它需要一个所有者？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who owns this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方是谁的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 挺好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make no mistake, it is a literal hole in the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毫无疑问，这是一个真正的地洞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But as far as holes in the ground go, it's not too shabby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但就地上的洞而言，还不算太破旧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like it here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A god, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 神，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what that egghead is calling himself these days?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那书呆子现在都这么称呼自己了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me tell you something: One day, that god of yours will die like any other man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我告诉你：总有一天，你的神会像其他人一样死去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see how his "godhood" works out when he's coughing up blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等他咳血的时候，我们看看他的“神性”是怎么起作用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To not worship them is to deny Caesar godhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不崇拜他们就是否定凯撒的神性。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走着瞧吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack> You will pay for your blasphemy.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>你会为你的亵渎付出代价的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you? Frumentarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么人？军团特务？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask a few more questions, and see what happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再问几个问题，看看会发生什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean by you've "been there, done that?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的“经历过，做过”是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need some sycophant with a god complex telling me what to do and who to kill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要一个有上帝情结的马屁精告诉我该做什么，该杀谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been there. Done that. Got the scars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我经历过，做过。留下了伤疤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. But I'm mighty familiar with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。但我对他们非常熟悉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't take much to get what their deal is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不费什么力气就能明白他们的业务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stroll into town, kick a few doors in. Kill a few community pillars. Subjugate the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漫步到镇上，踢开几扇门。干掉几个社区支柱，征服其余的人。
