ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's old hat. But it works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是老一套了，但很有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, order something and buzz off. You're starting to get on my nerves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，点点东西走人吧。你开始让我心烦了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you used to be in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是军团的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what good has that order done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个秩序有什么好处？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want me to name off all the towns he's decimated?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说出他摧毁的所有城镇的名字吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the people captured in the night to be sold and shipped off as a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有在夜里被抓起来卖出去当奴隶的人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what you call order?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你所说的秩序？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar is not a sycophant. He's bringing order to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒不是马屁精，他给废土带来了秩序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too bad. I ain't telling you shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太糟糕了。我什么都不会告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just trying to get to know you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想了解你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay. Just stop being so damn nosy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。别再八卦了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All you need to know about me is I pour the coffee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只需要知道我是倒咖啡的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speaking of, order or move on. There's a line forming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说到这里，点菜还是继续。大家都在排队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. I'll stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，我就不说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're about to find out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你马上就知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I run the general store. I mostly just re-sell whatever junk caravans try to pawn off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我经营一家杂货店，我主要是转卖商队想典当的垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking for work, talk to Gustavo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在找工作，跟古斯塔沃谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the numbers guy. I'm just the fucking junk guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是负责数字的，我他妈只是个捡垃圾的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你们有什么卖的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Vicente. Call me Chente.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字是维森特，叫我陈特就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't call me Vicen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别叫我维森。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of junk do you sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们卖什么垃圾？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Tres Leches Caravan Co. What are you? Blind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 三人行商队公司啊。你怎么回事？瞎子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's only the fastest growing caravan company this side of the Colorado. Rival of the Crimson Caravan Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是科罗拉多河这边发展最快的商队公司，深红商队公司的竞争对手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got a lot of nerve strolling in here like you never heard of us. You know that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还真有胆量，就像没听说过我们一样大摇大摆走进来。你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah right. Folks all over know us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，没错。全世界的人都认识我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're the fucking Jordano trio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是该死的若尔达诺三人组。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guys that started from the ground up? From Prison to going toe-to-toe with the Crimson fucking Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些白手起家的家伙？从蹲监狱到跟该死的深红商队正面交锋？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're kind of a big fucking deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们他妈算是大人物了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still haven't heard of us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没听说过我们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear. I've never heard of you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，我从来没听说过你们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There it is. Glad I jogged that smooth brain of yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。很高兴我唤醒了你聪明的大脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was about a second from knocking your head around til you started talking sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你开始讲道理之前，我只差一秒钟就能敲碎你的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember you now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在记起你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I have no idea who you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我不知道你是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You spend half your life making a name for yourself only for it to be forgotten the second you leave town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你花了半辈子的时间为自己赢得名声却在你离开小镇的那一刻就被遗忘了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's life!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是生活！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep. That's... life, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。这就是...生活，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. What do you want buddy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便了。你想要什么，伙计？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you'll remember it as the last place you got your ass beat, buck-o.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会记得这里是你最后一次挨揍的地方，小子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would remember something with such a stupid name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 名字这么蠢的东西，我会记得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well think a little harder, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再仔细想想，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说一遍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, "Vicen".
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题，"维森"。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Vicen"
ESP.TRADUIT: "维森"。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much for respect, are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不怎么尊重人，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What rat-hole did you climb out of?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是从哪个老鼠洞里爬出来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I was just teasing you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我只是逗你玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my fucking name, that's what's wrong with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈的不是我的名字，这就是问题所在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now what do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong with the name Vicen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 维森这个名字有什么问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They got a few good ideas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们想出了一些好主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weak fearin the strong type shit. That stuff works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弱肉强食，这种方法很有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd be surprised just how easily most people fold when you show em a little muscle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会惊讶地发现，当你向大多数人展示一点肌肉时，他们是多么容易屈服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad for business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对生意不利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Permit this. Taxes that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 允许这个，征税。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You tell me why I gotta waste my time paying fees and reporting at checkpoints while the big guys get waved on through?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我为什么我要浪费时间交费用，在检查站报到，而大人物们却可以轻松通过吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's because they don't want competition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是因为他们不希望竞争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bunch of corrupt communists, if you ask me. They deserve everything the Legion gives em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我说，就是一群腐败的共产主义者。军团给予他们的一切都是他们应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bet your ass I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那还用说吗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to do about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算怎么做呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you threatening me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在威胁我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the deck was stacked against us. We had no chance against that giant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但形势对我们不利，我们根本没有机会战胜那个巨人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Luckily the Legion'll make sure there's lots of room for a... "Company Expansion" pretty soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运的是，军团会确保有足够的空间...“公司扩张”很快就要开始了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were competing with the Crimson Caravan Company?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在和深红商队公司竞争？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hey!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，嘿！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got a badass over here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有个坏蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll kick your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要揍你一顿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太对了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've jogged my memory. I've heard of you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你勾起了我的记忆，我听说过你们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. Just leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，别来烦我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry pal, nothing at the moment. Road's out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，伙计，暂时没有。路不通了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe try talking to Enzo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不和恩佐谈谈？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need some work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一些工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Gustavo Jordano.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是古斯塔沃·若尔达诺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I handle the logistics here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责这里的后勤工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without me, this whole operation falls apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有我，整个行动就会失败。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go talk to Chente.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去跟陈特聊聊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gustavo Jordano [0600D424] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我一些东西吗？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are people upset by it? I liked it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们对此不高兴？我很喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looky here. I've found your paint gun. I think the person leaving the graffiti is you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看这儿。我找到你的喷漆枪了，我觉得留下涂鸦的人就是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I didn't know. Um, please don't tell the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我不知道。呃，请不要告诉军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is pissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团很生气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm going to tell the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我要告诉军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm investigating the graffiti. Know anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在调查涂鸦。知道什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you must.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你非要问的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been on the frontlines for, I don't know, four or five years now. It's hard to keep track.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在前线已经，我不知道，四五年了吧，很难记清。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fought in Parker pretty recently but was redeployed to here after a bad case of soldier's heart after Dry Wells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最近在帕克打过仗，但因为一场严重的士兵心理症被调到这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When did you start on the frontline?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么时候开始上前线的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fool. Some of my brothers haven't been properly educated like I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 傻子，我的一些兄弟没有像我一样接受过良好的教育。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sent here when I corrected my Centurion on the proper words to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被派到这里是因为我纠正了我的百夫长说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He called a Profligate a degenerate, and that was obviously wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他把放荡者称为堕落者，这显然是错误的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a lot of words. Did anyone else at your post like listening to you talk?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一大堆单词。你的岗位上还有其他人喜欢听你说话吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiders. In Legion land. Is this your lie or his?
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者，在军团领地。这是你编的谎言还是他编的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Callum was captured by raiders. I freed him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡卢姆被掠夺者抓住了，我放了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you expect a reward for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想为此得到奖赏吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward: choose his punishment. Decimation or crucifixion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的奖赏：选择他的惩罚，处死或钉十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Callum is a deserter. He tried to flee the Legion, but I captured him to bring him to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡卢姆是个逃兵。他试图逃离军团，但我抓住了他，带他来见你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. My men will harden their resolves and their commitment to the Legion through the killing of their Profligate brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我的人将通过杀死他们堕落的兄弟来坚定他们对军团的决心和承诺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decimation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. His broken body will serve as a warning to his brothers not to ever betray Caesar's Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。他残破的尸体将警示他的兄弟们永远不要背叛凯撒军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crucifixion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钉十字架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm. So you were lying. Or joking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。所以你是在说谎，还是在开玩笑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your degenerate comedy is wasting my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那堕落的喜剧在浪费我的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. Callum isn't actually a deserter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别介意，卡卢姆其实不是逃兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need proof. And I'm not going to divert my contubernium away from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要证据。我不会让我的十人队离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the truth. There were raiders hiding out in a mine nearby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是事实。掠夺者藏在附近的矿井里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't have you do anything. Callum is my subordinate and my responsibility. If you're concerned for him, furnish me proof of these raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让你做任何事。卡卢姆是我的下属，也是我的职责。如果你担心他，给我提供这些掠夺者的证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Otherwise, begone and I'll make an example out of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则，你就走开，我要拿他杀鸡儆猴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you have me do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll bring back proof that Callum was captured by raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会带回卡卢姆被掠夺者俘获的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you like. I'll make an example of him. Deserters are less than scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你的便。我要拿他杀鸡儆猴，逃兵连渣滓都不如。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really care what happens to Callum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎卡卢姆会怎么样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you like. I'll make an example of him. Deserters are less than scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你的便。我要拿他杀鸡儆猴，逃兵连渣滓都不如。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind about finding evidence. You can punish Callum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变主意不找证据了，你可以惩罚卡卢姆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I suspected. Very well. I shall make an example of him. Deserters are less than scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正如我所料。很好，我要拿他杀鸡儆猴，逃兵连渣滓都不如。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any evidence of the raiders in Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有任何证据能证明大晶石矿有掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Present it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have evidence that there were raiders in Big Spar mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有证据表明大晶石矿里有掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A filthy-looking savage. May his people's memory be forgotten. You've done the world a favor by killing them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个外表肮脏的野蛮人，愿他的子民被人遗忘。你杀了他们，算是帮了这个世界一个忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm satisfied with this evidence. Callum shall return to normal duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这个证据很满意。卡卢姆应该回归正常工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the raider leader's head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者首领的脑袋在我这儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tribal junk. Savages love this sort of superstitious trash-worship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 部落的垃圾，野蛮人就喜欢这种迷信的垃圾崇拜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm satisfied with this evidence. Callum shall return to normal duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这个证据很满意。卡卢姆应该回归正常工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an heirloom of the raider tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一件掠夺者部落的传家宝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A surviving woman? Fascinating. I will have to see her for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸存的女人？真有意思，我得亲自去看看她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm satisfied with this evidence. Callum shall return to normal duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这个证据很满意。卡卢姆应该回归正常工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a woman of their tribe who survived.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了他们部落的一个幸存下来的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A letter. A letter. You expect me to believe these animals write letters to each other?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一封信，一封信。你想让我相信这些畜生会互相写信吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I won't accept this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不接受这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了这封信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back with more evidence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会带更多证据回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a harsh man. Whenever he's in the mood to lecture or punish, I'm the one who gets the worst of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个严厉的人。每当他想要说教或惩罚的时候，我都是最倒霉的那个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: The priestesses say it's just because he sees potential in me, but I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女祭司说这只是因为他在我身上看到了潜力，但我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd feel better if you were there to back me up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有你在，我会感觉好一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't you talk to your Decanus yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不能自己和你的什长谈谈？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Thank you. His name is Quintus. My contubernium is stationed at Dolan Springs. I'll meet you there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！谢谢你！他叫昆图斯。我的十人队驻扎在多兰泉，我在那儿等你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll talk to your Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去跟你的什长谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well. Thank you for breaking me out of there. If you're ever in Dolan Springs, come see me. I'll buy you a soda.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，谢谢你救我出来。如果你哪天来多兰泉，来找我，我请你喝杯汽水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to talk to your Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会去跟你的什长谈的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really did it! I cannot thank you enough, amicus. Truly, thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的做到了！我真是太感谢你了，朋友。真的，谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I should get back to my duties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我该回去工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck? I trusted you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？我相信了你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going back to the mine? I can't thank you enough, amicus. The leader's head should be enough to satisfy Quintus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要回矿井去？我真是太感谢你了，朋友。首领的人头应该足以让昆图斯满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would go with you, but I'm already on thin ice. I'll stay here until you return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和你一起去，但我现在处境已经很艰难了。我会呆在这里直到你回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll drag you down, motherfucker. Don't think you've seen the last of me. Mars gives me strength.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把你拖下水的，混蛋，别以为你再也见不到我了。玛尔斯给了我力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weaklings like you only drag the whole Legion down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的懦夫只会拖累整个军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your world will end, you Profligate fuck. Your people will die screaming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的世界就要毁灭了，你这个堕落的混蛋。你的人民会尖叫着死去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only good Legionary is a dead Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有死掉的军团士兵才是好军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. We can't leave yet. Some of those savages are still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我们还不能走。有些野蛮人还活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even think we killed the leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不认为我们杀死了首领。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're raiders. Didn't you see the corpses in there? These people kill and steal for fun. We can't let them live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是掠夺者。你没看到里面的尸体吗？这些人以杀人和偷窃为乐，我们不能让他们活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you care if they're alive or not? You're almost free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要关心他们的死活？你就快自由了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew you'd see reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道你会明白的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Let's go finish them off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们去把他们干掉吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'll go deal with them myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我自己去对付他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going back down there to kill more people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会再回去杀更多的人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An Aspirant in the Cult of Mars. Unlike the Maidens, we take our devotion to Mars seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯崇拜的追寻者。和巫女们不同，我们对玛尔斯的忠诚是认真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're an Aspirant? What does that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是一个追寻者？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is nothing I wish to tell you. Speak to Priestess Calventia in Dolan Springs, if you are so interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有什么想告诉你的。如果你有兴趣，可以和多兰泉的女祭司卡文提亚谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说玛尔斯教团吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are servicable midwives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她们是称职的助产士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of them are born into the Legion. High-performing slaves, daughters and concubines of the Legion elite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她们中的很多人都是军团出身。杰出军团精英的奴隶，女儿和妻妾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Compare to an Aspirant, who must forfeit her life as a Libertus to serve Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相比之下，一个追寻者必须放弃作为自由民的生命来为玛尔斯服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's no wonder that so many Priestesses were formerly Aspirants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难怪这么多女祭司以前都是追寻者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't like the Maidens?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢女侍？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I enforce the laws of Mars. This settlement is ripe for the Legion, in many ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我执行玛尔斯的律法。从很多方面来说，这个定居点对军团来说已经成熟了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The children here are young, naive. They are not yet attached to their profligacy. I aim to show them a more noble way of living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的孩子还小，天真。他们还没有沉溺于自己的堕落，我的目标是向他们展示一种更高尚的生活方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The women, on the other hand, are disgraceful. They are like men. Stupid, Prolfligate men, who believe they are above the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而女人则是可耻的。她们就像男人一样，愚蠢、堕落的男人，他们认为自己凌驾于军团之上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripe? What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 成熟了？你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Mars created the world with a natural order. If it is not followed, things fall into chaos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。玛尔斯以自然的秩序创造了世界，如果不遵循，事情就会陷入混乱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't the Legion prefer that women be more like men?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团难道不希望女人更像男人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么要交易的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with Radiant Caravan, from the Mandate of the Sun Coast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来自日光海岸托管区的辐射商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What trade caravan are you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪个商队的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to tell. Our headquarters is in Hermosillo, right across the street from the Generalissimo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么可说的。我们的总部在埃莫西约，就在大元帅的街对面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since we're the only caravan around, we have a monopoly on all the sweet gear. Course, a lot of that money goes right into the treasury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我们是这里唯一的商队，所以我们垄断了所有的甜蜜装备。当然，其中很多钱直接进入了国库。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Radiant Caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个辐射商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called central planning. Competition doesn't do nobody no good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是所谓的中央计划，竞争对任何人都没有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the only caravan around?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这附近唯一的商队？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but not this far north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对啊，但不在这么靠北的地方卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slaves get dropped off in Two-Sun mostly, 'cause that's where the Golden Circle and the Great Triangle meet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶们大多被送到双日城，因为那里是黄金圈和大三角的交汇处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you deal in slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们贩卖奴隶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two big trade lines. The Circle goes around the Gulf, and the Triangle connects Two-Sun to Phoenix and Flagstaff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两大贸易线。黄金圈环绕海湾，大三角连接双日城、凤凰城和旗杆市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever get the chance, Two-Sun is a beautiful city. The orchestra there is incredible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有机会，双日城是个美丽的城市，那里的管弦乐队令人难以置信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Golden Circle? Great Triangle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 黄金圈？大三角？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's war. Long as you stick to the right roads, it's easy business. Course, if you stray, you're liable to get strung up by NCR Rangers or raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是战争。只要你坚持走正确的路，生意就很好办。当然，如果你偏离了方向，你很可能会被NCR游骑兵或掠夺者吊死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the south though. Things don't seem too bad up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过那是南方，这里的情况看起来还不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lalo Shen [0600C45C] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any thoughts on the war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对战争有什么看法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guarding the fish, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜是在看守鱼吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shore Watcher [0600C472] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This post is beyond boring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个岗位太无聊了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shore Watcher [0600C472] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I was killing Profligates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我是在杀那些堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shore Watcher [0600C472] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try to stop thinking. It makes time go quicker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试着停止思考，这让时间过得更快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Shore Watcher [0600C472] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. You're not here to collect for the Fort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你不是来为堡垒收钱的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not often that we get actual customers here. How can I help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这里很少有真正的顾客。我能为你做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make sure to buy lots!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定要多买哦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么要交易的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't you see the sign outside? It's the town trading post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没看见外面的标志吗？这是镇上的贸易站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Miss Becca told me it used to be a lot busier. Nowadays we just use it to store the fish we catch for the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贝卡小姐告诉我这里以前比较繁忙，现在我们只是用它来储存我们为堡垒捕获的鱼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the old trading post burned down a while ago. This one was built shortly after that. That's why it looks all different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，原来的贸易站不久前被烧毁了，这个是在那之后不久建造的。所以看起来完全不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should probably talk to Doc Clay if you want to know more. She's super old so she knows everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想了解更多，你应该去找克雷医生谈谈。她年纪太大了，所以什么都知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the trading post?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说贸易站的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name's Sabia. I'm no good at catching fish, so I work here instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫萨比亚。我不擅长捕鱼，所以就在这里工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Miss Oria says I've got a mind for numbers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利亚小姐说我对数字很有头脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's from the Legion. She says she's an Aspirant, but I don't really know what that means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是军团的人。她说她是个追寻者，但我真的不知道那是什么意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's the one who chose me to work here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是她选择我来这里工作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Miss Oria?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利亚是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think she owns the trading post. She's really nice. She says I'm smart enough to be a Priestess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想贸易站是她的。她人很好，她说我足够聪明，可以当一名女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of things does Miss Oria do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利亚小姐在这里都做些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because we know the lake better than they do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我们比他们更了解这个湖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Miss Oria says its our duty to make the Legion big and strong, so they can protect us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利亚小姐说我们有责任让军团强大起来，这样他们就能保护我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sabia [0600C470] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is the Legion making Newt fish for them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团为什么要让纽特他们捕鱼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This post is dull enough to where that won't be an issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个岗位够无聊了，所以不会有什么问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Julius, owner of the Pond and your superior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是尤利乌斯，池塘的主人，也是你的上司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A nobody plebe moron. I am Julius, master of the Pond, my Fossio Chloretum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个无足轻重的白痴。我是尤利乌斯，池塘的主人，我的克洛勒图姆矿场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're not Legion, then you're beneath me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不是军团成员，那你就不如我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell do you think you're talking to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你在跟谁说话？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the master of the Pond and the last true slaveowner in all of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是池塘的主人，也是亚利桑那州最后一个真正的奴隶主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know this: you will never be as important as I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要知道：你永远不会像我一样重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes you so important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么让你如此重要？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah. Seen it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的。以前见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're all gone now, but I'm still here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都不在了，但我还在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't talk to me that way. I have the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能这么跟我说话。我有凯撒的徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Julius, owner of the Pond. Ignore me at your peril.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是尤利乌斯，池塘的主人。无视我，后果自负。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if that means you're not going to bother me and fuck off, then thank Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果这意味着你不会来烦我，然后滚蛋，那就谢谢玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the quarry outside Chloride. Much of the limestone used to make concrete for the Legion is mined there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是克洛赖德外面的采石场。用来为军团建造混凝土的石灰石大部分都是在那里开采的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officially, it's called the "Fossio Chloretum," but slaves and my deputies have problems pronouncing that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 官方的说法是，它叫“克洛勒图姆矿场”，但奴隶们和我的代理人们发音都有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay on my good side and the Legion's, otherwise you'll be sent to the mines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站在我和军团这边，否则你会被送去矿区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Pond?
ESP.TRADUIT: 池塘是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took it by conquest, making it mine by right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是通过征服得来的，是我的权利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I marched with a force of raiders to guard the quarry and a number of slaves to work it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带着一队掠夺者守卫采石场，还有一些奴隶在那里工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to own the Pond?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么拥有池塘的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Allow? That implies that the quarry is the Legion's and that they just allow me to work it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 允许？这意味着采石场是军团的，他们只是允许我在那里工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I own the quarry outright, in my own name. The Legion recognizes my superiority over the rest of Dolan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我完全拥有采石场，以我的名义。军团认识到我比多兰的其他人更优越。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am better at squeezing the stone than anyone else, even including the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我比任何人都更擅长挤压石头，甚至包括军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion allow you to own the Pond?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团允许你拥有池塘吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I own it, fully. I have for the past four years. Ever since the Legion started retreating from Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我完全拥有它。过去的四年里，从军团从胡佛水坝撤退开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very few in Legion lands have this privilege. That's what puts me above the common Liberti trash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团的土地上，很少有人拥有这种特权。这就是我凌驾于普通的自由民垃圾之上的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but everything belongs to Caesar, right? You're just renting it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但一切都属于凯撒，对吧？你只是租来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I own all of them. Most of the slaves at the Pond are mine, although a few belong to several independent traders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这些都是我的。池塘的大部分奴隶都属于我，虽然也有一些属于几个独立的商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that that will last long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这种情况不会持续太久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the slaves? The Legion leases them to you, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那奴隶呢？军团把它们租给你的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're successful in this world, then you're a raider. The strong take from the weak. It's as simple as that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在这个世界上取得了成功，那么你就是一个掠夺者。强者掠夺弱者，就这么简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why the Legion will win and conquer the Wasteland. They're not morons who cling to words like democracy or equality.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么军团会赢得胜利，征服废土。他们不是那些执着于民主和平等字眼的白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because they're a lot smarter than you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们比你聪明多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had proved myself by right of conquest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经用征服的权利证明了自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was strong and had conquered the weak. I was Legion in deed not just in word unlike all of the sycophants here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很强大，征服了弱者。我是真正的军团，而不像这里所有的马屁精那样仅仅是口头上的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you were a raider, then why didn't the Legion execute you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是掠夺者，为什么军团没有处决你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look around. See those deputies? They're mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看周围。看到那些代理人了吗？我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they're the Legion's now, but I knew little 'Titus Killus' when he was called 'Wez the Knife'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，他们现在是军团的了，不过我认识一个叫“提图斯·吉鲁斯”的小男孩，当时他被称为“匕首韦兹”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are those raiders now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些掠夺者现在在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you're a worthless weakling that doesn't deserve anything more than the Legion boot clamped down on your neck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你就是一个一无是处的弱者，除了被军团的靴子夹住脖子，你什么都不配拥有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're not taking what you want, then you will never get anywhere. Accept that, or accept your place at the bottom of the trash heap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不去争取你想要的，那么你将永远一事无成。接受这一点，或者接受你在垃圾堆底部的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm not a raider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我不是掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you're in denial, and this conversation is not worth continuining. Piss off, wastrel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是在否认事实，这样的谈话就不值得继续了。滚开，废物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am successful. I'm just not a raider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很成功。我只不过不是掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take your place at the top of the food chain, never stop raiding, and fight for what is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 站在食物链的顶端，永远不要停止掠夺，为属于你的东西而战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess if you put it that way, then I am a raider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果你这么说的话，那我就是个掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, this conversation is not worth continuining. Piss off, wastrel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，这个对话就不值得继续了。滚开，废物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reject that conclusion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我反对这个结论。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't really matter what I think about them. They will conquer the Wasteland and make you think how they want you to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么看他们并不重要。他们会征服废土，让你按照他们的想法去思考。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They take what they want when they want. That's the way of the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们想要什么就会得到什么。这就是世界的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only wish that they went a little further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望他们能走得更远一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Liberti as a class should be liquidated and subsumed to Caesar's will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由民作为一个阶级应该被清算，并服从于凯撒的意志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are still free people in Chloride and Dolan Springs and Kingman and every other town in the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在克洛赖德、多兰泉、金曼还有军团的其他城镇还有自由民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I was in charge, there wouldn't be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我说了算，就不会有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean by that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这话是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the strong who dominate the weak, and I am not weak, so no, it wouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 强者支配弱者，而我并不弱，所以不包括。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would, however, include you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，这会包括你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't that include you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不包括你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I've heard at all before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，是啊，我以前也听说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar will throw you into the dirt where you belong once he's done with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等凯撒收拾完你，就会把你扔进属于你的泥土里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're just his latest whore, a good little slave boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只是他最新的男妓，一个听话的小奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not weak. I am the personal righthand to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不弱，我是凯撒的得力助手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I've heard at all before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，是啊，我以前也听说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar will throw you into the dirt where you belong once he's done with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等凯撒收拾完你，就会把你扔进属于你的泥土里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're just his latest whore, a good little slave girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只是他最新的妓女，一个乖乖的小女奴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not weak. I am the personal righthand to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不弱，我是凯撒的得力助手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Maybe, you will. Or maybe, you're just an egghead yapping his trap about things he can never hope to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？也许，你会的。又或者，你只是一个书呆子，在喋喋不休地说着他永远也不可能去做的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You earned your strength by taking it. I'm doing the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的力量是靠夺取而获得的，我也在这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? Maybe, you will. Or maybe, you're just an egghead yapping her trap about things she can never hope to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？也许，你会的。又或者，你只是一个书呆子，在喋喋不休地说着她永远也不可能去做的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You earned your strength by taking it. I'm doing the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的力量是靠夺取而获得的，我也在这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it's because I say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是因为我这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only an idiot would say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有白痴才会这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么说的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an election between two sycophants to the Legion. I'm not sure which one is the bigger bootlicker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个军团的马屁精正在进行一场选举，我不知道谁更会拍马屁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calvin's been bootlicking the Legion for years to rebuild his precious White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文为了重建他珍贵的白沙，多年来一直在讨好军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Luke claims that he wants more freedom to the caravans because they're more useful to the Legion that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卢克声称他想让商队获得更多的自由，因为他们这样对军团更有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's honestly disgusting that this is even being entertained. At least the common plebes around here don't get a vote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的很恶心，居然有人拿这个当娱乐。至少这里的平民没有投票权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything interesting happening in Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德有什么有趣的变化吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calvin. I know who the Legion wants to win, and I want to be backing that guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文。我知道军团想谁赢，我想支持那个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you voting for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你投票给谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are...are you serious? This a vote by merchants, and you're not a merchant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是...你是认真的吗？这是商人的投票，而你不是商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you were important, you'd know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你很重要，你会知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do I register to vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里登记投票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you go away?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能走开吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有别的问题要问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hell, yes!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，该死，好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I've decided to follow your advice. I'm going to take what I want, which is your life.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我决定听从你的建议。我要夺走我想要的，也就是你的生命。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm the regional head of White Sands Caravan, out in Kingman. It's the biggest and best caravan in all of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是金曼白沙商队的地区负责人，这是全亚利桑那州最大最好的商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What caravan are you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪个商队的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're a courier, there's plenty of merchants around to get work from. Everyone's building up their stocks for the upcoming election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是个邮差，周围有很多商家会找你工作。每个人都在为即将到来的选举做准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopefully, you'll pick my merchants and not Luke's, but work is what you want, then I can't stop you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你会选我的商人，而不是卢克的，但你想要的是工作，那我不能阻止你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, uh, yes, there is one in here. It's, uh, to the right in the back. Can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的，这里有一个。在，呃，后面的右边。不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a bathroom in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里有洗手间吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, no. I can see the confusion. No, I represent all of the caravans here to the Legion. In fact, most of the people aren't with White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，不是，我能看出你的困惑。不，我代表这里所有的商队去见军团，事实上，大多数人都不是白沙的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're real independent types.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是真正独立的类型。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So everyone in Chloride is with White Sands?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以克洛赖德的人都支持白沙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep! The caravans are currently voting for someone to represent them to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯！商队正在投票选出代表他们加入军团的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We haven't had an election before because there wasn't much opposition to me leading the merchants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们之前还没有举行过选举，因为没有多少人反对我领导商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An election? In Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举？在军团领地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, what'd you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啊，你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于克洛赖德的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, this is the capital of the Mojave Orientum, so it's led by a proconsul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这里是莫哈维东部的首府，由一位总督领导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is Aristophantes, real good buddy of mine. You can find him at the Consulate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他叫阿里斯托芬提斯，我的好朋友。你可以在领事馆找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gives the merchants a lot of leeway to operate, and I'm in charge of them. Hopefully, it will stay that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给了商人很大的经营空间，我负责管理他们。希望能保持这种状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an election coming up. Right now, I'm the merchants' representative to the Legion, but some of them aren't happy about that, so they're running Luke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上就要进行选举了。我现在是商人们在军团的代表，但他们有些人对此不满意，所以他们在操纵卢克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay that way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 保持这种状态？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because of me. It was back in '77. I don't know it back then, but the Legion had just lost at Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我。那是在77年，我当时不知道，但军团刚刚在胡佛水坝失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me and Julius successfully managed to negotiate a deal with the Legion. My caravan and his slaves would help the Legion keep a little presence in the region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和尤利乌斯成功与军团达成了协议，我的商队和他的奴隶会帮助军团在这片区域保持一定的影响力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I managed to befriend Aristophantes, and even got an audience with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法和阿里斯托芬提斯成了朋友，甚至还见到了凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did the merchants become so strong in Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人们是如何在军团领地变得如此强大的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's on some mission to create something called 'Nova Roma', a new capital for him to make the Legion a real civilization.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的使命是创建一个叫做“新罗马”的地方，一个新的首都，让军团成为一个真正的文明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's using this place as a test run for what he'll need and what he wants when he does that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在用这里做试验看看他需要什么，他想要什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's giving us a lot of grace here, and I'm grateful and plan on making the most of this opportunity to help build a new Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在这里给了我们很多恩惠，我很感激，并计划充分利用这个机会来帮助建立一个新的亚利桑那州。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you talk with Caesar about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和凯撒谈了些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cyanide Springs is most of the merchants are, both local and caravan. Both mine and Luke's. If you need to buy something, buy it there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 山奈泉的商人大多是本地人和商队，我和卢克的都有。如果你需要买什么东西，就在那里买。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an inn, run by a wonderful woman named Miss Wen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一家旅馆，是一个叫温小姐的美女经营的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm also obliged to tell you about Dolan Springs as part of our little partnership with them. I can highly recommend the Big Dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为我们与多兰泉合作的一部分，我也有义务向你们介绍一下多兰泉。 我强烈推荐大狗餐厅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: And Doc D has an animal clinic. Don't be alarmed by the name. Humans are animals, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: D医生开了一家动物诊所，别被这个名字吓到了，人类也是动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looking for nearby goods and services.
ESP.TRADUIT: 寻找附近的商品和服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly administrative stuff. It's the capital of the province, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是管理方面的东西了，毕竟这是行省的首府。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and stay away from the Cult. They've set up shop in Dolan's old church. They're a little strict and don't really like the merchants, but I'd stay away from them if I were you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，离教团远点，他们在多兰的旧教堂里创立了分会。他们有点严格，不太喜欢商人，但如果我是你，我会离他们远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're just...crazy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们就是...很疯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else nearby?
ESP.TRADUIT: 附近还有别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Religion has no place in public policy. That's the simple truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 宗教在公共政策中没有一席之地，这是一个简单的事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad that Aristophontes agrees with me because if they get control of the Legion, and they are trying to get control, it's going to be terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴阿里斯托芬提斯同意我的观点，因为如果他们控制了军团，而且他们正试图控制，那将会很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Running a place like this requires compromise, but they think they're acting in the name of Mars, so they can't and won't compromise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 管理这样一个地方需要妥协，但他们认为他们是在以玛尔斯的名义行事，所以他们不能也不会妥协。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be glad when they're gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们走了我会很高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you allowed to say that about the Cult of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以这么说玛尔斯教团吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't stop you, but I haven't gotten to this position without making some powerful friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会阻止你，但我可不是没有交到一些有权势的朋友就能走到今天这一步的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't stir the pot too much. It'd be hard for me to step in and help you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会小题大做的，我很难介入帮你摆脱困境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you do if I reported you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我举报你，你会怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I want to answer that question. The Legion's here, and they're going to be here for a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我是否想回答这个问题。军团在这里，他们会在这里待很长一段时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, if you haven't wised up to it by now, I'd stop asking questions like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，如果你现在还没有醒悟过来，我就不再问这种问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like the rest of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢军团的其他成员吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You misunderstand me. I have no malice towards you. And if I did, I still wouldn't threaten you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你误解我的意思了，我对你没有恶意。就算我有，我也不会威胁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're allowed to disagree, but you have to not be disagreeable, understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以有不同意见，但你不能让人讨厌，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you threatening me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在威胁我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I like you, so I'll be straight with you. I have friends of the fox persuasion. If you know what I'm talking about, then you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我喜欢你，所以我就直说了，我有信仰狐狸的朋友。如果你知道我在说什么，那你就明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't, then it's best to keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不知道，那么最好保持这种状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like friends. Maybe, I should make friends with your friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢朋友。也许，我应该和你的朋友交朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Sorry, but I don't want you to get in trouble because of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]抱歉，但我不想让你因此惹上麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我你在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad you see it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你能这么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这很公平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a nothing town, really. The most exciting thing that ever happened here was a Ranger or two rolling through every decade or so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个一无所有的小镇，真的。这里发生过的最令人兴奋的事情是每十年左右就有一两个游骑兵来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't until the Legion set up shop that things got rolling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到军团成立，事情才有了转机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are stable. Things are safe. Things are busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 形势稳定，一切都很安全，事情很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was Chloride like before the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在加入军团之前克洛赖德是什么样子的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing! What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题！你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know about the election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道选举的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, sorry, friend, but this is a merchants-only election, not like the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，抱歉，朋友，但这是只有商人参加的选举，不像NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You vote with the Denarii you have, and whoever has the most Denarii pledged to him becomes the representative to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你用手中的第纳尔投票，谁拥有最多的第纳尔，谁就成为军团的代表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do I register to vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里登记投票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not a merchant. Everyone here has a vested interest in Chloride. You have to have roots here or show that you're truly willing to make some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是商人。这里的每个人都在克洛赖德有既得利益，你必须在这里扎根，或者表明你真的愿意做一些事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem more like a free agent, or at least I assume you are with that Mark on your neck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来更像一个自由间谍，至少我认为你脖子上的那个徽记是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I have money. Why can't I vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我有钱。为什么我不能投票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Merchants are more useful to the Legion than any of the other Liberti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于军团来说，商人比其他的自由民更有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We give them everything in exchange for those safe roads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们为他们付出一切换取安全的道路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion needs us to help with their supply lines. Even the act of our free trade boosts their currency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团需要我们帮助他们铺设补给线，甚至我们的自由贸易行为也刺激了他们的货币。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we get special treatment from the Legion, it's because we've earned it through hard work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们得到了军团的特殊待遇，那是因为我们通过努力工作赢得了它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is that fair?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这怎么公平？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's me and Luke, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是我和卢克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And Julius, who owns the Pond. I think Tex is backing me, too. I can't say I'm not grateful for their support.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有那个池塘的主人尤利乌斯。我觉得特克斯也在支持我，我对他们的支持感激不尽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, there's the people I haven't corraled yet, like Milia or thay guy from Kingman. He's the guy in black. Doesn't talk about himself much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一些我还没搞定的人，比如米莉娅或者那个金曼的家伙。就是那个穿黑衣服的人，他不怎么谈论自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
