ESP.ORIGINAL: And Ruiz might be voting, but he hasn't been in town for months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁伊兹可能会投票，但他已经好几个月没来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's voting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 投票给谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my business to look into people's private lives, plus things are a little heated right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 窥探别人的私生活不关我的事，而且现在情况有点紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope that we can all be friends after this, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我希望以后我们都能成为朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know anything about them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道他们的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's me, and there's Luke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有我，还有卢克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the candidates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 候选人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've been the merchants' representative to the Legion for years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我多年来一直是商人们在军团的代表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No need to break the status quo, right? The status quo is stability, peace, order and healthy competition under the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没必要打破现状，对吧？军团统治下的现状是稳定、和平、秩序和良性竞争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you running on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在用什么竞选？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a small man, seeking great wealth and power. He wants use this opportunity for public service to just enrich himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个追求巨大财富和权力的小人物，他想利用这个为公众服务的机会来中饱私囊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Luke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卢克呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, my pride and joy. You've come to the right person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我的骄傲和快乐。你找对人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对白沙有疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's the oldest caravan in Arizona. We've been around for over a century. I'll tell you why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是亚利桑那州最古老的商队，我们已经存在一个多世纪了。我来告诉你为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wanted cargo delivered anywhere in Arizona, you turned to us because we were the only ones with the guards and the firepower to get your things where they needed to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想把货物送到亚利桑那州的任何地方，你可以找我们，因为只有我们有足够的保安和火力把你的东西送到需要的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things were great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's its history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它的历史是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, things are pretty good now, but for a while there, we were on the ropes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，现在一切都很好，但有一段时间，我们很紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like under the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团统治下是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, my bosses were not really being forthright with the Arizona people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我的老板对亚利桑那州的人不太坦率。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were selling guns to the Rangers and the Legion during their war with each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在战争期间向游骑兵和军团出售枪支。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't believe it was true until they showed me the books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信这是真的，直到他们给我看了那些书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It really stung to know that my bosses didn't trust me with that information, but in my heart, I knew that the Legion was right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道我的上司不相信我，不把这个消息告诉我时，我真的很难过，但在我心里，我知道军团是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep! We managed to secure the big slave transport and trading contract with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯！我们设法与军团签订了一份奴隶运输和贸易的大合同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the big contract that keeps the lights on these days, but I've also managed to break back into a couple of our old markets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一份大合同，能让现在的生意持续下去，但我也设法重新打入了我们的几个老市场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is White Sands doing better now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙的情况好转了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a lot more competition these days. Back in the old days, our only rivals were the Tall Pines caravans. But, lots of little caravans arose to fill those markets while we were rebuilding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在竞争越来越激烈了。在过去，我们唯一的对手是高松商队。但是，在我们重建的时候，很多小商队出现了，挤满了这些市场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheap labor and safe roads reduced start-up costs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 廉价的劳动力和安全的道路降低了启动成本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you need to break back into your old markets?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们为什么要重新打入老市场？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slaves. It's our big contract with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶。这是我们和军团的大合同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must confess that that I have a distaste for slavery, but it's necessary in this day and age, especially until we can break back into our old markets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须承认，我讨厌奴隶制，但在当今时代，这是必要的，尤其是在我们能重新打入我们的旧市场之前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does White Sands primarily trade in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙主要经营什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were a tribe that used to operate in this territory. They were traders, mostly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是曾经在这片土地上活动的一个部落，他们大多是商人...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew a lot of Tall Pines who worked on my caravans to send funds back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识很多高松人，他们在我的商队里工作，把钱寄回家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were great businessmen, especially in the arms market, which I guess was their preparation for their war with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是伟大的商人，特别是在军火市场，我猜这是他们为与军团的战争做准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a shame that the Legion wiped them all out because they really were great employees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾军团把他们都消灭了，因为他们真的是很棒的员工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tall Pines?
ESP.TRADUIT: TallPines ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead and ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去问他们吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's a town in Legion territory. Comes with all the perks, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是军团地盘上的一个小镇。有很多福利，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Safe roads, no crime, cheap labor, shit like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安全的道路，没有犯罪，廉价的劳动力，诸如此类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It kind of sucks that we can't have a drink anymore, but, honestly, it's whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不能再喝酒有点糟，但说实话，无所谓了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The town's pretty boring, otherwise. Without the Legion here, I don't think I would ever considering setting up shop here or even passing through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，这个小镇挺无聊的。如果没有军团在这里，我想我永远不会考虑在这里开店，甚至不会经过这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说克洛赖德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The merchants are currently voting on whether or not they want a new representative to the Legion, which they do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人们正在投票决定他们是否想要一个新的军团代表，他们确实想要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说选举吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me and Calvin. Calvin's a godammned idiot who got into this mess in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和加尔文。加尔文是个该死的白痴，就是他惹上了这场麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the candidates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 候选人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since the collapse of the Chainway, all of my coworkers have seen a 45% drop in revenue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从连环道坍塌以来，我所有同事的收入都下降了45%。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had to wait weeks for the Legion to actually start working on clearing the roads because they keep being diverted to the Legate's Camp and the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不得不等上几个星期，军团才真正开始清理道路，因为他们一直被转移到特使营地和堡垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop, or Solitare, whatever the fuck, exploded a while ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站，或者索利泰尔什么的，前阵子爆炸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traffic's all backed up, the caravans aren't running on time, the Legion's been breathing down our necks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 交通堵塞，商队不能按时行驶，军团紧盯着我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion won't even let us use caravan guards on this leg of the route. It's bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团甚至不让我们在这段路线上使用商队守卫。都是扯淡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What mess are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么乱七八糟的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Considering his track record, I honestly wouldn't be surprised if Calvin blew it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到他过去的表现，如果是加尔文把它炸了我也不会惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somehow, White Sands' profits keep going up while the rest of us have been in freefall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知何故，白沙的利润一直在上升，而我们其他人的利润却在直线下降。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think caused the collapse of the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为是什么导致了连环道的坍塌？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I haven't been there in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我有段时间没去那里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess there was some uprising? I mean, Big Stop has been on a decline ever since the NCR started charging tolls on the dam, so it wouldn't surprise me if it just keeled over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜发生了暴动？我的意思是，自从NCR开始对大坝收费以来，大站就一直在走下坡路，所以如果它倒下了，我也不会感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened in Big Stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I haven't been there in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我有段时间没去那里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guess there was some uprising? I mean, Solitare has been on a decline ever since the NCR started charging tolls on the dam, so it wouldn't surprise me if it just keeled over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜发生了暴动？我的意思是，自从NCR开始对大坝收费以来，索利泰尔就一直在走下坡路，所以如果它倒下了，我也不会感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened in Solitare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, usually, we don't need them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，通常情况下，我们不需要它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me put it this way, in the past fifteen years I've been doing business in Legion territory, do you know how many raiders I've seen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我这么说吧，在过去的15年里，我一直在军团的地盘上做生意，你知道我见过多少掠夺者吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three. When I was in NCR, I saw nine every trip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三个。我在NCR的时候，每次出差都能看到九个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the Legion's gotten paranoid ever since Solitare blew up and doesn't want us hiring caravan guards and arming them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，自从索利泰尔爆炸后，军团变得偏执起来，不希望我们雇佣商队守卫武装他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion won't let you use caravan guards?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不允许你使用商队守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's circle back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们绕回去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The status quo. Hmmh, the status quo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现状。哼哼，维持现状。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He spends so much time about his boyfriends in the Legion that I wonder if he knows that's Latin for "the mess we're all in ".
ESP.TRADUIT: 他花了那么多时间在军团里的男朋友身上，我想他是否知道那是拉丁语“我们都陷入了混乱”的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is Calvin running on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文靠什么竞选？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's connected with the proconsul, I know that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他和总督有关系，我知道的就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he's got something else going on because I've seen him meeting with lots of odd people at strange hours of the night. It's probably Frumentarii, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，他有别的事情要做，因为我看到他在晚上的奇怪时间和很多奇怪的人见面。不过可能是军团特务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wish it was something bad, like Rangers or undercover NCR, but they haven't been here in a long time. Or ever, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真希望是什么坏事，就像游骑兵或者NCR卧底。但他们很久没来过这里了，或者从来没有，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about Calvin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对加尔文了解多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is. I don't actually know if he is gay, but I hope he is because the Legion would execute him, and that would be just a tremendous improvement to everyone's situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。我不知道他是不是同性恋，但我希望他是，因为军团会处决他，这将极大地改善每个人的处境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, actually, it doesn't matter that much, because if he's fucking the Legion, then the Legion's going to have his back until after the election, but a guy can dream.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，其实，这也没那么重要，因为如果他跟军团上床了，那么军团就会一直支持他直到选举结束，但一个人可以有梦想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Calvin gay? Isn't homosexuality in the Legion illegal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文是同性恋吗？同性恋在军团不是非法的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're okay. Honestly, I'm not a big fan of pushy they are. They sometimes just take your shit whenever they feel like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很好。说实话，我不太喜欢咄咄逼人的人，他们有时想要什么就拿走你的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And honestly, the roads aren't that great right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，现在的路也没那么好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I'll tell you what, labor is so, so cheap here that it's much easier to break even than it is in the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我要告诉你的是，这里的劳动力非常非常便宜，比在NCR更容易做到收支平衡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah. It's pretty easy to get started in the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。在军团里很容易上手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the NCR, it's all forms and paperwork and red tape and bureaucracy. You have to pay your workers a salary, otherwise they run off, but that's a not a problem here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在NCR，到处都是表格，文书，繁文缛节和官僚主义。你必须给你的员工支付工资，否则他们就会跑掉，但这在这里不是问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is frankly much better for small businesses than the NCR is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白说，对于小企业来说军团比NCR要好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By labor, you mean slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的劳动力是指奴隶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah, the NCR government never solves anything. They only create problems and....
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是啊，NCR政府从来没有解决过任何问题。他们只会制造问题和...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, are you talking about the slaves? I mean, if we weren't using them, they'd be raiding or stinking up the place or doing drugs. Honestly think that it's more immoral to not enslave them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你是说奴隶吗？我想说，如果我们不使用他们，他们就会去抢劫，把这里弄得一团糟，或者吸毒。老实说，我觉得不奴役他们更不道德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't that strike you as wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不觉得这是错的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the government expands, your liberty contracts. It's been like that my whole life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当政府扩张时，你的自由就会收缩。我的一生都是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some NCR senator in Redding tells my caravan in Nevada what to do. Some bleeding-heart in the Boneyard wants me to up my minimum wage for my workers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 某个瑞丁的NCR议员告诉我在内华达州的商队该怎么做。在晒骨场，有个心肠不好的人要我提高工人的最低工资。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some greedy senator in the Hub wants more taxes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 中枢市有个贪婪的参议员想加税。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meanwhile, I petition my senator to send some boys to send troopers. They send troopers, alright. To set up checkpoints.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与此同时，我向我的参议员请愿，让他派几个小伙子带兵来。他们派兵来了，设立了检查站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I'm the one taking all that risk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我要承担所有的风险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it better for small businesses?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对小企业更好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Oh, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？哦，是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's less checkpoints, and I've never had to spend more than 20 minutes at one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，检查点少了，而且我从来没在一个地方待过20分钟以上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I can run more caravans because I'm waiting on some jockey to check my papers for three hours, and I pay less taxes during the entire trip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样一来，我就可以跑更多的大篷车，因为我只需等待某个骑师检查我的证件三个小时，而且我在整个旅途中缴纳的税款也更少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Add in the lower cost of labor to help you run your caravans, reduced need for guards, shit like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再加上更低的劳动力成本来帮助你管理商队，减少对守卫的需求，诸如此类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, I'm looking at a 160% profit margin in Legion territory. I never cracked more than 40% in NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，我在军团的地盘上有160%的利润率。我在NCR从来没超过40%
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The numbers don't lie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 数字不会说谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I asked about the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我问的是军团的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah, it's obvious, isn't?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，很明显，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry up and ask 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快去问问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Luke [0600E3BC] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, you're loud. I'm fine. Why? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，你太吵了，我没事。为什么？你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, you're loud. I'm fine. Why? What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，你太吵了，我没事。为什么？你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来糟透了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means I brawl. I like to fly high and throw punches, sometimes I take one in the process. Hence the fat eye. Consider this if you run your mouth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是我喜欢打架，我喜欢高高在上，挥拳出拳，有时我会在这个过程中挨一拳。这就是肥眼的由来，如果你敢说，考虑一下这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they call you Fat Eye?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么叫你肥眼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just a nobody, man. How about you take it easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个无名小卒，伙计。你放松点怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elephant Hill. Know why? Because it's a steaming pile of elephant shit, that's why. Whatever an elephant is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 象山。知道为什么吗？因为这是一堆冒着热气的大象屎，这就是原因。不管大象是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine a bar with no beer. Imagine a rest stop with no traffic. You have just imagined Elephant Hill. A pitstop on the road to nowhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一个没有啤酒的酒吧，想象一个没有车辆的休息站。你就是在想象象山了，一个没有目的地的车站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, keep your voice down. Why is she naming me in all of this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，小声点。她为什么要把我扯进来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jem sent me, it's about Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 捷姆让我来的，是关于塞多尼乌斯的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. You want to get involved in that? It's nasty business. But, fine. Yeah, Sedonus is an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。你想掺和进来吗？这是肮脏的生意。但是，好吧，对，塞多尼乌斯是个瘾君子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think we all know what this is about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们都知道这是怎么回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. You want to get involved in that? It's nasty business. But, fine. Yeah, Sedonus is an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。你想掺和进来吗？这是肮脏的生意。但是，好吧，对，塞多尼乌斯是个瘾君子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She said you could tell me about Sedonus' addiction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她说你可以告诉我塞多尼乌斯的成瘾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: His assistant came to me a while ago, pulled me aside. For a second, I thought he was going to kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前一段时间他的助手来找我，把我拉到一边。有那么一瞬间我以为他要杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, his voice got real low, and he asked if I knew where the local degenerates get Buffout. I tell him I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，他的声音变得很低，他问我是否知道当地的堕落者是在哪里搞到壮大灵的。我告诉他我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then he asked me if Buffout can be synthesized. I told him it could, but not by a waster, and then he got all agitated and left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后他问我壮大灵是否可以合成。 我告诉他可以，但不能用废品，然后他就激动地离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His assistant came to me a while ago, pulled me aside. For a second, I thought he was going to kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前一段时间他的助手来找我，把我拉到一边。有那么一瞬间我以为他要杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, his voice got real low, and he asked if I knew where the local degenerates get Buffout. I tell him I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，他的声音变得很低，他问我是否知道当地的堕落者是在哪里搞到壮大灵的。我告诉他我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then he asked me if Buffout can be synthesized. I told him it could, but not by a waster, and then he got all agitated and left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后他问我壮大灵是否可以合成。 我告诉他可以，但不能用废品，然后他就激动地离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, fuck it, you've proven yourself to be cool. I personally don't deal in chems, just to be clear. It's too risky. But I do deal in chem precursors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你的，你已经证明自己很酷了。澄清一下，我个人不做化学药物生意，这太冒险了。但我确实涉及化学前体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all stuff you can get anywhere, basic multipurpose ingredients. Some of it is even used by the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都是你可以在任何地方买到的东西，基本的多功能配料。其中一些甚至被军团使用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could say I deal in the benign. If someone takes my wares and makes themselves some chems with it, well that's not my problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以说我是做良性生意的。如果有人拿了我的货然后用它制造了些化学药物，那不是我的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know so much about the chem trade around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么对这附近的化学药物生意这么了解？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I tell you here stays between you and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里告诉你的事只有你知我知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had more questions about your work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的工作有更多的疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No guts, no glory. People want to get fucked up. Hell, now that the Legion's here people are trying to get twice as high just to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有勇气，就没有荣耀，人们想变得很操蛋。该死的，现在军团来了，人们都想爬到两倍高的地方，只是为了逃跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good money, the war's been good for business too. With Caesar all tied up with the dam it's given us some breathing room down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是笔大钱，战争对生意也有好处。凯撒被绑在大坝上，这给了我们一些喘息的空间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You live like this on Legion lands?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在军团领地就这样生活吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well yeah! I'm always fucking afraid. That's why I always have a little product on me, you dig? Takes the edge off, keeps me running smooth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯是啊！我总是他妈的害怕。所以我身上总是带着些小玩意，懂吗？缓解压力，让我保持顺畅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about me. If the Legion catches up to me I'll make sure I go quick. I'm not going up on any cross while I'm still breathing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用担心我。如果军团追上了我，我一定会尽快离开。只要我还活着，我是不会上十字架的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't you afraid you'll get caught?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不怕被抓住吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now you could say I'm holding onto what's left of my merchandise. Call it a fucking rainy day fund. So no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你可以说我还在坚守着我剩下的商品，就当是他妈的应急基金吧。所以没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I'll just hire every stranger that comes in here and talks my ear off. What makes you think I even want your help, big shot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我会雇佣每一个来这里唠唠叨叨的陌生人。你凭什么觉得我需要你的帮助，大佬？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need any help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要帮忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's true. Partners like that are hard to find out here, that's for sure. Alright, friend I may have something for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。这样的搭档在这里是很难找到的，这是肯定的。好吧，朋友，我可能有东西要给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sometimes work with these guys from down south, they're trying to make a name for themselves out here. Professionals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有时会和这些来自南方的人合作，他们想在这里扬名立万。专业人士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an order from them that I've been sitting on, and I need someone to run it down to Chloride before their patience runs dry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一份他们的订单，我一直在拖延，我需要有人在他们的耐心耗尽之前把它送到克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple delivery job. You show up, you give the guy the stuff, end of story. You and me split the pay 50/50. So are we in on this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] You and I aren't exactly friends of Caesar, we can trust each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]你和我并不是凯撒的朋友，我们可以互相信任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hey now watch that mouth of yours! Aw, fuck. You're right aren't you? Okay listen up compadre because here's the score.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嘿，管好你的嘴！啊，操。你说得对，不是吗？好了，听好了，伙计，这是实情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple delivery job. You show up, you give the guy the stuff, end of story. You and me split the pay 50/50. So are we in on this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Face it, Fat Eye. You need me. The fact that you're even willing to entertain this proves that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 面对现实吧，肥眼，你需要我。你愿意接受这个事实就证明了这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah but Legion spies don't mind working like that, so long as they think it gets them more degenerates on crosses at the end of the day.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]是的，但军团间谍并不介意这样工作，只要他们认为这样能让他们在一天结束时在十字架上挂上更多的堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't trust you, outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你，外来者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've done right by you so far, haven't I?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止，我对你还不错，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Fuck. It's that obvious, huh? I have enough supplies to cook up one last batch but then I'm dead in the water. Alright listen up.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]操，很明显吗？我有足够的物资来做最后一批，但那样我就死定了。好了，听好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sometimes work with these guys from down south, they're trying to make a name for themselves out here. Professionals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有时会和这些来自南方的人合作，他们想在这里扬名立万。专业人士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一份他们的订单，我一直在拖延，我需要有人在他们的耐心耗尽之前把它送到克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple delivery job. You show up, you give the guy the stuff, end of story. You and me split the pay 50/50. So are we in on this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you're going through chem withdrawal, you aren't in shape to move your product yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你正在经历药物戒断反应的过程，所以你没有能力自己去推销你的产品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah well if you think I look funny you can always stop looking at me, the door to somewhere else is over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]好吧，如果你觉得我很滑稽，你可以别再看我了，通往别的地方的门就在那边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just look at you, man. You're all sweaty and wet. You can't go out trading like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你，伙计。你浑身都是汗，你不能就这样出去做生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name-dropping the wise guy, huh? He's a bit of a snake but he's no Legion snake, that's for fucking sure. Okay then, here it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 借智者之名抬高自己？他有点像条蛇，但他不是军团的蛇，这他妈是肯定的。好吧，给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guido put me onto you, which means Guido says I'm cool.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圭多让我来找你的，也就是说圭多说我很酷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. You're saying you're bad enough to ride with Niemann and I get that. Okay, so here's the deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。你是说你已经够坏了，可以和尼曼并肩作战，我明白。好吧，事情是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple delivery job. You show up, you give the guy the stuff, end of story. You and me split the pay 50/50. So are we in on this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because Niemann sent me to you, which means Niemann says I'm good for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为是尼曼让我来找你的，也就是说尼曼说我能胜任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah well, this isn't helping out a kooky lady at Big Stop. But you've made your point. Alright here's what I have for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这可帮不了一个在大站的古怪女士，但你已经表达了你的观点。好吧，这是我要给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sometimes work with these guys from down south, they're trying to make a name for themselves out here. Professionals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有时会和这些来自南方的人合作，他们想在这里扬名立万。专业人士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an order from them that I've been sitting on, and I need someone to run it down to Chloride before their patience runs dry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一份他们的订单，我一直在拖延，我需要有人在他们的耐心耗尽之前把它送到克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple delivery job. You show up, you give the guy the stuff, end of story. You and me split the pay 50/50. So are we in on this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项简单的送货工作。你去找他，把东西给他，就这样，你和我平分报酬。那我们要加入吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm cool with Jem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我对捷姆没意见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck yeah, welcome aboard, amigo. Now the first thing we need is my shit. I don't keep it on me, so we'll need you to hike out to my stash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，欢迎加入，朋友。现在我们首先需要的是我的东西，我没带在身上，所以你得走到我的藏宝处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not far, so save your fucking complaints, I'll mark it on your map. We want everything that's in the duffle bag. Don't touch anything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 离这儿不远，别他妈抱怨了，我会在你的地图上标出。我们要行李袋里的所有东西，别碰其他任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you're the one that fucking asked! But if you want to leave me high and dry, I guess I can't stop you. I'll be around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，是你他妈问的！但如果你想让我孤身一人，我想我无法阻止你。我就在附近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have time for this right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在没时间跟你谈这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I don't feel up to it, okay? I'm not spelling it out for you. Just know that I'll be in good shape in a few days if you don't fuck this up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我感觉不太舒服，好吗？我不是来给你解释的，只要你不把这事搞砸，我几天后就会恢复健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remind me why you can't do this yourself, again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说一遍，你为什么不能自己动手？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lemme see! Alright, yeah, it's all here, good shit. Okay, your next stop is in Chloride. You don't want the red light district. Our man's in the park.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看！好了，都在这里了，好东西。好的，你的下一站是克洛赖德，你不要想红灯区，我们的人在园区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go there, and look for a prospector-type with a black hat, ask him if he knows if it's rained in Six Mile Crossing. That'll get you to the hand off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找一个戴着黑帽子的淘金客类型的家伙，问他知不知道六英里路口下雨了。这样你就能脱手了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and I shouldn't have to tell you this, but don't do anything stupid. We're here to pull off a nice clean deal, and these guys don't fuck around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不应该告诉你这些，但不要做傻事。我们来这里是为了完成一笔干净的交易，而这些家伙可不是在胡闹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was able to find your stash and have the supplies we need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了你的藏宝处，拿到了我们需要的物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck is this? That asshole! Don't think you didn't play any role in fucking this up. You can go ahead and fuck off now, I'm keeping this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈的是什么？那个混蛋！别以为你跟这事没关系。你可以滚了，这个我留着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dropped the package off, but your "friend" is upset about the wait. Here's the take.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把包裹送过去了，但你的“朋友”因为等得太久而不高兴。这是报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all here, huh? You must have had to talk your way into that, much obliged. Here's your half and a little bonus for a job well done. Nice work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都在这里了，是吧？你一定是费尽口舌才弄到的，我很感激。这是你的一半，还有一点奖金，奖励你的出色表现。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dropped the package off, but your "friend" is upset about the wait. Here's the take.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把包裹送过去了，但你的“朋友”因为等得太久而不高兴。这是报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye, Fat Eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜，肥眼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I thought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是这么想的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it you sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well you’re the one that came over here, stranger. What was it that caught your eye?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你跑过来的，陌生人。是什么吸引了你的注意？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [0600D08E] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are your friends?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友是谁?

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of question is that? Have you ever seen a caravan before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么问题？你以前见过商队吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [0600D08E] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know if it’s rained in Six Mile Crossing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道六英里路口下雨了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It’s about goddamn time. You are late as fuck, you know that? The boss wants to talk to you, he’s in the back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 差不多是时候了。你他妈的迟到了，你知道吗？老板想和你谈谈，他在后面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [0600D08E] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先告辞了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Safe travels to ya.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你一路平安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [0600D08E] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Traveling Merchant [0600D08E] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fat Eye is indisposed, I'm performing business on his behalf.
ESP.TRADUIT: 肥眼病了，我来替他办事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't begin to speculate on the matter of his current predicament, though it is likely well deserved. Addicts are slothful and unreliable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会对他目前的困境进行推测，尽管这可能是他应得的。瘾君子既懒惰又不可靠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assume that you at least have the package that we agreed to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你至少有我们约定好的包裹吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He looks like shit, I can tell you that. You're dealing with me instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以告诉你，他看起来糟透了。你要和我打交道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't begin to speculate on the matter of his current predicament, though it is likely well deserved. Addicts are slothful and unreliable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会对他目前的困境进行推测，尽管这可能是他应得的。瘾君子既懒惰又不可靠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assume that you at least have the package that we agreed to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你至少有我们约定好的包裹吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here it is. <Give Chem Precursors>
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，给你。<给予化学前体>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes. Now for the matter of payment. The shipment was late and it was delivered by a stranger, a violation of our agreement with the addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的，现在来谈谈付款的问题。货物晚点了，而且是一个陌生人送来的，这违反了我们和那个瘾君子的协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With these considerations made, I will be giving you 50 percent of what was agreed upon. You are both fortunate, this is a generous offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到这些因素，我将给你商定金额的50%。你们俩都很幸运，这是个慷慨的提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on now, let's talk money first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下，我们先谈谈钱的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes. Now for the matter of payment. The shipment was late and it was delivered by a stranger, a violation of our agreement with the addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的，现在来谈谈付款的问题。货物晚点了，而且是一个陌生人送来的，这违反了我们和那个瘾君子的协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With these considerations made, I will be giving you 50 percent of what was agreed upon. You are both fortunate, this is a generous offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到这些因素，我将给你商定金额的50%。你们俩都很幸运，这是个慷慨的提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I must say. I wasn't expecting to be spoken to this way during this exchange. But today has been full of surprises. Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我必须说，我没想到在这次交流中会被这样对待。但今天却充满了惊喜。好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your friend would do well to remember that our patience is a finite resource, be sure to tell him that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友最好记住，我们的耐心是有限的，一定要告诉他这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I think that you should give me the other 50 percent as recompense for reneging on our deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你应该给我另外的50%，作为你背弃协议的补偿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] And the terms of that agreement were not met. You are fortunate that we are giving you anything at all. As I said, the new offer is generous.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]协议的条款没有得到满足。你很幸运，我们给了你任何东西，正如我说的，新的报价很慷慨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? That's not fair, you and Fat Eye had an agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这不公平，你和肥眼是有约定的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't have a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我没得选了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're correct, you do not. You would do well to remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，你没有。你最好记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Man in Black [0600E3B3] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you ain't Legion, by the looks of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，看来你不是军团的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought everything in Arizona belonged to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还以为亚利桑那的一切都是属于军团的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right it does. Still, I can't be letting just anyone in; Caesar's orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，确实如此。不过，我不能随便让任何人进来，凯撒的命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go talk to Caius Drusus if you're looking for something in the storage lot. He's got the key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你要找仓库里的东西，去找盖尤斯·德鲁苏斯吧。他有钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last time I checked, everything is property of Caesar, Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，所有东西都是凯撒的财产，堕落者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? Just some old fool getting a sunburn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？只是个被晒伤的老傻瓜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's not too bad. When the road's fixed things'll pick up again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还不算太糟。等路修好了，情况就会好转。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must be pretty boring up here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里一定很无聊吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tres Leches Caravan. That's their HQ just up the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三人行商队，那边就是他们的总部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whose storage lot is this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是谁的仓库？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, just a trio of numbskulls from California lookin' to profit off the battle at the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只不过是三个想从大坝之战中获利的三个来自加州的笨蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about 3-Some Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说三人行商队吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't have the power to hire anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我没有雇佣任何人的权力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe try talking to Mr. G?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要不试着和G先生谈谈？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enzo Jordano. He's my boss. You can find him at the HQ, 2nd floor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恩佐·若尔达诺，他是我老板。你可以在总部2楼找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. G?
ESP.TRADUIT: G先生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's there to know? The poor girl fell apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么可知道的？可怜的女孩崩溃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It comes with age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随着年龄的增长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what happened to the road?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这条路怎么了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey pal, aren't we all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，伙计，我们不都是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly they make their money subcontracting independent traders to make dealing with the Legion a bit easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数情况下，他们通过转包给独立的贸易商来赚钱，以使与军团的交易更容易一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Problem is, not much trade going on around here. Our guys are too ill-equiped to take any of the other routes to the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，这里没什么生意可做。我们的人装备太差了，无法从其他途径进入堡垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're war profiteers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是战争奸商？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of our guys are junk dealers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们大多数人都是废品商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The problem, is the Legion ain't always looking for junk. Meaning they gotta wait in the market til they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，军团并不总是在寻找垃圾。这意味着他们必须在市场上等待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The more time waiting in the market, the less time they got for finding more junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在市场上等待的时间越多，他们找垃圾的时间就越少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's where we come in. Traders sign a contract with us, and in turn we sell their garbage on consignment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我们的切入点。贸易商与我们签订合同，而我们则寄售他们的垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do they make their money subcontracting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们怎么通过转包来赚钱的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we store it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们存储在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gustavo and Mr. G handle requests from the Legion. I pack it up, and we ship it up the road to the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古斯塔沃和G先生负责处理军团的委托。我把它打包，然后我们把它运到堡垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...or, we used to.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...或者说，我们曾经。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens to the junk from there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些垃圾会怎么处理？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not your business, pal. Ever hear of client confidentiality?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就不关你的事了伙计，听说过客户机密嘛？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of things do you ship to the Fort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们往堡垒运什么东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever can't seem to sell to the Legion is put up for sale at the Buy & Sell, which Vinnie runs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何看起来不能卖给军团的东西都被放在文尼经营的“买卖”上出售。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does 3-Some do anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 三人行还干别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Works for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what that is, but fine. Just be quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那是什么，不过好吧。快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Show Mark of Caesar] Look, I'm not some normal person. Just let me buy something.
ESP.TRADUIT: [出示凯撒的徽记]听着，我不是一般人。让我买点东西吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Eutychus [0600E3BA] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like some food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想吃点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a matter of fact, I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm getting older, as you can plainly see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也看得出来，我老了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I had myself a little fall the other day. I'm alright thanks for asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前几天我还摔了一跤。我还好，谢谢你的关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, I dropped my damn toolbox off the overpass, and out flew my welding mask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，我把该死的工具箱从天桥上掉了下去，我的焊接面罩飞出去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mind grabbing it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 介意帮我拿一下吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Need help with anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 需要帮忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感激不尽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an old man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个老头！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do it yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自己动手吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks a lot, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢了，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your mask
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的面罩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] The fuck it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]去你妈的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is my mask now.
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易30]现在这是我的面罩了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Well, I guess you earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，我想这是你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead and take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Damien [06005798] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is my mask now.
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易30]现在这是我的面罩了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm making a big batch of Spicy Crambalaya, but I'm all out of Cram.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在做一大堆香辣什锦午餐肉，但是午餐肉没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you scrounge me up 10 cans of Cram?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我找十罐饱饱牌午餐肉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahkay, well lemme know if ya change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊好，如果你改变主意了，请告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我现在有点忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks a bunch, pal. You really saved me a lot of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢了，伙计，你帮我省了不少时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take the recipe. You earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着配方。这是你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's that Cram you needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你需要的午餐肉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did? You should have asked me first, but I'm grateful nonetheless. Here's a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？你应该先问我的，但我还是很感激。这是报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should go break the news to my slave Postumus. It was supposed to be his job, but I suppose he'll be back on the regular shift now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该把这个消息告诉我的奴隶波斯图穆斯。这本该是他的工作，但我想他现在该回去正常值班了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I removed the boulder that was blocking the back entrance of the mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我移走了挡住矿井后门的巨石。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, my slaves have already informed me. Well done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我的奴隶已经告诉我了。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you looking at me like that? You expect payment...? I didn't ask you to do anything in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么用那种眼神看着我？你想要报酬...？我一开始就没有要求你做任何事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, fine, here. Don't spend it all in one place!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧，给你。不要把钱都花在一个地方！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I removed the boulder that was blocking the back entrance of the mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我移走了挡住矿井后门的巨石。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By Mars, you're telling the truth, aren't you? Thank you, amicus. I will deal with this myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯在上，你说的是实话，对吧？谢谢你，朋友。这件事我自己来处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm serious. He thinks you orchestrated the cave-in to kill his brothers. He'll be here any second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的，他认为是你策划了塌方事件来杀害他的兄弟们。他马上就到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By Mars, you're telling the truth, aren't you? Thank you, amicus. I will have him dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯在上，你说的是实话，对吧？谢谢你，朋友。我会找人对付他的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm serious. He thinks you orchestrated the cave-in to kill his brothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的，他认为是你策划了塌方事件来杀害他的兄弟们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am called Manius Castulus. Master of slaves. This is my mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫马尼乌斯·卡斯图卢斯，奴隶的主人。这是我的矿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Manius Castulus, Malpais Mine Slavemaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尼乌斯·卡斯图卢斯，马尔帕斯矿井奴隶主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else but gold, amicus? Not a lot, as you can probably tell by the size of this place, but it's a living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了金子还能有什么，朋友？不是很多，从这个地方的大小你可以看出来，但这是谋生之道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mine here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里挖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... By law, only Legion are allowed within such places. But, since you have that Mark, I'm not going to stop you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...根据法律规定，只有军团才能进入这些地方。但既然你有那个徽记，我就不阻止你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would caution against it, though. Not worth the risk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我还是要提醒大家不要这么做。不值得冒这个险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I go inside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Already said you could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经说过你可以了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I go inside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's ingenious, if I may say so myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恕我直言，这很巧妙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The water flows from a river or lake into a reservoir - imagine a big bath tub - elevated above the mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 水从河流或湖泊流入水库...想象一个大浴缸...在矿井上方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As it drains, it pulls a counterweight, which spins the pulley. Simple, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 排水时，它会拉动一个配重，使滑轮旋转。很简单，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ore carts come up; the empty ones go back down. Endless cycle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 矿车上来，空着回去。无限循环。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Automatically? How does that even work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 自动的？这是怎么做到的呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean Postumus? A good slave. Honest, hard worker that one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说波斯图穆斯？是个好奴隶，诚实，勤奋的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? He didn't give you any trouble, did he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？他没给你添麻烦吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with that slave with the hammer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个拿锤子的奴隶是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About Postumus...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于波斯图穆斯...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on just a minute! That Mark - you're going to meet Caesar, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍等一下！那个徽记，你要去见凯撒，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must be an important person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定是个重要人物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那拜拜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See you, Castullus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见，卡斯图卢斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We ship it back east to be melted down into Aureii. Pretty little things, eh? I'm sure you've seen lots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们把它运回东部，融化成金币。漂亮的小东西，对吧？我相信你一定见过很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do with all that gold?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要用这些金子做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've had some accidents lately. Something could fall and hurt your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最近发生了一些事故，有东西掉下来会伤到你的头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, it's just a dusty old mine. Doubt there's anything inside that would interest you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说了，那只是个满是灰尘的老矿井，里面应该没有你感兴趣的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your audience with Caesar! Did you deliver my proposition?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去见凯撒了！你把我的提议传达了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did what go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情进展如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You forgot?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你忘了？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The- oh! Um... I forgot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这...哦！呃...我忘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah... My apologies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的...我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about the proposal, I shouldn't have expected you'd remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心这个提议，我没想到你会记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're rubbing elbows with men much more important than myself, after all. Probably got real important things to think about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毕竟你在和比我重要得多的人来往，可能有真正重要的事情要考虑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what was it you needed then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，那你需要什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah, well...
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是啊，那个...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was some trouble in there recently, and he's taken it upon himself to clean things up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近那里出了点问题，他自己来收拾残局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Between you and me, I hate to see him so consumed by his grief, but who am I to stand in his way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 私下告诉你，我不愿看到他被悲伤吞噬，但我有什么资格阻止他？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He looks to be on death's door.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他看上去已经奄奄一息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahaha. That he does...
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈，他确实...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try not to take it personally. The man has been through a lot recently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽量不要往心里去，这个人最近经历了很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has a mouth on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他长了张好嘴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, aren't we all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不都是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But he actually appears to be working himself to death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他实际上似乎是在工作到死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is tragic, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很悲惨，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But for a slave to die, hammer in hand, working in service to the mighty Caesar...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但对于一个奴隶来说，拿着锤子，为伟大的凯撒效力而死...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is the greatest, most honorable fate he could hope for. For us it is to die in battle. Not much difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他所能期待的最伟大、最光荣的命运。对我们来说，就是战死沙场。差别不大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seriously, if he doesn't give it up soon, he's going to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，如果他不快点放弃，他会死的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I have explained, he is not "killing himself."
ESP.TRADUIT: 正如我所解释的，他不是在“自杀”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mining is a dangerous chore, and all slaves wear out eventually. That is the natural way of things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 采矿是一项危险的苦差事，所有的奴隶最终都会筋疲力尽。这是很自然的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're just gonna let him kill himself? How is that going to look for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就眼睁睁看着他自杀吗？这对你来说是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Oh, the accident you mean? Not much to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？哦，你是说那次事故吗？没有多少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Portion of the mine up and collapsed about a week ago. Pretty bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约一周前，矿井的一部分坍塌了。相当糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killed our very own Blaster, Mars rest his soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀死了我们的爆破手，玛尔斯保佑他安息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He lost someone recently?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他最近失去了什么人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was... the blaster. I mean he handled the dynamite. Good, clever worker that one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就是...爆破手，我是说炸药是他操作的。很好，很聪明的工人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't blast without him. And it'll be a while before our replacement gets here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爆炸离不开他，我们的替代者还需要一段时间才能到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was Blaster?
ESP.TRADUIT: 爆破手是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? I don't even know what to say. I do believe you of course...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我都不知道该说什么了。我当然相信你...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Postumus was fierce, but always so obedient. I never would have thought he'd want to hurt anybody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 波斯图穆斯很凶，但总是那么听话。我从没想过他会伤害任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know why he was so upset with me? Ah, it's not important now I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道他为什么对我这么生气吗？啊，我想现在已经不重要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my grattitude for stopping him before a scene was made out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感激你在事态发展之前阻止了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to kill Postumus. He seemed intent on taking you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须杀了波斯图穆斯，他似乎一心想干掉你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about? Postumus? Kill me? Are you serious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么？波斯图穆斯？杀我？你说真的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should know that Postumus is coming to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该知道波斯图穆斯要来杀你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许这样最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, enough about your slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，别说你的奴隶了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew it! Okay, bear with me here. I got something for you that could bring us both very far.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道！好的，请耐心听我说。我有东西要给你，可以让我们走得更远。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you meet with Caesar, I want you to deliver a proposal to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你和凯撒见面时，我需要你向他递交一份提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been working on a plan, a concept really, but it could revolutionize mining operations across the land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直在研究一个计划，一个概念，但它可能会彻底改变这片土地上的采矿作业。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Picture this: a self-repeating pulley system driven by a combination of counterweights and water pressure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一下：一个由配重和水压共同驱动的自重复滑轮系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like those cranes the Chainway boys are using, but powered by water!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像那些连环道工人们用的吊车一样，不过是用水驱动的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what would that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, okay, let me break it down for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，让我给你解释一下。
