ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, right now, we rely entirely on manpower for everything - hauling, lifting, digging. It's effective, sure, but wasteful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，现在，我们所有的工作都完全依靠人力——拖运、吊装、挖掘。这当然很有效，但很浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slaves get tired, they get hurt, they slow down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶们累了，受伤了，就会放慢速度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But with this system - stay with me now - it uses water to turn gears that lift ore carts automatically!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但有了这个系统...请听我说...它利用水来转动齿轮，自动提起矿车！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I get it, maybe I'm losing you. Let me put it this way: more gold, faster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我明白了，也许你听不懂我说什么。这么说吧，黄金越多，速度越快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds pretty complicated actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来相当复杂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, why not just waste more time? The slaves we save can be spent elsewhere - perhaps in constructing more pulley contraptions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那为什么不多浪费点时间呢？我们节省下来的奴隶可以用在其他地方...也许是建造更多的滑轮装置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not just use more slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不使用更多的奴隶呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, uh, that's the thing. I don't exactly have permission to build anything, much less the resources to do it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，呃，问题就在这里。我根本没有建造任何东西的许可，更不用说在这里建造的资源了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This mine's too small, the river's too far, and there is no one around clever enough to help me work out the mechanics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个矿太小了，这条河又太远了，附近也没有一个聪明的人能帮我解决这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But! With Caesar's approval, we could test it at one of the bigger operations, like Morenci.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是！如果凯撒批准，我们可以在莫伦西这样的大型基地进行测试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But do you know if it would actually work? Do you have a protoype?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你知道这真的有效吗？你有原型吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not just a pulley system! It's progress! A legacy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不仅仅是一个滑轮系统！这是进步！一份遗产！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, uh, yeah, I guess that's the gist of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，呃，对，我想这就是要点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you want me to tell Caesar about... some pulley system?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你想让我告诉凯撒...某种滑轮系统？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amicus, you would be at the forefront of this project. You'd be rich beyond your wildest dreams!
ESP.TRADUIT: 朋友，你会站在这个项目的最前沿，你会比做梦都要富有的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if you'd only ask I am sure they would let me work by your side (please ask).
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你开口，我肯定他们会让我在你身边工作(请开口)。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think about the possibilities!
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想这些可能性吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do I get out of this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能得到什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus, that is all I'm asking! This is your chance to go down in history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，我的朋友，这就是我唯一的要求！这是你名垂青史的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't forget to say it was my idea, all right? Manius Castulus. Malpais Mine Slavemaster. Remember the name!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别忘了说是我的主意，好吗？马尼乌斯·卡斯图卢斯，马尔帕斯矿井奴隶主，记住这个名字！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll uh... think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会呃...想想看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you here to take me away?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是来带我走的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Hello?
Hello... You must be the Virgin Mary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好...你就是圣母玛利亚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Hello?

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Stare him down>
ESP.TRADUIT: <瞪着他>

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Continue staring>
ESP.TRADUIT: <继续瞪>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... guess I'll leave you to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我想我还是不打扰你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. I'm still very busy here. Can I get back to work now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我还是很忙，我可以回去工作了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Does Master Castulus know this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。主人卡斯图卢斯知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie> Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you can be the one to let him know he'll have another corpse to drag out of this hole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就由你来告诉他，他又有一具尸体可以拖出来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not leaving until I'm done here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不把这事办完我是不会走的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie> Of course he does.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>他当然知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very funny. Can I get back to work now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常有趣。我现在可以回去工作了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I was joking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是开玩笑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smashing these rocks. Someone has to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 砸这些石头。总得有人这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still digging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还在挖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would someone like you give a damn anyways? What are you even doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的人为什么会在乎这些？你在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look so good. Anything I can do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的脸色不太好，有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you even doing here anyways? This is no place for ladies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底在这里做什么？这不是女人该来的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look so good. Anything I can do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的脸色不太好，有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate your asking, I really do. But don't worry about me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的关心，真的。但别为我担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sure you don't want to take a rest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定你不想休息一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh huh. Got six trapped behind these rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃嗯。有六个人被困在这些岩石后面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard there was some kind of accident recently. Were you involved?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说最近发生了什么事故。你参与了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Six dead from a cave-in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塌方造成六人死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我更多关于那次事故的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm the High Priestess of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是玛尔斯的女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bang your head on the ceiling or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的头撞到天花板了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a... <whisper> ...slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个...<低语>...奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha. And you've been unusually kind for a freebie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈。对免费的东西来说，你可真够客气的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're unusually bold for a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个奴隶，你胆子不小。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not bold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并不大胆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're unusually bold for a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个奴隶，你胆子不小。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you're usually dull for a freebie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而你通常会为免费赠品而感到无趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're unusually bold for a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个奴隶，你胆子不小。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go pound sand up your ass, freebie. I don't answer to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去把沙子塞进你的屁眼里吧，免费的。我不向你负责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Reputation] Know your place, slave. Or I'll put you there.
ESP.TRADUIT: [声望]摆正自己的位置，奴隶。否则我就来帮你摆正。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh> ...Can I really trust you? Actually, doesn't matter at this point.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>...我真的能相信你吗？实际上，现在已经不重要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a guard. Been a problem for us a long time. Then one day, killed another one of our brothers in cold blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个守卫，一直是我们的心腹大患。有一天，他又冷血的杀死了我们的一个兄弟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bashed his face in with a chunk of gold rock all over a can of cold food. You see where this is going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抄起金矿石砸烂他的脸，就为了一罐冷罐头。你知道这是怎么回事吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get the feeling that there's something you aren't telling me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我总觉得你有事瞒着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Sorry to disturb you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。很抱歉打扰你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha... I doubt that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈...我对此表示怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll catch you later then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我回头再找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhm. Well freebie, I'd suggest you go look around somewhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。好吧，免费的，我建议你去其他地方看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing in this mine but death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这矿井里只有死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just having a look around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是随便看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh huh. Got six trapped behind these rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃嗯。有六个人被困在这些岩石后面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard there was some kind of accident recently. Were you involved?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说最近发生了什么事故。你参与了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure there is. But you don't want it. Gold's poison.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有，但你不想要。黄金是毒药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought there was gold in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为这里有金子呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. So let me get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。所以让我回去工作吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean that gold is poison. Take a look around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说黄金是毒药。看看周围吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feel the sickness seeping out of every stone and crevice. We kick poison dust into the air 12 hours a day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉疾病从每一块石头和缝隙中渗出，我们每天12个小时向空气中排放有毒的灰尘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You make a habit out of coming here and it'll be your own breath that kills you, if nothing else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你养成了来这里的习惯，那么杀死你的将是你自己的呼吸，如果没有别的原因的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean that money corrupts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说金钱使人堕落。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean dust masks? Guards have 'em. Not enough for all of us, or so they claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说防尘面罩？卫兵有，但不够我们所有人用，至少他们是这么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I overheard Castulus saying he thinks the miasma keeps us docile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我无意中听到卡斯图卢斯说他认为污浊的空气能让我们变得温顺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you have any respirators?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有防毒面具吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been to California? Lucky you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去过加州吗？你真幸运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back in California they would have caught hell for that from the safety inspectors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是在加州，他们肯定会被安检人员骂得够呛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is what it is. But it would be a shame if you caught sick for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情就是这样。但如果你无缘无故生病，那就太可惜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's too bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那太糟糕了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're just being paranoid. What you can't see can't hurt you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你太多疑了，你看不见的东西伤害不了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Likely they all died days ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，他们可能都是几天前死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're still alive then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还活着吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't have the day off, if that's what you're asking. But I didn't see it happen either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我今天没休息，如果你是想问这个的话。但我也没看到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heard it. Felt it. Then I ran my ass outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到了，感觉到了，然后我就跑了出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So were you involved or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你到底有没有参与？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Storehouse got buried too. They want to recover the equipment. And...
ESP.TRADUIT: 仓库也被埋了。他们想要收回这些设备，还有...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So then what's the hurry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那还有什么要紧的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sure. Guards'll probably throw you a parade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，当然。卫兵们可能会给你列队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really oughtta just run along. I'll take care of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的该走了。我会处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The storehouse? There a reward in it for me if I help you get to it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 仓库？如果我帮你拿到，我能得到奖励吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Need to see a proper burial for my brothers. Guards understand that; got one of their own among the bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...我得给我的兄弟们办个像样的葬礼。卫兵们明白这一点，尸体中也有他们的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Let him finish>
ESP.TRADUIT: <让他说完>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blaster died too. For all I know a boomstick going off now would seal the rest of us in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爆破手也死了。据我所知，现在爆炸一响，我们其他人就会被封在里面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, guards are strict about who can even touch 'em, especially as of late.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，卫兵对谁能碰它们都很严格，尤其是最近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But why dig by hand? Dynamite would probably make quick work of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是为什么要用手挖呢？炸药可能很快就能解决这个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, too risky. And they won't let me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，太冒险了。他们不让我这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But why dig by hand? Dynamite would probably make quick work of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是为什么要用手挖呢？炸药可能很快就能解决这个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... Maybe, if we greased you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...也许吧，如果我们给你涂点润滑油的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But no use in doing that. The bodies will be bloated and we can't get them through there without making a big mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这样做是没有用的。尸体会变得臃肿，我们不可能把他们弄得一团糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Small Frame] I could try squeezing through that gap in the rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: [小巧玲珑]我可以试着从岩石的缝隙里挤过去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't sure about anything at this point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我什么都不确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, there's a back entrance to the mine on the other side of these hills. Boulders there too now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，在山的另一边有个矿井的后门。那里也有巨石。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't bother with it since it'd mean hammering out in the sun, but if you really want to take a swing at it then be my guest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有费心去做，因为这意味着要在阳光下敲打，但如果你真的想试一试，那就随你的便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure there isn't a better way through? You look closer to death than the other side of those rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定没有更好的办法吗？你看起来比在岩石的另一边更接近死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhm. Good luck to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhm. No promises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我不保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No promises, but try not to work yourself to death in the meantime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不保证，但尽量不要在此期间把自己累死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Don't need that Brahmin slop to fuel me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我不需要婆罗门牛的泔水来加油。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're thin as a rail. You need to eat at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你瘦得像根栏杆，你至少得吃点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Okay. You want to know why I'm not eating? It's so I can fit through those rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好吧。你想知道我为什么不吃东西吗？这样我才能穿过那些石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another day or two without food and you'll be dead from exhaustion. Seen it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再过一两天不吃东西，你就会精疲力竭而死。以前见过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe I just want to die in there with my brothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，也许我只是想和我的兄弟们一起死在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I should have in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一开始就应该这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You told me earlier that there was no point in squeezing through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你之前跟我说过挤过去是没有意义的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know... Might be easier to break through from the other side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道...从另一边突破可能更容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what would that accomplish? You can't get the bodies out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那又能实现什么呢？这样没法把尸体运出去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop. Won't have it. The Master won't either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别闹了。我不会，主人也不让。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I'll eat. But I can't quit working or they'll kill me anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我吃。但我不能放弃工作，否则他们会杀了我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're depressed. Suicidal even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很沮丧，甚至有自杀倾向。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, heard the blast loud and clear. Can't thank you enough, stranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我听到了响亮而清晰的爆炸声。真是太感谢你了，陌生人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let Castulus know and start burying the dead outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会通知卡斯图卢斯，开始在外面埋葬死者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feel free to take whatever you want from the storehouse. No one will be missing it now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么就从仓库里拿吧，现在没人会想念它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way through the back door is clear now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从后门进去的路现在畅通了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhm. Had to wait a long time to make it look like an accident and not a revenge killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。等了很长时间才让这看起来像是意外而不是复仇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plan was to keep him inside till just after shift's end, then wire a trap. Blow his head into the ceiling and crush his body with rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 计划是把他关在里面直到换班结束，然后设个陷阱。把他的头撞向天花板，用石头砸碎他的身体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't have been the first time those boys burnt 'emselves up playing with sticks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些家伙玩火自焚也不是头一次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had to take him out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须干掉他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. Saw the guard storm down the tunnel right before it went down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。就在隧道坍塌前，我看到守卫冲进了隧道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From what I've gathered, Blaster panicked and set off a bunch of sticks right then and there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，爆破手惊慌失措，当场就引爆了一堆炸药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What went wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 出了什么问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, none of us talked. I'm certain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我们都没说。我敢肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the slaves ratted to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个奴隶向他告密了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. And he knows I know he knows. Probably knew before it even went down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他知道我知道他知道了。可能在事情发生前就知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How likely was it that the guard got wise only hours before it was supposed to go down after months of planning? Not fucking likely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经过几个月的计划，警卫在行动前几个小时才发现，这有多大可能？他妈的不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But... does Castulus know what happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是...卡斯图卢斯知道发生了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I had to guess... He's just a sick bastard who takes pleasure in watching those around him die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果要我猜的话...他只是个以看着周围的人死去为乐的变态混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could be us or the soldiers; he doesn't give a damn about anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是我们，也可能是士兵。他对任何人都漠不关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is nothing human behind his eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的眼睛后面没有一丝人性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think Castulus wanted them all dead? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得卡斯图卢斯想让他们都死吗？为什么?

ESP.ORIGINAL: The others had nothing to do with it. As for me, well, he was counting on me killing myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他人跟这事毫无关系。至于我，他指望我自杀呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe thought it was good torture, or just convenient; who knows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许认为这是一种很好的折磨，或者只是方便。谁知道呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Master always gets his way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主人总是为所欲为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So why did he let you live? And the others?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那他为什么让你活着？其他人呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter. He'll find a way to kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，他会想办法杀了我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And he'll hurt others too when I'm not around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在的时候他也会伤害别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what I have to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我该怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你还活着。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'm sorry about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就抱歉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't let you do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能让你这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for understanding. Here, I want you to have these. I know they will be better kept in your hands than a dead slave's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的理解。给，我想把这些给你，我知道把它们放在你手里比放在一个死去的奴隶手里要好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get out of here before they think you're with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他们以为你跟我是一起的之前赶紧离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you don't have much of a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你也没什么选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] No! I'm sorry, but you just aren't getting it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不！我很抱歉，但你就是不明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Couldn't keep on... living, even if I had the choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无法继续...活下去，即使我有这个选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't go back to work as if nothing happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能装作什么都没发生就回去工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I want now is to go out on my own terms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在只想以我自己的方式离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've all suffered through enough. Let me handle Castulus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们受的苦够多了，让我来对付卡斯图卢斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] ...Freebie, you sure you want to do this?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]...免费的，你确定要这么做吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Postumus, your other brothers still need you. I can take care of Castulus. Quick and clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 波斯图穆斯，你的其他兄弟还需要你。我能搞定卡斯图卢斯，干净利落。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... Can I ask you a question first?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧...我能先问你个问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you give a damn about me, or any of us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要在乎我，或者我们其他人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spent three years in rags and ain't met nobody who wasn't a slave that ever gave me more than the evil eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我穿得破破烂烂的三年，除了奴隶之外，只有恶意的眼神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So who are you, really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你到底是什么人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, quick and clean. It won't be a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，干净利落。不会有问题的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you're lying, but fine. Probably don't want to know the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你在撒谎，但没关系。可能不想知道真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just do what you gotta do, and we'll both act like we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做你该做的，我们就当没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, in any case, I owe you my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，无论如何，我应该向你道谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm nobody special. I just like helping people when I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没什么特别的，我只是喜欢在力所能及的情况下帮助别人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That didn't really answer my question, but okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并没有真正回答我的问题，不过没关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go do what you gotta do, and we'll both act like we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去做你该做的事吧，我们就当没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, in any case, I owe you my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，无论如何，我应该向你道谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I dunno. You're cool, and I don't want to see you dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不晓得。你很酷，我不想看到你死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go do what you gotta do, and we'll both act like we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，去做你该做的吧，我们就当没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, in any case, I owe you my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，无论如何，我应该向你道谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a man who was helped out of his grave. Figure I should pay it forward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个被人从坟墓里救出来的人，我想我应该把爱传递下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go do what you gotta do, and we'll both act like we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，去做你该做的吧，我们就当没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, in any case, I owe you my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，无论如何，我应该向你道谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a woman who was helped out of her grave. Figure I should pay it forward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个被人从坟墓里救出来的女人，我想我应该把爱传递下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm... Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, go do what you gotta do, and we'll both act like we never met.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，去做你该做的吧，我们就当没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, in any case, I owe you my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，无论如何，我应该向你道谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just a merc. But I got no sympathy for this slavery nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个佣兵，但我不同情奴隶制这种荒唐的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what, you think you're some kind of hero? Like one man is gonna make any difference against the whole Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那又怎样，你觉得自己是个英雄吗？就凭一个人就能对付整个军团吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better keep your word. But after that, I need you to be as far away from us as possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好信守诺言。但之后，我需要你离我们越远越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a ticking time bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个定时炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just like to fuck up the Legion's shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是喜欢砸军团的场子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? You mean the dust masks? I would have given them some if I had any left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你是说防尘面具吗？如果我还有剩余的话，我会给他们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, don't tell anyone I said this, but I don't think those masks even work. Filters must have gone bad a hundred years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，别告诉别人我说了这话，但我觉得那些面具根本不管用，过滤器肯定在一百年前就坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only handed them out to the guards because they kept asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把它们发给卫兵只是因为他们一直在问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How come you give the Legionaries respirators but not the slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么你给军团战士呼吸器，却不给奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bene! Wait just a second.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！等一下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alllmost done...
ESP.TRADUIT: 差不多完成了...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, there you are. Just run this back to whence you came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，给你。把这个带回你来的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're very welcome. I'd like to be left alone now, if you don't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不客气。如果你不介意的话，我想一个人静一静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gee, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, give it here then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就给我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got another letter for you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一封信给你...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes. Give it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的。给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a reply for you to give him. Don't worry, it's already written. Just hand it to him next time you're up there if you don't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个答复要你给他，不用担心，已经写好了。如果你不介意的话，下次上去的时候交给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you gonna take it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要接受吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have much to say. Milia's selling, I'm just standing guard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么好说的。米莉娅负责卖，我只是站岗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I want to talk to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我想和你谈谈呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Legion, honey. It's not safe for us girls over here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是军团，亲爱的。我们这些女孩在这里不安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does Milia need a guard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么米莉娅需要守卫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's easy work. Boring, though. I spend most of my time daydreaming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这工作很简单，虽然很无聊。我大部分时间都在做白日梦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't charge as much as I should. I could triple my rate and Milia would still pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有收应收的费用。就算我要三倍的钱，米莉娅还是会付的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't feel right, wringing her for money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 压榨她的钱，感觉不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like being a bodyguard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢当保镖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't let the suit fool you. Milia's all woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别被那套衣服骗了，米莉娅是个女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Us girls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们女孩？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know what you meant, human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你的意思，人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose your untrained eyes can't tell us apart. We're not all men. The Dip makes us more... masculine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你未经训练的眼睛无法分辨我们。我们并不都是男人，泡澡让我们更...男性化了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important for me to remember my womanhood. To keep that part of myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，记住我的女性身份很重要。为了保留自己的那一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't expect you to understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不指望你能理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was asking more about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问更多关于你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes it feels silly to fight so hard for it. I wouldn't have to worry about it if the Master hadn't failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候这么拼命的争取会觉得很傻，如果主教没有失败我就不用担心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually do understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的能理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: True enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not really my business. You do you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的不关我的事。你做你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, and you're still a little bug half my size.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，你还是一只只有我一半大的小虫子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man or woman, you're still a mutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论男女，你都是个变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't bother me, I don't bother them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不打扰我，我也不打扰他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're silly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很傻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They all dress the same and speak the same, because they think it gives them strength. But there's one problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都穿一样的衣服，说一样的话，因为他们认为这给了他们力量。但有一个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're too different. Tall, short, strong, weak, cunning, stupid. Every ignorant tribal, every murdering savage, they're all made Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们太不一样了，高的、矮的、强的、弱的、狡猾的、愚蠢的。每一个无知的部落，每一个凶残的野蛮人，他们都变成了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strength comes from purity, from unity. The Legion has none.
ESP.TRADUIT: 力量来自纯洁，来自团结。军团没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely a thoughtful woman such as yourself has some opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样有思想的女人肯定有自己的想法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have nothing more to say about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于这件事我没什么可说的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, elaborate on that. Please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，详细说明一下，请。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's only one purity that matters, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一种纯洁是重要的，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's foolish to pretend you're some sort of new order for the world when your puny little bodies still can't handle radiation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你们弱小的身体还无法应对辐射时，假装自己是世界的新秩序是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My kind had true racial purity, without any of your weaknesses. We were better for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的种族很纯洁，没有你们的任何弱点。我们因此变得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are pure and unified. Certainly moreso than the pissant tribals they used to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是纯粹的和统一的。当然，他们比过去那些可怜的部落要厉害得多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised. It's rare to meet a sensible human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶，很难得遇到一个通情达理的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see your point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我懂你意思了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were far too many of your kind for us to ever stand a chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的同类太多了，我们根本没有机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your race lost. You couldn't have been that superior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你的种族输了，你不可能有那么大的优势。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You brought it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带起来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想谈这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way Calvin treats us is insulting. He acts like he's Legion, like he's better than us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文对待我们的方式是侮辱。他表现得好像他是军团，好像他比我们强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, Luke has more to offer. Freedom and wealth. And a true place in the Legion hierarchy as merchants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，卢克能提供更多，自由和财富。并作为商人在军团中占有一席之地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you following the town election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你关注镇选举了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to make money, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想赚钱，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Milia may want to go back west, but I like it here. It's frictionless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 米莉娅可能想回西部去，但我喜欢这里。没有摩擦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The soldiers have no ego. They simply buy. No haggle, no hassle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵们没有自我意识，他们只是简单的购买。没有讨价还价，没有麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want to be a part of the Legion's hierarchy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想成为军团的一员吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试一试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you play caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600D7E6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assume next you'll want to ask me if it's even profitable to be selling energy weapons to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你接下来会问我卖能量武器给军团是否有利可图。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The answer is: it's so-so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 答案是：一般般。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, it's quite poor. Business is not great. But I don't have much of a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，很差，生意不是很好。但我也没有什么选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're an energy weapons merchant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个能量武器商人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The weapon of your dreams, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信这是你梦寐以求的武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么卖的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was driven out of the NCR by a never-ending menagerie of local law, merc gangs, and mysterious hitmen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被永无休止的当地法律、雇佣兵帮派和神秘杀手赶出了 NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All sent my way by the Van Graffs, of course. They made it quite clear that I wasn't welcome in Nevada.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然都是范·格拉夫送过来的。他们明确表示，我在内华达州不受欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I'm stuck here, because this dystopia is still a damn sight more civilized than anywhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我被困在这里，因为这个反乌托邦仍然是比其他任何地方都更文明的景象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you have a choice?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么没有选择？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're pigs. Truly. I can't stand them. The deputies in particular make my skin crawl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是猪，真的。我受不了他们，尤其是那些代理人，让我起鸡皮疙瘩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why I tell you this as if you can understand it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我为什么要告诉你，好像你能理解似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you don't like the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你不喜欢军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're pigs. Truly. I can't stand them. The deputies in particular make my skin crawl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是猪，真的。我受不了他们，尤其是那些代理人，让我起鸡皮疙瘩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You understand what I mean, I'm sure. The way they leer. They talk about us behind our backs, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你明白我的意思，他们抛媚眼的样子。你知道的，他们在背后议论我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't be able to bear it if it weren't for Donna. And my plasma pistol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果不是唐娜，我是无法忍受的，还有我的等离子手枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you don't like the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为你不喜欢军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, well, I'm not sure I'd go that far. Maybe? I'm... hm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，好吧，我不确定我会走到那一步。也许？我...嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you going to buy something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算买东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand what you mean. I feel much more comfortable with women.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你的意思，我觉得和女人在一起更舒服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A woman after my own heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个合我心意的女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not trust them. Do not let your guard down around them. Certainly not here, where they're empowered to do whatever they like to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要相信他们，不要在他们面前放松警惕。当然不是在这里，在这里他们有权对我们为所欲为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if you're looking to defend yourself, you're in the right place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你想保护自己，你来对地方了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Men are scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 男人都是渣滓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't just dislike them. I am disgusted, and on edge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不只是不喜欢他们，我很反感，而且很紧张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries are poorly behaved. I don't blame you for disliking them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵行为不检点，我不怪你不喜欢他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose maybe that Mark you have affords you different treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想也许你身上的徽记给了你不同的待遇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really know what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太明白你在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: These days, primarily from junk traders. Unlike most, I know how to get these old toasters up and running again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些天，主要是从垃圾商人那里。与大多数人不同，我知道如何让这些旧的烤面包机重新运转起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I even dabble a bit in the dark arts...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至还涉猎过一点黑魔法...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Overclocking. Modding. Things of that nature.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超频，改装，这种性质的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you get your inventory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的库存都是从哪儿弄来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Against my better judgment and my personal feelings about the man, I support Luke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管我觉得不明智，也违背了我的个人情感，但我还是支持卢克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calvin is polite and businessmanlike, but it doesn't take a genius to figure out his game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文彬彬有礼，很有商人风度，但不是天才也能识破他的把戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a White Sands boy, through and through. He wants profit for him and his people, to everyone else's detriment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个彻头彻尾的白沙小子。他想为自己和他的人谋利，而让其他人蒙受损失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have a stake in the local election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在地方选举中有利害关系吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you ask her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不问问她？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I needed a guard. I don't trust these Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一个护卫，我不相信这些军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, it was like a dream come true, to meet an 8 foot tall woman with military experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这就像梦想成真，遇见了一个8英尺高的有军事经验的女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made her an offer, and she accepted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给她开了个价，她接受了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with the Super Mutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个超级变种人是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones? There are different branches, you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪些？有不同的分支，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Van Graffs are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 范·格拉夫都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, Jean-Baptiste and his sister? Both dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，让·巴普蒂斯特和他姐姐？都死了吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good news. For everyone. The world is a little better without them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对每个人来说这都是个好消息。没有他们，世界会更好一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps... I can go back west?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许...我可以回到西部？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll need some time to mull it over. Thank you, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一些时间考虑一下。不过还是谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mojave Van Graffs are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫哈维的范·格拉夫都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I misjudged you. Good to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我看错你了。很高兴知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Milia [0600D7E5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get over yourself. Not everything is about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别自以为是了，不是所有的事情都和你有关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quintus Pompeius Priscus. Top shot of Caesar's mighty Ballisti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昆图斯·庞培·普利斯库斯。凯撒强力炮弹的顶级射手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar relieved me of my degenerate name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒解除了我堕落的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He gave me a civilized name for every skull I pierced the day he visited my Centurion's camp during the Colorado campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 科罗拉多战役期间，他拜访我的百夫长营地那天，我刺穿的每一个头骨他都给了我一个文明的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My full name is: Quintus Pompeius Senecio Roscius...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的全名是昆图斯·庞培·塞内西奥·罗歇斯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Murena Coelius Sextus Iulius Frontinus Silius Decianus Gaius Iulius Eurycles Herculaneus Lucius Vibullius Pius Augustanus...
ESP.TRADUIT: ...穆雷纳·科利乌斯·塞克斯图斯·尤利乌斯·弗罗伦蒂努斯·西利乌斯·德奇安努斯·盖乌斯·尤里乌斯·尤里克勒斯·赫拉克勒斯·卢修斯·维布利乌斯·派厄斯·奥古斯特努斯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Alpinus Bellicius Sollers Iulius Aper Ducenius Proculus Rutilianus Rufinus Silius Valens Valerius Niger Claudius Fuscus Saxa Amyntianus Sosius...
ESP.TRADUIT: ...阿尔庇努斯·贝利修斯·索勒斯·尤里乌斯·阿朴尔·杜塞尼乌斯·普罗库鲁斯·鲁提利阿努斯·鲁菲努斯·西利乌斯·瓦伦斯·瓦勒里乌斯·奈哲尔·克劳狄乌斯·傅思古思·萨克萨·阿明提亚努斯·索西乌斯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Priscus.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...普利斯库斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's quite the name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is serviceable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它很有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Profligate firearms are always unreliable. This one is no different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落者的枪支总是不可靠的，这一次也不例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sights in particular are a bother. I've missed more than a handful of easy shots thanks to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤其是瞄准上的麻烦。多亏了他们，我错过了不少简单的射击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a nice rifle you've got there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这把步枪真不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会失手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only explanation is the weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的解释是武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rest assured, Profligate. I am more than lethal with a faulty firearm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放心，堕落者。用一把有毛病的枪，我的杀伤力更大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe it's you missing, not the rifle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是你没打中，而不是步枪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck finding something that meets my standards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望你能找到符合我标准的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not insult me with commonplace rickety detritus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别用那些稀松平常的破烂来侮辱我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I traded you for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我跟你换它呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's see what you've brought for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那就来看看你给我带了什么吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to trade for your rifle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想换你的步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop wasting my time, I've already traded it to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别浪费我的时间了，我已经跟你换过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to trade for your rifle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想换你的步枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good, the rifle is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好，这把步枪是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: (Trade Sniper Rifle)
ESP.TRADUIT: (交换狙击步枪)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent, the rifle is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，步枪是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: (Trade Anti-Material Rifle)
ESP.TRADUIT: (交换反器材步枪)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair trade, the rifle is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 公平交易，这把步枪是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Barter 25] (Trade Hunting Rifle)
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易25](交换猎枪)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose anything is better than this piece of junk. Give it here, the rifle is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想什么都比这破东西好。给我，这把步枪是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Barter 80] (Trade Varmint Rifle)
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易80](交换狐鼠步枪)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back when you have something worthy of a marksmen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等你有了配得上神射手的东西再来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Quintus Pompeius Priscus [0600D8BF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D8C1]AZPriscusQuest) 0600D8C1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Atlas Tower. It is broken. The hermit here is supposed to be fixing it, but he has not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿特拉斯塔，它坏了。这里的隐士应该修好它，但他没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the big tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那座塔是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intrigued by it, are you? I can only assume that's because it reminds you of the simpering weaklings you've fucked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对它很感兴趣，是吗？我只能假设那是因为它让你想起了你操过的那些傻笑的懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Much like your men, the tower is impotent. Utter junk. And nobody here seems able to repair it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你的人一样，高塔也无能为力。完全是垃圾，这里似乎没人能修好它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the big tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那座塔是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Atlas Tower. It is broken. The hermit here is supposed to be fixing it, but he has not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿特拉斯塔，它坏了。这里的隐士应该修好它，但他没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about the tower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能谈谈那座塔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talking about your sexual proclivities. And I'm talking about the tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是你的性取向，我谈论的是塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing right about this situation. I'm guarding the tallest heap of shit in Arizona and a woman is walking around unleashed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种情况根本就不对。我在守卫亚利桑那州最高的一堆垃圾，而一个女人却没被拴住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Right.
All women are the same. Allow me to spell it out for you. You. Are. A. Whore. Now stop boring me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的女人都一样。请允许我为你解释清楚，你，是，个，妓女。别烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't know anything about my sexual proclivities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你根本不了解我的性取向。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that you volunteering to help? I'm not interested. You disgust me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你自愿帮忙的吗？我没兴趣，你真让我恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask him! Or ask Paul, the useless Frumentarius who seems to be here only to stand around and jerk off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去问他吧！或者问问保罗，那个无用的特务，他似乎只是在这里站着打飞机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why hasn't he fixed it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么还没修好？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frumentarii are conniving, backstabbing castrates. They speak sweet words only to lull you into a state of vulnerability.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务是阴险的、背后捅刀子的阉割者，他们说的甜言蜜语只是为了诱骗你进入脆弱的状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no honor in fucking a man and killing him while he sleeps. There is no honor in poison, in sabotage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟一个人上床然后趁他睡觉时杀了他，这不是什么光荣的事，下毒和蓄意破坏是没有荣誉可言的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These people are not Legionaries. They are practically women.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些人不是军团士兵，他们实际上就是女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't like Paul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢保罗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know anything about him. Only that he is useless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对他一无所知，只知道他没用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I also know his name. Sherman. 'Should I fix this tower? Sure, man!'
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我还知道他的名字，谢尔曼。“我应该修这座塔吗？”，“当然，伙计！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this hermit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个隐士吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spite and revenge. This is punishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怨恨和报复。这是惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This post seems pretty uneventful. Why is a Decanus stationed here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个岗位看起来平淡无奇，为什么会有什长驻扎在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a lonely post. You must have a lot of time to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个孤独的岗位，你一定有很多时间去思考。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know. I only know that talking to you is a worse punishment than I had ever imagined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我只知道跟你说话是一种比我想象中更严重的惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Speech fail] You're being punished? For what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被惩罚了？为了什么?

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was an... indiscretion. With a ghoul. A Los Alamos trader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一个...不检点的言行，和一个食尸鬼，洛斯阿拉莫斯的商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My centurion was outraged. I was sent here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的百夫长怒不可遏，我是被发派来这里的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it that's got you so preoccupied?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到底是什么让你心事重重？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I find ghouls easier to get along with than most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得食尸鬼比大多数人都好相处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My centurion thought so too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的百夫长也这么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A ghoul? That's disgusting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食尸鬼?太恶心了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you mean. Give me a hint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白你的意思，给我个提示？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Sharptooth [06014E64] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope. Never heard the name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，从没听说过这个名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything about someone from Newt named August?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道纽特有个叫奥古斯特的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. What counts as strange? Do shady Legionaries sneaking around at night count as strange?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧。什么才算奇怪？见不得光的军团士兵在夜里鬼鬼祟祟的也算奇怪吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because that happens every night. It wouldn't even register as abnormal to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为这种事每晚都会发生，对我来说根本不算什么奇怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you see anything strange in town on the 16th of October?
ESP.TRADUIT: 10月16日那天你在镇上看到什么怪事了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides you? Yeah, I guess I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了你？嗯，我想我见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard of 'gait analysis'?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过“步态分析”吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the recent months, do you recall seeing anyone in town that you didn't recognize?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近几个月，你记得在镇上见过什么你不认识的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's intelligence bureau knows all about this stuff. They specialize in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR的情报部门知道这一切，他们是这方面的专家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Height, stride, the grace of a movement - all of these things add up to make a distinct gait. Your walk. Everyone's is different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身高、步幅、动作的优雅程度...所有这些因素加在一起构成了一个独特的步态，你的走路姿势。每个人的都是不同的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yeah, I do recall seeing someone I didn't know. His walk was unfamiliar to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我确实记得看到了一个我不认识的人，我不熟悉他的走路方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can guess what it means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能猜出它的意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's intelligence bureau knows all about this stuff. They specialize in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR的情报部门知道这一切，他们是这方面的专家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Height, stride, the grace of a movement - all of these things add up to make a distinct gait. Your walk. Everyone's is different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身高、步幅、动作的优雅程度...所有这些因素加在一起构成了一个独特的步态，你的走路姿势。每个人的都是不同的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yeah, I do recall seeing someone I didn't know. His walk was unfamiliar to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我确实记得看到了一个我不认识的人，我不熟悉他的走路方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never heard of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从来没听说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's intelligence bureau knows all about this stuff. They specialize in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR的情报部门知道这一切，他们是这方面的专家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Height, stride, the grace of a movement - all of these things add up to make a distinct gait. Your walk. Everyone's is different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身高、步幅、动作的优雅程度...所有这些因素加在一起构成了一个独特的步态，你的走路姿势。每个人的都是不同的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yeah, I do recall seeing someone I didn't know. His walk was unfamiliar to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我确实记得看到了一个我不认识的人，我不熟悉他的走路方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope this is going somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这能有所进展。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 2am. A Legionary leads a lone male into one of the ruined buildings on the south side of town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2点，一名军团士兵带着一名孤独的男性进入城镇南侧的一栋废墟中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I recognized the Legionary as a Frumentarius. Don't know which one. They all have a similar way of carrying themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认出那个军团的人是特务，不知道是哪一个，他们的举止都很相似。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The man was old. Had a bit of a limp. I think his hips were bad, that's how I figured he was old.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外那个人很老，有点瘸。我觉得他的臀部不好，所以我认为他很老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A while later, the Legionary leaves. The other man doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过了一会儿，军团的人离开了，另一个人没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
