ESP.ORIGINAL: What exactly did you see?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底看到了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I had to go to bed. I was exhausted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我得去睡觉了，我精疲力尽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened after that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, no problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Reed [06008AEF] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus whines and backs away.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯呜咽着退了回去。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Growl at Cerberus.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <对刻耳柏洛斯咆哮>

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get back to Laertes, mutt, or I'll kill you and wear you around my neck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在回到拉厄耳忒斯身边去，杂种狗，否则我就杀了你，把你挂在我脖子上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' grimace grows smaller and he rises slightly. He seems to study you.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的狰狞面孔逐渐收敛，微微站起身来。 它似乎在研究你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Crouch down.> Hi, Cerberus.
ESP.TRADUIT: <蹲下来>嗨，刻耳柏洛斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus looks at your hand. Then he creeps cautiously towards it, leading with his nose. You hear him snuffling.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯看着你的手。然后它小心翼翼地爬向你的手，用鼻子牵引着，你听到了它的鼻息声。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Turn away from Cerberus and place your hand on the ground.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <转身离开刻耳柏洛斯，把手放在地上>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' tongue darts out between his teeth. He draws back from you, as if preparing to run away.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的舌头从它的牙齿间窜了出来。它从你身边退缩，好像准备逃跑。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Disarm and show your hands.> Easy. I mean you no harm.
ESP.TRADUIT: <放下武器举起手>放松，我对你没有恶意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus growls loudly and pushes his tongue out between his teeth.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯大声咆哮，把舌头从牙齿间伸出来。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Take a step forward.> Don't make this difficult, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: <向前迈一步>别把这事搞得很复杂。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Draw your weapon and point it at the dog.> Give me a reason, mutt.
ESP.TRADUIT: <拔出武器对准那只狗>给我个理由，杂种。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus looks at you quizzically.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯疑惑的看着你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what, I'll be back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，我会回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' growls sharpen into a snarl. His lips pull back from his dripping teeth.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的咆哮变得尖锐，嘴唇向后咧开，露出滴着口水的牙齿。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Take another step forward.> C'mon. Your master is looking for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <再向前走一步>来吧，你的主人正在找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus snarls and lunges at you.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯咆哮着向你扑来。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Take another step forward.> Please stop wasting my time. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <再向前走一步>请不要再浪费我的时间了，我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' nose twitches and he glances at the meat, then back to you.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的鼻子抽动了一下，看了看肉，然后又看向你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Reach into your bag and pull out a piece of Brahmin meat.> Want this?
ESP.TRADUIT: <把手伸进你的包里拿出一块婆罗门牛肉>想要这个吗?

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' tilts his nose up slightly and steps forward, smelling the food. Finally, he grabs it out of your hand.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的鼻子微微抬起，向前走去，闻着食物的味道。最后，他从你手里抢了过来。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus chews ungracefully, then swallows. He licks his chops and turns to look at you.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯笨拙地咀嚼，然后吞下。他舔了舔骨头，转过身来看着你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Hold the meat out for Cerberus.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把肉拿出来给刻耳柏洛斯>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus looks at you and exhales shortly through his nose. His tail stands at attention.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯看着你，从鼻子里吐出一口气。它的尾巴立正着。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are we good? You trust me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们好了吗？你相信我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus tilts his head.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯歪着头。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Laertes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈拉厄耳忒斯吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus whines shortly and lowers his head.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯呜咽了一声，低下了头。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Point towards Big Stop.> You need to go back to him. He misses you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <指向大站>你得回去找他，他很想你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus turns and looks at one of the other dogs. The dog yawns. Cerberus yawns too, licking his nose. Then he looks back up at you.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯转过身，看着另一只狗。狗打了个哈欠，刻耳柏洛斯也打了个哈欠，舔着鼻子，然后它又抬头看着你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't care about Laertes. What do *you* want to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我并不在乎拉厄耳忒斯。*你*想做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus lays down and presses his nose into the ground. You hear him whining softly.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯躺下来，把鼻子埋在地上。你听到它轻声的呜咽。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus stands back up and looks at you with a renewed alertness.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯站了起来，重新警觉的看着你。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if you like being here, you can't turn your back on Laertes. He's family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算你喜欢待在这里，你也不能背弃拉厄耳忒斯。他是家人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus opens his mouth and pants lightly. His ear flicks forward. He seems happy.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯张开嘴，轻轻地喘气。他的耳朵向前弹，他看起来很开心。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It must be nice to run free with dogs just like you, huh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样和狗一起自由奔跑一定很好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus' tail perks up.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯的尾巴翘了起来。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on, Cerberus. Go home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，刻耳柏洛斯。回家了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cerberus wags his tail and turns in a circle. He looks at you with his mouth open, panting.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [刻耳柏洛斯摇着尾巴转着圈。它张着嘴看着你，喘着粗气。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cerberus [0600E266] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't make you go back. You can stay here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让你回去的，你可以留在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A favor. I need you to deliver something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮个忙，我需要你送点东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a slave yet, asshole. See this collar around my neck? I'm just a capture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还不是奴隶，混蛋。看到我脖子上的这个项圈了吗？我只是个俘虏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't talk to slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不跟奴隶说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就滚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A letter to my daughter. She's at a refugee camp close to Hoover Dam. Hoover's Hope, they call it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我女儿的信。她在胡佛大坝附近的一个难民营，他们称之为胡佛希望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I delivering, and where?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要送什么，送去哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it matter? Nothing interesting, I can tell you that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这重要吗？我可以告诉你，没什么有趣的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in the letter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 信里有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She didn't leave me and she didn't run away. This is what we agreed on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她没有离开我，也没有逃跑。这是我们约定好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your daughter ran away and left you to get enslaved?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你女儿跑了，留下你做奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sick. The Legion won't have me for long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我病了，军团控制不了我多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what a life of enslavement means, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道被奴役的生活意味着什么吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very contagious. It's my secret plan to wipe out the Legion. Once I cough on the Dominicus here, it'll only be a matter of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传染性很强，这是我消灭军团的秘密计划。一旦我对着多米尼库斯咳嗽，就只是时间问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm joking. I'm not contagious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开玩笑的，没有传染性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're sick? Is it contagious? Should I step back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你病了？会传染吗？我应该退后吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, you have a lot of questions. Am I that interesting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你问题真多。我很有趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion wanted information out of me and I didn't have any. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团想从我这里得到信息，而我什么都没有。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the Legion enslave you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团为什么要奴役你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Big Stop is a small town that's been through a lot. The trade has been good, and it's been bad. People come and go.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]大站是一个经历了很多的小镇。生意有好有坏，人们来来往往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those of us who stuck through the bad... we're like family. You don't give family up to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们中那些挺过难关的人...我们就像家人一样。你不能把家人交给军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But there's more to it, isn't there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但还有更多的原因，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Wow. Thanks for that. I didn't know we had a real philosopher in our midst.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]哇噢，谢谢哦。我都不知道我们中间还有个真正的哲学家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going to deliver the letter or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底送不送这封信？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you didn't do the crime, then you wouldn't be doing the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没有犯罪，那你就不会服刑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. God, thank you. You have no idea what a relief that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！天啊，谢谢你。你不知道这有多令人宽慰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The letter is in the town's Mojave Express. I was gonna mail it, but never got the chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这封信是在镇上的莫哈维邮政。我本来打算寄出去的，但一直没机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'll deliver the letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我来送这封信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's in the town's Mojave Express. I was gonna mail it, but never got the chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在镇上的莫哈维邮政里。我本来打算寄出去的，但一直没机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And... thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有...谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clarice [0600EC89] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's cut to the chase. I'll deliver it. Where's the letter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们切入正题吧。我来送，信在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suboptio Dominicus Rex, adjunct to optio Flavius Constantinus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官副手多米尼库斯·勒克斯，执行官弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯的副手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is your commanding officer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的指挥官是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want details, ask someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想知道细节，可以问别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ranger insurrection?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵暴动？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see that. Your passage is already cleared. Be on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我看到了。你的通道已经畅通了，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. A search isn't necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我身上有凯撒的徽记，没有必要搜索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, I see you have the Mark of Caesar. Your passage is already cleared. Be on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我看到你有凯撒的徽记。你的通道已经畅通了，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Search me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，搜我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mistake. I see you have the Mark of Caesar. Your passage is already cleared. Be on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我的错，我看到你有凯撒的徽记了。你的通道已经畅通了，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you try and search me, you're gonna lose a hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想搜我的身，你会失去一只手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahahaha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was told you would pay me for services rendered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你会为我提供的服务付费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave, requesting payment? How absurd!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个奴隶，要求报酬？太荒唐了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's so funny?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事这么好笑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you aren't a slave are you? Libertus, I presume?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你不是奴隶吗？我猜是自由民吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what the hell are you doing running letters?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你他妈为什么要寄信？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, of course!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a courier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个邮差。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess I can spare you some silver - a piece of silver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想我可以给你一些银子，一块银子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, since I've got you here, why don't you run my letter back to Willow? Tnen I'll double it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，既然我把你叫来了，不如你把我的信转交给柳树营吧？那我就加倍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you gonna pay me or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底付不付我钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Motherfucker!
ESP.TRADUIT: ...王八蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, you can take a rest now. I won't be writing a reply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你现在可以休息了。我不会写回信的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's uh... a good pencil for your trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这呃...一支好铅笔，给你添麻烦了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do? Let me see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？让我看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, that will be all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ceveus Crassus [0600D6E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got a letter for you from Camp Willow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一封你的信，来自柳树营地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a letter from the Malpais Scribonius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一封马尔帕斯书记官的信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, since you're asking, you can deliver this letter to the logistics office in Malpais. Hand it to the Scribonius at the desk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然你这么问了，你可以把这封信送到马尔帕斯的后勤办公室，把它交给桌子旁的书记官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's slave work, but I would appreciate it. The man will pay you on delivery if you ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是奴隶的活，但我会很感激的。如果你要求的话，他会货到付款的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scribonius Prentus [06006DD3] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything I can do to help out around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, he subjected you to that, did he? Don't be fooled, the man is not as innocent as he seems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是他让你这么做的吧？别被骗了，这个人并不像他看起来那么无辜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is nonetheless... creative.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，他还是...有创造力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know... When I talked to him he just kept going on about some pulley system he thought up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道...当我和他谈话时，他只是不停的说他想到的一些滑轮系统。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drink Sunset Sarsaparilla!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝夕阳沙士！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sunset Sarsaparilla Protectron [06007DE2] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drink Sunset Sarsaparilla!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝夕阳沙士！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sunset Sarsaparilla Protectron [06007DE2] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drink Sunset Sasparilla!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝夕阳沙士！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sunset Sarsaparilla Protectron [06007DE2] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么到这儿来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, chill out. Fuck. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，冷静点。操，抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep looking at me like that and I'll pluck out your eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再这样看着我，我就把你的眼睛挖出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars provides bounties to those who are righteous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯为那些正直的人提供了奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: We show the Dissolute what devotion can achieve. Fertility, of body and soil. Favorable seasons. Water, be it from rain or Legion caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们向放荡者展示了虔诚所能达到的效果。身体和土壤的肥力，四季宜人，水，无论是来自雨水还是军团商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would simply be foolish to reject the Cult's aid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拒绝教团的援助是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult of Mars manages settlements? That seems more administrative than religious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团管理定居点？这似乎更像是行政上的，而不是宗教上的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easy, hound. I mean no harm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松点，伙计。我没有恶意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Yes... that is Legion paint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的...那是军团涂料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your dog is Legion property.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的狗是军团财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The blue bio med gel is uncommon. Most of the police cyberdogs in Denver have a pink gel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种蓝色的生物医学凝胶并不常见。丹佛的大多数警用机械犬都有粉色的凝胶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's dog also had blue gel. It makes me wonder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的狗也有蓝色凝胶。这让我很好奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like to purchase your dog from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想从你这里买下你的狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's news to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我来说是个新鲜事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. We will not discuss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们不讨论它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want Rex, you'll have to kill me for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要雷克斯，就得为他杀了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would take him to Caesar and see if Caesar recognizes him. If Caesar does not, then he will join our most esteemed mongrels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要带他去见凯撒，看凯撒能不能认出他来。如果凯撒不同意，他就会加入我们最受尊敬的杂交犬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Rex? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？雷克斯？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lupa's brain? You mean inside the bio med gel? Antony's dog? Hmm. I do hope she died well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卢帕的大脑？你是说在生物凝胶里？安东尼的狗？嗯，我真希望她死得安详。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were to sell him, you'd be paying double, because he has Lupa's brain in there too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我卖了他，你得付双倍的钱，因为他身上也有卢帕的大脑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another dog's brain? You mean inside the bio med gel? It's possible to do that? Fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一只狗的大脑？你是说在生物医学凝胶里？这有可能吗？真有意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were to sell him, you'd be paying double, because he has another dog's brain in there too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我卖了它，你得付双倍的钱，因为它里面还有另一只狗的大脑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I said, I would take him to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过，我要带他去见凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rex, as you call him, was Caesar's war hound during the siege on Denver. Caesar will surely welcome him home with festivities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷克斯，你是这么叫他的，是凯撒围攻丹佛时的战犬。凯撒一定会隆重欢迎他回家的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I am incorrect, and this is not Caesar's dog, then Rex will be taken into our war pack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我说错了，这不是凯撒的狗，那雷克斯就会加入我们的战斗队伍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He will be fed real meat, brought on hunts, groomed twice a week. This is a life of luxury for any Wasteland dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他会吃真正的肉，带他去打猎，每周给他梳两次毛。对于任何一只废土狗来说，这是一种奢侈的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you have in mind for Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对雷克斯有什么打算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not have real money, but I do have caps. I understand that this is the currency of the Dissolute in the west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有真钱，但我有瓶盖。我知道这是西方放荡者的货币。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 2,250 caps. A grand sum. In exchange, you will give me Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2250瓶盖，一大笔钱。作为交换，你要把雷克斯交给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much are you willing to pay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意付多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sick? How so?
ESP.TRADUIT: 生病了？怎么回事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, nevermind. I can see it now. He is old. A brave and strong animal, to have lived this long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，没关系，我现在看到了。他老了，活了这么久，真是一只勇敢而强壮的动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he is indeed Caesar's dog, Caesar would ensure his last days are spent in luxury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他真的是凯撒的狗，凯撒一定会让他最后的日子过得很奢华。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry to break it to you, but the dog is sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉打断你，但是这条狗病了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. You have made me a very happy man. I cannot wait to see him reunited with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。你让我成为了一个非常幸福的人，我等不及要看他和凯撒重聚了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a fair deal. [Sell Rex.]
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个公平的交易。[卖掉雷克斯]

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. You are lucky that I respect a hound's choice in owner, else I would be tempted to take him from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你很幸运，因为我尊重猎犬的主人选择，否则我就会把它从你身边夺走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guard this checkpoint. Dominicus Rex requested a houndmaster, which would be me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责守卫这个检查站。多米尼库斯·勒克斯要求一个驯犬师，那就是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The dogs I brought with me are trained to sniff out traces of gunpowder and chems. They found us many goodies, which the Frumentarii destroyed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带来的狗受过训练，能嗅出火药和化学药物的痕迹。他们给我们找到了很多好东西，但都被特务给销毁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Profligate enemy is no more, but I'm still here. My doggies sniff the merchants who arrive and tell me if something is being hidden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落的敌人不复存在，但我还在这里。我的狗嗅着来的商人，告诉我是否有什么东西被藏了起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A waste of time. Very few are stupid enough to bring chems to the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浪费时间。很少有人会蠢到把化学药物带到堡垒来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you have the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你有凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I brought chems to the Fort. It was no big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就把化学药物带到堡垒来了，没什么大不了的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? How? Nobody searched you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？怎么会？没人搜查你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The dogs have to get very close to smell the bad things. It's unfortunate, but incredible that they can do it at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗必须靠得很近才能闻到不好的东西。这很不幸，但令人难以置信的是，他们能做到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pretend you said nothing. You have the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就当你什么都没说。你有凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have chems on me right now. How come your dogs haven't noticed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在身上就有化学药物，你的狗怎么没发现？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Let's talk something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我们聊点别的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good idea. Not your problem, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好主意。不关你的事，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a good idea. Are you going to tell Caesar that you let me bring chems into your lands?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是个好主意。你打算告诉凯撒你让我把化学药物带进你的土地吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am amused by the fact that he shares his name with your dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得好笑的是，他和你的狗名字一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a man who acts swiftly and with great cruelty, like many of the Tan Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个行动迅速而又非常残忍的人，就像许多棕色帽子一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Dominicus Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得多米尼库斯·勒克斯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a man who acts swiftly and with great cruelty, like many of the Tan Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个行动迅速而又非常残忍的人，就像许多棕色帽子一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Dominicus Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得多米尼库斯·勒克斯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His tribe. A tribe rival to mine. They joined the Legion willingly. We did not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的部落，和我竞争的部落。他们自愿加入了军团，我们没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tan Caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 棕色帽子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not up close. I saw him once, when I was a Hangdog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没，不是近距离的。我曾经见过他一次，那时候我还是个低贱的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had fought the Legion for many months. We survived, but nobody was winning. Things changed when the Legate Lanius arrived.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经和军团作战好几个月了，我们活了下来，但没有人赢。当拉尼厄斯特使到来时，情况发生了变化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw the Caesar then. He had a cyberdog at his side. A Denver cyberdog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时我看到了凯撒。他身边有一只机械犬，一只丹佛机械犬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The battles grew harsher. More of us died. My faith was shaken. The dogs of Denver had forsaken us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗变得更加激烈，我们死了更多的人。我的信念动摇了，丹佛的狗已经抛弃了我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we joined the Legion, many of our dogs did too. I think we should have surrendered sooner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们加入军团的时候，很多狗也加入了。我认为我们应该早点投降。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever met Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过凯撒吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Work? Maybe so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工作吗？也许吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A dog of mine ran off several days ago. If I were allowed to leave this post, I'd search for him myself. Sadly, I'm stuck here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一只狗几天前跑掉了。如果我被允许离开这个岗位，我会亲自去找他。很遗憾，我被困在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you look for him? I would pay you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能去找他吗？我会付钱给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有工作给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. You'll find him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。你能找到他吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your lost dog...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你丢失的狗...

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not good. He is the property of the Legion. Property of Caesar. He is one of our best sniffers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不太好。他是军团的财产，凯撒的财产。他是我们最好的嗅探者之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is he happy? Will he be happier with those mongrels than he would be with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他快乐吗？他跟那些杂交犬在一起会比跟我在一起更开心吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found your dog, but he's not coming back. He found a new home with a pack of wild mongrels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了你的狗，但它不会回来了。他和一群野生杂交犬一起找到了新家。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Why? He was perfectly healthy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？为什么？他非常健康！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found your dog. I put him out of his misery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到你的狗了，我让他摆脱了痛苦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He did! Thank you, amicus. Here, take this as my thanks. I'll keep him in my sight at all times from now on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他做到了！谢谢你，朋友。给，把这个当作我的感谢吧。从现在开始，我会一直盯着他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see Cerberus found his way back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来刻耳柏洛斯找到了回来的路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I considered that, but I think probably not. He was my best dog. I spoiled him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我考虑过，但我认为可能不会。他是我最好的狗，我把他宠坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's possible that the executions spooked him. Sometimes dogs get stressed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是行刑吓到了他，有时候狗狗会有压力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe your dog just didn't like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你的狗只是不喜欢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is Cerberus. I was taking him for a piss at the south end of town when he shot off to chase a mole rat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的名字叫刻耳柏洛斯。我在小镇的南端带他撒尿时，他突然跑去追鼹鼠了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He never came back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他再也没有回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know there are brahmin in the plains to the south. Cerberus always loved brahmin meat. I would give him a portion of my meals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道在南边的平原上有婆罗门牛，刻耳柏洛斯总是爱吃婆罗门牛肉，我会把我的餐食分给它一份。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe he's feasting on those big old brahmin. But I need him. He's my best sniffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他在享用那些高大的婆罗门牛。但我需要他，他是我最好的嗅探员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Just don't make any sudden moves once you find him. Be calm. Step quickly and he'll bite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。只要你找到他，就不要轻举妄动。保持冷静，快走，他会咬人的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll find your dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会找到你的狗的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? No. One of the Frumentarii named him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？不，一个军团特务给他起的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cerberus? Does he have three heads?
ESP.TRADUIT: 刻耳柏洛斯？他有三个头吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an herbal medicine. You can find huge patches of it growing east of Denver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种草药，你可以在丹佛东部发现大片大片的这种植物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything about Brush?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你了解狐尾草吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I suppose that is all that matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我想这才是最重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for finding him, amicus. I'm glad to know that he is safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你找到他，朋友。得知他平安无事，我很高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seemed very happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他看起来非常开心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Being in service to Caesar is a great honor. Though, perhaps a dog cannot understand that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为凯撒效力是莫大的荣幸。不过，狗可能无法理解这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for finding him, amicus. I'm glad to know that he is safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你找到他，朋友。得知他平安无事，我很高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, but anything is better than being a tool for the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，但做什么都比成为军团的工具好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Degenerate trash. I will take your word that Cerberus is safe, but I won't pay you a thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落的垃圾。我相信你说的刻耳柏洛斯是安全的，但我不会付你一分钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, probably not, but you don't deserve him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，也许不是，但你配不上他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Truly? I had no idea. Then I thank you. You did a brave thing. Here, take this as my thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]真的？我不知道。那就谢谢你了，你做了一件勇敢的事。给，把这个当作我的感谢吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> He was suffering. You put him under too much stress. It broke him.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>他很痛苦。你让他承受了太多压力，这让他崩溃了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Degenerate liar. You'll pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]堕落的骗子。你会付出代价的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> He had a... uh... medical issue. He wasn't going to make it. I'm sorry for your loss.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>他有一个...呃...医疗问题。他撑不过去了，对你的损失我深表遗憾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out of my sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出我的视线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. Things got out of hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。事情失控了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I will take your life for his.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就用你的命换他的命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate dogs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I will take your life for his.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就用你的命换他的命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to make you suffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你痛苦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, a little bit of everything. I help out where I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，什么都会一点。我在力所能及的地方帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beyond that, I'm kind of the teacher for this place. That's what I'm good at.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，我也算是这里的老师。这是我的强项。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Theory. Frameworks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理论，框架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Evelina's old enough, I'll get to teach her practical things, but for now it's all heady and conceptual.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等伊芙琳娜长大一点，我会教她一些实用的东西，但现在这些都是令人兴奋和概念性的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you teach?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你教什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa's daughter. Well, Job's daughter. I'm kind of her uncle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦的女儿，嗯，约伯的女儿。我算是她叔叔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Evelina?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊芙琳娜是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look around you. This place is my baby. Voluntary association, no money, no property.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你的周围，这地方是我的宝贝。自治组织，没有钱，没有财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone looks out for each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都互相照顾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray came up with the broad strokes, but I made suggestions, hammered out the specifics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷提出了大致的构想，但我提出了建议，敲定了细节。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty cool, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很酷，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about these theories and frameworks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我讲讲这些理论和框架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, smartass, things have been running smoothly for nearly a decade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，小聪明，这十年来一切都很顺利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murders happen. They've probably always happened. It's no reason to throw the whole system out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谋杀时有发生，也可能一直都在发生。 但这并不是把整个系统都扔掉的理由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is murder considered a part of that 'voluntary association'?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谋杀被认为是“自治组织”的一部分吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because nobody knows how to do it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为现在没人知道怎么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many caps are you carrying? And you'd defend them with your life, right? Because you need them to pay for food and shelter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你带了多少瓶盖？你会用生命保护它，对吧？因为你需要它们来支付食物和住所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't used to be that way, but it's hard to unlearn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前不是这样的，但很难改变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand. Why did you need to teach people how to look out for each other?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白。你为什么要教人们如何互相照顾？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All experiments are pointless if you're not interested in improving anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对改进任何事情都不感兴趣，那么所有的实验都是毫无意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A community without money or property seems like a pointless experiment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个没有钱或财产的社区似乎是一个毫无意义的实验。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree, but more than that, it's durable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意，但更重要的是，它经久耐用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We lived just like this for tens of thousands of years, but once we started with the property, it only took us 4,000 years to destroy the planet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就这样生活了数万年，而一旦我们开始拥有财产，我们只花了4000年就摧毁了这个星球。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something to think about, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是值得思考的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A community without money or property is an admirable ideal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个没有金钱或财产的社区是一个令人钦佩的理想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't force anyone to do anything. If you want to hoard things, then leave and do it out there in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有强迫任何人做任何事。如果你想囤积东西，那就离开这里，到废土去囤吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A community without money or property just means you've forced everyone to be poor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个没有钱或财产的社区只意味着你迫使每个人都变得贫穷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The big war? The Great one? Yeah, I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大战？最大的那个？是的，我在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was an academic back then. I taught at UC Berkeley. Youngest professor in the humanities department.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我那时是一名学者。我在加州大学伯克利分校教书，人文系最年轻的教授。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I read books, wrote books, graded papers, fucked students. It was a waste of damn time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我读书，写书，批改论文，操学生。简直是浪费时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you around before the war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 战前你在这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I wasn't doing anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我什么都没做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of that time is long gone, friend. Can't remember a thing. It's a blur.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大部分时间都过去了，朋友。什么都不记得了，一片模糊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember I was angry. I remember getting arrested. Multiple times, probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得我当时很生气。我记得我被逮捕了，可能是好几次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never liked the job. The students were my people. They had heart. They cared. With their silly little protest signs, they cared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直不喜欢这份工作。学生是我的人，他们有勇气，他们在乎。他们举着愚蠢的小抗议标语，表示他们很在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why was it a waste of time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么说这是浪费时间？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember I felt bad. Not for myself, but for my students.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得我当时很难过。不是为了我自己，而是为了我的学生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We failed them, you know. All of us. We failed the kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我们辜负了他们，我们所有人。我们辜负了孩子们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it like when the bombs dropped?
ESP.TRADUIT: 炸弹落下的时候是什么样子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, they're fucking rats. Animals. Dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他们是该死的老鼠，畜生，污垢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're evil, friend. I don't say that lightly. They're the latest in a long line of evil, unbroken since the dawn of civilization.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很邪恶，朋友。我可不是随便这么说的。他们是一长串邪恶中最新的一个，自人类文明诞生以来就从未间断过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Authoritarians. Killers. Fascists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 独裁政权，杀手，法西斯分子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They think we're animals. They think humans ought to kill each other forever. They think the only way to be good, is to be good at killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们认为我们是动物，他们认为人类应该永远互相残杀。他们认为成为好人的唯一方法，就是善于杀戮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what evil is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么邪恶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fuck do you know about human nature? Look at you! You're smooth as a baby's bottom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈的懂什么人性？看看你！你像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think you're wise and worldly? You think you're superior for embracing violence? You're a dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得自己聪明又世故？你以为你崇尚暴力就高人一等？你就是条狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Human nature is what we make of it. My nature as a human is to help others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人性是由我们自己塑造的。作为一个人，我的天性就是帮助别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't feel the same way, then you are my enemy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不这么想，那你就是我的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's human nature to fight each other. Some people come out on top, others lose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自相残杀是人类的天性。有些人成功了，有些人失败了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we're both fools in good company. I'll drink to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们两个都是傻瓜，有个好伙伴。我要为此干一杯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. Humans don't have to fight each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意。人类不需要自相残杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nearly ten years. I was one of the founders, if you could call us that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 将近十年了。我是创始人之一，如果你能这么称呼我们的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you lived here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里住了多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不记得了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What motivated you to found this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么促使你创办了这个地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, Murray's rewritten the history. He'll tell you all about our lofty ideals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，穆雷改写了历史。他会告诉你我们所有的崇高理想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I was just pissed. The Rangers got swallowed up by the NCR and called away. The Legion had no one to stop them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我只是很生气。游骑兵被NCR吞并了，被召回了。军团没有人来阻止他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I guess I just wanted to leave. I didn't want to be in the Wasteland anymore. Didn't want to have to face our failure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我想我只是想离开，我不想再待在废土上了，不想再面对我们的失败。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't remember?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不记得了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not the way the Rangers did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像游骑兵那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made some bombs. Helped drill some of the guys on insurgency and asymmetric warfare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做了一些炸弹，帮助训练一些士兵应对叛乱和非对称战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that they needed my help with that stuff. They had figured most of it out themselves. But there's still good info in old books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说他们需要我帮忙，他们自己已经解决了大部分问题。但旧书中还是有很多有用的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Our* failure? Did you fight the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: *我们*的失败？你和军团战斗过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the same as the Legion. Warmongers. They kill and conquer reflexively, because the don't know how to sit still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们和军团一样，战争贩子。他们本能地杀戮和征服，因为他们不知道如何坐着不动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR wants more. More of everything. More land, more power, more bodies for the war machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR想要更多，更多的一切。更多的土地，更多的权力，更多的人为战争机器服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's only one way to get more, and that's by expanding out. So they send their soldiers and start taking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一种方法可以得到更多，那就是向外扩张。所以他们派遣士兵开始占领。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: More land for the cows. More soldiers to take the land. More power to run the factories making guns. More citizens to collect taxes from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更多的土地来养殖奶牛，更多的士兵来占领土地，更多的电力来运转制造枪支的工厂，更多的公民来收税。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It never ends because nobody can be satisfied with what they have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它永远不会结束，因为没有人会满足于他们所拥有的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. Now what do you mean by that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。现在你这是什么意思？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. The NCR and the Legion are similar in a lot of ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，NCR和军团在很多方面都很相似。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Yes they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的，他们是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to watch the world cannibalize itself for resources once. Everyone expanded so far and extracted so much that there was nothing left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经不得不看着这个世界为了资源自相残杀。每个人都扩张得太快，攫取得太多，以至于什么都不剩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once there's nothing left, where do you go? Nowhere. You collapse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦一无所有，你会去哪里？哪里都去不了，你崩溃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But collapse is shameful, you see. So we took the world with us in one last violent outburst, as if to prove that even though we're dying, we are still strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你知道的，崩溃是可耻的。所以，我们在最后的暴力爆发中带走了整个世界，似乎是为了证明，即使我们即将死去，我们依然强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're both empires that expand to extract resources from the land and from people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们都是为了从土地和人民身上攫取资源而扩张的帝国。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that's true, but so does every state. It's hardly special about the NCR and the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这是事实，但每个州都是如此。NCR和军团没什么特别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there such thing as righteous violence?
ESP.TRADUIT: 世上有所谓正义的暴力吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They both claim to have the unique power to use violence righteously, whether it be prisons or crucifixion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都声称自己拥有一种独特的力量，可以公正地使用暴力，无论是监狱还是十字架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agreed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it's always wrong to subjugate someone else? No matter if it's the NCR, the Legion, me, or you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以征服别人永远都是错的？不管是 NCR、军团、我还是你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing new under the sun, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太阳底下没有新鲜事，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're right. I wouldn't be here if I didn't agree with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你说得对。如果我不同意你，我也不会在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These modes of organizing have been tried before. Rome fell. The United States fell. These civilizations lasted a long time, they had their fair shake, and they failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些组织模式以前已经尝试过。罗马灭亡了，美国倒下了。这些文明持续了很长时间，他们受到了公平的对待，但他们失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We must try something new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们必须尝试一些新的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR and the Legion both draw from the Old World to try and make a new one.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR和军团都从旧世界中吸取经验，试图创造一个新的世界。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you're feisty. I must've hit a nerve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你真是争强好胜。我一定是戳到你的痛处了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They both breathe air and drink water. Your false equivalences aren't as smart as you think they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都呼吸空气，都喝水。你虚假的等价交换并没有你想象的那么聪明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I don't actually think the NCR and Legion are similar at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。我并不认为NCR和军团有什么相似之处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's say you stop paying taxes because you can't, in good conscience, support this government. What happens if you decide you want to stop contributing to this endless death?
ESP.TRADUIT: 假设你停止纳税，因为出于良心，你不能支持这个政府。如果你决定停止为这无尽的死亡做贡献，会发生什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They throw you in jail and put you to work. They make you build their rail lines. They make you work the assembly lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把你关进监狱，让你去工作。他们让你帮他们修铁路，他们让你在流水线上工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They *make* you. They beat you if you refuse. How is this different from slavery?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们使唤你。如果你拒绝，他们会打你。这和奴隶制有什么区别？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The difference is that the NCR doesn't enslave people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不同的是，NCR不会奴役人民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The state is Caesar's pocketbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 国家就是凯撒的钱袋子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every slave, every pack animal, every grain of wheat, all of it is his. He has supreme ownership of all state capital.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每一个奴隶，每一头驮畜，每一粒小麦，都是他的。他拥有全部国有资本的最高所有权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that better or worse than rule by Brahmin Baron?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这比婆罗门贵族的统治好还是坏？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion isn't beholden to a wealthy elite. They expand to better the state, not someone's pocketbooks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不受制于富有的精英。它们的扩张是为了改善国家，而不是为了某些人的钱袋子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really believe that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的相信吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you and me are at an impasse, friend. Because I believe people like you should be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就陷入僵局了，朋友。因为我认为像你这样的人应该被杀掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong with slavery? Weaklings are meant to be ruled over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶制有什么问题？弱者就是要被统治的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we're in agreement. Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就达成一致了。很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel the same way about people like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你这样的人也有同样的感觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will some day, when you get serious about your ideals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天，当你认真对待你的理想时，你会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe you should be killed just because you disagree with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为你应该因为和我意见相左而被杀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me tell you a story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我给你讲个故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was the latter years of Tandi's presidency, when the NCR really went wild with expansion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在坦蒂总统任期的最后几年，NCR才真正开始疯狂地扩张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They had this little trick where they could steal your town from right under you, all without even putting troops on the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有个小伎俩可以在你眼皮底下偷走你的小镇，甚至不用派军队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR settlers would start showing up into your town, see. At first it was a few, but soon it was a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR移民会开始出现在你的城镇。一开始只有几个，但很快就多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would get to the point that there were so many NCR citizens in your town, that you were practically in the NCR already.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你的城镇中有很多NCR居民时，你实际上已经是NCR的一员了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So when those NCR settlers started agitating, demanding you join the NCR, you couldn't say no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以当那些NCR移民开始煽动，要求你加入NCR时，你无法拒绝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They would out-vote you. They would intimidate the locals. Anything and everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的票数会超过你，他们会威胁当地人。什么都可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the NCR would come to you and say that you have so many NCR citizens in your town, that it's their right to take over and govern you as an NCR territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会来找你，说你的城镇有这么多NCR公民，他们有权利接管并统治你，就像NCR领土一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But even if the NCR is as you say, it still extends rights to its citizens that the Legion does not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但即使NCR像你说的那样，它仍然赋予其公民军团所没有的权利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm getting there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我快说到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is what happened to Bullhead, you see?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是布尔海德的下场，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullhead was a peaceful city populated by tribals. I don't say that to glorify them, just to paint you a picture. They weren't savages.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布尔海德是一个和平的城市，居住着部落。我说这些并不是为了美化他们，只是为了给你描绘一幅画面，他们不是野蛮人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR settlers show up. The locals do not like this. The locals never do, but this time, these people *really* didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR移民出现了。当地人不喜欢这样，当地人从来都不喜欢，但这一次，*真的*不喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: People started refusing service to NCR citizens. There were fights and murders. It was nasty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们开始拒绝向NCR公民提供服务。有打斗和谋杀，太肮脏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd it end? The NCR citizens started a little uprising. The locals responded with violence. In self-defense, I might add.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结果呢？NCR的公民们开始了一场小小的起义，当地居民以暴力回应。我得补充一句，这是正当防卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So the NCR sends the army. They say they're going to pacify the region, clear it of all its raiders and savages. It was a lie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以NCR派出了军队，他们说要平定这个地区，清除所有的掠夺者和野蛮人。这是个谎言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR killed every tribal they could find. Men, women, children. They didn't bother to draw a distinction. To the NCR, they were all savages.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR杀死了他们能找到的每一个部落，男人，女人，孩子。他们懒得区分，在NCR看来，他们都是野蛮人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does this have to do with the rights NCR citizens have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这与NCR公民拥有的权利有什么关系？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the time, I worked adjacent to the Followers of the Apocalypse, with a paper called the Free Republican Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时，我在《自由共和邮报》工作，与天启追随者毗邻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were incredibly critical of this war. They called it a war, but it wasn't really. It was an extermination campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们对这场战争持批评态度。他们称之为战争，但实际上并不是，这是一场种族灭绝运动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We published accounts of the atrocities. We listened to the victims. We actually did our damn jobs as reporters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们发表了对这些暴行的报道，我们听取了受害者的意见。我们实际上做了我们该死的记者工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day, a gang of NCR soldiers kicked down our door. They were in uniform, with their service guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天，一群NCR的士兵踢开了我们的门。他们穿着制服，拿着军枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They had some sort of warrant. They told us we were a threat to public safety. They took everything we had and put us in cuffs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有某种搜查令，他们说我们对公共安全构成威胁。他们拿走了我们所有的东西，给我们戴上了手铐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get any fanciful ideas about your rights as an NCR citizen. *That* is how they treat their citizens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要对你作为NCR公民的权利有任何幻想，这就是他们对待公民的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can tell you're getting somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能看出你有所进展。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR doles out rights and takes them away as it sees fit. The rights are illusory. There is no consistency and there was never meant to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR发放权利，并在它认为合适的时候剥夺权利。这些权利是虚幻的，没有一致性，也从来没有这样的打算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're a threat to NCR power, if you report on their crimes, if you refuse to kneel and let them take from you, your rights are forfeit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对NCR的权力构成威胁，如果你举报他们的罪行，如果你拒绝下跪让他们夺走你的权利，你的权利就会被剥夺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, really, under the NCR you have the exact same rights as under the Legion. You have the right to do what you want, up until the point you piss off the state.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，说真的，在NCR治下和在军团治下你拥有完全相同的权利。你有权利做你想做的事，直到你惹到了国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare me the story. Just get to your point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我讲故事了，直奔你的主题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have a point. There is no point. You're really going to expect a ghoul to have a point?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有观点，没有意义。你真指望一个食尸鬼有什么观点？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what is your point? The NCR and the Legion are both equally bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你的观点是什么？NCR和军团都一样糟糕？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We both know the Legion is evil, don't we? What's the point discussing it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都知道军团是邪恶的，不是吗？讨论它有什么意义？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You complain so much about the NCR that I could mistake you for a Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对NCR抱怨太多了，我都快把你当成军团士兵了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare me that bullshit. It's the exact same thing as the old world, and you see where that got us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我胡扯了。这和旧世界是一样的，你知道我们会变成什么样子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to follow the Republic into its destruction, then feel free. If you're too closeminded to imagine something truly better, then have a fucking blast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想追随共和国走向灭亡，随你便。如果你太封闭，无法想象更好的东西，那就尽情享受吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't be fooled, though. You want something better for the Wasteland, this is it. Here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我不会上当的。你想让这片废土变得更好，这就是，这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree the NCR has problems, but it's the best hope for the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意NCR有问题，但它是废土最大的希望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is a dead end. Take it from an old ghoul who saw the end of the world. The NCR has no future.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR是一条死胡同。听一个看到过世界末日的老食尸鬼的话吧，NCR没有未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe the NCR isn't the best hope for the Wasteland. I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许NCR不是废土的最大希望。我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you're talking!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这才对嘛！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right about the NCR. The Wasteland needs something new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对NCR的看法是对的，废土需要一些新的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe you know what hope is. I think you're excited for a future where you're on top and your enemies are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你知道希望是什么。我觉得你对未来很兴奋，因为你能高高在上，而你的敌人都死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right about the NCR. The Legion is the Wasteland's true hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对NCR的看法是对的。军团才是废土真正的希望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Who? House? The one in Vegas? You ask me as if he's a big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么先生？豪斯？维加斯的那个？你问得好像他是个大人物似的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robert House, as I knew him before the War, is a narcissist. He always has been. He likes to play with toys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗伯特·豪斯，我在战前就认识他了，他是个自恋狂，他一直如此。他喜欢玩玩具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? You tell me. We don't get much news down here. What's going on with Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？你告诉我，我们这里没什么新闻。豪斯先生怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're joking. Is he working with the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吧，他是NCR的人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. House is a serious regional player now. He wants to transform Vegas into a utopia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 豪斯先生现在是一个重要的地区参与者，他想把维加斯变成一个乌托邦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Independently? With what army?
ESP.TRADUIT: 独立？靠什么军队？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He runs Vegas independently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他独立经营维加斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! That sounds like a nightmare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！听起来像一场噩梦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A robot police force that answers only to one single trillionaire? And he runs the whole city that way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个只对一个亿万富翁负责的机器人警察部队？他就这样管理着整个城市？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has a robot police force to keep the peace and enforce the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有一支机器人警察部队来维持和平和执法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. No chance in hell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，绝对不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
