ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like I told you: he likes to play with toys. A robot police force? Toy soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我告诉过你的：他喜欢玩玩具。机器人警察部队？玩具士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he wanted to help people or improve the Wasteland, he wouldn't have waited 200 years. We moved on without him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他想帮助人们或改善这片废土，他不会等上200年。没有他，我们继续生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think he may be a potential future for the Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他可能是废土的未来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Independent from whom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 独立于谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I support democracy. Full democracy. The locals ought to decide things together, democratically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我支持民主，全面民主。当地人应该民主地共同决定事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If independence looks like that, I'll always support it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果独立是这样的，我将永远支持它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you support an independent Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会支持独立的维加斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love 'em. Even when I hate them, I love them. Anyone in particular you wanted to know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爱他们，即使我恨他们，我也爱他们。你有特别想了解的人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the other members of the community?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为社区的其他成员怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a good guy. I talk politics with him sometimes. Doesn't really like to talk about himself, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好人。我有时和他谈政治，不过他不太喜欢谈论他自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think he's probably got some regrets that weigh on him, but don't we all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他可能有一些遗憾耿耿于怀，但我们不都是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He found us much later than some of the others. It's funny because sometimes I could swear that he was one of the founders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他发现我们比其他人晚得多。这很有趣，因为有时我可以发誓他是创始人之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Love him. If I'd have met him twenty years ago, I would have tried to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱他。如果我二十年前遇到他，我一定会杀了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to be a Legionary. A Frumentarius. Pure evil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他曾是一名军团士兵，军团特务。纯粹的邪恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For me, he's proof that men can change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，他证明了人是可以改变的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe it makes me a hypocrite for palling around with Mr. Former Mass Murderer, but screw it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许这让我成为了一个伪君子，因为我和前杀人狂先生混在一起，但管他呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's like a little brother to me, so know that I don't mean to talk down on him when I say this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就像我的小弟弟一样，所以你要知道，我说这些话并不是想贬低他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's confused. His heart's in the right place, but he doesn't have any sort of ideological consistency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很困惑。他的出发点是对的，但他没有任何意识形态上的一致性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wanted us to be an experiment in free-association and mutual aid, but it seems like all that means to him is hanging out in the mushroom farm and tripping.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想让我们成为自由结社和互助的实验对象，但对他来说，这似乎只意味着在蘑菇农场闲逛和狂欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know he's worried about the Legion. We all are. That isn't an excuse to give up on taking this place seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他很担心军团，我们都是。这不是放弃认真对待这里的理由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He still thinks the NCR is going to come save us. That should give you an idea. Delusional. Detached from reality. Deeply unserious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还以为NCR会来拯救我们。你应该明白了，妄想症，脱离现实，非常不严肃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He thinks war is a battle between the good guys, and the bad guys. And the good guys are here to do good things. The NCR will save us because they're the good guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他认为战争是好人和坏人之间的战争。好人是来做善事的，NCR会救我们，因为他们是好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's ahistorical. No, it's worse than that. It's undialectical. It's stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不符合历史的。不，比那还糟。这是不辩证的，这很愚蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Benjamin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本杰明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's just like her father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她就像她父亲一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't fault her for it though. She's just a little girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我也不能因此责怪她，她只是个小女孩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's got his head on straight. Only concerns himself with the practical. Gotta respect that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他头脑很清醒，他只关心实际问题。必须尊重这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, thanks. Nothing gets a guy going like racism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，谢谢。没有什么比种族歧视更让人抓狂的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Black Widow] You know, you're pretty cute for a ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: [黑寡妇]作为食尸鬼，你还挺可爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I appreciate the flirtation, it's very stimulating, but you'd be disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我很欣赏你的调情，很刺激，但你会失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not as virile as I used to be. Mentally and physically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不像以前那么阳刚了，精神上和肉体上都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the fluids? Well, it's uh, like a... biohazard. I imagine. It wouldn't be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 液体呢？嗯，这就像...生物危害，我想也是，不安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, don't be like that. You know how I meant it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，别这样。你知道我是什么意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I appreciate the flirtation, it's very stimulating, but you'd be disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我很欣赏你的调情，很刺激，但你会失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not as virile as I used to be. Mentally and physically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不像以前那么阳刚了，精神上和肉体上都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the fluids? Well, it's uh, like a... biohazard. I imagine. It wouldn't be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 液体呢？嗯，这就像...生物危害，我想也是，不安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I didn't mean it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我不是那个意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, you're a freak...
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你真是个怪胎...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll clear my schedule. Tell the T.A. to cancel my lunch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会取消我的日程安排，让助教取消我的午餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Rad Child] Hey, it's not a good time if the Geiger counter isn't rattling.
ESP.TRADUIT: [核子少年]嘿，如果盖革计数器不响，那可不是个好时机。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And hey, if you ever go ghoul, come and find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有，嘿，如果你变成食尸鬼了，来找我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We could have a tea, and I'll tell you about the Old World books I used to love reading.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以喝杯茶，我给你讲讲我以前喜欢读的旧世界的书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ripley [0600E4F3] (mod) Quest : ([0600E4F4]AZHavenRipleyDialogue) 0600E4F4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we go back to that previous thing you said?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能回到你之前说的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's very rare for Caesar to grant his Mark to anyone, much less a Profligate. For you to be a woman as well? You must be something truly special.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒很少把他的徽记给任何人，更不用说一个浪荡子了。为了你这个女人吗？你一定很特别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But perhaps you're not much of a woman at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也许你根本就不是个女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're humbled? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你自卑了？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That your soul is not that of a woman. Or, rather, your soul is closer to Mars than it is to your mother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的灵魂不是女人的灵魂。或者，更确切地说，你的灵魂更接近玛尔斯，而不是你的母亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Appear to be? What are you implying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来是？你在暗示什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Femininity is trifling. Passive, irrational. We are carried by our whims to places men dare not go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女性气质是微不足道的，消极，不理智。我们被自己的奇思妙想带到男人不敢去的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you are not like most men, either, because men were made to serve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你也不像大多数男人，因为男人是为服务而生的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你与众不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You serve Mars, yes, but you do so of your own accord and with your own agency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你为玛尔斯服务，但这是你自己的意愿，也是你自己的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you act, you do so with power not even the Praetorians possess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你行动时，你拥有连禁卫军都没有的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That tells me you are special.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这说明你很特别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not following.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Daughter of Mars...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯的女儿...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Chuckles.* Hmm. Maybe you are!
ESP.TRADUIT: *轻笑*嗯，也许你是！ !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I'm not a normal woman. I'm the Daughter of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我不是一个正常的女人，我是玛尔斯的女儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Modesty? Hmm, modesty. As is our place, perhaps. You really are perfect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谦虚？嗯，谦虚。也许我们的地方也是如此。你真的很完美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing special about me. I'm just a normal woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没什么特别的，我只是个普通的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but that's where you're wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，那你就错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion has had great men. Lanius, the Legate before him. You would only have been another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团中不乏伟人。拉尼厄斯，在他之前的特使。你只是另一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is special about you is that you are not a man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的特别之处在于你不是一个男人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am special, but my gender has nothing to do with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很特别，但这与我的性别无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are truly inspiring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真会鼓舞人心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing special about me is my dedication to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的特别之处在于我对军团的奉献。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Mojave Orientum branch of the Cult of Mars. From here, we manage all the Dissolute settlements of the region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是玛尔斯教团的莫哈维东方分部。从这里开始，我们管理着这片区域的所有浪荡子的定居点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you like to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说玛尔斯教团吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars is the one who created this world long ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯在很久以前创造了这个世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When degeneracy began to spread across the land, Mars chose to start anew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当堕落开始在这片土地上蔓延时，玛尔斯选择重新开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He bathed the world in fire and sent His son, Caesar, to create a new world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他让世界沐浴在烈火之中，并派他的儿子凯撒去创造一个新世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the veil of a Priestess. My face is not for you to see, nor anyone. It belongs only to Mars, to Caesar, and myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是女祭司的面纱。我的脸不能让你看到，也不能让任何人看到。它只属于玛尔斯，凯撒和我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should a Legionary come and speak to me, he will not be speaking to a mere woman. He will be speaking to the Cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果一个军团士兵来跟我说话，他不会只是跟一个女人说话。他是对信仰说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with that mask you're wearing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你戴的面具是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: God is a superstition for Profligates and savages. Caesar is the son of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 神是放荡者和野蛮人的迷信，凯撒是玛尔斯的儿子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is he a god?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是神吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He commands the biggest army this world has ever seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他指挥着世界上最庞大的军队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He speaks things into being. He snaps his fingers and things are made so. He shapes the world in his own divine image.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他用语言创造万物，他弹指一挥间，万物皆成。他以自己的神圣形象塑造世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he is not god, then no man has ever been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他不是神，那么从来就没有人是神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Caesar a god?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒是神吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are those who live lives of debasement, of treachery and self-interest. They lie, cheat, steal. This is degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人过着低俗、背叛和自私自利的生活。他们撒谎、欺骗、偷窃。这就堕落
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Profligate families exist in isolate, with no common cause, no allegiance. A Profligate nation is only a collection of individuals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落的家庭是孤立存在的，没有共同的事业，没有忠诚。 堕落的国家只是个人的集合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even in the NCR, men are made to fend for themselves. Merchants are allowed to scheme and manipulate, to the detriment of all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使在NCR，人们也不得不自谋生路。商人被允许策划和操纵，损害所有人的利益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Women are forced to the frontlines of war. They're told that they are equal to men, and this false belief drives them to ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妇女被迫奔赴战争前线。她们被告知她们和男人是平等的，而这种错误的信念使她们走向毁灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars finds this all abhorrent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯认为这一切都令人憎恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does the Legion consider to be degenerate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团认为什么是堕落？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We uphold the Legion's principles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们坚持军团的原则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Head Priestess Pompeia communes with Caesar often and interprets his word. These are made into doctrine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首席女祭司庞培娅经常与凯撒交流，解读他的话。这些都被编入了教义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strength, loyalty, justice. We instill these virtues in every child. We show them the path to righteousness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 力量，忠诚，正义。我们把这些美德灌输给每个孩子，我们为他们指明正义之路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maidens do the work of rearing and raising children. As a priestess, I perform spiritual duties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女侍做的是抚养孩子的工作。作为一名女祭司，我履行着精神上的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the duties of the Cult of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I instruct the men and the maidens in religion. I teach them Mars' ways, what He desires, how to please Him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我教导男男女女信仰宗教。我教他们玛尔斯的方式，他的愿望，如何取悦他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I perform prayers when needed. I oversee and sometimes lead our customary sacrifices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在需要的时候进行祈祷。我负责监督，有时还会领导我们的例行祭祀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I also show my fealty to Mars in more private ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也会用更私密的方式来表达我对玛尔斯的忠诚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your spiritual duties?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你精神上的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We sacrifice bulls to honor Mars. When we cut the animal's throat, we show Him that we are thirsty for blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们用牛祭祀玛尔斯。当我们割开动物的喉咙时，我们向它表明了我们对鲜血的渴望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If He is satisfied with our offering, He will grant us glorious battles with many dead Profligates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他对我们的奉献感到满意，他会让我们与许多死去的放荡者进行光荣的战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about these sacrifices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我讲讲这些祭祀吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Penance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忏悔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you show your fealty to Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如何向玛尔斯表达你的忠诚？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Perhaps.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]也许吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think fire is the closest we can get to Mars. He cleansed the Earth in fire, and so for us to wield fire, it's like we're wielding a part of Him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为火是我们能到达的最接近玛尔斯的地方。他用火净化了大地，所以我们使用火，就好像在使用他的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the Legion, I was a chem fiend. Only seventeen years old and already an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加入军团之前，我是个恶魔帮。才17岁，就已经是个瘾君子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars saved me. When I feel lost or confused, I use fire to remind myself of my devotion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯救了我。当我感到迷失或困惑时，我用火来提醒自己我的奉献。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel that you need penance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得你需要忏悔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Do not pry.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不要打探。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, can you elaborate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，你能详细说明一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two Profligates vie for the Legion's favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个放荡者在争夺军团的青睐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The people here are concerned only with money. I find it sickening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的人只关心钱，我觉得这很恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on with this election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次选举是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I favor neither. A Profligate cannot, and should not, govern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都不支持。一个堕落者不能也不应该执政。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From where would his power come? Not from Mars. Not from Caesar. A savage intends to rule over the righteous? Don't make me laugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的力量从何而来？不是来自玛尔斯，也不是来自凯撒。一个野蛮人想统治正义的人？别逗我笑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pray that Lanius arrives before this town descends into degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我祈祷拉尼厄斯能在小镇堕落前到达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which candidate do you favor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你支持哪位候选人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Proconsul Aristophontes? He is a strange man. I'm not convinced of his devotion to Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯总督？他是个奇怪的人。我不相信他对玛尔斯的忠诚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Proconsul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我关于总督的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have never seen him pray. I have never seen him fight. I have never seen even an ounce of zeal in him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从未见过他祈祷，我从没见过他打架。我从未在他身上看到一丝热情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems perfectly content smiling and shaking the hands of the merchants who stalk this place. He serves them before he serves the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他似乎非常满足地微笑着，与在这里徘徊的商人握手。他先为他们服务，再为军团服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have heard tales of him carrying out mass sacrifices of his own slaves in preparation for large battles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过他在准备大型战役时大规模牺牲自己奴隶的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His capacity for destruction and slaughter is truly breathtaking. Mars surely smiles upon him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的毁灭和屠杀能力确实令人惊叹，玛尔斯一定会对他微笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe he is with Head Priestess Pompeia in Flagstaff now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他现在和首席女祭司庞培娅一起在旗杆市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对拉尼厄斯特使有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have courage, to speak that name to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有勇气，对我说出那个名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some said that the Burned Man was a medicine man for a Profligate religion, before he came to the Legion. Perhaps he was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说，在他加入军团之前，火烧人是一个为堕落宗教服务的巫医。也许是吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man I knew seemed to worship not Mars, nor some Profligate god, but himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识的火烧人似乎不崇拜玛尔斯，也不崇拜什么堕落的神，只崇拜他自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe that is why he failed the Legion. His supreme arrogance blinded him to Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信这就是他让军团失望的原因，他极度的傲慢使他看不到玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对火烧人有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, a friend of the Legion. One of our assets didn't perform his duties, and so we had to punish his family for his failures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，军团的朋友。我们的一个线人没有履行他的职责，所以我们不得不为他的失败而惩罚他的家人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An absolute waste of Frumentarii resources.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这绝对是对特务资源的浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR recently opened up their checkpoint for refugee passage. The boss saw an opportunity to thin out NCR security ahead of the march on Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR最近开放了他们的检查站让难民通过，老大看到了在维加斯战役前削弱NCR安保的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We dispatched one of the former rats in this hole and loaded him up with explosives to be redeem himself by killing a number of NCR troops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们派了一个以前的告密者到这个洞里，给他装上炸药，让他通过杀死一些NCR部队来赎罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, the bomb failed to detonate. The Frumentarii didn't have any direct handlers on the ground, so we aren't sure what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，炸弹没有引爆。特务在明面上没有任何直接操纵者，所以我们不确定发生了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did your asset not do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的线人有什么没做到？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Are you aware how difficult it was to cobble together a plan from nothing in a matter of days? Why did you intefere?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你知不知道在几天内从无到有拼凑出一个计划有多难？你为什么要插手？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, uh, that was me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，呃，是我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Un-Legion-like?" Let me tell you you what is "un-Legion-like". It's losing to the forces of degeneracy and profligacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: “不像军团”？让我来告诉你什么是“不像军团”，它正在堕落和放荡的力量面前节节败退。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion must use every available tool to weaken, sabotage and delay our enemies in preparation for the march on Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团必须利用一切可能的手段来削弱、破坏和拖延我们的敌人，为向维加斯进军做准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that means using the forbidden technologies, then so be it. If that mean using proxies, then so be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这意味着要使用被禁止的技术，那就用。如果这意味着要使用代理人，那就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of this is done in the name of Caesar, do you understand? Perhaps we Frumentarii should being more clear on this point to each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都是以凯撒的名义进行的，你明白吗？在这一点上，也许我们应该更清楚地认识彼此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, leave me. I have much work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，离我远点。我有很多工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because it was un-Legion-like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为这不像军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Frumentarius asset threatening another Frumentarii? I.... On behalf of myself and Cato, I would like to apologize for our failure to properly control our asset.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个特务的线人威胁另一个特务？我...我谨代表我自己和加图，为我们没能妥善控制自己的线人道歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should have you check in more with the Frumentarii to avoid situations like this in the future. Anyways, I bid you vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该让你多和特务联系，以避免以后出现这种情况。不管怎样，我祝你顺利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He threatened to kill me as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还威胁要把我也杀了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had I known that it was you making such a deal, I would have spared his family. Sorry about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早知道是你在做这样的交易，我就会放过他的家人。不好意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In future, speak with one of us before you decide to do something like that. Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以后，在你决定做这样的事情之前，和我们中的一个人谈谈。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I told him that I would relieve him of his duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我告诉他我会解除他的职责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of, course. He would have been redeemed. Mars honors sacrifice in the name of family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了，他会得到救赎的。玛尔斯尊重以家庭之名做出的牺牲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the first step towards subsuming yourself to the Legion, the ultimate family. Alas, he was a coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你融入军团这个终极家族的第一步。唉，他是个懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where you actually going to spare his family?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的打算放过他的家人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！我有个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... Yes, of course, he did. I have the file here somewhere.... It's not really important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...有的，当然有，他说过。我把文件放在这里的某个...这并不是很重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did he have a name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有名字吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. He redeemed himself in the name of Caesar by sacrificing himself for his family. There are few things are virtuous as that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了。他以凯撒的名义为家庭牺牲了自己，救赎了自己。很少有比这更高尚的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Frumentarius Agent [0600E797] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think that he was more than a tool?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他不只是个工具？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are grieving the loss of their father and my husband. We haven't seen him in several days. The Legion told us that he completed his mission, whatever that means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们为他们的父亲和我丈夫的逝去而悲痛，我们好几天没见到他了。军团告诉我们，他完成了任务，不知道这意味着什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A brave soul who made impossible choices when the Legion came to Solitare. When the frumentarii came, they took him and tortured him for days on end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个勇敢的灵魂，在军团来到索利泰尔时做出了不可能的选择。特务来的时候抓住了他，连续折磨了他好几天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They did unspeakable things to him.Not long ago, they let him visit us, and he told us that we would never see him again, and that it was okay because we would we safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们对他做了难以形容的事。不久前，他们让他来看我们，他告诉我们，我们再也见不到他了，这很好，因为我们会安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His handler told us that he was going to attack the NCR checkpoint at Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的联络人告诉我们他要袭击胡佛水坝的NCR检查站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was your husband?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你丈夫是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were there? Then, it's true! We will never see him again. And an explosion? We won't even see the body....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当时也在？那么，这是真的！我们再也见不到他了。还有爆炸？我们连尸体都见不到了...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could have stopped it. You could have saved him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你本可以阻止的，你本可以救他！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your husband is deceased. He died in an explosion at the checkpoint. I was there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你丈夫去世了，他死于检查站的爆炸。我当时在场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't know that! And neither could he! Get out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么可能知道！他也不能！出去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was his choice. He was convinced that if he didn't, you would be dead instead of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他的选择。他坚信如果他不这么做，死的就会是你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you should have tried harder! Get out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你应该更努力！出去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to stop him but failed. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试图阻止他，但失败了。我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I.... Yes, of course. In service....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...是的，当然。服务...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In service....
ESP.TRADUIT: 服务...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Of course. I'm glad that the Legion thinks of him as important. He was. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，当然。我很高兴军团能重视他，他确实很光荣。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He died in glorious service to the Legion. True to Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他光荣的为军团服务而死。忠于凯撒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if you're lying, but I sense you aren't.... Please leave. I just.... I want to be alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你是不是在撒谎，但我感觉你不是...请离开吧。我只是...我只是想一个人待着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it makes you feel any better, he was at peace in his last moments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这能让你感觉好点的话，他在生命的最后时刻很平静。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How dare you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你竟敢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Donna [0600E78B] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your husband was pathetic, and so are you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你丈夫很可悲，你也是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm... amazed that that he lasted even this long. What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...我很惊讶他居然能坚持这么久。发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to have closure. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个了结很好。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wore explosives and detonated at an NCR checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他身上带着炸药，在NCR检查站引爆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asshole. I hope you never have to go through this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 混蛋，我希望你永远不会经历这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a bunch of little bits. Blew up himself at the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他散是满天星了，在大坝上引爆了自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, he's alive? Do you know where he is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说，他还活着？你知道他在哪儿吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to have closure. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个了结很好。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> He was rescued by the NCR. But that means he won't be coming back.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎]他被NCR救了，但这意味着他不会再回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You asshole!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sarah [0600E78C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I was just kidding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我开玩笑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't got to tell shit to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没必要跟你废话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you heading?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要去哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah? Or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？不然呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better walk your ass back, there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好给我滚回去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? Then, you should do your job, and let us through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？那你就做好本职工作，让我们过去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just doing my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在做我的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if I did, which I didn't, I wouldn't tell you. Assholes think that you can gun down other people, and it's fine just because you changed your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我没有，但就算我知道我也不会告诉你。混蛋们认为你可以枪杀别人，因为你改变了主意就没事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen anything suspicious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有看到什么可疑的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't scared of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不怕你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or the ceasefire will end violently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则停火将会以暴力告终。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，见鬼！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010198] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [ATTACK] I'm tired of this crap. You're about to get an education in "Or this".
ESP.TRADUIT: [攻击]我受够了这些废话。你马上就要接受"不然呢"的教育了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, a drifter! Not many of those around these days. With the war heating up, almost everyone moves with a purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，一个流浪者！这年头这样的人不多了。随着战争的升温，几乎每个人的行动都是有目的的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Myself, drifting is my purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，流浪就是我的目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just passing through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是路过而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I hope you accept denarii!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧我希望你能接受第纳尔！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just pulling your leg. This is the frontlines so a lot of folk still trade in caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我逗你玩呢。 这里是前线，所以很多人还在用瓶盖交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fascinating, isn't it? As long as you don't run afoul of them, things are quite orderly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有意思，不是吗？只要你不与他们发生冲突，一切还是很有秩序的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured I'd see what the Legion was like for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想亲自看看军团是什么样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有意思...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you been hitting the chems?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一直在嗑药吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, don't answer that. Actually, let's move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，别回答这个。算了，我们继续吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell anyone, but I'm here undercover. I have a mission in Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别告诉任何人，我是卧底。我在军团领地有个任务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am! Been with Radio New Vegas for nearly 8 years now. Before that I was employed back at the Hub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是！我在新维加斯电台工作快8年了。在那之前我在中枢市工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came out here to follow the NCR's Mojave campaign, but when I got here, what truly fascinated me was the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里是为了关注NCR的莫哈维战役，但当我到了这里，真正让我着迷的是军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe half a year ago, I worked up the nerve to cross the river with a trade caravan. I plead my case to a Frumentarius and I've been reporting here ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概半年前，我鼓起勇气跟一个贸易商队过了河。我向一个特务求情，从那时起我就一直在这里报道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a reporter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是记者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be surprised to hear, but they don't! Not usually, anyway. I'm the exception.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会感到惊讶，但它们并不允许！至少通常不允许，我是个例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In some ways it's actually beneficial for them to have me around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某种程度上，我在他们身边是有益的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think of the Legion M.O. -- crucifixions, huge fires with stacks of smoke. All of it demands attention. All of it is meant to terrify.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想军团的惯用手法，钉十字架，浓烟滚滚的大火。这些都是为了获取关注，所有这些都是为了恐吓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spread the word for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我帮他们传播消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does the Legion allow reporters to run around their teritory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么军团允许记者在他们的地盘上跑来跑去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the truth is propaganda, my friend, then I'm its most committed crusader. It'd do nobody any good to ignore what's happening here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果真相是一种宣传，我的朋友，那么我就是它最坚定的斗士。忽视这里发生的一切对任何人都没有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're a Legion propagandist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你是军团的宣传员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is not how I'd characterize my job. I spread the news. If the news terrifies, then maybe it should. Maybe the truth is terrifying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我对自己的工作的描述。我传播了这个消息，如果这个消息让人感到恐惧，那么也许它就应该是这样。真相或许就是可怕的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spreading terror under the guise of honest reporting. I respect it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以诚实报道为幌子散播恐怖。我对此表示尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Let me know if you uncover any leads on this so-called positive news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！如果你发现了任何关于这个所谓的积极事情的线索，请告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you try reporting something positive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不尝试报道一些积极的事情呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my business how you do your job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你工作的方式与我无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are a few. Truth is: it's dangerous work, and thankless too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个。事实是：这是一份危险的工作，而且吃力不讨好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You spend all your time racing to be on the scene of the next big story, but by the time you get there, the story's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把所有的时间都花在赶赴下一个大新闻的现场上，但当你到达的时候，故事已经结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd have to be crazy or stupid to want this life. I'll let you decide which I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有疯子或者傻子才会想要这样的生活，我会让你来决定我是哪个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there a lot of reporters in the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫哈维有很多记者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Informants and bots, mostly. A journalist is nothing without his informants, and the bots go around collecting data. When we arrive on the scene, the story is nearly already written.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要靠线人和机器人。没有线人，记者什么都不是，而机器人则到处收集数据。当我们到达现场时，故事几乎已经写好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you need the human element to really get good quotes. Folks don't like talking to eyebots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你仍然需要人为因素来获得真正好的引述。人们不喜欢和眼球机器人说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and we use two-way radios for just about everything. Hard to overstate how useful those things are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，我们几乎什么都用双向对讲机。这些东西的用处怎么说都不为过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do Radio New Vegas reporters operate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 新维加斯电台的记者是怎么工作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he's a computer, for one. Surprised? Yup, it's true! He's all wires and cables.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，他是一台电脑。惊讶吧？嗯，是真的！他浑身都是电线和电缆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice guy, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过是个不错的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In our archive, there are a couple holodisks of his Pre-War radio shows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们的档案里，有几张他战前广播节目的全息影碟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating to hear him interview an old fart like Dean Domino, knowing that Dean was probably killed when the bombs started flying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听他采访迪安·多米诺这样的老混蛋真有意思，他知道迪安很可能在轰炸开始时就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Mr. New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说新维加斯先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well. Hm. They're a highly militarized society organized around some core ideals that may seem strange to you or me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。嗯，他们是一个高度军事化的社会，围绕着一些对你我来说可能很奇怪的核心理念。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every individual seems to regard himself as a tool. They are for Caesar to wield in his construction of a new world. To this end, they don't care if they're injured, or even if they die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人似乎都把自己当作工具，他们是凯撒用来建设新世界的。为此，他们不在乎自己是否受伤，甚至是死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't really have citizens, either. Not like the NCR. If you're not a soldier or a slave, you're a subject, and the Legion can order you around as they see fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们也没有真正的公民，不像NCR。如果你不是士兵或奴隶，你就是臣民，军团可以随意命令你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么了解？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a sense, yes. In that same sense, so are you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某种意义上，是。从同样的意义上说，你也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been given grace. All subjects have grace so long as they mind themselves. By the way you carry yourself, I take it you have a little more grace than most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们被赐予了恩典。只要管好自己，所有臣民都可以得到恩典。从你的举止来看，我认为你比大多数人得到的恩典都多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you, or I, screw up too badly, that grace will be revoked. And then we'll be dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你，或者我，搞砸了，这种恩典就会被撤销。然后我们就会死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So don't screw up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以别搞砸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a subject?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是臣民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, no. There is some censorship and, ah, body searches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，不。有一些审查制度，还有搜身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mind. Rather, I do mind, but I understand the necessity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不介意。更确切地说，我介意，但我理解这种必要性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion allow you to print whatever you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团允许你想印什么就印什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's a war going on between the Legion and some army called the NCR. I don't know if you've heard of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，军团和NCR之间正在进行一场战争。我不知道你是否听说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I jest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开玩笑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here in Legion territory, the biggest moves are being made along the river. Bullhead, Camp Willow, the Dam Spillway. All taken within the last year or so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团的地盘上，最大规模的行动正在沿河进行。布尔海德、柳树营地、水坝泄洪道。都是最近一年左右拍的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway collapsed. It's that big overpass just west of here. That's greatly hampered transport.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道坍塌了，就是这里西边的那个大立交桥。这极大地阻碍了运输。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitare, east of here, had some trouble with spies, but the Legion dealt with that as they usually do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里东面的索利泰尔遇到了一些间谍问题，但军团还是像往常一样处理了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's been going on in the world lately?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近世界上发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Great Chainway, Route 93, is one of the most important trade routes in Arizona. It, I-40, and I-17, make up the Great Triangle: a big circuit connecting Phoenix, Flagstaff, and Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 93号公路的大连环道是亚利桑那州最重要的贸易路线之一。它，40号洲际公路和17号洲际公路构成了大三角：一条连接凤凰城、旗杆市和金曼的大环线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the industrial capital, the actual capital, and the biggest logistics hub in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是工业中心，实际的首都，也是莫哈维最大的物流中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway only broke apart a couple months ago. Amazingly, it hasn't slowed the Legion down much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道几个月前才散架。令人惊讶的是，这并没有减慢军团的速度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说连环道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truthfully, I can't tell you a whole lot. Yes, I'm a reporter, but I'm not a stupid reporter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我不能告诉你太多。是的，我是记者，但我不是一个愚蠢的记者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the Legion delivers punishment, it's final. Nosing around would only get me killed too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团做出惩罚时，那就是最后的结果。到处打听只会害死我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can tell you that the spies were NCR Rangers. Solitare has been under Legion control for a year now, so it seems unlikely to me that they were hiding out undercover all that time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以告诉你，间谍是NCR游骑兵。索利泰尔已经被军团控制了一年了，所以在我看来，他们不太可能一直在卧底。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were executions, tortures, and more executions. The Legion isn't usually cruel to its subjects the way it is to profligates, but those people were made to suffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有处决，酷刑，还有更多的处决。军团对待自己的臣民并不像对待放荡者那样残酷，但那些人是被迫受苦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about what happened at Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说在索利泰尔发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Buh-bye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜拜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EABA]AZStanleyHartfordDialogueQuest) 0600EABA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rotting away while the NCR watches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在NCR的注视下慢慢腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, yes. It fucking seems that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，是的。他妈的好像是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you live here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你住在这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god, with the questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天，还有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the Legion wants to enslave me, and torture and kill my dad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为军团想要奴役我，折磨并杀死了我父亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All because some Ranger assholes got uppity and decided to start killing people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是因为一些游骑兵的混蛋狂妄自大，决定开始杀人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you live here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么住在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the NCR will shoot us if we try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为如果我们这么做，NCR会开枪的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a load of crap! I always heard they were the good guys, that they were better than the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 简直是一派胡言！我总是听说他们是好人，他们比军团更优秀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the only time I've ever seen them, they're turning my home into a warzone and fucking shooting at us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我唯一一次见到他们，他们就把我的家变成了战区，还他妈朝我们开枪！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you cross the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不穿过大坝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: God, whatever, I don't care. Talk to Omar if you care so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪，管它呢，我不在乎。既然你这么在乎，就去找奥马尔谈谈吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna die here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会死在这里的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I could try talking to the NCR and seeing if they'd let you cross the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我可以试着和NCR谈谈，看看他们能不能让你穿过大坝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's...
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you care? You're not going to save her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么关心这个？你救不了她的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is your mom?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你妈妈在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. No you can't. You couldn't even if you wanted to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，你不能。就算你想，你也做不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's at Big Stop. Probably a slave by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在大站，现在可能已经是奴隶了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I *could* save her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我*可以*救她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop it. Killing people isn't going to fix things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说了，杀人并不能解决问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I don't want to talk about it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不想再谈这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've killed slavers before. I can free her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前杀过奴隶贩子，我可以解救她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, thanks. Your bravery is truly moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦，谢谢。你的勇气真让人感动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't want to tangle with the Legion. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我可不想和军团发生冲突。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know if the Gun Runners would be willing to negotiate the sale of guns to a third party?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道军火贩子会不会愿意把枪卖给第三方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, what they need them for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，他们要那些干什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know if the Gun Runners would be willing to negotiate the sale of guns to a third party?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道军火贩子会不会愿意把枪卖给第三方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the NCR fucking hates you, and they're our biggest client? Stupid question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为NCR他妈的讨厌你，而他们是我们最大的客户懂吗？蠢问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fat fucking chance I'm gonna hear you out. Ranger chatter tells me that your name isn't persona non grata at The Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈不可能听你说完。游骑兵告诉我你的名字在堡垒里不受欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's for fighting the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是用来对抗军团的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea wha the fuck your deal is. Still, NCR hates the Legion, so I'll sure they'll approve this sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全不知道你他妈的是怎么回事。不过，NCR讨厌军团，所以我肯定他们会批准这笔交易的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you need them delivered?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要送到哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's for fighting the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是用来对抗军团的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, say no more. Where do you want the shipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不用多说了。你想把货送到哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fighting the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对抗军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My brother fucking died at Dry Wells when the Legion took it. Fuck those assholes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我哥哥在干井被军团占领时死了。去他妈的那些混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, where do you want the shipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你想把货送到哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That easy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么简单？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your contacts, they have money?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的联络人，他们有钱？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Echo Bay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回声湾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，很高兴和你做生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They have money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gun Runners technical support for Camp McCarran. We're required to send at least one to the really big contractors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军火贩子派驻麦卡伦营地的技术支持人员。按规定，我们必须给那些真正的大客户至少派驻一名。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your job here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a good posting. Cheap and easy access to The Strip through that monorail, good pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个很好的岗位。通过那条单轨铁路可以很便宜很方便地到达长街，薪水也不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The walls keep us nice and safe from the Fiends outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 城墙保护我们免受外面恶魔帮的伤害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me anything about Camp McCarran?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说麦卡伦营地吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It used to be a lot better posting before that monorail blew up. Hope they fire whoever let that happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那辆单轨列车爆炸之前，这个岗位的工作要好得多。希望他们炒了那个让这种事发生的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me anything about Camp McCarran?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说麦卡伦营地吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Colonel Hsu. He's inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许上校，他在里面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge of Camp McCarran?
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦卡伦营地的负责人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Contreras. He's the quartermaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孔特雷拉斯，他是军需官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolute pain in the ass to get shit from, even though somehow, he's got everything good. Makes you wonder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从他手里拿东西绝对是件痛苦的事，尽管不知怎么的，他什么都有。这让你很好奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone at Camp McCarran that I should avoid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦卡伦营地有我应该避开的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: First Recon. They're the guys in the red berets. Came down here to shoot Fiends with lead instead of chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一侦察营。他们就是戴红色贝雷帽的人，来这里是为了用子弹而不是毒品来射杀恶魔帮的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone else important here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他重要人物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since First Recon left for Forlorn Hope, just me to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从第一侦察营离开这里去了一线生机营地，老实说，只有我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone else important here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他重要人物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucking burnouts from The Strip. Back in the NCR, they'd just be junkies. But out here? They're junkies with guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从长街来的这帮该死的废物。在NCR，他们顶多就是些毒虫，可到了这儿呢？他们就成了带枪的毒虫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing that sorts them out is 5.56 and frag grenades, which conveniently, I am here to keep in stock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一能把它们分类的是5.56子弹和破片手榴弹，很方便，我这里有库存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shame we can't do that shit back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 遗憾的是我们不能在家里做这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the Fiends?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我一些关于恶魔帮的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We only have the finest industrial arsenal in the whole Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只有这片废土上最好的工业兵工厂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have anything for you to buy, but we've set up a shop to the north of here. We've got a robot that handles all the transactions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有东西给你买，但我们在北边开了一家店。我们有一个机器人来处理所有的生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Gun Runners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说军火贩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm? 25% increase in....
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I thought he was buying from our competitors to keep all that shit in stock. Yeah, I don't care if we're the ones he's buying from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我还以为他从我们的竞争对手那里买东西来囤货呢。是啊，我不在乎他是不是从我们这里买的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Contreras gave me this sheet to take to Isaac. Mean anything to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孔特雷拉斯让我把这张单子交给艾萨克。对你有什么意义吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, maybe. It doesn't really matter, though. Field testing done by our enemies is just as good for us as field testing done by our friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，也许吧。不过，这并不重要。敌人的实地测试和朋友的实地测试一样，对我们都有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think he's arms dealing on the side?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他在私下做军火交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I know Isaac. If shit's fucked, he'll let me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我认识艾萨克。如果事情搞砸了，他会告诉我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want me to loop you in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我同步给你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about McCarran.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦卡伦说得够多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Helena Devic, pleased to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 海伦娜·德维奇，很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Helena Devic. It is not a pleasure to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 海伦娜·德维奇，见到你不是我的荣幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's classified if you are who we think you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是我们认为的那种人，那是机密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm responsible for all Ranger operations in and around Camp McCarran and practically all of the Vegas sector.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责麦卡伦营地周围的所有游骑兵行动以及维加斯区域的所有行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes beyond if brass thinks I'm slacking. Which I never am, but that doesn't seem to stop them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果上头觉得我在偷懒，有时候就得干得更多。我可从来没偷过懒，但这似乎也阻止不了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean *all* Ranger operations, yeah. See, I have to coordinate all 'non-essential' Ranger taks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说*所有*游骑兵行动，是的。听着，我必须协调所有“非必要的”游游骑兵行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What counts as non-essential includes anti-Fiend operations, reconnaissance of South Vegas, watching the Strip, anti-smuggling operations, the works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非必要行动包括反恶魔帮行动、南维加斯侦察、监视拉斯维加斯大道、反走私行动等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, I also have to crunch numbers. All the equipment requests coming from Camp Golf come to me, and then I make decisions whether those resources go to Army or Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，我还得处理数字。所有来自高尔夫营地的装备要求都交给我，然后我决定这些资源是交给陆军还是游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you say 'all Ranger operations?'
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说“所有的游骑兵行动”？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, there is no one in charge of intelligence here. Any new Ranger gets sent to Camp Golf, the Dam or one of the outposts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这里没有负责情报的人。任何新来的游骑兵都会被派到高尔夫营地，水坝或某个前哨基地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I have nothing to work with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我没什么可做的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you also in charge of intelligence here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也负责这里的情报部门吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It does, doesn't it? I can't prove it, but I'm pretty sure it's because General Oliver hates us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实是这样，不是吗？我无法证明，但我很确定这是因为奥利弗将军讨厌我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officially, it's because all of our outposts are being overwhelmed by the Legion, but I know he considers McCarran his base, even if he's at the Dam right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照官方的说法，这是因为我们所有的前哨都被军团占领了，但我知道他认为麦卡伦是他的基地，即使他现在在大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't there many Rangers at McCarran? That seems like a big blind spot.
