ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么麦卡伦的游骑兵不多？这好像是个很大的盲点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is. It's probably what allowed that centurion to escape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。这可能就是那个百夫长逃跑的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't there many Rangers at McCarran? That seems like a big blind spot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么麦卡伦的游骑兵不多？这好像是个很大的盲点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is. It's probably what allowed someone to blow up the monorail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的。这可能就是有人炸毁单轨列车的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't there many Rangers at McCarran? That seems like a big blind spot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么麦卡伦的游骑兵不多？这好像是个很大的盲点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个都没有？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oliver demanded that any Ranger intel on Arizona specifically pass through McCarran before Golf.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥利弗要求任何关于亚利桑那的游骑兵情报都必须在到高尔夫营地之前通过麦卡伦营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That way, he would be the one to approve Ranger operations in Legion territory instead of Hanlon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，他就可以代替汉隆批准游骑兵在军团领地的行动了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, Oliver's gone and punted it back to Golf, and Golf doesn't want us moving out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，奥利弗已经把皮球踢回给了高尔夫营地那边，而高尔夫不想让我们往那个方向行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had to resort to sending new information to Sutter over at the Dam, who is an unpleasant man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不把新情报发送给大坝那边的萨特，他是个很讨人厌的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned work beyond McCarran?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了麦卡伦之外的工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm? Oh, yes. I've been there. Many times in fact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？哦，是的。我去过那里，事实上是很多次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That means you know about Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这说明你知道亚利桑那的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the NCR? Scouting missions in '73 all the way to '78. Before that, '66 to '67.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮NCR吗？从73年一直到78年都在执行侦察任务，在那之前是66年到67年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When were you in Arizona?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么时候在亚利桑那州的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's solid red. There are so many Legionaries there. It's like an ant hive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是纯红色的。那边的军团士兵可真多，就像一个蚁巢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The queen of the Legion is located on Fortification Hill, with a base camp that stretches all the way to Lake Mead. That's where Caesar holds court.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的女王位于要塞山上，她的大本营一直延伸到米德湖。那是凯撒的朝廷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a small tribal fishing village, Newt, but Legion's probably enslaved the lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里有个部落的小渔村，纽特，但军团可能已经奴役了那里的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And Big Stop. Caravan town, although not many caravans pass through these days, what with the Legion occupation and the Dam lockdown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有大站，商队城镇，虽然这些天没有多少商队经过，因为军团的占领和大坝封锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it like across the Colorado?
ESP.TRADUIT: 科罗拉多河对岸是什么样子的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to assume you're not some would-be traitor. But you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就假设你不是什么潜在的叛徒。但你不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion has everything locked down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团把一切都封锁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do I get across?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要怎么过去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Afraid not. We have no operatives on that side of the river in this sector.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕不，我们在河那边的这个区域没有特工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And our intelligence quality is directly proportional to the number of Rangers we have in a given are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的情报质量与我们在特定地区拥有的游骑兵数量成正比。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we have none over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而我们这边没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还知道别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean the highway across the river? No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说那条河对岸的高速公路吗？不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the very least, they hasn't been any chatter on official channels. I would have heard it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少，官方渠道上还没有传出任何消息。我会听到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out of curiosity, did the NCR blow up the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好奇问一下，是NCR炸毁了连环道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be Colonel Hsu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是许上校。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is technically supposed to be his office, but he took mercy on me and lets me work out of a room with a view.
ESP.TRADUIT: 严格来说，这应该是他的办公室，但他对我发了发慈悲，让我在一间能看到风景的房间里工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, this used to be the general's office, it's Hsu's by right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，这里曾经是将军的办公室，现在是许的办公室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge at McCarran?
ESP.TRADUIT: 麦卡伦的负责人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a saint. I actually feel like he listens to my concerns unlike Oliver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个圣人，我觉得他会倾听我的担忧，不像奥利弗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I tell him I can't spare any Rangers for Fiend patrol, he agrees to not divert them and instead calls in First Recon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我告诉他我没有多余的游骑兵去做恶魔帮巡逻时，他同意不让他们分流，而是叫来了第一侦察营。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I tell him that the Ranger outposts are meeting overwhelming resistance, he promises to look into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我告诉他游骑兵的前哨站遭遇了巨大的抵抗时，他承诺会调查此事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the man is under so much pressure. I can't help but respect him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且他承受着巨大的压力。我不得不尊敬他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think of Hsu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得许上校是什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got training from the Desert Rangers out east back in '69. Ended up helping them and the NCR communicate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 69年，我在东部的沙漠游骑兵受训。最终帮助他们和NCR沟通。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I got picked up by intelligence services and shuffled into the NCR Rangers instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我被情报部门录用了，被调到NCR游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you become a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish. No, I failed the final combat trial that they make you do out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望如此。不，我没有通过他们要求的最终战斗试炼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're downright lethal if you're not the best of the best, so it scared off a lot of folks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不是精英中的精英，那它们就极其致命，所以吓退了很多人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, even that incomplete training is a cut above the NCR-born Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，即使是不完整的训练也比NCR出身的游骑兵要好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a Desert Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个沙漠游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, first, there aren't any Desert Rangers anymore. They signed up with the NCR a decade ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，现在已经没有沙漠游骑兵了。他们十年前就和NCR签约了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, any Desert Rangers are just NCR Rangers these days. It's kind of sad, but it is what it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，现在所有的沙漠游骑兵都只是NCR游骑兵。这有点可悲，但事实就是如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Desert Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说沙漠游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's no shortage of work for contractors around here. You'll want Colonel Hsu, Major Dhatri or Lieutenant Boyd.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的承包商不缺活儿干。你需要许上校，达特里少校或博伊德中尉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Downstairs. If you're coming in through the front, it's the room just to the left of the front doors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 楼下。如果你从前门进来，就是前门左边的那个房间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fiend bounties, wetwork, honestly he has his finger on the pulse of this whole place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恶魔帮悬赏，脏活，老实说，他对这里了如指掌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's the colonel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 少校在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bounties on Fiends. He's out in the main yard, by north gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对恶魔帮的赏金。他在外面的大院子里，北门旁边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's Major Dhatri offering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 达特里少校提供什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's right next door, actually. Interrogating a prisoner right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，她就在隔壁。正在审问一名囚犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lieutenant Boyd. Where's she?
ESP.TRADUIT: 博伊德中尉。她在哪儿?

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the only one here you can't get work from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是这里唯一提供不了工作的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No authorization to license, farm out, receive assistance from or delegate, per official orders from General Oliver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据奥利弗将军的官方命令，不得授权许可，外包，接受援助或委托。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things might change if you can get the brass's attention, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，如果你能引起高层的注意，情况可能会有所改变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The work is intel. While Colonel Moore has you operating west of the Colorado, we need you to operate east of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工作是情报。摩尔上校让你在科罗拉多河以西行动，我们需要你在科罗拉多河以东行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR doesn't have much intel on this part of Arizona because we're spread thin basically everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR对亚利桑那州的这部分没有太多的情报，因为我们基本上分散在各处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The specifics are primarily photography work and just helping us update our knowledge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 具体细节主要是摄影工作，只是帮助我们更新我们的知识。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our understanding is that you have access to Arizona. Caesar granted you some sort of advanced travel visa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的理解是你可以进入亚利桑那，凯撒给了你某种高级旅行签证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if you've antagonized them, the gates are down, but brass isn't willing to get assets in there. Unless they have a proven track record in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算你惹毛了他们，大门也已经关了，但高层不肯派人进去。除非是那些已经在莫哈维证明过自己的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么是我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great. Let's begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。我们开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The job has two major components. The first is photography work. We need updated images of Big Stop, Malpais, The Fort, Elephant Hill and Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这项工作有两个主要组成部分。首先是摄影工作，我们需要大站、马尔帕斯、堡垒、象山和克洛赖德的最新图像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The second is intel itself. We need information on the whereabouts of Frumentarii leadership, he locaion of a couple of missing Rangers and whether or not Support Unit Hoover is still intact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其次是情报本身。我们需要军团特务头目的下落，几名失踪游骑兵的下落以及胡佛支援小队是否完好无损的情报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, then why did you come here? Well, that's fine. Job's still on the table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那你为什么会来这里？好吧，没关系。工作还在桌上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, go ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以，请讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about things first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep. Honestly, it's all about photographs now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。老实说，现在最重要的是照片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all the specific jobs you wanted me to do, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你要我做的所有具体工作，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About the job you're offering....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你提供的工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About the job you gave me...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你给我的工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the first one, we need pictures of Frumentarii agents operating on the other side of the river. We want a good idea of their organizational structure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一个，我们需要军团特务间谍在河对岸行动的照片。我们想要了解他们的组织结构。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the second, we sent a couple of Rangers into Big Stop a while ago, but they haven't reported back in a while. I want you to see what's what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二个，我们之前派了几个游骑兵去大站，但他们有段时间没回复了。我想让你搞明白是怎么回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the final one, the Desert Rangers left behind some stay-behind units of Rangers and volunteers to harass Legion supply lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一个，沙漠游骑兵留下了一些留守的游骑兵和志愿者，骚扰军团的补给线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have only one on record in this sector, but we haven't heard anything from them since the first battle at Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个区域只有一个记录在案的，但自从胡佛大坝的第一次战役之后就没有他们的消息了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll have to go into more details about that second part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于第二部分，你需要给我更多的细节。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? When?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？什么时候？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your Rangers are dead following a revolt, and Big Stop's been locked down in retaliation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的游骑兵在一场起义中被杀了，为了报复，大站也被封锁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean Sutter told you? He wouldn't lock me out of the loop on this, would he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 萨特告诉你了是什么意思？他不会把我排除在外吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's got to be some report here somewhere. I'll look for it later and give Hoover Dam a call.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里肯定有什么报告。我稍后再找，然后给胡佛大坝打电话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three weeks ago. Sutter told me while he was asking for bounties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三周前。萨特在索要赏金的时候告诉我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well, darn. You'd think they'd have seen it from the Dam if Rangers were raising hell. They wouldn't lock me out of the loop, would they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧，可恶。如果游骑兵闹事的话，他们应该能从大坝上看到。他们不会把我排除在外了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess here's your reward anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想这就是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three weeks ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三周前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have they been active at all? Any recent operations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还活跃吗？最近有什么行动吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found our support unit. They're hiding in a cave in the White Hills area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到我们的支援小队了，他们藏在白山附近的一个山洞里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll list them as defunct then. Thanks for hoofing it out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就把它们列为不存在了。谢谢你跑一趟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cannot find your support unit anywhere. Not in any of the big towns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到处都找不到你的支援小队，没有在任何一个大城镇里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll list them as defunct then. Thanks for hoofing it out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就把它们列为不存在了。谢谢你跑一趟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I cannot find your support unit anywhere. Not in any of the big towns.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我到处都找不到你的支援小队，没有在任何一个大城镇里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Incredible work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不可思议的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're planning to support a slave rebellion at Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们计划在马尔帕斯支持奴隶起义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we can, of course. Assuming there are no complications. Of course, there will be at least some complications, and I'll have to go through the proper channels and requisition...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，如果我们可以的话。假设没有更复杂的情况。当然，至少会有一些复杂的情况，我必须通过适当的渠道和申请...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，不用担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will the NCR support them?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会支持他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's disappointing news. Still, I guess we can close that file.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是令人失望的消息。不过，我想我们可以结束这份档案了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're all dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's good to know that they still exist, but I'm not really sure what we can do with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，很高兴知道他们还存在，但我不确定我们能做些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. They argued a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也不尽然。他们经常争论。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Take this camera and these film reels. Oh, and if you somehow run out, I have more on the wall over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！带上这台相机和这些胶卷。哦，如果你不知道怎么用完了，我那边的墙上还有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll get right on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我这就去办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I can't force you. I can just pay you. So do it for the good of the NCR or the good of your pocketbook. Take this camera and these film reels. Oh, and if you somehow run out, I have more on the wall over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我不能强迫你，我可以付钱给你。所以，为了NCR也好，为了你的钱袋也好，你就这么做吧。带上这台相机和这些胶卷，哦，如果你不知道怎么用完了，我那边的墙上还有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll see what happens in Arizona. This is a lot of legwork.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们看看亚利桑那会发生什么。这可是一大堆跑腿的活儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Of what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？什么照片？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have photographs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work on the photographs in Legion territory. Command is satisfied with this intel. Here's a bonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团领地的照片整理得不错，指挥部对这个情报很满意。这是额外的奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have photographs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, sure, if you have more, we'll take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然，如果你还有的话，我们就买。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have more photographs of Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有军团特务的照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good lord. So many bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝啊，这么多尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, at the very least, we know that we won't be getting help this time once we cross the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，至少我们知道这次过了大坝就不会有人来帮我们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop. The Legion suppressed a rebellion in town. A lot of bodies. Oh, and they call it Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站。军团镇压了镇上的起义，很多尸体。哦，他们叫它索利泰尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An election? This is bad news. If the Legion is confident enough to allow elections, it means the town's infested with collaborators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举？这是个坏消息。如果军团有足够的信心允许选举，那就意味着这个城镇有大量的合作者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have to send this to CIO, get some burn orders out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得把这个发给首席信息官，还得把销毁命令发出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chloride. It's pretty active. The merchants are even holding an election.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德，非常活跃。商人们甚至在举行选举。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it was always going to be a long shot getting a bunch of raiders to sign on with the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，让一群掠夺者与NCR签约总是不太可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elephant Hill. No more raiders these days. Not much of anything this days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 象山。这些天没有掠夺者了，最近也没什么事发生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, looking at this, the Legion presence has actually decreased since the last battle. A lot of logistics support must have been moved to the Legate's Camp or maybe even the Base Camp directly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，你看，上次战斗后，军团的兵力反而减少了。很多后勤支援肯定被转移到了特使营地，甚至直接转移到了大本营。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get this? This is practically all of high command. I recognize Lucius, for instance. All that's missing is Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么拿到这个的？这实际上是最高指挥部的事。比如说，我认得卢修斯，就差拉尼厄斯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Incredible work, great photos.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人难以置信的工作，很棒的照片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fort. Even have a picture of Caesar himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒。甚至还有一张凯撒本人的照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're a lot less active here than last time, but that's to be expected. Intel states that they've been spreading their presence out to avoid total losses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的活动比上次少了很多，但这是意料之中的。情报部门称他们已经分散行动以避免全部损失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done well with the Frumentarii intel. Out of curiosity, have you encountered a Frumentarius agent named Cato Hostilius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务的情报你做得很好。好奇问一句，你有没有遇到过一个叫加图·奥斯蒂吕斯的军团特务间谍？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you need more Frumentarii pictures?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要更多军团特务的照片吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have more intel on them? Well, sure, we'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有更多关于他们的情报吗？好吧，当然，我们要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop, right? This is Corvus, I think. We picked up some chatter about a rogue Frumentarius agent a while ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站，对吧？我想这是克渥斯。前段时间，我们听到了一些关于军团特务间谍叛变的消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least we have a face to the name, but this isn't that helpful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总算能把人和名字对上号了，不过这也没多大帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a surveillance picture of this guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有这家伙的监控照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unusual name for a Legionary, ah, I see. Makes sense the Legion would want to use their talents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个军团士兵叫这个可不太寻常，啊，我明白了。军团想要使用他们的天赋是有道理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahiga.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Him I recognize. Several operations to his name, including something called 'Racket'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识他。好几次以他的名字命名的行动，包括一次代号“敲竹杠”的行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Useful information indeed. I swear, they're crazier and crazier every day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这确实是有用的信息。我发誓，他们一天比一天疯狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Avreli. Hasn't done anything yet, but he's planning a mass terror attack on NCR soil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿夫列利。还没行动，但他计划在NCR的国土上发动大规模恐怖袭击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, that's not a name we recognize. This is pretty far from the frontlines, so he must be part of the Frumentarii's internal security unit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这个名字我们不认识。这里离前线很远，所以他一定是军团特务内部安全部门的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bellius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伯里乌斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Striking. He's out of the field, then. Has been for a long time, if our reports are accurate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是惊人。这么说，他已经出局了。如果我们的情报准确，已经有很长一段时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus. I found him prisoner amongst a slave refuge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯，我发现他被囚禁在一个奴隶收容所里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of Vulpes's personal agents. Ever since his death, they've been scattered all over the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔普斯的一名直属间谍。自从沃尔普斯死后，他们就流散到了各地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gabban. Found him out in Nipton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加本，在尼普顿发现了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say we recognize him, and if he's not a full Frumentarius, I can't give the full example.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能说我们认识他，如果他不完全是军团特务，我也不能给出完整的例子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it might be useful later, so I'll give you something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，也许以后会有用，所以我给你一些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iosep Aneth. Speculatore, not quite a Frumentarius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊奥赛普·阿尼瑟。密探，不完全是军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, sorry, but we already know about him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，抱歉，但我们已经知道他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't quite pay you for this, but I can spare some ammo. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付不了多少钱，但我可以给你一些弹药。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Karl. He's at Red Rock Canyon with the Great Khans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。他在红岩峡谷和大汗帮在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He looks familiar. Anti-alcohol operations near Dry Wells? Not a big player in the grand scheme of things. Well, maybe for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他看起来很眼熟。是在干井附近执行反酒精行动的？从大局来看，算不上什么大人物。嗯，也许目前是这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spirit Chaser.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逐灵者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bonafide leader of the Frumentarii in the flesh. We've suspected him of operating on The Strip for quite some time now, but there he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务的真正领袖。我们怀疑他在长街活动已经有一段时间了，但他确实出现了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He probably won't leave The Fort from now, which is a little unfortunate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从现在起他可能不会离开堡垒了，这有点不幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is great work regardless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之这活干得非常棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vulpes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔普斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No name though. Keep in the Legion's good graces for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有名字。暂时保持军团的好感吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd say good work, but I'm sure the loot they're offering will make up for this. The brass cannot pay someone in your position with this type of report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想说你做得很好，但我相信他们提供的战利品会弥补这一点。高层不能用这种报告付钱给你这种职位的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This guy. Legion is offering me access to some of their spare loot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个家伙。军团给了我一些备用战利品的使用权。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes, his name, his name is, uh....
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，对，他的名字，他的名字是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, it doesn't matter. He's involved in something right now that I can't do into details about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这并不重要。他现在卷入了一件我不能透露细节的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't quite pay you for this, but I can spare some ammo. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付不了多少钱，但我可以给你一些弹药。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This guy negotiated the deal with the Van Graffs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家伙跟范·格拉夫家族谈妥了交易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? This is good work. It's a shame we don't have a name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？干得好。很遗憾我们没有名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This guy at Big Stop. He organized the recent suicide bombing at Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大站有个家伙，他组织了最近发生在胡佛大坝的自杀式炸弹袭击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, we've seen him time to time. Led a couple scouts over Nellis, didn't go too well for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我们时常见到他。带了几个侦察兵去内利斯，结果不太顺利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This guy at Hoover Dam. No name, sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个人在胡佛水坝。没有名字，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supposedly, he one of the Frumentarii's best agents in the field.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，他是军团特务最好的间谍之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is involved with 18 major anti-NCR operations, but we don't have a face at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的名字与18次反NCR行动有关，但我们根本不知道他的长相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's gone dark, so we're worried he's planning somehing big.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他销声匿迹了，所以我们担心他在策划什么大事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, you were asking something else. We'll take more pictures if you have them, but brass has been hesitant to keep pouring money into this. I'll still get you paid, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，你在问别的事情。如果你有更多照片，我们还会拍，但是高层一直不太愿意继续往这上面砸钱。不过，我还是会确保你拿到钱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我还没有。

ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，他是军团特务最好的间谍之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 他销声匿迹了，所以我们担心他在策划什么大事。

ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，你在问别的事情。如果你有更多照片，我们还会拍，但是高层一直不太愿意继续往这上面砸钱。不过，我还是会确保你拿到钱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Devic [0600EE12] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was helping target the artillery on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时在帮忙引导炮火攻击你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry for trying to kill you, by the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一句，很抱歉我想杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I look different up close? What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我近距离看不一样了？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's okay. You didn't do a good job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。你水平不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't happen again as long as we're all, I don't want to say friends, but, uh...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不会再发生了，只要我们还在一起，我不想说朋友，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as we are all mutually armed and mutually friendly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们都彼此持有武器，并且彼此保持友好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were an outsider. We blow up outsiders. But, water under the bridge, I hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个外来者，我们炸外来者。但我希望，这已经是过去的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the very least, I will try not to call you savage. You've met with Mother Pearl after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少，我会尽量不叫你野蛮人。你已经见过珀尔妈妈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. You're a fucking snake. You lied about the ants down there. There is no way in hell the elder will sign off on your little project, whatever it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。你他妈的就是个阴险小人，你对下面那些蚂蚁的事撒了谎。长老绝不可能批准你那个狗屁项目，不管它是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know if I could negotiate a reliable supply of explosives out of Nellis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我能否从内利斯这边争取到可靠的炸药供应吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. You're a fucking snake. You lied about the ants down there. There is no way in hell the elder will sign off on your little project, whatever it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。你他妈的就是个阴险小人，你对下面那些蚂蚁的事撒了谎。长老绝不可能批准你那个狗屁项目，不管它是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jennifer [0600F39C] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE10]AZFreeformNellis) 0600EE10 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
