ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Hushed.> The NCR wants the refugees dead. Leave before it happens, and they'll wave you through.
ESP.TRADUIT: <肃静>NCR希望这些难民死掉。在事情发生之前离开，他们会让你通过的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You know what? You're right. I did all I can. Just wait till I leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你知道吗？你说得对，我已经尽力了。等我走了再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, it's them or you. You're already done all you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，不是他们就是你。你已经做了你能做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah? Well, I'm not going down without a fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]是吗？好吧，我不会束手就范的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I have no problem killing you, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我也不介意杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, bring it, motherfucker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，放马过来吧，操你妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> Eh, fuck it, you're in the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击]呃，操你大爷，你挡道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three days, huh? That should just be enough time to head back and convince everyone to take advantage of the peace. Thanks, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三天，是吧？这段时间应该足够回去说服大家好好利用和平了。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Begins at midnight. Lasts for three days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从午夜开始，持续三天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You gave me notions of being a hero. Pulled some refugees from Arizona to take advantage of the ceasefire. Missed the cutoff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我萌生了当英雄的念头。我从亚利桑那拉了些难民来利用停火协议，错过了停火时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, the Legion is fully convinced I'm a subversive element. And the NCR wants me to spy on the refugees instead of letting me through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，军团完全确信我是一个颠覆分子。NCR想让我监视难民而不让我通过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, once again, I'm stuck. It's your fault. Buzz off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我又一次陷入了困境，都是你的错。走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来买东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来买东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来买东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Legion territory. You need denarii to trade here. You'll have to exchange all of your caps for Legion coin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是军团领地，你需要第纳尔才能在这里交易。你得把你所有的瓶盖换成军团货币。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来买东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii need bottlecaps for their operations. We can trade normally. Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务需要瓶盖来维持他们的运作，我们可以正常贸易。这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's trade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来买东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Publius Veranus, Suboptio Temporalis to Optio Nerva. Do you have business here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 普布利乌斯·维拉努斯，涅尔瓦执行官的临时副手。你来这里有事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I am Publius Veranus, Suboptio Temporalis to Optio Nerva.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我是普布利乌斯·维拉努斯，涅尔瓦执行官的临时副手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you Nerva?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是涅尔瓦？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Acting assistant to the second-in-command to the Centurion. The last one got killed on his way to the bathroom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 百夫长执行官的代理助理，上一个在去洗手间的路上被杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since then, Nerva has withdrawn all troops from the spillway, as it is a poor defensive position with limited capabilities for raiding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后，涅尔瓦从溢洪道撤出了所有军队，因为这是一个防御能力有限的薄弱阵地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is a Suboptio Temporalis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是临时副手？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Per principatum, pax. Through supremacy, peace. This is the founding principle of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通过霸权，实现和平。这是军团成立的基本原则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have civilized Arizona. We have civilized great tracts of Colorado, New Mexico and Utah. And we will civilize the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们让亚利桑那变得文明，我们已经让科罗拉多、新墨西哥和犹他州的大片地区变得文明。我们会让莫哈维也变得文明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In summa, the Legion is the greatest chance for peace and prosperity in this war-torn Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总而言之，军团是这片被战争蹂躏的废土上实现和平与繁荣的最大机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nerva and I are of one mind on this. I dislike the Frumentarii. The Legion has core principles. Every nation should.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这一点上，涅尔瓦和我的想法是一致的，我不喜欢特务。军团有核心原则，每个国家都应该如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ours are "nostra ab auctoritate", "qualitas potentia nostra", "quodcumque dixerit vobis, facite". Right from our might. Might from our quality. Follow orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的原则是“正义来自我们的力量”、“力量来自我们的品德”、“服从命令”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the Frumentarii are not mighty. They do not go out in battle and meet the enemy head-on. They use disgraceful tactics of deception and subterfuge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但特务并没有强大的力量。他们不会在战场上与敌人正面交锋，他们使用不光彩的欺骗和诡计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, they cannot possibly be right. Still, Caesar has a plan for them, and the third principle still applies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，他们不可能是对的。不过，凯撒对他们还是有计划的，第三条原则仍然适用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything you dislike about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么不满意的地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legate is the most supreme example of a Legionary. He is disciplined, courageous, honest, honorable and zealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使是军团军人的最高典范。他自律、勇敢、诚实、可敬、热情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soon, he will lead us over the Dam and into the Strip.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很快，他就会带领我们越过大坝，进入长街。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From there, we will build a new jewel is the ashes of the Wasteland, showing that the Legion is triumphant over all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那里，我们将在废土的灰烬中建造一颗新的明珠，向世人展示军团的胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得拉尼厄斯特使怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His demotion from Centurion to Optio was terrible. Withdrew from the Spillway to prevent attacks from NCR snipers on Lanius's orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他从百夫长降职为执行官真是糟糕透顶。 在拉尼厄斯的命令下，他撤出了泄洪道，以防止NCR狙击手的袭击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was punished by Caesar for obeying them. Now, he probably won't get to see action. Word is he'll be shipped back east just ahead of the battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他因为服从他们而受到凯撒的惩罚。现在，他可能不会再上战场了，有消息说他会在开战前被送回东部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this Nerva.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说涅尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A worthy opponent. Although Oliver is of a more cowardly persuasion, the NCR boasts such titans as Hsu, Hanlon, Moore and Kimball.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个值得尊敬的对手。虽然奥利弗是一个比较懦弱的人，但NCR拥有像许、汉隆、摩尔和金博尔这样的巨人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kimball is almost as superhuman as Caesar. Any lesser man would have surrendered Bullhead much earlier. Taking Bullhead was as costly as whole of Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 金博尔几乎和凯撒一样是超人。换做别的人，布尔海德早就投降了，占领布尔海德的代价不亚于整个科罗拉多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So much blood for such an insignifcant target. And it is apparent that he seems fully willing to do it again, not just in Parker, but here as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了一个微不足道的目标，流了这么多血。很明显，他似乎完全愿意再次这样做，不仅在帕克，在这里也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I also hear that the NCR is preparing for a return to Bullhead. At least, if the NCR midterms are anything to go by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还听说NCR正准备重返布尔海德。至少，如果NCR中期选举还能继续下去的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar? Oh, you mean the trader at the refugee camp. What about him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔？你是说难民营的那个商人吗。他怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to talk about Omar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来谈谈奥马尔的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have some new proposal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么新的建议吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to talk about Omar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来谈谈奥马尔的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why on Earth would we grant that? As a sympathizer of the slaves, he is a known subversive element.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到底为什么要同意呢？作为奴隶的同情者，他是众所周知的颠覆分子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar can either take his chances in the NCR or die with the Dissolute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔要么在NCR碰碰运气，要么和浪荡子们死在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar is seeking passage back into Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔正在寻找返回军团领地的通道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... Very well, amicus. Know that any crimes that Omar commits will be on your head and will be rewarded with the summary execution of both of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...很好，朋友。要知道，奥马尔犯下的任何罪行都要算在你头上，你们俩都会被就地处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this letter to Omar. Tell him that it will secure him passage back to Dolan Springs in exchange for a contract of supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这封信带给奥马尔，告诉他这能让他安全回到多兰泉，换取一份补给合同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion Rep] I'm a friend of Legion. Isn't my word good enough?
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]我是军团的朋友，我的话还不够吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不够。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a friend of Legion. Isn't my word good enough?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是军团的朋友，我的话还不够吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A ceasefire? Why on Earth would we agree to that when we are winning? Doing that would surrender the initiative!
ESP.TRADUIT: 停火？当我们要赢的时候，我们为什么要同意呢？这样做会失去主动权！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is requesting a temporary ceasefire to allow for the transport of refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR要求暂时停火，以便运送难民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. If the NCR wishes to allow the refugees to cross, then they can retake this spillway and "rescue" the Dissolute themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。如果NCR希望允许难民通过，那么他们可以重新占领这条泄洪道，自己"营救"这些道德沦丧的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is requesting a temporary ceasefire to allow for the transport of refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR要求暂时停火，以便运送难民。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A chance to show the Legion's greater magnanimity than the NCR? Very well, you may take this ceasefire proposal back to Wire.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]一个展示军团比NCR更宽宏大量的机会？很好，你可以把这份停火提议带回NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Secure for me a signature, and return. I will submit it to Nerva for review.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我签个字，然后回来。我会提交给涅尔瓦审阅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR claims that the Legion is nothing but savages. Let's prove your civilization is superior.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR声称军团不过是野蛮人，让我们证明你们的文明是优越的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Your infantile attempts to appeal to my ego are truly pathetic. I will not be negotiating a ceasefire.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你幼稚地试图激发我的自尊心真是可悲。我不会就停火进行谈判。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would be the hero! Not just to the Legion, but to the NCR, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会成为英雄！不只是军团，还有NCR的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] The refugees would be draining NCR resources while demoralizing NCR troops while spreading tales of not just Legion terror, but mercy. A solid argument.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]难民们会消耗NCR的资源，挫伤NCR军队的士气，同时传播不仅是军团恐怖，还有仁慈的故事。一个有力的论点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Take this ceasefire proposal to the NCR. Secure for me a signature, and return. I will submit it to Nerva for review.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。把这份停火提议交给NCR，给我签个字，然后回来。我会提交给涅尔瓦审阅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The refugees would spread tales of Legion brutality and mercy in the NCR at no cost to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难民们会在NCR传播军团残暴和仁慈的故事，而军团不会为此付出任何代价。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Right? Wrong? In war? Take your naivete someplace where they have time for it. There will be no ceasefire.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]正确？错误？在战争中？带上你的天真去他们有时间的地方。不会有停火的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the right thing to do, and you know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是正确的做法，你知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A reasonable claim. Tell Omar that he may pass through to Dolan Springs in exchange for a contract to supply my troops at the spillway.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]合理的主张。告诉奥马尔，他可以用回到多兰泉来换取一份合同，为我在泄洪道的部队提供补给。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it better to have a trader who owes you his very life? He will offer a discount, I'm sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个欠你一条命的商人不是更好吗？我相信他会给你折扣的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] The word of a dissolute sympathizer means absolutely nothing to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]一个浪荡子同情者的话对我来说毫无意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, he'll owe you one, right? Isn't that enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，他会欠你一个人情的，对吧？这对你来说还不够吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see it. Hmm. Recovery of NCR dead and their dogtags? That can be arranged. Very well, Nerva will sign this counteroffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看。嗯，找回NCR的尸体和他们的狗牌？可以安排。很好，涅尔瓦会签署这份还盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Inform someone among the refugees that the ceasefire will begin once Wire has been informed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉难民中的某个人，一旦通知怀尔，停火就会开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've returned with a counteroffer from the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带着NCR的还盘回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see it. Hmm. Recovery of NCR dead and their dogtags? That can be arranged. Nerva is very likely to sign this counteroffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看。嗯，找回NCR的尸体和他们的狗牌？可以安排。涅尔瓦很有可能会签署这份还盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ceasefire will begin once Wire has been informed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦通知怀尔，停火就会开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've returned with a counteroffer from the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带着NCR的还盘回来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Then, we have nothing further to talk about. If the Profligates are not interested, then they are not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。那我们就没什么可谈的了，如果放荡者不感兴趣，那么他们就是不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR rejected the proposal.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR拒绝了这一提议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, go find out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，去找出答案吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Captain Joseph Wire. There some reason you're talking to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约瑟夫·怀尔上尉。你和我说话有什么原因吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Told you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早就告诉你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion wasn't interested in a ceasefire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对停火不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hell. Not another bleeding heart. No one's crossing that checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，见鬼，不是另一个滥好人。没人能通过那个检查站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do I talk to about securing passage through the checkpoint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该和谁谈谈通过检查站的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be me. Did Omar send you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是我。奥马尔派你来的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do I talk to about securing passage through the checkpoint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该和谁谈谈通过检查站的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again? I already told you no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来了？我已经告诉你不行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do I talk to about securing passage through the checkpoint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该和谁谈谈通过检查站的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told him that the NCR's standing policy is to not let any unauthorized persons through due to security regulations issued by General Oliver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经跟他说过了，根据奥利弗将军颁布的安全条例，NCR的一贯政策是不允许任何未经授权的人通过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, he did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, what are you bothering me for? Don't tell me you're here just for general refugee crap?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你来烦我干什么？别告诉我你来这里只是为了难民的破事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, he didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a proposal, but I think your friend needs to be out of earshot for me to tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个提议，但我觉得你朋友需要躲在听不到的地方，我才能告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there some sort of deal we could work out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能不能商量个办法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, yes. The Legion doesn't take action against those refugees because they think it demoralizes the troops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，是的。军团没有对这些难民采取行动，因为他们认为这会打击部队的士气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, seeing the victims of Legion oppression just wither away and die? Sadly, the Legion's right. Our troops don't really have the stomach for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，看着军团压迫下的受害者凋零死去？可悲的是，军团是对的，我们的军队真的没有这个胃口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, if the refugees were to be...removed, then morale would improve. Do you understand what I'm saying?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，如果这些难民...移走，士气就会提高。你明白我的意思吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there some sort of deal we could work out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能不能商量个办法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The deal with the refugees is still on the table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有关难民的协议仍在谈判中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there some sort of deal we could work out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能不能商量个办法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't say that. I said "remove", and keep your voice down. All I'm saying is that Omar could pass through if the rest of the refugees were gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没那么说，我说的是"移走"，小点声。我想说的是，如果其他难民都走了，奥马尔可以通过这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, I could throw in something a little extra. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，我可以再给你点额外的好处。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want me to slaughter a bunch of refugees? That's sick!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我屠杀一群难民吗？太恶心了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your call. But as long as those security concerns are there, I cannot help your trader friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你决定吧。但只要这些安全问题存在，我就无法帮助你的商人朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely not. Find someone else to do your dirty work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对不行，找别人替你干这些脏活吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great. Report back to me when the refugees have been removed. This will show the Legion that we can be just as brutal as they are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。难民移走后向我报告，这会让军团知道，我们也可以和他们一样残忍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work. That'll show the Legion that their brutality doesn't intimidate us. This will be great for morale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好。这样就能让军团知道他们的残暴无法吓倒我们，这将极大地鼓舞士气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR doesn't officially sponsor mercenaries, but I'll put some good words in with the brass. Oh, and here's a little something extra.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR并没有正式赞助雇佣军，但我会对高层说几句好话。对了，还有一点额外的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I did it. All the refugees are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我做到了。所有的难民都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. I thought you might have been just another bleeding heart.... But you think just like I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。我以为你可能只是另一个滥好人...但你和我想的一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll spread some rumors about how you're a hero to Oliver to give you some cover. Oh, and here's your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在奥利弗面前散布一些关于你是英雄的传言好给你掩护。对了，这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus a little something extra. Got this here street sweeper, for taking out the trash. I used during the Vault City Riots a couple years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再加上一点额外的东西。这是清道夫，用来清理垃圾，几年前我在地下掩体市暴乱时用过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have fun with it now. Oh, and don't talk to the press. They wouldn't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在享受它吧。还有，别跟媒体说，他们不懂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the refugees are dead, but so is Omar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，难民都死了，但奥马尔也死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hurry up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was brought in by General Oliver to help oversee his strategic vision. I'm an old friend of his. I'm under Colonel Moore's command, but she hates me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是奥利弗将军派来监督他的战略规划的，我是他的老朋友。我受摩尔上校指挥，但她讨厌我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What brings you to the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么风把你吹到水坝来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was brought in by General Oliver to help oversee his strategic vision. I'm an old friend of his. I'm directly under his command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是奥利弗将军派来监督他的战略规划的。我是他的老朋友，我直接听命于他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know who killed her, but frankly, I'm grateful. Uptight gloryhound bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道是谁杀了她，但说实话，我很感激。这条保守的荣誉母狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What brings you to the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么风把你吹到水坝来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything that Moore doesn't want to do herself. Logistics, supply, construction, reconnaissance, and internal affairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有摩尔不想自己做的事。后勤、供应、建筑、侦察、内务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do at the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在大坝做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vault City. Pretty nice if you want healthcare, but it's been downhill since the NCR ended the autonomy. Joined the military to escape the bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地下掩体市。如果你想要医疗保健，这里很好，但自从NCR结束自治以来，它一直在走下坡路。参军是为了逃避这些屁事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turns out that bullshit's everywhere. I did two tours against the Brotherhood, one tour in Bullhead and fought at Helios. Missed the first Hoover Dam, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实证明，那些屁事到处都是。我参加了两次与兄弟会的战斗，一次是在布尔海德，一次是在太阳神一号。虽然错过了第一次胡佛水坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The things I saw at Bullhead have only convinced me that there's nothing but savages on the other side of the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在布尔海德看到的一切让我确信科罗拉多河的另一边只有野蛮人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's got its work cut out for us when it comes to civilizing the east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在教化东部的问题上，NCR有很多工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm known for my flexibility. It's why Oliver brought me in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是出了名的灵活，这就是奥利弗找我来的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's an awful lot of jobs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可真是非常多的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, probably not. Moore's in the offices downstairs, but she doesn't take kindly to tourists. And Oliver's in the power plant, but he's not taking visitors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，可能不行。摩尔在楼下的办公室，但她对游客不太友好。奥利弗在发电厂，但他不接待访客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I meet General Oliver or Colonel Moore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能见见奥利弗将军或摩尔上校吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, some asshole snuck in and killed Moore. Dam's under lockdown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，有个混蛋溜进来杀了摩尔，大坝被封锁了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I meet General Oliver or Colonel Moore?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能见见奥利弗将军或摩尔上校吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The war with the Legion? It varies from front to front. It gets better the further away from here you get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和军团的战争？每个方向都不一样。离这里越远就越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Command designates two big theaters: the Upper Mojave and the Lower Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 指挥部指定了两个大战区：上莫哈维和下莫哈维。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How goes the war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 战争进展如何？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, the Vegas Campaign. We've got too many fires to put out, and the Legion's been taking advantage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，维加斯战役。我们要扑灭的火太多了，而军团一直在占便宜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They seized Cottonwood Cove, Nelson and Camp Willow. Meanwhile, we've got tribals, Brotherhood, and gangsters tying our troops up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们占领了棉白杨湾、纳尔逊和柳树营地。与此同时，我们的部队却被部落、兄弟会和黑帮捆住了手脚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the past year, the Legion has expanded its holdings west of the Colorado in this theater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在过去的一年里，军团在科罗拉多以西的这个战区扩大了地盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Upper Mojave? That this one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 上莫哈维？这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's everything south of Bullhead. We're doing great in Mexicali, but not so much everywhere else. We lost Blythe. Hell, we barely fought back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是布尔海德以南的所有地方。我们在墨西卡利做得很好，但在其他地方就不太好了。我们失去了布莱斯，见鬼，我们几乎没有还手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know there are some holdouts in the mountains down there, but they're not going to retake the town any time soon. And then, there's Bullhead itself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道山下有一些抵抗者，但他们短期内不可能夺回城镇。然后，还有布尔海德本身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We lost it. We gave the Legion hell, practically leveled the city, but we still lost it. People back home are absolutely pissed. And there's Parker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们失去了它。我们给了军团很大的打击，几乎把城市夷为平地，但我们还是失去了它，家乡的人非常生气。还有帕克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might as well write that one off. No one cares that they're dug in like ticks on a dog's ear. Not enough to send them reinforcements, anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不如一笔勾销吧。就像狗耳朵上的虱子一样没人关心，反正也没有足够的力量给他们派援军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Baja's the only place you can say we're winning, and we're doing it with only a handful of Rangers. You know why? It's because the Rangers do what we don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴哈是唯一一个你能说我们赢了的地方，而且我们只有少量游骑兵。你知道为什么吗？因为游骑兵做了我们不做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They aren't afraid to play dirty. They aren't afraid of the press. They aren't afraid of the Brahmin Barons or wishy-washy voters. They're unrestrained.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不怕玩阴招，他们不怕媒体，他们也不怕婆罗门贵族或优柔寡断的选民。他们不受约束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lower Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下莫哈维？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh-huh. Knock yourself out. The NCR can't really regarrison the camp anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯哼，随便你。无论如何，NCR不可能真正重视这个营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I'm pretty sure that the Chiefs want the Legion to hold positions along the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我很确定老板们想让军团在科罗拉多河驻扎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as the Legion has superiority along the Upper Colorado, they'll keep trying to cross it down south, where they'll get chewed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要军团在科罗拉多上游有优势，他们就会一直试图过河。不过我们南方的朋友会解决的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I retook Camp Willow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我夺回柳树营地呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Veteran Rangers have arrived in the Mojave, and Camp Willow's still there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经验丰富的游骑兵已经到了莫哈维，而柳树营地还在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, you want to talk to the Rangers over at Delta about that instead. See why they haven't gotten off their asses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，你应该和德尔塔的游骑兵谈谈这件事。看看他们为什么还不动起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I retook Camp Willow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我夺回柳树营地呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you now? It has been quiet for a while. Oliver's preventing any redeployment from the dam to other sectors. Legion will probably retake it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在？已经平静了一段时间了。奥利弗阻止了任何从大坝转移到其他区域的行动，军团可能会夺回它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hate this fucking theater so much. If the NCR wasn't so stupid about holding this fucking dam, we could have retaken Bullhead and be in Kingman by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真他妈讨厌这个战区。要不是NCR傻傻地守着这该死的水坝，我们早就能夺回布尔海德了，说不定现在已经到金曼了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kicked the Legion off Camp Willow not long ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不久前把军团踢出了柳树营。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers have been fighting the Legion for over a decade. They burn crops, poison wells, blow up bridges. They wage war like it's a fucking war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵已经和军团作战超过十年了。他们烧毁庄稼，给水井下毒，炸毁桥梁。他们在打一场该死的仗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the things they're doing in Mexicali? They actually armed the regional warlords there. Could you imagine that happening here? Of course not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说他们在墨西卡利做的事呢？他们实际上武装了当地的军阀。你能想象这种情况在这里发生吗？当然不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The press has been on our asses since Bullhead. They've been bitching non-stop that we lost it, and every front page of The Redding Times pisses me off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从布尔海德开始，媒体就一直在盯着我们。他们一直在抱怨我们失地，《瑞丁时报》的每一个头版都让我生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They can't seem to get it into their heads that artillery-leveling a city, civilians or not, is perfectly acceptable when you're denying it to the enemy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们似乎不明白，当你抵抗敌人时，不管平民死活，用大炮夷平一个城镇也是完全可以接受的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we should. It's our government's mandate to its people. We spent years pacifying that city and rooting out the savages.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该这样做，这是我们政府对人民的使命。我们花了数年时间平定那座城市，铲除野蛮人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once Bullhead was cleaned up, it was a shining example of everything the NCR stood for. Like hell we should let the Legion take that city without a fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦布尔海德被清理干净，它就成为了NCR所代表的一切的光辉榜样。我们绝不能让军团不战而夺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unrestrained?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不受约束？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] No. No, I wouldn't. Ah, hell. Go back to Omar. Tell him that he and the refugees can come through. Just know, if anything happens, it's on your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]不，不，我不会。啊，见鬼，回去找奥马尔吧，告诉他，他和难民们可以通过。只要知道，如果发生什么事，都是你的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Look, I'm a hero in the NCR. You wouldn't say no to a hero, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]听着，我是NCR的英雄。你不会拒绝一个英雄的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] No. No, I wouldn't. Ah, hell. I'll let the refugees through. Just know, if anything happens, it's on your head.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]不，不，我不会。啊，见鬼，我会让难民通过的。只要知道，如果发生什么事，都是你的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Look, I'm a hero in the NCR. You wouldn't say no to a hero, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]听着，我是NCR的英雄。你不会拒绝一个英雄的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You're not that much of a big shot around here. The answer's no. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你在这里也不是什么大人物。答案是否定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm a hero in the NCR. You wouldn't say no to a hero, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我是NCR的英雄。你不会拒绝一个英雄的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] The hell you are. How the hell is anyone supposed to trust your word? Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你他妈算老几，怎么可能有人相信你的话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm a hero in the NCR. You wouldn't say no to a hero, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我是NCR的英雄。你不会拒绝一个英雄的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] That's a joke, right? Everyone on this Dam is on the edge of decorating the walls with your brains. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]开玩笑的吧？大坝里的每个人都想用你的大脑装饰墙壁。滚开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm a hero in the NCR. You wouldn't say no to a hero, would you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我是NCR的英雄。你不会拒绝一个英雄的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not heartless, but our own stocks of food are low, and we really can't spare any for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不是没心没肺，但我们自己的食物储备也不多了，我们真的没有多余的给他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if you can't let them through, can't you just supply them some food?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，如果你不能让他们通过，就不能给他们一些食物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah.... Fuck it. Let's do something good, for once. I'll talk to the quartermaster and get some food out. And you can tell Omar that he can come on through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊...去他妈的。让我们做点好事，哪怕一次，我去跟军需官谈谈，弄点吃的出来。你可以告诉奥马尔，他可以通过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Look, it's me we're talking about. Can't you make an exception just this once?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]听着，我们说的是我。你就不能破例一次吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah.... Fuck it. Let's do something good, for once. I'll talk to the quartermaster and get some food out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊...去他妈的。让我们做点好事，哪怕一次，我去跟军需官谈谈，弄点吃的出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Look, it's me we're talking about. Can't you make an exception just this once?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]听着，我们说的是我。你就不能破例一次吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, we can't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我们不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, it's me we're talking about. Can't you make an exception just this once?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们说的是我。你就不能破例一次吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Well, if that's true.... Yeah, we could spare some food to the refugees. That trader can come on through as well, if he wants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，好吧，如果这是真的...嗯，我们可以分给难民一些食物。如果那个商人愿意，他也可以进来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I solved your food issue. The sharecroppers should be making enough food for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我解决了你的食物问题，佃农应该为你准备了足够的食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Well, if that's true.... Yeah, we could spare some food to the refugees. We'll send a shipment over in the morning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，好吧，如果这是真的...嗯，我们可以分给难民一些食物。明天早上我们会送一批货过去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I solved your food issue. The sharecroppers should be making enough food for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我解决了你的食物问题，佃农应该为你准备了足够的食物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A ceasefire? You some fucking Follower or something? I mean, I won't stop you from trying, but the Legion doesn't do ceasefires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 停火？你他妈是天启追随者？我的意思是，我不会阻止你尝试，但军团不会停火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're serious, the spillway was previously held by a man named Nerva. Not sure where he is now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你是认真的，泄洪道之前是由一个叫涅尔瓦的人控制的。现在不知道他在哪里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know he had a small outpost at the rest stop. If you can convince him, we might have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他在休息站有个小前哨。如果你能说服他，我们可能会达成协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some pull in the Legion. What if I negotiated a ceasefire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在军团里有一定的影响力，如果我通过谈判达成停火呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pull? With the Legion? You know, working with them is strictly terroristic behavior. I should have you shot dead for even suggesting it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉拢？和军团？你知道，和他们合作是非常恐怖的行为。就因为你提出这个建议，我就该把你毙了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only reason I'm not is because you've obviously never worked with the Legion, otherwise you'd know the Legion doesn't do ceasefires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么做的唯一原因是因为你显然从来没有和军团合作过，否则你应该知道军团是不会停火的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're serious, the spillway was previously held by a man named Nerva. Not sure where he is now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你是认真的，泄洪道之前是由一个叫涅尔瓦的人控制的。现在不知道他在哪里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know he had a small outpost at the rest stop. If you can convince him, we might have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他在休息站有个小前哨。如果你能说服他，我们可能会达成协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I could get some pull with the Legion, could I arrange a ceasefire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我能拉拢到军团的支持，我能安排停火吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy shit, really? Give me that. "Three-day ceasefire.... Passage of refugees.... Release of Legion prisoners?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天啊，真的？把那个给我。“三天停火...难民通行...释放军团俘虏？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: They sell our prisoners into slavery, and want us to send theirs back to them? They probably just want to shoot them for disloyalty, but that's our right, not theirs!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把我们的俘虏卖了做奴隶，还要我们把他们的送回去？他们可能只是想因为他们不忠而射杀他们，但那是我们的权利，不是他们的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, absolutely not. Kimball would have my head on a pike if I did that. Tell Nerva no deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，绝对不行。如果我这么做，金博尔会把我的头插在长矛上。告诉涅尔瓦无法成交。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm back. The Legion has offered a written ceasefire proposal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我回来了，军团提供了一份书面停火建议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Good faith? Aaah.... Fine. I'll add a provision to allow for the recovery of NCR dead and their dogtags. If Nerva agrees, we have a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]诚意吗？啊...好吧，我将增加一项条款，允许回收NCR死者和他们的狗牌。如果涅尔瓦同意，我们就成交了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, Nerva is negotiating in good faith. If you don't like the deal, counteroffer. Don't walk away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，涅尔瓦在诚心诚意地谈判。如果你不喜欢这笔交易，就还价，不要一走了之。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] It's a terrible deal. And I'll get court-martialed for even considering it. No deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]这是一笔糟糕的交易，哪怕只是考虑过，我也会被送上军事法庭。没有达成任何协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, it's not that bad of a deal, and you'll be doing some good. Isn't that what really matters?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，这并不是一笔糟糕的交易，而且你会做一些好事。这难道不是最重要的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, fuck. Didn't actually think that this would happen. That's all California needs. More people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，操。我没想到会发生这种事，这正是加州所需要的。更多的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, since you got us into this situation, you're going to help the NCR manage them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然是你让我们陷入这种境地，你就得帮助NCR管理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been temporarily conscripted under Executive Order 861. Come on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据第861号行政命令，你被临时征召入伍。来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ceasefire begins on your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一发出信号，停火就开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, fuck. Didn't actually think that this would happen. That's all California needs. More people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，操。我没想到会发生这种事，这正是加州所需要的。更多的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, since you got us into this situation, you're going to help the NCR manage them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然是你让我们陷入这种境地，你就得帮助NCR管理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been temporarily conscripted under Executive Order 861. Come on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据第861号行政命令，你被临时征召入伍。来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ceasefire begins on your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一发出信号，停火就开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, can't say I'm too grateful, since I told you this would happen. Anyways, ceasefire's over. You've been relieved. Clear the bridge, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也不太感激，因为我早就告诉过你会发生这种事。总之，停火结束了，你已经解脱了。清空桥梁，伙计们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've managed to disarm a suicide bomber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我成功解除了一个自杀式炸弹袭击者的武装。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, can't say I'm too grateful, since I told you this would happen. Anyways, ceasefire's over. You've been relieved. Clear the bridge, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也不太感激，因为我早就告诉过你会发生这种事。总之，停火结束了，你已经解脱了。清空桥梁，伙计们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've convinced a suicide bomber to be disarmed. Need your boys to disarm him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说服了一名自杀式炸弹袭击者解除武装，需要你的人去解除。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, can't say I'm too grateful, since I told you this would happen. Anyways, ceasefire's over. You've been relieved. Clear the bridge, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也不太感激，因为我早就告诉过你会发生这种事。总之，停火结束了，你已经解脱了。清空桥梁，伙计们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a suicide bomber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个自杀式炸弹袭击者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, can't say I'm too grateful, since I told you this would happen. Anyways, ceasefire's over. You've been relieved. Clear the bridge, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也不太感激，因为我早就告诉过你会发生这种事。总之，停火结束了，你已经解脱了。清空桥梁，伙计们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a suicide bomber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个自杀式炸弹袭击者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, probably. Better safe than sorry. Still, can't say I'm too grateful, since I told you this would happen. Anyways, ceasefire's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，可能吧，小心驶得万年船。不过，我还是不能说我很感激，因为我告诉过你会发生这种事。总之，停火结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been relieved. Clear the bridge, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经解脱了。清空桥梁，伙计们！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was probably a suicide bomber. I didn't check.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很可能是自杀式炸弹袭击者，我没有检查。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you know what? The NCR's going to keep you on hand to help monitor those fuckers. You've been temporarily conscripted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你知道吗？NCR会让你留在这里，帮助监视那些混蛋。你被临时征召入伍了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't get a say in this. Come with me to the checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这事你没有发言权。跟我到检查站去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar's been informed. I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经通知奥马尔了。现在我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you know what? The NCR's going to keep you on hand to help monitor those fuckers. You've been temporarily conscripted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你知道吗？NCR会让你留在这里，帮助监视那些混蛋。你被临时征召入伍了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't get a say in this. Come with me to the checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这事你没有发言权。跟我到检查站去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry. Our friends in Mexicali will make sure he tells us everything he knows. It's amazing what their enhanced interrogation technicians can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心，我们墨西卡利的朋友会确保他告诉我们他知道的一切。他们的高级审讯技术人员的能力真是惊人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, probably an execution in a military court in Baja for attempted terrorism. Wish we could execute him now, though. Throw him off the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，可能会在巴哈的军事法庭因恐怖主义未遂而被执行死刑。真希望现在就能处决他，把他从大坝上扔下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will happen to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他会怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Charlie. I guard this gate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫查理，我守着这扇门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from New Adytum. It's a burb of the Boneyard. Pretty nice. Left home to try and do some good. You see how that's working out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自内城区，这是晒骨场的一个郊区，挺不错的。离开家想做点好事，你看到结果了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just want to go home, man. The Legion can have the Mojave. Don't tell Wire I said that though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想回家，伙计。军团可以得到莫哈维，不过别告诉怀尔我这么说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure. Follow me. Remember you can't get back to the other side without an escort. Sorry about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然，跟我来。记住，没有人护送你是回不去那边的，不好意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I go in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能进去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Security Order No. 1070. Oliver has ordered that anyone approaching the checkpoint is to be regarded as a Legion asset and treated with hostility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第1070号安保法令。奥利弗下令任何接近检查站的人都将被视为军团的线人并受到敌意对待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wire's issued a communique that defines 'maximum hostility' as a shoot-on-sight order. Had to do it a couple of days ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怀尔发布了一份公报将"最大敌意"定义为立即开火。几天前我不得不这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, uh, couldn't bring myself to get rid of the body. Nobody could. It just sat there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，呃，没法让自己把尸体处理掉。没人能做到，它就在那儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, how come you don't let anyone in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么不让任何人进去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, orders is orders. I'm not happy about it either, but what can I do about it? It's policy issued from Oliver himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，命令就是命令。我也不高兴，但我能做些什么呢？这是奥利弗亲自签发的政策。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just.... I just want to go home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是...我只想回家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you just gun down refugees?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能枪杀难民？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not authorized to discuss any of that. You'll need to talk to Captain Joseph Wire about that. He's in the visitor's center.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无权讨论这些。这事你得跟约瑟夫·怀尔上尉谈，他在游客中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to negotiate the passage of Omar and the refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来协商奥马尔和难民的通行问题的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Told you. Talk to Wire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉你了，去找怀尔谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to negotiate the passage of Omar and the refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来协商奥马尔和难民的通行问题的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing is happening since Wire's dead. Brass has pushed an even greater crackdown than he ever did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怀尔死后什么都没发生，上级发起了比以往任何时候都更严厉的打击行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to negotiate the passage of Omar and the refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来协商奥马尔和难民的通行问题的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great. He's in the visitor center. Oh, I can't let you through. You'll have to go back the way you came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，他在游客中心。哦，我不能让你过去，你只能原路返回了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll go talk to Wire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去和怀尔谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what do you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你有什么想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, can't we work something out between you and me? Just for Omar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们就不能好好商量一下吗？就为了奥马尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well.... 350 caps. Take it or leave it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...350瓶盖，要不要随你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about some caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些瓶盖怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then Omar's too poor for my blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那奥马尔我也不太吃得消。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too rich for my blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我吃不消。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Tell Omar to come down here at midnight. I'll work something out and wave him through. Send him to Boulder City.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，叫奥马尔半夜到这儿来，我会想办法让他通过的。送他去巨石城。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, come back when you can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，等你有了再来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't afford that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负担不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it does. Not like I'm getting much action on leave, either. Not even old enough to buy a drink at the Gomorrah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，确实如此。我休假的时候也没什么事干，甚至还没到在蛾摩拉买酒的年龄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you want to go Legionary-style, huh? You are pretty good-looking. Sure. Give us a couple of rounds, and I'll wave Omar through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你想走军团风格，是吗？你长得很漂亮。没问题，我们玩几圈，我让奥马尔通过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a been a while since you've had your needs met, hasn't it? Let me show you a good time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经有一段时间没满足自己的需求了，不是吗？让我带你好好玩玩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, uh, no, sorry. I'm not really interested in that sort of stuff. I mean, you seem nice and all, but I would not be willing to do, um, sex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，呃，不，抱歉，我对那种事情不太感兴趣。我是说，你看起来很不错，但我不愿意和你，呃，上床。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must have needs, right? Let me be your quartermaster, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定有需求，对吧？让我来当你的军需官吧，亲爱的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, caps. 350 would be enough for me to get a couple boxes of Tragic the Garnering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，瓶盖。350就够我买几盒悲剧牌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Private Charlie [06010193] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, what would it take for you to wave Omar through?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那你要怎样才能让奥马尔通过呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well, it's been terrifying. I lost a lost of friends in Solitare. Now, I'm just on my way to Aerotech and can hopefully make a new life for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧，太可怕了，我在索利泰尔中失去了很多朋友。现在，我正在去航空科技的路上，希望能开始新的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's next for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你接下来有什么打算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, nothing's wrong. Have a nice day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没什么问题。祝你过得愉快。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, shit. Please, I.... The Frumentarii will kill my family if you don't let me do this. I don't want to kill you if I don't have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]噢，该死。拜托，我...如果你不让我这么做，特务会杀了我的家人。除非万不得已，我也不想杀你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can wait until you leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以等你离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have upper body stiffness consistent with the placement of 18 C4 charges.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的上半身僵硬程度与18枚C4炸药的放置位置相符。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't. The Frumentarii are terrifying. If you saw what they did in Solitare.... I don't really want to talk about it. Sorry. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没有。特务太可怕了，如果你看过他们在索利泰尔做的...我真的不想谈这个。对不起，再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for possible saboteurs or Frumentarii agents. Have you seen any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找可能的破坏者或者军团特务的间谍。你见过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, shit. Please, I.... The Frumentarii will kill my family if you don't let me do this. I don't want to kill you if I don't have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]噢，该死。拜托，我...如果你不让我这么做，特务会杀了我的家人。除非万不得已，我也不想杀你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can wait until you leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以等你离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way you walk indicates excessive weight on the chest, consistent with over 10 placed explosives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从你走路的姿势来看胸部的重量过重，与十多处放置炸药的位置相符。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's hot out. It's always hot in the Mojave. Please, I don't want any trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，外面很热，莫哈维总是很热。拜托，我不想惹麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem to be sweating quite a bit. Anything to hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像出了不少汗。有什么需要隐藏的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell? Are you one of them? Please. Can't you just leave me alone? I'm already doing what you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？你也是他们中的一员吗？求你了，你就不能放过我吗？我已经照你说的做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion Rep] <Hushed.> I'm with Caesar's Legion. You're a Frumentarius asset, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]<低声>我是凯撒军团的，你是特务的线人，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] What the hell? Are you one of them? Please. Can't you just leave me alone? I'm already doing what you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]搞什么鬼？你也是他们中的一员吗？求你了，你就不能放过我吗？我已经照你说的做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vulpes me misit difficultates nullae sint fac. No problems, understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 沃尔普斯派我来确保没有问题(拉丁语)。没问题，明白吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Look, I didn't flee through Gila monsters and slavers just to hear you pretend to be a scumbag. Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]听着，我从大毒蜥和奴隶贩子那里逃出来不是为了听你装成人渣的。滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Los ojos del poderoso Caesar siempre te estan mirando. Always watching.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒强大的眼睛时刻注视着你(拉丁语)。一直盯着你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To blow up the checkpoint, kill some NCR soldiers. I'm the bomb. I complete my task, and my family is let go. If I don't, they'll be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要炸掉检查站，杀几个NCR的士兵，我就是炸弹。我完成我的任务，我的家人就会被释放。如果我不这么做，他们就会被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what does the Legion want? We Frumentarii don't always talk to each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团想要什么？我们特务并不总是互相交谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, um, look, if it isn't too much to ask.... I know my place, but can you promise to look after my family? Tell them I love them? They're in Solitaire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，嗯，听着，如果这个要求不过分的话...我知道我的立场，但你能保证照顾我的家人吗？告诉他们我爱他们？他们在索利泰尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you so much! Um, is there anything else? I'm just trying to delay it, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢！呃，还有别的事吗？我只是想拖延时间，你懂吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my word as an agent of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以军团间谍的身份向你保证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...see. Well, thanks anyways. If you see them, tell them I love them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...明白了。好吧，还是谢谢你。如果你看到他们，告诉他们我爱他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, is there anything else? I'm just trying to delay it for just a little bit, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，还有别的事吗？我只是想拖延时间，你懂吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll try, but I can't promise that. The Legion is brutal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会试试看，但我不能保证。军团很残酷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only good thing about this is that I can take you with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的好处就是我可以带你一起走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You deserve nothing. The Legion will rid the world of you and your pathetic family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么都不配。军团会把你和你可怜的家人从这个世界上清理掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...um, really? You mean, the Legion's changing its mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...呃，真的？你是说，军团改变主意了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As an agent of the Legion, I will relieve you of your duty and will safeguard your family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为军团的间谍，我将解除你的职责，并保护你的家人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is great! And I have your word that my family will be safe? Yes? Okay, then. So can you defuse me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太棒了！你能保证我的家人不会有事吗？嗯？那，好吧。你能拆除我的炸弹吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did not negotiate this ceasefire to have some upstart ruin it. You have my word as a Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我协商停火协议可不是为了让某个自命不凡的新手毁了它。我以军团士兵的身份向你保证。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is great! And I have your word that my family will be safe? Yes? Okay, then. So can you defuse me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太棒了！你能保证我的家人不会有事吗？嗯？那，好吧。你能拆除我的炸弹吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I do. I am a trusted agent of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然能。我是一个受军团信任的间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay? Holy shit, I thought I was going to die today. Thank you so much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了？我的天，我还以为我今天要死了。非常感谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I've disarmed you. I'll go talk to Wire so you can be waved through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我解除了你的炸弹。我去跟怀尔谈谈，让他们放行你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay? Holy shit, I thought I was going to die today. Thank you so much!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了？我的天，我还以为我今天要死了。非常感谢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not skilled enough to disarm you. I'll go talk to Wire and get someone to disarm you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的技能不足以解除你的炸弹。我去跟怀尔谈谈，让他找人来解除。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, okay. I'll wait until you're clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，好吧。我等你安全了再说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, nothing. Detonate when I cleared the blast radius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没什么。我离开爆炸范围后就会引爆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I keep thinking that this is my punishment. But I don't know what I'm being punished for. Did I do something wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直觉得这是对我的惩罚，但我不知道我为什么会受到惩罚。是我做错了什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I knew what I could've done differently. I don't know if it's because I was a rat in Solitaire or because I couldn't save anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我知道我能做些什么。我不知道是因为我在索利泰尔是个告密者还是因为我救不了任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're with the Legion, can you tell me what I did wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是军团的人，能告诉我我做错了什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, sure, we'll talk for a bit. What do you want to talk about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，当然，我们再聊一会儿。你想聊什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean that some things are just out of your control? That's almost comforting, in a way. I can live with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是有些事情是你无法控制的？在某种程度上，这几乎算是一种安慰了。我可以接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or, no, I guess I won't. Thank you, anyways. I'll wait until you're out of range.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者，不，我想我接受不了。不管怎样，还是谢谢你。我会等你离开爆炸范围的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If someone in the Legion can be as kind as you, then I guess there's hope after all. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团里有人能像你这样善良，那我想还是有希望的。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It isn't your fault. No one can control everything. That's just life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是你的错。没有人能控制一切，这就是生活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess it was naive to expect answers. Well, thanks for talking I guess. Even if didn't last long. I'll wait until you're clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，期待答案是太天真了。嗯，我想谢谢你的谈话，即使没有持续很长时间。我等你安全了再说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm tired of listening to you yap. Your execution's been delayed long enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听腻了你的废话，你的死刑已经拖得够久了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <The suicide bomber has been dealt with.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <自杀式炸弹袭击者已被处理>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Shoots him before he was press the detonator.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <在他按下引爆器之前射杀他>

ESP.ORIGINAL: <The suicide bomber has been dealt with.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <自杀式炸弹袭击者已被处理>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Knock him out.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把他打晕>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but I don't believe you. The NCR lost Solitare, and now I hear they've lost Nelson and Searchlight. Just go. I'll wait until you're clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我不相信你。NCR失去了索利泰尔，现在我听说他们又丢失了纳尔逊和探照灯。快走吧，我等你安全了再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a recognized hero in the NCR, I promise that the NCR will save your family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为NCR公认的英雄，我保证NCR会拯救你的家人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I want to do doesn't matter. I have to do this or the Frumentarii are going to kill my family. Look, just go. I'll wait until you're clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想做什么并不重要。我必须这么做，否则特务会杀了我的家人。听着，快走吧，我等你安全了再说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, you don't really want to do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你不是真的想这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but make it fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但要快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, can you wait until I leave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你能等到我离开吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's over here, boys!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就在这里，伙计们！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't know the Frumentarii! They'll know there's a trick. They always do. They're always watching. They know everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不了解什么是军团特务！他们会知道这里面有诡计。他们总是这样，他们一直在监视，他们什么都知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Speech] Look, these troops have families just like you. I have a plan. No one has to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: [口才]听着，这些军人也和你一样有家庭。我有个计划，没人会死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They told me that if the bomb doesn't go off, then my family will be killed. They said that they have ways of making sure I complete my mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们告诉我，如果炸弹不爆炸，我的家人就会被杀。他们说有办法确保我完成任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Legion actually checking for? What did they tell you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团到底在查什么？他们怎么跟你说的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, no, but they always know. There's probably a Frumentarius right here, right now. They're everywhere. Oh God, they're everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没有，但他们总是知道。可能就在这里，就在此时此刻，他们无处不在。噢，天哪，到处都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, and did they go into how they would know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那他们有没有说他们是怎么知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I.... It's too late for me, but it isn't for you. Please, just run.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...对我来说已经太迟了，但对你来说还来得及。求你了，快跑吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, stay with me. The Legion isn't here. I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，听我说。军团并不在这里，我在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那，我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm not going to let you explode.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不会让你爆炸的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Get clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，快离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [0601019A] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay. I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系的，我理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, tourist. Here's the rules. Don't start fights, don't steal shit, don't bother the brass and stay away from the checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，游客。规则是这样的：不要挑起争端，不要偷东西，不要打扰上级，远离检查站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : NCR Trooper [060102E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You approach that checkpoint, and people are gonna start shooting. Doesn't matter who you are. You could be Kimball himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你靠近那个检查站，人们就会开始开枪。你是谁并不重要，你是金博尔本人也一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : NCR Trooper [060102E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Door doesn't even work from this side anyway. It auto-bolts. Anyways, enjoy your visit to the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正门从这边也开不了，它会自动上锁。总之，好好享受你的水坝之旅吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : NCR Trooper [060102E4] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 类似这样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You the one Crocker sent over? Downstairs, in the offices. She's got a pretty big one near the power plant, so you can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是克罗克派来的那个人？楼下，办公室里。发电厂附近有一个相当大的，所以你不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Colonel Moore summoned me. You know where she is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 摩尔上校叫我来的，你知道她在哪儿吗？
