ESP.ORIGINAL: Had to deal with some security concerns east of the dam ahead of the president's visit. Can never be too careful. Anyways, get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在总统访问之前，必须处理大坝东部的一些安全问题，再小心也不为过。总之，回去工作吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have there been any security concerns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有安全方面的顾虑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. I've been ordered to cooperate with a friendly civilian by Oliver for the duration of President Kimball's visit. Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊。奥利弗命令我在金博尔总统来访期间与一位友好的平民合作，很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want my earnest advice, the Legion is likely to use multiple assassination methods given the failure of the checkpoint bomber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想听我的忠告，考虑到检查站炸弹的失败，军团可能会使用多种暗杀方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There. I've cooperated. Now, leave me alone, and go bother Graham...or Grant, whatever his name is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那里，我很配合了。现在，让我一个人呆着，去找格拉汉姆...或者格兰特，随便他叫什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have there been any security concerns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有安全方面的顾虑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's you. I've been ordered to cooperate with a friendly civilian by Oliver for the duration of President Kimball's visit. Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是你啊。奥利弗命令我在金博尔总统来访期间与一位友好的平民合作，很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The shit that happened last time better not happen this time. The Legion is likely to use an explosive device, given their success at the checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上次发生的事这次最好别再发生了。军团很可能会使用爆炸装置，因为他们在检查站取得了成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There. I've cooperated. Now, leave me alone, and go bother Graham...or Grant, whatever his name is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那里，我很配合了。现在，让我一个人呆着，去找格拉汉姆...或者格兰特，随便他叫什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have there been any security concerns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有安全方面的顾虑？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Nerva is currently drilling the first batch of the Red Okie Centuria at the Castra Legatus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能。涅尔瓦目前正在特使营垒操练新一批的红俄克拉荷马百人长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I speak with Nerva?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以跟涅尔瓦谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the Second Battle of Hoover Dam. Entry to the Castra Legatus is strictly barred to non-military personnel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二次胡佛水坝战役之后。非军事人员严禁进入特使营垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have business with him, then you discuss it with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你和他有生意要谈，那就和我商量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When may I speak to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么时候可以和他说话？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I oversee Legion reinforcements and caravans coming to and from the Castra Legatus. It's a very boring position.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责监督军团的援军和商队进出特使营垒，这是一个非常无聊的职位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legate is currently pulling in all available Centurions to discuss battle strategy, tactics, training and drilling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使目前正在召集所有可用的百夫长讨论作战战略、战术、训练和演习。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They usually go through Malpais instead of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们通常从马尔帕斯走，而不是这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your duties?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I missed my chance to make Centurion due to a bout of dysentery during the Battle of Universidad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。在大学之战中我得了痢疾，错过了成为百夫长的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember the celebrations as they lined the streets of Two-Sun with crucifixes as the resistance there was broken and bloodied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还记得他们在双日城的街道两旁插满了十字架，那里的抵抗力量被击溃，鲜血淋漓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember the joy of the discovery of an ancient gladiatorial ring in what is now the Universitas Caesaris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还记得在现在的凯撒大学发现一枚古老的角斗士戒指时的喜悦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I am old and spent. Decades of combat experience to observe Centurions playing with their concubines and watching refugees rot in the shadow of the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我老了，精疲力竭。几十年的战斗经验，观察百夫长玩弄他们的妻妾，看着难民在大坝的阴影下腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps Lanius will make me a Centurion just before the Battle of Hoover Dam so I may die in frontline service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许拉尼厄斯会在胡佛水坝战役前任命我为百夫长，这样我就可以死在前线了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And not through suicide to escape this absolutely useless outpost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而不是通过自杀来逃离这个毫无用处的前哨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a rather low title for someone of your age.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你这个年纪的人来说，这头衔太低了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Optios are the step below Centurions, who are a step below legates, all of whom are a step below the Legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官比百夫长低一级，百夫长比特使低一级，他们都低于那位特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although, there's only one Legate in the Mojave right now. He reports directly to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，现在莫哈维只有一个特使。他直接向凯撒汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let me correct myself. There is Marcellus Sedonus in Malpais. But, in my view, he is well past his prime and should be retired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，让我纠正一下。马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯在马尔帕斯。但是，在我看来，他早已过了巅峰期，应该退休了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Optio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是执行官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Optios are the step below Centurions, who are a step below legates, all of whom are a step below the Legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官比百夫长低一级，百夫长比特使低一级，他们都低于那位特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although, there's only one Legate in the Mojave right now. He reports directly to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，现在莫哈维只有一个特使。他直接向凯撒汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Optio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是执行官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything to educate the Dissolute on their place in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要能教育浪荡子认识到他们在世界上的地位就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for answering my questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你回答我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's Charlie. Volunteered for this post, poor bastard. He's not really cut out for this post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是查理。自告奋勇来做这个工作，可怜的杂种，他不是这个职位的料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that guy over there? Looks kind of green for this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边那个人是谁？在这里看上去像个新手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He hasn't been well since Omar's band of scumbags came through. He had to man the post all by himself because we were on a one-week fundraising tour.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从奥马尔那帮人渣进来后他就一直不舒服。我们要进行为期一周的筹款巡回活动，所以他必须一个人负责这个职位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He let the bodies lie there for days and hasn't been right since. He's buried himself deep in Tragic: The Garnering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他让尸体在那里躺了好几天，从那以后就一直不对劲，他让自己沉浸在悲剧牌中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't even show interest in hitting Gomorrah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甚至没表现出对蛾摩拉的兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we like him, don't get me wrong. But he's probably a bleeding heart at his core. He should go back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别误会，我们喜欢他。但他可能骨子里是个心肠很软的人，他应该回家去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不是？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shoot anyone who tries to cross the checkpoint. Pretty simple. Orders were issued after the Legion took the spillway during drills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 射杀任何试图通过检查站的人，非常简单。军团在演习中占领了泄洪道后，政府发布了命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You probably haven't been on the Dam long enough. Legion is always looking to pull some shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能在大坝上待的时间还不够，军团总想搞点鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had to execute one of our engineers because he was a Legion spy just yesterday. Wasn't the first time either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昨天不得不处决了我们的一个工程师，因为他是军团的间谍。也不是第一次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyone of those refugees could be a Frumentarius. Anyone of them could try to go out in a blaze of glory and take us with them. It's us or them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些难民中的任何一个都可能是军团特务，他们中的任何一个人都有可能带着我们光荣离开。不是我们死，就是他们亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why won't you let people through the checkpoint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不让人们通过检查站？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You say refugees, I say potential Legion spies. Charlie did absolutely nothing wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说是难民，我说是潜在的军团间谍。查理绝对没有做错什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not one person here would have done anything different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有一个人会做出不同的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Checkpoint Officer Garner [0601035E] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar said that you shot at refugees.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔说你向难民开枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You likely seek a contract of supply. Speak to my superior, Publius Veranus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是在寻求一份补给合同，请找我的上司，普布利乌斯·维拉努斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to discuss the trader up the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来讨论路那边的商人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am of the Frumentarii. You do not need to know anything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一名军团特务，你不需要知道其他的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Flaminius Tarsus, a humble servant of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是弗拉米尼乌斯·塔尔索斯，军团的卑微仆人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生来就是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Childhood is quite mundane. You learn common grammar, sports, religious instruction, practical combat instruction, theater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 童年是很平凡的。你要学习通用语法、运动、宗教指导、实战指导、戏剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, when you hit 16, it's frontline duties. Sometimes you get called earlier, though. I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，当你16岁的时候，就开始前线工作了。不过，有时你会提前接到传唤，我就是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为一名军团士兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a post along the Via Mojave Minor. Lanius allows any new Centurions on their way to the dam as a place of rest before they arrive at his camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是莫哈维小路上的一个前哨。拉尼厄斯允许所有前往大坝的新百夫长在到达他的营地之前休息的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They usually pass through to Malpais for the baths, even after the Chainway collapsed. When they do arrive, we tend to their needs and their concubines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们通常会经过马尔帕斯去洗澡，即使是在连环道坍塌之后。当他们到达时，我们要照顾他们和他们妻妾的需求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not empowered to make decisions on Profligates without the direct approval of my superior. Speak to Publius Veranus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有上级的直接批准，我无权对放荡者做决定。去和普布利乌斯·维拉努斯谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here to discuss the trader up the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来讨论路那边的商人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Antoninus, a servant of the glorious Legion of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是安东尼乌斯，凯撒军团光荣的仆人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legate Lanius has permitted Centurions on their way to his camp three days of rest in Malpais or this checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯特使允许百夫长在前往他营地的途中在马尔帕斯或这个检查站休息三天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The centurions usually pick Malpais, but on the off-chance they don't, we keep guard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 百夫长通常会选择马尔帕斯，但万一他们不选，我们就负责守卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's great. We have everything we need. We know how to fight, how to heal, how to serve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。我们拥有需要的一切，我们知道如何战斗，如何治愈，如何服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have brothers-in-arms which will follow us into battle. We show off superior Legion might every time we are seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有战友，他们会跟随我们一起战斗。每次被人看见，我们都会炫耀军团的强大力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We civilize the world around us, and we make the world a better place for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们教化我们周围的世界，让世界变得更美好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This post is a little boring though. No battles, no actions, just me, Flaminius and Veranus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然这个岗位是有点无聊。没有战斗，没有行动，只有我，弗拉米尼乌斯和维拉努斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like being a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当一名军团士兵是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall tell you only because it is obvious. I am performing reconnaissance on the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我之所以告诉你，只是因为这是显而易见的。我正在对大坝进行侦察。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legate wants any information that may indicate NCR plans for any offensive operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使需要任何可能表明NCR进攻计划的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing on the spillway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在泄洪道上干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, the trader. I saw you talking to him. I know that Nerva and his subordinates are unlikely to provide him passage without some contract of supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，那个商人，我看见你跟他说话了。我知道涅尔瓦和他的部下不可能在没有补给合同的情况下给他提供通道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, you and I can make a deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许，我们可以做个交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar is seeking passage into Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔正在寻求进入军团领地的途径。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My offer is still on the table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的提议仍然有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar is seeking passage into Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔正在寻求进入军团领地的途径。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii protect their friends. Should you perform some action for us, we would be willing to bestow our mark of protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务保护他们的朋友。如果你能为我们做点什么，我们愿意给予我们的保护徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what are you offering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你出什么价？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My superior, Cato Hostilius, has several plans for weakening NCR morale at the dam. Operation Lincoln, Operation Scarcity and Operation Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的上司，加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，有几个计划来削弱大坝上NCR的士气。林肯行动，伤痕之城行动和科罗拉多行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of these, it is Operation Colorado that is of the most interest. It details the assassination of Captain Wire or Colonel Moore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中，最令人感兴趣的是“科罗拉多行动”。它详细描述了对怀尔上尉或摩尔上校的暗杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill one of them, and the Frumentarii will place Omar under our protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了他们中的一个，特务就会把奥马尔置于我们的保护之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm going to need something beyond vague notions. What do you want me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我需要一些不那么模糊的概念。你想让我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A valid response. Come back if you are prepared to use those options. Know that the frumentarii will not grant protection to Omar for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有效的回答。如果你准备使用这些选项，请回来。要知道，特务不会白白给奥马尔提供保护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I'm trying to stay in somewhat good standing the NCR. Keep my options open.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我想和NCR保持良好关系，让我有更多选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, come back here when you have succeeded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，等你成功了再回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wonderful news. We will place Omar under our protection, as agreed. In addition, a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息。我们会按照约定，把奥马尔置于我们的保护之下。此外，还有奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wonderful news. A high-value target to be sure. This will cripple the NCR's ability to hold the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息。一个高价值的目标，这将削弱NCR控制大坝的能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this a reward. As agreed, Omar is under Frumentarii protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个当作奖励吧。按照约定，奥马尔将受到特务的保护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Moore is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 摩尔死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wonderful news. Hopefully, the NCR will panic. They'll be so busy looking for who's responsible, it will make infiltration much easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好消息，希望NCR会感到恐慌。他们会忙着寻找凶手，这样就更容易渗透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion will look favorably upon you for a long time yet. Take this as a reward, and inform Omar that he be under frumentarii protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在很长一段时间内都会对你有好感。收下这个作为奖励，通知奥马尔，他受到了特务的保护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Both Moore and Wire are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 摩尔和怀尔都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time is of the essence for your trader friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你的商人朋友来说，时间是至关重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, he is so screwed. You know he actually gave a speech saying "We've got the bull by the horns, and he can't escape" two days before news about Bullhead broke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，他完蛋了。 你知道吗，在布尔海德沦陷的前两天，他还发表了讲话，说 "我们已经抓住了公牛的犄角，他逃不掉了"。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the midterms are anything to go by, Congress is going to revoke his funding. Vice President also wants to pivot back to Bullhead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果中期选举的情况属实，国会将取消对他的资助。副总统还想回到布尔海德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the other hand, the peace party sort of imploded after that scandal with the Stockmen's Association, so who knows?
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一方面，在斯托克曼协会的丑闻之后，和平党也开始瓦解，谁知道呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That said, whoever wins the Redding senate election will probably be the next leader of that party. War's really unpopular there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说，无论谁赢得瑞丁参议院选举，都有可能成为该党的下一任领导人。战争在那里非常不受欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless of what happens here, I'm not voting for him. He'll probably fuck up this speech, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管这里发生什么，我都不会投他的票。他可能也会搞砸这次演讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0601018E]AZDamNQuest2) ...But You Can't Come In EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your thoughts on President Kimball?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对金博尔总统有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Optio Nerva is not here. He is currently in the Legate's Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 涅尔瓦执行官不在这里，他目前在特使营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a Legion commander named Nerva.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个叫涅尔瓦的军团指挥官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. The Legate has ordered that any non-military personnel of the Legion, barring Caesar himself, are barred from entry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行。特使已经下令，除凯撒本人外，任何非军事人员都不得进入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, one of his subordinates is located at the Hoover Dam Rest Stop south of here. You may communicate your business through him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，他的一个下属就在这里南边的胡佛水坝休息站。你可以通过他来沟通你的业务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Frumentarius [0601035C] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I see him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以见他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean, outside of civilizing the world in the name of Mars? We watch the barges moving back and forth from Camp Willow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说，除了以玛尔斯之名开化世界之外？我们看着驳船在柳树营地来回移动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whenever there aren't any Centurions here, that's about all there is to do. Flaminius plays caravan with Veranus, but I don't really understand the game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要这里没有百夫长，就只能这样了。 弗拉米尼乌斯和维拉努斯一起玩大篷车扑克，但我不太懂这个游戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do for fun here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里都玩什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a medical condition caused by a failure for a soldier to die when his brothers do so. When legionaries die in the cause of Caesar, their souls go the halls of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种医学上的疾病，是由于一名士兵没有在他的兄弟牺牲的时候死去。当军团战士为凯撒牺牲时，他们的灵魂将进入玛尔斯的殿堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In battle, when so many Legionaries' souls travel to the halls, the souls of the still-living Legionaries attempt to do so as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战斗中，当众多军团士兵的灵魂进入大厅时，仍然活着的军团士兵的灵魂也试图这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This happened to me in the Battle of Dry Wells. Three entire contubernia, including my own, were utterly obliterated in the span of several minutes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在枯井战役中就遇到过这种情况。在几分钟的时间里，整整三个十人队，包括我自己的，都被完全消灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My soul was in torment and sent me into visions, tempers and brain fog for days. As such, I was moved to a less active outpost, where I could recover from my mania.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的灵魂饱受折磨，好几天里我都陷入了幻觉、暴躁和脑雾之中。因此，我被转移到了一个不那么活跃的前哨，在那里我可以从我的狂躁中恢复过来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soon, my soul will be purified, and I will join my brothers, where we will serve the Legion even after death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很快，我的灵魂就会得到净化，我将加入我的兄弟们，在那里，即使死后，我们也会为军团效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's "soldier's heart?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是 "士兵心理症"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fun? Sometimes, the Centurions tell us war stories, but we haven't heard many of those in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 消遣？有时，百夫长会给我们讲一些战争故事，但我们已经有一段时间没有听到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do play caravan with Veranus, but Antoninus isn't very good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实和维拉努斯一起玩大篷车扑克，但安东尼乌斯不太擅长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you for fun? When you're not fighting, I mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么消遣？我是说，你们不打仗的时候？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，好啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flaminius [0601030D] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like to play some caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想来一把大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion. It is the only tribe that matters. All are part of the Legion, whether they know it or not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团，这是唯一重要的部落。不管他们是否知道，他们都是军团的一员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those who believe themselves to be outside the Legion are nothing more than inferior dissolute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些自认为不属于军团的人只不过是劣等的浪荡子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is a bunch of tribes, so what tribe did you come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是由多个部落组成的，你来自哪个部落？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dissolute scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放荡的人渣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a load of shit. Who has time to care about all these arbitrary labels?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像一堆狗屎，谁有时间去关心这些武断的标签呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did no such thing. These words have meaning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有做过这种事，这些话是有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion probably sent you here because you spoke out of line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团派你来可能是因为你说话太出格了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is the proper mindset.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是正确的心态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is lucky to have someone so devoted to Caesar's hierarchy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团很幸运能拥有这么忠诚于凯撒等级制度的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To civilize it in Caesar's name, of course. To end degeneracy and profligacy, and to instill obedience and servitude into every man, woman and child.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是以凯撒的名义教化它。结束堕落和挥霍，将顺从和奴役灌输给每一个男人，女人和孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Antoninus [0601033F] (mod) Quest : ([0601031E]AZDamNQuestMiscDialogue) 0601031E (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is the Legion in the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团为什么在莫哈维？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, everything you could possibly want, partner! Labor! Sex! Companionship! Malachi has it all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你想要的都有，伙计！劳动！性！陪伴！玛拉基全都有！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't find higher-quality manpower on the shelves anywhere else, so don't even look!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在其他任何地方的货架上找不到更高质量的人力，所以根本不用看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I could hardly be in business if I didn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果我不这样我的生意就做不下去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let you in on a secret, just 'cause I like you so much. Legion has a contract with me, because they recognize great value when they see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要告诉你一个秘密，就因为我很喜欢你。军团跟我签订了合同，因为他们发现了巨大的价值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I come out here on a regular basis to make deliveries. I'll be heading into Phoenix, so you better take advantage of these prices while they're hot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我定期来这里送货。我要去凤凰城了，所以你们最好趁现在价格便宜！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you make a lot of sales?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的销售额高吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those factories burn through slaves like nothing else, even my high-quality goods. But it isn't just them. Anyone who needs a quality workhand comes to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些工厂对奴隶的摧残是其他任何地方都无法比拟的，即使是我的优质产品。但不仅仅是他们，任何需要优质工人的人都会来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your best business is in Phoenix?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在凤凰城的生意最好？

ESP.ORIGINAL: None as good as me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人能比得上我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Other traders, though? No, not many. There aren't enough savages to support a large and competitive slaver economy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，其他商人呢？不，不是很多。没有足够的野蛮人来支撑一个庞大的、有竞争力的奴隶经济。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The biggest slaver outfits make their catches on the edges of Legion territory, in Mexico and Texas. Everyone else just combs the wastes for tribals the Legion missed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最大的奴隶贩子组织在军团领地的边缘，在墨西哥和德克萨斯进行抓捕。其他人只是在废墟上搜寻军团遗漏的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there other private slave traders in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团里还有其他的私人奴贩吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the million-Denarii question! I can see you've got the spirit of a businessman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个价值百万第纳尔的问题！我看得出你很有商人的精神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Townsfolk keep the money circulating. Without them, the economy would fall apart. Plus, why would I enslave some of my best customers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 市民们让货币保持流通，没有他们，经济将会崩溃。再说，我为什么要奴役我最好的客户？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't slavers just enslave townspeople?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么奴隶贩子不直接奴役城镇居民？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Justify? I don't reckon there is anything to justify. Slavery gives purposes to the weak. It lifts them up and allows them to be a part of something greater than themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 证明？我不认为有什么好证明的。奴隶制给了弱者目标，鼓舞了他们，让他们成为比自身更伟大的事物的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Much better than living in squalor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比生活在肮脏的环境里要好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you justify selling people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如何证明卖人是合理的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trade secret, partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商业机密，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you get these slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪儿弄来这些奴隶的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Come on, there are a lot of tribals, even if I'm the only one who knows how to find them.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]拜托，部落还有很多，就算只有我知道怎么找到他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you capture enough slaves to maintain a contract with the Legion just by hunting tribals?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能仅仅通过狩猎部落就俘获足够多的奴隶来维持与军团的合约呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] How about you stop mouthing off about things you don't understand, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]朋友，你能不能别再对你不懂的事指指点点了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens when you run out slaves to sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没有奴隶可以卖了怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't be impugning my good business here, would you? How about you start talking straight and get to your point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会是在诋毁我的好生意吧？不如你开门见山，直奔主题吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: To capture them all, you'd have to have an army of slavers big enough to rival the Legion. Do they all get a cut of the profit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要想把他们全部拿下，你必须拥有一支足以与军团抗衡的奴隶大军。他们都能分到利润吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tribals or not, slaves are slaves. Maybe I've managed to sidestep the business of hunting them down. So what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管是不是部落，奴隶就是奴隶。也许我已经成功回避了追捕他们的任务，那又怎样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: The efficiency of my operation is second to none. You know why? Because my slaves are born in captivity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的工作效率是首屈一指的。你知道为什么吗？因为我的奴隶是在囚禁中出生的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You only need a few men and a few women. Keep them. You think I'm going to kill my golden goose?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只需要几个男人和几个女人，留着他们就行。你觉得我会杀了我的金鹅吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I let them fuck. I keep them healthy. No harm is done to them. We've been doing it this way for years, before I even had hair on my chin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让他们干炮，我让他们保持健康，他们没有受到过任何伤害。我们这么做已经好几年了，那时我下巴上还没长毛呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you argue with the results?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能对结果提出异议吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: My point is that your story doesn't add up. How are you really getting these slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，你的说法不合常理。你到底是怎么弄到这些奴隶的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for bringing this to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你把这个带给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barry [0600EE0E] (mod) Quest : ([0600EE0F]AZFreeformMcCarran) 0600EE0F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your master. Where is he?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的主人。他在哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. That's the Mark of Caesar. I see. I suppose it's not my place to question Caesar's choice in tools.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，那是凯撒的徽记。原来如此，我想我没资格质疑凯撒对工具的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am tending to this shrine. The sand and the winds do not treat it kindly, and someone must be here to meet the pilgrims.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在照看这座神殿，风沙对它并不友善，必须有人在这里迎接朝圣者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It may be a ruin, but we are very close to the Magnum Chasma. This shrine draws power from that holy land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它可能是废墟，但我们离大裂谷很近。这座神殿是从那片圣地汲取力量的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, it is peaceful here, isn't it? You can truly be alone with Mars. He shows us that he is pleased with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，这里很安静，不是吗？你可以和玛尔斯真正独处。他向我们表示他对我们很满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sends us fires in the sky, and shows us how to sacrifice the brahmin for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他让我们在天空中燃起火焰，教我们如何为他牺牲婆罗门牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is this shrine here? This place is a ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这里会有神殿？这里是一片废墟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are truly interested? Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的感兴趣吗？很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Priestess named Sola made me her apprentice when I was nothing but a slave. I trained to be a Maiden under her guidance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一位名叫索拉的女祭司，在我还是个奴隶的时候，就把我收为徒弟。我在她的指导下受训成为一名女侍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, she died. No other Priestess would take me in, and I could hardly be a Maiden without a Priestess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，她死了。没有其他的女祭司愿意收留我，没有女祭司，我很难成为一名女侍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I felt lost for a time, forsaken by Mars. I begged for forgiveness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我迷失了一段时间，被玛尔斯抛弃了。我乞求原谅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, I learned of this shrine. It was vacant. Its previous caretaker had been murdered by a traveler.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来，我听说了这座神殿。它是空的，它的前任管理员被一个旅行者谋杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew Mars had taken pity on me. I have been here, serving Mars, ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道玛尔斯同情我了。从那以后，我就一直在这里服侍玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sola's decision to sponsor me as a Maiden was controversial.
ESP.TRADUIT: 索拉提议我成为女侍的决定是有争议的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mother was a capture, a Profligate Ranger. My father was a degnerate raider. I am told it was a tragic accident that they met at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我母亲是个俘虏，一个放荡的游骑兵，我父亲是个堕落的掠夺者。我听说他们的相遇是一场悲惨的意外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think of it: a raider bests a Legion patrol and steals a slave for himself. Such a strange thing to happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一下：一个掠夺者击败了军团巡逻队，为自己偷走了一个奴隶。发生了这么奇怪的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion eventually recovered my mother, pregnant. She later died during my birth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团最终救回了我怀孕的母亲，她后来在我出生的时候去世了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you can imagine, many of the women believed I was cursed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以想象，很多女人认为我被诅咒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why wouldn't any Priestesses take you in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么没有女祭司收留你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars is the architect of everything you see around you. The rocks, the plants, all of it is His creation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火星是你周围一切事物的创造者。岩石，植物，所有的一切都是他创造的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In return for having given us this world, Mars asks us to behave righteously and with good intention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为给予我们这个世界的回报，玛尔斯要求我们以正义和善意行事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To honor him. To purge the world of those who dishonor him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尊崇他，清除世界上那些玷污他的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, specifically, does Mars ask of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 具体来说，玛尔斯要求你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Road's closed?" You mean the Legion aren't letting anyone through?
ESP.TRADUIT: “道路封闭？”你是说军团不让任何人通过？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ye really ain't heard? Ol' Chain-Way's bit the dust, she did. Big earthquake 'swhat I heard, but tain't what I woulda' guessed to be honest wi'cha.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的没听说吗？老连环道已经寿终正寝了啦，真的。我听到的是大地震哦，不过说实话，我猜不是这样的啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it don't make a lick o' difference to me why it went the way it did. All's I know is'at folks don't come round no more on account o' it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过咧，事情为什么会变成这样哦，对我来说一点也不重要啦。我知道的就是说，人们不再来这里了哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know. I had a great view of that shitshow while the geckos were chewing my leg off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我知道。 蜥蜴把我的腿咬断的时候我看得一清二楚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, uh... Wha'd'ya mean? Where ye comin' from, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下，呃...你是什么意思啦？话说回来，你到底是哪里来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn! I thought the Legion would have finally gotten rid of you ugly fucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死！我还以为军团终于可以摆脱你们这些丑陋的家伙了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoa...! Heheheh, now how's that a way to greet a friendly face out here where friends're so few? I'm jus' tryin' to make a livin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇哦...！嗬嗬嗬，在这种朋友这么少的地方哦，这算什么友好的问候方式啊？ 我只是想"混"口饭吃而已啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, but the road south *is* open then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，那南边的路是开放的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh.... Yup, last I heard. But then ye'd know better than I would, wouldn'cha? Where ye comin' from, anyway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...是啦，我最后听说的啦。但你会比我更清楚，对不对啦？话说回来，你到底是哪里来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My apologies. I didn't mean to hurt your feelings, my good man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。我不是有意伤害你感情的，我的好兄弟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: S'okay. I understand ye come a long way only to be stuck wich'is ol' ghoul. Why don'cha stay awhile and enjoy the cool air?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的啦。我知道你远道而来却被一个老尸鬼困住了哦。你为什么不多待一会儿，享受一下凉爽的空气呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And ye can take a shower and git that nasty stink outta ye, ye stupid, ugly smoothskin son'a'a'bitch! Heheheh now that don't feel so good, do it kid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去洗个澡啦，把身上的臭味弄掉哦，你这又蠢又丑的狗娘养的滑皮！ 嗬嗬嗬，现在感觉不太好了吧，孩子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You won't get any business from me, you stinking old zombie creep. I'm getting out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会跟你做生意的，你个臭僵尸。我要离开这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. Good riddance, asshole. Don't bother crawling back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。总算解脱了，混蛋。别费劲爬回来了哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard it was sabotage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说是破坏活动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt et. I've seen et all. Rangers long gone. And thees Support Unit Hoover? Haven't seen them in years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑，我什么都见过了。游骑兵早就走了，胡佛支援小队？很多年没见了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don know that et mit have been. Seems like everythin's fallin' apart these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我们曾经有过什么。这年头好像一切都崩坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what are you still doing out here? This some kind
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你还在这里干什么？这些

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维加斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You crossed the 'Rado? Must 'ave some powerful friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你穿过了无线电？你一定有一些有权有势的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodsprings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 清泉镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neva' heard o' it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 涅瓦听到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another bounty hunter. Tellin' ya now. I got no alcohol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又一个赏金猎人。我现在就告诉你，我没有酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... I suppose I should'a guessed as much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢...我想我应该猜到了啦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 南方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... where in the south?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好啦...南边的什么地方哦？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... Alright then. Keep yer secrets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...好嘛。保守你的秘密哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 北方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pardon me? Thought I jus' heard ye say ye came from the north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么？我刚才听到你说你是从北方来的哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坟墓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I hate to be the one to tell ye this, but'cha must 'ave come full circle. This here's *my* grave! And by the smell of ye, it'll be yer's too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我不愿意告诉你这些，但你肯定是绕了一个圈子。这里是我的坟墓！从你的气味来看，也会是你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know all about it... Just need a drink.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都知道了...我只想喝一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, say no more, friend. What can I get'cha?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，别再说了啦，朋友。你想要点什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really in the mood to chat, ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在没心情聊天，食尸鬼。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heheheh, okay then. So then what *are* ye in the mood fer, smoothskin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗬嗬嗬，那好哦。那么你现在想要什么呢，滑皮？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, kid. Here's what I got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没问题啦，孩子。这是我有的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to open a tab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想开个帐单。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a looksie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看咯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me what you got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't much, but it's better than nothin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然不多啦，但总比什么都没有强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have to drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么喝的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't want to talk about it anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正我也不想谈这事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我还有别的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bear. I'm the leader of the Rusty Hooks. I ensure our contract with the Legion continues smoothly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊。我是锈钩帮的头头，我保证我们和军团的合同顺利进行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The name is Bear. I'm the second-in-command here. I handle our contact with the Legion, trade negotiations, and generally make sure everyone is on the same page.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字叫大熊，我是这里的二把手。我负责与军团的联系，贸易谈判，确保所有人都能达成一致。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to provide security for a trade outfit called Los Alamos Co-op. I suppose I got bored of that, so I quit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前给一个叫洛斯阿拉莫斯合作社的贸易组织当保安。我想我已经厌倦了，所以我辞职了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, I met Kyle, and he made me an offer I couldn't refuse. I've been with him ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，我遇到了凯尔，他给了我一个我无法拒绝的条件。从那以后我就和他一起混了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么到这里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understand that most of your kind are afraid of Super Mutants. Even the humans who say they're tolerant will cringe when they see us up close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要知道你们大多数人都害怕超级变种人。即使是那些自称宽容的人类，在近距离看到我们时也会畏缩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries, on the other hand, respect strength. What's stronger than a Super Mutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 而另一方面，军团士兵崇尚力量。还有什么比超级变种人更强大？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't take me seriously as a human being, but that's fine with me. They can talk to Kyle and I can stand around looking scary. Better that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不把我当人看，但这对我来说很好。他们可以和凯尔说话，而我可以站在一旁，看起来很吓人。这样比较好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion have a problem with you being a Super Mutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对你是超级变种人没意见吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thinking isn't my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 思考不是我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're a powerful army. Very impressive. They pay well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是一支强大的军队，非常令人印象深刻。他们的工资很高。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do *you* think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: *你*对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We do whatever they ask. We're not exactly in a privileged position, so saying 'no' isn't an option.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让我们做什么我们就做什么。我们并不完全处于特权地位，所以说“不”不是一个选项。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of work do you do for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为军团做什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你觉得呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle and Sid certainly won't make it. Me, I'll die one way or another. Jillian might be alright, she's knowledgable enough to be an asset, but chances aren't great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔和锡德肯定撑不过去。我呢，无论如何都会死的。吉莉安可能还好，她的知识足够让她成为线人，但可能性不大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To put it bluntly, we're already in the process of our own extermination. I can only prolong our usefulness and hope for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说白了，我们已经在自我毁灭的过程中了。我只能尽可能延长我们的作用，希望能有好的结果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell the others I said that, though. Jillian always gets moody about it and I don't want to upset her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，别告诉其他人我这么说过。吉莉安对此总是闷闷不乐，我不想让她难过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, Kyle broke our generator last time the topic came up. It was a pain to fix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，上次提到这个话题的时候凯尔弄坏了我们的发电机。修理起来很痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens if you stop doing work for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不再为军团工作了呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sid told you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡德告诉你的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please listen carefully: you cannot tell anyone else about this. Kyle may seem foolish to you, but he is cunning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请仔细听好：你不能把这件事告诉任何人。凯尔可能在你看来很蠢，但他其实很狡猾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not just me in danger now, it's Sid, and you too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在危险的不只是我，还有锡德，还有你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sid told me about the bomb Kyle planted in your heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡德跟我说了凯尔在你心脏里放炸弹的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your heart bomb...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你心脏上的炸弹...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a caravan guard in New Mexico. The Rusty Hooks ambushed us one day, and I fought back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在新墨西哥州当过商队警卫。有一天，锈钩帮伏击了我们，我反击了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must've killed six of them, but they had riddled me so full of bullets that I passed out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我肯定杀了其中六个人，但他们把我打得千疮百孔，我昏过去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I came to, I felt this pressure in my chest, like a cage around my heart. Kyle was standing over me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我醒过来的时候，我感到胸口有一种压力，就像一个笼子包围着我的心脏。凯尔站在我跟前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told me that he had planted a bomb inside me, and that he could detonate it whenever he wanted. But if I were to become his protector, his guard dog, he'd let me live.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我，他在我体内安置了一颗炸弹，他可以随时引爆它。但如果我成为他的保护者，他的看门狗，他会让我活下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know life as a mutant probably doesn't seem like much to you smoothskins, but I didn't want to die. I still don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道变种人的生活对你们滑皮来说可能没什么意义，但我不想死。我还是不想死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, how did Kyle manage to put a bomb inside you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，凯尔是怎么在你体内放炸弹的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think I haven't thought of that? If his heart stops beating, the bomb detonates. It uses some sort of radio frequency.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为我没想过吗？如果他心脏停止跳动，炸弹就会引爆。它使用某种无线电频率。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And even failing that, the rest of the Hooks would kill me for trying to start a mutiny. Kyle may be stupid, but he's still the leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算没爆炸，锈钩的其他人也会因为我想造反而杀了我。凯尔也许很蠢，但他还是老大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you just kill Kyle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不杀了凯尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back before my time, the Rusty Hooks used to do a thing called a pack fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我还没来的时候，锈钩帮经常进行一种叫帮斗的活动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Hook would challenge the gang's current leader to a one-on-one fight, and the winner would take the throne.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个钩子将挑战该团伙的现任领导人并进行一对一的战斗，获胜者将获得王位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we could briefly disable the bomb frequency somehow, I could challenge him to a pack fight and win leadership of the Hooks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们能以某种方式短暂地屏蔽炸弹频率，我就可以挑战他，与他进行一场帮斗，并赢得锈钩的领导权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if Kyle dies in our fight, I wouldn't have to worry about the bomb ever again. It would be a tragic accident. It's what happens when a human fights a Super Mutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果凯尔在我们的战斗中死亡，那我就再也不用担心炸弹了。这将是一场悲惨的意外，是人类与超级变种人战斗的结果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then how do we get rid of Kyle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们怎么除掉凯尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle is the muscle and the brains behind the operation. I just keep his workload light. Things function best that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔是整个行动的主谋，我只是帮他减轻工作量。这样事情运行得最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you do the work of a first-in-command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你在做一把手的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jillian. Is there a reason you're bothering me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 吉莉安，你来烦我有什么原因吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm an engineer. You know, mechanical equipment, old tech, stuff like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是工程师。你知道的，机械设备，老技术，诸如此类的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, yes. The Legion scavenges a lot of tech that they don't know how to get working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，很大。军团收集了很多他们不知道如何使用的科技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They buy from those ghouls in New Mexico, too. And the necrotic shitheads aren't going to fix the stuff that breaks, so it becomes our job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们也从新墨西哥的食尸鬼那里买。这些大脑坏死的白痴不会去修复坏掉的东西，所以这就成了我们的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are engineers in high demand in Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团领土上的工程师需求量大吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保留地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're mostly arms dealers, but they're slavers and religious fanatics too. Fucking animals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们大多是军火商，但也有奴隶贩子和宗教狂热分子。该死的畜生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls in New Mexico?
ESP.TRADUIT: 新墨西哥的尸鬼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, how about the fact that they put an explosive collar around my neck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果他们在我脖子上套了个爆炸项圈呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I swear, if Caesar marched in there and crucified them all, the world would be better for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发誓，如果凯撒冲进去把他们都钉死在十字架上，世界会因此变得更美好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your problem with The Reservation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对保留地有什么意见？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've known each other since we were kids in El Burque. Joined a gang together and hit the wastes. Had a couple years of fun before Caesar showed up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还是孩子的时候在阿尔伯克基就认识了。一起加入帮派，四处闯荡。在凯撒出现之前，我们玩了几年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When The Reservation put a collar around my neck, it was Kyle who tracked me down and ambushed the caravan. Not even the big mutant scared him off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保留地给我套上项圈的时候，是凯尔跟踪我伏击了商队。即使是大变种人也没能把他吓跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to know Kyle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么认识凯尔的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle did what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔做了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No... I can't. I won't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不...我不能。我不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did Bear tell you why he joined the Rusty Hooks? He was guarding the Reservation slaver caravan that was transporting me to my new owner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊告诉你他为什么加入锈钩帮了吗？他当时在看守着把我送到新主人那里的保留地奴隶商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He may be a nice guy now, but what if it's a lie? What if he's just waiting for the chance to kill us all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他现在是个好人，但如果那是谎言呢？万一他只是在伺机杀光我们呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle put a bomb in Bear's heart. Can you defuse it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔在大熊的心脏里放了颗炸弹。你能拆除吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About Bear's heart bomb...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于大熊心脏上的炸弹...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. Fucking hell. What about Kyle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，真他妈见鬼。那凯尔呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know Bear well enough to know that he wouldn't hurt you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很了解大熊，知道他不会伤害你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because Bear is a Super Mutant doesn't mean he's a savage. Some of them are good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊是个超级变种人并不意味着他就一定是个野蛮人。有些还是不错的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus Christ. Fine. Alright. I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天在上，很好。好吧，我来做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll do it in my shop
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在我店里弄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie> Bear won't hurt Kyle.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>大熊不会伤害凯尔的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A pack fight? That's ancient history. We haven't done that sort of thing since Byrd.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮斗？那是古老的历史了。伯德之后我们就没做过这种事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And... fuck! Just look at them. Bear is three times Kyle's size. A pack fight will kill him!
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且...操！看看他们，大熊的体型是凯尔的三倍。帮斗会要了他的命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bear wants to invoke a pack fight and take Kyle's throne.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊想发动一场帮斗，夺取凯尔的王位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then figure something out. I won't let Kyle die because of some stupid mistake he made years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就想办法。我不会让凯尔因为几年前犯的愚蠢错误而死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I can't do it. If Bear is gonna fight Kyle, I won't disarm his bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我做不到。如果大熊要和凯尔决斗，我不会拆除他的炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle is important to me, and I won't let Bear fuck it all up just because he can't abide by servitude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔对我很重要，我不会因为大熊无法忍受奴役就把一切都搞砸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a way to keep Bear from killing Kyle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么办法能让大熊不杀凯尔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Lemme take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。让我看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair my stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能修我的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly tools and parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是工具和零件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I got you figured all wrong, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我完全看错你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Kyle, and this is my crew. We're the Rusty Hooks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是凯尔，这是我的团队。我们是锈钩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was granted to me by Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是凯撒赐予我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're a gang. Stick-ups, robberies, caravan raids, ransoms. Everything a gang does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是一个帮派。抢劫，掠夺，商队袭击，勒索。帮派会做的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Used to hang around New Mexico, on the outskirts of Albosqkayqe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去常在新墨西哥的阿尔波凯奇郊区闲逛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the Rusty Hooks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 锈钩是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ABQ, man. I think the Legion's calling it Albus Quercus now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔伯克基，老兄。我想军团现在管它叫阿尔布斯奎勒库斯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, Albosqkayqe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，阿尔波凯奇？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Less useful ones, sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么用的一个，当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought the Legion destroyed gangs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为军团消灭了帮派。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do *you* do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: *你*在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: We do anything that needs doing. If the Legion can't handle it, we take care of it. Slave recovery, tech wizardry, repairs, retrofits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做任何需要做的事。如果军团处理不了，就交给我们。奴隶恢复，技术魔法，修理，翻新。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what an RobCo encabulator is? No, you probably don't, and the Legionaries don't either. But I do. That's why they come to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道罗科增压机是什么吗？不，你可能不知道，军团也不知道。但我知道，这就是他们来找我的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's Bear. He's my second-in-command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是大熊。他是我的副手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a beast, even for a Super Mutant. I once saw him fight two deathclaws off with only his bare hands. Even killed one of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使作为超级变种人来说，他也是一头野兽。我曾经看到他赤手空拳打跑了两头死亡爪，甚至杀了其中一头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the only person here with enough sense to respect me as a leader. Whatever I want, he makes happen. So don't cross me, or Bear will fuck you up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是这里唯一一个有足够理智，尊重我领导地位的人。无论我想要什么，他都能实现。所以别跟我作对，否则大熊会毁了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with the super mutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个超级变种人是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck no I don't. Do I look like Alice McFlannerty? Go bother Sid about that shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈才没有呢。我长得像爱丽丝·麦克弗兰纳蒂吗？去烦锡德吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah, I could. But I'm not going to. Maybe Sid will, or Jillian. Get them to do your chores. I'm busy running a gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的，我可以，但我不打算这么做。也许锡德会，或者吉莉安会，让他们来帮你做家务。我正忙着管理一个帮派。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair some of my stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我修几件东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably because the high-level strategic shit I'm doing mentally is just too much for you to grasp. It's called multi-tasking. Now fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是因为我脑子里想的那些高级战略对你来说太难理解了，这就是所谓的多任务处理。现在滚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't look very busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来不太忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，老兄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry for asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉打扰了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not gonna shit on the hand that feeds me. They pay on time and in full. That's as close as I'll ever get to being gainfully employed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不会在喂养我的手上拉屎。他们按时足额付款，这是我最接近有报酬的工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Different than it is now, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和现在不一样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the Legion, our leader was a guy named Byrd. He had this big fat iron hook where his left hand was supposed to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在加入军团之前，我们的领袖是一个叫伯德的家伙。他本应是左手的地方挂着个大铁钩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things were looser. We could smoke and get high. Byrd didn't give a shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都变得松散。我们可以抽烟嗑药，伯德根本不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'd hit caravans, rob farmsteads. One of my favorite things to do was something we called slavejacking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们袭击商队，抢劫农场。我最喜欢做的事情之一是我们称之为“奴隶抢劫”的活动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slavery is huge in El Burque. Someone was always delivering slaves somewhere. We'd find a good spot to lay low, then pop an ambush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在阿尔伯克基，奴隶制盛行，总有人在某地运送奴隶。我们要找个隐蔽的好地方，然后设个埋伏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bam bam, pop pop. Guards are dead and the cargo is ours. We deliver it and get the money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘭嘭，砰砰，卫兵都死了，货物是我们的了。我们送过去，拿到钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't do something like that anymore, though. Not if you like your head attached to your body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我不能再做这样的事了，如果你还喜欢头和身体连在一起的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was life like before the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加入军团之前的生活是怎样的？
