ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion killed him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团杀了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's actually funny in hindsight, because I was gonna kill him myself. I had it all planned out. Bear was going to back me up and everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事后想想还挺有趣的，因为我本来想亲手杀了他。我什么都计划好了，大熊会支持我的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the Legion cornered us, they covered Byrd in gasoline and burned him. They asked the rest of us why we shouldn't get the same treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团把我们逼入绝境时，他们在伯德身上浇了汽油，然后烧死了他。他们问我们其他人为什么我们不应该得到同样的待遇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was the only one who spoke up. I don't even remember what I said, but they seemed pleased. I guess that's why we're alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是唯一一个站出来说话的人，我甚至不记得我说了什么，但他们看起来很高兴。我想这就是我们活着的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Byrd?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伯德怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck them. Degenerate losers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操他们的，堕落的失败者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jillian's the only one I can stand. Sid's a moron. Bear is totally wrapped around my finger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能忍受的只有吉莉安。锡德是个白痴，大熊完全被我玩弄于股掌之间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest of these losers are still raiders at heart. It's a miracle the Legion didn't enslave them, or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剩下的失败者本质上还是掠夺者。军团没有奴役他们或者更糟，真是个奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about the other Rusty Hooks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得其他锈钩怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I think it's really sweet how you take care of your crew. These people would be lost without you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，我觉得你照顾成员的方式真的很贴心。没有你，这些人会不知所措。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm really not the guy you want to talk to. Talk to Kyle, or Bear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我真的不是你想找的人。跟凯尔或大熊谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I mostly just hold a gun and look scary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我通常只是拿着枪，看起来很吓人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to do repairs, but Jillian's way better at that stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前是做维修的，但吉莉安做得比我好多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sure! I can probably find something around here worth selling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然！我应该能在这附近找到一些值得出售的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just asked. Byrd told me to prove my worth, so I robbed a pawn shop. I brought back the loot and he said welcome aboard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是问问而已。伯德让我证明自己的价值，所以我抢劫了一家当铺。我把赃物带回来，他说欢迎加入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things were easier back then. We drank and smoked and fucked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时候的生活比较简单。我们喝酒，抽烟，打炮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: God, I miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我真怀念。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you join the Rusty Hooks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么加入锈钩帮的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It's easy to say I hate them, but maybe we deserve them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。说我恨他们很容易，但也许是我们罪有应得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're just dumbshit raiders. We always have been. We robbed people, killed people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只是些愚蠢的掠夺者，我们一直都是。我们抢劫，杀人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then the Legion shows up and tells us we can't do it anymore. They hang the old leader from a cross and put Kyle in charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后军团出现了，告诉我们不能再这么做了。他们把老首领吊死在十字架上，让凯尔掌权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now things are safer, and we can't hurt people anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在安全多了，我们不能再伤害别人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what guilt is. I just do what it takes to survive, and it turns out that surviving isn't so great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道什么是罪恶感。我只是尽我所能活下来，而事实证明，活下来也并不是那么美好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel guilty about being a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得作为一名掠夺者有罪恶感吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're expressing some thoughts that are dangerously close to suicidal ideation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你表达了一些非常接近自杀的想法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you're right. Everything sucks, forever. Just gotta get over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你说得对。一切都很糟糕，永远如此。只要克服它就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Life is hard. Suck it up and move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生活很艰难。接受现实，继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to listen to some junkie complain? 'Boo-hoo, I can't do jet anymore because the Legion would kill me.' That's what you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想听什么瘾君子抱怨吗？“呜呜，我不能再磕杰特了，因为军团会杀了我的。”这就是你想要的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're chest-deep in shit. Kyle's been going through withdrawals for four months, Jillian is getting old, and Bear's a fucking walking timebomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都深陷泥潭。凯尔已经戒毒四个月了，吉莉安也老了，大熊他妈的是个活定时炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're fucked. Once Jillian gets too old and ugly for the Legion, that's it. They're going to fucking kill us and we'll deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们完蛋了。一旦吉莉安对军团来说又老又丑，那就完了。他们会杀了我们，这是我们应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to talk about it, I'm all ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想聊聊，我洗耳恭听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? I don't remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我怎么不记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was that you said about Bear being a timebomb?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说大熊是个定时炸弹是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucking stupid motherfucker can't shut up. I just can't shut up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的这个傻逼怎么就是闭不上嘴呢，我就是闭不上嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bear has a bomb in his chest. Is that what you wanted to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大熊的胸口有个炸弹。这就是你想知道的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I put it there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我放的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha, wow! That's a weight lifted off my shoulders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈，哇哦！这让我如释重负。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I put it there, right next to his heart. Kyle told me to, so I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我放的，就在他的心脏旁边。凯尔让我这么做的，我就这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did that happen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because Bear is a massive Super Mutant and Kyle wanted him on our side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为大熊是一个巨大的超级变种人，凯尔想让他站在我们这边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obviously, we couldn't just ask him. Kyle isn't really a people person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然，我们不能直接问他。凯尔不太喜欢与人打交道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we stop talking about this? It's better left forgotten.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能不谈这个了吗？最好把它忘了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did Kyle want you to put a bomb in Bear's chest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔为什么要你在大熊胸口放炸弹？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truly? That would be excellent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？那就太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's do it without delay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们立即行动吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Given your physiology, it should be easy enough to remove the bomb from your chest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据你的生理机能，把炸弹从你胸口取出应该很容易。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's okay. We'll think of something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没关系。我们再想想别的办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can try taking the bomb out, if you want. How hard can it be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意，我可以试着把炸弹取出来。这能有多难？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can manage that, it would be the perfect opportunity to initiate a pack fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能做到这一点，这将是发起帮斗的绝佳机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can create a frequency jammer for the bomb with a sensor module and some scrap electronics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以用传感器模块和一些电子废料为炸弹制造一个频率干扰器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take all the time you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要多少时间都行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the sensor module and the scrap electronics. Let's create a bomb jammer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿到了传感器模块和电子废料，我们来制造一个炸弹干扰器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you'd need a sensor module and some scrap electronics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你需要一个传感器模块和一些电子废料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did I need for the bomb jammer again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 炸弹干扰器需要什么来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, no. I don't think it does. I'd prefer not to bet my life on tin foil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，不，我不这么认为。我可不想把命押在锡纸上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't tin foil block frequencies? We can try that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡箔难道不能干扰频率吗？我们可以试试。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are only two people in this camp who would know how to disarm the bomb. Jillian and Sid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个营地里只有两个人知道如何解除炸弹。吉莉安和锡德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jillian doesn't know about the bomb, but if you tell her, she should be easy enough to convince. I hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吉莉安不知道炸弹的事，但如果你告诉她，她应该很容易被说服。我希望如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sid put the bomb in there, but I don't know if he knows how to disarm it. He's unreliable. If he revealed the bomb's existence to you, he must be feeling guilty. Use that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 炸弹是锡德安放的，但我不清楚他是否知道怎么拆除，他不可靠。但如果他向你透露了炸弹的存在，他一定很内疚。利用这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go talk to them and see if you can't find a way to convince them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去和他们谈谈，看看你是否能找到说服他们的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and thank you. I appreciate it. Truly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有谢谢你。我很感激，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we just need to disarm the bomb long enough for the pack fight. How do we do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我们只需要干扰炸弹足够长的时间来进行帮斗。我们该怎么做呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think about it some more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我再考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me? I don't know how!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？我不知道怎么拆！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I put it in there a long time ago. I was so fucking high that it felt like I could touch numbers. There's no way I'll be able to figure it out now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很久以前放的。我当时嗑药磕得太他妈嗨了，感觉都能摸到数字了。我现在不可能弄明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you really want me to do it, you need to get me some chems. Three boxes of mentats... and an amp of jet. That should be enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你真想让我这么做，你得给我弄点药。三盒曼他特...还有一箱杰特。这应该够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you won't be able to find that shit easily. Not in Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你不会那么容易找到的，军团的地盘上没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to disarm Bear's heart bomb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你解除大熊的心脏炸弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank fucking god.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢天谢地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, give me a little while and I'll see what I can get working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给我点时间，我看看能找到什么办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have your jet and mentats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有你要的杰特和曼他特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three boxes of mentats and some fucking jet! You want Bear's heart bomb disabled, go get me the chems. Hurry! I'm salivating just thinking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三盒曼他特和一箱杰特！你想拆除大熊的心脏炸弹，就去给我拿药来。快点！一想到它我就流口水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sid [06009785] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did I need to do again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还需要做什么来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... unfortunate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这...真不幸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leaving Kyle alive is not an option. As long as he's alive, he'll be able to detonate the bomb in my heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让凯尔活着是不可能的。只要他还活着，他就能引爆我心脏里的炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I'm ever to be free, Kyle needs to die. He dies during the pack fight, while the bomb is disarmed. I won't accept anything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我想重获自由，凯尔必须死。他在帮斗中死亡，炸弹也被拆除，别的我都不接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jillian won't disarm your heart bomb unless you promise not to kill Kyle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你保证不杀凯尔，否则吉莉安不会拆除你的心脏炸弹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She did well. She couldn't disable it permanently, but she managed to jam it for a time. We have an opening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她做得很好。 她没能让它永久失效，但她成功地干扰了它一段时间。我们有机会了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did Jillian do with the bomb?
ESP.TRADUIT: 吉莉安是怎么处理炸弹的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I whipped up a jammer for the bomb's radio frequency, but it won't last forever. In the meantime, I recommend finding a doctor to get that thing out of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做了一个炸弹无线电频率干扰器，但它不能一直使用。同时，我建议找个医生把那东西取出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jillian [06009777] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you ready for the pack fight?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备好参加帮斗了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kyle! I refuse to tolerate being your slave any longer. I challenge you to a pack fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯尔！我再也不能忍受做你的奴隶了。我向你发起帮斗的挑战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck are you talking about? Are you forgetting your place here? I own you. You are my puppet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的你在说什么？你忘了自己在这里的位置了？我拥有你，你是我的傀儡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不再是了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bear [06009779] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the fuck told you that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁他妈告诉你的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it true that you put a bomb in Bear's chest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的在大熊的胸膛里放了颗炸弹吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah right. I'll have to pay that little fuck a visit and remind him what that kind of accusatious bullshit does for group cohesion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，没错。我得去拜访一下那个小混蛋提醒他这种指责性的屁话对团队凝聚力有多大影响。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... not Sid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...不是锡德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What-the-fuck-ever. You bring that up again, and you're not walking out of this camp alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈又怎么了。你再提起这件事，你就别想活着离开这个营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody told me anything. I just have good intuition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人告诉我任何事，只是我的直觉很准。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to believe that loser? Give me a break.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要相信那个废物吗？饶了我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kyle the Hook [06009775] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 锡德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Solitare internment camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是索利泰尔拘留营。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or do you mean the town? It too is Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者你指的是小镇？这也是索利泰尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of our caravans pass through this town on their way to the Fort. Presently, you could say its importance is in flux.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们所有的商队在去堡垒的路上都会经过这个小镇。目前，你可以说它的重要性在不断变化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our best Scribonii have moved here from Malpais so as to monitor transport along the highway more closely, though our regional command still resides in Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好的书记官已从马尔帕斯搬到了这里，以便更密切地监测公路沿线的交通情况，但我们的地区指挥部仍在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm of the opinion that we should abandon Malpais altogether in favor of Solitare. Malpais brings us bad luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意见是，我们应该完全放弃马尔帕斯，转而选择索利泰尔。马尔帕斯会给我们带来厄运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Solitare play a big role in the Legion's war effort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔在军团的战争中扮演的角色重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As big a role as it can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽其所能扮演重要角色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our best Scribonii have moved here from Malpais so as to monitor transport along the highway more closely, though our regional command still resides in Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最好的书记官已从马尔帕斯搬到了这里，以便更密切地监测公路沿线的交通情况，但我们的地区指挥部仍在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm of the opinion that we should abandon Malpais altogether in favor of Solitare. Malpais brings us bad luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意见是，我们应该完全放弃马尔帕斯，转而选择索利泰尔。马尔帕斯会给我们带来厄运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Solitare play a big role in the Legion's war effort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔在军团的战争中扮演的角色重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Dominicus Rex. I am Suboptio to Flavius Constantinus, who serves the Veteran Centurions that serve Legatus Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是多米尼库斯·勒克斯。我是弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯的副手，他是侍奉拉尼厄斯的老兵百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As he is their chief representative in Malpais, I am the third-most senior commander of the 480 men who hold this town and its surrounding area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他是他们在马尔帕斯的首席代表，所以我是控制这座城镇及其周边地区的480名士兵的第三高级指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Purging Solitare of its rot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 净化索利泰尔的腐朽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dissidents. Rebellion. Some weeks ago, two Rangers launched an operation from inside the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 异见者，叛乱。几周前，两名游骑兵在镇上发起了一次行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was my job to figure out how this happened. How did they get here? Who harbored them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的工作就是弄清楚事情是怎么发生的，他们是怎么到这里来的？谁窝藏了他们？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I received my answers, I delivered judgment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我得到答案的时候，我做出了判断。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What rot is there in Solitare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔有什么腐朽的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since the interview, as I have told you, Solitare has been a beacon of stability and order. Yes, I can safely say it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从那次采访之后，正如我说过的，索利泰尔已经成为了稳定和秩序的灯塔。是的，我可以放心地说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rot has been purged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 腐败已经清除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Has the "rot" been purged yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: “腐败”被清除了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cleaning up the last of the rot. As I promised, order has been restored.
ESP.TRADUIT: 清理最后的腐败，正如我所承诺的，秩序已经恢复。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I create results for my Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我为我的军团创造成果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you killed all these people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这些人都是你杀的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We already spoke on this. You made your stance clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经谈过这个问题了，你已经表明了自己的立场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You killed all of these people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些人都是你杀的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Then we can meet as equals on this issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，那么我们就可以平等地讨论这个问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand why you did what you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能理解你为什么那么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you do not have a cause you would kill for, you are nothing more than an animal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没有一个你愿意为之杀人的理由，你就只不过是一只动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't have to kill innocent people just because of two Rangers' actions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没必要因为两个游骑兵的行为而杀害无辜的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are those who withheld information pertaining to the Rangers, or otherwise impeded our investigation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们隐瞒了与游骑兵有关的信息，或者妨碍了我们的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They will be enslaved and sent somewhere far from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会被奴役，送到离这里很远的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are those people in the cage?
ESP.TRADUIT: 笼子里的那些是什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For your sake, I will assume you mean Sedonus, and not the Burned Man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为你着想，我猜你指的是塞多尼乌斯，而不是那个被烧伤的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is fine. He will be replaced by Lanius soon regardless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很好。无论如何，他很快就会被拉尼厄斯取代。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Malpais Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得马尔帕斯特使怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because you were granted an interview in the past does not give you the right to ask these questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在过去获得了采访机会并不意味着你有资格问这些问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Malpais Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得马尔帕斯特使怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because you were granted an interview in the past does not give license to ask that question now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在过去获得了采访机会并不意味着你现在有资格问这些问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man is nothing but a failure. That is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人就是个失败者，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating question. I play chess with anyone who will have me: Decani, Frumentarii, our Optio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣的问题。我和任何愿意跟我下棋的人下棋：什长、特务、我们的执行官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One can say what they will about the Frumentarii, but facing them in a game of strategy makes it clear that they operate on a level above most men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们可以随意对特务说三道四，但在战略游戏中面对他们，就能清楚地看到他们的行动水平高于大多数人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you like to do for fun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢做什么消遣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it doesn't interest me. It can tell us nothing of strategy, only that the man with the best cards wins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不感兴趣。它不能告诉我们什么策略，只会告诉我们牌最好的人赢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you play caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure do! Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然有！看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything to trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可以交易的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Solitare. Before the Legion came, we mostly traded in water, since we're so close to the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是索利泰尔。在军团来之前，我们主要靠水贸易，因为我们离河很近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, we're more of a defensive fortification.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们更像是防御工事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Legion. Some people got uppity again. It happens sometimes. Just gotta try to keep your head down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，军团，有些人又嚣张起来了。这种情况时有发生，你只要低调点就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were some executions. Torture, too. Most of it took place in that big building under the watch of a soldier named Dominicus Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人被处决了，还有酷刑。大部分都是在那栋大楼里发生的，在一个叫多米尼库斯·勒克斯的士兵的监视下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, as long as you focus on your own business, you should be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，只要你专注于自己的业务，你就不会有事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The town looks like it was attacked. What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个小镇看起来像是被袭击过。发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Boy, you're curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小子，你好奇心真重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were some Rangers. Two of them. I guess they must've been hiding here for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个游骑兵，两个吧。我猜他们一定在这里藏了一段时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day, gunshots started going off. Legionaries started running. It went on for a while. Gunfire and bombs and screaming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天，枪声开始响起，军团士兵开始奔跑。这种情况持续了好几天，枪声，炸弹和尖叫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers were dug in, slipping from alley to alley. You couldn't go outside 'cause you might get shot, or step on a mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵们挖好了洞，从一条巷子溜到另一条巷子。你不能出去，因为你可能会中枪，或者踩到地雷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually it stopped. I guess the Rangers ran outta ammo. One of 'em lit himself on fire. The other blew himself up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终它停了下来。我猜游骑兵的弹药用光了，其中一个自焚了，另一个引爆了自己身上的炸弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that was the end of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情就这样结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What caused the Legion to crack down on the town like this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团为什么要对小镇进行这样的镇压？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um. Thank you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，谢谢你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The old owner, Roddy, got killed some weeks ago. It just made the most sense for me to take over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来的主人，罗迪，几周前被杀了。让我接手是最合理的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem a little young to be running a store.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经营商店的话你似乎有点年轻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a whole lot, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕不是很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone's still kinda shaken by the Legion's executions. Don't know if it's okay to try and go back to the way things were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大家还在为军团的处决感到震惊，我不知道是否可以试着回到以前的生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to take a load off and relax, I'd really recommend heading south to Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想放松一下，我建议你往南去多兰泉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在镇上有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look at you! Such an eager little tent servant. Yes, there is something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你！真是个热心的小帐篷仆人。是的，有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find Malachi. He should be in the market just south of camp. Give him this invoice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 找到玛拉基。他应该在营地南边的市场，把这张发票给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else you need done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还需要做什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look at you! Such an eager little tent servant. Yes, there is something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你！真是个热心的小帐篷仆人。是的，有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My chief slave supplier was found to be engaging in illicit private slavery. In that sense, it's no wonder they were never more than adequate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的主要奴隶供应商被发现从事非法的私产奴隶。从这一点来看，难怪他的供应只是勉强合格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deliver this invoice to Julius in Chloride. He is a known quantity and hopefully a source of better slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这张发票交给克洛赖德的尤利乌斯。他是一个知名人物，而且很有可能是更好的奴隶的来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else you need done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还需要做什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look at you! Such an eager little tent servant. Yes, there is something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你！真是个热心的小帐篷仆人。是的，有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My original slave trader, a man named Malachi, is dead. Take this invoice to Julius in Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我原来的奴隶贩子，一个叫玛拉基的人，死了。把这张发票给克洛赖德的尤利乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else you need done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还需要做什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 会合适的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find my Adjutant. He is somewhere in this camp. Go to him. And when you get to him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找我的副官，他就在这个营地的某个地方，去找他吧。当你找到他时...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Punch his lights out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一拳打爆他的头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the pay is right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果报酬合适的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a trader. One of the few who hasn't given us trouble. Punctual, attentive, acquiescent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个商人，为数不多的没有给我们添麻烦的人。准时，专注，顺从。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If others were like him, we might have... I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果其他人也像他一样，我们可能会...我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would certainly be less frustrated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然就不会那么沮丧了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before I go, who is Malachi?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我走之前，问一下玛拉基是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Profligate knows its place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浪荡子很有分寸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Find my Adjutant. He is somewhere in this camp. Go to him. And when you get to him...
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找我的副官，他就在这个营地的某个地方，去找他吧。当你找到他时...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Punch his lights out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一拳打爆他的头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Anything to make myself useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。只要能让我有用就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go find Malachi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去找玛拉基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then we have nothing to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们就没什么好谈的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, did you? I should be angry at you for assaulting a Legionary. Did I ask you to do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，是吗？你袭击了一名军团士兵，我应该对你生气。是我让你这么做的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if I didn't, he deserved it. And if I didn't tell you, then I would have told you the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算我没有，他也活该。如果我不告诉你，我也会跟你说同样的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want more work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要更多的工作吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I punched your Adjutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打了你的副官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 操！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I appreciate that you're making yourself useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我很感激你能帮上忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've questions, ask them. Otherwise, make yourself scarce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有问题，问他们。否则，让自己消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Here, some denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。给，还有一些第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see you're a Profligate with some sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看你是个有点理智的浪荡子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you've questions, ask them. Otherwise, make yourself scarce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有问题，问他们。否则，让自己消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I delivered that invoice to Malachi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把发票交给玛拉基了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Legatus Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Your confusion is palpable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。你的困惑显而易见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it you've heard of Legatus Lanius. Lanius is the Princeps Legatus of the entire Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你听说过拉尼厄斯特使吧，拉尼厄斯是整个军团的最高统帅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the legatus of the Legio currently in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是目前在莫哈维的军团的特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that is how your feeble Profligate mind needs to perceive it, then yes, that is correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这就是你软弱、堕落的头脑所需要的感知方式，那么是的，这是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius is the Legate, and I am a legate. Is that simple enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯是特使，我也是特使。这对你来说够简单了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you are a legate, but you're not the Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你是一名特使，但你又不是拉尼厄斯那种特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that is how your feeble Profligate mind needs to perceive it, then yes, that is correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这就是你软弱、堕落的头脑所需要的感知方式，那么是的，这是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius is the Legate, and I am a legate. Is that simple enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯是特使，我也是特使。这对你来说够简单了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you are a legate, but you're not the Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你是一名特使，但你又不是拉尼厄斯那种特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I ask you some questions about the Legion's military?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以问你一些关于军团军队的问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. A Legio is a fighting force of 6,000 men. That would be 12 Cohorts, plus auxiliary units.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。军团是一支6000人的战斗部队，总共有12个步兵大队，外加辅助部队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cohorts are led by veteran Centurions. Cohorts are divided into ten Centuriae, which are led by lesser Centurions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 步兵大队由老兵百夫长率领。一个步兵大队分为10个百人队，由次等百夫长带领。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are ten Decani in a Centuria, and each one leads eight men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个百人队有十名什长，每名什长带领八个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you explain Legion military hierarchy to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我解释一下军团的军事等级制度吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Few. Only the most distinguished are elevated to the position and given their own Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很少。只有最杰出的人才能晋升到这个职位，并拥有自己的军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rest assured, Legatus Lanius is *the* Legatus. All Legions fall under his command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请放心，拉尼厄斯特使就是拉尼厄斯特使，所有军团都听从他的指挥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when another legate fails, it is Lanius who steps in and corrects his mistakes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当另一个特使失败时，是拉尼厄斯介入并纠正了他的错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many legates are there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多少个特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The position was granted to me after my victories during the Prescott-Sedona campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个职位是我在普雷斯科特-塞多纳战役中获胜后得到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unlike all other ranks within the Legion, to become Legatus, you must be chosen personally by Caesar. I was chosen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像军团中的其他军衔，要成为特使，你必须由凯撒亲自挑选。我被选中了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become a legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为特使的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gladly. I was newly a veteran Centurion, and had just assumed leadership of Cohors IV.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很乐意。那时我刚刚成为一名老兵百夫长，并担任第四大队的领导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion had taken Flagstaff earlier that year. Caesar set his sights south. He wanted Phoenix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在那年的早些时候占领了旗杆市。凯撒把目光投向了南方，他想要凤凰城。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The towns of Prescott and Sedona had joined together so as to prevent our advance. Six different tribes and militias with a common cause: stopping us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了阻挡我们前进，普雷斯科特和塞多纳两个城镇联合在一起。六个不同的部落和民兵都有一个共同的目标：阻止我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We took Sedona with ease. The enemy retreated into Woodchute Mountain, near the town of Jerome. I refused to follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们轻而易举地拿下了塞多纳，敌人撤退到杰罗姆镇附近的伍德丘特山。我拒绝跟随。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, I took Montezuma, Camp Verde, and Dewey-Humboldt. Then we took Prescott.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，我选择了蒙特祖玛、坎普维德和杜威洪堡。然后我们拿下了普雷斯科特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally, we went through Woodchute Mountain, coming from the west. By the time we arrived, the Profligates had no will left to fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后，我们从西边穿过了伍德丘特山。我们到达的时候，这些放荡者已经没有反抗的意志了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They meant to be an impassable wall. They waited for us to spring their trap, while we were already in their towns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的本意是成为一道无法逾越的墙，他们等着我们踏入他们的陷阱，而我们已经进入了他们的城镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It took only thirty days to break this six-tribe coalition. When I met Caesar at Sedona, he named me Legatus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅用了30天就打破了这六个部落的联盟。当我在塞多纳遇到凯撒时，他晋封我为塞多尼乌斯特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Prescott-Sedona campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说普雷斯科特-塞多纳战役。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leading my men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带领我的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will you be doing during the Battle of Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛水坝战役期间你会做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you. You are less than dirt, Profligate. If it weren't for that Mark you have, I would kill you where you stand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的，你这个比泥土还卑微的浪荡子。如果不是因为你身上的徽记，我会当场杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar knows my value. He understands my strength. If this camp is small, it is only because he knows larger camps don't suit me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒知道我的价值，他了解我的力量。如果这个营地很小，那只是因为他知道更大的营地不适合我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is a decorated legate such as yourself commanding such a small camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么像你这样一个功勋卓著的特使要指挥这么小的营地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not say another word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要再说了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars give me strength.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯赐予我力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is only because Caesar protects you, that your innards are not spilling into the sand right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是因为凯撒保护了你，你的内脏现在才不会溅到沙子里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or maybe Caesar doesn't think you're that valuable at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者凯撒根本不觉得你有什么价值。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever considered that you might just be an old man past his prime?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过你可能只是个过了壮年的老人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry. I didn't mean anything by it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我没有别的意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Malpais Legionary Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是马尔帕斯军团营地
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about Malpais again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能再跟我说说马尔帕斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not speak that name, worm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要谈论那个名字，小虫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This camp is established on the site of Malpais Flattop Mesa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个营地建立在马尔帕斯平顶方山的遗址上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, Malpais like the Malpais Legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，马尔帕斯指的是马尔帕斯特使吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you stupid? Why have any Legion camps at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是傻逼吗？为什么要有军团营地？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a supply base so that the Fort and the Legate's Camp aren't overwhelmed by the burdens of logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个补给基地，这样堡垒和特使军营就不会被后勤负担压得喘不过气来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why have another Legion camp so close to the Fort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要在离堡垒这么近的地方再建一个军团营地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean, history? This is a military camp. It has been since 2277.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么，历史？这里是个军营，自2277年以来一直如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the previous legate lost Hoover Dam, Malpais was left behind. Now, we have returned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当前任特使失去胡佛水坝时，马尔帕斯被留下了。现在，我们回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the history of Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯的历史是怎样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It used to, when this region was less civilized, but not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。以前是这样，当时这个地区还没那么文明，但现在不是了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of the other Legion camps in the area operate adjunct to this one, as satellite camps. The logistics happen here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该地区所有其他的军团营地都是作为这里的卫星营地运作的。后勤工作在这里进行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traders taking the Chainway north also stop here. We purchase some of our slaves that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沿连环道向北走的商人也在这里停留。我们用这种方式购买了一些奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Malpais see a lot of action?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯有很多行动吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway is the overpass west of here. It collapsed some time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道是这里西边的立交桥，不久前倒塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what's the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，连环道是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I drank them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喝了它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with all the soda bottles around your tent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帐篷里这么多汽水瓶子是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. He was the field commander of Legio I, but also of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。他是第一军团的战地指挥官，也是整个军团的指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Legio II was established and given to me, the Malpais Legate retained seniority, and thus had the final say over my Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当第二军团成立并交给我时，马尔帕斯特使保留了优先权，因此他对我的军团有最后的决定权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you ever work with the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和火烧人一起工作过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fierce. His devotion to Mars was uncompromising. He seemed to revel in conquest. To kill gave him life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狂热，他对玛尔斯的忠诚是毫不妥协的。他似乎陶醉于征服，杀戮给了他生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was the Burned Man like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人是什么样的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not question Caesar's judgment. If he believed Lanius was the best man for the job, then it is so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要质疑凯撒的判断。如果他相信拉尼厄斯是最合适的人选，那就没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why weren't you made Caesar's second-in-command when the Burned Man failed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人失败后，你为什么没被任命为凯撒的副手？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough! If you are trying to goad me into some sort of reaction, you will be sorely disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了！如果你试图刺激我做出某种反应，你会非常失望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am content with my place here at Malpais. When Lanius arrives, he will assume command of Legio II and secure victory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对我在马尔帕斯的位置很满意。当拉尼厄斯到来后，他将接管第二军团的指挥权，并确保胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems like you were skipped over for the promotion. You really aren't jealous at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你在升职的时候被忽略了。你真的一点都不嫉妒吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have served the Legion for nearly three decades. I have met many Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为军团服务了近三十年，我见过许多军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps I crossed paths with the Legionary who is now Lanius. If I had, I wouldn't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我遇到过现在叫拉尼厄斯的军团士兵。如果有，我也不会知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The man of the mask, though? No, I have never met him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个戴面具的人呢？不，我从未见过他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever met Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过拉尼厄斯特使吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Blackfoot. I met Caesar and Graham before they discovered Mars' purpose for them. In turn, they showed me my purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自黑脚。在凯撒和格拉汉姆发现玛尔斯对他们的意义之前，我遇到了他们。 反过来，他们也让我明白了我的目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What tribe are you from originally?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来自哪个部落？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't think that anybody in the NCR knew that there were Rangers out east before that damn treaty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那该死的条约签订之前，我觉得NCR里没人知道东部有游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you're one of the good ones. You can stay. Keep away from the gated section. I've rigged it with traps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你是好人之一，你可以留下来。远离门控区，我装了陷阱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] That armor.... You're from before the Ranger Unification Treaty, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]那件盔甲...你是游骑兵统一条约之前的人，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I wish. No secret mission. I appreciate that you recognized the armor though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！但愿如此。没有秘密任务，不过我很感激你认出了我的盔甲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen closely. Stay away from the gate. Very dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细听好。离大门远点，非常危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] You're an Arizona Ranger, aren't you? Are you on a secret mission to kill Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]你是亚利桑那游骑兵，对吧？你在执行刺杀凯撒的秘密任务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not NCR. I never have been and never will. I fucking hate the NCR. And if you're with them, I hate you, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是NCR，我从来不是，也永远不会是。我他妈讨厌NCR，如果你和他们一伙，我也讨厌你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let you leave, but don't come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让你离开，但不要再回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Look, I'm with the NCR. You're NCR too, right? That's Ranger armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]听着，我是NCR的。你也是NCR，对吧？那是游骑兵的盔甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see. You're just a little slow. That's right, kid, I'm a song. Mr. New Vegas sings about me to make kids like you happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，原来如此，你只是有点迟钝。没错，孩子，我就是一首歌，新维加斯先生唱我是为了让你们这样的孩子开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you run along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're an Arizona Ranger? I think Mr. New Vegas airs a song about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是亚利桑那游骑兵？新维加斯先生好像唱了一首关于你的歌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问点别的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ow! What the fuck?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔！搞什么鬼？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch him in the nose.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <一拳打在他鼻子上>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, partner! You run along now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，搭档！你快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an invoice for you from Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一张马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯给你的发票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Speak to me when your business here is concluded and your belongings will be returned to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。等你办完这里的事，你的东西会还给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Speak to me when your business here is concluded and your belongings will be returned to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。等你办完这里的事，你的东西会还给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <保留藏匿武器>当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Speak to me when your business here is concluded and your belongings will be returned to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。等你办完这里的事，你的东西会还给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <保留藏匿武器>当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, I'm not going in the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，我不去营地了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll keep that in mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No wonder you're so cranky all the time. Soda is bad for your health!
ESP.TRADUIT: 怪不得你总是这么暴躁，汽水对你的健康有害！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think you're educated just because you can deduce things?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为你受过教育就因为你会推理？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I serve Caesar. I have and will until I die. Whatever I put in my body is between me and the latrine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我侍奉凯撒，过去是，将来也是，直到我死。 无论我往身体里放什么，都是我和厕所之间的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quick temper, binge-drinking sugary sodas... Are you nursing an addiction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 脾气暴躁，嗜饮含糖苏打水...你上瘾了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no proof of anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有任何证据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think Caesar would like to hear that one of his legates is an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得凯撒不会愿意听到他的特使是个瘾君子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Put yourself in my position. You're a soldier, a commander. Well-respected. Important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 设身处地为我想想。你是一名士兵，一名指挥官。广受尊敬，很重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, one day, you notice that you can't march as far as you used to. You can't spar as long. You start getting tired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，有一天，你发现你不能像以前那样大步前进了，你不能战斗那么长时间了。你开始感到疲倦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you do in my place? Would you let your legacy slip away? Would you die an old decrepit fossil? I wouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是我，你会怎么做？你会让你的遗产溜走吗？你会变成老朽的化石死去吗？我不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yes, I started taking Buffout. It made me stronger. Better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我开始服用壮大灵。它让我变得更强大，更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I came to my senses. I killed the drug runner who kept me supplied. I tried to move past it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后我恢复了理智，我杀死了给我供药的运毒者。我试着忘记这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can't find a way out. My body craves something. I'm restless. I'm irritable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我找不到出路。我的身体渴望某种东西，我焦躁不安，我易怒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only want to serve Caesar as I once did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想像以前那样为凯撒效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was difficult before chems weren’t banned by the Legion. It used to be that you could get drunk after a battle, take a hit of something strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团没有禁止化学药品之前，这很困难。过去你可以在战斗后喝醉，喝点烈性酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did this start?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么开始的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Graham put a stop to that. For good reason, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，格拉汉姆制止的。这也是有充分理由的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: King Devil’s alliance. A band of pissant raiders. We had just defeated them in a battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔王联盟，一群可怜的掠夺者。我们刚刚在一场战斗中打败了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got cocky. One of the newly-assimilated tribes threw a party. People got drunk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们变得自大了，在一个新被同化的部落举行了一次聚会，人们都喝醉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The raiders took advantage of that moment. They nearly crippled us. The next morning, Graham ordered the first Decimation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者利用了这个机会，他们差点把我们弄残了。第二天早上，格拉汉姆下令进行第一次十一抽杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion didn't always ban chems?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不是一直禁止化学药品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Malpais Legate to you. You're not a legate. You don't have leave to say his name. I'll let it go this once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是马尔帕斯特使。你不是特使，你没资格叫他的名字，这一次我就不追究了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't enough though. Killing every one-in-ten was too random. So, by the end of the week, we were visited by our first crucifixion as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这还不够，杀死十分之一的人太随机了。所以，到了周末，我们第一次开始钉十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, by the end of that week, all of the Legion's drug runners had been crucified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，在那个星期结束的时候，军团所有的毒贩都被钉上了十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rumor was that Caesar ordered the crucifixions, but Graham carried them out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传言是凯撒下令将他们钉在十字架上，但格拉汉姆执行了这些命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, Joshua Graham invented the Decimation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，十一抽杀是约书亚·格拉汉姆发明的？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch him in the nose, hard.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <狠狠地打他鼻子一拳>

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch him in the nose with your full strength, consequences be damned.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <用尽全力打他的鼻子，管它什么后果>

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch him in the nose with your full strength, consequences be damned.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <用尽全力打他的鼻子，管它什么后果>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your commander asked me to do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的指挥官让我这么做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps. I would not be so arrogant to delay your audience with Caesar. Conclude your business with him, and I would be willing to provide some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。我不会傲慢到拖延你觐见凯撒的时间，如果你和他达成交易，我愿意提供一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work. Do you have any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作，你有吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She knows her place. There is a problem here at Base Camp that needs to be dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她知道自己的位置。大本营有个问题需要解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work. Iulia stated that you might be the person to talk to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在找工作，尤利娅说你可能是合适的人选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Caesar trusts you, then so do I. There is a problem here at Base Camp that needs to be dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果凯撒信任你，那我也信任你。大本营有个问题需要解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work. Do you have any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作，你有吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is an unknown malcontent spreading anti-Legion propaganda in this area. He leaves Profligate graffiti on the road between Big Stop and the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一个身份不明的不满者在这个地区传播反军团的宣传。他在大站和堡垒之间的路上肆意涂鸦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My superiors do not believe this to be an issue. The Fort and Base Camp are so far from the frontline that they do not even bother posting guards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的上级不认为这是个问题。堡垒和大本营离前线太远，他们甚至都懒得派卫兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They apparently cannot understand that if Caesar's will is affronted even the smallest bit, then the Legion is weakened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们显然无法理解，如果凯撒的意志受到哪怕是一点点的冒犯，那么军团就会被削弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Justice is justice, order is order, and the law is the law. We must enforce it even if it be inconvenient to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正义就是正义，秩序就是秩序，法律就是法律。即使对我们不方便，我们也必须执行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is that even possible? This place is swarming with Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这怎么可能？这地方到处都是军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are found in the morning. Presumably, he comes at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是在早上被发现的，他大概是晚上弄的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When does the graffiti appear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 涂鸦是什么时候出现的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely absurd. The Burned Man does not exist, and any slave you hear mentioning otherwise should be reported at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对荒谬。火烧人根本不存在，如果你听到有任何奴隶提到这个，都应该立刻报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard the slaves mention the Burned Man as being responsible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听奴隶们说火烧人是罪魁祸首。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Sighs.* The Burned Man is allegedly the spirit of an arch-traitor who failed us in the First Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: *叹气*据说火烧人是第一次胡佛水坝战役中让我们失望的大叛徒的灵魂。.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was punished accordingly and removed from existence. His body was set alight, and his spirit was cast into the Grand Canyon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他受到了相应的惩罚，从此不复存在。他的身体被点燃，他的灵魂被投进了大峡谷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Both his body and his spirit have been destroyed. That is the penalty for failure in the Legion. Only a slave would admire such an obvious failure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的身体和灵魂都被摧毁了，这是在军团中失败的惩罚。只有奴隶才会欣赏如此明显的失败。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, as you can see, the Burned Man cannot possibly exist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，如你所见，火烧人不可能存在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only a man would be so bold as you directly affront a Legionary, and even if a woman were of that boldness, we keep a close watch on all of them in the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有男人才会有你这样的胆量直接去冒犯一个军团士兵。不过即使一个女人有这样的胆量，我们也会密切监视这片区域的所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are assuming a 'he?'
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么假设是“他”？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...meant no offense, truly. But, you must understand that you are an anomaly, and unless you are leaving the graffiti, then the point still stands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...无意冒犯，真的。但是，你必须明白，你是一个异类，除非是你留下的涂鸦，否则这一点仍然有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think that Caesar would give the Mark of Caesar to a woman if I were not bold?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我不大胆，你认为凯撒会给一个女人徽记吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...see. If Caesar has a reason for this, then I suppose the matter is settled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...明白了。如果凯撒有理由这么做，那我想事情就解决了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I am. I do it in the service of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是我，我这么做是为了凯撒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
