ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm not responsible, so I guess I better start looking for who is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这不关我的事，我想我最好开始找找该谁来负责了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, that would be best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许这样最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll keep on the lookout for bold women, just in case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以防万一，我会继续留意那些大胆的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Newt provides us useful resources. Men for the war. Women for the labor. Food for the soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特为我们提供了有用的资源。参加战争的人，妇女的劳动，士兵们的食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am concerned that Caesar will punish me for taking action. Perhaps, the need for order does not outweigh the need for resources.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心凯撒会因为我的行动而惩罚我。也许，对秩序的需求并没有超过对资源的需求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a particular reason that the Legion doesn't just collectively punish Newt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团没有集体惩罚纽特有什么特别的原因吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You are right. I am only ashamed that I did not see it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你说得对。我只是感到惭愧，我以前没有看到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall decimate the town of Newt as the legate would do. And if the vandalism continues, the entire town will be destroyed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要像特使那样毁灭纽特镇。如果破坏行为继续下去，整个城镇都会被摧毁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this as a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这个当作报酬吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar will only reward success. And you know that this is the quickest path to success.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒只会奖励成功，你知道这是通往成功的捷径。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You are not even a Liberti. You are a Dissolute, an outsider, even if you bear the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你甚至不是个自由民。你是个浪荡子，是个外来者，即使你身上有凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know nothing of the Legion's needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团的需求一无所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get back to looking for the vandal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回去找那个破坏者吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure Caesar won't mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信凯撒不会介意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I am. Now, get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然是。现在，回去工作吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're probably right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能介绍一下你自己吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not waste Caesar's time by speaking of my own unimportant life. Complete your business with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会浪费恺撒的时间来谈论我自己不重要的生活。完成你和他的业务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能介绍一下你自己吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. What do wish to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能介绍一下你自己吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since I was born.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从我出生起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, if you are asking how long I have worn the uniform, then I became a soldier at the age of 12, and have been in Caesar's service for eight years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，如果你问我穿这身军服多久了，那么我是在12岁时成为一名士兵的，已经为凯撒服务了8年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你加入军团多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wherever Caesar has demanded. I have seen service against the Tall Pines and the First Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒要求的任何地方。我见证了对高松战役和第一次胡佛水坝战役。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where have you fought?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在哪里打过仗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're unusually curious for a Dissolute. Which campaigns would you like to know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个浪荡子，你的好奇心很不寻常。你想了解哪些战役？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me a little about those campaigns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我一些关于这些战役的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Which ones do you need a reminder of?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。哪些是需要提醒的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about the campaigns again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能再给我讲讲这些战役吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A treacherous tribe that operated in this area. They traded with all like whores, caring not who they did business with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个在这一带活动的奸诈部落。他们像妓女一样和所有人交易，不在乎和谁做生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since put to the cross, and expunged from this area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从上了十字架，就从这片区域被抹去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tall Pines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 高松战役。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Legion victory. It forced the NCR to confront us as a major power and set the stage for a climactic battle in which justice will prevail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的胜利。它迫使NCR以一个大国的身份与我们对峙，并为一场正义必胜的高潮战斗奠定了基础。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The First Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一次胡佛水坝战役。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only in the sense that they held the dam, but they were too weak to pursue, and they are too weak to hold it now
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是在某种意义上，他们守住了大坝，但他们太弱了，无法追击。现在他们还是太弱，守不住大坝的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Lanius is ready, we shall march on the dam and Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等拉尼厄斯准备好了，我们就向大坝和维加斯进发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't the NCR win that battle?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR不是赢了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you did not possess the Mark of Caesar, your head would be severed from your shoulders. Watch your tongue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你没有凯撒的徽记，你的头就会从肩膀上被砍下来。说话注意点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is absolute bullshit. You can't just describe a clear loss as a victory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这绝对是胡扯。你不能把一场明显的失败说成是胜利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do. And so does Caesar. And soon, we will not have to say it. Everyone will know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，凯撒也一样。很快，我们就不用再说了，每个人都会知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么说的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By Mars, where did you find this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯在上，你在哪儿找到的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I have. Here's proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我有。这就是证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh? And who did you extract this from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢？你从谁那里弄来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I have. I secured a confession.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我有。我让他招供了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, get back to work. Or do you have questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那回去工作。还是有什么问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I haven't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我还没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah. I suspected as much. His mother will be crucified under lex talionis, and he himself will need honest discipline in Caesar's service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，我也是这么怀疑的。他的母亲将遵循塔利奥尼斯法被钉死在十字架上，而他自己也需要在为凯撒的服务中受到诚实的约束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a child in Newt, named Pablo. He was responsible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特有个孩子，叫巴勃罗。他得为此负责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No trader would be stupid enough to undermine Caesar, who gave him stable roads and honest labor. Though, they are of the Reservation....
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有哪个商人会愚蠢到去挖凯撒墙角，因为凯撒给了他稳定的道路和诚实的劳动。虽然，他们是保留...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> It was one of the traders from the Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是一个来自保留地的商人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You speak the truth. I cannot crucify them due to the Los Alamos Agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你说的是实话。根据洛斯阿拉莫斯协议，我不能把他们钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can expel them from the camp, let the Dolan Springs garrison deal with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我可以把他们赶出营地，让多兰泉的驻军来处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if they are the Reservation, then they cannot possibly trusted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们是保留地的人，那就不可信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Independent traders have assimilated themselves the best to the Legion justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]独立商人已经将自己融入了军团的正义之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your judgement cannot be trusted. Our business is concluded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的判断不可信，我们的生意结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traders are always shifty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人总是很狡猾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You speak the truth. I cannot crucify them due to the Los Alamos Agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你说的是实话。根据洛斯阿拉莫斯协议，我不能把他们钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can expel them from the camp, let the Dolan Springs garrison deal with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我可以把他们赶出营地，让多兰泉的驻军来处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if they are the Reservation, then they cannot possibly trusted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们是保留地的人，那就不可信。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Independent traders have assimilated themselves the best to the Legion justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]独立商人已经将自己融入了军团的正义之中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your judgement cannot be trusted. Our business is concluded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的判断不可信，我们的生意结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traders are always shifty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人总是很狡猾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, he prioritizes returning to the city that made his career more than the dam. A pity he is not Legion. He would make a fine Legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，比起大坝，他更想回到这座成就了他事业的城市。可惜他不是军团，他能成为一名出色的特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would Kimball want to retake Bullhead when the NCR can barely hold onto the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然NCR几乎守不住大坝，那金博尔为什么还要夺回布尔海德？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A traitor Legionary in the heart of Legion control? Do you expect me to believe this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团控制中心的叛徒军团战士？你想让我相信这个吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> It was Hunts Goats.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎]是“山羊”亨茨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A bastardization of Legion principles. *Sigh.* He was a good Legionary, but he will have to be dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]军团原则的劣化。<叹气>他是一名优秀的军团士兵，但他必须被处理掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid Hunts Goats has relapsed into degeneracy. Believes that the graffiti is a work of beauty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕“山羊”亨茨又堕落了，认为涂鸦是一件美丽的作品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] It is not obvious to me. If you do not have any proof, then I will assume that you are lying or a fool.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]对我来说不是很明显。如果你没有任何证据，那么我就会认为你在说谎或是个傻子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, our business is over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样的话，我们的生意就结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is obvious that Hunts Goats is a secret Profligate spy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显而易见，“山羊”亨茨是个秘密的浪荡子间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A bastardization of Legion principles. <Sigh.> He was a good Legionary, but he will have to be dealt with.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]军团原则的劣化。<叹气>他是一名优秀的军团士兵，但他必须被处理掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid Hunts Goats has relapsed into degeneracy. Believes that the graffiti is a work of beauty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕“山羊”亨茨又堕落了，认为涂鸦是一件美丽的作品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] It is not obvious to me. If you do not have any further proof, then I will assume that you are lying or a fool.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]对我来说不是很明显。如果你没有任何进一步的证据，那么我就会认为你在说谎或是个傻子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is obvious that Hunts Goats is a secret Profligate spy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显而易见，“山羊”亨茨是个秘密的浪荡子间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Primus Statio is one of the eyes of Caesar. Anything that approaches the Fort is monitored.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一站是凯撒的眼睛之一，任何接近堡垒的东西都会被监控。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be assured, anything that could threaten Caesar himself will be dealt with swiftly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，任何可能威胁到凯撒的事物都会被迅速处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you watch at the Primus Statio?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在第一站看什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They look sort of like Bighorners, except they can climb mountains. You'll find them out in Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们看起来有点像大角羊，只不过它们会爬山。你可以在科罗拉多找到它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a goat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 山羊是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before my transfer here, I was from a small community in southern Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我转到这里之前，我来自科罗拉多州南部的一个小社区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion conscripted me to fight in their war against the Brotherhood out east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团征召我参加他们在东部对抗兄弟会的战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm amazed I survived. My superiors told me that it was the hardest battle they ever fought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶我能活下来。我的上级告诉我，这是他们经历过的最艰难的战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the first of four statios scattered around this region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是散布在这个地区的四个监测站中的第一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there other stations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他站点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不再有了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's Brotherhood out east?
ESP.TRADUIT: 东部有兄弟会？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were called the Brotherhood of Steel. A strange tribe who wore powered armor and lived in bunkers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们被称为钢铁兄弟会。一个穿着动力盔甲，住在地堡里的奇怪部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The campaign was brutal, about three years long. Forced the Legion to use Stealth Boys to counter them. When we breached their bunker, they unleashed a deadly gas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这场战役很残酷，持续了大约三年，迫使军团使用隐身小子来对抗他们。当我们突破他们的地堡时，他们释放了致命的毒气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Took nearly a hundred Legionaries with them, at the tail-end of a campaign that killed thousands of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们带走了近百名军团士兵，在一场战役中，我们数千人被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hear rumors that there's a chapter in the Mojave. I know the Centurions dread a repeat of that fight. And so do I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说他们在莫哈维有一个分会。我知道百夫长害怕那场战争重演，我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Brotherhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说兄弟会吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, Finturus sent you. I'll tell you what I told him. The other Legionaries like them, and so do I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是芬图勒斯派你来的。我告诉你我跟他说过的话，其他军团士兵都喜欢，我也喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for leads on who might be leaving graffiti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找可能留下涂鸦的人的线索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beauty is appreciated by Mars. It abates his desire for destruction to see works of art in his name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯欣赏美。看到以他的名义创作的艺术品，他的毁灭欲望就会减弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A much-needed boon ahead of our march on Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们进军胡佛大坝之前急需的福音。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, the other Legionaries think they're neat, and if Caesar doesn't care, neither do I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，其他军团成员都觉得自己很干净，如果凯撒不在乎，我也不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it's anti-Legion graffiti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但，这是反军团的涂鸦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're dead-set on stopping the graffiti artist, you might try somewhere in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你执意要阻止这位涂鸦艺术家，你可以去纽特的某个地方试试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know Finturus has already grilled Flemus about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道芬图勒斯已经盘问过弗勒慕斯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, no leads, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那，没有线索了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're dead-set on stopping the graffiti artist, you might try somewhere in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你执意要阻止这位涂鸦艺术家，你可以去纽特的某个地方试试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, no leads, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那，没有线索了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was under the impression that Lucullus was sent to escort you. Return to him to find your way. We look forward to your service to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得卢库卢斯是被派来护送你的，回到他那里寻找你的路。我们期待你为我们服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I possess the Mark of Caesar. I am here to speak to your boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，我是来找你老板的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Pablo. I live here in Newt with my mom. She's one of the farmers. Maybe you've met her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是巴勃罗，我和我妈妈住在纽特。她是农民之一，也许你见过她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't know how much I can help you, but I'll try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我不知道能帮到你多少，但我会尽力的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm kind of sad right now, but if you want to know, then I'll tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在有点难过，但如果你想知道，我会告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm kind of sad right now, but if you want to know, then I'll tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在有点难过，但如果你想知道，我会告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly, I help prepare fishing nets. We have to catch a lot of fish for the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数时候，我帮助准备渔网。我们得为军团抓很多鱼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They look funny, but everyone in town seems to be scared of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们看起来很有趣，但镇上的每个人似乎都害怕他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They look funny, but everyone in town seems to be scared of them. I can see why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们看起来很滑稽，但镇上的每个人似乎都害怕他们。我知道为什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They look funny, but everyone in town seems to be scared of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们看起来很有趣，但镇上的每个人似乎都害怕他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I...can explain. I was trying to remove some graffiti. Someone's been leaving it at one of the Legion stations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...可以解释。我只是想擦掉一些涂鸦，有人把它留在了军团的一个据点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone's been leaving graffiti at the Legion station. I've been trying to clean it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人在军团驻地涂鸦，我一直在努力清理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen a lady Legionary before. Do you like my art? I've been leaving it as a joke for the soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没见过女军团士兵呢。你喜欢我的作品吗？我只是给士兵们开了个玩笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen a lady Legionary before. I'm leaving some art for the Legionaries. Do you want to see?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没见过女军团士兵呢。我要给军团留下一些艺术品，你想看吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, really? I've been leaving it as a prank against the Legion. Thought some of them might laugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，真的吗？我一直把它当作是对军团的恶作剧，我想他们中的一些人可能会笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't tell anyone I've been leaving it, though. That's a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过别告诉别人是我留的。这是个秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I quite like the graffiti. Did you do this yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很喜欢那些涂鸦。这是你自己画的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, yes, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，是，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Carry on, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就继续吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, yes, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，是，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Carry on, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就继续吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My son? Oh, dear, did he do something wrong? Please tell me it didn't have anything do to with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我儿子？天哪，他做错什么了吗？请告诉我这和军团没有任何关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have news about your son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有关于你儿子的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My son? Oh, dear, did he do something wrong? Please tell me it didn't have anything do to with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我儿子？天哪，他做错什么了吗？请告诉我这和军团没有任何关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this paint gun by the wagon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在马车旁找到了这把喷枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My son? Oh, dear, did he do something wrong? Please tell me it didn't have anything do to with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我儿子？天哪，他做错什么了吗？请告诉我这和军团没有任何关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this paint gun by the wagon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在马车旁找到了这把喷枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What would you like to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说纽特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I work 15 hours a day to feed the Legion. There's a whole lot of soldiers, with a lot of stomachs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我每天工作15个小时来养活军团。有很多士兵，他们有很多胃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't use to farm this much. Previously, just getting by was enough. My son sometimes helps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前没种过这么多地，以前，勉强度日就够了。我儿子有时会帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's too free-spirited. I'm worried that he's doing to do something stupid. I just wish he'd stick to painting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他太自由奔放了，我担心他会做些傻事。我只希望他能专心画画。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much. I've managed to secure his freedom from the Legion. Not old enough for conscription, not young enough for indoctrination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不多。我把他从军团手里救了出来，还没到征兵的年龄，也没到接受教化的年龄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am so happy that he won't have to be a Legionary. He'll have a normal childhood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴他不必成为一名军团士兵，他会有一个正常的童年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your son do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He works in the fields with me. Says he doesn't like painting anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他和我一起在地里干活，说他不喜欢画画了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your son do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He works in the fields with me. Says he doesn't like painting anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他和我一起在地里干活，说他不喜欢画画了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your son do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not a Legion outpost, but the answer to your question is more complicated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不是军团的前哨，但你的问题...答案更复杂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We might not have been made slaves to the Legion, but it isn't much better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们也许没有沦为军团的奴隶，但也好不到哪里去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This doesn't feel like a Legion outpost. Are you guys independent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里不像是军团的前哨。你们是独立的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like I told you. Men for the war machine. Women for labor, food and medicine. And children for blacksmithing and training.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我告诉过你的。为战争机器而战的男人，妇女需要劳动提供食物和药品，让孩子们去打铁和训练。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's life like under the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团统治下的生活是什么样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a trading post along Lake Mead. Belonged to a local tribe. They're gone now, killed when the Legion last came through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是米德湖边的一个贸易站，属于当地的一个部落。他们已经完了，在军团上次来到这里的时候被杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dr. Clay's been here longer than I have. Might ask her about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生在这里待的时间比我长，或许可以问问她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was Newt before the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特在加入军团之前是什么样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于纽特就说到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might have noticed that there's no men around here. The Legion stole them away for their war machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能注意到了，这里没有男人。军团为了他们的战争机器偷走了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've been posted to Nelson. I guess the Legion took that some time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们已经被派往纳尔逊了，我猜军团不久前夺走了它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They took some of the women as slaves for their camps far away to the south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把一些妇女作为奴隶带到遥远的南方营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the children have been sent to training quarters to become Legionaries of the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些孩子已经被送往训练基地，成为未来的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then, there's the food. The army is a bottomless pit of demands. They demand all of our meat and crops to fill their bellies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，还有食物。军队是需求的无底洞，他们要求我们所有的肉和作物来填满他们的肚子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They demand our maidens and their alcohol to treat their wounds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需求我们的少女和她们的酒来治疗伤口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They demand the nimble hands of our children to fine-tune their weapons of war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需求我们的孩子们灵巧的手来调整他们的战争武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like living under the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 生活在军团治下是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We bear it because we have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们忍受是因为我们必须忍受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a lot of hardship. How do you bear it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那可真够辛苦的。你怎么受得了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, my, God. Please, spare him. He's only 12. Wait. You're not Legion, are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我的，天哪。拜托，饶了他吧，他还只有12岁。等等，你不是军团的人，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That means that they don't know yet, right? Please do not tell them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说他们还不知道，对吧？求求你不要告诉他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid it did. He's been leaving anti-Legion graffiti outside Base Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕是的，他在大本营外面留下了反军团的涂鸦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need money? I have 50 caps. That's almost all I have. Please, that's enough, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要钱吗？我有50瓶盖，这几乎是我的所有。求你了，这样就够了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would need to be persuaded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要被说服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，谢谢你，谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won't let you. The Legion has taken everything else. I won't let you take Pablo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让你得逞的。军团已经夺走了一切，我不会让你带走巴勃罗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I am telling the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我这就告诉军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I could maybe spare another 30. Please don't tell the Legion. This is all I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我也许可以再拿出30，求求你不要告诉军团。这是我仅有的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Almost all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 几乎所有？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I can't. I don't have anymore. Please don't tell the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我做不到，我真的没有了，求你不要告诉军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再来点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Please, don't tell the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！拜托，别告诉军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Almost all of them. Soon, Lanius will arrive, and the Second Battle of Hoover Dam will begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几乎全部。很快，拉尼厄斯就会到达，第二次胡佛水坝战役就会打响。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only hope that the Brotherhood will be dealt with sooner rather than later. I'd really rather not see them again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只希望能尽快解决兄弟会的问题，我真的不想再见到他们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know Caesar has a plan, but I worry daily that I'm not strong enough to be able to carry out his will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道凯撒有他的计划，但我每天都担心自己不够强大，无法执行他的意志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there many veterans of that conflict on the way to the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在去莫哈维的路上有很多经历过那场冲突的老兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions about the vandal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对那个破坏者有些疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I didn't know that. The man actually attempted to murder me with a Sunset Sasparilla bottle when I tried to interview him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我不知道。我想采访他的时候他居然想用一瓶夕阳沙士谋杀我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must have caught him on a good day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定是赶上他的好日子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是特使。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. Well done. It was a test from Mars. He used it to show us that degeneracy had managed to slip into our ranks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，干得好。这是一次来自玛尔斯的测试，他用它向我们表明堕落者已经渗入了我们的行列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're saying it was a test from Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说这是来自玛尔斯的测试？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep! My instructor is super nice! He brings me buckets of red stuff to paint the other children's faces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯！我的教官非常好！他给我带来几桶红色的东西，用来给其他孩子的脸上涂颜料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He says that, if I'm a good Legionary, he'll let me paint Legion victories and stuff. So cool!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他说，如果我是一名优秀的军团士兵，他会让我描绘军团的胜利之类的。太酷了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They let you paint still?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还让你画画？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I have a gun now. So, that's really cool. And I have this uniform. And I have a bunch of friends to play with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我现在有枪了。所以，这真的很酷。我有这身制服，我还有一群朋友可以一起玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mother was upset when I left. But, I like it here better than I like Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我离开的时候，我妈妈很伤心。但是，比起纽特，我更喜欢这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do now that you're in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你加入军团后做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Ruth. I run the diner. I cook, clean, take out the trash, all of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫鲁思，我经营餐厅。我做饭，打扫，倒垃圾，所有这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to tell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么好说的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've lived in Big Stop-- er, Solitare my whole life. I've run this diner for nearly 15 years. Took over when my dad passed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一辈子都住在大站...呃，索利泰尔。我经营这家餐厅快15年了，我父亲去世后我就接手了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My husband used to help out, but he got sick. My son stepped up to give me a hand, but I lost him too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我丈夫过去常常帮忙，但他病了。我儿子站出来帮了我，但我也失去了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was two years ago, now. Been running this diner alone ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是两年前的事了。从那以后，我一直独自经营这家餐厅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I don't mean to sour the mood. Can I get you something to eat?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我不是故意要破坏气氛的。你要吃点什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself, Ruth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己吧，鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He went missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他失踪了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kissed me on the forehead and said 'See you in a little while, ma.' That was the last time I saw him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亲了一下我的额头，说：“一会儿见，妈妈”。那是我最后一次见到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, I'm sorry, I don't like to get emotional like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，对不起，我不喜欢这样情绪化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Clears throat.> We have menus. If you want to eat something.
ESP.TRADUIT: <清了清嗓子>我们的菜单，如果你想吃点什么的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to your son?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 菜单上有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that put you off? You must not be from around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让你很反感？你一定不是这附近的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries are some of my most consistent customers. Sure, they're rude, they have no manners, but they always pay. That's good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵是我最忠实的客户之一。当然，他们很粗鲁，没有礼貌，但他们总是付钱。这对我来说已经足够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, those boys stop being scary once you've seen one with his mask off, gorging himself on pie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，一旦你看到那些男孩摘下面具，狼吞虎咽地吃派，你就不会觉得他们可怕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you serve Legionaries here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这里为军团士兵服务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about this town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我讲讲这个小镇吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, well, it's complicated. All you need to know is that the Legion ruled that it's going to be called Solitare, going forward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，好吧，这很复杂。你只需要知道，军团决定将它命名为"索利泰尔"就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this place called Solitare or Big Stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方叫"索利泰尔"还是"大站"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A tornado? Hah. Do tornadoes usually litter a place with bullet holes and blood?
ESP.TRADUIT: 龙卷风？哈，龙卷风通常会在一个地方留下弹孔和血迹吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This town has been passed between the Legion and the NCR a couple times now. Before the NCR, it was the Rangers. Someone always wants us for something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个城镇已经在军团和NCR之间转手过好几次了，在NCR之前，是游骑兵。总有人想要我们做些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the last time the NCR pulled out, they didn't pull out all the way. Some Rangers stuck behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想上次NCR撤离的时候，他们并没有完全离开。一些游骑兵留在了后面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Last month, they decided to attack the Legion. You can guess how that went.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上个月，他们决定攻击军团。你可以猜到结果如何。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is everyone? It looks like a tornado blew through the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大家都去哪儿了？看起来像是龙卷风吹过了这个城镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truthfully I don't know. I don't know what the difference is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我也不知道。我不知道有什么区别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The stories say that Rangers are the reason Big Stop even exists at all: a man named Tycho, who pushed raiders off of Hoover and made Big Stop safe enough to prosper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些故事说，“大站”之所以存在，是因为有一个叫提可的人，他把掠夺者赶出了胡佛车站，让“大站”安全起来，繁荣起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rangers were always coming and going when I was a little girl, settling disputes, hunting bounties. Then, one day, they really left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我还是个小女孩的时候，游骑兵总是来来去去，解决争端，猎取赏金。直到有一天，他们真的离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they came back, they had their armor painted all different and they had a flag with them. They said they were the government.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们回来的时候，他们的盔甲被涂上了不同的颜色，身上还带着一面旗帜。他们说他们是政府。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same Rangers? You tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同样的游骑兵？你说呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, when you say Ranger, do you mean NCR Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你说的游骑兵，是指NCR游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a day or two of quiet. You could almost start to think that things were over. Then, the Legion got real mad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一两天的宁静，你几乎可以开始认为一切都结束了。然后，军团真的疯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They started kicking in doors, rounding people up and bringing them to that big gas station. You can imagine the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们开始破门而入，把人们聚集起来，带到那个大加油站。剩下的你可以自行想象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened after the Rangers attacked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵袭击后发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I make a good squirrel stew, if you wanna try that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做的松鼠炖肉很好吃，如果你想尝尝的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd recommend heading south to Dolan Springs if you wanna kick back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想放松一下，我建议你向南去多兰泉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Careful, though. The highway there is collapsed, so you'll have to take the canyons. Place is filled with nasty critters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，小心。那里的高速公路坍塌了，所以你只能走峡谷，那地方到处都是讨厌的小动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do in town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 城里有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What did you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？你有什么想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I want something that isn't on the menu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我想吃菜单上没有的东西呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wine, huh? Pop open a bottle and pour ourselves a couple of glasses? Maybe tune the radio to something slow...
ESP.TRADUIT: 酒，是吧？开瓶酒，给自己倒几杯？要不把收音机调慢点...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's just one problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有一个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was thinking we'd start with some wine...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我们可以先喝点酒...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion doesn't allow us to have wine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不允许我们喝酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're sweet, though. Maybe in some other world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你很可爱，也许在别的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alrighty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruth [06013F05] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们聊点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm &PCName;
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who am I? Who the fuck are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是谁？你他妈是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course something's the matter. Something's always the damn matter now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有什么事，现在总是有些该死的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is something the matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion's my problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是我的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wha's your problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么问题？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't like the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do it, shitheel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去啊，蠢货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I went and told the Legionary in charge how you really feel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我去告诉军团负责人你的真实感受呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Peace! Ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 和平！哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a brainwashed dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是条被洗脑的狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get over yourself. The Legion brought peace to this Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别自以为是了，军团给这片废土带来了和平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand how you feel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解你的感受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nobody does, 'til soldiers knock on your door with a gun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人关心，直到士兵拿着枪来敲你的门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really care about politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太关心政治。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ernest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 欧内斯特。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because they're morons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们是白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do some people call this place Solitare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么有人管这地方叫索利泰尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uprising? An uprising....
ESP.TRADUIT: 起义？起义...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I didn't see anything. I wish I had. I heard those boys did good, those Rangers. Bless them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我什么都没看见。我希望我看见了，我听说那些游骑兵干得不错，祝福他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you see any of the Ranger uprising?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到游骑兵起义了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're no friend of the Legion, are you? I hear some of them talking. They don't trust you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是军团的朋友，对吧。我听到他们中的一些人说的话，他们不信任你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I did know those boys at some point. Maybe not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我确实在某个时候认识那些男孩，也许不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Fine. You win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧。你赢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion don't like me, and I don't like them. That isn't enough to earn your trust?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不喜欢我，我也不喜欢他们。这还不足以获得你的信任吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I don't trust you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然不相信你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're walking, talking, spending, buying, even breathing in Legion territory, you're on their side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在军团的领土上行走、交谈、消费、购买，甚至呼吸，那你就是站在他们一边的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a supporter of the Legion. You really don't trust me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是军团的支持者。你真的不相信我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did well for ourselves. Had trade contracts with everyone. Crimson Caravan had a branch here. Folks were happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们自己干得很好，和所有人都有贸易合同，深红商队在这里有个分分公司。大家都很开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then the Legion came and business dried up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后来军团来了，生意也没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Biggest mistake the Rangers ever made was signing that treaty with the Legion. Dunno whose idea that was but I hope they're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵犯过的最大的错误，就是和军团签订了那个条约。不知道这是谁的主意，但我希望他们已经死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think the Legion is going to honor a fucking treaty? You think they're going to shop and dine alongside Desert Rangers?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得军团会遵守一个该死的条约吗？你觉得他们会和沙漠游骑兵一起购物吃饭吗！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fucking cowards. They knew they'd never win, not even with the NCR on their side. So they rolled over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的懦夫。他们知道他们永远不会赢，即使有NCR的支持。于是他们翻了个身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was Solitare like before the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团出现之前索利泰尔是什么样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I tell you anything? Do you think I want your damn sympathy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要告诉你？你以为我需要你的同情吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you so angry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么生气？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries killed my son, dammit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的儿子被军团士兵杀了，该死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just trying to get a full view of what it's like living under Legion rule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想全面了解一下在军团统治下生活是什么样子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Perfect. Doesn't it feel good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！完美。感觉不错吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll let you in on a secret: rage is the key to a long life. It keeps you going forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我告诉你一个秘密：愤怒是长寿的关键，它能让你永远坚持下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, old man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，老头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouldn't have raised him to stand up for himself, I guess. Shouldn't have taught him to do what's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我不该把他养大，让他为自己出头。不应该教他做正确的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because when a man with a gun wants you to sit down and do what's wrong, you either do it or die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为当一个拿着枪的人想让你坐下来做错误的事的时候，你要么做，要么死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ernest [06013F07] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kinda sorta. I'm deputized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算是吧，我是代理人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是军团士兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because they recognized that I'd be an asset. Cracking heads, beating motherfuckers: that's my wheelhouse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们意识到我是个有用的人。敲脑袋，打混蛋，那是我的拿手好戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The soldiers don't wanna waste their time guarding a town like this. They get someone with a proven track record, like me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵们可不想把时间浪费在守卫这样的小镇上。他们会找一个有良好记录的人，比如我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robberies, kidnappings, rapes, murders. What I'm saying is this: give me a reason to kill you, degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抢劫，绑架，强奸，谋杀。我想说的是，给我一个杀了你的理由，堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the Legion deputize you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团为什么委派你为代理人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a soldier. I just needed a cause. The Legion gave me one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾是一名士兵。我只是需要一个理由，军团给了我一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you were a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你是个掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't give a fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别他妈管了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about this election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这次选举怎么看？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion won't let us use chems, and the Maidens are off limits. See, honey, we're all pent up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不让我们用毒品，女侍也是禁区。看，亲爱的，我们都被压抑住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, some of these other deputies are real bad guys. I wouldn't trust them as far as I could throw them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一些代理人是真正的坏人。就我所知，我不会相信他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I'm saying is that a pretty thing like you needs protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，像你这样漂亮的东西需要保护。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. I wish you were a whore. Then, I could legally execute you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我真希望你是个妓女，然后，我就可以合法地处决你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your back out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在外面小心点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得你需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need protection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要保护。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself. Watch your back out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。小心你的后背。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I really don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我真的不需要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I respect that. I really do. Can't speak for some of these other guys, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，我尊重这一点，我真的。但我不能代表其他的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Here are your belongings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。这是你的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My business here is concluded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里的事已经办完了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malpais Gate Guard [06013B79] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I'm not ready to leave the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我还没准备好离开营地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caius Drusus. I am the Legion representative here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 盖尤斯·德鲁苏斯，我是这里的军团代表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Joel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 乔尔
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a reason you're in my kitchen? You're taking up space.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来我厨房有什么原因吗？你占用空间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 您是哪位？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got nothing to do with being rude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟粗鲁一点关系都没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got deadlines, and I'm behind on prep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要赶截止日期，我的准备工作已经落后了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you wanna help pack fifty Caravan Lunches, I'm afraid you're in the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你想帮忙打包50份商队盒饭，否则恐怕你会碍事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No need to be so rude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没必要这么粗鲁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shoot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm the cook, the maid, the muscle, the mail man, and more. I do it all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我是厨师、女佣、打手、邮递员，还有更多。我什么都做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You hungry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你饿吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're the cook around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这里的厨师？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Tres Leches Caravan Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是三人行商队公司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll want to talk to the Jordanos if you got questions about the business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对生意有疑问，可以去找若尔达诺家的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't say I like them too much. It's best I don't talk about that though. Biting the hand, and all that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能说我很喜欢，不过我还是不谈这个为妙。忘恩负义之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that is a difficult question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在这是个很难回答的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is a rock that's been rolling downhill for quite some time
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR是一块已经滚下坡相当长一段时间的石头
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I like the idea of the NCR? Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢NCR的想法吗？当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But with jagoffs like Kimball at the helm, it's tough to make the case that they're much better than anyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，有金博尔这样的蠢材掌舵，很难证明他们比其他人强得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eat up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吃光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I'm famished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我饿坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this anyway. For the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，还是拿着吧。在路上吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm not hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不饿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. Jordano gave me the job after I came to him with my sob story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我向若尔达诺先生讲述了我的悲惨经历后，他给了我这份工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I walked up to his desk, hat in hand, with this big ol' tale about how the Republic screwed me over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿着帽子走到他的办公桌前，讲了一个关于共和国如何欺骗我的大故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Government seized all my assets." "No work anymore, it's all going to the big guys" -- You know the deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: “政府没收了我所有的资产。”“不再有工作了，都给大公司了”，你知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. J accused me of plagiarism at first. He said I stole their story.
ESP.TRADUIT: J先生起初指控我抄袭，他说我剽窃了他们的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We started talking, and it turns out the NCR screws over a lot of people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们开始讨论，结果发现NCR欺骗了很多人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you end up working here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么会在这里工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 挺好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a union guy -- excuse me, former union guy. So I've got higher standards than some folk might.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是工会成员...不好意思，前工会成员。所以我的标准比一般人要高。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've managed to talk my way into better accomodations for us dungeon dwellers though. It all adds up, I say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我已经设法说服他们给我们这些地下城居民提供更好的住宿。我说，一切都会好起来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like working here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢在这里工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I oversee operations here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我监督这里的运作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the road collapsed, I was responsible for cargo inspections at the checkpoint up the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在道路坍塌之前，我在路上的检查站负责货物检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Until that's fixed, I'm stuck here with these degenerates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个问题解决之前，我只能和这些退化的人呆在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Vicen. He runs the shop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟维森谈谈，他经营这家商店。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我一些东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Gustavo or Mr. Jordano.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和古斯塔沃或若尔达诺先生谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got an errand I don't have time for. Interested in running it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个差事，没时间去做。有兴趣帮我经营一下吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Joel Nunez [0600D437] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you personally need help with anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个人有什么需要帮助的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Tres Leches Caravan Company. A Profligate business venture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是三人行商队公司，一个浪荡子的商业投机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I understand it, they were forced out of the New California Republic by a far larger competitor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，他们被一个大得多的竞争者赶出了新加州共和国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The world of business is not that different from the Wasteland. Kill or be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商业世界和废土并没有什么不同。杀或被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You take me for a common merchant, Profligate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把我当成一个普通的商人，浪荡子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not insult me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别侮辱我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我一些东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have heard many rumors on what caused it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于它的原因我听过很多传闻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say Ranger Sabotage, others an unholy curse. If you ask me, these three fools have something to do with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说是游骑兵破坏，也有人说是邪恶的诅咒。要我说，这三个傻瓜跟这件事有关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not trust them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what collapsed the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道是什么原因导致连环道坍塌的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I checked for contraband and confiscated cargo better used by the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我检查了违禁品，没收了一些更适合军团使用的货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chems are destroyed. Able-bodied male slaves sent to a work camp or to Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 化学药物被销毁，身体健全的男性奴隶被送往劳动营或马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars willing I will return to my post soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯保佑，我很快就会重返岗位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cargo inspections?
ESP.TRADUIT: 货物检查？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway is our chief supply route in this theater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道是我们在这个战区的主要补给路线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Its elevation makes it impossible to assault and guarantees safe passage for trade to the Fort and Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它的高度使其不可能受到攻击，并保证了通往堡垒和马尔帕斯的贸易通道的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The collapse has been a great pain in the Legions side.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次坍塌对军团来说是一个巨大的痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Armicustos Lateran [0600BFB5] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我一些关于连环道的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enzo John Jordano.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恩佐·约翰·若尔达诺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get the shit that needs to get done, done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把该做的都搞定了，做完了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleased to make your acquaintence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴与您相识。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 您是哪位？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. Unless you got a business degree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不太有，除非您有商业学位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vinnie's your guy if you're looking for the Buy & Sell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你要找买卖，文尼就是你要找的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我一些东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the Tres Leches Caravan company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是三人行商队公司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fastest growing caravan this side of the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 科罗拉多河这边发展最快的商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gladly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It all started when my brothers and I got outta the joint. We was in there for petty theft. 3 years for 10 Tandi's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都是从我和我的兄弟们出狱的时候开始的。我们是因为小偷小摸被关进去的，10重量的坦蒂头判了3年。
