ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turns out, prison's a great place to learn business. We traded sweetrolls for cigarettes. Cigarettes for jet. Jet for cash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实证明，监狱是学做生意的好地方。我们用甜甜圈换香烟，香烟换杰特，杰特换现金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By the end of our stint, we left with more money than what got us sent there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到我们刑期结束时，我们手上的钱比进去的时候还多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We took our skills and put them to work out in the real world. Bringing us to here. Our brand new HQ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们将自己的技能运用到现实世界中。我们来到了这里，全新的总部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now you're caught up, champ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在你赶上了，冠军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about Tres Leches Caravan Co.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说三人行商队公司吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just a normal Joe, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个普通人，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job's hard, but I wouldn't trade it for the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工作很辛苦，但给我全世界我也不换。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, with the road out I've had a lot of time to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这条路没了，我有很多时间思考。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've got no idea how long this route's fucked; We need to maintain cashflow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不知道这条路被毁会持续多久，我们需要维持现金流。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's time to diversify. Our time as junk dealers is over as far as I'm concerned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是时候多元化了。在我看来，我们做废品贩子的时代已经结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: With businessmen, of course. If you must ask, then it is most probable that these affairs do not concern you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是和商人。如果你一定要问，那么这些事情很可能与你无关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, I have other tasks to attend to, so if you have anything more to discuss, please make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我还有其他事情要处理，所以如果你还有什么要讨论的，请快点说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Business? What kind of business are you involved with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 生意？你做什么生意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, you are speaking to him. Unless you were mistaken and meant to seek out Tribunus Calvin or Centurion Aetius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你正在和他说话。除非你搞错了，想找保民官加尔文或百夫长埃提乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to speak with the top dog around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和这里的老大谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scilicet! I would be delighted to assist a local hero such as yourself. How can I be of service?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是说嘛！我很乐意帮助像你这样的本地英雄。我能为你做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I was just wondering if you could answer a few questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我想问你能不能回答几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I look as if though I am posted here to entertain questions from any wastrel who wanders in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看起来像是被派到这里来接受什么闯进来的二流子提问的人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only joking of course! I am at your service for as long as time permits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是开玩笑啦！只要时间允许，我随时为你服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I was just wondering if you could answer a few questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我想问你能不能回答几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is no trouble. I bid you vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一点也不麻烦。我向你告别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must have wandered into the wrong place. I'll be going now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一定是走错地方了，我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You cannot be serious. After all you have done to the people of Dolan Springs, consider yourself lucky that you are not already on the cross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会是认真的吧。在你对多兰泉的人民做了那么多坏事之后，你应该庆幸自己没有被钉上十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not be affiliated with the likes of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会和你这种人为伍的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see... Hmm...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看...嗯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It so happens that you suit the description of a particularly impenitent tramp I have heard rumors about. No, I do not have work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你恰好符合我听说过的一个特别顽固的流浪汉的描述。不，我没有工作给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truly, you are...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的，你是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As well as that may be I have no use for a cudgel at the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我现在也不需要棍棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you ought to ask Centurion Aetius about this. I am sure he could make do with someone of your... temperament.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你应该问问百夫长埃提乌斯，我相信他可以凑合用用你这种...气质的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? I suppose I could make use of someone with your social standing. How does fifty Denarii sound?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？我想我可以用上像你这样有社会地位的人。50第纳尔听起来如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In deference to your accomplishments in the name of Caesar, it is unfortunate that have no tasks suitable to be delegated to an outsider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到你以凯撒之名所取得的成就，很不幸没有合适的任务可以委托给外来者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should you find yourself ingratiated with the townspeople, I may have work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你发现自己受到了居民的欢迎，我可能会给你提供工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a mercenary or just another vagrant? No matter, I am sure there is work available with any one of the local caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是雇佣兵还是流浪汉？没关系，我相信任何一个当地的商队都有工作可做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I said, I have nothing for you at this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说过了，现在我没有事情给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead. I will answer what I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请讲，我会尽我所能回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有更多的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know why you came to me of all people, but I suppose I can help. Is there something in particular you are looking for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你为什么偏偏来找我，但我想我能帮上忙。你有什么特别想找的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some directions around town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你给我指路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you be more specific?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能说得更具体点吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could use some more directions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要更多的指示。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then please ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就问吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to ask about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问点别的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. I do not have much more time for dawdling, so unless there is something in particular you need, you ought to get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。我没有更多的时间磨磨蹭蹭，所以除非你有什么特别需要，否则你该走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我想知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what else do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你还需要什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我想知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the consulate of Chloride, office of the Proconsul of the Mojave Orientum province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是多兰泉领事馆，莫哈维东部总督办公室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the Proconsul of Mojave Orientum. This is my office. Understood? Optime!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是莫哈维东部的总督，这是我的办公室。理解吗？好吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this some kind of Legion outpost?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是军团的前哨吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Aristophontes, Proconsul of Chloride and the Mojave Orientum province at large.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是阿里斯托芬提斯，多兰泉和莫哈维东部的总督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Proconsul Aristophontes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 总督阿里斯托芬提斯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁来着？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I govern this province and ensure that Caesar's law is enforced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我管理这个行省，确保凯撒的法律得到执行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My office is also responsible for taking census, securing tribute to Flagstaff, and recording all traffic through our checkpoints.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的办公室还负责进行人口普查，确保旗杆市的贡品，并记录所有通过检查站的车辆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the duties of a Proconsul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 总督的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the province I govern from here in Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我在多兰泉管理的行省。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was that about the "Mojave Orientem"?
ESP.TRADUIT: “莫哈维东部”是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have much to say about it. Only a few years ago, this town was little more than a degenerate hive of vagrants and pilferers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多话要说。就在几年前，这个小镇还只是一个堕落流浪汉和小偷的聚集地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have since transformed it into the bustling hub of commerce you see today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后，我把它改造成了今天你看到的繁华的商业中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only wish I could say the same for the rest of the province, but Caesar understands that war leaves its mark on the land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真希望我也能对这个行省的其他地方说同样的话，但凯撒明白战争会在这片土地上留下印记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Dolan Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说多兰泉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那去问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it. I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了。我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An administrative rank in Caesar's Legion. As Proconsul, my duties are to govern this province and ensure that Caesar's law is enforced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒军团中的行政军衔。作为总督，我的职责是治理这个行省，确保凯撒的法律得到执行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My office is also responsible for taking census, securing tribute to Flagstaff, and recording all traffic through our checkpoints.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的办公室还负责进行人口普查，确保旗杆市的贡品，并记录所有通过检查站的车辆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood. What's a Proconsul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了。总督是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not forget yourself, sir! I am a revered senior servant of Caesar, and my authority is the highest in this valley. I will not tolerate such disrespect in my presence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要忘乎所以，先生！我是受人尊敬的凯撒的高级仆人，我的权力在这个山谷里是最高的，我不能容忍这种不尊重我的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I get it. You don't have to be a dick about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，我明白了。你不用这么混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not forget yourself, miss! I am a revered senior servant of Caesar, and my authority is the highest in this valley. I will not tolerate such disrespect in my presence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要忘乎所以，女士！我是受人尊敬的凯撒的高级仆人，我的权力在这个山谷里是最高的，我不能容忍这种不尊重我的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, yeah, I get it. You don't have to be a dick about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗯，我明白了。你不用这么混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh for Mars's sake! I have neither the time nor the patience to converse with morons. Please leave me be or I will have you thrown out of town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，看在玛尔斯的份上！我既没有时间也没有耐心和白痴交谈。请离我远点，否则我会把你赶出小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um... I still don't get it... Is this Chlorine or Mohoffee Orectum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...我还是没搞明白...这里是多兰的拳头还是莫哈菲的臀部？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. You would be especially wise to keep such remarks to yourself from now on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。从现在起，你最好把这些话藏在心里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My apologies. I didn't mean to offend you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，我不是有意要冒犯你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, that does it! You will leave my consulate. Now! If I ever see your degenerate face again, mark my words, I will see you crucified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，就这样吧！你必须离开我的领事馆，马上！如果再让我看到你这张堕落的脸，记住我的话，我就把你钉在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or what? You gonna cry about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不然呢？你要哭吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, that does it! You will leave my consulate. Now! If I ever see your degenerate face again, mark my words, I will see you enslaved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，就这样吧！你必须离开我的领事馆，马上！如果再让我看到你这张堕落的脸，记住我的话，我就把你抓去当奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or what? You gonna cry about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不然呢？你要哭吗？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Leave.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <离开>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, I'm sorry! I didn't really mean it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，对不起！我不是真心的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: You - argh! Deputies!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你...啊！代理人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Blow a raspberry in his face.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <往他脸上吹个覆盆子>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else would you like to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, that's really interesting. I wanted to ask you about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，那真有趣。我想问你点别的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If by "glorified" you mean highly respected and experienced, then yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的"光荣"是指受人尊敬和经验丰富，那么是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're a glorified Legion bureaucrat then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说你是光荣的军团官员了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most often it is a rank granted to veteran Scribonii, who are already fitted for administrative duties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最常见的情况是授予资深书记官这个军衔，他们已经适合担任行政职务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does one become a Proconsul?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个人如何成为一名总督？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, but such men are indispensible as martial leaders. It would be wasteful to repurpose them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，但这些人是不可或缺的军事领袖。 重新调整用途是一种浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, not many Legionaries would consider that a reward. They cherish the heat of battle, and the valor of dying a warrior's death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，没有多少军团士兵会把这当成奖励。他们珍视战斗的激情，珍视像战士一样死去的勇气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is difficult for their minds to grasp the honor that comes with a life of humble restraint and civic duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的头脑很难领会谦卑克制和公民义务生活所带来的荣誉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Centurions or Legates? Wouldn't they be most deserving of a whole province to rule over?
ESP.TRADUIT: 百夫长或特使呢？难道他们不应该统治整个行省吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, although not quite. Caesar has never authorized an excise tax, or even toll roads for that matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，尽管不完全是。凯撒从来没有授权征收消费税，甚至也没有授权收费公路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, all subjects of the Legion - Liberti - are expected to contribute a flat sum of resources, unless granted a special exemption.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，除非获得特别豁免，否则军团的所有臣民...自由民...都要缴纳一笔固定的资金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tribute? So you collect taxes then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贡品？所以你要收税。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A public record of subjects, infrastructure, buildings, land features... things of that sort. All of it is delivered to Flagstaff once a year to be audited.
ESP.TRADUIT: 臣民、基础设施、建筑物、地势的公共记录...诸如此类的事情。所有这些每年都会被送到旗杆市接受审计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a census?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人口普查是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh really? And what would that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，真的吗？那是什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have formulated an opinion on Proconsuls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一个关于总督的想法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is. I had served Caesar as a Scribonius for nearly twenty years before he rewarded me with the title.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。在凯撒授予我这个头衔之前，我已经作为书记官侍奉他将近二十年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Few in the Legion ever prove themselves worthy of administering a latrine, let alone an entire province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团中很少有人能证明自己有资格管理一个厕所，更不用说管理整个行省了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like an prestigious position!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来是个声望很高的职位！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is true. My duties are rarely so numerous that I do not have hours in the week with nothing to do, such as now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是真的。我的任务很少如此之多，以至于我每周都有几个小时无所事事，比如现在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the mundanity of council meetings is nothing to look forward to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而平淡无奇的议会会议也没什么值得期待的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this is the role that Caesar sought fit for me, and boredom is a manageable foe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是凯撒为我寻找的适合我的角色，无聊是一个可以控制的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like a boring position...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来是个无聊的职位...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. While I am no stranger to the sentiment it seems that I misjudged your character.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。虽然我对这种情绪并不陌生，但似乎是我误判了你的性格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you would be better off wrestling in the mud with the Profligates than in the company of civilized men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你与其与文明人为伍，还不如与放荡者在泥泞中搏斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like a disgraceful position.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来像是个不光彩的职位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay... I am not surprised that an outsider would struggle to comprehend the merits of our system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧...一个外来者很难理解我们制度的优点，我并不感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I'm totally apathetic to the concept.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我对这个概念完全不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Can I ask about something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我能问点别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fairly large, technically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 严格来说，相当大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: North to south, it extends from the shore of Lake Mead all the way to Kingman, which is the seat of the Proconsul of Mojave Meridiem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从北到南，从米德湖岸一直延伸到金曼，是莫哈维中部总督的所在地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: East to west, it extends from the Colorado to the mouth of the Magna Chasma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从东到西，它从科罗拉多延伸到大空洞的入口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How big is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多大？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you might have noticed, the Chainway has been destroyed. I am cut off from most of my territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能已经注意到了，连环道已经被摧毁了。我的大部分领土都被切断了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean, "technically"?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的"严格来说"是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fortunately, Caesar and his Legatii have effectively always administered that area for as long as it has been under our control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运的是，凯撒和他的特使一直有效地管理着那个地区，只要它还在我们的控制之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My only concern is ensuring the timely completion of the Chainway's repair and the rerouting of supplies upriver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一关心的是确保连环道的修复工作及时完成，并重新安排上游的补给路线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you govern the towns to the north, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你如何管理北方的城镇呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Well, yes. But you must understand why I was assigned to this province to begin with. It is a special case... An experiment if you will.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，是的。但你必须明白我为什么被派到这个行省来。这是个特例...可以称之为实验。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kingman is just south of here... Caesar governs the north... You only rule over a single town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 金曼就在这里的南边...凯撒统治着北方...你只统治着一个小镇？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Nonsense. The front has stalled for far longer than anybody had anticipated, and the consequences of that are far beyond my control.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]无稽之谈。战线停滞的时间远远超出了所有人的预期，其后果也超出了我的控制范围。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am still officially the governor of this entire region, and I am doing everything in my power to hold it together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我仍然是这整个地区的正式总督，我正在尽我所能让它团结在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way you describe your territory sounds to me like you barely govern it at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我听来，你描述你的领地的方式就像你根本没有管理过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cannot give a definite answer. Our territory is constantly expanding and its vastness discourages correspondence over such trivial facts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能给一个明确的答复。我们的领土在不断扩大，辽阔到人们对这些微不足道的事实不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only know of a dozen provinces and fewer I can name:
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道十几个行省，能说出名字的就更少了：
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mojave Orientum, Mojave Meridiem, Vallis Pacis, Yuma, Magna Chasma, Flagstaff, Phoenix, Two-Sun, Albus Quercus. There are surely many more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫哈维东部、莫哈维中部、和平谷、尤马、大裂谷、旗杆市、凤凰城、双日城，还有阿尔伯克基。当然还有很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many provinces are there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一共有多少个行省？

ESP.ORIGINAL: An experiment in civilization building! You may have noticed that Chloride is quite unique from our other municipalities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个文明建设的实验！你可能已经注意到，多兰泉与我们的其他城市相比是非常独特的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guards, aside from Aetius, are not true Legionaries. They are volunteer patrolmen, and mostly Liberti!
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了埃提乌斯之外，这些卫兵都不是真正的军团士兵。他们是志愿巡视员，大多是自由民！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Twice a week, I meet with an assembly of local business owners, and their elected representative, to formulate policy for the province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每周两次，我都要与当地企业主和他们选出的代表会面，为该行省制定政策。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar approved this because he is interested in its potential as a model for the rest of our society to follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒之所以批准这样做，是因为他看中了这里作为我们社会其他成员学习榜样的潜力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of experiment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么样的实验？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I am! If my project is successful, which it has been thusfar, I am to be the first choice for Proconsul of the Mojave province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是当然！如果我的项目成功了，到目前为止，我将成为莫哈维行省总督的首选。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once Vegas is ours, Decimus will be *my* inferior! Ha!
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦维加斯归我们了，德西默斯就是我的下属了！哈！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you seem really passionate about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你看起来对这个很有热情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... Decimus Aquinas is the Proconsul of Mojave Meridiem. Do not take what I said too seriously, we just have a... friendly rivalry with each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢...德西默斯·阿奎纳是莫哈维中部的总督。别把我说的话太当真，我们只是...彼此间的友好竞争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Decimus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 德西默斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are welcome. Was there anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不客气。还有别的事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those were all the directions I needed. Thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我需要的所有方向。谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you came here for leisure, you will likely be disappointed. Chloride is not a Profligate town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你来这里是为了休闲，你可能会失望。多兰泉不是一个放荡者的小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do in Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在克洛赖德有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The trading post is the blue building in the center of town. It is run by a man named Nicodemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贸易站是城镇中心的蓝色建筑，是一个叫尼哥德慕的人管理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is an... interesting fellow. But you should keep him at arm's length.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个...有趣的家伙，但你应该和他保持距离。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a store in town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上有商店吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could try The Big Dog at the other end of town. There is also a diner just down the road, but it is for traders only.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以去找镇子另一头的大狗。这条路的尽头也有一家小餐馆，但只为商人服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I get a meal around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近哪里有吃饭的地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not unless you are one of the traders, no. I recommend Elephant Hill. It is a short walk south, along what's left of Highway 93.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你是商人之一，否则不行。我推荐象山，沿着93号公路的剩余部分向南走一小段路就到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ricamore, the owner, is a good friend of mine, so tell him I sent you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 店主里卡莫尔是我的好朋友，告诉他是我让你来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any place to sleep?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有地方睡觉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will be waiting. Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会等你的。再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back later, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我一会儿再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am listening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, then. Let's discuss something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就算了。我们讨论点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Well, I must admit you *do* have a certain charm about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，我必须承认你确实有某种魅力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright then, I suppose it would be foolish to pass you up for a job of this sort. How does fifty Denarii sound?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧，我想如果不让你做这种工作就太愚蠢了。50第纳尔听起来如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have to worry about that. People love me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用担心这个，大家都喜欢我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] "Come on...! I can do it....!" Hahaha that is you! That is what you sound like!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]“拜托...！我可以的...！”哈哈哈，就是你！这就是你的声音！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my, I am sorry about that. It was only a joke! But seriously, I am not giving you this job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，真是抱歉。开个玩笑而已！但说真的，我不会给你这份工作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on... I can do it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托...我可以的...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be that as it may, I am not willing to take such a risk. I think this conversation is over now. Goodbye!
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是不愿冒这个险。我想这个话题到此为止了，再见！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would never! That has to be a coincidence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不会呢！这一定是个巧合。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bene! I am handing you a document containing a list of my tributaries and the total value of tribute they each owe in Denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好！我现在交给你一份文件，上面列着我的贡品清单，以及他们每人所欠贡品的总价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are to locate them, collect their tribute in full, and return it to me. In full. With haste. Understood? Any questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要找到他们，收足他们的贡品，交给我。全额，尽快，明白了吗？有问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I accept your offer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我接受你的提议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Indecisiveness is an unemployable trait anyway. Now get out of my sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，无论如何，优柔寡断是一种无法就业的特质。现在滚出我的视线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, I don't think I want to work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 转念一想，我不想为你工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wrong answer! If you are to work with me - that is, if you are to work with Caesar - then you must be willing to accept our offer, no questions asked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 答错了！如果你要跟我合作...也就是说，如果你要跟凯撒合作，那么你必须愿意接受我们的提议，不要问任何问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, no more questions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，已经没有问题了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Depends. You still haven't told me what the job is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看情况，你还没告诉我工作是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. You will receive your payment when the tribute is on my desk. Move along now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实。贡品放在我桌上，你就能拿到钱。现在就开始吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will get it done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会搞定的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Yes! That was a test and you failed! Now go before I revoke my offer!
ESP.TRADUIT: ...是的！那是一场考验，你失败了！趁我还没收回报价，赶紧走吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't you just say not to ask any more questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你刚才不是说不要再问问题了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, of course I do. This is *outstanding* tribute and I require someone with tact to obtain it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我当然找了。这是未解决的贡品，我需要有技巧的人来获得它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you already have people to collect tribute?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是已经找人来收贡品了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, believe me, he would, *if* he were not receiving sufficient tribute regardless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，相信我，如果他没有收到足够的贡品，他会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am no fool. Should the scales be uneven, I split the difference, and everyone remains satisfied. ...Until it comes time to settle debts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是傻瓜。如果天平不平衡，我折中一下，然后每个人都满意...直到偿还债务的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised that Caesar hasn't already held you accountable for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶凯撒居然没有让你为此负责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those thugs Aetius has patrolling the streets are for little more than show.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃提乌斯派去街上巡逻的那些恶棍不过是做做样子而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And between you and me it is best to distance them from any situations that could invoke their barbarism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你我之间最好让他们远离任何可能引发他们野蛮行为的场合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about your deputies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的代理人呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They must. That is why I am hiring you. Use whatever methods you wish, but do not do physical harm to them or anything else that should reflect poorly on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们必须提供，这就是我雇你的原因。你想用什么方法都行，但不要对他们造成身体上的伤害，也不要做任何会让我丢脸的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if they can't offer enough tribute?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们不能提供足够的贡品怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Denarii, food, water, clothes, useful tools and materials in good condition. And, if nothing else, bodies. But please do not let it come to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第纳尔、食物、水、衣服、有用的工具和完好无损的材料。如果没有别的，还有尸体，但请不要让事情发展到那种地步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No person of Chloride has submitted themselves to slavery under my watch thusfar, and I intend to keep it that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止，多兰泉还没有人在我的监视下沦为奴隶，我也打算继续保持这种状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What exactly qualifies as valid tribute?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么才是有效的贡品？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I give the soldiers massages, care for them when they're sick, and listen to their problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给士兵们按摩，在他们生病的时候照顾他们，倾听他们的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a part of the healing process. They push themselves hard, but sometimes they go too far and hurt themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是治愈过程的一部分。他们把自己逼得很紧，但有时他们太过火，伤害了自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do the soldiers need massages?
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵们为什么需要按摩？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Purchase a slave if you want relief. Massages are strictly medicinal and for soldiers only.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想放松，买个奴隶吧。按摩是严格意义上的医疗服务，只适用于士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get a massage?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能给我按摩一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I would say the most common are emotional.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想说最常见的是情绪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many soldiers are quick to anger. Others are seized by a horrible impatience. They tell me they fear they're not doing enough to please Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多士兵很容易发怒，另一些人则被一种可怕的不耐烦所困扰。他们告诉我，他们担心自己做得不够好，无法取悦玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On rare occasions, I've talked to soldiers who present with confusion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在极少数情况下，我曾与表现出困惑的士兵交谈过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say that time isn't passing normally, or that the world isn't real, or similar such things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们说时间没有正常流逝，或者这个世界不是真实的，或者类似的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those cases always make me sad, but those soldiers end up being some of the most vicious in the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些情况总是让我很难过，但这些士兵最终会成为军团中最凶残的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of problems do the Legionaries have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵有什么样的问题呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't say such ridiculous things. Legion men are not weak like Profligate men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要说这种荒唐的话，军团的人不会像放荡的人那样软弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like the symptoms of a dissociative disorder. Those men are likely traumatized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来像是分离性障碍的症状，那些人可能受到了精神创伤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tch. Degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 切，堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. Legionaries sound like weak losers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，军团士兵听起来就像是软弱的失败者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jaw Ripper bought them from a trader for me. I'm blind as a mole rat without them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下颚撕裂者从一个商人那里给我买的，不戴眼镜我就瞎得像只鼹鼠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They fog up really bad when the baths are running, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但当浴池开着的时候就会起雾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice glasses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂亮的眼镜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's an Instructor. We Maidens usually raise the girls, but Instructors raise the boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个教官。通常是我们女侍养女孩，而教官养教官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Jaw Ripper?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下颚撕裂者是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Daria [06017D8E] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Malpais Market. Perhaps its name provides a hint. Here, traders and slavers peddle their wares.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯市场，也许从它的名字就能看出端倪。 在这里，商人和奴隶贩子兜售他们的商品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this market.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个市场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. It is simply the most efficient way for us to operate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这是我们最有效的运作方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine if we were to waste our men scavenging for Pre-War guns, or hunting down captures. Unconscionable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一下，如果我们的人都浪费在搜寻战前的枪支，或者追捕猎物上。不合理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, these 'third-parties' must compete to provide us the best service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，这些“第三方”必须竞争，为我们提供最好的服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion buy from third-party merchants?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团会从第三方商人那里采购吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The treasury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 国库。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our Liberti willingly provide a tribute of food and water, and our soldiers serve only Caesar. That leaves us with an excess of funds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的自由民自愿上贡食物和水，我们的士兵只为凯撒服务。这给我们留下了过剩的资金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where does the Legion get the money to make purchases?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的采购资金从何而来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Scribonius. Like most Scribonii, I am a former Libertus. I joined the Legion as a young man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一名书记官。和大多数书记官一样，我之前是一名自由民。我年轻时就加入了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appealed to the regional Proconsul. I was made to demonstrate my abilities, and questioned by a Frumentarius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我向地方行省总督恳求。我被要求展示我的能力，并被一个军团特务审问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ultimately, I passed all tests with flying colors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，我以优异的成绩通过了所有的测试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you join the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么加入军团的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides standard military business and trade, there is a scuttle to fix the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了标准的军事业务和贸易外，还有一项修复连环道的任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway is the overpass just west of here. Until recently, it was perfectly intact. Its collapse has hampered our supply lines significantly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道就是这里西边的立交桥。直到最近，它还是完好无损的，它的坍塌严重阻碍了我们的补给线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of things go on around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里都发生了些什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not much more than a highway rest stop. I believe there's a restaurant there, or some sort of saloon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟高速公路休息站差不多。我想那里应该有家餐厅，或者是酒吧之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you are interested in meeting the elderly, infirm, and otherwise useless, I would highly recommend visiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有兴趣见见老年人、体弱多病者和其他无用之人，我强烈建议你去看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Elephant Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说象山。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ones you see are the ones that got here safely. The others? Well...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到的是安全抵达这里的人。其他人呢？这个嘛...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe many are getting as far as Elephant Hill, then simply turning back. Frustrating, to say the least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信很多人走到象山就折返了，至少可以说是令人沮丧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trentoria [06016C80] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It seems like merchants are still getting here just fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来商人们还是能很顺利地来到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus! Okay, I'm sorry. Fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪！好吧，对不起。操。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Titus Killus [06014F1C] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such a big heart you have. It'll make a great meal for the vultures when I tear it out of your chest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有一颗宽容的心。等我把它从你的胸膛里扯出来，秃鹫们就可以好好享用了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, a drifter! Not many of those around these days. With the war heating up, almost everyone moves with a purpose. Myself, drifting is my purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，一个流浪汉！这年头这样的人不多了。随着战争的升温，几乎每个人的行动都是有目的的。对我来说，流浪就是我的目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just passing through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是路过而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope you accept denarii!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我希望你能接受第纳尔！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just pulling your leg. This is the frontlines so a lot of folk still trade in caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我逗你玩呢。 这里是前线，所以很多人还在用瓶盖交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're serious, though, you might try the foreman at the Chainway or the trading post. The optio here might have work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，如果你是认真的，你可以试试连环道或贸易站的工头。这里的执行官也可能有活儿给你干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Steer clear of the centurion though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过要避开百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope you accept denarii!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我希望你能接受第纳尔！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just pulling your leg. This is the frontlines so a lot of folk still trade in caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我逗你玩呢。 这里是前线，所以很多人还在用瓶盖交易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're serious, though, you might try the foreman at the Chainway or the trading post. The optio here might have work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，如果你是认真的，你可以试试连环道或贸易站的工头。这里的执行官也可能有活儿给你干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fascinating, isn't it? As long as you don't run afoul of them, things are quite orderly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有意思，不是吗？只要你不与他们发生冲突，一切还是很有秩序的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the "don't run afoul of them" part that trips most people up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人都会被 "不要触犯他们 "这句话绊倒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured I'd see what the Legion was like for myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想亲自看看军团是什么样的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure am! Been with Radio New Vegas for nearly eight years now. Before that, I was employed back at the Hub.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是！我在新维加斯电台工作快八年了。在那之前，我在中枢市工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came out here to follow the NCR's Mojave Campaign, but when I got here, what truly fascinated me was the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来这里是为了关注NCR的莫哈维战役，但当我到了这里，真正让我着迷的是军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe half a year ago, I worked up the nerve to cross the river with a trade caravan. I pled my case to a Frumentarius and I've been reporting here ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概半年前，我鼓起勇气和一个贸易商队过了河。我向一个特务求情，从那时起我就一直在这里报道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you're a reporter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你是个记者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be surprised to hear, but they don't! Not usually, anyway. I'm the exception.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会感到惊讶，但它们并不允许！至少通常不允许，我是个例外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In some ways, it's actually beneficial for them to have me around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某种程度上，我在他们身边是有益的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think of the Legion M.O. -- crucifixions, huge fires with stacks of smoke. All of it demands attention. All of it is meant to terrify.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想军团的惯用手法，钉十字架，浓烟滚滚的大火。这些都是为了获取关注，所有这些都是为了恐吓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might have heard my report on Lanius's decimatio. I spread the word for them, when they want the word spread, that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能听过我关于拉尼厄斯被杀的报道。当他们想要传播消息的时候，我为他们传播消息，就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does the Legion allow reporters to run around their teritory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么军团允许记者在他们的地盘上跑来跑去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the truth is propaganda, my friend, then I'm its most committed crusader. It'd do nobody any good to ignore what's happening here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果真相是一种宣传，我的朋友，那么我就是它最坚定的斗士。忽视这里发生的一切对任何人都没有好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have never written even a single falsehood. I pride myself on always telling it like it is, no matter how much people don't want to hear it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没有写过一句假话。我为自己总是实话实说而感到自豪，不管人们有多不想听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're a Legion propagandist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你是军团的宣传员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is not how I'd characterize my job. I spread the news. If the news terrifies, then maybe it should. Maybe the truth is terrifying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我对自己的工作的描述。我传播了这个消息，如果这个消息让人感到恐惧，那么也许它就应该是这样。真相或许就是可怕的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if it's terrifying, people have got to know. It's definitely honest, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果它很可怕，人们必须知道。但这绝对是诚实的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spreading terror under the guise of honest reporting. I respect it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以诚实报道为幌子散播恐怖。我对此表示尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Let me know if you uncover any leads on this so-called positive news. I know I'd want to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！如果你发现了任何关于这个所谓的积极消息的线索，请告诉我。我清楚我也很想知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you try reporting something positive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不尝试报道一些积极的事情呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my business how you do your job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你工作的方式与我无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are a few. Truth is: it's dangerous work, and thankless too. You spend all your time racing to be on the scene of the next big story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个。事实是：这是一份危险的工作，而且吃力不讨好。你把所有的时间都花在赶赴下一个大新闻的现场上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By the time you get there, the story's over. Then, you have to figure out the truth. You have to reconcile dozens of differing eyewitnesses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你到达那里的时候，故事已经结束了。然后，你得找出真相，你得调和几十个不同的目击证人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you have to make big decisions on who was right or who was wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接着，你必须做出重大决定，谁是对的，谁是错的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not everyone wants you to know the truth either, and they'll go to great lengths to stop you learning it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也不是每个人都想让你知道真相，他们会不遗余力地阻止你了解真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd have to be crazy or stupid to want this life. I'll let you decide which I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有疯子或者傻子才会想要这样的生活，我会让你来决定我是哪个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there a lot of reporters in the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫哈维有很多记者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Informants and bots, mostly. A journalist is nothing without his informants, and the bots go around collecting data.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要靠线人和机器人。没有线人，记者什么都不是，而机器人则到处收集数据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you need the human element to really get good quotes. Folks don't like talking to eyebots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你仍然需要人为因素来获得真正好的引述。人们不喜欢和眼球机器人说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we arrive on the scene, the story is nearly already written.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们到达现场时，故事几乎已经写好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and we use two-way radios for just about everything. Hard to overstate how useful those things are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，我们几乎什么都用双向对讲机。这些东西的用处怎么说都不为过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do Radio New Vegas reporters operate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 新维加斯电台的记者是怎么工作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he's a computer, for one. Surprised? Yup, it's true! He's all wires and cables. In our archive, there are a couple holodisks of his pre-war radio shows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，他是一台电脑。惊讶吧？嗯，是真的！他浑身都是电线和电缆。在我们的档案里，有几张他战前广播节目的全息影碟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating to hear him interview an old fart like Dean Domino, knowing that Dean was probably killed when the bombs started flying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听他采访迪安·多米诺这样的老混蛋真有意思，他知道迪安很可能在轰炸开始时就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Mr. New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说新维加斯先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, no. There is some censorship and, ah, body searches. I don't mind. Rather, I do mind, but I understand the necessity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，不。有一些审查制度，还有搜身，我不介意。确切地说，我介意，但我理解必要性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been getting worse the past couple of weeks. The centurion is so unstable, and sometimes, I worry that he'll just kill me for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去几周情况越来越糟。那个百夫长太不稳定了，有时候，我担心他会无缘无故地杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion allow you to print whatever you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团允许你想印什么就印什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, no. There is some censorship and, ah, body searches. I don't mind. Rather, I do mind, but I understand the necessity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，不。有一些审查制度，还有搜身，我不介意。确切地说，我介意，但我理解必要性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's lightened up since that centurion got removed. The new one even allowed me to have a beer. Haven't had one of those in forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从那个百夫长被撤职后就变轻松了。新来的那个甚至允许我喝啤酒，我好久没喝过这种东西了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if it was almost entirely water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使它几乎全是水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion allow you to print whatever you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团允许你想印什么就印什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't everyone these days? What's so special about you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在每个人不都是吗？你有什么特别的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been in the news, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也上过新闻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有关于军团的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're a highly militarized society organized around some core ideals that may seem strange to you or me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是一个高度军事化的社会，围绕着一些对你我来说可能很奇怪的核心理念。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every individual seems to regard himself as a tool. They are for Caesar to wield in his construction of a new world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人似乎都把自己当作一种工具，他们是凯撒用来建设新世界的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To this end, they don't care if they're injured, or even if they die. Sometimes, I'm not even convinced they were ever human.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为此，他们不在乎自己是否受伤，甚至是死亡。有时，我甚至不相信他们曾经是人类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't really have citizens, either. Not like the NCR. If you're not a soldier or a slave, you're a subject, and the Legion can order you around as they see fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们也没有真正的公民，不像NCR。如果你不是士兵或奴隶，你就是臣民，军团可以随意命令你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么了解？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a sense, yes. In that same sense, so are you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某种意义上，是。从同样的意义上说，你也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've been given grace. All subjects have grace so long as they mind themselves. By the way you carry yourself, I take it you have a little more grace than most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们被赐予了恩典。只要管好自己，所有臣民都可以得到恩典。从你的举止来看，我认为你比大多数人得到的恩典都多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you better not screw up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你最好别搞砸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a subject of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是军团的臣民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's a war going on between the Legion and some army called the NCR. I don't know if you've heard of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，军团和NCR之间正在进行一场战争。我不知道你是否听说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I jest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我开玩笑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's done pretty well for itself in this front. Six months ago, the NCR abruptly left Bullhead. Not sure why. Maybe they lost. Don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在前线表现得很好。六个月前，NCR突然离开了布尔海德，不知道为什么。也许他们输了，不清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't imagine folks back home are happy about that. Bullhead's the city Kimball ran on to become President, so he probably got raked in the midterms earlier this year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法想象家乡的人们会对此感到高兴。布尔海德是金博尔竞选总统的地方，所以他可能在今年早些时候的中期选举中失利了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About a month ago, the Legion took Camp Willow. A week later, the Legion knocked the NCR off the spillway of Hoover Dam. But I've heard they've withdrawn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约一个月前，军团占领了柳树营。 一周后，军团把NCR打下了胡佛大坝的泄洪道。但我听说他们撤退了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're interested in more local stuff, there's the Chainway collapse and the Solitare situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你对更多本地的东西感兴趣，还有连环道坍塌和索利泰尔的情况。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's going on in the world?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，世界上发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, the local news stories are the collapse of the Chainway, and the violence in Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，当地的新闻报道是连环道的坍塌，以及索利泰尔的暴力事件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's going on in the world?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，世界上发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Great Chainway, Route 93, is one of the most important trade routes in Arizona. It, I-40, and I-17, make up the Great Triangle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 93号公路的大连环道是亚利桑那州最重要的贸易路线之一。它，40号洲际公路和17号洲际公路构成了大三角
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A big circuit connecting Phoenix, Flagstaff, and Kingman. That's the industrial capital, the actual capital, and the biggest logistics hub in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一条连接凤凰城、旗杆市和金曼的大环线。那是工业中心，实际的首都，也是莫哈维最大的物流中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway only broke apart a couple months ago. Amazingly, it hasn't slowed the Legion down much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道几个月前才散架。令人惊讶的是，这并没有减慢军团的速度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They've shifted towards using the Colorado more. Apparently, the NCR couldn't keep them out of Nelson or Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们更倾向于利用科罗拉多河。显然，NCR没能阻止他们进入纳尔逊和棉白杨湾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说连环道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Great Chainway, Route 93, is one of the most important trade routes in Arizona. It, I-40, and I-17, make up the Great Triangle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 93号公路的大连环道是亚利桑那州最重要的贸易路线之一。它，40号洲际公路和17号洲际公路构成了大三角
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A big circuit connecting Phoenix, Flagstaff, and Kingman. That's the industrial capital, the actual capital, and the biggest logistics hub in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一条连接凤凰城、旗杆市和金曼的大环线。那是工业中心，实际的首都，也是莫哈维最大的物流中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway only broke apart a couple months ago. It wasn't until recently that's it slowed down them down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道几个月前才解体。直到最近，他们才缓过劲来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently, the Legion's hold on the Colorado has weakened. NCR must have retaken Nelson or Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然，军团对科罗拉多河的控制有所减弱。NCR肯定夺回了纳尔逊或棉白杨湾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说连环道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truthfully, I can't tell you a whole lot. Yes, I'm a reporter, but I'm not a stupid reporter. When the Legion delivers punishment, it's final.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我不能告诉你太多。是的，我是一个记者，但我不是一个愚蠢的记者。当军团作出惩罚时，就是最后的结果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nosing around would only get me killed too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瞎打听只会害死我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I do know is that the townsfolk were collaborating with NCR Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道镇上的人在和NCR游骑兵合作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure where they came from, considering Big Stop's been under Legion control for the past year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道他们是从哪里来的，因为大站在过去的一年中一直在军团的控制下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it's over now. There were executions, tortures, and more executions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，现在一切都结束了。处决，酷刑，还有更多的处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion isn't usually cruel to its subjects the way it is to Profligates, but those people were made to suffer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团通常不会像对待放荡者那样残酷对待自己的臣民，但那些人却因此受尽折磨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The commander there, Dominicus Rex, seems to be satisfied for now. But who knows? Maybe he'll change his mind and start killing again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里的指挥官多米尼库斯·勒克斯现在似乎很满意。但谁知道呢？也许他会改变主意，重新开始杀人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about what happened at Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说在索利泰尔发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Told you. They butchered the place after the townsfolk collaborated with some Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早就告诉你了。在镇上的人与几个游骑兵合作后，他们屠杀了这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about what happened at Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说在索利泰尔发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where you not fucking paying attention when we visited? Do you have a brain injury or-? Uh, actually never mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来的时候你他妈没注意听吗？你脑子坏了还是？ 呃，算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about what happened at Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说在索利泰尔发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No clue. I've done some poking around, and everyone seems to have a different theory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有线索。我调查了一下，每个人似乎都有不同的看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Frumentarius agent told me that might have been a rogue agent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一位特务间谍告诉我可能是有间谍叛变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the soldiers seem to think it was Support Unit Hoover, a resistance group that gave the Legion a lot of trouble in the past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些士兵似乎认为这是胡佛支援小队，一个过去给军团带来了很多麻烦的抵抗组织。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the merchants think it was the work of a commando team of Rangers. And some of the slaves think it was the work of the Burned Man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些商人认为这是游骑兵突击队干的，有些奴隶认为这是火烧人的杰作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All very exciting possibilities. Me, my money is on this Support Unit Hoover group.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都是非常令人兴奋的可能性，我赌的是胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, the Legion wouldn't just not repair their main road. They might be brutal, but they're efficient. Right? Right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，军团不会不修他们的主干道。他们可能很残忍，但他们很有效率。对吧？对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did the Chainway collapse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么连环道会坍塌？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, yeah, it is. Town used to be called Big Stop, but after the rebellion, the Legion's banned the use of that name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，是的。小镇以前叫大站，但在叛乱之后，军团禁止使用这个名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They really want you to call it Solitare. Don't tell anyone I called it Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们真的希望你把它叫做索利泰尔，别告诉别人我叫它大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh? Big Stop? I thought the town was called Solitare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？大站？我记得那个小镇叫索利泰尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask about your journalism work.
