ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问一下你的新闻工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truthfully? What incredible luck! You know that RNV has been trying to reach you for an interview forever? You move around too damn much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 属实吗？真是太幸运了！你知道新维加斯电台一直想采访你吗？你他妈到处乱跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the interview starts now. Do you have a name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，采访现在开始。你叫什么名字？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <You point to the scar on your head.> I'm the courier from Goodsprings.
ESP.TRADUIT: <你指着头上的伤疤>我是来自清泉镇的邮差。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fort, huh? Invited to speak with Mr. House, the ambassador and Caesar? You certainly do live an exciting life. Wish I had that kind of pull.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒，是吧？受邀与豪斯先生，大使和凯撒谈话？你的生活确实很精彩，真希望我也有这么大的影响力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually.... Hey, after you're done speaking to Caesar, come back here. I've got a proposition for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实...嘿，你和凯撒谈完之后，再回来。我有个提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. Evidently, Caesar has business to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记。显然，凯撒有事要谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wasn't really expecting that. But, if that's your name, then that's your name. So, tell us, what has it been like since you got shot? And how did that even happen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真没想到。但是，如果这是你的名字，那就是你的名字。跟我们说说，你中枪后是什么感觉？这是怎么发生的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's &PCName;.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, huh. You shouldn't be hitting the chems in Legion territory. That's a capital offense, along with just about every other offense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，嗯。你不应该在军团的地盘上嗑药，这是死罪，和其他几乎所有的罪行一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there an actual reason you're here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来这里有什么真正的原因吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here on a secret mission against the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来执行对抗军团的秘密任务的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay....
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, there was this guy, Benny....
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个叫...本尼的家伙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy crap! How'd you get that? You mean you were telling the truth? So, that means you're going to the Fort, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的天！你怎么弄到的？你的意思是你说的是实话？那就是说你要去堡垒了，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... As long as your "secret mission" doesn't involve pissing off the entire Legion, I have a proposal for you when you get back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...只要你的"秘密任务"不激怒整个军团，等你回来我有个提议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, you probably shouldn't keep the big guy waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎么说，你还是别让那个大块头等了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, look. I have the Mark of Caesar. See?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，听着，我有凯撒的徽记。明白吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Let's get started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！让我们开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I can do an interview.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我可以接受采访。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair's fair. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 彼此都要公平，你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay.... Offer's still on the table, if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧...如果你改变主意，提议仍然有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <You raise your hand to cover your face.> I don't talk to the press.
ESP.TRADUIT: <你举起手遮住脸>我不跟媒体说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay.... Offer's still on the table, if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧...如果你改变主意，提议仍然有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure if you're joking or not, but you have spoken to Caesar, right? Would you do another interview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道你是不是在开玩笑，但你和凯撒谈过了，对吧？你能再做一次采访吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an army of robots underneath the Fort. I dealt with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒下面有一支机器人军队，我解决了他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They always are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一直都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was shorter than I thought he'd be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比我想象中要矮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. I've got a proposition for you. How would you like to do some freelance work for Radio New Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我有个提议给你。你愿意为新维加斯电台做一些自由工作吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have the flexibility you do. Sure, the Legion lets me run around and ask questions, but you have the Mark of Caesar. You could really get some juicy stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有你那种灵活性。当然，军团允许我到处乱问问题，但你有凯撒的徽记，你可以得到一些有趣的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't expect you to work for free. I'll cut into my retirement fund if I have to. Far as I'm concerned, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不指望你免费工作，如果有必要，我会动用我的退休基金。对我来说，这是一个千载难逢的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, well that's that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，该怎样就怎样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that job offer....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于那份工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Alright, so the rate's going to be 100 caps per interview. Another 100 caps for any major scoops. Pretty simple, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！好吧，所以每次采访的费用是100瓶盖，大新闻再给100瓶盖。很简单，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, come back if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果你改变主意了就回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I could probably bump it up to 110, but I'm not exactly rolling in caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我可能会把它提高到110，但我可没有赚大钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems a little light for someone doing all of the legwork.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对一个做了所有跑腿工作的人来说，这似乎有点少。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yes, I'm rolling in caps. I shove them up my ass when the Legion is doing body searches.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]是的，我赚了大把的瓶盖。军团搜身的时候我就把它们都塞进屁眼里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a joke, by the way. I'm not, and I don't do that. I don't have any caps to spare is what I'm saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便说一句，这是个玩笑。我不是，我也不会那么做。我是说，我没有多余的瓶盖了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't journalists make loads of caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 记者不是能赚很多钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Let's get started. You probably haven't done this kind of work before, so we'll start small.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！我们开始吧。你可能以前没有做过这类工作，所以我们从小事开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's been repairing the Chainway for a long time, and I'm curious about how it's coming along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团修复连环道已经有很长一段时间了，我很好奇他们的进展如何。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get on over there and ask some questions, whatever feels natural. Once you're satisfied, come back here and give me a rundown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去问些问题，就随便问些自然的问题。你觉得满意了，再来跟我说个大概。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and since you're a journalist for RNV, here's your own newsman fedora. Don't lose it. I only brought the two when I came across the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，既然你是新维加斯电台的记者，这是你的记者软呢帽。别弄丢了，我穿越科罗拉多河的时候就带了两顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds fair to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很公平。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Tell me what you've learned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！告诉我你学到了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Tell me what you've learned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！告诉我你学到了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I finished that slavers job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完成了奴贩的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then finish it so I can pay you. You're my eyes and ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就完成它，我好付钱给你。你是我的耳目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're not going to do it, then I'm not going to pay you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不去做，我就不会给你钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Legion ingenuity. Legion will probably like that. What about the slaves? What's the work there like for them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。军团的智慧，军团可能会喜欢这个。奴隶们呢？他们在那里的工作怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion shows significant ingenuity in rebuilding the Chainway. We should focus on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在重建连环道方面表现出了非凡的创造力。我们应该关注这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess if we want to light a fire under the Legion's ass, that's the way to do it. Maybe the higher-ups will like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果我们想激怒军团，就该这么做。也许上级会喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't imagine that the Legionaries living here are going to like that, though. What about the slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我无法想象住在这里的军团士兵会喜欢这样。奴隶们呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's progress on rebuilding the Chainway is slow. We should focus on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团重建连环道的进度很慢。我们应该关注这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt that. I mean, did you even ask any of the slaves for their opinions? But, hey, if that's what they said, that's what they said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。我是说，你有问过奴隶们的意见吗？但是，嘿，如果他们真是这么说的，那就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. The Chainway isn't a particularly interesting story anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦好吧。无论如何，连环道并不是一个特别有趣的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: The slaves seem content and happy with their work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶们似乎对自己的工作感到满足和快乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt that. I mean, did you even ask any of the slaves for their opinions? But, hey, if that's what they said, that's what they said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。我是说，你有问过奴隶们的意见吗？但是，嘿，如果他们真是这么说的，那就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like I'll have to wait a lot longer for any leads on good news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我要等更长的时间才能得到好新闻了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The slaves seem content and happy with their work.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>奴隶们似乎对自己的工作感到满足和快乐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Well, that's about what I expected. I'm going to print it, even if the Legion hates it. It's low-stakes, and maybe it'll motivate them to try another strategy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，这就是我所期望的。就算军团不喜欢，我也要把它发表出来。这样做的风险不高，也许能促使他们尝试其他策略。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The foreman's a murderer, and the slaves suffer harsh work conditions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工头是个杀人犯，奴隶们的工作环境很恶劣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Now for the real meat: the slave trade. I'll come clean right out the gate and say that I have been trying to make headway on this story myself for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。现在进入正题：奴隶贸易。 我就开门见山地说，我自己一直想在这篇报道上有所突破。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My grand vision is a profile of the inner-workings of the Legion slave economy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的宏伟愿景是描述军团奴隶经济的内部运作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it'll play well to Vegas, maybe even give the NCR socialites something to chew on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这对维加斯很有帮助，甚至可能给NCR的名流们一些启发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's a foreign empire, a great big boogeyman. But in the heart of the Legion is an economy not unlike what we have back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个外来帝国，一个巨大的怪物。但在军团的中心，有一个和我们家乡没什么不同的经济体系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just with people, instead of land and stocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只不过核心是人，而不是土地和股票。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've done some preliminary work on this story, but I'd love to see what you find. Your energy, and that Mark you have, may get you some very interesting answers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这篇报道做了一些初步调查，但我很想看看你有什么发现。你的能量，还有你身上的徽记，可能会给你带来一些非常有趣的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know there's a new representative of White Sands Caravans over at the market.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道市场那边来了一位白沙商队的新代表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there's that independent slave trader, Malachi. Talk to them, see what you can dig up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有那个独立的奴隶贩子，玛拉基。和他们谈谈，看看能挖到什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do I start?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从哪里开始呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that there's a new representative of White Sands Caravan over at the market. Someone killed Malachi, so no chance of a story there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道市场那边来了一位白沙商队的新代表。有人杀了玛拉基，所以不可能有故事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do I start?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从哪里开始呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, no! That's insane. Are you trying to get me killed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，不！这太疯狂了。你是想害死我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should call for the slaves to rise up against the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该号召奴隶起来反抗军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell is wrong with you? You do realize you're in Legion territory, yes? They'll kill us both. You're fired. I can't risk working with a lunatic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底在搞什么鬼？你知道这里是军团领地吧？他们会把我们俩都杀了的。你被解雇了，我不能冒险和一个疯子共事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，就是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way. Absolutely not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没门，绝对不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is your duty as a reporter to report on the truth of slavery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为记者，报道奴隶制的真相是你的职责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Such a way with words. Maybe you should be the journalist here.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]真会说话，也许你该在这里当记者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, you're right. To yearn for freedom is the most human thing there is. I need to show people that not even the Legion can crush that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，你说得对。渴望自由是人的本性，我要让人们知道，即使是军团也无法摧毁它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't even think I need to write anything else. See you later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我觉得我不需要再写什么了。回头见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Freedom is the ultimate truth. We must print it. To do otherwise would be perpetuate a lie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自由是终极真理。我们必须把它印出来，否则，就是在延续谎言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] The right thing to do is not getting me killed. I'm just going to write that the independent slave trade is barbaric.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]正确的做法是不要害死我。我只是想写，独立的奴隶贸易是野蛮的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopefully, that will satisfy you. Did you find out anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 希望这能让你满意。你还发现什么了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it the right thing to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这难道不是正确的做法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is not fucking funny. What are we printing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈一点都不好笑。我们要印什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, just joking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，开个玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, we should. I'm not in the business of antagonizing the people who have the power to end my life whenever they want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我们应该。我不想和那些有权随时终结我生命的人作对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. We should probably say something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，我们应该说点别的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That it is. So you want me to focus on the cruelty of it? That is why it's called the Chainway, you know. I can do that. Anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样，所以你想让我把重点放在它的残酷上？这就是为什么它被称为铁链之路，你知道的。我可以做到，还有别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's my report on the independent slave trade. It's barbaric.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我关于独立奴隶贸易的报道，这太野蛮了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That it is. A terrible business. But terribly effective too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样，一件糟糕的生意。但也非常有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, though. We need to maintain a neutral tone, even if it's getting harder and harder to do that these days. Anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你说得对。我们需要保持一种中立的基调，即使现在越来越难做到这一点。还有别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's my report on the independent slave trade. It's business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我关于独立奴隶贸易的报道。这就是生意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That it is. And who are we to question what he deems right? We can leave that to the folks back west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。我们又有什么资格质疑他的判断呢？我们可以把这个问题留给西部的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's my report on the independent slave trade. It's Caesar's will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我关于独立奴隶贸易的报道。这是凯撒的意志。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi? What about him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基？他怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I looked into Malachi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我调查了玛拉基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good question. It's a delicate issue. In one sense, all of the Legion is a chattel slavery system. People are born slaves and they die slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好问题,这个问题有点微妙。从某种意义上说，整个军团都是私产奴隶制，人们生而为奴，死而为隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose the Legion's internal slavery is acceptable because it's done righteously. Everyone serves Caesar, the Son of Mars. They have divine purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想军团内部的奴役是可以接受的，因为它是公正的。每个人都效忠于玛尔斯之子凯撒，他们有神圣的目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, replace Caesar with some sleazy businessman, and what's left? A single individual building an ever-growing army of servants. It's a recipe for disaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，用一个卑鄙的商人取代凯撒，还剩下什么？一个人建立了一支不断壮大的仆人大军。这是一场灾难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does the Legion care so much about chattel slavery?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么军团如此关心私产奴隶制？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. I don't have any further work right now, but come back in three days. I may have something good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。我现在没有别的工作了，三天后再来吧。我可能有好东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. I don't have any further work right now, but come back in three days. I may have something good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。我现在没有别的工作了，三天后再来吧。我可能有好东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that is horrible. And illegal. I'm surprised that the Legion didn't find out, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那太可怕了，而且不合法。不过，我很惊讶军团竟然没有发现。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii are usually pretty on the ball. Still, we better let them know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务通常都很灵通。不过，我们最好让他们知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Malachi was a chattel slaver. And the Legion did nothing about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子，而军团对此无动于衷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that is horrible. Odd of them to attack you, though. Out of curiosity, did you tell them that Malachi was a chattel slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那太可怕了。不过，他们攻击你也太奇怪了。出于好奇，你有没有告诉他们玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi was a chattel slaver. And the Legion attempted to kill me for doing something about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子。因为我的所作所为，军团想要杀了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think so? From what I understand, he was a major supplier. That's worrying. Do we know why the Legion killed him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么认为吗？据我所知，他是主要的供应商。真让人担心，知道军团为什么要杀他吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I don't know what happened. The Legion killed Malachi for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我不知道发生了什么，军团无缘无故杀了玛拉基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's illegal. I don't know if you knew that. I take serious offense at glamorizing chattel slavery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是非法的。我不知道你是否了解，我对美化奴隶制的行为非常反感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm writing that the Legion dealt with him as appropriate. At the very least, that should keep them from breathing down my neck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我写的是军团对他做了适当的处理。至少，这样他们就不会一直盯着我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi was a chattel slaver. What's wrong with that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子。这有什么问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's nice when we're able to do some good and stay in the good graces of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们能做点好事，还能得到军团的青睐，这是件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi was a chattel slaver. The Legion will deal with him once we publish this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子。一旦我们公布这个，军团会处理他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good. Finally, some good news. Been a while since I've been able to write anything like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，很好。终于有好新闻了，我有一段时间没能写出这样的东西了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi was a chattel slaver. The Legion dealt with him as appropriate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子，军团会酌情处理他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To protect the slaves? Do you believe that, or are you just a quick learner? Still, I guess we'll print it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了保护奴隶？你信吗，还是你只是一个学东西很快的人？不过，我想我们还是要报道出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi was a chattel slaver. The Legion dealt with him to protect the slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子。军团为了保护奴隶，处理了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. That is unusual. Maybe I can curry some favor with the higher-ups by reporting lower-ranking Legionaries as not doing their jobs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。这很不寻常。也许我可以通过举报低级军团成员不尽职来讨好高层。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, no fucking wonder. You were about to get me in serious trouble with the Legion. I'm reporting that the Legion dealt with him as appropriate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这他妈也难怪。你差点让我在军团那边惹上大麻烦，我报道的是军团对他进行了适当的处理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, yeah. I knew that he did that. That's insane. But the truth is crazy sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]噢，是的，我知道他是那样做的，这太疯狂了。但事实有时候就是很疯狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll have to be extra careful if the Legionaries are getting that jumpy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团变得如此神经质，我想我得格外小心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi accidentally hit a Legionary in the face while he was waving his hands around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基在挥舞双手时不小心打到了一名军团士兵的脸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Hmm.... Somehow, I don't believe you. I'm beginning to think that Malachi was a chattel slaver. That's probably how he kept his prices so low.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]嗯...不知为何，我不相信你。我开始觉得玛拉基是个私产奴隶贩子，这可能就是他把价格保持在这么低的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if that's the case, then the Legion was justified in killing him. I'm writing that. You're fired by the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是这样的话，军团就有理由杀他了，我写下来了。顺便说一句，你被解雇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They just went crazy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们简直疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wants us to interview him. I'm not going to bullshit you, this will be dangerous. He doesn't possess an ounce of mercy in his body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想让我们采访他。我不是在跟你扯淡，这很危险，他的身体里没有一丝仁慈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he decides we're trouble, that's it, we're dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他认为我们是麻烦，那就完了，我们死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does he want with us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他找我们干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dominicus has requested that I call him on the radio prior to when we come. He says that he wants to show us how civilized the Legion can be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多米尼库斯要求我在我们来之前通过无线电联系他，他说他想向我们展示军团的文明程度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I call him up on the radio, I think that's it. I really don't want to piss him off, so he schedules the interview, and we go, understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我用无线电联系上他，我想就是时候了。我真的不想惹他生气，所以他安排好采访，我们就去，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When's the interview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么时候采访？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Butcher of Big Stop. Or, the Savior of Solitare. He's the man responsible for the executions of NCR collaborators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站的屠夫，或者，索利泰尔的救世主。他是处决NCR同谋的罪魁祸首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, collaborator was defined very loosely. Or necessarily broadly, depending on how you look at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，同谋的定义非常宽松。或者是广义上的，这取决于你如何看待它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was sent in by Legate Lanius to manage the Frumentarii and to stamp out any chance of a second revolt. Say what you will, but he's been very successful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他受特使拉尼厄斯之命，前去管理军团特务，并消灭任何可能发生的第二次叛乱。不管你怎么说，但他很成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's amazing that you've gotten out alive after speaking with the Butcher of Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你跟大站的屠夫谈过之后还能活着出来真是太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was sent in by Legate Lanius to manage the Frumentarii and to stamp out any chance of a second revolt. Say what you will, but he's been very successful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他受特使拉尼厄斯之命，前去管理军团特务，并消灭任何可能发生的第二次叛乱。不管你怎么说，但他很成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. The Legion confiscated all of my weapons when I came here. I'm going to need an escort to Solitare. Don't worry. I can keep up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我来这里的时候，军团没收了我所有的武器，我需要一个人护送我去索利泰尔。别担心。我能跟上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, we can't refuse him forever. I'll try to hold him off, but please, don't leave me hanging here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们不能永远拒绝他。我会试着拖住他，但求你了，别把我晾在这儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh. Guess there was nothing to those rumors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵，看来那些谣言根本不存在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Malachi's on the up-and-up. Super-cheap slaves. Kind of impressive, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>玛拉基是个诚实的人，超级廉价的奴隶，真让人印象深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Radio New Vegas? A journalist? No, I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新维加斯电台？一个记者？不，我很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Radio New Vegas is doing a report on the Chainway. Would you care to comment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 新维加斯电台正在做关于连环道的报道，你愿意评论一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you I'm busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉你我很忙了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still trying to report on the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在努力报道连环道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an invoice that needs to be delivered to the Tres Leches Caravan. Please deliver this to Enzo if you are able.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一张发票需要送到三人行商队。如果可以，请把这个交给恩佐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're in a shack on top of the Chainway. Just follow the overpass south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在连环道顶上的小屋里。沿着立交桥往南走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what needs doing around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，这里还有什么需要做的呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, what questions do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你有什么问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I've done work for you. Give me some credit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我为你工作过。给我点信任吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The concrete powder itself is made in Chloride, with a mix of processed Chainway debris and flue ash sent in from the Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 混凝土粉末本身是克洛赖德制造的，混合了加工过的连环道碎片和从邦联运来的烟道灰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The iron we mine here in Malpais has to be sent south as well. Once they're ready, they send the metal rods and the cement mixture back to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在马尔帕斯这里开采的铁也要运往南方。一旦他们准备好了，就会把金属棒和水泥混合物送回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, we haul water jugs from the river and Lake Mead to here. The concrete is mixed, the and rods are inserted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，我们从河里和米德湖运水罐到这里。搅拌混凝土，插入金属棒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where does the Legion get these materials?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团从哪里弄来这些材料的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Several of our slaves were offered greater rations provided that they climb the Chainway and move parts up there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的几个奴隶得到了更多的口粮，条件是他们爬上连环道，把零件搬上去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was an amazing display of what slaves can do when properly motivated by the Legion. Once the parts were up, a work camp was established, and the crane was assembled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个令人惊叹的展示，当军团适当地激励奴隶时，他们可以做到什么。零件组装好后，工作营地就建立起来了，吊车也组装好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does the Legion move the concrete from the ground to up there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是如何将混凝土从地面搬运到上面的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it's dangerous. Many slaves have died and will die in the construction of the Chainway. Many of them were stupid, but some of them were not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然很危险。在连环道的建设过程中，许多奴隶已经或者即将死去。他们中的许多人是愚蠢的，但也有一些人不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's dangerous work, and if all of the slaves in the Legion showed the determination of our slaves here, then the Legion would be marching on Shady Sands by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一项危险的工作，如果军团中所有的奴隶都能表现出我们这里的奴隶的决心，那么军团现在应该已经在沙荫镇行军了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 危险吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't tell you for certain. Marcellus Sedonus blames the NCR Rangers we rooted out of Solitare. Support Unit Hoover, they called themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能肯定地告诉你。百夫长马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯把责任归咎于我们从索利泰尔驱逐出去的NCR游骑兵。他们自称为胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it was Support Unit Hoover, then we have a bigger problem, because they had to have gotten those explosives from somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是胡佛支援小队，那我们就有更大的麻烦了，因为他们肯定是从什么地方弄到那些炸药的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't tell you for certain. Our deceased legate blamed the NCR Rangers we rooted out of Solitare. Support Unit Hoover, they called themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能肯定的告诉你。我们已故的特使把这事归咎于我们从索利泰尔驱逐出去的NCR游骑兵，他们自称胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it was Support Unit Hoover, then we have a bigger problem, because they had to have gotten those explosives from somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是胡佛支援小队，那我们就有更大的麻烦了，因为他们肯定是从什么地方弄到那些炸药的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, it's a bad omen to lose both the Chainway and the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，失去连环道和特使仍然是一个坏兆头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't print that last remark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要发表最后那句话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] It would be nice for people to know how the Legion is outpacing the NCR in reconstruction. What questions do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]让人们知道军团在重建方面是如何超越NCR的，是一件很好的事情。你有什么问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a golden opportunity to showcase how you are leading the Legion in outperforming the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个展示你如何带领军团超越NCR的绝佳机会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I have no time for fame. This bridge will not repair itself. Leave me to my work.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我没有时间沽名逐利。这座桥不会自行修复，别打扰我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. Think of the fame to be had.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，想想将来会有多出名。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmmm.... It is irregular, but.... Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...这不符合规范，但是...为什么不呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I speak to the slaves about their work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能跟奴隶们谈谈他们的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You serious? You just step out of the Ultra-Luxe or something? Didn't Mister Vegas ever tell you not to talk to slavers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真的？你疯了？你知道你在和谁打交道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, I'm with Radio New Vegas. We're doing a report on slave traders. Can you spare a few words?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，我是新维加斯电台的记者。我们正在做一篇关于奴隶贩子的报道，你能抽出时间聊几句吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're funny. Sure thing. Hazme muy famoso. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真幽默。当然，我很有名，你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It must have slipped his mind. I guess he'll just have to air my eulogy between songs. Now, that interview...
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不知道，所以你还是让我采访你吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a rough business. You have to spend sometimes six months of the year out in the wilds of Texas and Mexico.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个艰难的行业。你一年中有时要花六个月的时间到德克萨斯和墨西哥的荒野去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got to bring all the food and water you can to make the trips. You got to be armed to teeth to defend it from raiders, wildlife and other slavers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得带上所有能带的食物和水才能上路。你得全副武装才能抵御掠夺者，野生动物和其他奴隶贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've probably never seen a Gila Monster, but they're nasty fuckers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能从没见过大毒蜥，但它们都是恶心的混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you've got to speak a bunch of different languages to make deals with the various tribes out there. I speak nine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，你必须说一堆不同的语言来与不同的部落达成协议。我会说九种语言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you've got to be on constant alert to make sure the deals don't go bad. Have to make sure they're not trying to screw you. Or shoot you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须时刻保持警惕，以确保交易不会出错。你得确保他们不是想害你，或者开枪打死你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like being a slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 做奴隶贩子是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, there. Sometimes, it's necessary to bust down some doors. I've been on plenty of raids like that over the past decade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。有时候，破门而入是必要的。在过去的十年里，我经历过很多这样的突袭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, the cargo's got legs, and sometimes they try to flee. Catching them without killing them is a major pain in the ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，货物是有腿的，有时他们会试图逃跑。在不杀死它们的情况下抓住它们是一件非常麻烦的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It requires skills that most raiders who became slavers don't got. Can't tell you how many bastards we have to terminate for losing a solid source of denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这需要大多数成为奴隶贩子的掠夺者所不具备的技能。 我们不知道有多少混蛋因为失去了一个可靠的第纳尔来源而被干掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about capturing the slaves? That's got to be pretty difficult, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那抓奴隶呢？那一定很困难，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Family business. My dad was a slaver, pulled me into it too. Been doing the job for 15 years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 家族生意。我父亲是个奴隶贩子，把我也拖下水了。我干这行已经十五年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We weren't cut out for living in Two-Sun. Shit's too boring, too easy. No way to get rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不适合住在双日城。太无聊了，太轻松了，没办法发财。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Abuelo always said Two-Sun used to be a shithole, but I never saw it. Place is nothing but traders and wannabes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爷爷总说双日城以前是个鬼地方，但我从没见过。这里只有商人和想要成为商人的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become a slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为奴隶贩子的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Small world. It probably is, but I don't think anyone's changing the signs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界真小。可能是吧，但我觉得没人会改变符号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My friend Raul's been through Two-Sun, although he says it's spelled T-U-C-S-O-N.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我朋友劳尔去过双日城，不过他说拼写是T-U-C-S-O-N。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rules to slavery? There's a few. Legion doesn't like independently-owned slavery farms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶制的规定？有一些，军团不喜欢独立经营的奴隶农场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's all sorts of rules and regulations to it, like I can't own more than four slaves, and I got to give up any babies they make immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有各种各样的规定，比如我不能拥有四个以上的奴隶，他们生的孩子我必须马上放弃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and the taxes on them.... Let's just say I'm happier as a distributor than an owner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有他们的税...这么说吧，我当经销商比当老板更开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there any rules to slavery in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对奴隶制有什么规定吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called chattel slavery. It's when the slaves are your private property, and you're breeding them to sell to the general Liberti public.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这被称为私产奴隶。当奴隶是你的私有财产时，你把他们养大，然后卖给广大的自由民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That stuff's against the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是违法的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Independently-owned slavery farms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 独立经营的奴隶农场？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah. I'm with White Sands now. I mostly process the slaves in the logbooks. Sometimes I do the paperwork officiating captures into slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我现在和白沙商队一起。我主要是处理日志中的奴隶，然后填写文书，把他们从俘虏变成奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bureaucratic nightmare. Still, it's miles better than hoofing it to get the cargo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 官僚主义噩梦。不过，这比步行去取货要好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you still a slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你还是个奴隶贩子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, want to give us some competition? I wouldn't advise it if you're looking for wealth and fame. You usually only break even. It's miserable work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，想给我们增加点竞争对手？如果你追求的是财富和名声，我不建议你这么做。你通常只能做到收支平衡，这是一份苦差事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your coworkers wouldn't hesitate to sell their own mother to you, and the buyers....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的同事会毫不犹豫地把自己的母亲卖给你，而买家...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I wouldn't say bad things about my current employers, but they squeeze the aureus until the bull bleeds, and if they don't like you, I hope you were nice to your cargo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我不会说我现在雇主的坏话，但他们把奥里斯压榨得很厉害，如果他们不喜欢你，我希望你能善待你的货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be joining them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能会加入他们的行列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I wanted to become a slaver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我想成为一名奴隶贩子呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Liberti. Es como la libertad. It basically means 'freedman'. You can think of it as the people who are at liberty to live normally under the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: Liberti，也是自由的意思，指的是“自由民”。你可以把它理解为在军团统治下自由的正常生活的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Liberti actually have it easier than Legion soldiers do, long as you follow the rules. Ranchers, traders, prospectors -- all liberti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，只要你遵守规则，自由民比军团士兵更轻松。农场主、商人、淘金客都是自由民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their skills make them useful, but they're required to use those skills for the Legion. Otherwise, no more liberty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的技能使他们有用，但他们的技能需要为军团所用。否则，就没有自由了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a Liberti?
ESP.TRADUIT: 利伯蒂是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will grant this request given your favor with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于你在凯撒心中的地位，我会答应你的请求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any chance I could speak with the slave alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能让我单独和奴隶谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be grateful you are receiving this opportunity at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感恩你能得到这个机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any chance I could speak with the slave alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能让我单独和奴隶谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely wonderful. It's the hardest work assignment I've been in but easily the most fulfilling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是太棒了。这是我做过的最艰难的工作，但也是最有成就感的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The foreman is tough but fair, and I wouldn't trade it for anything else. Is there anything else, sir?
ESP.TRADUIT: 工头很严厉，但很公正，我不会用其他任何东西来交换。还有别的事吗，先生？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's it been like working on the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，在连环道工作是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the hardest work assignment I've been in. I worked in the flue ash fields in Navajo territory. I thought that was bad, but this is worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我做过的最辛苦的工作。我在纳瓦霍地区的粉煤灰场工作，我以为那已经很糟糕了，但这里更糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's long work hours with almost no food and almost no water. The foreman is a tyrant who sometimes throws a couple of slaves off the Chainway when he loses his temper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工作时间很长，几乎没有食物和水。工头是个暴君，有时他一发脾气就把几个奴隶从连环道上扔下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't get me started on the early days. The Legion wouldn't give us rope. We had to climb the concrete with our bare hands
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我提早期的事，军团不给我们绳子，我们只能徒手爬混凝土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of my friends died that day. If it's all the same to you. I don't really want to talk about it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那天我的很多朋友都死了。如果对你来说没什么差别的话，我真的不想再谈这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's it been like working on the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，在连环道工作是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? Well, maybe that's true. But it doesn't translate to better work conditions. Or better treatment. Now, I've got to get back to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？嗯，也许这是真的。但这并不意味着更好的工作条件，或者更好的医疗环境。现在，我得回去工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The foreman said that he respects the slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 工头说他很尊重奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, have some water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，喝点水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, sir, what did I do wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，先生，我做错了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nestor! You are still on break, correct?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奈斯托！你们还在休息，是吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. A man from Radio New Vegas is here to interview you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，有个新维加斯电台的人来采访你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing. A woman from Radio New Vegas is here to interview you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。新维加斯电台的一位女士来采访你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your quota will be reduced by 5%. Now give the reporter what they want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的配额将减少5%，现在给记者他们想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh? Interview? But what about my quota?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃？采访？但是我的工作配额怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nestor [06017520] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay....
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, I'm with Radio New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，这里是新维加斯电台。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see. Well, you've come to the right place. Malachi is the finest slave trader east of the Colorado, and probably west of, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我明白了。嗯，你来对地方了。玛拉基是科罗拉多河以东最好的奴隶贩子，可能在科罗拉多河以西也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're interviewing a number of enterprising businessmen such as yourself. Care to comment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们正在采访一些像你这样有进取心的商人。介意发表意见吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You motherfucker. You'll regret this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你个混蛋。你会后悔得罪玛拉基的，你再也见不到这么好的东西了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to give me everything you got, otherwise I'm reporting your ass to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得把你所有的东西都给我，不然我就向军团告发你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm executing you in the name of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我以军团的名义处决你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. It isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，不关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's none of my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am aware that the people of the Mojave have such a shallow view of the Legion. They do not understand us properly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道莫哈维人对军团的认识很浅薄，他们无法正确地理解我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They do not understand that our brutality, although unfortunate, is necessary to bring civilization to these savage lands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不明白，我们的残暴，虽然很不幸，却是给这片野蛮土地带来文明所必需的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They do not understand the great difficulties involved in bringing order to our chaotic world. But, with this interview, they will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不理解为我们混乱的世界带来秩序所涉及的巨大困难。但是，通过这次采访，他们会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you hope to achieve with this interview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你希望通过这次采访实现什么目标？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps they do. It is your job to rectify this, to present the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他们会。你的工作就是纠正这一点，呈现真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The truth is that the Legion are on a fully justified mission of civilization and order. The truth is that all who fall before us, all we punish, truly deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实是，军团正肩负着文明与秩序的正当使命。事实是，所有在我们面前倒下的人，所有被我们惩罚的人，都罪有应得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yes, I do think this interview will cause people to reconsider, just like you will reconsider making any such further remarks during this interview.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我认为这次采访会让人们重新考虑，就像你会重新考虑在这次采访中发表任何进一步的言论一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let us begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the Mojave views you as a psychopath? Do you really think you'll be able to change minds?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道莫哈维人把你当成神经病吗？你真觉得你能改变他们的想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should I wish it, I could have your head severed from your shoulders at the snap of my fingers. Remember that before we begin the interview.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我愿意的话，我打个响指就能把你的头从肩膀上割下来。在我们开始采访之前，请记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion? Civilized? Those two words don't go together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团？文明？这两个词不能放在一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a suboptio in Caesar's Legion. I am of Tan Cap stock. Since my induction, I have rapidly advanced through Caesar's meritocracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是凯撒军团的一名执行官副手，我出身于坦卡普家族。 自入伍以来，我在凯撒的功勋体系中迅速晋升。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Functionally, I am an Optio, but should this town remain docile, I will be made Centurion in time for the march west into the NCR heartland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从职能上讲，我是一名执行官，但如果这个城镇没有发生第二次叛乱，我将被任命为百夫长，以便在征服莫哈维之后，及时向西进军NCR领土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell us about yourself, Dominicus Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我们介绍一下你自己，多米尼库斯·勒克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tan Caps were a tribe in southern Colorado prior to our induction into Caesar's Legion. The Tan Caps valued discipline and order above all else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们加入凯撒军团之前，坦卡普是科罗拉多州南部的一个部落。坦卡普把纪律和秩序看得比什么都重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, naturally, when confronted with a civilizing force that held our exact same ideals, we voluntarily joined the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，很自然地，当面对与我们有着相同理念的文明力量时，我们自愿加入了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tan Caps dutifully served the Legion during the Hangdogs Campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在吊狗战役中，坦卡普尽职地为军团服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Following that, the tribe was deemed completely free of Profligate elements and was merged with no loss of life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，部落被认为完全没有浪荡子的元素，并在没有人员损失的情况下被合并。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps if the Mojave chooses to civilize itself, they might be spared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许如果莫哈维人选择开化，他们可能会幸免于难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Tan Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说坦·卡普家族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I maintain security in the town of Solitare. I ensure that the people of this town are safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责维护索利泰尔镇的治安，我确保镇上居民的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your duties here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里的职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are numerous criminal elements in this region. Profligate Rangers launched a rebellion earlier this year. Support Unit Hoover remains hidden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地区有许多犯罪分子。今年早些时候，浪荡子的游骑兵发起了一场叛乱，胡佛支援小组仍然隐藏着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a criminal underworld that needs to be stamped out. The NCR breathes down our necks from the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 表层之下的犯罪亟待铲除，NCR从大坝上压住了我们的脖子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In light of all these problems, all of this rot, I must find solutions by any means necessary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于所有这些问题，所有的腐败，我必须通过任何必要的手段找到解决办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Safe from what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪方面的安全？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the past, the Rangers established a number of armed stay-behind units meant to resist us from the inside. The one that operated here was Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们与游骑兵的战争中，他们建立了许多被称为支援小队的留守单位。 在这里执行任务的就是胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They must be incredibly skilled agents. They have evaded our best Frumentarii for nearly a decade. And somehow, not one of our informants has seen them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一定是非常有经验的特工。近十年来，他们一直在躲避我们最好的特务。不知怎么回事，我们的线人都没见过他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevertheless, they will be found and destroyed. It is not just my will, but Caesar's.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，他们会被找到并摧毁。这不仅是我的意志，也是凯撒的意志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's Support Unit Hoover? One of the previous people I interviewed mentioned them, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛支援小队是什么？我之前采访过的一个人也提到了他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brutal? What is brutal about a bullet between the eyes? It is quick, with very little pain. Consider the lines of crucifixes outside the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 残暴？子弹打在两眼之间有什么残暴的？它很快，几乎没有痛苦。想想大坝外一排排的十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I consider that far more brutal. After all, did you not survive a bullet between the eyes? Was it not quick and painless?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为那要残酷得多。毕竟，你不是从两眼之间的子弹中幸存下来的吗？ 难道不是又快又无痛吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you writhe in agony for days on end? Of course not. You were shot, and you woke up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是否在痛苦中挣扎了好几天？当然没有。你中枪了，然后醒了过来。现在想想，我们射杀的人永远不会醒来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now consider that the people we shoot will never wake up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在想想，我们射杀的人永远不会醒来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is mercy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是仁慈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you justify the brutality that the Legion has displayed here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么解释军团在这里的残暴行为？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because Big Stop was a den of anti-Legion sentiment, but Big Stop no longer exists.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为大站曾经是反军团情绪的大本营，但大站已经不存在了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitare is a town totally and utterly loyal to the Legion, and there will be no repeat of the Solitare Insurrection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔是一个完全忠于军团的城镇，索利泰尔的叛乱不会再次发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to you. Why does the Legion call this town 'Solitare' and not 'Big Stop?'
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到你身上。为什么军团称这个小镇为索利泰尔而不是大站？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely, you are aware that the Rangers had help? Collaborators. Friendly persons. Without them, the Rangers would have been killed instantly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定知道游骑兵队有帮手吧？合作者，友好人士。如果没有他们，游骑兵会立刻毙命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But even if it were just two people, then the answer would still be yes. Order must be maintained at any cost, lest we descend into anarchy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但即使只有两个人，答案也是肯定的。 我们必须不惜一切代价维护秩序，以免陷入无政府状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was it necessary to massacre most of Solitare to deal with a rebellion by two Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了对付两个游骑兵的叛乱，是否有必要屠杀大部分的索利泰尔居民？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely, you are aware that the Rangers had help? Collaborators. Friendly persons. Without them, the Rangers would have been killed instantly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你肯定知道游骑兵队有帮手吧？合作者，友好人士。如果没有他们，游骑兵会立刻毙命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But even if it were just two people, then the answer would still be yes. Order must be maintained at any cost, lest we descend into anarchy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但即使只有两个人，答案也是肯定的。 我们必须不惜一切代价维护秩序，以免陷入无政府状态。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it's Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有这里是索利泰尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was it necessary to massacre most of Big Stop to deal with a rebellion by two Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了对付两个游骑兵的叛乱，有必要屠杀大部分的大站居民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Solitare. Solitare provides us with a valuable resupply point just outside of the Fort. It is also necessary to patrol the roads to Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是索利泰尔。索利泰尔为我们在堡垒外提供了一个很有价值的补给点，前往多兰泉的道路也需要巡逻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does Big Stop do for the war effort against the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站对军团的战争起到什么作用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Solitare provides us with a valuable resupply point just outside of the Fort. It commands the road leading to Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔为我们在堡垒外提供了一个很有价值的补给点，它控制着通往多兰泉的道路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does Solitare do for the war effort against the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔对军团的战争起到什么作用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will be safeguarding Solitare for the battle's duration. My Frumentarii are to ensure that the surrounding towns are free of subversion as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将在战斗期间守护索利泰尔，我的特务要确保周围的城镇也不会被颠覆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not expect any disorder. The execution you saw on the way here should be the last of the bloodshed. I'm quite confident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不希望有任何混乱，你在来的路上看到的行刑应该是最后的流血事件了。我很有信心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will you be doing during the Second Battle of Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在第二次胡佛水坝战役中你会做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, "seems" is a bit of misnomer. The people here have a history. Solitare has been passed between NCR and Legion since before the First Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，"似乎 "有点用词不当。 这里的人有颠覆活动的历史，在第一次胡佛水坝大战之前，索利泰尔就已经在NCR和军团之间转移了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is necessary to ensure that the Second Battle of Hoover Dam doesn't inspire them to do something foolish. Something that they would regret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有必要确保第二次胡佛水坝之战不会激发他们做出愚蠢的事情，一些他们会后悔的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope this interview was satisfactory. I look forward to your report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望这次采访能令人满意，我期待你的报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Solitare is as secure as it seems, then why won't the Legion let you fight at Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果索利泰尔真的很安全，那为什么军团不让你去胡佛大坝作战？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Solitare! My talents are far beyond moving Legionaries through tunnels! I alone can maintain order in this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是索利泰尔！我的才能远远超过在隧道里运送士兵！我一个人就能维持镇上的秩序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They would be utterly waste.... Are you writing this down, stenographus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们完全是浪费...你写下来了吗，速记员？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Big Stop is as secure as it seems, then why won't the Legion let you fight at Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果大站真像看起来那么安全，那为什么军团不让你去胡佛水坝作战？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, of course, sir. I've been writing everything down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，当然，长官，我一直在记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stenographus [06017585] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not, sir. I've just been doing what you've told me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然没有，长官，我只是在按您说的做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stenographus [06017585] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: N-no. Of course not. You would never do that. No one could possibly view you as disloyal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没...没有，当然没有。您绝对不会这么做的，没有人会认为您不忠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stenographus [06017585] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you wrote down sensitive battleplans. Are you planning to undermine the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，你记下了敏感的作战计划。你打算破坏军团吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, are you implying that I am undermining the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你是在暗示我在破坏军团吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. Which means you must be planning to undermine the Legion. Which is death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，这意味着你一定在计划破坏军团。那就得死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, shall we continue the interview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们可以继续采访了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officer! There must be some mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 长官！一定是搞错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chattel slaver? You must know that chattel slavery is illegal, and I am a legitimate businessman....
ESP.TRADUIT: 私产奴隶？你得知道，私产奴隶是非法的，我是一个合法的商人...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll rue the day you crossed Malachi!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会后悔和玛拉基过不去的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm tired of your disingenuous assertions!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受够了你虚伪的断言！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what may that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to report a crime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要报案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is... a grave crime. Some of the Scribonii have raised questions about his operation in the past, but no one suspected chattel-slavery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是...严重的罪行。一些书记官曾对他过去的行动提出过质疑，但没有人怀疑他是私产奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If what you say is true, that would certainly explain how he's able to supply us with the quantity of slaves he does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的是真的，那就能解释为什么他能给我们提供这么多的奴隶了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We will open an investigation. In the meantime, Malachi will be detained for questioning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们将展开调查。与此同时，玛拉基将被拘留审问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi has confessed to me that he is a chattel slaver. That is a crime, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基向我坦白，他是个私产奴隶贩子。这是一种犯罪，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion will repossess his captures and place them under general Legion authority.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团会收回他的俘虏，并将其置于军团的全权管辖之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will happen to the slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶们会怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph. You have the Mark of Caesar, so I am implored to believe you. I will radio this in and have a contubernium sent to his ranch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼，你身上有凯撒的印记，所以恳请我相信你。我会用无线电汇报，然后把一对奴隶婚姻送到他的农场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they find evidence of this... chattel-slavery, then you will have the Legion's thanks. Elsewise, you can expect a visit from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们发现这方面的证据...私产奴隶，你就会得到军团的感谢。否则，你可以期待我们的来访。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a chattel slaver and had been cheating the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个私产奴隶贩子，一直在欺骗军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brothers, kill this degenerate!
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟们，杀了这个堕落者！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为正义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi, come with us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基，跟我们走！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malachi, you are charged with improper accounting of slaves, private chattel slavery and tax fraud in defiance of Lex Caesaris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛拉基，你被指控对奴隶进行不当交易，私产奴隶以及无视《凯撒律法》的税务欺诈。
