ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Silence. Resist any further, and your life will be forfeit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安静。再敢反抗，你就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chiron [06017595] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. I know. But, it's my name on the byline, not yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我知道。但署名是我的，不是你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, this is what you signed up to be a reporter for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，这就是你报名当记者的目的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you mad? We're going to tell the Butcher of Big Stop that we don't think he's good enough to print?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了吗？我们要去告诉大站的屠夫我们认为他不配出采访？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's insane! It might actually be worse than publishing a critical interview!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太疯狂了！可能比发表一篇批评性的采访还糟糕！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if we just didn't print the interview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们不刊登采访呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want me to uncritically take Dominicus's word for it? I mean, did you see the dead bodies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我不加批判地相信多米尼库斯的话吗？我是说，你看到那些尸体了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, I can still smell the corpses. Did you see the mass grave at the south end of town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 上帝啊，我还能闻到尸体的味道。你看到城镇南端的万人坑了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion butchered this place, and for what? Two Rangers launching a rebellion? That can't be justified at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团屠杀了这个地方，为了什么？两个游骑兵发起叛乱？那根本就不合理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dominicus was right, and he deserves credit for rooting out subversion and restoring order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多米尼库斯是对的，他铲除了颠覆分子，恢复了秩序，这值得称赞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I guess we can do that. Feels like a compromise that will still piss the Legion off. Publish that, then see how they react.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想我们可以这样做。感觉这个折中方案还是会激怒军团的。发表出来，看看他们有什么反应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, I don't want to stick around here. Things are getting too hot. I can't take the stress. Maybe I'm not cut out for journalism anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我都不想再待在这里了。事情变得太危险了，我受不了这种压力。也许我已经不适合做记者了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, though... you've got moxie. You make yourself worthy of that Mark you're wearing, and maybe one day I'll be writing your biography.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你...你很有勇气。你要让自己配得上你身上的徽记，也许有一天我会为你写传记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck out there. You'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，你会需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have to print the spillway thing, but we should print the brutality of the situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不必报道泄洪道的事情，但我们应该报道这种残暴的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I guess we can do that. Feels like a compromise that will still piss the Legion off. Publish that, then see how they react.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想我们可以这样做。感觉这个折中方案还是会激怒军团的。发表出来，看看他们有什么反应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, I don't want to stick around here. Things are getting too hot. I can't take the stress. Maybe I'm not cut out for journalism anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我都不想再待在这里了。事情变得太危险了，我受不了这种压力。也许我已经不适合做记者了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, though... you've got moxie. You make yourself worthy of that Mark you're wearing, and maybe one day I'll be writing your biography.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你...你很有勇气。你要让自己配得上你身上的徽记，也许有一天我会为你写传记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck out there. You'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，你会需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should print the brutality of the situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该把这种情况的残酷程度报道出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. Maybe he could. And if we changed the Legion's mind on this even a little, then it might be worth it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，也许他会。如果我们能在这件事上稍微改变一点军团的想法，那就值得了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, I think I'm taking a break from journalism. Things are getting too hot. I can't take the stress anymore. Maybe I'll just relax in the roadhouse for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我想我要暂时离开新闻业了。事情变得太危险了，我受不了这种压力了。也许我应该在路边旅馆里放松一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, though... you've got moxie. You make yourself worthy of that Mark you're wearing, and maybe one day I'll be writing your biography.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你...你很有勇气。你要让自己配得上你身上的徽记，也许有一天我会为你写传记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck out there. You'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运，你会需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll placate Dominicus. He restored order, but he could cement it by toning down the violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去安抚多米尼库斯。他恢复了秩序，但他可以通过缓和暴力来巩固秩序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what? I don't care. The man's an animal, and he's going to kill us if we don't print what he wants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗？我也不在乎。那人是个禽兽，如果我们不发表他想要的东西，他会杀了我们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't do this anymore. The world has gone mad. I never know if my next body search will be my last. I never know who will snap and why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能再这样下去了。整个世界都疯了，我不知道下一次搜身会不会是最后一次。我永远不知道谁会崩溃，为什么会崩溃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion say they're peacekeepers, but this is fucking chaos. I'm done. I have no more work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团说他们是维和部队，但这他妈太混乱了。我受够了，我没有更多的工作给你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay safe out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在外面要注意安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These people harbored enemy spies. Dominicus did the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些人窝藏了敌方间谍，多米尼库斯做了正确的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's what you think. I'll print it, but that's it. After this, I'm done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是这么想的，我会把它刊登出来，但仅此而已。在这之后，我就结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel like I'm cresting a hill. This is the Legion. I saw them in full, talked to the commanders, shook hands. I got what I wanted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我正在攀登高峰。这就是军团，我看到了他们的全部，和指挥官们交谈，握手。我得到了我想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It isn't sustainable. One day, the Legion will kill me. I can't stay here just because of some morbid fascination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是可持续的。总有一天，军团会杀了我，我不能因为某种病态的迷恋就待在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I quit. I've got no more work for you. Good luck out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我得辞职了。我没有更多的工作给你了，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These people harbored enemy spies. Dominicus did the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些人窝藏了敌方间谍，多米尼库斯做了正确的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. We're on the same page. What are we actually printing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我们意见一致。我们到底要印什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, maybe not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，也许不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better be right about this. Can't believe I'm going to abandon my last report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好是对的。真不敢相信我要放弃我的最后一份报道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I can do this anymore. Things are getting too hot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我做不下去了，事情变得太危险了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If men like Rex and Lanius are the future of the Legion, I can't keep risking my neck to report on them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果像勒克斯和拉尼厄斯这样的人是军团的未来，我不能一直冒着生命危险去报道他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I'll write about you instead. The Mark of Caesar is a high honor, after all. If you make yourself worthy of a biography, I promise I'll be the first guy on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我会写写关于你的故事，毕竟，凯撒的徽记是一种崇高的荣誉。如果你让自己成为了值得写传记的人，我保证我会是第一个动笔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the meantime, come find me in the roadhouse. I doubt the Legion will let me leave anytime soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在此期间，你可以到路边旅馆来找我。我怀疑军团短期内不会让我离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be seeing you, kid. Good luck out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 会再见的，孩子。祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it might not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也未必。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know I am. So, do we have another plan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我知道我是。那我们还有别的计划吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might be right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, hell.... You're right. This is exactly what I signed up for, and I knew the risks when I crossed the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]噢，该死...你说得对。这正是我的初衷，当我穿越科罗拉多河时，我就知道其中的风险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tomorrow morning, the Legion will find out that their golden boy accidentally leaked important military plans to satisfy his own ego.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明天早上，军团就会发现，他们的金童为了自我满足，不小心泄露了重要的军事计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no more work for you. I'm going to pack my things and see if I can't arrange some way out of here, before things get hot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有更多的工作给你了。我要去收拾细软，看看能不能在事态恶化之前，想办法离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we both make it, come find me in Vegas. We'll have some beers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们都成功了，来维加斯找我。我们要喝点啤酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What good is a journalist if he can't bring change to the world and only observe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果一个记者不能给世界带来改变，只能观察，那他还有什么用？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] My job isn't worth my life. I'm not printing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我的工作不值得我付出生命，我不会印的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, news is news. Print it, and do your job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，新闻就是新闻。把它印出来，做好你的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I've never had to watch the Legion in action before. I always followed them. I can't think straight. What's your idea?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我以前从来没看过军团的行动，我总是跟着他们，我无法清醒的思考。你有什么主意？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what do you want to print?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你想印什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay still. Your body search begins now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别动。现在开始搜身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tent Guard [060175DE] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does he not know how bad the roads are right now? It's not possible to move the supplies he's asking for. I'll send him a message later today.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道他不知道现在的路况有多糟糕吗？他要的物资不可能运得出去。今天晚些时候我会给他发消息的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have some caps for your trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麻烦你了，拿点瓶盖吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an invoice from the foreman at the Chainway. He's wondering why supplies have been delayed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这有张连环道工头给我的发票，他想知道为什么物资推迟了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Ever since the Chainway collapsed, wildlife's been all stirred up. Yesterday, one of our caravans got attacked by bighorners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。自从连环道坍塌后，野生动物就开始蠢蠢欲动了。昨天，我们的一辆大篷车被大角羊袭击了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Days before that, a swarm of bloatflies. Day before that, bark scorpions. And some of our caravans are disappearing as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之前几天，一群辐射蝇。再往前一天，树皮蝎。我们的一些商队也在失踪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Roads used to be safe as houses. Now, not so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去，道路和房屋一样安全。但现在，情况却并非如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said that the roads were bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说路况很糟糕？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have an invoice that needs to be delivered to the Tres Leches Caravan. Please deliver this to Enzo if you are able.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一张发票需要送到三人行商队。如果可以，请把这个交给恩佐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the thanks of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对你表示感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I finished that job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完成了那份工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm...impressed that Radio New Vegas understands the necessity of my work. In any event, I appreciate your...zeal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...新维加斯电台理解我工作的必要性，这让我印象深刻。无论如何，我很欣赏你的...热情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most people would flinch at being forced to watch an execution. You seem...different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人在被迫观看行刑时都会退缩。你看起来...不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should probably start the interview now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在应该开始采访了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a massive admirer of what you're doing with the place. After the interview, I could give tips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常欣赏你对这地方的改造。采访结束后，我可以给你一些建议。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard about the Legion using children to do their dirty work. I'd never thought I'd see it in person. I've never seen any of this in person.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说军团利用孩子来干他们的肮脏勾当。我从没想过我能亲眼看到，我从来没亲眼见过这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like there was an execution here not too long ago. Maybe it was the last one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来不久之前这里有过一次处决，也许是最后一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 救命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Malachi [0601039A] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> Your vile crimes end here.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>你的卑鄙罪行到此为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cyn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 辛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please just tell me what you need. Prattle is punished here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请告诉我你需要什么。闲聊在这里是要受到惩罚的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to ask a few questions
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I am instructed to only heal members of the Legion. Profligates are not worthy of my healing hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我奉命只治疗军团的成员，浪荡子配不上我的治愈之手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, take this. It'll numb whatever is hurting you for awhile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，拿着这个。它能麻痹你的疼痛一段时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm hurt, can you heal me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我受伤了，你能治好我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Balneum. A place of healing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浴场，一个疗伤的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am an Maiden of the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是玛尔斯教团的女侍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any day now I will prove my faith and ascend to the Priestesshood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从现在起我随时都将证明我的信仰并升为女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the outfit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这身打扮是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever the Legion asks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团要求什么就做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly I serve food and apply bandages. When urgent care is required, I am sometimes allowed to perform rudimentary surgery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我主要负责提供食物和包扎伤口。当需要紧急护理时，我有时被允许做一些基本的手术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My hands are very steady, you see. A useful asset around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我的手很稳。是这里有用的资产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not waste my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要浪费我的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly removing shrapnel and bullets, sewing up wounds and re-attaching fingers and ears.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是取出弹片和子弹，缝合伤口，重新接上手指和耳朵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could do so much more, too. With the right tools, I could save a Century's worth of men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能做更多。有了合适的工具，我可以拯救一个百人队的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of surgery do you perform?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做什么手术？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shut your mouth before your jaw is broken, Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你的下巴被打断之前闭上你的嘴，浪荡子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a great privilege to even be let in this room let alone lay hands on Mars' greatest soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能进入这个房间就已经是莫大的荣幸了，更不用说触摸玛尔斯最伟大的士兵了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such an assignment is proof I am favored by Mars. Any day now my servitude will be duly recognized. Mars willing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样的任务证明了我受到了玛尔斯的青睐，总有一天我的仆人身份会被正式承认。玛尔斯的意愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're only allowed to help sometimes? That's insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只被允许偶尔帮忙？这太疯狂了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Bargain elsewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。去别的地方砍价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我点东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mainly work on those who are already unconscious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我主要治疗那些已经失去知觉的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Conscious patients I am only allowed to bandage and stitch, for the most part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数情况下，我只能给神志清醒的病人包扎和缝合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I once had a Legionary tell me my hands were too womanly for surgery. That my fingers would break trying to push a scalpel through his muscles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经有个军团士兵告诉我，我的手太女人了，不适合做手术。我的手指在试图用手术刀穿过他的肌肉时会折断。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be that so, I will gladly break my hands if it proves my dedication to Mars. Anything to be a Priestess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即便如此，如果能证明我对玛尔斯的奉献，我愿意折断我的手。只要能成为女祭司，什么都可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do the Legionaries object to a woman caring for them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵会反对一个女人照顾他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be a Priestess is to be free. It is to be trusted. To be valued.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做一名女祭司就是自由的。是值得信赖的，被重视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Maiden is treated like a child. Dismissed, ignored, overlooked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对待女侍就像对待孩子。被摒弃，被无视，被忽略。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My skills could do good if only I was allowed to use them. So I must prove myself. I am a woman, yes, but not an invalid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要允许我使用，我的技能就能发挥作用，所以我必须证明自己。我是女人，没错，但不是病人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Cyn [06009556] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you want to be a Priestess so badly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么想当女祭司？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便了，快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This won't be the last you see of me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不会是你最后一次见到我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Cram. You know what you did with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的饱饱牌午餐肉，你知道你用它做了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, Cram's a Pre-War food full of preservatives and stuff. You shouldn't be eating it anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，饱饱牌午餐肉是一种战前食品，充满了防腐剂之类的东西。反正你也不应该吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm definitely not going to eat it after what you did to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你把它弄成那样，我绝对不会吃的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, shut up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，闭嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You observed them under the influence, didn't you? Isn't that all you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在酒精的作用下观察到他们的，对吧？这不就是你所需要的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what you saw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我你看到了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I don't feel like I have enough information to tell you one way or the other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我觉得我没有足够的信息来告诉你到底是怎么回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's calming. We Legionaries must be prepared for battle at all hours of the day, for our entire life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它让人平静。我们军团士兵必须每时每刻为战斗做好准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asher, for example, spends most of his time in an intense rage against the entire world. Brush helps him focus that rage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如阿舍，他大部分时间都对整个世界充满愤怒。狐尾草帮助他集中精力发泄愤怒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus sent me to ask you about Brush. What do you use it for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯让我来问你关于狐尾草的事。你用它做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Oh, that settles that. I'm banning Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？噢，这样就解决了。我禁止使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That motherfucker....
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个王八蛋...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, your reward. Be about your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你的报酬。随便用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spoke to Ficus. He questioned your authority.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟菲古斯谈过了，他质疑你的权威。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot darn, that's not good. That's not good at all. You and I can get in big trouble getting seen with that around these parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，这可不太好，这一点都不好。你和我带着这个在这附近被人看见会有大麻烦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And raiders? I don't need that. It's crazy how they've survived this long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有掠夺者？我不需要那个，他们能活这么久真是太不可思议了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you hold onto those, I ain't too keen on spending my twilight years on a cross overlooking the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你留着吧，我可不想在俯瞰科罗拉多河的十字架上度过我的晚年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Slippery Will [0600ABCA] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were raiders in the mine, but no treasure there. Unless you consider chems to be treasure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 矿里有掠夺者，但没有宝藏，除非你把化学药品当成宝藏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, fuck you, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，也他妈不管我的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not my problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it does. I didn't need you to tell me that. If you're not going to help, then leave me alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，确实如此。我不需要你来告诉我，如果你不打算帮忙，那就别来烦我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Omar [06010191] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that sucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那太糟糕了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our orders are to demoralize the NCR. The refugees are to stay put.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们接到的命令是打击NCR的士气，这些难民要留在原地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a refugee camp near here. Why haven't you taken them as slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近有个难民营。你为什么不把他们当奴隶？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You're right. There are Rangers on that side of the Colorado River. They've sniped several of our scouts that got near the camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你说得对。科罗拉多河岸边有游骑兵，他们狙击了我们几个接近营地的侦察兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the NCR really cared, there wouldn't be a refugee camp. So, what's the real reason?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果NCR真的在乎，就不会有难民营了。所以，真正的原因是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Probably, but then the NCR couldn't see them, so it'd be a moot point.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]可能吧，但NCR又看不见，所以这是没有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Publius Veranus [06013E29] (mod) Quest : ([0601018D]AZDamNQuest1) There's a Man at the Door EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but wouldn't it demoralize them more if they were slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，但如果他们是奴隶，岂不是更挫他们的士气？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trying to get through to the NCR. Legion doesn't treat my kind well, but I hear the NCR's got ghoul Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试图和NCR取得联系。军团对我这种人不太好，但我听说NCR有尸鬼游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if it's a land of milk and honey, but anyone's better than the Legion for my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那是不是一片乐土，但对我的人民来说，任何人都比军团强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It's never been good in Legion territory, but things got bad five or six years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。在军团的地盘上，情况一直不好，但在五六年前，情况变得糟糕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion lost a war against ghouls from a place called 'Reservation'. They've been taking it out on us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在一个叫做“保留地”的地方输掉了与尸鬼的战争。他们一直在拿我们撒气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or, maybe, it's because we don't fall for their crap? I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者，也许是因为我们不相信他们的鬼话？我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't treat ghouls well?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不善待尸鬼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a little joke. It's where I'm from, back in Arizona. It got overrun by the Legion a couple decades ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开个小玩笑。那是我的家乡，在亚利桑那州。几十年前就被军团占领了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At first, I thought, "well, as least the raiders are gone now". But, the Legion are just another bunch of raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 起初，我想，“好吧，至少现在掠夺者完了”。但是，军团只是另一群掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We tried to cross three or four days ago, but the soldiers opened fire. Killed one of us, injured four others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三四天前，我们试图过河，但士兵们开枪了。一人死亡，四人受伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Omar told us that the NCR captain thinks we might be Legion spies in disguise. I can't believe that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥马尔告诉我们NCR上尉认为我们可能是伪装的军团间谍。我简直不敢相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, doesn't the NCR know what Legionaries look like? The answer is not like us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，NCR难道不知道军团兵长什么样吗？答案和我们不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why haven't you gone over to the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不去NCR？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Omar. He's met the captain before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和奥马尔谈谈，他以前见过上尉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I can help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我能帮上忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tough luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真倒霉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you? Don't you need to be talking to the NCR to work on it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？难道你不需要和NCR谈谈才能解决吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tombstone [0601019B] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm working on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在努力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([0600B3EF]AZBaseCampBethDialogue) 0600B3EF (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, screw you, too. I'm leaving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，去你的。我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me details.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我细节。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As impressive as I thought he'd be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我想象的一样令人印象深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Can you go into a bit more detail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。你能说得更详细一点吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a thug.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个恶棍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are they upset? I, uh, guess that whoever's doing it should stop. Anyways, I've got to go, mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不高兴？我想不管是谁干的，都该住手了。总之，我先走了，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for whoever's been leaving graffiti in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找那个在纽特涂鸦的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are they upset? I, uh, guess that whoever's doing it should stop. Anyways, I've got to go, miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不高兴吗？我想不管是谁干的，都该住手了。总之，我先走了，小姐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Pablo [06013D43] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for whoever's been leaving graffiti in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找那个在纽特涂鸦的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, yeah. He left some stuff on the wall over there. He's not very good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，对。他在那边的墙上留了些东西，他画得不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your son paints?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子会画画？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He used to paint, but he's stopped recently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他过去常画画，但最近不画了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does your son paint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子会画画吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know damn well he doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很清楚他不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isabela [06013D41] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does your son paint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你儿子会画画吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Food, water, some other drinks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食物、水和其他一些饮料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you selling?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. This is Legion territory. All the other stuff is in a gray area. Alcohol is absolutely illegal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。这里是军团的地盘，其他的都处于灰色地带，酒精绝对是非法的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance of something harder?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么更硬的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you take caps or denarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们收瓶盖还是第纳尔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see what you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你有什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The keeper of this humble roadhouse. Supplier of fine drink and good food to passing caravaneers and Legionaries. Legionaries eat free, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个简陋旅馆的管理员。为路过的商队和军团提供优质的饮料和食物。当然，军团士兵是免费的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't bother with names, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎名字，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They like me. I keep up with the banter. Most people are too soft for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们喜欢我，我跟得上他们的戏谑。大多数人都太软弱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bring money in and keep soldier morale up. It's no fun to get your drinks poured by some sickly-looking slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我赚钱，让士兵士气高涨。让一个病怏怏的奴隶给你倒酒可没什么意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're really just a bartender? Why does the Legion need you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你真的只是个酒保？军团为什么需要你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I guess. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想也是，你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay. We're not particularly busy, anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。反正我们也不是特别忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能聊点别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A bunch of caravans pass through this area on their way to Fortification Hill and the Legate's Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商队在前往要塞山和特使营地的路上会经过这个地区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion needs supplies for the war. Could be better, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团需要战争补给。不过，可能会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who comes to this roadhouse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁来这个旅馆？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway collapsed. Not many merchants coming through these days. Something's got the wildlife all stirred up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道坍塌了，这些天来的商人不多。有什么东西把野生动物都激怒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the Legionaries typically don't drink Nuka-Cola.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且军团士兵一般不喝核子可乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the second-most important site for the Legion in the Mojave, right after the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是军团在莫哈维的第二重要地点，仅次于堡垒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the supplies pass through here on their way to there and the Legate's Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的物资都要从这里运去那里和特使营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, Marcellus Sedonus. He a legate brought on to oversee logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯。他是被派来监督后勤工作的特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A man named Flavius Constantinus. He replaced the old legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯的人。他取代了原来的特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How the hell should I know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么会知道？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Legate's Camp you mentioned, is Lanius already there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的特使营地？拉尼厄斯已经来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no. The one at the camp is Legate Lanius. The one here is one of the smaller legates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不。军营里的那个是拉尼厄斯特使，这个是小一点的特使之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He apparently used to be some big shot, but I get the impression that most of the Legionaries here don't like him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他显然曾经是个大人物，但我觉得这里的大多数军团士兵都不喜欢他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A legate? Like Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使？拉尼厄斯那种？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was killed. No one's sure who did it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他被杀了，没人知道是谁干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He apparently used to be some big shot, but I get the impression that most of the Legionaries here aren't too sad about him dying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他以前显然是个大人物，但我觉得这里的大多数军团士兵对他的死并不太伤心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A legate? Like Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使？拉尼厄斯那种？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Town? This ain't a town. It's a military base.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇？这里不是小镇，这是个军事基地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess if you ask the Legion nicely, you could use their bath house.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想如果你友好地请求军团，你可以用他们的浴场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a trading outpost just south of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 南边有个贸易前哨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything interesting around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上有什么好玩的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sell yourself into slavery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把自己卖为奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, just fucking with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，逗你玩的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The heads of the camp are Sedonus, the optio, and the adjutant. They're all towards the tents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 营地的首领是塞多尼乌斯，执行官和副官。他们都往帐篷那边去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the south is the Chainway construction site. They're always looking for couriers to run invoices and materials.
ESP.TRADUIT: 南面是连环道建筑工地，他们总是在找快递员来运发票和材料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll want to talk to the Optio. He's the head of the camp here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会想和执行官谈谈的，他是这个营地的首领。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the south is the Chainway construction site. They're always looking for couriers to run invoices and materials.
ESP.TRADUIT: 南面是连环道建筑工地，他们总是在找快递员来运发票和材料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a nut journalist over there. Says he's from Radio New Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边有个疯子记者，说他是新维加斯电台的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a bartender, so yes. For starters, the Legion's not been doing too well since the collapse of the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个酒保，所以有。首先，自从连环道坍塌后，军团的状况就不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This first one is for free. Stay away from the legate. He's an absolute psychopath.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一个免费。离特使远点，他是个十足的神经病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Frumentarius agent came in last week claiming that one of their agents might have blown up the Chainway. You didn't hear it from me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上周有个特务间谍来过，说他们的间谍可能炸毁了连环道。不是我告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was a Ranger rebellion in Big--. A rebellion in Solitare. I'd stay clear if I were you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大...索利泰尔发生了叛乱。如果我是你，我会躲得远远的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus isn't the first legate based in Malpais. The last one was killed for failing at Hoover Dam four years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯并不是第一个驻扎在马尔帕斯的特使，上一个四年前因为胡佛大坝的失败而被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus wasn't the first legate based in Malpais. The last one was killed for failing at Hoover Dam four years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯不是第一个驻扎在马尔帕斯的特使，上一个四年前因为胡佛大坝的失败而被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some Legionaries at this camp apparently deserted. That's pretty rare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个营地的一些军团士兵显然是离开了。这种情况很少见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some Radio New Vegas journalist came into town six months ago. He's been asking questions, but I ain't answering them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 六个月前，新维加斯电台的一个记者来到这里。他一直在问问题，但我不回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dale brought in an artillery piece from Yuma. Legion must be getting serious about the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴尔从尤马运来了一门大炮。军团对大坝的事肯定是认真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没了，就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think at all. No point to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全不看，没有任何意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于马尔佩斯就说到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bartender [06019956] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I noticed. Here's your reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我注意到了。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've finished that job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经完成了那项工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you repair some of my gear?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能帮我修些装备吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could you tell me about Dolan Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我讲讲多兰泉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you mechanically inclined? I'm looking for someone to help optimize the power output at Greenway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢机械吗？我想找人帮忙优化格林威的功率输出。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still looking for someone to optimize the windmills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在找人来优化风车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They first showed up six years ago, but then they left for a bit. Lost some battle or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们六年前第一次出现，但后来离开了一段时间。输了一场战役还是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They had a little puppet government set up until they could return, which they did, oh, four years now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们建立了一个傀儡政府，直到他们可以回来，他们做到了，哦，四年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long has the Legion been here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团在这里多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not bad. They ban drugs, so no junkies. They killed all of the raiders, so good trade. They seem to like our town, so we get some freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不坏。他们禁止毒品，所以没有瘾君子。他们干掉了所有的掠夺者，生意很好做。他们似乎很喜欢我们的小镇，所以我们也得到了一些自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as you aren't a dumbass, not bad at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你不傻，就不差。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Legion like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是什么样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion holds the northern edge. You probably passed by it on the way here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团守住了北部边缘。你来的路上应该也经过了吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those pain-in-the-ass merchants are set up in the gas stations and the local trading post by the water tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些讨厌的商人被安置在加油站和水塔旁边的当地贸易站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can get food and drink at the Big Dog, and the diner by the station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以在大狗餐厅和车站旁边的小餐馆买到食物和饮料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then, there's the moralizers at the Temple of Mars at the old church.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，在老教堂的玛尔斯神庙有教化者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the important locations around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 城镇周围有哪些重要地点？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The election. I wish those merchants would get it over with, so we can get some peace and quiet again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举。我真希望那些商人能快点了结这件事，这样我们就能重新过上平静的生活了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything going on around town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上有什么事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, the merchants convinced the Legion to let them run the town and keep things nice and smooth for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，商人们说服了军团，让他们来管理这个小镇，为他们打理好一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An election? In Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举？在军团领地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not an independent trader, so no. Only the caravaneers get to vote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是独立商人，所以不能。只有商队才有投票权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you get to vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能投票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's no secret that the Legion wants the White Sands guy to win, but he's not as popular as the other guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团想让白沙商队赢已经不是什么秘密了，但他们没有另一个那么受欢迎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really give a shit either way. Doesn't affect me one bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我都不在乎。对我一点影响都没有
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't even make bets on the outcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甚至不能对结果下注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think is going to win?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为谁会赢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea what that is, and I don't care. Honestly, I wish that those pain-in-the-ass merchants would just leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道那是什么，我也不在乎。说实话，我真希望那些讨厌的商人能离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've never needed them before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们从来不需要它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Civic engagement is the foundation of society!
ESP.TRADUIT: 公民参与是社会的基础！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Congratulations. You're an honorary citizen of Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝贺你，你是多兰泉的荣誉市民了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm not very political, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我也不太喜欢政治。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask 'em.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此有些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What we use it for now. It funnels some power to here and Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在用它做什么？给这里和金曼输送电力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to use the power for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要用这些电力做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't care. They're just a bunch of windmills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团才不管呢，它们只是一堆风车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're already active. I just want to make them work a little better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们已经在活动了，我只是想让它们工作得更好一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't that bother the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不会影响军团吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beyond my expertise. Plus, I think there's something wrong up the power line somewhere up north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 超出了我的专业范围。另外，我觉得北边某个地方的电线出了问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How come you haven't fixed it yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么还没修好？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Get to work, and come back here for your payment when you're done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。去工作吧，完成后再回来拿报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Zeke [0601998C] (mod) Quest : ([0601998E]AZGreenwayWindFarmQuest) Let the Four Winds Blow EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I go by the name Red Rivers. I am the head Armicustos here at the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字叫红河，我是堡垒的首席军械守卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have unwittingly stepped into the Deathclaw's den.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你无意中踏入了死亡爪的巢穴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the War Room, where our most cunning plan operations against the Profligates to the West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是作战室，我们在这里制定最狡猾的计划对付西部的放荡者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, Caesar is much too busy co-ordinating with the Legate Lanius on planned assault on the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，凯撒正忙着与拉尼厄斯特使协调攻打水坝的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is just where the centurions from the Legate's Camp come to relay training demands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这正是特使营地的百夫长前来传达训练要求的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Caesar come here often?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒经常来这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you learn not to pry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在哪儿学的不打探别人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hail from the Salt River tribes of Phoenix. When Caesar conquered my people, I was one of 22 youth taken in the campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自凤凰城的盐河部落。当凯撒征服我的人民时，我是被征召入伍的二十二名青年之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My familiarity with the rivers in the area allowed me to be a most effective scout for the Legion's raiding parties during the sack of Phoenix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这片区域的河流非常熟悉，在凤凰城被攻陷的过程中，我成为了军团突袭小队最得力的侦察兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every river, stream, creek and tributary I brought them to ran red in due course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我带他们去的每一条河流、小河小溪和支流，都在适当的时候变成了红色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where'd you get the name Red Rivers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 红河这个名字是怎么来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare me your disgust. They were not my people, they were river-rat vermin that barely put up a fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 省省你的恶心吧。他们不是我的同胞，他们是几乎不反抗的河鼠害虫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You killed your own people? That's awful!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你杀了你的同胞？太可怕了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is the only force strong enough to civilize the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是唯一强大到足以教化废土的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cowards, the lot of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都是懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen first hand entire companies of NCR troopers flee at the mere sight of our battle banner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我亲眼见过NCR的整个连的士兵仅仅看到我们的旗帜就逃跑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call it what you want, I watched grown men run away from our banner until they puked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你怎么说，我看着成年人从我们的旗帜下逃跑，直到他们呕吐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that is what the NCR calls tactical, so be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这就是NCR所谓的战术，那就是吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR aren't cowards, what you saw was a tactical retreat.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR不是懦夫，你看到的只是战术撤退。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are far from the first to say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是第一个这么说的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What you say is true. I've seen their so-called forces and they are pathetic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的没错。我见过他们所谓的部队，很可怜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rank-and-file do not. Not ours, at least. Firearms jam. They need ammunition. They break. To rely on guns makes a soldier weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 士兵不用。枪械卡壳，需要弹药，会坏。依赖枪支会让士兵变得软弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That being said, it would be foolish for an army to not use guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 话虽如此，军队不使用枪支是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assign the guns to our soldiers as appropriate, and repair them when needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会根据情况把枪分配给我们的士兵，并在需要的时候修理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does the Fort need an Armory? I thought the Legion didn't use guns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么堡垒需要军械库？我以为军团不用枪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a dull posting. Under Caesar's orders I am not to leave this place until we take the Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一份乏味的工作。根据凯撒的命令，在我们拿下胡佛水坝之前我不会离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like being the Armorer here at the Fort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢在堡垒里当军械师吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. We only deal with merchants under contract with Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。我们只跟和凯撒签了合同的商人打交道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you sell me something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能卖给我点东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I have the supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我有物资的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will you repair my equipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能修理我的装备吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a recruit Decanus. Meaning, I am Decanus to a contubernium of recruit Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是新兵什长。意思是，我是一群军团新兵的什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I myself am not a recruit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说我自己是新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not. If I am a recruit, I am only a recruit to the rank of Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是。就算我是新兵，我也是什长级别的新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's okay if you are a recruit. There's no shame in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是新兵也没关系，这没什么不好意思的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Demonstrating bravery in battle. That is the only way to gain any title of worth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战斗中表现勇敢。这是获得任何有价值头衔的唯一途径。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does one become a Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要怎么才能成为什长？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I do. He's in my contubernium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然知道，他在我的十人队里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a good soldier with great passion. He's resourceful and cunning. However, he is not a leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个充满激情的好士兵。他很机智很狡猾。然而，他并不是一个领导者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He may make a good Frumentarius, some day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许有一天他会成为一名优秀的特务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything about a Legionary named Arceus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道一个叫阿尔克修斯的军团士兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He talks to Corella more than the others, but that doesn't concern me. He just has more to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他跟科雷拉说话比跟其他人多，但我不担心。他只是有更多话要说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Has he ever done anything suspicious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他做过什么可疑的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is the contubernium's tent maid. All the men are well acquainted with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是十人队的帐篷女仆，所有的男人都和她很熟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is Corella?
ESP.TRADUIT: 科雷拉是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. She tends to the cooking and cleaning and other more servile duties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。她负责做饭、打扫和其他一些卑躬屈膝的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the men also talk to her. Confide in her, I suppose. A woman's input can be useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些男人也和她说话。我想是向她倾诉吧，女性的意见可能是有用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a tent maid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帐篷女仆是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, like a wife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，就像妻子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes, that. Some of the Centurions have something similar. A personal concubine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，对，就是那个。一些百夫长也有类似的东西，私人情妇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A wife. It's a woman that you can confide in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妻子，是一个你可以信赖的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes, that. Some of the Centurions have something similar. A personal concubine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，对，就是那个。一些百夫长也有类似的东西，私人情妇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A wife. It's a woman that cooks and cleans for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妻子，是一个为你做饭和打扫卫生的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And? Why are you telling me this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后呢？你为什么要告诉我这些？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus is in a relationship with one of the slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯与其中一个奴隶发生了关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's unfortunate. He's a good soldier. I suppose they'll have to be punished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就太不幸了，他是个好士兵。我想他们必须受到惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A male slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 男奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last time this happened, it was decimation. Either that, or a bullet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上一次发生这种情况，是抽杀。要么那样，要么一颗子弹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's preferred that this sort of thing is dealt with quickly and quietly, so crucifixion is out of the question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种事情最好是迅速而安静地处理，所以钉十字架是不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of punishment will they receive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会受到什么样的惩罚？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not often, but it does happen from time to time. I only tell you this because you're a friend of a Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不经常，但确实偶尔会发生。我告诉你这些只是因为你是军团的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rarely between a soldier and a slave, though. Not that I've seen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过很少在士兵和奴隶之间。我没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be easier to overlook if we were not so near to Caesar and the Castra Legatus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们不是离凯撒和特使军营这么近的话，就更容易被忽视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion have to punish people for this sort of thing often?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团需要经常因为这种事惩罚人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. That sort of degeneracy is the domain of the Profligates across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。那种堕落是河对岸那些放荡者的领地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the Legion have to punish people for this sort of thing often?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团需要经常因为这种事惩罚人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, thank you for bringing this to my attention. It will be dealt with swiftly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，谢谢你告诉我这件事。我们会迅速处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if that's all, I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，如果没别的事，我先走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not easily. He's one-eighth of my contubernium, an integral part of the fighting force. Why should I throw him away?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不容易。他是我这个十人队的八分之一，是战斗部队不可或缺的一部分。我为什么要把他扔掉？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can Arceus be reassigned to another post?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯可以被调到其他岗位吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. I suppose you're right. Fine. How about... Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想你是对的。好吧，要不...棉白杨湾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll need to get the paperwork in order, but I see no reason why it shouldn't be accepted. It's a fine post. I think he'll thrive there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要把文件整理好，但我觉得没有理由不接受。这是个好职位，我认为他会在那里茁壮成长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go tell him to pack his things. He'll be heading out in a day or so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉他去收拾东西，他大概一天后就会离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar has personally recognized me as an asset to the Legion. Does my track record not speak for itself? Trust me on this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒亲口承认我是军团的宝贵财富，难道我的记录不能说明问题吗？相信我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try again. This time, give me a real answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再试试。这次，给我一个真实的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, sir, because he's in love. Can't you find it in your heart to reassign him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，长官，因为他恋爱了。你就不能给他换个职位吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, no. He cannot be reassigned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就不行，他不能被调任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道这么多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you didn't hear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你没听到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus and a male slave were caught engaging in deviant behavior. A slave woman uncovered it and brought it to our attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯和一个男奴隶被发现有越轨行为。一个女奴揭发了，引起了我们的注意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He actually killed her to try and cover up his secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他竟然为了掩盖自己的秘密而杀了她。
