ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did admire that about him. Always uncompromising.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实很欣赏他这一点，永不妥协。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, he was punished as appropriate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，他受到了适当的惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Arceus around?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯在吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decimation by the rest of his contubernium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 被他十人队的其它人杀死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What punishment did he receive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他受到了什么惩罚？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The slave boy? Beaten and shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个奴隶男孩？殴打和枪杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crucifixion is too visible for a crime like this. Most people want it dealt with quickly and quietly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像这样的罪行被钉在十字架上太显眼了，大多数人都希望这件事能迅速而安静地解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Syracuse [06019BA6] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Flemus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那弗勒慕斯呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cook and clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做饭和打扫卫生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That may not sound like much, but let me tell you, it is when you're doing it by the hundreds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来可能不多，但让我告诉你，当你数百次这样做时就不同了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Twenty years or so. I don't much mind it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 二十年左右，我不太在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the same work I was doing for my husband, way back when.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这和我以前为我丈夫做的工作一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当奴隶多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you don't want to get into that. It's ancient history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你不会想跟我谈这个的。这是一段古老的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you're really that curious... I was a raider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你真的那么好奇的话...我是一名掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was silly. I could have just stayed home and the Legion would've let me be a Liberti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很愚蠢。我本可以待在家里，军团会让我成为自由民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you do before you became a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在成为奴隶之前你是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's not a whole lot to tell. I left home with my boyfriend when I was a young girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么好说的。当我还是个小女孩的时候，我和男朋友一起离开了家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He joined a gang. We got into chems. He started robbing caravans. We got married.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他加入了一个帮派，我们开始嗑药，他开始抢劫商队，我们结婚了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truth be told, we survived a lot longer than we should have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我们活得比应该活的久多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were a raider? Tell me about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是掠夺者？跟我说说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think they're brutes, but they're orderly. You have to admire them for that. They have rules, and they enforce them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得他们很野蛮，但他们很有秩序，你不得不佩服他们。他们有规则，他们执行这些规则。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's always cargo coming in. Some of the traders hoof it here too, instead of stopping at Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，总是有货物进来。有些商人也在这里行走，而不是在马尔帕斯停留。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Other than that, there are lots of military drills. Almost everything here is military, plus the slaves who do the domestic work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，还有很多军事演习。这里几乎所有的东西都是军用的，还有做家务的奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The real problem is some of these slaves. They're troublemakers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的问题是其中一些奴隶。他们是麻烦制造者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of things go on here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里都发生些什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't mean to start rumors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我不是故意制造谣言的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that there are some people here who seem more concerned with their own secrets than doing their jobs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是这里有些人似乎更关心自己的秘密而不是做好自己的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like Flemus. Always sneaking away at night. Him and Arceus always seem to go missing at the same time. It spells trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如弗勒慕斯，总是在夜里偷偷溜走。他和阿尔克修斯似乎总是同时失踪，这意味着麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope they're not doing something bad. Chems, do you think? Gosh, I hope not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望他们没有做什么坏事。你觉得是毒品吗？天哪，我希望不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh would you? That would be wonderful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你会吗？那就太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really, it's not that I mean to snitch, but it's so hard to get things done when one person is not putting in the effort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说真的，我并不是想告密，但如果一个人不努力的话，事情就很难办好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can look into Flemus and Arceus, if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想的话，我可以去查弗勒慕斯和阿尔克修斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Legionary is hiding something from the Legion. A slave is hiding something from his brothers and sisters. Does that not concern you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一名军团士兵对军团隐瞒了一些事情，一个奴隶对他的兄弟姐妹隐瞒了一些事情。你不担心吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's wrong. It's suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是错误的，这很可疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what it is they're hiding. It could be chems, or maybe they're planning to desert. Or stealing something. Or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道他们在隐瞒什么。可能是毒品，也可能是他们打算逃跑，或者偷东西之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever it is, I can't figure it out on my own. I need your help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管是什么，我自己都搞不清楚。我需要你的帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, before I go, what *exactly* is your concern?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，在我走之前，你*究竟*在担心什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's one Legionary around here with a good head on his shoulders. I think his name is Finturus. You may ask him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近有个很有头脑的军团战士。我想他的名字叫芬图勒斯，你可以问他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Otherwise, you could always just ask around. Someone has to know something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则，你可以到处打听。总有人知道些什么吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who should I go talk to for more information about what Arceus and Flemus are doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该去找谁了解更多关于阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯的信息？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what that means, don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这意味着什么，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're guilty. They must be up to something. You have to get to the bottom of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有罪，他们一定有什么阴谋。你必须弄清楚这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus says you should shut your "bitch mouth." His words, not mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯说你应该闭上你的“臭嘴”。他说的，不是我说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's wonderful!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，那太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must tell the Legionary's Decanus. They'll probably be beaten. Serves them right!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得告诉士兵的什长。他们可能会挨打，他们活该！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus and Flemus are in love. They're sneaking out for some privacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯相爱了，他们偷偷溜出去找点私人空间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, gladly!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，乐意之至！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Arceus and Flemus again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再来谈谈阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're breaking the rules. It's a degenerate relationship. Any Legionary will tell you that it's immoral, that men are supposed to be with women.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们违反了规则，这是一种堕落的关系。任何一个军团士兵都会告诉你这是不道德的，男人应该和女人在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those two are not special. They are not above the rules. Surely you can see that. They cannot be above the rules that the rest of us follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那两个人没什么特别的，他们不能凌驾于规则之上。你肯定能看出来，他们不能凌驾于我们其他人所遵循的规则之上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every woman here has lost someone. Husbands, lovers, even our children. The Legion takes our children!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的每个女人都失去过亲人。丈夫，爱人，甚至我们的孩子。军团带走了我们的孩子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But because Arceus and Flemus are men, they're allowed to have this? They're allowed to have love? I won't stand for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但就因为阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯是男人，他们就可以拥有这个吗？他们就可以拥有爱吗？我不能容忍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must tell the Legion. If you don't, I will. I would be spitting on my husband's grave if I let those two continue to fornicate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须告诉军团，如果你不说，那我来。如果我让那两个人继续私通，我就是在向我丈夫的坟墓吐口水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want them to be punished for it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让他们因此受到惩罚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't take too long. I might go find the Decanus myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要拖太久，我可能会自己去找什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk to them about it first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想先跟他们谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good! I can't thank you enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！我对你感激不尽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll go tell the Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会去告诉什长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'll tell the Decanus myself! I might even get a reward for bringing this to the Legion's attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就亲自告诉什长！把这件事告诉军团，说不定还能得到奖励呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to tell the Decanus. You need to let them have their relationship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会告诉什长的，你得让他们拥有自己的感情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, regardless, thank you for bringing this to my attention. The Legion will be so much stronger with those two gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，谢谢你让我知道这件事。他们俩死了，军团会更强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do whatever you want. It's not my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想做什么就做什么，这不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Absolutely not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，绝对不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there some way I can convince you not to tell the Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么办法能说服你不要告诉什长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're really going to put money on the line just to save those two? I don't understand why you even care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要为了救那两个人把钱都搭上吗？我不明白你为什么这么在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 100 denarii. That's my price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 100第纳尔，这就是我的价格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much would it cost to buy your silence?
ESP.TRADUIT: 要花多少钱才能让你保持沉默？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll accept that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here: 500 caps. In exchange, you're going to forget about Arceus and Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，500瓶盖。作为交换，你要忘掉阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll accept that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here: 100 denarii. In exchange, you're going to forget about Arceus and Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，100第纳尔。作为交换，你要忘掉阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 500 caps.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much money did you want, again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要多少钱，再说一遍？

ESP.ORIGINAL: 100 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 100第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much money did you want, again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要多少钱，再说一遍？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're deranged!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll keep my mouth shut. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会守口如瓶的。快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you so much as glance at the Decanus, I'll be wearing your tongue as a necklace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你敢看什长一眼，我就把你的舌头当项链戴上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're really going to threaten an old woman? You're scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要威胁一个老妇人吗？你这个人渣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll keep my mouth shut. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会守口如瓶的。快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're going to have some trouble getting to the Decanus with both your legs broken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你两条腿都断了的话，想要去找什长恐怕会有困难。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not afraid of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不怕你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you try and tell the Decanus, I will hurt you so hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你敢告诉什长，我会狠狠的揍你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that... Are you threatening me? How dare you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是...你在威胁我吗？你怎么敢这样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll keep my mouth shut. Just go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会守口如瓶的。快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should drop this for your own good. I'd hate for you to go missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了你好，你应该放下这件事。我可不想让你失踪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I train with the drill instructors and also fetch things for the soldiers sometimes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和教官一起训练，有时也给士兵们拿东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the strongest thing in the wasteland. Profligates cower before us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是废土上最强大的力量，放荡者在我们面前畏缩不前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going to kill them and honor Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们要杀光他们，向玛尔斯致敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pretty suspicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还挺可疑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever seen anything suspicious around camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在营地附近见过什么可疑的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.... Nope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...没了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything suspicious besides me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我之外还有什么可疑的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think harder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再仔细想想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, I see smoke from a campfire a little north of here, on the shore. It only happens at night, so that's kinda interesting I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时，我能在稍微往北一点的海岸上看到篝火冒出的烟雾。这种情况只发生在晚上，我想这很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything going on in the camp that seems interesting or notable to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得营地里有什么有趣或值得注意的事情吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only painters I know are Flemus and Pablo, but Flemus never plays with me because his legs are wobbly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识的画家只有弗勒慕斯和巴勃罗，但弗莱姆斯从来不和我玩，因为他的腿总是摇摇晃晃的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to paint, but I would never paint mean things about the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也画过画，但我不会画那些诋毁军团的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know any painters?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识什么画家吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. You tell me. Why are you helping out the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你告诉我，你为什么要帮助军团？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have a problem with me being a woman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对我是女人有意见？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You believe in a vision of the world where you're nothing more than a man's property?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信在这个世界上你只不过是男人的财产？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever privilege you've been given won't last. The men can't stand a woman with more power than them. You're a walking contradiction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你拥有什么特权都不会长久，男人无法忍受比他们更有权力的女人。你是个活生生的矛盾体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day, someone's gonna try and fix that contradiction. You'd do well to remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天，会有人试图解决这个矛盾。你最好记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in the Legion's vision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信军团的愿景。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you should explore more on the other side of the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你应该到河的另一边多探索一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not committed to the Legion. I'm just exploring my options.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并没有效忠于军团，我只是在探索我的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lucky you. They don't pay us a single denarius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真幸运，他们一个第纳尔都不付给我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion pays well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团给的挺多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strange that he'd extend such grace to a woman. You must be a pretty big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真奇怪，他居然对一个女人如此仁慈。你一定是个大人物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate the Legion. I'm only here because Caesar invited me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恨军团，我来这里只是因为凯撒邀请了我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just the woman the Legion talks to when they want their tribute. I make sure they only take what we can spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是军团想要贡品的时候会找的女人。我确保他们只拿走我们多余的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, I keep lookout. There's a great view of their camp from here. If I see anything through my binoculars, I let people know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，我负责放哨。从这里可以很好地看到他们的营地，如果我用望远镜看到什么，我会告诉大家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't start thinking I'm the leader of the town or anything though. I'm really just the one here who's least afraid of dying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别以为我是镇上的头儿什么的，我只是这里最不害怕死亡的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a fishing village, for the most part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里基本上是个渔村。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There used to be more trade along the lake, but you'd have to ask Doc Clay about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去沿河的贸易比较多，但这你得去问克雷医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说纽特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We give them labor and food. In exchange, they don't kill us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们给他们提供劳动力和食物。作为交换，他们不杀我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does Newt serve the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特如何为军团服务？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! I knew this would blow up eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！我就知道这件事最终会爆发的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lots of people use that campfire, but I figure you're talking about the two young men who are sneaking away at night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人都在用那个篝火，但我猜你说的是那两个晚上偷偷溜走的年轻人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a small campfire along the shore north of Base Camp. Have you ever seen who tends it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大本营北边的岸边有个小营火，你见过谁照料它吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember seeing them through my binoculars for the first time and thinking to myself that one day, someone is gonna get in a lot of trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得我第一次用望远镜看到他们的时候我就在想，总有一天，有人会惹上大麻烦的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know much except what I can see. One of 'em is blond. The other doesn't look like a soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我能看到的，我知道的不多。其中一个是金发，另一个看起来不像士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about the two men?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我那两个人的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides feeling each other up? No, nothing suspicious at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了感受对方？不，没有什么可疑的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you see them doing anything suspicious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到他们做了什么可疑的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup. Seemed like a pretty romantic date.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，看起来是很浪漫的约会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Feeling each other up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 感受对方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The sooner I tell, the sooner this stops involving Newt at all. It's not our problem. I saw what I saw, and that's that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我越早告诉你，纽特就能越早撇清干系。这不是我们的问题，我看到了我看到的，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Becca [06019C12] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're very forthcoming with that information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很乐意提供这些信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, he's a good friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他是我的好朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard you know Arceus quite well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说你很了解阿尔克修斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why wouldn't they be? We're two halves of the same whole. We both serve Caesar and Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不会？我们是一个整体的两部分，我们同时侍奉凯撒和玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a tent maid, it's natural to develop a friendship with your contubernium. That's part of the job of being a tent maid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个帐篷女仆，和你的十人队建立友谊是很自然的。这是帐篷女仆工作的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that you're not allowed to take it any further than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是你不能再进一步了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, are Legionaries allowed to befriend slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，军团士兵可以和奴隶交朋友吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're not supposed to... become intimate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不应该...变得亲密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would only create problems. You can't take care of a baby here, it's not safe or clean, and we don't have the supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这只会带来问题。你不能在这里照顾孩子，这里既不安全也不干净，我们也没有医疗用品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Usually, pregnant maids are sent back to rest camps or creation centers with the first available caravan. But that means the soldiers lose their maid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常情况下，怀孕的女仆会被送回休息营地或生产中心，与第一辆可用的大篷车一起。但这意味着士兵们会失去他们的女仆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus isn't like that though. He's more understanding than the other men.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但阿尔克修斯不是这样的，他比其他人更善解人意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take it further? What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 更进一步？你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh gosh no. He's not like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦天哪，不是。他不是那样的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that the kind of relationship you have with Arceus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和阿尔克修斯就是这种关系吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's thoughtful and very sweet. Don't let the exterior fool you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很体贴，很贴心。不要被外表欺骗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once you get him to open up, he's really great. He's the only one of his contubernium that really feels things, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦你让他敞开心扉，他真的很棒。他是十人队里唯一一个真正有感情的人，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说他吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not like him, no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不像他，不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't blame them. It's just something that becomes clear from talking to them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不怪他们。这只是通过与他们交谈而变得清晰的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, the other Legionaries don't feel things?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，其他军团士兵没有感情吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sneaking away? Who said that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 偷偷溜走？谁说的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus would never do something to hurt the Legion, if that's what you're implying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯绝不会做任何伤害军团的事，如果你是这个意思的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there one slave in particular you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你指的是某个奴隶？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why might he be sneaking away with a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他为什么会带着一个奴隶偷偷溜走呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should leave this alone. Please. They're not hurting anybody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还是别管这事了。拜托，他们没有伤害任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't. I promised that I wouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能，我保证过不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't know that they're not hurting anybody if you won't tell me what's going on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不告诉我发生了什么，我就不知道他们有没有伤害任何人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't. I promised that I wouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能，我保证过不会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just spit it out. I'm tired of playing detective.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有话快说，我厌倦了扮演侦探。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你明白了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're in love, but if people were to find out, they would be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们相爱了，但如果被人发现了，他们会被杀的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get it. I've had to keep some of my relationships secret too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白，我也不得不对我的一些恋情保密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你明白了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're in love, but if people were to find out, they would be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们相爱了，但如果被人发现了，他们会被杀的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get it. I've had to keep some of my relationships secret too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白，我也不得不对我的一些恋情保密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's the problem: they would get in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这就是问题所在：他们会惹上麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're... in love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们...相爱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm no Legionary. I just want to make sure that they're not doing something that could get them in trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是军团士兵，我只是想确保他们不会做会给自己惹上麻烦的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, I can't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you please just tell me? Pretty please? I can keep a secret, I promise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我吗？美女，拜托了？我会保守秘密的，我保证！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're insane! You say you want to help?!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了！你还说你想帮忙？！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're in love. Is that what you wanted to know? Just don't hurt me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们相爱了，这就是你想知道的？别伤害我就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm asking nicely. Please don't make me beat the information out of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的请求很客气，请别逼我从你嘴里弄出信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell? No! I'm not telling you anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？不！我什么都不会告诉你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just tell me or I'll... I'll beat you up. I'll beat you up really bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快告诉我，否则我就...会揍你一顿。我会狠狠揍你一顿的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How...?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Good job. You're very smart. Are you happy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，干得好，你很聪明。开心了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus and Flemus are in love. If anyone else found out about this, they could be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯相爱了。如果有人发现了，他们可能会被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You feel safe with Arceus. Is that because he doesn't desire you the way the other Legionaries do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得和阿尔克修斯在一起很安全，难道是因为他不像其他军团士兵那样渴望得到你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, of course I'm hiding something. I told them I'd keep their secret, and I will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我当然有所隐瞒。我告诉过他们我会保守秘密，我做到了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're hiding something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在隐瞒什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Maidens and Priestesses say it's the gravest defiance of Mars, because men and women are supposed to make children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女侍和女祭司说，这是对玛尔斯最严重的蔑视，因为男人和女人应该生儿育女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus and Flemus would be punished severely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯和弗勒慕斯将受到严厉的惩罚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't tell anybody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能告诉任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does the Legion feel about same-sex relationships?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是如何看待同性关系的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. Where are you going now? You aren't going to tell anyone, are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等。你现在要去哪里？你不会告诉别人的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我想知道的，谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave woman? Then maybe she'll understand. Just don't let this get out, please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个女奴隶？也许她会理解的。千万别泄露出去，求你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a slave woman who's concerned that they're doing something to sabotage the Legion. I'm going to tell her that they're not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个女奴隶担心他们会做些破坏军团的事，我要告诉她他们没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm not going to tell anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我不会告诉任何人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think about it some more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我再考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Arceus. I serve under the decanus Syracuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是阿尔克修斯，我为叙拉古什长效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you want something more substantial?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要更实质性的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again? I already said I am a Legion recruit serving under decanus Syracuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再来？我已经说过了，我是一名在叙拉古什长手下服役的新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能再谈谈你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Arceus. I serve under the decanus Syracuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是阿尔克修斯，我为叙拉古什长效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要更实质性的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again? I already said I am a Legion recruit serving under decanus Syracuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再来？我已经说过了，我是一名在叙拉古什长手下服役的新兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about you again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能再谈谈你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, of course we're acquainted. Why shouldn't we be? He painted the flag outside my tent. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们当然认识，为什么我们不能认识？我帐篷外的旗是他画的，就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does Flemus say you two are acquainted?
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯为什么说你们认识？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? No. I don't. I don't know who that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？不，我不认识，我不知道那是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would I ever cavort with slaves? They are beneath me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要跟奴隶厮混？他们在我之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the slave Flemus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识那个叫弗勒慕斯的奴隶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia? You're going to listen to a woman? You believe some worthless slave woman is an authority here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅？你要听一个女人的话？你相信一个毫无价值的女奴是这里的权威吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should have her beaten. Go to her and tell her to keep her bitch mouth shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真该揍她一顿，去告诉她闭上她的臭嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia says you and Flemus are plotting something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅说你和弗勒慕斯在密谋什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're persistent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很执着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yet, you don't seem eager to let this secret get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，你似乎并不急于泄露这个秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Since you're telling me this, then I suppose you're willing to see reason. You'll be my bait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。既然你跟我说了这些，那我想你是愿意明白道理的。你就当我的诱饵吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Iulia put you up to this, it's only a matter of time before she figures it out on her own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是尤利娅让你这么做的，她自己搞清楚只是时间问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell her. Gauge her reaction. Then, come back to me. We'll discuss what to do with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉她，观察她的反应。然后，回到我身边，我们商量一下该怎么处置她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know about your relationship with Flemus. Iulia wants me to reveal your secret to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你和弗勒慕斯的关系，尤利娅想让我向她透露你的秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're serious, aren't you...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真的吧，不是你...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus. Shit. I knew she would be trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，该死。我就知道她会是个麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If word gets out, Flemus will be killed. I don't even want to imagine what they'd do to him, but I know it won't be as simple as a bullet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果消息传出去，弗勒慕斯就会被杀。我甚至不想想象他们会对他做什么，但我知道不会像一颗子弹那么简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia wants to expose your relationship with Flemus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅想曝光你和弗勒慕斯的关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Iulia again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再谈谈尤利娅吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I know what to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有，我知道该怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This woman, Iulia, is just a slave. She's only one of thousands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个女人，尤利娅，只是个奴隶。她只是成千上万人中的一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If she were to die, someone else would take her place, and Flemus would be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她死了，别人会接替她的位置，那么弗勒慕斯就安全了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think, if I found something to get upset with, and I started beating her for it, I could make it look like an accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想，如果我发现了什么让我生气的事，然后开始为此殴打她，我可以让这一切看起来像一场意外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Men beat the slaves all the time. It'll just be a mistake. I'll be punished, but our secret will be safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人们总是殴打奴隶。这只是一个错误，我会受到惩罚，但我们的秘密不会泄露。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any ideas on how to stop her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么办法阻止她吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Unless you have a better idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，除非你有更好的主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to beat her to death?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想把她打死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reassigned to another outpost? He wants that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 调到另一个前哨？他想要的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, maybe he's right. If I were gone, her accusations would become nothing more than hearsay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，也许他是对的。如果我走了，她的指控只会变成道听途说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flemus thinks you should get yourself reassigned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯认为你应该调任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you have sway with the Legion, then yes, that may work. Otherwise, I wouldn't try it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在军团中有影响力，那么是的，这可能有用。否则，我不会去尝试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't I just talk to your Decanus and ask him to send you somewhere else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就不能跟你的什长谈谈让他把你送到别的地方去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would need to get in the right amount of trouble: enough to be a problem here, but not so much that they'll kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要惹上适当的麻烦：足够成为这里的一个问题，但又不能多到让他们杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could steal something. If I got caught stealing, they would probably ship me to Malpais or somewhere less important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以偷点东西。如果我偷东西被抓到，他们可能会把我送到马尔帕斯或其他不那么重要的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they also may kill me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们也可能会杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does a Legionary have to do to be reassigned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个军团士兵要怎么做才能被调任？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think about it some more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我再考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. I'm glad. I really don't want to leave this post. I'd probably never see him again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我很高兴。我真的不想离开这个岗位，我可能再也见不到他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let us go put an end to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们结束这一切吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go with your plan. Kill Iulia, and make it look like an accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们按照你的计划来吧。杀了尤利娅，然后伪装成意外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reassigned to another outpost? He wants that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 调到另一个前哨？他想要的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, maybe he's right. If I were gone, her accusations would become nothing more than hearsay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，也许他是对的。如果我走了，她的指控只会变成道听途说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flemus thinks you should get yourself reassigned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯认为你应该调任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you think that's best. Do you think you can convince my Decanus, or must I steal something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你觉得这样最好的话。你觉得你能说服我的什长吗，还是说我得偷点东西？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd truly prefer not to steal something. I worry that, because the war is heating up, I'll be made an example of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不想偷东西。我担心，因为战争正在升温，我会被杀鸡儆猴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It'd be a flip of a coin whether they kill me or reassign me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是杀了我还是重新分配我，都是抛硬币决定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go with Flemus' plan. Get yourself reassigned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们按照弗勒慕斯的计划来吧，给自己换个岗位。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. It'll be cleaner that way. And I won't be risking a flogging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。那样就干净多了，我可不想冒被鞭打的风险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell Flemus... no, nevermind. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉弗勒慕斯...不，算了。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can convince your Decanus to reassign you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以说服什长重新指派你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Let's see how this goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧，让我们看看情况如何。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't wait around for me. Come back in a day or so and find me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别等我了，过一两天再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I probably can't convince your Decanus. You're going to have to steal something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可能无法说服你的什长，你得去偷点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You tell me. You were the last slave to touch my laundry, and now my coin purse is missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说呢。你是最后一个碰过我衣服的奴隶，现在我的零钱包不见了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? She won't be easy to convince. Still, thank you, and good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？要说服她可不容易。谢谢你，祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll handle Iulia myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己来处理尤利娅。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing is always such a thrill. I trust you understand what I'm talking about. That feeling like you're being awakened to something. It's invigorating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀戮总是那么刺激，我相信你明白我在说什么。那种感觉就像你被什么东西唤醒了，这让人精神振奋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the better to know that I've done it righteously. She was a worm. She was less than dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 知道我这么做是正义的就更好了。她是只虫子，她连泥土都不如。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: For Flemus, I would kill her a thousand times more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了弗勒慕斯，我愿意再杀她一千次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help, amicus. She would have discovered us eventually. It's better that we dealt with it now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助，朋友。她迟早会发现我们的，我们现在解决这件事比较好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to report my mistake to my Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果你不介意的话，我要向我的什长报告我的错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flemus. I'm a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弗勒慕斯，我是个奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't physically fit enough for it. My joints are... wrong, somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的身体不适合，我的关节...有问题，不知何故。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why, but they hurt often, and every once and a while, something will dislocate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道为什么，但它们经常疼，而且时不时地，有些地方会脱臼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Maidens say it's abnormal. They had never seen a kid hurt himself so badly playing stickball. My shoulder popped right out of the socket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 女侍们说这不正常。他们从来没有见过一个孩子在玩棍球时伤得这么重。我的肩膀从关节窝里弹了出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't all male slaves supposed to become Legionaries?
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道不是所有的男奴都应该成为军团士兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Textile work and dyeing, mostly. Those flags you see out there? Some of them are mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是纺织和染色。你看到那边的旗子了吗？其中一些是我做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's actually very relaxing work. The red pigment comes from these little bugs you can find on cacti.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这其实是一份非常轻松的工作。红色颜料来自仙人掌上的小虫子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a small farm for them in Two-Sun, but out here, you have to search for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在双日城有个小农场，但在这里，你必须自己去寻找它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't mind them. I know that must sound crazy to you coming from a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不介意。我知道你从奴隶口中说出这句话一定很疯狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My earliest memories are of having to hide from raiders. They came by, shouting, trashing everything and stealing whatever they could grab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最早的记忆是不得不躲避掠夺者。他们来了，大喊大叫，把所有东西都毁了，把能抢到的东西都抢走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had to hold my breath so they wouldn't hear me. Then they started shooting. I couldn't even cry because it would give me away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不屏住呼吸，不让他们听见。然后他们开始射击，我甚至不能哭，因为那样会暴露我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what life was like before the Legion. The Legion makes everyone a lot safer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是加入军团之前的生活。有了军团，大家就安全多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus, you said? I don't know any Arceus. Did I say I do? I must've misheard you. I know an Atreus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说阿尔克修斯？我不认识阿尔克修斯。我说过我认识吗？我一定是听错了，我认识一个阿特柔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does Arceus say he's never heard of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么阿尔克修斯说他从没听说过你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I mean, I've met him. I know of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。我是说，我见过他，我认识他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the Legionary Arceus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识叫阿尔克修斯的军团士兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? That's absurd. If she has a problem, she should just come speak to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？这太荒谬了。如果她有什么问题，她应该来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia seems to think you and Arceus have some sort of scheme.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅似乎认为你和阿尔克修斯有什么阴谋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia? She's alright, I guess. I don't like to speak bad of people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅？我想她还好吧。我不喜欢说别人的坏话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think she likes me, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我觉得她不喜欢我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Iulia?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得尤利娅怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? How did you...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你怎么...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia did this? She put you up to this? That awful woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅？她让你这么做？那个可怕的女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're telling me first, then I suppose that means you're having doubts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你先告诉我，那我猜你是有疑虑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's unwavering when she sets her mind to something. If you figured it out, she will, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当她下定决心做某事时，她是毫不动摇的。如果你发现了，她也会发现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you should just tell her? Rip the bandage off. If she reacts poorly, then....
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你应该直接告诉她？把绷带撕掉。如果她反应不好，那么...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we can deal with that when we get to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，到时候我们再来处理这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know about your relationship with Arceus. Iulia wants me to reveal your secret to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你和阿尔克修斯的关系，尤利娅想让我向她透露你的秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no...
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢不...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Okay. Well, we can think of something, can't we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，好的，我们能想出办法的，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia wants to expose your relationship with Arceus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅想揭露你和阿尔克修斯的关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Iulia again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再谈谈尤利娅吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. If our relationship is the problem, then maybe we just need to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧。如果问题出在我们的关系上，也许我们只需要...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus needs to be reassigned. Somewhere else, far from here. Once he's gone, Iulia's accusations will mean nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯需要调任，别的地方，离这儿很远的地方。等他走了，尤利娅的指控就没有意义了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate it, and I hate that she would have won, but that's the safest option. Otherwise, we're both dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌这样，也讨厌她会赢，但这是最安全的选择。否则，我们都得死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any ideas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么主意吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. It's either that, or something very stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。要么是这样，要么是做一些非常愚蠢的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want me to get Arceus reassigned to another camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我把阿尔克修斯调到别的营地吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perfect. Thank you. Words are not enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完美。谢谢你！言语不够表达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go talk to Arceus about getting reassigned to another camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去跟阿尔克修斯谈谈调到另一个营地去的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, he should not do that. Do not let him. He's not thinking straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，他不应该那样做。别让他得逞，他脑子不太清醒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus wants to kill Iulia to preserve your secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯想杀死尤利娅来保守你的秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't be serious. Please tell me you're not considering it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不会是认真的吧，别告诉我你在考虑这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His plan seemed pretty sensible to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，他的计划似乎相当明智。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that, but I still can't accept killing her for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，但我还是不能接受为此而杀了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it's irrational, but I can't bear the thought of killing her just to save our skins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这很不理智，但我无法忍受为了保命而杀死她的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll never be safe for as long as she knows your secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要她知道你的秘密，你就永远不会安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would care. Please don't go that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会在乎的，请不要走那条路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's an annoying old bag. Who cares if she dies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个讨厌的老太婆，谁在乎她会不会死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right, we shouldn't kill her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，我们不应该杀她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Fine. Just, please remember what I said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，很好。只是，请记住我说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to talk to Arceus about it and explore our options
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要和阿尔克修斯谈谈，探讨我们的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about another solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们谈谈另一个解决方案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just tired of things being this way. It's like someone always has to get hurt for someone else to be happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是厌倦了这样的生活，就好像总有人要受伤才能让别人开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help. I'd prefer not to think about this ever again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助。我不想再想这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was either her, or you. Arceus did the right thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是她，就是你。阿尔克修斯做了正确的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I know you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，我知道你是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just different to see him do it. It's different when it's not some Profligate soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是看到他这么做感觉不一样。 如果不是某个浪荡子的士兵，那就不一样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just move on. I'd prefer not to think about this ever again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们继续吧。我不想再想这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quit whining. Arceus saved you from Legion punishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再抱怨了，阿尔克修斯把你从军团的惩罚中救了出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There never is, is there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 从来就没有，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help. I'd prefer not to think about this ever again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助。我不想再想这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was no right solution here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有正确的解决方案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're... you have problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你...你有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to discuss anything more with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想再和你讨论任何事情了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, you didn't enjoy that? I thought it was thrilling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你不喜欢吗？我觉得很刺激。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. 100 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，100第纳尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what you're talking about...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你在说什么...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes? Sorry, did I do something wrong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？抱歉，我做错什么了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I suppose I can exchange that for denarii with one of the caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，我想我可以和其中一个商队兑换第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about 500 caps? That's equivalent to 100 denarii, plus 25 more as a thanks for making it easy for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 500瓶盖怎么样？那相当于100第纳尔，再加25第纳尔，感谢你帮我解决了这个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I don't want your worthless trash money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不想要你那些没用的垃圾钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, would you take that in caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，你能把它换成瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Thank you, amicus. Now we'll never have to fear her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，谢谢你，朋友。现在我们再也不用害怕她了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have to worry about Iulia anymore. I killed her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用再担心尤利娅了，我杀了她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia? That nasty woman? How did she find out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅？那个讨厌的女人？她是怎么发现的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it doesn't matter as long as she doesn't talk. I'll be keeping an eye on her. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想只要她不说话就无所谓了，我会盯着她的。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave named Iulia was going to expose your secret, but I made sure she'll keep her mouth shut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫尤利娅的奴隶本来要揭发你的秘密，但我确保了她会守口如瓶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure? She loves to blab.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗？她喜欢说闲话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I'll just have to keep an eye on her. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我只能盯着她了。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have to worry about Iulia anymore. She won't say a word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不用再担心尤利娅了，她一个字也不会说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? A slave? How did she find out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？奴隶？她是怎么发现的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose it doesn't matter if she's dead. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想只要她死了就无所谓了。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave named Iulia was going to expose your secret. I killed her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫尤利娅的奴隶要揭发你的秘密，我杀了她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How dare you make accusations against me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你竟敢指控我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take this to my Decanus. No, I'll take it higher. The camp Centurion will hear about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把这个告诉我的什长。不，我要更高，营地里的百夫长会知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drop this now, or you will regret it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上放弃，否则你会后悔的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and Flemus can't keep your stories straight. What are you two plotting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和弗勒慕斯没法把故事讲连贯。你们两个在搞什么阴谋？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You lying whore!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个说谎的婊子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iulia! Face me, you bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利娅！面对我，你这个婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm excellent. Still sore from the beating they gave me, but otherwise, never been better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。他们打了我一顿，我还很痛，但除此之外，再好不过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got what I wanted, though. They're sending me to Dry Wells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我得到了我想要的。他们要送我去枯井。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not. Dry Wells is both a boring post and a dangerous one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。枯井是一个无聊又危险的岗位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate there is singleminded to a fault. I've heard stories of his skirmishes in the Gibraltar mountains. Bloodbath.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里的特使一意孤行犯了错误。我听说过他在直布罗陀山区的小规模战斗，大屠杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose I should just be happy they're not sending me to Dog Town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我应该庆幸他们没送我去狗镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, you have my thanks. Please keep an eye on Flemus for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我都要感谢你。请帮我照看一下弗勒慕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem happy about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来不太高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cottonwood Cove? That's excellent! I may make Veteran before the fight for the Dam even begins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 棉白杨湾？太好了！也许在大坝之战开始之前，我就能成为老兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus. I'm in your debt. But... before I go, may I ask one more favor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友，我欠你个人情。但是...我走之前，能再请你帮个忙吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please keep an eye on Flemus for me. He's a sensitive soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请帮我照看一下弗勒慕斯，他是个敏感的灵魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well. I'm off to pack my things. Until we meet again, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我要去收拾东西了。下次再见吧，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Syracuse said he'll reassign you to Cottonwood Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叙拉古说他会把你调到棉白杨湾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awful. But I got what I wanted, right? We got what we wanted. Iulia's accusations mean nothing now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟透了。但我得到了我想要的，对吧？我们得到了我们想要的，尤利亚的指控现在毫无意义了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least he's going somewhere safer than here. I was dreading the big battle, but I can breathe easier knowing he won't be on the front lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少他去了一个比这里安全的地方。我很害怕这场大战，但知道他不会上前线，我可以松口气了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, thank you. I don't know why you helped us, but it means the world to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，谢谢你。我不知道你为什么要帮我们，但这对我来说意义重大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awful. But I got what I wanted, right? We got what we wanted. Iulia's accusations mean nothing now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟透了。但我得到了我想要的，对吧？我们得到了我们想要的，尤利亚的指控现在毫无意义了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I'm going to worry about him. Cottonwood Cove is the front of the front lines. He's going to be cut off from everything out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会担心他。棉白杨湾是前线的前线，他会和外面的一切失去联系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, thank you. I don't know why you helped us, but it means the world to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，谢谢你。我不知道你为什么要帮我们，但这对我来说意义重大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The degenerate knows our tongue? Non es tam stultus quam expectavi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落者知道我们的语言？你没有我想的那么蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regardless, you are not allowed to enter the Magnum Chasma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，你都不能进入大裂谷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not if I cut your head off first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非我先把你的头砍下来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. Off. Degenerate. Your presence here is a spiritual rot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚，蛋。堕落者，你的出现是一种精神上的腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Magnum Chasma will not be defiled by the likes of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大峡谷不会被你这样的人玷污。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Animal veneratione dignum putat!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他认为这种动物值得尊重！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show *me* respect, dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尊重*我*，狗。
