ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. How about you show me some respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，你能不能放尊重点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmph.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Andronicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安德罗尼库斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see your Mark of Caesar. I will humor you if you have questions, but do not irritate me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到你的凯撒徽记了。如果你有问题，我会迁就你，但不要激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I think we got off on the wrong foot. I'm &PCName;
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我觉得我们一开始就有误会。我是&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then the feeling is mutual. Caesar may have given you his Mark, but I only see another degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么这种感觉是相互的。凯撒也许给了你他的徽记，但我只看到另一个堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will humor you if you have questions, but do not irritate me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有问题，我会迁就你，但不要激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't much impress me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你没什么印象。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your pathetic sheep bleatings do not move me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你那可怜的绵羊叫声打动不了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see your Mark of Caesar. I will humor you if you have questions, but do not irritate me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到你的凯撒徽记了。如果你有问题，我会迁就你，但不要激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no hostility. I address you as your better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是敌意，是用强者的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see your Mark of Caesar. I will humor you if you have questions, but do not irritate me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到你的凯撒徽记了。如果你有问题，我会迁就你，但不要激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the hostility?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么会有敌意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Growl! Bark! You can not scare me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫啊！吠啊！你吓不到我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, Legion scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，军团渣滓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think you are Legion? Do you think that Mark makes you like us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为你是军团吗？你觉得是徽记让你喜欢我们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are a Profligate. Remember it. Your proper place is in chains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个浪荡子，记住这一点，你应该被锁起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will humor you if you have questions, but do not irritate me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有问题，我会迁就你，但不要激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm no degenerate. I agree with Legion values.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是堕落者，我认同军团的价值观。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hahaha! Try me. We can make a ritual of it. Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, until Mars is pleased.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈哈！试试看。我们可以把它当成一种仪式，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，直到玛尔斯满意为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are a more respectable Profligate than most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是一个比大多数人都体面的堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask me the questions you have, then leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问我你想问的问题，然后离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think is stopping me from taking you apart and playing with your bones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为是什么阻止了我把你拆散玩你的骨头？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to ask you some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问你几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A canyon so large you can stand on one edge and not see the opposite side. One of Mars' natural splendors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个巨大的峡谷，你可以站在一边而看不到对面。玛尔斯的自然奇观之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the Magnum Chasma - birthplace of the Legion, and a holy site.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就是大裂谷——军团的诞生地，也是圣地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may not enter. You may not even lay eyes on it. The Magnum Chasma is off limits to the Dissolute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能进去，你甚至可能都看不到它。大裂谷是放荡者的禁区。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's through that gate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那扇门后面是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the origin of all creation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是万物的起源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Mars unleashed the Cleansing Fire, a great fissure in the Earth formed. The Magnum Chasma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当玛尔斯释放出“净化之火”时，地球上形成了一个巨大的裂缝。大裂谷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the Magnum Chasma, degenerates and savages lived in squalor. The savages did not know it, but they were waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大裂谷，堕落者和野蛮人生活在肮脏的环境中。野蛮人并不知道，但他们一直在等待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were waiting for Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在等待凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After many years of tribulation, Mars sent His son to the tribes of the Magnum Chasma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 经过多年的磨难，玛尔斯把他的儿子送到了大裂谷的部落面前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar brought them language, civilization, purpose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒给他们带来了语言、文明和目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are those tribes, united as one. One people, one history, and one mission - to purge the world of savagery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就是那些部落，团结一致。同一个民族，同一个历史，同一个使命——清除世界上的野蛮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes the Magnum Chasma holy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大裂谷为何神圣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only exceptions are envoys of the Great Southwest Confederacy, and even they must be accompanied by escort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的例外是大西南邦联的使节，即使他们也必须有护卫队陪同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. Surely I should be allowed through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，当然应该允许我通过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a nation from the northeast of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个位于亚利桑那东北部的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Weak and pathetic, the way all Dissolute nations are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 软弱可悲，所有放荡者的国家都是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Great Southwest Confederacy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大西南邦联是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those are the terms of the treaty signed at Window Rock. I do not question the order of things, nor should you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些是在温多罗克签署的条约的条款。我不质疑事物的秩序，你也不应该。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are they allowed into the Magnum Chasma?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么允许他们进入大裂谷？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only small groups. To get here, they must sail west on the Colorado and arrive at South Cove.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有小部分。要到达这里，他们必须沿着科罗拉多河向西航行，到达南湾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a journey meant for the Frumentarii, or Speculatores.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一段为特务或密探准备的旅程。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, the bulk of our soldiers are arriving from Kingman. Even the Colorado Legion arrives slowly through Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我们的大部分士兵都是从金曼过来的，就连科罗拉多军团也要通过金曼慢慢到达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius could be on Bright Angel Trail at this very moment, walking the same steps Caesar and the founding tribes walked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此时此刻，拉尼厄斯可能正在光明天使之路上，走着凯撒和创始部落走过的路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you see a lot of people passing through here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到很多人经过这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask the Maiden at the shrine down the road. She may have something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问问路那头神殿的女侍吧，她可能有事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Magnum Chasma Gatekeeper [0601A5AA] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有工作给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What gives you the gall to ask me personal questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你竟敢问我私人问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will answer only because you bear Caesar's Mark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我回答你是因为你身上有凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am from a vault. I was a little girl when we received the All-Clear Signal. With my family, we stepped out into the wastes. I remember feeling hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自一个避难所，当我们收到解除警报的信号时，我还是个小女孩，和我的家人一起，我们走进了废土。我还记得当时充满希望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But there is no hope in the wasteland. Raiders found my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但在这片废土上是没有希望的，掠夺者发现了我的族人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cried tears of joy when the Legion finally came and butchered my captors. I thought the Legion would take me. I hoped for it. I had no one left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团终于到来，把抓住我的人都杀了的时候，我流下了喜悦的眼泪。我以为军团会带走我，这是我所希望的，我已经没有亲人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Decanus only looked me in the eye and told me to "remember the justice" he had delivered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长只是看着我的眼睛，告诉我要“记住他所带来的正义”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps he thought I would be worthless to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他认为我对军团毫无价值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Oria [0600C44A] (mod) Quest : ([06013D34]AZFreeformNewt) 06013D34 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard some nosy young-blood barged their way into town recently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说最近有几个爱管闲事的年轻人闯进了镇上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep an eye out for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 留意他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't piss off Gila Monsters. Their venom wears you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别惹大毒蜥，它们的毒液会让你精疲力竭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes you easy lunch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让你成为轻松的午餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that King Ed's bald as an egg.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说爱德华国王秃顶了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd think a demigod like him would be able to grow more hair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为像他这样的半神应该能长出更多的头发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't drink Nuka Yellow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要喝核子黄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's lots of caves round these parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近有很多洞穴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whole lotta hidey-holes for good folks like us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像我们这样的好人有很多藏身之处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ol' Ripley mutters in his sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老雷普利在睡梦中喃喃自语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A guy like him's gotta have some ghosts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像他这样的人肯定有鬼魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Avoid that Satellite Array up the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 避开那边的卫星阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That place is on lock-down. Even the Legion avoids it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那地方被封锁了，就连军团也避开那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard they used to dump bodies in Lake Mead before the War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说战前他们经常把尸体扔在米德湖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think they still do that up by the fort?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他们还会在堡垒附近这么做吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that the Highway collapsed under the weight of King Ed's massive ego.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说高速公路被爱德华国王的自负压垮了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stay clear of the Cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远离邪教。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll know them when you see them. A bunch of crazy witches in fencing masks. Hard to miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见到他们就知道了，一群戴着击剑面罩的疯狂女巫。很难错过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's not as straight-edge as they claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团并不像他们说的那么正直。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turns out putting a skirt on a junkie doesn't fix their Jet craving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实证明给瘾君子穿裙子并不能解决他们对杰特的渴望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Horners round these parts are pretty pissy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一带的大角羊都很暴躁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out for scavengers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心拾荒者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In these parts, people get territorial looking for scraps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这些地方，人们争夺地盘，寻找残羹剩饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion don't care if they shoot you on-site. "Survival of the fittest".
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团才不管他们会不会当场击毙你，“适者生存”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion claims a lot more territory than they control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团占领的地盘比他们控制的要多得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From what I've heard, they mostly hold the roads and the valleys. The hills have all sorts of Tribes hiding just out of view.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，他们基本上守住了道路和山谷。山上隐藏着各种各样的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard the Legion don't use Power Armor because they can't figure it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说军团不使用动力装甲是因为他们搞不懂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too stupid to find the "on" button, I guess?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜是蠢到连开关都找不到吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone clogged the toilet with rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人用石头堵住了厕所。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They got a big bull statue down in Bullhead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在布尔海德有座大公牛雕像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it's from before the War! How ironic is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且还是战前的！是不是很讽刺？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man's real name is Jeremy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人的真名是杰里米。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you believe me if I told you I met him once? Nice guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我告诉你我见过他一次，你会相信吗？不错的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion don't wear anything under those skirts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的人不会在裙子下面穿任何东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must get breezy down there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下面一定很凉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard they got motorcycle chariots down South,
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说南方有摩托战车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds pretty impractical to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很不现实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR's stretched thin.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR捉襟见肘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any rumors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么传言？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many things. I was a supply runner for Haven, but my other duties have kept me busy as of late.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多事情。我是港湾的补给员，但最近因为其他工作忙得不可开交。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place is largely self-sufficient, but occasionally requires specialty items.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方基本上自给自足，但偶尔需要特殊物品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many of the people also want news of the outside world, and we have to be proactive in making sure that the Legion doesn't know we're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人也想知道外面世界的消息，我们必须积极主动的确保军团不知道我们在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about supply running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说物资运输的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We wear their garb and pretend to be Frumentarii. The rank-and-file are unable to ask questions, and the Frumentarii never know who is who.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们穿上他们的衣服，假装自己是特务。普通士兵不问问题，军团特务也不知道谁是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: By the time they check, we have taken what we required.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等到他们检查的时候，我们已经拿到了我们需要的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, this only works provided that we do not abuse it, and the last time I was up top was three weeks ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，只有在我们不滥用的情况下，这招才会起作用，而我最后一次使用是在三周前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you avoid the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如何避开军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, just me. Benjamin was injured and is recuperating, and the other one had a disagreement in which he nearly killed Murray, so he left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，只有我。本杰明受了伤，正在养伤，另一个因为意见不合差点杀了穆雷，所以他离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the other runners?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他选手是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tend to Cal, giving him company and watching his health. I also am in the process of deprogramming Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我照顾卡尔，陪伴他，关注他的健康。我也在对克渥斯进行反洗脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, my most important job is dealing with the ant attacks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我最重要的工作是对付蚂蚁的攻击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your other duties?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的其他职责是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a bartender now, but a friend from long ago. He became ill following a particularly bad night a long time ago, so I tend to him the best I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他现在是酒保，不过是很久以前的朋友。很久以前，他在一个特别糟糕的晚上生病了，所以我尽力照顾他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Frumentarius. He discovered this place before the Chainway collapsed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个军团特务，他在连环道坍塌前发现了这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I convinced the people here to spare him so that I might convince him to see the error of his ways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说服这里的人饶了他，这样我就能让他认识到自己的错误。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean by deprogramming Corvus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的反洗脑克渥斯是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a colony beneath us that went hostile five years ago. I'm not sure why, but the ants have been particularly aggressive for the past two months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们楼下有一个蚁群，五年前就开始敌对了。 我不知道为什么，但在过去的两个月里，蚂蚁的攻击性特别强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, it has something to do with the Chainway's collapse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，这与连环道的倒塌有关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ant attacks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 蚂蚁攻击？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poorly. He refuses to acknowledge his new life and believes that Caesar would reward him favorably for discovering this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很糟糕。他拒绝承认自己的新生活，并相信凯撒会因为他发现了这里而给予他丰厚的奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he is now a Profligate, the same as the rest of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，他现在是一个堕落者，和我们其他人一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that working out for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that is what you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这是你想要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was many things, but right now, I am a Ranger and the current leader of Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做过很多事，但现在，我是一名游骑兵，也是胡佛支援小队的现任队长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you before you came here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来这里之前是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that is what you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这是你希望的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. These days, I am its only active member.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。这些天，我是唯一活跃的成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're with Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是胡佛支援小队的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's treaty with the Arizona Rangers forced us to pull troops from the front against the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR与亚利桑那游骑兵的条约迫使我们从前线撤回部队对抗军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We left stay-behind units along the Colorado to prepare for our return with NCR reinforcements. As you can see, it has not gone well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在科罗拉多河沿岸留下了留守部队为我们未来的增援部队做准备。如你所见，进展并不顺利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说胡佛支援小队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were supposed to be. Cal and I chose these people to make up the unit with another Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们本来应该是。卡尔和我选择了这些人和另一个游骑兵组成一个小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The founding members of this community had helped us in the past. Bombs, smuggling, hiding, healing. But, only two of them chose to join, neither of whom are here anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个社区的创始成员曾经帮助过我们，炸弹、走私、藏匿、治疗。但是，只有两个选择加入，他们都已经不在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the only member? Isn't the rest of this place Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你一个成员？这里的其他人不是胡佛支援小队的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. He never wore the armor and apparently failed their test many times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。他从未穿过盔甲，而且显然多次未能通过测试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he had been living among them since before I was there. I consider him a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，在我来之前，他就一直生活在他们中间。我认为他是游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal was a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔是游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Resistance is never easy. It requires being able to throw away everything. These people could do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抵抗从来都不是一件容易的事，需要能够抛弃一切。这些人可以做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, it also requires that they believe they can win, and many of them do not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，这也需要他们相信自己能赢，而他们中的许多人并不相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, I wish that I could force them to join the unit at gunpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候，我希望我可以用枪逼着他们加入部队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Cal would never approve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但卡尔绝不会同意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't the rest of this place join Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这里的其他人不加入胡佛支援小队？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the south, perhaps. I would not know, though. I never had any contact with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是往南。不过，我不知道，我从未和他们有过任何联系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there other support units?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有其他支援小队吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not nearly enough. Our greatest victory was the rebellion at Big Stop during the First Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 远远不够。我们最大的胜利是第一次胡佛水坝战役期间在大站的反抗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We killed scores of the Legion's best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们杀了很多军团的精锐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop was liberated. It did not last, and the Legion returned one year ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站被解放了，但这并没有持续多久，一年前军团又回来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was another rebellion recently. It did not go well. Perhaps, we should have helped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近又发生了反抗，进展并不顺利。也许，我们应该帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what have you done to weaken the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你做了什么来削弱军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Terrorism? How can the cause of freedom and liberation be terrorism?
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怖主义？自由和解放的事业怎么会是恐怖主义呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can tell you that none of the people in Big Stop felt terror at what we did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以告诉你，大站没有人对我们的所作所为感到恐惧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because the Legion is brutal doesn't mean you should resort to terrorism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团很残忍并不意味着你应该诉诸恐怖主义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I plan. I do not have the resources or the time to do anything else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我计划着，我没有资源也没有时间做其他事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, if we can get this place back under control, I can do something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，如果我们能控制住这个地方，我还能做点别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你是怎么做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is correct. I was found by Cal in the year 2265. He and a few other Rangers managed to subdue me in the Corridor of the Sun, near old Casa Grande.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。我是在2265年被卡尔发现的，他和其他几个游骑兵在卡萨格兰德附近的太阳走廊成功制服了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They took me to their headquarters in Quartz Site, seeking information that only a Frumentarius like myself would possess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们把我带到阔茨赛特的总部，寻找只有像我这样的特务才会拥有的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to kill myself many times but was thwarted each attempt. For the next three weeks, I screamed at my captors, hurling insult upon insult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾多次试图自杀，但每次都失败了。在接下来的三个星期里，我对着抓我的人大喊大叫，辱骂对方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, I went quiet. For the next four months, Cal administered his knowledge to me. His knowledge of morality, of Caesar, of justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后，我就安静下来了。在接下来的四个月里，卡尔把他的知识传授给我，他对道德，对凯撒，对正义的了解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It took another week before I asked a single question: 'How can a civilization built on a lie have done so much good for the Wasteland, then?'
ESP.TRADUIT: 又过了一个星期，我才问了一个问题：“那么，建立在谎言之上的文明怎么能给这片废土带来这么多好处呢？”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was the beginning of my enlightenment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是我启蒙的开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are an old tribe. When I was a Legionary, I used to fear them as wraiths of Mars, sent down to cull the weak so the Legion would emerge stronger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是一个古老的部落。当我还是一名军团士兵的时候，我曾经把他们当作玛尔斯的幽灵，被派来淘汰弱者，让军团变得更强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are an astoundingly tough people, with millennia of collective survivalist knowledge and battlefield experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是令人惊讶的坚韧的人，拥有数千年的集体生存主义知识和战场经验。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Arizona Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说亚利桑那游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was not difficult. In many ways, they are similar to the Legion, but they are superior, for their meritocracy is broader and truly equal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并不难。在许多方面，他们与军团相似，但他们更优越，因为他们的精英统治更广泛，真正的平等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are bound by an ethos of personal freedom, martial excellence, brotherhood, justice and self-sacrifice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵们被个人自由、军事卓越、兄弟情谊、正义和自我牺牲的精神所束缚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And its ethos harnesses the most powerful idea of all: love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它的精神气质体现了最强大的理念：爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you switch from being a Legionary to a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么从军团士兵变成游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the most powerful emotion that can be displayed by humanity. It drives the human body, mind and soul to great heights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱是人类所能表现的最强大的情感，它驱使人的身体、思想和灵魂达到很高的境界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It creates life, nurtures the weak into the strong and brings so much beauty into the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱创造了生命，把弱者培育成强者，给世界带来了如此多的美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know what the perfect civilization is, but whatever it is, it must be driven by love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道完美的文明是什么，但不管是什么，它一定是由爱驱动的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's so special about love?
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱有什么特别的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, one day, a world united in love will become reality. I do not think we are there yet, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，有一天，一个在爱中团结的世界将成为现实。不过，我觉得我们还没到那一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A civilization built on love is not only possible but necessary for the Wasteland to become something greater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 建立在爱之上的文明不仅是可能的，而且是必要的，使废土变得更加伟大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the truth as I understand it. If you view otherwise, you are welcome to try and create something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我所理解的事实。如果你不这么认为，欢迎尝试创造其他东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds like idealistic hogwash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来像理想主义的废话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The path to becoming a Ranger was long and arduous, and I did not always possess the values they pushed me to have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 成为一名游骑兵的道路漫长而艰辛，我并不总是拥有他们灌输给我的价值观。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought that I had been reborn once in the Legion, but the Rangers shaped my life far more than they did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为我曾在军团中获得重生，但游骑兵对我人生的影响远远超过他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your enlightenment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的启蒙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was personally recognized by Caesar during the first pacification of Phoenix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一次平定凤凰城时，凯撒亲自认可了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sent me east, into the Llano Estacado to bring its settlements under Legion influence. I did so, befriending tribes and infiltrating towns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他派我往东，进入埃斯塔卡多平原把那里的居民纳入军团的控制之下。我这样做了，与部落交朋友，潜入城镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After three years, I returned to Pasorez, the great pass to the south with hundreds of slaves to serve in his war machine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三年后，我带着数百名奴隶回到了通往南方的重要关隘帕索雷兹，为他的战争机器服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On my return, I was ordered to raid the Great Southwest Confederacy. I burned an entire town alive for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，我奉命袭击大西南联盟。我为了他烧了整个镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the treaty with them was signed, the Legion was the uncontested power of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在与他们签订条约后，军团成为了亚利桑那州无可匹敌的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were a Frumentarius? Tell me about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是军团特务？跟我说说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Vulpes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得沃尔普斯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii do not have leaders. They report directly to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务没有领袖，他们直接向凯撒汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He must be a recent hire, but if he has obtained Caesar's approval this fast, then he must be very skilled indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他应该是最近才上任的。如果他这么快就得到了凯撒的认可，那他一定很有本事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the leader of the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是军团特务的领袖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were once the dominant power of Arizona. A union of tribes older than the War, older than America.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们曾经是亚利桑那州的主导力量。一个比战争还古老，比美国还要古老的部落联盟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar viewed them as the last major threat before facing the NCR. Decades of unifying 50 tribes under his banner to even establish a negotiating table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒把他们看作是面对NCR前的最后一个主要威胁。几十年来，他将50个部落统一在他的旗帜下，甚至设立了一个谈判桌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They surrendered, which is fascinating to me. I combed through their records after the treaty was signed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们投降了，这对我来说很有趣。条约签署后，我仔细查阅了他们的记录。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They could have beaten us. Even in their disunity, they were stronger than the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们本可以打败我们的。即使不团结，他们也比军团强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Great Southwest Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说大西南联盟吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers happened. They viewed the surrender of the confederacy as a sign that they had let the Legion get too strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵出现了。他们认为联盟的投降表明他们让军团变得过于强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the first few months, the Legion did not know what it was fighting. Entire camps would disappear over night, leaving scores of dead bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在最初的几个月里，军团并不知道自己在与什么战斗。整个营地会在一夜之间消失，留下几十具尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Salt River Valley erupted in rebellion, viewing this as a sign from Mars or their old tribal gods that they had told the Legion they had abandoned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 索尔特河谷爆发了叛乱，他们认为这是来自玛尔斯或他们古老部落神灵的征兆，他们已经告诉军团他们已经放弃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion was aflame for the next seven years, fighting the Rangers and their failures alike. They grew so strong in fear of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在接下来的七年里，军团燃烧着，与游骑兵和他们的失败作斗争。他们因为害怕游骑兵而变得如此强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they won. The Salt River Valley was again pacified, and the Rangers were forced to bring in the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们赢了。索尔特河谷再次被平定，游骑兵被迫引入NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened after Confederacy surrendered?
ESP.TRADUIT: 联盟投降后发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a common degenerate in the Salt River Valley. When the Legion was purifying the land, a Centurion took pity on me and allowed me to redeem myself in Caesar's eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是索尔特河谷一个普通的堕落者。当军团净化这片土地时，一位百夫长怜悯我，允许我在凯撒面前救赎自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the next three weeks, I was forced into sobriety. I screamed for days on end and begged for death. The Legion did not grant it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接下来的三个星期，我被迫戒酒。我连续尖叫了好几天，祈求死亡，军团没有同意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: During all of this, my superiors beat me over and over again. They screamed that I was weak and pathetic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这期间，我的上级一次又一次地殴打我，他们尖叫着说我软弱可怜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I awoke from my stupor, I looked and saw that I had no wounds. The Maiden told me that I had survived and that it was now time for my reeducation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我从昏迷中醒来，我看见我没有受伤。女侍告诉我，我活下来了，现在是我接受再教育的时候了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the next six months, I was taught the values I was to carry into the Wasteland in Caesar's name. After my rebirth, I was a new man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在接下来的六个月里，我学到了我将以凯撒的名义带入这片废土的价值观。重生之后，我是一个全新的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you join the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么加入军团的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He made the Legion. He cracked Arizona to his will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他创立了军团，他按照自己的意愿摧毁了亚利桑那。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He believes himself to be, or at least requires others to believe, that he is a god among men, sent down from Mars to give gifts of knowledge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他相信自己是，或者至少要求别人相信，他是人类中的神，被玛尔斯派来赐予知识的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a man, and his time on Earth grows short. He will not live to see his Legion crumble, and that is a most horrendous injustice he has inflicted on the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个人，他在地球上的时间不多了。他不会活着看到他的军团崩溃，这是他给世界带来的最可怕的不公正。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得凯撒怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius. The Frumentarii have been disseminating many false rumors, and it's difficult to seperate the truth from the legend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯。军团特务一直在散布许多虚假的谣言，很难将事实与传说区分开来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never knew the man personally. The name emerged after my time in the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我与这个人素不相识，这个名字是在我离开军团之后出现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I know is that he led the Colorado Campaign and is prepared to march across the dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我所知道的是，他领导了科罗拉多战役并准备越过大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do think of Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么看拉尼厄斯特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe the official story is that he was a member of tribe in New Mexico known as the "Hidebarks".
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信官方的说法，他是新墨西哥州一个被称为“海德希克”部落的成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I combed through entire warehouses of Confederate records. I found no trace of any such tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我翻遍了整个仓库的联盟记录，我没有发现任何这个部落的踪迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where you do think he comes from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他是从哪儿来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I had to guess, Lanius might be some new rank within the Legion following the failure of Joshua Graham.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要我猜的话，拉尼厄斯可能是约书亚·格雷厄姆失败后在军团里的新军衔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's supposition, though. Until Lanius is killed, we'll have no way of knowing for sure. Perhaps, not even then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，这只是一种假设。在拉尼厄斯被杀之前，我们无法确定。也许，即使到那时也不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, yes, but where do *you* think he comes from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，是的，但“你”认为他是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is civilization regressed. Its culture professes ideals of martial excellence, loyalty and justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是文明的倒退，它的文化主张卓越的军事、忠诚和正义的理想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is not possible to bring about those values through purely security measures. They need freedom to blossom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅仅通过安全措施是不可能实现这些价值的，需要自由才能开花。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This suppression will not survive the death of its master. Its shambolic corpse may march on for a decade, perhaps even two, but it has no future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种镇压在其主人死后将不复存在，其混乱的尸体可能会持续十年，甚至二十年，但它没有未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They offer nothing new, only a return to the culture of annihilation that ended the Old World. They are an ideological dead-end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们没有提供任何新的东西，只是回到了终结旧世界的毁灭文化。它们是意识形态上的死胡同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion offers many things that the Wasteland needs. Its values are good. It recognizes that justice, loyalty, brotherhood and sacrifice are needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团提供了许多废土需要的东西。它的价值观很好，它认识到正义、忠诚、兄弟情谊和牺牲是必需的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But its methods prevent such values from taking root in the world. The Legion uses fear, hatred and anger to enforce these values.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但它的方法阻止了这种价值观在世界上生根，军团利用恐惧、仇恨和愤怒来强化这些价值观。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But justice through fear is not justice at all, brotherhood without love is coercion, and sacrifice without meaning is a waste.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，通过恐惧实现的正义根本不是正义，没有爱的兄弟情谊是强迫，没有意义的牺牲是浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without those additional values, the Legion is forced to suppress human urges to enforce change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有这些额外的价值，军团就不得不压制人类强制变革的冲动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion offers strength and order. It's what the Wasteland needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团提供力量和秩序，这正是废土所需要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lie is nothing to be shamed of. Humans are not capable of building civilizations based on the truth. The great truths are veiled behind our own inadequecies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谎言没什么可羞耻的。人类没有能力建立基于真理的文明，伟大的真理被我们自己的不足所掩盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many people have been saved through lies and deception. The question is what does that lie promote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多人都是通过谎言和欺骗得救的，问题是这个谎言能促进什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's lie offers the values of justice, loyalty, brotherhood and sacrifice. Those are necessary for the Wasteland to rebuild into something greater.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的谎言提供了正义、忠诚、兄弟情谊和牺牲的价值观，这些都是废土重建的必要条件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the Legion's methods in service of that lie are not capable of bringing about those values in any form of permance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，军团为这个谎言服务的方法并不能带来任何形式的永久价值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These values have to be cultivated from within, not formed as the product of stripping away the negative facets of a man's nature.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些价值观必须从内在培养，而不是通过剥离一个人本性的消极方面而形成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion is an abomination built on lies. It offers nothing to the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是建立在谎言之上的可憎之物，对废土没有任何好处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion worships Caesar as a god. A divine, immortal and perfect being.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团把凯撒奉为神明，神圣、不朽、完美的存在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When that god dies, they will start to question whether he was a god at all, if Mars punished him for failure, what those failures were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当那个神死后，他们会开始质疑他到底是不是神，如果玛尔斯因为失败而惩罚他，那些失败是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They will look for new gods to fill the void as confusion seeps into their mind. And the Legion's rigid hierarchy will crumble as they come to different answers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当困惑渗入他们的头脑时，他们将寻找新的神来填补空白。当他们找到不同的答案时，军团僵化的等级制度将会崩溃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It will not happen at all at once, but the outcome is inevitable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不会一下子发生，但结果是不可避免的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure that's true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定那是不是真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, the Legion is dead, and they do not know it. Its corpse will march across the dam and probably take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，军团死了，而他们却不知道。它的尸体会穿过大坝，很可能会占领大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, what then? The Legion's corpse will attract vultures from within and without.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，那又怎样呢？军团的尸体会吸引来自内部和外部的秃鹫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's dead, so we'll see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒死了，我们拭目以待。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A difficult question. Who replaces Caesar as the head of Caesar's Legion? Who is worthy of taking on the mantle of a god?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个很难回答的问题。谁将取代凯撒成为凯撒军团的首领？谁配披上神的外衣？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's own values dictate that it must go to the strongest. The contest to determine who that is will destroy the Legion, blowing them into a thousand pieces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团自身的价值观决定了它必须去找最强大的人。这场决定谁是真命天子的比赛将摧毁军团，把他们炸成碎片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soon, he'll be a simple footnote in the dustbin of history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很快，他就会成为历史垃圾桶里的一个脚注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you think will replace him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为谁会接替他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not understand what is political about the Mojave's impending annihilation, but if you want to talk about something else, then by all means.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白莫哈维即将覆灭有什么政治意义，但如果你想谈别的，那就说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care about politics much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太关心政治。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A what? Oh, I have heard that term used before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个什么？我以前听人用过这个词。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raiding is an action, not an accurate descriptor of what I was. No, I was a degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 劫掠是一种行为，而不是对我的准确描述。不，我是个堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I preyed upon the weak and committed countless depravities in the name of pleasure and power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以快乐和权力的名义掠夺弱者，犯下了无数的恶行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Degenerate? Do you mean that you were a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落？你是说你曾经是个掠夺者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For years, I terrorized the Salt River Valley, doing damage to all I encountered. I killed, I pillaged, I tortured, I raped, I burned, I devoured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年来，我在索尔特河谷横行霸道，所到之处满目疮痍。我杀人，我抢劫，我折磨，我强奸，我焚烧，我毁灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I relished in my own power over the weak, and I inspired others to do the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我享受着自己凌驾于弱者之上的力量，并激励其他人也这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What type of depravities?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪种类型的堕落？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion beat new values into me. New values to suppress the degenerate flame within me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团给我灌输了新的价值观，新的价值观来压制我内心堕落的火焰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the Legion was never interested in snuffing out that flame, only in making sure that it burned at only their command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，军团对扑灭这团火焰从来都不感兴趣，他们只想确保火焰只在他们的命令下燃烧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You kill, torture, rape and devour at their command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在他们的命令下杀戮，折磨，强奸和毁灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was Cal who taught me how to use those values to snuff out that degenerate flame, and to make something new with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是卡尔教会了我如何用这些价值观来熄灭堕落的火焰，并用它创造出新的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The flame that consumed all was flame no longer. Its ashes were fertile ground for new values to grow and prosper under Cal's gentle guidance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吞噬一切的火焰不再是火焰。它的灰烬是肥沃的土壤，在卡尔的温和引导下，新的价值观得以成长和繁荣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was only then that I was reborn. My flame was no longer, replaced with a towering redwood of new values. That is how I became a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到那时，我才获得了新生。我的火焰已不复存在，取而代之的是一棵高耸的、具有新价值的红杉。我就是这样成为一名游骑兵的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did a person like you become a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样的人是怎么成为游骑兵的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want details.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道细节。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I cut out the hearts of husbands and forced their widows to cook them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我挖出了丈夫的心，强迫他们的遗孀把它煮了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I burned infants at the stake for ritual sacrifice and for simple amusement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把婴儿绑在木桩上烧死，作为祭祀和简单的娱乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I captured and enslaved children to be broken by other degenerates as they saw fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我俘获并奴役了一些孩子，让其他堕落的人按照他们认为合适的方式来伤害他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I violated the bodies of countless men and women, in every conceivable way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我侵犯了无数男人和女人的身体，用各种可以想象的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Through all of this, I was in a constant state of inebriation, pursuing euphoria upon euphoria.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这一切的过程中，我一直处于醉醺醺的状态，追求一种又一种的快感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will never be able to remember all of the damage I inflicted on the world. And, every night, in my dreams, I experience a new memory returning to the surface.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将永远无法记住我给这个世界造成的所有伤害。而且，每天晚上，在我的梦里，我都能体验到一种新的记忆浮现出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your crimes are unforgivable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的罪行不可饶恕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is not avoidable to do otherwise as long as I live. That is a simple, unavoidable truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我活着，就无法避免不这样做。这是一个简单而又无法回避的事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Until I receive my rightful execution at the hands of more civilized societies, the best I can do is to follow in the wake of my own disaster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我被更文明的社会合法处决之前，我能做的最好的事情就是紧跟我自己的灾难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I resolved long ago to do go ten acts of good for every act of evil I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很久以前就下定决心，每做一件坏事，就做十件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish to reach that threshold in which I've repaired the world more than broken it, but I have no expectation I ever will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望达到这样的境界：我修复了这个世界，而不是破坏了它，但我不指望自己能做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you live with yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是如何与自己相处的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could do better. I should have done better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以做得更好，我应该做得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's the best any of us can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是我们最好的选择了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That would be nice, but I do not think that is possible. My reborn life has been too short.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好，但我认为那不可能。我的重生太短暂了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know you haven't already reached it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道你还没做到呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish it was not so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a kind thing to say even if you are wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使你错了，这样说也是一种善意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think you've achieved it, and you just don't know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你已经做到了，只是你自己不知道而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Whatever image that conjures in your mind, I very likely did it. I had no limits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，无论你脑海中浮现出什么画面，都很可能是我干的。我没有限制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Violated? You mean...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 侵犯？你的意思是...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a difficult question. Children were very similar to adults in my mind at the time. They were all meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个很难回答的问题。在当时的我看来，孩子和成年人非常相似。他们都是肉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No limits? Even children?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有限制？即使是儿童？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not dodging the question. My memories of that time are incomplete, but I would not be surprised if I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是在回避这个问题。我对那段时间的记忆是不完整的，但如果我记得，我也不会感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I do not know the answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我不知道答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're dodging the question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在回避问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a good thing. I only wish I was strong enough to not resist should you resolve to bring me to justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是好事。 我只希望自己足够强大，如果你决心将我绳之以法，我就不会反抗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, I am not, and this community will likely wish to kill you for your rightful act of justice, for which I apologize if that is the route you choose to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，我不够，这个社区可能会因为你的正当行为而杀了你，如果你选择走这条路，我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've killed monsters like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀过像你这样的怪物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should not. Degeneracy is a self-destructive sickness and the sign of inferiority.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不应该这样。堕落是一种自我毁灭的疾病，是自卑的标志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you speak the truth, then understand that your life has no value to anyone, not to me, not to the world, not to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你说的是真话，那么你要明白，你的生命对任何人都没有价值，对我没有，对世界没有，对你自己也没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Such sickness can only be cured from within. Seek help so that others may help you cultivate it as you are clearly incapable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种病只能从内部治愈。寻求帮助，这样别人就可以帮助你培养它，因为你显然没有能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I approve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我赞成。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a broad word, and I struggle to see where raiders begin and end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个很宽泛的词，我很难看出掠夺者的起点和终点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do tribes that depend on raiding in the harsh winters count as raiders? Or NCR troops who cross the Colorado to kill, burn and loot Legion camps? Are they raiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在严寒的冬天依靠掠夺为生的部落算掠夺者吗？或者穿越科罗拉多去屠杀、焚烧和掠夺军团营地的NCR部队？他们是掠夺者吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I was a Ranger, I found that the people of the wastes didn't distinguish between who was raiding them, whether they be degenerate, tribe, army, refugee or thug.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我还是游骑兵的时候，我发现废土上的人根本分不清是谁在袭击他们，不管他们是堕落的人、部落的人、军队的人、难民还是暴徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any event, raiding was the least terrible thing I did in my time as a degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，抢劫是我堕落时做过的最不可怕的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do mean that raiding is a state of action? I've met lots of raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 劫掠是一种行为状态是什么意思？我见过很多掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not leave this place much, but I will answer what I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不常离开这里，但我会尽我所能回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于莫哈维的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know much about them, but my comrades did. Cal told me that he is from there, and the other hated them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太了解他们，但我的同志们知道。卡尔告诉我他是那里人，另一个讨厌他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spoke with soldiers at Camp Golf back before Hoover Dam, when the Mojave was much wilder. They seemed like good people, nothing like how they described.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在胡佛水坝之前，我在高尔夫营地和士兵们交谈过，那时的莫哈维更荒凉。他们看起来都是好人，一点也不像他们描述的那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was hard to believe that they could have made an all-devouring empire that annihilates all in its way, like how my comrades described.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很难相信他们会像我的战友们描述的那样，建立一个以自己的方式消灭一切的吞噬帝国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of my old comrades believed that he was the best hope for the Mojave. A man capable of standing up to the Legion and NCR like how the Rangers never could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一个老同志相信他是莫哈维的最大希望，他有能力对抗军团和NCR而游骑兵永远都做不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have my doubts. I think it is dangerous to rely on the plans and ambition of a single man, no matter how great his plans are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑。我认为依赖一个人的计划和野心是危险的，不管他的计划有多么伟大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is arrogant to assume that reality will automatically bend to your will alone. Reality is only bent by a force of thousands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 认为现实会自动屈从于你的意志是傲慢的，现实只会被千万人的力量所扭曲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he does not understand that, then he is already doomed to failure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他不明白这一点，那么他已经注定要失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the people who live here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得住在这里的人怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is the most recent arrival. If she had been here a decade ago, I would have asked her to join Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是最近来的。如果她十年前在这里，我会让她加入胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As it stands now, I do not think she is willing to take advice from the others, let alone orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就目前的情况来看，我认为她不愿意接受别人的建议，更不用说命令了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He would have made a fine Ranger. His character is excellent, even if his ideals are totally unrealistic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他本可以成为一名优秀的游骑兵。尽管他的理想完全不切实际，但他的性格是很优秀的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The world is going to need people like him to make important ideas into reality.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个世界需要像他这样的人把重要的想法变成现实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Benjamin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本杰明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have been together for a long time. Back before he called himself "Cal".
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在一起很长时间了，在他自称"卡尔"之前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has done so much for me, and I have always looked up to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他为我做了那么多，我一直很尊敬他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, these days, he is a good person who is far too hard on himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，这些天来，他是一个对自己太苛刻的好人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it is not. His old name is a dead one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是。他以前的名字已经死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But he has asked that I not refer to him with any of his old names, so I will respect his wishes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他要求我不要用他以前的名字来称呼他，所以我会尊重他的意愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Cal not his name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔不是他的名字？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was with the Rangers back then. He managed to get the drop on me and render me unconscious. I was taken to Quartz Site, their old headquarters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时候他还是游骑兵，他设法把我打倒，让我不省人事。我被带到阔茨赛特，他们的旧总部。
