ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He dedicated himelf to breaking my conditioning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他致力于打破我的习惯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you can see, he succeeded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所见，他成功了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you meet him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么认识他的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal blames himself for many things that simply are not in his control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔为许多他根本无法控制的事情自责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems to think that everything the Legion does is on his shoulders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他似乎认为军团所做的一切都是他的责任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean he's too hard on himself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说他对自己太苛刻是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told me that me that he knew Caesar long ago and had the opportunity to kill him but blinked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我，他很早就认识凯撒，有机会杀了他，但他眨眼了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would he think that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他为什么会这么想？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not think it is good for him to blame himself for everything terrible the Legion did without also taking credit for everything good it does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为他为军团所做的一切可怕的事情责怪自己，而不为军团所做的一切好的事情邀功是件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, isn't the Legion his fault, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，军团不是他的错吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many things. They enforced restraint where none existed before. They purged Arizona of degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多事情。他们在以前没有约束的地方实行了约束，他们肃清了亚利桑那的堕落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many towns have destroyed by the Legion, but many others thrive under their leadership.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多城镇被军团摧毁，但也有许多城镇在他们的领导下繁荣起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even those who oppose the Legion often find themselves united in the common goal of fighting a shared enemy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使是那些反对军团的人也经常发现他们为了共同的目标团结在一起，对抗共同的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, too, have been shaped by them. Without them, the Rangers would have killed me as a common degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，也是，被他们塑造的。如果没有他们，游骑兵会把我当成一个普通的堕落者杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What good things did the Legion do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团做了什么好事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That it does. Caesar is not a god, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。不过，凯撒不是神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it takes a lot of courage to kill a god.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，杀死一个神需要很大的勇气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That it does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it takes a lot of courage to kill a dictator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，干掉一个独裁者需要很大的勇气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔的事到此为止。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a Legionary. He is hated here. More than that, he is a Frumentari. He believes in the Legion even when Caesar has granted him the opportunity not to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一名军团士兵，他在这里被人憎恨。更重要的是，他是军团特务。他相信军团，即使凯撒给了他不相信的机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I was in that position once, so I know it is possible for him to be pulled out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我曾经处于那种境地，所以我知道他有可能被拉出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He believes that anyone can overcome anything if they are willing to adapt. An important step on the path to enlightenment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他相信，只要愿意适应，任何人都可以克服任何困难。这是开悟之路上的重要一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not comfortable around babies or children. But, she will grow up to be a good kid, I am sure of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和婴儿或孩子在一起不舒服。但是，她会成长为一个好孩子，我确信这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊芙琳娜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I used to eat them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我以前经常吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why aren't you comfortable with children?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和孩子在一起为什么不舒服？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell? That's disgusting!
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？太恶心了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have done my best to purge that knowledge from my memory, but I unfortunately know that they taste better when smoked instead of salted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经尽我最大的努力将这些知识从我的记忆中抹去，但我不幸地知道，烟熏的味道比盐腌的更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cannibal] What do they taste like?
ESP.TRADUIT: [食人族]是什么味道的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I did not have to. That is why I don't want to be around them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我没必要这么做。所以我才不想和他们在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Ghastly Scavenger] You do what you have to.
ESP.TRADUIT: [恐怖食尸人]做你该做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand the discomfort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解这种不安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I...see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我...明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you feel that is productive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你觉得这样做有成效的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not really any of my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More than most, his life has been shattered by someone imposing their will on him. I empathize.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比大多数人更严重的是，他的生活被某人强加于他的意志所破坏。我感同身受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A competent administrator with a pleasant persona. However, he is totally lacking in character or restraint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个有能力的、和蔼可亲的管理者。然而，他完全缺乏个性和克制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should he continue his present ways, he will become little more than a degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他继续这样下去，他就会变成一个堕落的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told me that he considers me a friend, but I am not convinced the feeling's mutual. He cares more about a person's ideals rather than their character.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我他把我当成朋友，但我不确定这种感觉是相互的。他更关心一个人的理想而不是他们的品格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any event, he is one of the few people here who chooses to spend time with me, so he must enjoy our conversations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，他是这里为数不多的愿意花时间和我在一起的人，所以他一定很享受我们的谈话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a good person. I does not like me, but I cannot blame him for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好人。我不喜欢我自己，但我不能因此责怪他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He keeps Haven safe, and that is the important thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他保护着港湾的安全，这才是最重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She wanted to join Support Unit Hoover, but I vetoed it. Too young, too untested, too ambitious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她想加入胡佛支援小队，但我否决了。太年轻，未经考验，太有野心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe one day though. Her father raised her well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许有一天吧，她父亲把她抚养得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was an excellent farmer but fatalistic about Haven's chances and very paranoid about Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是一个优秀的农民，但对港湾的命运持宿命论态度，对约伯也非常偏执。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fear that when she wakes, she will do something drastic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我担心她醒来后，会做些过激的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What she did to Job was terrible. I only hope that she will find the strength to live with her failure and to do better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她对约伯的所作所为太可怕了。我只希望她能找到面对失败的勇气，做得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Wierzbowski [0601B97E] (mod) Quest : ([0601B981]AZWierzbowskiDialogue) 0601B981 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really see how that's any of your business, but you'll probably be here a while, so it's whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道这和你有什么关系，但你可能要在这里待一段时间，所以无所谓了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a drug dealer, a two-bit punk in Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个毒贩，在大站的小混混。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't like drug dealers, so here I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不喜欢毒贩，所以我在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Already told you I was a drug dealer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉过你我是个毒贩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a friend in the Arizona Rangers who was nursing an addiction to Med-X. Sold him Fixer at low prices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个朋友在亚利桑那游骑兵服役，他对吗啡针-X上瘾了，把瘾头解低价卖给了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After he went clean, the Rangers asked if I could sell medicine instead of drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他戒毒后，游骑兵问我能不能卖药而不是毒品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agreed to give them a bunch of the good stuff in exchange for them ignoring the bad stuff I was giving the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意给他们一堆好东西，以换取他们无视我给掠夺者的坏东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't see a Ranger for years after that, but apparently they were fighting the Legion that whole time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后我很多年都没见过游骑兵了，但很明显他们一直在和军团作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they came back, they were looking for people to join Support Unit Hoover. That wasn't for me, so I told them no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们回来的时候，他们正在寻找加入胡佛支援小队的人。那不适合我，所以我拒绝了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I couldn't take a chance that the Legion wouldn't find out, so I came here instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我不能冒着被军团发现的风险，所以我来了这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up here specifically? Everyone else here seems more talkative than you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是怎么到这里来的？这里的每个人似乎都比你健谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a friend in the Arizona Rangers who was nursing an addiction to Med-X. Sold him Fixer at low prices.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个朋友在亚利桑那游骑兵服役，他对吗啡针-X上瘾了，把瘾头解低价卖给了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After he went clean, the Rangers asked if I could sell medicine instead of drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他戒毒后，游骑兵问我能不能卖药而不是毒品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agreed to give them a bunch of the good stuff in exchange for them ignoring the bad stuff I was giving the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意给他们一堆好东西，以换取他们无视我给掠夺者的坏东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't see a Ranger for years after that, but apparently they were fighting the Legion that whole time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后我很多年都没见过游骑兵了，但很明显他们一直在和军团作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they came back, they were looking for people to join Support Unit Hoover. That wasn't for me, so I told them no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他们回来的时候，他们正在寻找加入胡佛支援小队的人。那不适合我，所以我拒绝了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I couldn't take a chance that the Legion wouldn't find out, so I came here instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我不能冒着被军团发现的风险，所以我来了这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up here specifically?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底是怎么到这里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: About a decade. I'm one of the original people that found this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约十年了，我是最早发现这个地方的人之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray, Ripley, Benjamin, his daughter, Wally, Doc and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷、雷普利、本杰明、他女儿，沃利，道格和我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Support Unit Hoover was kind of in-and-out, so I don't really count them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛支援小队的人都是进进出出的，所以我不把他们算进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who were the original people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最早的人有谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guard this gate. Make sure there's no intruders. If there are, I sound the alarm and bring everyone out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我守着这扇门，确保没有入侵者。如果有，我就拉响警报，把所有人都叫出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The place is a death trap, so unless you're being escorted by a runner, you usually end up dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方是个死亡陷阱，所以除非有偷运人护送，否则你通常都会死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that a difficult job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这工作难吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just you and that Corvus asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你和克渥斯那个混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there many intruders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有很多入侵者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are there many intruders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有很多入侵者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Snuck in during one of my coffee breaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 趁我喝咖啡休息的时候溜进来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski caught him and begged us not to kill him. God, that was such a shitshow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基抓住了他，求我们不要杀他。天啊，那真是一场闹剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd Corvus get in here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯是怎么进来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only obligation I have is protecting this place from intruders. Keep it nice and safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的职责就是保护这个地方不受外来者入侵，保持它的完好和安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have time for any fancy ideas beyond that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有时间去想那些稀奇古怪的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your thoughts on the Mojave? On the outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对莫哈维有什么看法？在外面？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I've heard that one before. The Rangers told us they'd be back with reinforcements and that we wouldn't have to hide no more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这句话我听过。游骑兵告诉我们他们会带着援兵回来，我们就不用再躲起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was a decade ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是十年前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, they told us that the NCR was crossing the dam for real and had beaten the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，他们告诉我们NCR真的越过大坝了，并且打败了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the Rangers thought there was something wrong and told us to stay low. The NCR stopped at Big Stop and went no further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个游骑兵觉得不对劲，叫我们保持低调。NCR在大站停了下来，没有再往前走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, forgive me if I don't believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，请原谅我不相信你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR's going to cross the dam, so maybe you can come out again.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR要穿过大坝了，所以也许你可以再出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it bothers me, but if they decide to go full force and storm this place, then there's not a whole lot of hell I can do about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，这让我很困扰，但如果他们决定全力以赴袭击这个地方，那我就没办法了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll shoot any skirt that comes through until I'm dead, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，只要是穿裙子的进来，我就开枪，直到我死为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's coming. Doesn't that bother you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团要来了，你不担心吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll tell it to you straight. Everyone here is a preachy asshole or an incompetent fuckup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我就直说了。这里的每个人都是爱说教的傻逼或者无能的混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal's a drunk, Murray gets high on the mushrooms, Ripley never shuts the hell up, Benjamin whines about the NCR, and Sharky's a nervous wreck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔是个酒鬼，穆雷嗑蘑菇嗑嗨了，雷普利总是闭不上嘴，本杰明成天抱怨NCR，还有沙尔基神经兮兮的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't even get me started on Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更别提维尔茨波夫斯基了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only people I like are Doc, Serwa and that Ahote girl. Serwa's a good worker, and the others leave me the hell alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只喜欢道格，瑟尔瓦和那个叫阿霍特的女孩。瑟尔瓦是个好员工，其他人都离我远点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got questions about the people here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这里的人有些疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never liked him. I like him less since he murdered Wally. And I didn't like Wally, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来就不喜欢他。自从他杀了沃利，我就不那么喜欢他了，而且我也不喜欢沃利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mutie was a loose cannon, and we should have told him to leave when he found this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个变种人是个失控的大炮，他发现这里时我们应该让他离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dude's a freak. He's a cannibal and a rapist. I'm fucking amazed they let someone like that in the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这家伙是个怪胎，他是个食人族和强奸犯。我真他妈惊讶，他们居然让这样的人加入游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And, he wants to act like he's a changed man, all high and mighty? Give me a break.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，他还想装出一副痛改前非、趾高气扬的样子？ 饶了我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong with Wierzbowski?
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sold drugs and occasionally had to beat people up to get paid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我卖毒品，偶尔不得不打人来赚钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a world of difference between that and slaughtering an entire family for fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这和为了好玩而屠杀整个家庭是完全不同的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't you use to be a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前不是掠夺者吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I mean, her crying's annoying, but she's a baby, so it's whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，她哭起来很烦人，但她还是个婴儿，所以无所谓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Evelina?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那伊芙琳娜呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, she's a good girl. Real go-getter. I like her more than her daddy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，她是个好女孩，真是个能干的人。比起她爸爸我更喜欢她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She never complains about dumb shit and is generally very nice to be around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她从不抱怨愚蠢的事情，而且通常很好相处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ruce [0601B97B] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, no one else calls this place 'Freihafen'. Not even my daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，没人叫这个地方“弗赖哈芬”，连我女儿也不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means 'free haven' in my native tongue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我的母语中，它的意思是“自由港”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't heard anyone else call this place Freihafen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没听过别人叫这地方弗赖哈芬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from Snake Mountains. They speak Germanic up there. Came down here a long time here a long time, and now I'm here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自蛇山，那里的人说日耳曼语。我来这里很久很久了，现在我在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really sure where it came from, but my grandparents told me that it's older than the War, older than even America.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定它来自哪里，但我的祖父母告诉我，它比战争还要古老，甚至比美国还要古老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen it written on 9mm ammo basically everywhere in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在9毫米弹药上见过这些字，基本上到处都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They must have been skilled engineers. Or warmongers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一定是熟练的工程师，或者战争贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your native tongue? Are you a tribal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的母语是什么？你是部落民？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really sure where it came from, but my grandparents told me that it's older than the War, older than even America.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定它来自哪里，但我的祖父母告诉我，它比战争还要古老，甚至比美国还要古老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen it written on 9mm ammo basically everywhere in the wastes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在9毫米弹药上见过这些字，基本上到处都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They must have been skilled engineers. Or warmongers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一定是熟练的工程师，或者战争贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Germanic again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再跟我说说日耳曼语。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's peaceful, far away from the war with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很和平，远离与军团的战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard that the NCR recently offered my old hometown town their protection. It's amazing that they'll do that for a town as far away as that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说NCR最近向我的家乡提供了保护。他们会为这么远的一个小镇做这种事，真是太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only a matter of time before they come and save this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们迟早会来拯救这里的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Snake Mountains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说蛇山。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I left home at a young age. I was always pretty restless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很小就离开了家，我总是很不安分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had an argument with my family and ended up coming down here. I had an uncle in Peach Springs. After he died, I took over his business and worked for one of the Tall Pines caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和家人发生了争吵，最后来到了这里。我有个叔叔住在桃泉，他死后，我接手了他的生意，在高松的一个商队工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to Arizona?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么来亚利桑那的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was pretty nice. The Tall Pines were good bosses, and I got to see a lot of the Wasteland with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很不错。高松的老板都很好，我和他们一起见识了很多废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I married one of the merchants I protected, and we settled down in Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和我保护的一个商人结了婚，在金曼定居下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it like being a caravaneer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当一名商旅是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marguerite died. Placental abruption during birth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛格丽特死了，分娩时胎盘早剥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa survived, but she did not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦活了下来，但她没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's your wife now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你妻子现在在哪儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's nice of you to say. I came to peace with that a long time ago. Every day, ich bin dankbar that I knew Marguerite. Uh, 'I'm thankful', sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能这么说真是太好了。我很久以前就接受了，每一天，我都很高兴我认识玛格丽特，呃...我都很感激，抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I owe it to her to raise Serwa right and to make as many new memories with her as possible before I meet her in the great hereafter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了她，我应该好好抚养瑟尔瓦，在我来世与她重逢之前，尽可能多的与她创造新的回忆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这个消息我很难过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ja, I want to talk about something else, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵，我也想说点别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa. She's an angel on earth. I brought her with me to Freihafen when this place was just a cave to hide in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦，她是人间天使。我带她来自由港的时候这里还只是个藏身的洞穴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's just like her mother, real headstrong. I can't blame her for wanting to leave this place and see the world, but I have to keep her safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她就像她妈妈一样，非常固执。我不能怪她想离开这个地方去见见世面，但我必须保证她的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's your daughter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你女儿是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day, it'll be up to her. I wish it were now. But, with the Legion rolling through the region, I'd just be sending her to her death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总有一天，决定权在她。我希望是现在，但是军团在这片区域横行，我只会让她去送死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've already lost someone important to me before. There is no way I'm letting that happen again. When the NCR comes and cleans this place up, then she'll be good to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经失去过对我很重要的人了，我绝不会让这种事再次发生。等NCR来把这里清理干净，她就可以走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, you should let her choose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，你应该让她选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'd hope not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't argue with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一点毋庸置疑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It can be if you want it to be, but maybe that's for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意，可以这样，但也许这样是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's none of my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She doesn't hate me, I know that. She's just frustrated about how we're all stuck she. She's getting to the age that I was when I left home for Arizona and began seeing the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不恨我，我知道。她只是对我们被困在这里感到沮丧，她已经到了我离开家去亚利桑那开始见世面的年纪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I grew up in beautiful mountains as far as the eye could see. She grew up in a cave. It isn't fair, and I know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在一望无际的美丽群山中长大，她在一个山洞里长大。这不公平，我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you get along with your daughter beyond that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，你和你女儿相处得好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题要问你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I call it 'Freihafen', but no one else does like I've said. The place doesn't really have a name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我叫它“自由港”，但没别人这么叫。这地方其实没有名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers set it up for us a decade ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵十年前把我们安排在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They promised us that they would return with NCR reinforcements, and we just have to believe in them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们向我们承诺会带着NCR的援军回来，我们只要相信他们就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I do. The Rangers promised, and Rangers always keep their promises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。游骑兵承诺过，而且他们总是信守诺言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And more importantly, the Rangers always won. They'll do so again, I'm sure of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 更重要的是，游骑兵总是赢。他们还会这样做的，我敢肯定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really think the NCR's going to save you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真觉得NCR会来救你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers were strategically regrouping and summoning extra support.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵正在进行战略重组，并召集额外的支援。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not denying that the Legion's tough, but one Ranger is worth a hundred Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不否认军团的强悍，但一个游骑兵抵得上一百个军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the NCR flag is raised over Dolan Springs, we'll all be safe again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当NCR的旗帜在多兰泉升起的时候，我们就都安全了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Rangers were winning against the Legion, then how come you had to hide away here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然游骑兵赢了军团，那你为什么要躲在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe you. The NCR has emerged as the most powerful nation in Wasteland since the War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你。NCR已经成为战争之后废土上最强大的国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are best fighters on the planet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是世界上最好的战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Between them, nothing in the Wasteland can stop them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他们之间，废土的一切都无法阻挡他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've worked in the NCR for years. I know how they work. They're not coming to help you anytime soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在NCR工作了很多年，我知道它们是怎么运作的。他们短期内不会来帮你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... wasn't expecting that response to be honest. It's a rare opinion down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...没想到你会这么坦诚，在这里很少见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in the NCR because I believe in the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信NCR，因为我相信游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It just seems that no one else does, and I can't understand it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是好像没有人知道，我无法理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because, if the Rangers were wrong, then there is simply nothing to believe in anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为，如果游骑兵队错了，那就没什么可相信的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. The NCR is coming to save you and soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，NCR很快就会来救你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't need luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That makes you a real oddity down here. Kind of refreshing if I'm honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里真是个怪人。说实话，还挺新鲜的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really have any strong opinions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的没有什么强烈的意见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's cold and damp, but it's safe. Well, safer than the rest of the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里又冷又潮，但很安全。比废土的其他地方都安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll admit that things have been going pretty badly for the past several months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我承认在过去的几个月里情况一直很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I never imagined that a murder would happen here. A Frumentarius agent found us a couple of months ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我从没想过这里会发生谋杀案。几个月前，一个军团特务的间谍找到了我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there have been ant attacks ever since then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后就一直有蚂蚁袭击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We just have to survive long enough for the NCR to come back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只要撑到NCR回来就行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's home. A good one. One day, it won't be anymore, and I look forward to that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是家，一个不错的家。总有一天，它将不复存在，我期待着那一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are looking up. Freihafen hasn't been doing so well since before the Legion came back to Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 情况正在好转。自从军团回到大站后，自由港的状态一直不太好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have my thanks, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a supply runner, or I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是补给员，或者曾经是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was injured last time I was up top. Doc told me to take it easy for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上次我在上面受伤了，道格让我放松一段时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As much as I don't want to admit, I'm getting old, so I have to stop pushing myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我不想承认，但我已经老了，所以我必须停止逼迫自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it was stupid. I tried to help someone that maybe I shouldn't have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，太蠢了。我试着帮了一个也许我不该帮的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went off half-cocked and without permission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有经过允许就擅自行动了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The person wasn't happy when I told him. He attacked me in anger and ran away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我告诉他的时候，那个人很不高兴。他生气的袭击了我，然后跑掉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you get injured?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么受伤的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare parts, medicine, ammo, the occasional gun. This and that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 零件，药品，弹药，偶尔还有枪。瞎忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't need that much, so we don't have to go up top very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不需要那么多，所以我们不需要在上面做太多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What supplies did you get?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得到了什么补给？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back to other things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 回到其他事情上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's a Wasteland. The Mojave Wasteland's a little better than most, but it's still very dangerous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是一片废土。莫哈维废土比大多数地方都好一点，但仍然很危险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, it amazes me that so many people fight to be king of the trash heap.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候，让我惊讶的是，这么多人争着成为垃圾堆之王。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the world outside this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方外面的世界怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The best hope for the Wasteland. They promise an end to chaos and the establishment of a democratic state where everyone can feel connected again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废土的最大希望。他们承诺结束混乱，建立一个每个人都能再次感受到联系的民主国家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are exactly what the Wasteland needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们正是废土所需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's great to hear someone else think that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到别人这么想真是太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can agree with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On that, we'll have to disagree.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这一点上，我们有不同意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure if the NCR is the Wasteland needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定NCR是不是废土需要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Degenerate? What are you, a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落？你是什么，军团士兵？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR has it's problems, sure, but 'degenerate?' I don't believe that.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR当然有它的问题，但是“堕落”？我不相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is a degenerate-ridden hole.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR是一个堕落丛生的空洞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's strange, but if that's what you wanted to know, then now you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很奇怪，但如果这就是你想知道的，现在你已经知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just asking what you think. I don't really care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想问问你的看法，我真的不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the personification of evil. And they will die, even if it takes them a while. I don't have much else to say on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是邪恶的化身，他们会死的，即使需要一段时间。关于这一点，我没有太多要说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He runs New Vegas, but I don't know much else beyond that. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他掌管着新维加斯，但除此之外我就不知道别的了。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, she's wonderful. My pride and joy. She shouldn't be alive, the doctors said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，她太棒了，我的骄傲和快乐。医生说她应该活不了多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, here she is. She's a miracle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，她还在，她是个奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if we have our differences these days, she will grow up to be a wonderful woman. I couldn't be prouder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使我们现在有一些分歧，她也会成长为一个很棒的女人。我感到无比自豪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Her mother died during childbirth. A placental abruption at the worst possible time. Serwa had to be removed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她的母亲死于分娩。在最糟糕的时候发生胎盘早剥，瑟尔瓦必须被移除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The doctors tried to stop the building, but they didn't succeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生们试图阻止分娩，但没有成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa was deprived of oxygen for nine seconds.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦缺氧了9秒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the doctors managed to surf her just in time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，医生及时帮她肺表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why shouldn't she be alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么她不能活多久？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I do not. I would prefer that you never ask that question ever again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没有。我希望你永远不要再问这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you blame her for your wife's death?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把你妻子的死归咎于她？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nein, tue ich nicht, I told you to not bring it up again. Arschloch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没有。我告诉过你不要再提这件事，混蛋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you blame her for your wife's death?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把你妻子的死归咎于她？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The doctors told me that it's called 'surfactant'. I think it helps the lungs expand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生告诉我这叫做“肺表面活性物质”，我觉得这有助于肺部扩张。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surf? What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 肺表？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what the doctors said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生是这么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, medical surfactant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，医用表面活性剂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sicher, let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实，我们谈点别的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这里的人怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's new and keeps to herself, so I haven't gotten much time to know her. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是新来的，不太合群，所以我没多少时间了解她。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems depressed all the time. I tried to cheer him up by telling him that the NCR would be here soon, but he just stared at me and then called me an idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他似乎一直很沮丧。我试图让他高兴起来，告诉他NCR很快就会来，但他只是盯着我，然后说我是白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he hates everyone here and wants to kill them. Wierzbowski thinks that he can change him, but I'm not so sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他讨厌这里的每一个人，想杀了他们。维尔茨波夫斯基认为自己可以改变他，但我不太确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's quiet and keeps to himself, but he's been healing up the cuts and scratches of everyone here for years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很安静，独来独往，但多年来他一直在为这里的每个人疗伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's my granddaughter. I can't wait to help raise her with Serwa. I've never been a grandfather before, and I can't wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我的孙女。我等不及要和瑟尔瓦一起抚养她了，我从来没有当过祖父，我等不及了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa and I might have our differences, but she's letting me help take care of her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦和我可能有分歧，但她让我帮忙照顾她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This whole place will help raise her. Ripley's promised to be her teacher. Murray's promised to devote time with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这整个地方都能帮她长大。雷普利答应做她的老师，穆雷承诺会花时间陪她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know I'm not well-liked here, but it warms my heart to know that they'll help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我在这里不太受欢迎，但知道他们会帮助我，我的心很温暖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊芙琳娜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a difficult person to work with even before Wally was killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在沃利被杀之前，他就是个很难共事的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is trying to be a good person, but trying might not be enough for anybody here anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在努力做一个好人，但对这里的所有人来说，光努力可能还不够。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't hate him, though. He tried his damnedest to keep his temper when near Evelina. He hates when she cries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我并不讨厌他。当他接近伊芙琳娜时，他尽了最大的努力控制自己的脾气，他讨厌她哭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone here will tell you that he's a deadbeat. I'm going to tell you that they're wrong, and it's not because he's the father of my grandchild.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的每个人都会告诉你他是个游手好闲的人。我要告诉你们，他们错了，这并不是因为他是我孙女的父亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray isn't stupid. He always knows exactly what he needs us to bring him when me and Wierzbowski go up top.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷不傻。当我和维尔茨波夫斯基上去的时候他总是很清楚需要我们带什么给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's amazing that this place hasn't torn itself apart. That's because of him, not in spite of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方还没有分崩离析真是太神奇了。那是因为他，尽管不是他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we don't get along. He's told to my face that I am hopeless, idealistic moron just because I believe in the word of the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们合不来。他当着我的面说我是一个绝望的、理想主义的白痴，就因为我相信游骑兵的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Words have power, especially when they come from the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 话语是有力量的，尤其是来自游骑兵的话语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told me that he was a teacher and a free thinker. I don't understand how he doesn't realize that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我，他是一名教师，也是一名自由思想家。我不明白他怎么没意识到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's always in a bad temper, but he does his job. I think the stress is getting to him. Poor guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的脾气总是很坏，但他能做好他的工作。我觉得他压力太大了，可怜的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's to say? She's my angel. My pride and joy. She will make a great mother, I just know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么可说的？她是我的天使，我的骄傲和快乐。她会成为一个伟大的母亲，我知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was nice. Highstrung, but nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她人很好。有点紧张，但很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's done some terrible things in the past. I don't know if he's really turned over a new leaf, but the question I ask myself often is whether I would trust him to be around my daughter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他过去做过一些可怕的事情。我不知道他是否真的有改过自新，但我经常问自己的问题是，我是否会信任他在我女儿身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The answer I keep coming to is yes, so maybe he has.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不断想到的答案是肯定的，所以也许他有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Benjamin [0601B97D] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's enough about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就到此为止吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, uh, I already told you I'm the town administrator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经说过了，我是小镇的管理员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That means I check and make sure that we have enough food and water and everything else to function down here, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这意味着我要检查并确保我们有足够的食物和水以及其他一切维持这里正常运转所需的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I also try to keep the place together. We've got to stick together, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也试着让这个地方保持稳定。我们必须团结一致，知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, uh, yeah. I can't be too pushy about not letting people have stuff because that's too much, uh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，呃，是的。我不能太咄咄逼人地不让别人拿东西，因为那样太过分了，呃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Centralization, that's the word!
ESP.TRADUIT: 集权化，就是这个词！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can't also just let take them take stuff when I'm not there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我也不能让他们在我不在的时候拿走东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, it's really hard to keep track of everything, and I, uh, have to run around for most of the day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，要把每件事都记录下来真的很难，而且我，呃，一天中的大部分时间都得跑来跑去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that a difficult job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这工作难吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Medicine, mostly. Fixer. Spare parts. Bits of electronics. Ammo. Gun parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 主要是药物，瘾头解。备用零件、一些电子元件、弹药、枪支配件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lots of stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What supplies do you usually need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你通常需要什么物资？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, uh, I was always good with numbers and inventories and stuff, so I volunteered back when this safe place was founded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，呃，我一直很擅长数字和库存之类的东西，所以在这个安全的地方成立之初，我就自告奋勇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you become administrator?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为管理员的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is our little easy town. The Rangers found it for us a decade ago and promised to keep us safe until they returned with reinforcements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们安逸的小镇。游骑兵十年前为我们找到了它，并承诺在增援部队回来之前保护我们的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Rangers haven't returned, and so we're stuck here. There's not much point worrying about the Legion, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，游骑兵还没回来，所以我们被困在这里了。不过担心军团也没多大意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they come in and here and kill us, then we're screwed, so we might as well make the most of the situation and just take it easy, brother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们进来杀了我们，那我们就完蛋呗，所以我们最好充分利用现在的情况，放松点，兄弟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is our little easy town. The Rangers found it for us a decade ago and promised to keep us safe until they returned with reinforcements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们安逸的小镇。游骑兵十年前为我们找到了它，并承诺在增援部队回来之前保护我们的安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Rangers haven't returned, and so we're stuck here. There's not much point worrying about the Legion, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，游骑兵还没回来，所以我们被困在这里了。不过担心军团也没多大意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they come in and here and kill us, then we're screwed, so we might as well make the most of the situation and just take it easy, sister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们进来杀了我们，那我们就完蛋呗，所以我们最好充分利用现在的情况，放松点，姐妹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is our little easy town. The Rangers, uh, wait did I already tell you this? You had other questions, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们安逸的小镇。游骑兵，等等，我跟你说过了吧？你还有其他问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个地方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone here takes it easy, or, I mean that they should probably take it easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的每个人都很放松，或者，我是说他们应该放松。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going through a little rough patch right now, but we'll get through it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在正经历一段艰难的时期，但我们会挺过去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Easy town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 安逸的小镇？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a Frumentarius in the drunk tank, Job murdered someone, the water chip's broken, and the ants are attacking downstairs non-stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 醉汉拘留所里有个军团特务，约伯杀了人，水芯片坏了，蚂蚁在下面不停袭击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of them might kill us all, but I'm not too worried about. Things will work out. They always do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中一个可能会杀死我们所有人，但我不太担心，事情会解决的。总是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's rough right now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有什么困难？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing, thanks to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么，多亏了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's rough right now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有什么困难？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He managed to find this place just before the Chainway collapsed. He must not have told his Frumentarii buddies because no one's come looking for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在连环道坍塌前找到了这个地方。他肯定没有告诉他的特务同伙，因为没有人来找他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski knocked him and convinced us to spare the guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基击倒了他，说服我们放过他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski's a cool dude, but I'm not really sure that was the best option.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基是个很酷的家伙，但我不确定这是不是最好的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with the Frumentarius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job killed someone. It's not a mystery or anything like that. He got pissed at Wally and killed him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯杀了人，这不是什么神秘的事情。他生沃利的气，杀了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be lying if I said that I didn't think that something like this would eventually happen. I don't really know what to think on the matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我说我不认为这种事最终会发生，那一定是在说谎。我真不知道该怎么看待这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got to take a hit of the mushrooms, and I'll figure out where I stand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得去吃点蘑菇，然后再想清楚自己的立场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the murder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说谋杀案。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that. Yeah, so, Wally was the mechanic and apparently lost the thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那个。是的，所以，沃利是机械师，很明显他把东西弄丢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd ask him where it is, but he's, uh, not with us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问他在哪里，但他不在我们身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The water chip?
ESP.TRADUIT: 水芯片？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He have an ant farm downstairs for food. There must be some hostile ant colony burrowing at us, but they've been attacking our ants and us non-stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在楼下建了一个蚂蚁农场作为食物。 一定是有敌意的蚂蚁群在钻我们的洞，但它们一直在不停地攻击我们和我们的蚂蚁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's terrible. I've been thinking about throwing some of the calming mushrooms down the hole, but Wierzbowski and Ahote told me that that wouldn't work and to stop asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太可怕了。我一直在考虑往洞里扔一些镇静蘑菇，但维尔茨波夫斯基和阿霍特告诉我这行不通，别再问了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are ants attacking the place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有蚂蚁在攻击这个地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, man. Nobody runs this place. I help keep the place running nice and smooth. I'm not in charge of anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，伙计，这地方没人管。我帮助维持这个地方的正常运转，我不负责任何人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's in charge of anybody here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没人管别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're the town administrator, does that mean you're in charge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你是小镇管理员，是不是就意味着你说了算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone here volunteers the work that's needed to be done. Each according to their need or ability, or....
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的每个人都自愿完成需要完成的工作。根据他们的需要或能力，或...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, sorry, I forgot how Ripley said it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，抱歉，我忘了雷普利是怎么说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, uh, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，呃，对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's in charge? How does that work? How do things get done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人管事？这是怎么做到的呢？事情怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, uh, the people here, they are.... I'm sorry, lost my train of thought there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，呃，这里的人，他们是...不好意思，我有点走神了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What stops people from just doing nothing if they're only volunteering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人们只是志愿服务，怎么阻止他们什么都不做呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah, yeah, so, the people here, they, um, do what they can do in order to help us do what we need, and they just do it, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，对，是的，所以，这里的人，他们，尽他们所能来帮助我们做我们需要做的事，他们就这么做了，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That makes sense, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这说得通，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听不懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trying, I am. I'm not really as political as Ripley wants me to be. It's hard for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在努力，我在努力。我不像雷普利希望的那样热衷于政治，这对我来说很难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's a cog in the machine and everyone's free to be as they are, I know that, but I don't understand what he wants to do beyond that. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人是机器上的齿轮，每个人都可以自由地做自己，我知道这一点，但我不明白他除此之外还想做什么。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray, you can explain it to me the government structure of this community as simply as possible?
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷，你能尽可能简单的给我解释一下这个社区的政府结构吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trying, I am. I'm not really as political as Ripley wants me to be. It's hard for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在努力，我在努力。我不像雷普利希望的那样热衷于政治，这对我来说很难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one's a cog in the machine and everyone's free to be as they are, I know that, but I don't understand what he wants to do beyond that. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人是机器上的齿轮，每个人都可以自由地做自己，我知道这一点，但我不明白他除此之外还想做什么。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think you've answered my question yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你还没回答我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was a bigwig in the White Sands Caravans, believe it or not. Had an annual salary of 120,000 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信由你，我曾是白沙商队的大人物，年薪12万瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Board of directors and stuff. I had a family, a loving wife and two kids that I didn't spend nearly enough time with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 董事会之类的。我有一个家庭，一个可爱的妻子和两个孩子，但我却没有花足够多的时间陪伴他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do before you came here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来这里之前是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was and is the largest caravan company in whole of Arizona. It used to be the Crimson Caravans of the east. It's not anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它过去是，现在也是整个亚利桑那州最大的商队公司。它曾经是东部的深红商队，现在不是了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's still based in Kingman, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，它的总部还在金曼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is White Sands Caravans?
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙商队是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Busy. I worked really long hours. It was hard work keeping the payrolls up, making sure the caravans ran on time, balancing the books.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很忙，我工作时间很长。维持工资增长，确保商队准时运转，平衡账目，是一项艰苦的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would come home to my family asleep practically every night, and I would wake up and leave before they did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我几乎每天晚上回到家，家人都在睡觉，然后我醒来，在他们醒来之前离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it like working at White Sands Caravans?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在白沙商队工作是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: White Sands liked money. I liked money. The Rangers came to us and asked us to help open up a supply route to the NCR through the north, through Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙喜欢钱，我喜欢钱。游骑兵来找我们，让我们帮忙开辟一条补给线，从北部通过金曼到NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I went back to the board, and they said yes, so they signed deal to sell guns them. Things were good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又去找董事会，他们同意了，于是就签了协议卖枪给他们。一切都很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion came to us and asked us to supply them. They agreed to our terms, and signed a contract. Things were better. I retired with a nice, cushy pension.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团来找我们，要求我们提供物资。他们同意了我们的条件，并签订了合同。事情变得更好了，我退休时拿到了一笔丰厚的退休金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, the Rangers lost. Things went bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，游骑兵输了。事情变糟了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to White Sands?
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙商队怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no they didn't. They lined up the board of directors and crucified them. Then, they took the best earners and beheaded them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，他们不是。他们把董事会成员排成一排，钉死在十字架上，然后，他们把赚钱最多的人斩首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their heads decorate the streets outside the White Sands headquarters even today. A monument to Profligacy and whoring, the Legionaries said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到今天，他们的头颅还装饰着白沙总部外的街道。军团成员说，这是一座纵欲和嫖娼的纪念碑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't dispute the Legion when they say that their greed caused all of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团说这一切都是他们的贪婪造成的，我无法否认。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm guessing the Legion didn't like you sold to both sides?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜军团不喜欢你两边都卖物资？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Yeah, they did. I don't really want to talk about this anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的，确实是这样。我真的不想再谈这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like they sold the rope the Legion used to hang them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来他们把用来绞死自己的绳子卖给了军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A little, but they made their bed. The biggest tragedy is that we all have to lay in it to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一点，但他们自己铺的床。最大的悲剧是，我们都不得不躺在上面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能聊点别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel guilty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感到内疚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Yeah. Any chance we can change the subject?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，对。我们能换个话题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太可怕了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm done talking about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想再谈这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sucks to be you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真倒霉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gone. My wife left me without saying goodbye. I had one of the staff babysit the kids while I was at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没了。我妻子不辞而别，我让一个员工在我上班的时候照看孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I came home one day to fight that raiders had roughed up the place. One of my kids was dead, and the other was missing. Got confirmation that she was dead back in '70.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一天我回到家，发现掠夺者在家里大肆破坏。 我的一个孩子死了，另一个失踪了。 70年的时候，我得到证实，她已经死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should have spent more time with them. Shouldn't have left them alone. Always 'should have'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该多花点时间陪他们，不应该丢下他们不管的。总是“应该”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's your family?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的家人呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So am I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry for your loss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 节哀顺变。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I'm here now, and I wasn't there then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我现在在这里，而我当时并不在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you couldn't protect them, how can you protect this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你连他们都保护不了，你怎么能保护这个地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made a lot of friends in the Rangers back in the old days. After my retirement from White Sands, I sheltered some of them in my home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前在交了很多游骑兵朋友。我从白沙退休后，把他们中的一些人安置在家里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They remembered that and asked me to join Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们记得这一点，并邀请我加入胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, trying to live up to the Rangers is probably impossible, so I said no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，想要达到游骑兵的水平是不可能的，所以我拒绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I sheltered people in the past, so I figured that maybe I could keep doing it, and that's how this place started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我以前为别人提供过庇护，所以我想也许我可以继续这样做，这地方就是这样开始的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you end up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么到这里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, this is an easy town, where everyone can keep it easy. That was my goal, you know?
