ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，这是个安逸的小镇，每个人都可以过得轻松。这就是我的目标，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion makes life so hard for everyone here. I don't know if we'll survive the coming months, so the best I can do is to help everyone take it easy should that happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团让这里的每个人都过得很艰难。我不知道我们是否能挺过接下来的几个月，所以我能做的就是帮助大家放松，以防万一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the founder of this place, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你就是这里的创始人了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met Ripley a while ago. Helped me find myself at a very bad time in my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在那之前不久认识了雷普利，帮我在人生最糟糕的时候找回了自我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know anyone else before you built this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在你建造这个地方之前，你还认识其他人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My greed had consumed me. My love of money cost me my wife and my children, but it was all for nothing when the Legion came through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的贪婪吞噬了我。我对金钱的热爱让我失去了妻子和孩子，但当军团到来时，一切都是徒劳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I heard that White Sands was taken over by the Legion, I realized that I was a terrible person with a terrible worldview.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我听说白沙被军团占领的时候，我意识到我是一个有着糟糕世界观的可怕的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley showed up something better even if I don't really understand it that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利展示了一些更好的东西，尽管我不是很理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A bad time in your life?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人生中最糟糕的时候？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That anarchy might be a good thing after all since it forces people to come together and overcome greed, to change human nature into something better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种无政府状态可能是一件好事，因为它迫使人们团结起来，克服贪婪，让人性变得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, um, uh.... Yeah, I forgot where I was going with that. It's difficult to articulate, so I'll just talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，嗯，呃...对，我忘了我要说什么了。这很难说清楚，所以我就说点别的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was that worldview?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么世界观？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，哪个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这里的人怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's new. If I wasn't trying to stay loyal to Serwa, I think my younger self of one year ago would be leering all over her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是新来的。如果我不是想对瑟尔瓦保持忠诚的话，我想一年前的我一定会对她抛媚眼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's not very social, but she does help out without asking, so she cares, I can tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不太爱交际，但她会主动帮忙，所以我看得出来，她很在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a pretty good guy. He's a good supply runner, and it seems he likes me. I'm glad that at least one person doesn't think I'm an idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个很好的人，他是个很好的补给员，而且他似乎喜欢我。我很高兴至少有一个人不认为我是个白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Benjamin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本杰明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's been in the dumps since he showed up here years ago. I'm not sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从他几年前来到这里，就一直闷闷不乐。我不确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to get him in touch with his feelings over a little session, but he seemed like he just really didn't want to talk to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试着用一段时间让他了解自己的感受，但他似乎真的不想和我说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scary guy. He says he wants to kill all of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怕的家伙，他说他要杀了我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski thinks he can change, but I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基认为他能改变，但我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good guy. He's got a lot more drive than most of the people here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好人。他比这里的大多数人都有干劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's my daughter. She's an accident, but, man, just the happiest possible accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我的女儿。她只是个意外，但是，伙计，可能是最幸福的意外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊芙琳娜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One-night stand. To be real with you, I've kind of let myself go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一夜情。跟你说实话，我有点放纵自己了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, whenever I see a chance for escape, I take it. Mushrooms, alcohol and the babes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，每当我看到逃跑的机会，我就会抓住。蘑菇，酒精和美女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Usually, I can't get any, so I just use the old Cram special.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我都买不到，所以我就用老饱饱牌特餐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tried to have some fun with the guys, but I just can't get interested in them. Ripley told me that he used to be the same way, and, uh....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试着和他们一起找点乐子，但我就是对他们没兴趣。雷普利告诉我他以前也是这样，然后...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what were we talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我们说什么来着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd that happen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么发生的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yeah, yeah, the pregancy. Anyways, I asked Serwa out. I think she must have been extra-angry at her daddy for her to say yes that day, since usually she just insulted me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对，对，怀孕。总之，我约了瑟尔瓦出去。我想她那天答应我一定是因为她特别生她爸爸的气，因为她通常只是侮辱我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was pretty shocked when she said that she wanted to keep it. I thought for sure that Doc was going to have to perform an abortion. But, she said no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当她说她想留下孩子的时候，我很震惊，我以为道格肯定要给她做人流手术。但是，她拒绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The pregancy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怀孕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to try to be a good father. I've been trying to make more time to spend time with her. I've been given a second chance, and I don't want to waste it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要努力做一个好父亲，我一直在努力挤出更多时间陪她。我得到了第二次机会，我不想浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，我需要这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then, that's going to have to change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就得改变了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You strike me as a poor parent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你是个可怜的家长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll be a good father.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会是个好父亲的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He probably would have benefitted the most from some mushrooms. I've always tried to get him to take some with me in a little session.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能从一些蘑菇中获益最多，我一直想让他在治疗的时候带点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told me that it would have destroyed what little control he has over his temper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我，这样会毁掉他对自己脾气仅有的一点控制能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll always wonder. It's a real shame what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我会一直好奇。真的很遗憾发生了这样的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He murdered someone in an outburst. The first to occur in our community.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一时冲动杀了人，这是我们社区的第一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I love that guy. I try to attend his lectures whenever I can, but he holds a lot of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我喜欢那家伙。我尽量一有时间就去听他的讲座，但他讲的课很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's difficult for me to keep up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很难跟上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sort of helped me a long time try to find meaning the world, so I owe a lot to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在很长一段时间里，他帮助我找到了世界的意义，所以我欠他很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's angry all the time and doesn't want to talk to any of us. I offered him a smoke, but he declined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他总是很生气，不想和我们任何人说话。我请他抽烟，但他谢绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's a hottie, but way too highstrung for a good lay, to be honest with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个辣妹，但说实话，她太紧张了，不适合上床。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All that shouting and screaming. And she never smiles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的呼喊和尖叫，而且她从来不笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I'd really consider actually doing it with her. I'm with Serwa, and Sharky's in a coma, and that's no good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说我真的会考虑和她做。我和瑟尔瓦在一起，而沙尔基还在昏迷中，这很不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kind of a square, to be honest. The Rangers I knew could outdrink an elephant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，有点老实巴交。我认识的游骑兵喝得比大象还多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he doesn't want to drink at all. I've been trying to convince him to take some mushrooms with me, but, uh, he declined. Loudly, he declined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，他根本不想喝酒。我一直想说服他和我一起带些蘑菇，但他拒绝了，他大声拒绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That guy should definitely take it easy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那家伙绝对应该放松点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like up there? I haven't seen the outside world since I was a kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上面是什么样子的？我从小就没见过外面的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This place does get many, or really any, visitors. Once you're here, you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方确实有很多，或者说根本没有游客。一旦你到了这里，你就在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't seen the outside world in ten years, so I don't know what it's like up there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有十年没见过外面的世界了，所以我不知道那里是什么样子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这关你什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot, dry, sunny? Those are kind of foreign concepts to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 热、干燥、晴天？这些对我来说都是陌生的概念。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's weird seeing someone just take them for granted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到别人把它们视为理所当然，感觉很奇怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's hot. It's dry. It's sunny basically all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很热，很干燥，基本上一直都是晴天。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How big?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多大？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's huge. Mountains, valleys, deserts, rivers, lakes. It's big.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很大很大，山脉、山谷、沙漠、河流、湖泊。很大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what my dad says, too. That can't everything, but I guess you want to talk about other things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸也这么说。这不能说明一切，但我猜你想谈别的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's terrible. There's violence and war and death out there. Nothing but bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很可怕，到处都是暴力、战争和死亡。全是胡扯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's helpful. I guess you want to talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很有帮助。我猜你想说点别的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很大。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Must be nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，肯定很漂亮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's land on open ground as far as I can see, and land beyond that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我所能看到的地方都是开阔的，在那之外还有陆地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guard the armory. There's not much to guard against, but I guard it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看守军械库。没什么好防备的，但我还是要小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pushed Murray to give me a job three or four years ago. It was just after the NCR left Big Stop, I think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三、四年前，我催促穆雷给我一份工作。我想是在NCR离开大站后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you get that job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么得到这份工作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good question. The Rangers promised us that we would one day be able to return to our homes in Arizona, and the NCR would keep pushing the Legion back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好问题。游骑兵向我们保证，总有一天我们能回到亚利桑那州的家，而NCR会继续击退军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That didn't happen, though. The NCR stopped at Big Stop, and fighting was still going on all over the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，这并没有发生。NCR在大站停了下来，到处都在打仗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meanwhile, the Legion held Dolan Springs and was able to counterattack.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与此同时，军团控制了多兰泉，并进行了反击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we stayed here. We shouldn't have. We should have gone out and fought.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我们就留在了这里。我们不该这么做的，我们应该出去战斗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the NCR was in Arizona four years ago, why didn't you leave then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果NCR四年前就在亚利桑那，你当时为什么不离开？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hate it here. Almost everyone here is a burnout or a coward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌这里。这里的每个人几乎都是精疲力竭的人或懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should be fighting the Legion like the Rangers asked us to instead of hiding out down here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该按照游骑兵的要求去和军团作战而不是躲在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这个地方怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, no, I haven't, but I am so sick of just doing nothing. I've done nothing my whole life, and I will do something before I die in this hole, damn it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没有，我没有，但我厌倦了无所事事。我这辈子什么都没做过，在我死在这鬼地方之前一定要做点什么，该死的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you fought the Legion before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前和军团打过仗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Underestimated? I can't estimate them at all. I've never seen them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 低估？我根本无法估计，我从没见过他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone here talks about how scary they are, but then they say the Legion's doomed to collapse and we just have to wait.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的每个人都在说他们有多可怕，但他们又说军团注定要崩溃，我们只能等待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, which is it? Do they think the Legion will just topple over on its own?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，到底是哪一种呢？难道他们认为军团会自己崩溃吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No! We have to fight them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不！我们必须对抗他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion shouldn't be underestimated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别低估了军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've thought about it. I've thought about it a lot. Ever since I came here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想过了，我想了很多。自从我来到这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I guess I don't want to leave everyone here all alone. I want to protect them, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我猜我不想把所有人都独自留在这里，我也想保护他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want them to come with me and fight alonside me as I march into the Grand Canyon with friends at my back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望他们和我一起，在我和朋友们一起向大峡谷进军时与我并肩作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That might be too much for everyone here. Their fire's gone out, and I don't know if I can rekindle it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可能对这里的每个人来说都太过了。他们的火熄灭了，我不知道能不能重新点燃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you leave to fight them yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不自己去和他们战斗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean it's not your business? Do you think you're better than us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不关你的事是什么意思？你觉得你比我们强吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's your Wasteland, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这也是你的废土！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of my business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不关我的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's fair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这很公平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just meant that's it's up to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是这取决于你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, screw you, too! Don't talk to me again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你也去死吧！不要再和我说话了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do think I'm better than you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实觉得我比你强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, fine. But, my point still stands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。但是，我的观点仍然成立。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's because I wanted to change the subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是因为我想换个话题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad, that's Benjamin, brought me in when I was a kid. He used to help scout for the Rangers during their war with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爸爸，也就是本杰明，在我小的时候带我来的。他曾在游骑兵与军团的战争中帮助他们侦察。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They asked him to join Support Unit Hoover, but he told them that he didn't want to abandon me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们要求他加入胡佛支援小队，但他告诉他们他不想抛弃我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I can understand that, especially now that I have a baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我能理解，尤其是现在我有了孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to be here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么来到这里的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Evelina? Well, it's kind of complicated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，伊芙琳娜？嗯，这有点复杂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd that happen? The baby, I mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是怎么回事？我是说孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray's the biological father, but it's Job who spends most of the time taking care of her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷是孩子的生父，但大部分时间都是约伯在照顾她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's the father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子父亲是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job likes kids and babies and stuff. Sometimes, he blows his lid and screams at people, or you know...Wally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯喜欢小孩和婴儿之类的。有时，他会发脾气，对着别人大喊大叫，或者你知道的，沃利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I've never seen him do that with Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我从没见过他对伊芙琳娜那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess he likes kids.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜他喜欢孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did Job do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯为什么这样做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He works quite a bit, but he always makes time for her at night so I can sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他工作很多，但他总是在晚上腾出时间陪她，这样我就可以睡觉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does Murray do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷是做什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray's a bit of a...how do I put this, a deadbeat. He's high about 80% of the time, and works the other 20%.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷有点...怎么说呢，游手好闲。他80%的时间都在嗑药，剩下的20%都在工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's nice, he's sweet, don't get me wrong, but he really isn't parent material.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他人很好，很贴心，别误会，但他真的不是当父母的料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know things went badly with his last family, and he does want to make things right this time, but at the end of the day, he's not a great fit for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他和上一个家庭的关系不太好，这次他也想弥补，但说到底，他不太适合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is it complicated?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么复杂的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was having a rough night, and I was having a rough night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他那晚过得很糟糕，我也很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kind of felt sorry for the guy for the first time. One thing led to another, and, well, here I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我第一次为他感到难过。一件事接着一件事，然后，嗯，我就在了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, why did you sleep with him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么和他上床？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a lot of opinions on a lot of people. Which ones do you want to know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对很多人都有很多看法。你想知道哪些？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得这里的人怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really know her. She keeps to herself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太了解她，她独来独往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's my dad. He's way, way too overprotective. He refused to let me join Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是我爸爸。他保护得太过分了，他拒绝让我加入胡佛支援小队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even when he caved, Wierzbowski didn't let me join either. Now, we're right back where we started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使他屈服了，维尔茨波夫斯基也不让我加入。现在，我们又回到了原点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to be a part of something. I want to do something, and I will. One day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想参与其中，我想做点什么，我会做到的。总有一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Benjamin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本杰明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a deadend. You talk to him and can see that his fire has gone out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个死脑筋。你和他交谈，可以看出他的热情已经熄灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I honestly can't stand looking at him. It's depressing and enraging and reminds me of why I can't wait to leave this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我一看到他就受不了。这让我沮丧和愤怒，让我想起为什么我等不及要离开这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's pretty terrible. I wish I could just ice him, but Wierzbowski begged us so hard to let him live that I couldn't bring myself to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很糟糕。我希望我能办了他，但维尔茨波夫斯基苦苦哀求我们让他活下来，我无法让自己这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good man. Actually tries to give us checkups.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好人，其实是想给我们做检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's my baby. I don't know if I should have kept her, but....
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我的宝贝。我不知道我是否应该留下她，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm happy I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我很高兴我这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊芙琳娜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's great. It's kind of strange seeing such a big guy change a baby's clothes, but those sausage fingers are way more nimble than they look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很棒。看到这么大的人给婴儿换衣服有点奇怪，但那些香肠手指可比看起来灵活多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe someone who can be so gentle could do something so terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不敢相信一个如此温柔的人会做出这么可怕的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's promised to be Evelina's schoolteacher whenever her time comes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他答应当伊芙琳娜的老师，无论她什么时候来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good that he's making himself useful since I'm not actually sure what he does around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还好他能帮上忙，因为我也不太清楚他在这里做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He doesn't bother me, and I don't bother him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不打扰我，我也不打扰他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's usually pretty nice to me whenever we do talk, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我们聊天的时候他通常都对我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's a hysterical screaming idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个歇斯底里尖叫的白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the leader of Support Unit Hoover, the people who fought the Legion for years and years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是胡佛支援小队的负责人，他们多年来一直与军团作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to join so bad, and that feeling has only gotten stronger since I've had Evelina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我太想加入了，自从我有了伊芙琳娜，这种感觉就更强烈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, he keeps saying no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，他一直说不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I guess not much is going on around here. What do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我猜这附近也没什么事。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Serwa [0601B97C] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not? Are you dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？你很危险吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tend to the Ant Farm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我照料蚂蚁农场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or, used to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者，曾经。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I killed a man. My friend. In frustration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀了一个人，我的朋友。在沮丧中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Left my post. Something riled the ants up shortly after. Completely overrunning the farm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我离开了岗位。不久之后，有什么东西激怒了蚂蚁，彻底占领了农场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I failed. I am awaiting my execution now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我失败了，我现在正在等待处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You used to? Why'd you stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你曾经？你为什么停下来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not want a lessor punishment. Execution is what I deserve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不希望受到更轻的惩罚，死刑是我应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely there's a better punishment than execution?
ESP.TRADUIT: 肯定有比死刑更好的惩罚吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is what I deserve. Life for a life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我应得的，一命还一命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Execution? That's pretty harsh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 处决？这太苛刻了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have no sheriff. My fate will be decided with a vote by the community.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们没有治安官，我的命运将由社区投票决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is going to execute you? Does this place have some sort of sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁来处决你？这地方有什么治安官吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will serve whatever the community deems a suitable punishment, then die on my own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意接受社区认为合适的惩罚，然后独自死去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if they don't want you to be executed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们不想处决你呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything from cultivating their eggs to raising pupae.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从培育它们的卵到培育它们的蛹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a great pleasure of mine. Ants are rewarding livestock to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的一大乐趣，蚂蚁是很有价值的家畜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe they're being culled right now. A shame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信它们现在正在被宰杀。真可惜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What sort of work did you do at the Ant Farm?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在蚂蚁农场做什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Only the finest threads in the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以，只有废土上最好的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see what you have for sale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你有什么卖的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, since you asked, I'll tell you. I get my wares from traders, Old World museums and tourist attractions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，既然你问了，那我就告诉你吧。我从商人、旧世界博物馆和旅游景点那里进货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd be surprised how often you can find clothes from before the War in good condition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会惊讶地发现，你经常能找到保存完好的战前衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should see how good their condition is. How about buying some now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该看看他们的状态有多好。现在就买怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you get your clothes from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的衣服是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Only the occasional traveler stopping by for a drink, and, of course, to buy some clothes from me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。只是偶尔有旅行者过来喝一杯，当然，也会从我这里买些衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd be better off asking the ghoul next door. He's been around much longer than I.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好问问隔壁的尸鬼，他比我活得久多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will say that it's kind of a good thing that not much happens. It means that the Legion is doing its job and keeping the roads clear of trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会说这是一件好事，没有发生太多事情。这意味着军团在履行自己的职责，让道路畅通无阻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good for business. Good for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对生意有利，对我来说也很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything around Elephant Hill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 象山附近有什么景点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I think of the Legion? Well let me tell you, they're okay in my book. They are a little rough, but I don't mind them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对军团的看法？好吧，让我告诉你，以我的观点他们没问题。有点粗糙，但我不介意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frankly, my business here is doing fine because of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白说，正是因为他们，我的生意才做得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it obvious? Have you ever been held at gun point by some bandits on your way here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是很明显吗？你来这里的路上有没有被土匪用枪指着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course you haven't, since the Legion killed those spineless cowards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当然没有，因为军团杀了那些没骨气的懦夫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I would probably still be living in Scottsdale if it wasn't for the safe roads we have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，如果不是因为这里的道路安全，我可能还住在斯科茨代尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Francisco [0601BD6C] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does the Legion benefit your shop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对你的商店有什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For you? Yes, in a sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你的？在某种意义上，有的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You travel to the front often, correct? And you are bold and faithful to Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你经常去前线，对吧？你对玛尔斯既勇敢又忠诚？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, perhaps you would be willing to help recover the armor of our lost Centurions. Ones who were killed in the field.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，也许你愿意帮忙找回我们失踪的百夫长的盔甲。那些死在战场上的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work available?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们有工作要做吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, several of our Centurions have gone missing in the field. Presumed dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我们的几个百夫长在战场上失踪了。推定死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you willing to help recover their armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意帮他们找回盔甲吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About the lost Centurions..
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于阵亡的百夫长...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're right. You have done a great service to the Legion. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你说得对。你为军团做出了巨大的贡献，谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid I don't have any coins to give you, but what could be a greater reward than the blessing of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我没有硬币可以给你，但有什么比玛尔斯的祝福更好的奖励呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was the last of the lost Centurions, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是最后一个失踪的百夫长，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bene. Do you know who it belonged to?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，你知道是谁的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found one of the Centurion armor plates you were looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一个你要找的百夫长铠甲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What more do you need to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have more questions about the lost Centurions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于失踪的百夫长，我还有很多疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pater Mars supernus, nomen tuum invoco ut tua filia ex utero Terrae nata, unde cuncta creata sunt...
ESP.TRADUIT: 天父火星，我呼唤您的名字，作为您从地球子宫中诞生的女儿，万物都是从地球诞生的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...nox et dies, bonum et malum, lupus et bos, ex tuo semine minore genita...
ESP.TRADUIT: ...黑夜与白天，善与恶，狼与牛，诞生于你较小的种子...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...in humili devotione erga Caesarem magnum, ex tuo semine maiore genitum, quem iusto imperio omnium rerum benedixisti in perpetuum.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...谦卑的献身于伟大的凯撒，他是您更伟大的后裔所生，您以公正的统治永远祝福他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pater Mars, precor ut huic filio minori suam debitam fortunam largiaris, nam et ipse devotionem suam tibi, atque Caesari, probavit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天父玛尔斯，我祈求您赐予这个小儿子应有的命运，因为他本人已经证明了他对您和凯撒的忠诚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Protege eum a scelere et morbo. Animum eius confirma, cum hostem in proelio iterum obiturus sit. Sapientiam novam ei tribue, eumque ad maiorem victoriam duc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 保护他免受犯罪和疾病的侵害。当他即将在与敌人的战斗中再次死去时，增强他的精神。赐予他新的智慧，带领他走向更大的胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pro his tibi laudes perpetuas gratiasque offerimus, Pater Mars. Sic fiat semper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为此，我们向您致以永恒的赞美和感谢，天父玛尔斯。让它永远如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like to receive Mars's blessings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意接受玛尔斯的祝福。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have already prayed for you today. We should not pester the heavens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我今天已经为你祈祷了，我们不应该纠缠上天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would like to receive Mars's blessings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意接受玛尔斯的祝福。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars guide you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯指引你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是该走的时候了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Safe travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 旅途平安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for me to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是该走的时候了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. There are currently only four missing in this theater. Here is a proscription detailing their names and last known whereabouts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，这个战区现在只有四个人失踪了。这是一份禁令，详细列出了他们的名字和最后的行踪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can do that. Are you looking for anyone in particular?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以做到。你在找某个特定的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well then. Should you change your mind, I'll be here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。如果你改变主意了，我就在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I'm not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我没兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When a Centurion dies, it is custom to bring their armor to a shrine such as this to be consecrated for use in the next life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 百夫长死后，按照惯例，要把他们的盔甲带到像这样的神殿里供奉起来，以备来世使用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Performing the sacred rites is one of my duties as a Shrine Maiden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行神圣的仪式是我作为神殿女侍的职责之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need their armor for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要他们的盔甲做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. As long as you recover their armor plates. Only those are needed for the death rituals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不重要，只要你找回他们的盔甲。死亡仪式只需要这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... what do I do with their bodies? Should I bury them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以...我该怎么处理他们的尸体？我应该埋了他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A slave is a body. A Legionary is his blade. A Legatus is his name. A Centurion is his armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奴隶是一具肉体，军团战士是他的利刃，特使是他的名字，百夫长是他的盔甲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without it, he is also without rank, and cannot lead his men in the Eternal Battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有盔甲，也就没有了军衔，无法在永恒之战中领导他的士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I ask why their armor is so important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能问一下为什么他们的盔甲如此重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not often. In this theater, the vast majority of our casualties were taken in 2277.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是很经常。在这个战区，我们的绝大多数伤亡都发生在2277年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How often do you lose Centurions in the field?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们经常在战场上失去百夫长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: First, the plate is soaked in the blood of a bull for three days, then left to dry on hot coals for one day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，盘子在公牛的血液中浸泡三天，然后放在热的炭火上干燥一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the ninety-sixth hour, it is wrapped in leather and delivered to the Black Priestess by Cursor. She peforms the final rites.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在第96小时，它被皮革包裹，并通过传令兵送到了黑衣女祭司那里。她主持最后的仪式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do these death rituals entail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些死亡仪式包括什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? So you can mock it again? I don't wish to discuss it with you any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？好让你再嘲笑一次？我不想再和你讨论这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the Eternal Battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说永恒之战吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is what awaits the faithful and honorable in the next life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是等待忠诚和可敬的人下辈子的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the continuance of purpose, service to Caesar, forever. The cause and the enemy remain essentially the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是使命的延续，永远为凯撒服务。事业和敌人本质上是一样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the Eternal Battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说永恒之战吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus. I do not have much to spare, but I'll try to make it worth your time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友。我没有多余的时间，但我会尽量不让你浪费时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get to looking for those armor plates, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就去找那些铠甲了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My pleasure. Was there anything else you needed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的荣幸。你还需要别的什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I've heard all I need to know, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想该知道的我都知道了，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is esoteric knowledge so I'm not surprised. She is the Priestess of the Magnum Chasma, second in rank to Pompeiia herself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是深奥的知识，所以我并不感到惊讶。她是大裂谷的女祭司，地位仅次于庞培。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is said that the Black Priestess does not eat or drink. Her mouth opens only to utter the sacred incantations that bridge this world with the next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说黑衣女祭司不吃不喝。她的嘴张开，只是为了说出连接这个世界和下一个世界的神圣咒语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never heard of any "Black Priestess."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没听说过什么“黑色女祭司”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The final ritual is performed by sinking the plate to the very bottom of the Magnum Chasma, where the gate to the next world lies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后的仪式是将盘子沉入大裂谷的最底部，那里是通往另一个世界的大门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How that gate is opened is known only to the Black Priestess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那扇门是怎么打开的只有黑衣女祭司知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens after that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 之后会发生什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Much like this world. Only that the land is arranged differently and there are places with names unfamiliar to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像这个世界一样。只是土地的布局不同，有些地方的名字我们并不熟悉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is all I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what does the next world look like exactly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，下一个世界到底是什么样子的呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm listening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在听。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That all makes sense, I guess. I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这都说得通，我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. When that happens, you move on to the next world. Then the next. Et sic porro.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是。当这种情况发生时，你就会进入另一个世界，然后是下一个。等等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there's a battle going on, does that mean you can die in the afterlife too?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有一场战斗正在进行，这是否意味着你在来世也会死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They may continue serving their own purpose. For example, I will remain a Maiden or Priestess of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们可以继续为自己的目的服务。比如，我将继续做玛尔斯的女侍或女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what happens to slaves and others who aren't fit to participate in battle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但奴隶和其他不适合参加战斗的人怎么办呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a Dissolute, your form will degenerate into that of a miserable, savage mutant. Your limbs and organs will swap places. Your skin will ooze green fluid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个放荡者，你的形态将堕落为一个悲惨的、野蛮的变种人。你的四肢和器官会互换位置，你的皮肤会渗出绿色的液体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will fight alongside an army of the beasts as opponents of the Eternal Faithful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你将与一支由野兽组成的军队并肩作战，作为永恒忠诚者的对手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will I fight in the Eternal Battle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会参加永恒之战吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. If you are devoted to Mars and Caesar, you will see this blessing for what it is. Otherwise, you will not receive it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。如果你忠于玛尔斯和恺撒，你就会明白这是什么祝福。否则，你将不会收到它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you just keep fighting the same enemies over and over again in slightly different places?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你只是在稍微不同的地方不断与相同的敌人战斗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do. Do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信，你呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you really believe in all that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的相信这些吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else can I help you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. At least a hundred.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，至少100个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many worlds are there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多少个世界？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry. If you prove yourself to Caesar, I am sure he will reward you appropriately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心。如果你能向凯撒证明自己，我相信他会给你适当的奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like the sound of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢这种说法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Believe me, you will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我，你会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll just see about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们走着瞧吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Repent for your degeneracy, and submit to Caesar. Whatever purpose he has set for you, stick to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为你的堕落忏悔，臣服于凯撒。无论他给你设定了什么目标，都要坚持。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can I avoid becoming a slimy monster?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎样才能避免变成一个黏糊糊的怪物呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you are faithful. Keep it up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你是忠诚的。坚持下去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure do!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然信！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard that cynicism is a symptom of advanced Profligacy. But if Caesar trusts you, it is because he thinks you can be saved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说愤世嫉俗是极端堕落的一种症状。但如果凯撒信任你，那是因为他认为你可以得救。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Continue your service to the Legion. Mars's gift will make itself clear in due time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续为军团服务，玛尔斯的恩赐会在适当的时候显现出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so, but it sounds like a shitty existence for everyone involved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的，但这听起来对所有人来说都是一种糟糕的生活。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is natural for the Dissolute mind. I urge you to vanquish any doubts and continue your service to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对放荡者来说是很自然的。我劝你打消疑虑，继续为凯撒效力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars's gift will make itself clear in due time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯的恩赐会在适当的时候显现出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe? I'm finding some of the concepts a little hard to grasp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧？我觉得有些概念有点难以理解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can you say that? There is nothing insane about believing in the natural order of the universe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能这么说？相信宇宙的自然规律并没有什么疯狂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar has placed his trust in you, but I will not entertain such blasphemy. Now be on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒信任你，但我不会容忍这种亵渎。现在你可以走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It sounds fucking *insane* to be honest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，老实说，这听起来很他妈的*疯狂*。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a cowardly trick by the enemy. Let us hope he went down fighting with Profligate blood on his blade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是敌人的卑鄙伎俩。让我们希望他在战斗中倒下，刀刃上沾着堕落者的血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leonidas. I guess the NCR never found his body amidst all the rubble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 列奥尼达斯，我猜NCR没能在废墟中找到他的尸体。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They came too close to the storm of fire, and it tainted their souls. It has happened before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们离烈焰风暴太近了，烈焰玷污了他们的灵魂。这种情况以前也发生过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or maybe they were only ambushed and outnumbered in battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许他们只是在战斗中遭到了伏击，人数上处于劣势。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least it will ease their comrades to know they did not stray from Caesar's light.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少他们的战友们知道他们没有偏离凯撒的光辉，会感到宽慰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Scorpius. Found his whole unit dead on the highway east of the Divide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯科皮乌斯，发现他的整个小队都死在了大裂谷东边的高速公路上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To abandon one's commander is an incorrigible mark of dishonor. That is why the survivors of the Vespertine Centuria were all put to death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抛弃自己的指挥官是不可救药的耻辱。这就是为什么黄昏百夫长军团的幸存者都被处死的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the Eternal Battle, it will be Julianus's right to fight alone. His men are bearing the cross forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在永恒之战中，尤利安努斯将拥有独自战斗的权利，而他的部下将永远背负着十字架。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Julianus. Looks like his men left him behind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利安努斯，看来他的手下把他丢下了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ventured into Fire Root Cavern alone and retrieved Maius's armor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一个人冒险进入火根洞穴取回了迈尤斯的盔甲？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you not leading an army yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不亲自领导一支军队？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maius. He literally tried to fight fire with fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迈尤斯，他真的试图以其人之道还治其人之身。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should be very careful who you lie to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 撒谎最好要看人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I lied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我说谎了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Just let me know when you are ready. The prayer is somewhat long-winded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！你准备好了就告诉我。这篇祷文有些冗长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样足够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you out of your mind?! Surely you are not suggesting to steal what has been sacrificed to Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了吗？！你该不会是想偷献给玛尔斯的东西吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I don't want your stupid blessing. Don't you have coins left by pilgrims or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不想要你那愚蠢的祝福。你没有朝圣者留下的硬币吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Who- who do you think you are? Fine, take the coins and leave. May Mars's lightning strike you down.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你...你以为你是谁？好吧，拿着硬币走吧。愿玛尔斯的闪电击倒你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be taking them. Stay out of my way or you'll share your fate with the last Priestess who ran this shithole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会拿走的。别挡我的道，否则你会和管理这鬼地方的上一个女祭司一样下场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You bastard! Don't you know it's forbidden to strike a Maiden? Lay a hand on me and Shadows Clouds will lash you to a cross.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你这个混蛋！你不知道殴打女侍是禁止的吗？只要你敢碰我，阴影云就会把你绑在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care who you think you are, you're henceforth persona non grata here. Go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不管你自认为是谁，从今以后你在这里就是不受欢迎的人。走吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want those coins. Give them to me or I'll hurt you, badly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要那些硬币。把它们给我，不然我会让你受伤的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So do you want the blessing or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你到底要不要祝福？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Henriette [0600BEF3] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Boo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um...
Boo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi...
Works every time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 万无一失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahhh!!
Guess not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't scare me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吓不倒我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大声说出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About Camp Willow...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于柳树营地...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I noticed. Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我注意到了。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, you want a fucking medal or something? You have to join the service for that. Best I can give you is my chump change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，你他妈想要勋章什么的？你必须为此服役。我最多只能给你点零钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone at Camp Willow is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 柳树营的人都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I noticed. Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我注意到了。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, you want a fucking medal or something? You have to join the service for that. Best I can give you is my chump change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，你他妈想要勋章什么的？你必须为此服役。我最多只能给你点零钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone at Camp Willow is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 柳树营的人都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Garcetti, Sergeant Major, 18Z, 2nd Battalion, 1st Ranger Regiment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加西堤，军士长。第一游骑兵团第二营，特种部队高级士官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I run counter-ops in this sector.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责这个区域的反抗行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Veteran? No. I'm just getting started.
ESP.TRADUIT: 资深？不，我才刚刚开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a Veteran Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是资深游骑兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ain't nothing more to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么可知道的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know more about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想多了解你一些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was alive. And now he isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还活着，而现在他不在了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Pason?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得帕森怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was alive. And now he isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他还活着，而现在他不在了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Pason?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得帕森怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pason is what we call a son of a bitch. Man's stiff as ghoul cock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕森就是我们所说的狗娘养的，跟尸鬼的鸡巴一样顽固。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not cut out for this armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不适合穿这身盔甲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about Pason?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得帕森怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seventeen years.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have you been a Ranger for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当游骑兵多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion are back at Willow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团回到了柳树营。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, don't get up. They'll still be there even if we burn it down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，别起来。就算我们把它烧了，他们也还在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At least the battle is definitely coming any day now. I'll be ready for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至少现在战斗肯定随时会到来，我会做好准备的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's new?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么新鲜事吗?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's new?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么新鲜事吗?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I get your opinions on various individuals, groups, and places?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能听听你对不同个人、团体和地方的看法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna go now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, when the enemy jerks off, I do the same. We lock eyes but neither of us is allowed to finish... yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，当敌人打飞机时，我也打。我们目光相遇，但谁也不允许结束...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is how wars are fought nowadays.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是当今战争的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of counter-ops?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么样的反抗行动？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Was that supposed to be a metaphor for something?
ESP.TRADUIT: ...这是什么隐喻吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生下来就穿着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And fuck off with that "could" shit. No one's asking Mommy and Daddy for their charge card around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别再扯什么“能不能”的屁话了，这里没人刷爹妈的签帐卡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought only veterans could wear the black armor...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以为只有老兵才能穿黑色盔甲...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fifty-five tribals, eight muties, a Steel Paladin and three initiates, eighteen red tribals, eleven unknown.
ESP.TRADUIT: 55个部落民，8个变种人，1个钢铁圣骑士和3个新兵，18个红色部落民，11个未知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How many confirmed kills do you have?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确认击杀了多少人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. I just show up, kill, and move on to the next shithole. They all look the same to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。我只是出现，杀人，然后去下一个鬼地方。在我看来都是一样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But yeah, I've toured Baja.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我去过巴哈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you in Baja before you came to the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来莫哈维之前在巴哈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Salute.> Thank you for your service.
ESP.TRADUIT: <敬礼>感谢您的服役。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. But they're all classified. Even the one about the lizard and the Ensenada whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但都是机密。包括蜥蜴和恩森那达妓女的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you've got some cool stories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你一定有些很酷的故事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get on with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about *you*. I want to talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说*你*了，我想谈点别的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask your mommy. She'll give you mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问你妈去，她会把我的给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell is a charge card?
ESP.TRADUIT: 签帐卡是什么鬼东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I know. Saving 100 for someone special.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我知道。为某个特别的人留的100。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... 99 kills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是...杀了99人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]如果你这么说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's... a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是...很多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all do raiding. But I carry a real gun, and they have spears and live in dirty mud huts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都干过掠夺。但我拿着真枪，而他们拿着长矛，住在肮脏的泥屋里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you say tribals? I think the preferred term is "raiders."
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说部落民？我觉得应该叫“掠夺者”。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No *little* kids, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有*小*孩子，总之。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yeah, killed some women in Mexicali. Roses get thornier the more south they grow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，在墨西卡利杀了几个女人。玫瑰越往南生长刺越多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about women, and children?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那女人和孩子呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure yet. There has been nothing remarkable about anyone I have killed thusfar. This haunts me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还不确定。到目前为止，我杀的人都没有什么特别之处。这一直困扰着我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who do you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得谁合适？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. Practically everyone in the battalion got one that day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上，那天几乎全营的人都干掉了一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you killed a Brotherhood Paladin, though. That's a remarkable feat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过你说你杀了一个钢铁兄弟会的圣骑士，这是一项了不起的壮举。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just like here, but people don't bother crying when they're shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像这里一样，但人们中枪的时候都懒得哭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it like down there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里是什么样子?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like here, but you don't know what anyone is saying, so you just shoot them when they ask questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像这里，但你不知道别人在说什么，所以他们一提问你就开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it like down there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那里是什么样子?

ESP.ORIGINAL: People who won't be remembered. I made sure of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些不会被记住的人，我确保了这点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who were you fighting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在和谁战斗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got that backwards. *We* are the ghosts. And we don't chase nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你搞反了。*我们*是鬼，我们什么都不追。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing but busty señoritas. And the high you get from inhaling the fumes off the bubbling green tar that used to be some tribal's face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 净是些丰满的女郎。还有就是当你吸入那些冒泡的绿色焦油散发出的烟雾时所获得的快感，而那些焦油以前是某个部落成员的脸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone told me you guys were just "chasing ghosts."
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人告诉我，你们只是在“追鬼”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Been here before. I still don't think about it at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前来过。我还是没想过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the Mojave so far?
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止，你觉得莫哈维怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I honestly don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry for bringing that up. Let's change the subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉提起这件事。我们换个话题吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Opportunities are meant to be taken without permission. Fuck HQ and fuck their mothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 机会就是未经许可就能抓住的。去他妈的总部操他们的妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll give you an earful sometimes, but it's all part of the game. Pason doesn't *get* that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有时会给你一堆废话，但这都是游戏的一部分。帕森不*明白*这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm detecting some conflict here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现这里有些冲突。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only in the mornings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有早上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do ghouls really get that... hard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼真的那么...硬吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean Pason is by the books, whereas you're a loose cannon?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说帕森是循规蹈矩的人，而你是个不受约束的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: These costumed douchebags are practically taunting us. They think they can paddle around in the river like they're the canals of Venice.
