ESP.TRADUIT: 这些穿着戏服的混蛋简直是在嘲笑我们。他们以为自己可以在河里划来划去，就像在威尼斯的运河里一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...Because we are letting them.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...因为我们在放任他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What opportunities are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的机会是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, no. No, I know what you're implying and it isn't like that at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，不。不，我知道你在暗示什么，但事实并非如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would I take a bullet for him? Yeah. Would I show up to his wedding? Maybe. Only to steal his bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会替他挡子弹吗？会。我会出席他的婚礼吗？也许吧，只是为了偷走他的婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got no respect for him. We ain't a "team."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一点也不尊重他，我们不是“团队”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow! Just like in my Pre-War comic books!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇！就像我战前的漫画一样！

ESP.ORIGINAL: General Doter started hoarding ammo. Thinks they're gonna do the big attack soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老耄将军开始囤积弹药，他觉得他们很快就要发动大规模袭击了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now we can only get off four shots a day. Not enough to make a difference.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们一天只能打四枪，不足以产生影响。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the problem? Aren't you able to shoot at their rafts from here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么问题吗？难道你不能从这里射击他们的木筏吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wanted to take an infiltration team across the river and torch their camp with my bare hands. Even offered to go alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想带一支渗透小队过河，徒手把他们的营地烧了，甚至提出一个人去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pason declined. He's afraid HQ will get mad at him if we don't stay put.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕森拒绝了，他担心如果我们不能做到按兵不动，总部会生他的气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not seeing how any of this is Pason's fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看不出这是帕森的错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, that's the one. Used to be one of our outposts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，就是这里。曾经是我们的前哨基地之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you wanted to attack Camp Willow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你想袭击柳树营地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Place called Camp Willow. Or I guess now they're calling it "Campus Willus."
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫柳树营地的地方，或者我猜现在他们称之为“威勒斯营”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's straight east of here. Used to be one of our outposts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这儿的正东方向，以前是我们的前哨基地之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What camp were you planning to attack?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算攻击哪个营地？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is an officer, and I'm not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是军官，而我不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're a veteran, and he isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你是老兵，而他不是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. "You can fuck HQ but you do *not* fuck your lieutenant." - Ranger proverb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。“你可以操总部，但不能操你的中尉。”——游骑兵谚语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then what's stopping you? Shouldn't Pason and his mother get fucked?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么阻止了你？难道帕森和他妈妈不应该被操吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I had friends at Willow. Maybe I want to even the score a little.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我在柳树营有朋友，也许我想扳回一局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This sounds personal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来是个人问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know your type. You think you're tough shit to go around stealing our glory without committing to the uniform. Well, you know what I think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我了解你的类型。你以为你很牛逼，能不穿制服到处偷我们的荣誉。嗯，你知道我怎么想的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could take out the camp for you. I've killed lots of Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你拿下营地，我杀过很多军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure your lieutenant will come around eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你的中尉最终会回心转意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No sooner than the enemy comes around our front door.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在敌人绕过我们的前门时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure Pason will come around eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信帕森最终会回心转意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: First, fuck you. Second, I don't care anymore. I'd like to see you kill those bastards, if you really got what it takes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，操你妈，?其次，我不在乎了。我倒想看你杀了那些混蛋，如果你真有本事的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And one more thing: you see any Ranger dogtags or keepsakes lying around the place, bring them back with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一件事，如果你看到任何游骑兵的狗牌或纪念品，把它们带回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your thoughts on the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the only place around not worthy of being totally bombed into the Stone Age, and still, at least half of it should be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是唯一一个不值得被炸回石器时代的地方，但至少有一半的地方应该是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your thoughts on the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对NCR有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I think anything? There are a hundred others just like him back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要想这些？在我们国家有上百个和他一样的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Mr. House?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得豪斯先生怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once. It was... uneventful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一次。那是...平淡无奇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever been to Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去过维加斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an objective. Also, all this running water reminds me of the kidney stone I passed in Tijuana.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个目标。还有，这些流水让我想起了我在蒂华纳排出的肾结石。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you feel about the Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得胡佛水坝怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a good chief, but I think his Ranger sensibilities have been eroded by politics. That's how it has to be, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个好领袖，但我觉得他的游骑兵精神已经被政治侵蚀了。我想这是必然的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you respect Hanlon?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你尊敬汉隆吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seriously? No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 认真的？不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you respect Oliver?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你尊重奥利弗吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you vote for Kimball?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你投票给金博尔了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 客气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was all I wanted to ask about, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我想问的，谢谢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. I've never met up with them for a chat. Tribals are tribals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我从没和他们见过面聊天。部落就是部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion? The guys you're fighting against?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团？那些和你对抗的家伙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a felon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个重罪犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Boneyard shit. I nearly killed a kid over a girl. Served two years in LSP. It was a long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晒骨场的破事。我差点为了一个女孩杀了一个孩子，在LSP蹲了两年。这是很久以前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? What did you do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你做什么了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep. They don't care as long as you're disciplined.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。只要你遵守纪律，他们才不管呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they still let you be a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们还是让你当游骑兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I literally have not ever thought about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的从来没想过这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But would you have voted for Kimball if you could?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果可以的话，你会投票给金博尔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kimball is saving the Republic! You should be more supportive of your commander-in-chief.
ESP.TRADUIT: 金博尔在拯救共和国！你应该更加支持你们的总司令。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, Kimball is just another reactionary crony. We wouldn't be in this mess if Peterson had won.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，金博尔只是另一个保守的亲信。如果彼得森赢了，我们就不会陷入这样的困境。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, Kimball is basically a fascist. This country has been going downhill ever since Tibbett left office.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，金博尔基本上就是个法西斯主义者。自从蒂贝特卸任后，这个国家一直在走下坡路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Merry Christmas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣诞快乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wasn't in it for a reward, but thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是为了报酬，但还是谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're welcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不客气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收下了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Ehh... Fuck it, why not. I never use it anymore, and you're more Ranger than half these other losers.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]呃...操，为什么不呢。我再也不用它了，你比其他一半的废柴更像游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you give me your Sequoia, I promise to kill the Legate with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你把你的红杉给我，我保证用它杀了特使。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You can take it from my cold, dead hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你可以从我冰冷的死人手中拿走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, I know you guys got those cool pistols. I deserve yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，我知道你们有很酷的手枪。我值得你这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收下了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's not much, but it's the thought that counts. Thanks. Here's a little something extra for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然不多，但心意最重要，谢谢。这是额外给你的一点东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Also, I found this photograph in the building. <Give Ranger photo.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <给出游骑兵照片>还有，我在大楼里找到了这张照片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, not yet. I think this new LT can be won over though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，还没有。不过我觉得这个新中尉是可以争取到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are you going on your mission to attack Camp Willow, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你要去执行袭击柳树营地的任务了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell no. You wanted to do it yourself so badly. So go do it yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不。你太想自己动手了，所以你自己去做吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ranger Garcetti [0601CA98] (mod) Quest : ([0601CA9B]AZFreeformRSDelta) 0601CA9B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So are you going on your mission to attack Camp Willow, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你要去执行袭击柳树营地的任务了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would like to venture back across the river and slaughter the Profligates that harass us? Fine by me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你愿意冒险回到河对岸屠杀那些骚扰我们的堕落者吗？我觉得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that you needed my permission, Dissolute. Go take your shot. Come back when you've made your kill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不需要我的允许，浪荡子。去开枪吧，杀完人再回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could deal with them for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你解决。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I noticed there weren't any shots fired at our barges today. That is actually impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我注意到今天没有人向我们的驳船开枪。真是令人印象深刻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, a small reward, as a token of my thanks. I will spread word of your accomplishments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你一点小小的奖励，以表我的谢意。我会宣传你的成就。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Caro [060062DE] (mod) Quest : ([06008F94]AZFreeformCampWillow) If I Had a Quarter EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That Ranger station won't be giving you any more trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个游骑兵站不会再给你添麻烦了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mark of Caesar. It's been a long time since I've seen one in use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的徽记，我已经很久没看到有人用了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are one of a few chosen my Lord has allowed to walk these lands. I sense you're not likely to follow in their footsteps, but to make your own path in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是我的主人允许在这片土地上行走的少数人之一。我感觉你不太可能追随他们的脚步，而是要在这个世界上开辟自己的道路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry?
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know how you got it. I know you. I've seen you. Read reports on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你是怎么拿到的。我认识你，我已经见过你，阅读过关于你的报告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, but where are my manners, my name is Spirit Chaser?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，可是我的礼仪呢，我叫逐灵者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got it by....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是通过...

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you did. It's Spirit Chaser.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确实这么做了。是逐灵者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I asked for your name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我问过你的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's my business. You ask it so casually without even knowing my name. It's Spirit Chaser by the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是我的事，你连我的名字都不知道，就这么随便问。顺便说一下，是逐灵者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's not my name. I was referring to the Mark of Caesar you have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，那不是我的名字。我指的是你身上的凯撒徽记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, my name is Spirit Chaser. It's a pleasure to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，我叫逐灵者。很高兴认识你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice to meet you, Mark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴认识你，徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, he's a nobody. Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他是个无名小卒。别在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's the other guy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一个人是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a talented Frumentarius, don't get me wrong. Loyal to Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个才华横溢的特务，别误会。忠于凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But he's a dullard. Unimaginative operations. A total bore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他是个笨蛋，毫无想象力的操作。太无聊了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's always been like that, too. Even when he was a fucking Painted Rock scribbling in the dirt .
ESP.TRADUIT: 他也一直这样，从他还是个在地上乱涂乱画的混蛋开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't like your partner?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢你的搭档？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Bellius. He's my current partner. Against my will, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，伯里乌斯，他是我现在的搭档。当然，这是违背我意愿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I am curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我很好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么说的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a question we should be asking you. What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我们应该问你的问题。你在这里做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are you guys doing out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你们在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you ready to answer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备好回答了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what are you guys doing out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你们在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're monitoring the situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们正在监控局势。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I answered your question. Your turn. What are you doing out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经回答了你的问题，该你了。你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There have been bad omens in the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地区有不祥之兆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what situation is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么局势呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Persistent. Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坚持不懈，很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The SMART Array is the great brick wall to our efforts to establish a supplementary supply line along the Pierce Ferry Road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 智能阵列是我们沿着皮尔斯渡轮公路建立补充补给线努力的巨大砖墙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since the Chainway collapsed, we've been more dependent on the Colorado than we want to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从连环道坍塌以来，我们对科罗拉多河的依赖已经超出了我们的想象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is supposed to ease our logistical woes, but we've had numerous problems in the area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这本来是为了缓解我们的后勤问题，但我们在这个地区遇到了很多问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is the fourth time I've asked you what are you guys doing out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我第四次问你们在这里做什么了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah. The mercantile pursuits. Steer away of the SMART Array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，商业追求。避开智能阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Invisible technologic ghosts haunt the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看不见的技术幽灵萦绕在这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On my way to Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在去克洛赖德的路上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Explore away from the SMART Array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 探险远离智能阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Invisible technologic ghosts haunt the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看不见的技术幽灵萦绕在这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just exploring Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是在亚利桑那探险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The SMART Array. I would warn you that the place is cursed by the Old World.
ESP.TRADUIT: 智能阵列。我要警告你，这地方被旧世界诅咒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Invisible technologic ghosts haunt the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看不见的技术幽灵萦绕在这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to check out that big satellite thing over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想看看那边那个大卫星。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't expect us to answer something for nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能指望我们毫无理由的回答问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have to answer your questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要回答你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're unsure. They're similar to rouge Nightkin units we're fought before, but these ghosts are almost completely silent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不确定。它们类似于我们之前战斗过的夜行族单位，但这些幽灵几乎完全沉默。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Presently, we're working under the assumption that they are robots with advanced stealth technology, but we've never actually seen them from up close.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前，我们假设它们是拥有先进隐形技术的机器人，但我们从未真正近距离观察过它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned ghosts at the SMART Array?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了智能阵列里的幽灵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our cattle are mutilated, strange lights flicker in the sky, our radios malfunction, and there is something else here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的牛被肢解了，天空中闪烁着奇怪的光，我们的无线电失灵了，这里还有别的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What other problems are there in the area?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地区还有什么其他问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not something to be shared with non-assets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是与非资产共享的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was the something else you mentioned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到的其他东西是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would be authorized to provide one, if you can find him. Of course, he's likely surrounded by Profligates. We've identified the existence of a place known as 'Haven'. Potentially a hideaway for runaway slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能找到他，我有权提供。当然，他身边很可能都是堕落者，我们发现了一个叫做“港湾”的地方。可能是逃跑奴隶的藏身之处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there a bounty on Corvus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人悬赏克渥斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, you might be useful after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，说不定你还能派上用场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A rogue Frumentarius. We have reason to believe that he caused the collapse of the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叛变的特务，我们有理由相信是他造成了连环道的倒塌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had been telling us for weaks that its integrity was failing, and that we'd be sorry if we didn't listen to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他几周来一直说这东西的结构失稳，要是不听他的，有我们后悔的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, he disappears, and the Chainway falls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，他消失了，连环道倒塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus was always an asshole, but I never expected him to lash out against us like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯一直都是个混蛋，但我从没想过他会这样攻击我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion Rep] I am a friend of the Legion. Seriously, just tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]我是军团的朋友。说真的，告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Unfortunate for you, because I am going to keep avoiding it, and there's not much you can do about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]对你来说很不幸，因为我会一直回避，而你对此无能为力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're agitating me by avoiding the question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你回避这个问题是在激怒我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm, you might be useful after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，说不定你还能派上用场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A rogue Frumentarius. We have reason to believe that he caused the collapse of the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叛变的特务，我们有理由相信是他造成了连环道的倒塌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had been telling us for weaks that its integrity was failing, and that we'd be sorry if we didn't listen to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他几周来一直说这东西的结构失稳，要是不听他的，有我们后悔的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, he disappears, and the Chainway falls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，他消失了，连环道倒塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus was always an asshole, but I never expected him to lash out against us like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯一直都是个混蛋，但我从没想过他会这样攻击我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to ask a fifth time. Answer. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会问第五遍。回答，马上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, Ahiga. Everyone likes him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，阿希加。每个人都喜欢他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A rogue Frumentarius. We have reason to believe that he caused the collapse of the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叛变的特务，我们有理由相信是他造成了连环道的倒塌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He had telling us for weaks that its integrity was failing, and that we'd be sorry if we didn't listen to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉我们这东西的结构失稳，要是不听他的，有我们后悔的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, he disappears, and the Chainway falls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，他消失了，连环道倒塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus was always an asshole, but I never expected him to lash out against us like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯一直都是个混蛋，但我从没想过他会这样攻击我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've done some work for Ahiga. That worth anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为阿希加做过一些工作，这有价值吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bounty itself, I would give a sum of 200 denarii. But, if you can find this haven, I would offer you 30 denarii for the information alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赏金本身，我会给你200第纳尔。但是，如果你能找到这个港湾，我就给你30第纳尔，单是这个信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much are you offering?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你出多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll keep a lookout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会留意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up to you. Obviously, you are to discuss this with no one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 由你决定。显然，你不能和任何人讨论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Manifestations of Old World evil. Cattle are mutilated. Radios fail.
ESP.TRADUIT: 旧世界邪恶的表现。牛被肢解，无线电失灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The place is cursed, and with the coming battle at Hoover Dam, we do not have the resources to combat it for the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个地方被诅咒了，随着胡佛大坝即将到来的战斗，我们暂时没有资源来对抗它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on at the SMART Array?
ESP.TRADUIT: 智能阵列怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd have to speak to Alba Nox in Solitare. The SMART Array operation is more or less being run by him right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得去找索利泰尔的阿尔芭·诺克斯，智能阵列的运作现在或多或少都是由他负责的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neither me nor my partner have full knowledge of all the moving parts involved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和我的搭档都不完全了解其中涉及的所有活动部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Bellius. This is a Frumentarii outpost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是伯里乌斯，这是军团特务的前哨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't have business here, then move along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在这里没什么事，那就走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This ongoing operation doesn't particularly need to stay secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这项正在进行的行动并不特别需要保密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We want people to stay away from the SMART Array.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们希望人们远离智能阵列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, what's the point in all of this knowledge if we can't let people know we know every once in a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说了，懂这么多东西要是不能时不时让别人知道还有什么意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't care that people know you're Frumentarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不在乎别人知道你是特务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Spirit Chaser. I wouldn't bother talking to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是逐灵者，我懒得和他说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He won't answer any of your questions in a straightforward manner. In fact, he'd get dizzy if he tried to walk a straight line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不会直截了当地回答你的任何问题。其实，如果他试图走直线，他就会头晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's your partner?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的搭档是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's complicated, but it's all Frumentarii politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很复杂，但这都是特务的政治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pissed off Alba Nox back when we fought the Tall Pines when one of my operations interrupted his.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我之前跟高松作战的时候惹恼了阿尔巴诺克斯，因为我的行动打断了他的行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's never forgiven me for that, so when he got the ear of Cato, he asked Cato to dump Spirit Chaser on me because of me and his... personal history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他永远不会原谅我，所以当他得到加图的支持后，他让加图把逐灵者甩给我，因为我和他的...个人历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't like your partner, why are you working with him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不喜欢你的搭档，为什么要和他一起工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius. One of Vulpes's friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，沃尔普斯的一个朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since Vulpes managed to get the position as Caesar's personal advisor, Cato's star has risen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从沃尔普斯获得了凯撒的私人顾问职位，加图的星星就升起了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's been away on some intelligence operation across the river for a while now. Has something big planned in the future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他去河对岸执行情报任务已经有一段时间了，对未来有很大的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The head of the Solitare unit. Well, I say head.
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔小组的头，好吧，我说的是头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't have to take orders from him, but Cato likes him, and Cato's usually right about these things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不必听命于他，但加图喜欢他，而且加图对这些事情的判断通常是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Alba Nox?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His head's a spiral staircase. Can't think straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的头像个螺旋形楼梯，无法清醒的思考。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can tell him I said that, by the way. It'd be funny to see his face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，你可以告诉他是我说的。看到他的脸一定很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've met Alba Nox before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前见过阿尔巴·诺克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a Painted Rock, which was one of the true civilized tribes of Arizona. He's a goddamn Mogolim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自彩绘岩，这是亚利桑那州真正的文明部落之一。而他是个该死的莫哥林人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bunch of thieving bastards. Had to routinely kick them out of our lands and away from Confederate borders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一群偷东西的混蛋。不得不经常把他们赶出我们的土地，远离邦联边境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and he was always a damn punk. Couldn't keep his mouth shut down during the parlays, either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，他一直是个该死的小混混。在战斗中他也管不住自己的嘴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talked about how his tribe was destined to conquer us. Damn insect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说他的部落注定要征服我们。该死的虫子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were uplifted by the Southwest Confederacy themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们受到了西南邦联自身的鼓舞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were carrying the torch of civilization while the Mogolim were banging rocks together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们高举文明的火炬，而莫哥林人却在敲石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have no idea how much joy it brought to me when the Mogolim elders were buried alive. Best day of my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不知道当莫哥林长老被活埋时，我有多高兴。我生命中最美好的一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your history with Spirit Chaser?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和逐灵者有什么渊源？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tribes are the only correct form of civilization. The Profligate U.S. government annihilated the world because of their failure to acknowledge that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 部落是文明的唯一正确形式，堕落的美国政府因为不承认这一点而毁灭了世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After the War, those tribes formed true nations. The Great Southwest Confederacy was the mightiest such nation in all of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战后，这些部落形成了真正的国家，大西南邦联是整个亚利桑那州最强大的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We Painted Rock were uplifted, actually taught by them how to live. The other tribes the Legion conquered are pale imitators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们彩绘岩被鼓舞了，实际上是由他们教我们如何生活。军团征服的其他部落都是苍白的模仿者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why Caesar recognizes the Confederacy as an equal. It's only natural.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么凯撒承认邦联是平等的，这是很自然的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Southwest Confederacy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是西南邦联？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some other questions about the Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有一些关于邦联的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Confederacy represents a way of life that predates mankind's deviation from Mars's vision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邦联代表了一种生活方式，早在人类偏离玛尔斯的视野之前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As such, they are chosen by Mars in much the same way Caesar is. In time, we will march on New California, and we will all become one with Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，他们被玛尔斯选中的方式和凯撒差不多。假以时日，我们将进军新加利福尼亚，我们将与玛尔斯融为一体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised Caesar recognizes anyone as an equal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶凯撒居然承认任何人是平等的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion and the Confederacy will one day become one. A monolitic, totalitarian, perfect culture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团和邦联总有一天会合二为一的。一个单一的、极权主义的、完美的文化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The highest form of civilization. On the day that happens, we will be one with Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 文明的最高形式。到那一天，我们将与玛尔斯融为一体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One with Mars? What does that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和玛尔斯融为一体？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all going to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都会死的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's what it takes to become one with Mars, then so be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这是与玛尔斯融为一体的必要条件，那就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One with Mars? You're all going to die?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和玛尔斯融为一体？你们都要死了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Piacentinus, Caesar's personal architect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是皮阿琴提乌斯，凯撒的私人建筑师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must forgive the transgression. I've, uh, been in an agitated mood for quite some time now. Let's start over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须原谅我的罪过。我，呃，情绪激动已经有一段时间了。让我们重新开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Piacentinus, Caesar's personal architect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是皮阿琴提乌斯，凯撒的私人建筑师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that you're an abrasive prick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你是个粗鲁的混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Important? I am as important as you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重要吗？我和你一样重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Piacentinus, Caesar's personal architect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是皮阿琴提乌斯，凯撒的私人建筑师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar has grand visions for the Wasteland. He has need of new men to give shape to that vision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒对废土有宏伟的愿景，他需要新人来实现这一愿景。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the first and foremost of those new men, chosen to make the world anew in His image.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这些新人中，我是第一个也是最重要的，被拣选来按照他的形象再造世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am his Michelangelo. Tasked with a new renaissance of everything in existence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是他的米开朗基罗，肩负着复兴现存万物的重任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's personal architect? What's that entail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的私人建筑师？这意味着什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is good to speak with someone interested in these things. Most Legionaries are not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与对这些事情感兴趣的人交谈是件好事，大多数军团士兵都不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about about your work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eighteen years ago, Caesar decreed that we bring the three great cities of Arizona into the 23rd century.
ESP.TRADUIT: 十八年前，凯撒下令将亚利桑那州的三大城市纳入23世纪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The great cities were to become capitals of industry, culture and administration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大城市将成为工业、文化和行政的中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sent out missives to all of the great architects of Arizona. A competition was held. Caesar demanded that we design the perfect cathedral for the Martian Cult in Two-Sun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给亚利桑那州所有伟大的建筑师都发了信，举行了一场比赛。凯撒要求我们为双日城中的玛尔斯教团设计一个完美的大教堂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I won handily.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我轻而易举的赢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you become his architect?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么成为他的建筑师的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything. I built for him amphitheaters in all the great cities, for the common man to venerate His name and learn His history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切。我在所有的大城市为他建造了圆形剧场，让普通人敬仰他的名字，学习他的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I built for Him magificent gladiatorial rings, for Liberti to prove their worth to the Legion, a chance to earn their might.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为他打造了华丽的角斗士戒指，让自由民向军团证明自己的价值，让他有机会赢得自己的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I transformed Flagstaff into the city of seven wonders. Beautiful concrete domes over the Martian Cult, obelisks for great battles, statues of our Lord on Earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把旗杆市变成了拥有七大奇迹的城市。玛尔斯教团美丽的混凝土穹顶，见证伟大战役的方尖碑，地球上我们主人的雕像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I built for him a new university in Two-Sun to rival anything in The Boneyard. Orchestral halls, museums, art galleries. All the blessings of Legion culture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在双日城为他建造了一所新的大学，足以与晒骨场的任何大学相媲美。交响乐大厅、博物馆、艺术画廊，军团文化的所有祝福。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I resurrected the city of Phoenix from the ashes of the Great Burning and built temples of industry, fed by the sweat and tears and sinew of thousands of slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从大火的灰烬中复活了凤凰城并建造了工业神殿，用成千上万奴隶的汗水、眼泪和筋骨来哺育它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In all these lands, the rebirth of Rome on Earth is complete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在所有这些土地上，罗马在地球上的重生已经完成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What have you built for Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为凯撒建造了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you might not know. The first city of Mars. The first city of true civilization.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你可能不知道。玛尔斯的第一座城市，第一座真正文明的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Its fall left a gap in the world, one that we never filled. Its successors were all pale imitations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它的陨落在世界上留下了一个空白，一个我们永远无法填补的空白。它的后继者都是苍白的模仿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Vegas? Vegas will be the new Rome. A shining city to be an example for all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是维加斯呢？维加斯将成为新的罗马，一座为所有人树立榜样的光辉城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rebirth of Rome?
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗马的重生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Caesar's pack of dogs are wholeheartedly devoted to war. History is not an immediate concern for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，凯撒的那群狗全心全意地投入战争。对他们来说，历史不是当务之急。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I've gone on long walks with Caesar about his vision for years. Sadly, these days, he is more concerned with the war. I haven't gone a walk with him for months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但多年来，我一直在和凯撒谈论他的愿景。可悲的是，这些天来，他更关心战争。我已经好几个月没有和他一起散步了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do other Legionaries not know about Rome?
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道其他军团成员不知道罗马吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A grand, magnificent palace for the son of Mars. The palace would have a magnificent forum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为玛尔斯之子建造的宏伟宫殿，这座宫殿将有一个宏伟的广场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beautiful flowing foundations, grand statues, the finest cuisine, the largest amphitheater in the known world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 美丽流动的地基，宏伟的雕像，精美的菜肴，世界上最大的圆形剧场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Memorial obelisks for the sacrifices that made the Legion possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纪念为军团而做出的牺牲的方尖碑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar will build the people, but I will build the city. The most magnificent, most cultured city in the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒建设人民，而我将建造城市。世界上最壮丽、最文明的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want to build in New Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想在新维加斯建什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What nonsense are you speaking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在胡说些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Michael Angelo? Like the Strip architect?
ESP.TRADUIT: 迈克尔·安吉洛？就跟长街的那个建筑师一样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if he's the imitating the same man, he might be of use. What does he design?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果他是在模仿同一个人，他也许能派上用场。他设计了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned a Michelangelo? Same guy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到的米开朗基罗？同一个人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen the signs from afar. There may be some use to him. I will speak to Caesar about sparing him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经从远处看到了迹象。他也许能派上用场，我要向凯撒请求饶恕他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better he work as my protege than be wasted as a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他做我的徒弟总比当奴隶好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Signs, billboards, stuff like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 招牌、广告牌之类的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be the judge of that. Assuming that the troops don't behead him in the streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那就由我来判断了。前提是军队不会把他当街斩首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would be a shame for him to become a second Archimedes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他成为第二个阿基米德，那就太可惜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, nothing really interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，没什么有趣的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The architect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 建筑师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, like the death ray?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，比如死亡射线？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it's always up to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，一切都由我决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Up to you, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就看你的了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two-Sun. The most civilized city of the Legion, of the whole world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 双日城，军团最文明的城市，全世界最文明的城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dad was a slave trader, traveling from Gente with convoys of hundreds of slaves every year. It was that hard work that allowed me to attend a trade school for architecture.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我父亲是一名奴隶贩子，每年带着数百名奴隶的车队从根特出发。正是这份努力让我进入了一所建筑专业的职业学校。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After graduation, I used my allowance to purchase a building, a number of slaves and a trade license. When Caesar arrived, I was ready to begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毕业后，我用零用钱买了一栋楼，买了一些奴隶和一张贸易许可证。凯撒到达时，我正准备开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. The slaves who died en masse laboring away for Caesar's vision should feel honored to have been part of the creative process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。为实现凯撒的愿景而集体牺牲的奴隶们应该感到荣幸，因为他们是创作过程的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The greater the vision, the greater the sacrifices needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 愿景越远大，所需要的牺牲就越大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You used slaves as workers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你用奴隶当工人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awaiting a delivery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等待送货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing at Base Camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在大本营做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know if Flemus has been up to something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道弗勒慕斯在搞什么鬼吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he isn't working for me, then he doesn't matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他不为我工作，那他就不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I have more important things to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我有更重要的事情要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take that as a no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就当你拒绝了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't. And I'm not interested in the culprit. His artistic skills appeal only to base Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不知道。我对犯人也不感兴趣，他的艺术技巧只对基层军团有吸引力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know who's been leaving graffiti around Base Camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道是谁在大本营附近乱涂乱画吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Piacentinus [0601CB92] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think so, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么认为！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, friend, I'm sure the customers will be pouring in now that we've livened this place up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友，我相信顾客们会蜂拥而至的，因为我们把这个地方搞活了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As promised, your bonus commission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照约定，给你额外的佣金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoops, almost forgot! I'll take back my checkbook now. I knew I could trust you with it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，差点忘了！我现在要拿回我的支票簿，我就知道可以放心交给你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think my job here is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为我的任务完成了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think so, too!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么认为！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, friend, I'm sure the customers will be pouring in now that we've livened this place up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友，我相信顾客们会蜂拥而至的，因为我们让这里热闹起来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As promised, your bonus commission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照约定，给你额外的佣金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think my job here is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为我的任务完成了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, what have you got for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你给我带来了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About the curios you requested...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你要的古董...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes! Yes! I'm so glad you asked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有的！有的！我很高兴你问了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may have noticed that my vestibule, impressive as it may be, is lacking in essential character. It's incomplete!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能已经注意到，我的前厅，虽然给人留下了深刻的印象，但缺乏基本的特色。这是不完整的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is why I am in need of an arbiter of procurement. Specifically, a field arbiter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我需要一个采购权威人士，确切的说，一个领域权威人士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work available?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们有工作要做吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahaha I knew you'd coming crawling back, you son of a bitch! Lucky I'm such a charitable employer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊哈哈，我就知道你会爬回来的，你这个狗娘养的！幸运的是我是一个如此仁慈的雇主。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here's the rundown: I still need a haunted artifact, a magnificent beast rendered stuffed...
ESP.TRADUIT: 下面是概要：我还需要一个闹鬼的文物，一只被做成标本华丽的野兽，呈现出一种...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...couture of a cutting-edge style, and a *perfect* fucking rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...前沿风格的填充时尚，还有一块该死的*完美*石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I changed my mind about the job. I'll help you grow your collection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我改变了对这份工作的看法，我会帮你增加藏品的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Degauss? You dingbat, I was just pulling your leg so you'd help me out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 消磁吗？你这个傻瓜，我只是在跟你开玩笑，好让你帮帮我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I did already pay you, so I'd call us even.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但我已经付过你钱了，所以我们扯平了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I held up my end of the deal. Will you degauss me now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我履行了我的承诺。你现在能消磁我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this? I need you... to find more curios... for my collection!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样如何？我需要你...寻找更多的古玩...为了我的收藏！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure I follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太明白你的意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell yes! That's my offer. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太对了！这就是我的提议。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need me to go out and find more stuff for your museum?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要我出去为你的博物馆找更多的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, man, look: the point of this here venture isn't to go out picking through street litter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，伙计，听着：在这里冒险的目的不是出去捡街上的垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, we're panning for golden fucking nuggets. Or rather: you are; or would-slash-will be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我们他妈的在淘金。或者更确切的说：你在，
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got just a few gewgaws that have caught my mind's eye, but someone needs to go out and get them, and someone else needs to sit here and take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这儿有几件吸引眼球的小玩意，总得有人跑腿去取，有人坐镇来收。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's my offer. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我的提议。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you need help finding junk? Isn't it lying around literally everywhere?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要找人帮你找垃圾？不是到处都是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see how it is. You're an avaricious bastard, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我明白了。你是个贪得无厌的杂种，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, here's the up-and-up: I will reimburse you for each item procured, with a generous bonus upon full completion of the job. Deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，事情是这样的，我将为你购买的每一件物品报销，并在工作完全完成时给予慷慨的奖金。成交？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you haven't offered me anything yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，你还没给我任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, listen up cause I'm only gonna say this once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，听好了，因为我只说一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need: a haunted artifact, a magnificent beast rendered stuffed...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要，一个闹鬼的文物，一只被做成标本的华丽的野兽，呈现出一种...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...couture of a cutting-edge style, and a *perfect* fucking rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...前沿风格的填充时尚，还有一块该死的*完美*石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Depends. What are you looking for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看情况。你在找什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, listen up cause I'm only gonna say this once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，听好了，因为我只说一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need: a haunted artifact, a magnificent beast rendered stuffed...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要，一个闹鬼的文物，一只被做成标本的华丽的野兽，呈现出一种...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...couture of a cutting-edge style, and a *perfect* fucking rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...前沿风格的填充时尚，还有一块该死的*完美*石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds good to me. What are you looking for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错。你在找什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, sounds like a waste of my time. Go find someone else to be your errand-boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，听起来像是在浪费我的时间。去找别人给你跑腿吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Possessed by a ghost or something. An item so fucking cursed that just looking at it makes your eyeballs shiver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 被鬼什么的附身了。一件该死的被诅咒的东西，光是看就会让你的眼球发抖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could bring me a chair permanently stained with the sweat off Satan's nutsack; I'll still take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以给我拿来一把椅子，上面沾满了撒旦阴囊上的汗渍，我也会收下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean by "haunted?"
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的“闹鬼”是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, man, you know what I'm talking about. Some kind of huge animal with five or even ten legs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，伙计，你知道我在说什么。某种有五条甚至十条腿的巨大动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only not still alive so I don't get fucking eaten. We're looking for a taxidermal magnum opus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是不能活着，这样我就不会被吃掉了。我们要找的是巨型标本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But yeah, get one with as many legs as you can find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是是的，你可以找一个有很多腿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A magnificent beast rendered stuffed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一只被做成标本的华丽野兽？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. I need something of real substance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。我需要一些实实在在的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Couture? You want me to find you fancy clothes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 前沿风格？你想让我给你找些漂亮衣服吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice clothes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 漂亮的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Couture? What does that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 前沿风格？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...And a rock?
ESP.TRADUIT: ...还有一块石头？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd be surprised. Once Calvin Hanson and his thugs took over, the good stuff stopped coming in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会大吃一惊的。一旦加尔文·汉森和他的暴徒掌权，好东西就不再来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now all the caravans ever have to trade is soap. And they don't even come in the animal shapes anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在所有的商队交易的都是肥皂，它们甚至不再是动物的形状了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: None of this stuff sounds particularly hard to come by.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些东西听起来都不难弄到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told you that I saw it with my mind's eye. These plans cannot be conveyed with primitive words.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉过你，我是用心灵之眼看到的。这些计划不能用原始的语言来表达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should have received a copy via telepathic link, but... I think something has gone totally FUBAR with the airwaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该通过心灵感应收到一份副本，但是...我觉得有些东西跟电波完全脱节了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, are we under attack? No, I think it's you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我们被攻击了吗？不，我觉得是你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the fuck have you been talking to? Answer me, dammit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈在跟谁说话？回答我，可恶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want all these things for? Are they going in the same collection?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要这些东西做什么？它们是同一个系列吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] No, no, of course not! I'll lend you my checkbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]不，不，当然不是！我把我的支票簿借给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't spend my money on anything I wouldn't!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别把我的钱花在我不想花的东西上！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like I'll be doing all the work here. You expect me to pay for your stuff out of pocket?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来这里的活儿都是我干的，你想让我自掏腰包买你的东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] No can do! That's just the cost of doing business, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]无能为力！恐怕这就是做生意的成本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As long as you're thrifty, I guarantee you'll make your money back tenfold!
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要你勤俭节约，我保证你会赚回十倍的钱！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A couple of these sound awfully pricey. I want my payment up front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个听起来很贵，我要求提前付款。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to hear. I hope you're ready for the dumpster dive of a lifetime!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就好。我希望你已经准备好迎接一生中最难忘的一次垃圾箱之旅了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll hunt down those knickknacks for you, Nic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你找到那些小玩意的，尼哥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew you would say that. You're an unreliable partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就知道你会这么说，你是个靠不住的搭档。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I also know you'll change your mind. That's what makes you so reliable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我也知道你会改变主意的，这就是为什么你这么可靠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'm actually not super stoked about this. I think I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，其实我对这个也不是特别感兴趣。我想我还是算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check, uh... Elephant Hill. Yeah, that old place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 检查，呃...象山。嗯，就是那个老地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Super goddamn spooky, man, you wouldn't believe it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太他妈诡异了，伙计，你不会相信的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's even run by a zombie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甚至是由僵尸运营的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where would I even find something like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我上哪儿去找这样的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I mean I'm looking for nice clothes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是说我在找漂亮的衣服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Blush.> Why thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <脸红>谢谢你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not on the up-and-up regarding that stuff. You'll know it when you see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，关于那件事我并不是实话实说。你看到的时候就知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you be more specific?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能说得更具体点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't bring me a watch. You hear me? There will be no fucking watches under this roof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别给我带手表就行了。听到了吗？这房子里再也不会有他妈的手表了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll uh... be on the lookout then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会呃...那就小心点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it. The rocks here are shit. No one wants these rocks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说对了。这里的岩石都是狗屎，没人想要这些石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go look somewhere where there are rocks that people actually want, like Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找一些人们真正想要的石头，比如克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But not just any rock...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但不是随便一块石头...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what I said? Silver isn't a fucking rock, you dingbat. Rocks aren't shiny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是这么说的吗？银又不是石头，你个笨蛋。岩石没有光泽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring me a rock that's buttery to the touch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我拿一块摸起来像黄油的石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been to Chloride; they mine silver there. Is that what you're looking for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去过克洛赖德，他们在那里开采银矿。这是你要找的吗?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just down the road, man. It's the place with the big sign and the big hole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这条路上，伙计。就是那个有大招牌和大洞的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normal color. Last thing we want is people thinking we're up to some pinko nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 普通颜色。我们最不希望看到的就是人们认为我们在做一些卑鄙的勾当。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And it needs to be flawless and fit in the palm of my hand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它需要完美无瑕，适合我的手掌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you looking for a certain color, shape, or...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在寻找某种颜色、形状还是...？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uhm... because I would know? You aren't finding any good rocks around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔...因为我会知道？你在这附近找不到好石头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, my olfactory system is impeccable; I could trace any rock you bring me down down to a quarter foot of where you found it within an 80 mile radius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，我的嗅觉系统无可挑剔。你带给我的任何一块石头，我都能追踪到方圆80英里的四分之一英尺内。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if you tried to dupe me, I would simply report you for commercial fraud, and the authorities would sort it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想骗我，我只会以商业欺诈的罪名举报你，然后由当局来解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's stopping me from bringing you a rock I find ten feet out that door?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么阻止我给你带一块我在门外十英尺处找到的石头？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better make it the best rock!
ESP.TRADUIT: 最好让它成为最好的石头！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I promise I'll bring you a great rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我保证给你带块大石头来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was talking about Calvin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是加尔文。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They have a hole in the ground, too, but watch your step cause the real rock bottom there is a cruel place called Cyanide Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地上也有一个洞，但要小心脚下，因为真正的底部是一个叫山奈泉的残酷地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
