ESP.ORIGINAL: Big hole? Is there a mine there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大洞？那里有矿井吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cyanide Springs is kind of like Hell without any of the redeeming qualities. It's hot and full of roving bands of psycho sinners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 山奈泉有点像没有任何可取之处的地狱。那里很热，到处都是成群的神经病罪犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes you say that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么说？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talking about the fucking airwaves, man! Tell me who you're working for!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是他妈的电波，伙计！快告诉我你是谁的手下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit, I should've known. We've been compromised!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，我早该知道的。我们有麻烦了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, calm down, man. Keep it together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，冷静点，伙计。振作一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I think those sons of bitches caught you unawares. You must have really pissed them off because I've never seen anything like this before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我觉得那群混蛋打了你一个措手不及。你一定把他们惹毛了，因为我从来没见过这种事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good that you found me. Only I know how to degauss you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你找到了我，只有我知道如何消磁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... Well I have been talking to Priestess Calventia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...我和女祭司卡文提亚谈过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That rat-faced motherfucker? Agh, we've been compromised!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个老鼠脸的王八蛋？我们有麻烦了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, calm down, man. Keep it together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，冷静点，伙计。振作一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I think those sons of bitches caught you unawares. You must have really pissed them off because I've never seen anything like this before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我觉得那群混蛋打了你一个措手不及。你一定把他们惹毛了，因为我从来没见过这种事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good that you found me. Only I know how to degauss you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你找到了我，只有我知道如何消磁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I may have made Calvin's acquaintance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可能认识了加尔文。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I? Are you? Who's asking the questions here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？你呢？谁在问问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, me! Now tell me who you're working for!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，就是我！现在告诉我你为谁卖命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you on drugs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吸毒了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I? Are you? Who's asking the questions here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我？你呢？谁在问问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, me! Now tell me who you're working for!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，就是我！现在告诉我你为谁卖命！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you insane?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you're lying. You can't hide the truth from me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你在撒谎，你不能对我隐瞒真相！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The Legion sent me here to spy on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>军团派我来监视你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't fool me, man. Spill the goddamn beans!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你骗不了我的，伙计。快给我说出来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The NCR sent me here to spy on you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>NCR派我来监视你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't a solo op. No how, no way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是单人行动，没可能，不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one, I swear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人，我发誓！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dammit, I am calm! Okay, okay, I know you're innocent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，我很冷静！好了好了，我知道你是无辜的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I think those sons of bitches caught you unawares. You must have really pissed them off because I've never seen anything like this before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我觉得那群混蛋打了你一个措手不及。你一定把他们惹毛了，因为我从来没见过这种事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good that you found me. Only I know how to degauss you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你找到了我，只有我知道如何消磁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, just calm down, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，冷静点，好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Okay, man, calm down, don't leave. I know you're innocent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！好了，伙计，冷静点，别走。我知道你是无辜的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen, I think those sons of bitches caught you unawares. You must have really pissed them off because I've never seen anything like this before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我觉得那群混蛋打了你一个措手不及。你一定把他们惹毛了，因为我从来没见过这种事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good that you found me. Only I know how to degauss you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴你找到了我，只有我知道如何消磁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck this, I'm out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去他妈的，我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, man, ignorance is bliss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，老兄，无知是福。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you still interested in helping me out, or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还想帮我吗，还是怎样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I see where this is going. I'm not interested in hearing your rants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我明白你的意思了。我没兴趣听你的夸夸其谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax. You can just take it off when you're ready for the procedure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放松。等你准备好手术了就可以取下来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep your degaussers the hell away from me! You'll wipe my damn Pip-Boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的消磁器离我远点！你要把我的哔哔小子给弄坏了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Them and the rest of the NCR-Legion-Military-Agricultural-Fucking-Complex. They're after us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们和其他的NCR-军团-军事-农业-复合体。他们在追我们俩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, who's "they?" You think the Cult are behind this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，“他们”是谁？"你认为教团是幕后主使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Them and the rest of the NCR-Legion-Military-Agricultural-Fucking-Complex. They're after us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们和其他的NCR-军团-军事-农业-复合体。他们在追我们俩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, who's "they?" You think White Sands is behind this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，“他们”是谁？"你觉得白沙是幕后主使吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus. The fucking NCR-Legion-Military-Agricultural Complex, man. They're after us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老天，该死的NCR-军团-军事-农业-复合体。他们在追我们俩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's "they?"
ESP.TRADUIT: “他们”是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They scrambled your mind wires; the Microley Lines in your skull. Probably while you had your back turned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们扰乱了你的思维线路，你头骨里的微型能量线，可能是在你背过身去的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've been mentally severed from the global unconscious!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经在精神上与全球潜意识分离了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh oh... What did they do to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃哦...他们对我做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, "thinking" is the ticket. We've trespassed on NCR-Legion government thought-property, and that makes us thought-criminals!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看，“认为”就是关键。我们已经侵犯了NCR-军团政府的思想财产，这使我们成为思想罪犯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you an artist, too? Do you have an active imagination? It makes you prone to wandering in your dreams.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也是个艺术家吗？你有丰富的想象力吗？它会让你容易在梦中徘徊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what did me in. I stumbled onto their thought-property by total accident!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我的下场。我完全是偶然发现了他们的思想财产！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw things I wasn't supposed to, and now they've got me in their crosshairs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到了不该看到的东西，现在他们又盯上了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My life has been going downhill ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后，我的生活每况愈下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are they after me? I don't think I've done anything wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么要追我？我不认为我做错了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, man, I'm right as rain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，伙计，我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're really crazy, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的疯了，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most people don't know that the Legion and NCR are in kahoots. Them and the deep state financiers like White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人不知道军团和NCR是互相勾结的，他们和像白沙这样的深层政府金融家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This war is a fucking farce. It's an excuse to uproot us honest, hardworking folks, and steal our land. They want to convert it all into cattle pastures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这场战争就是他妈的闹剧。这是一个借口，让我们这些诚实、勤劳的人背井离乡，偷走我们的土地，他们想把这里全部改造成牧场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you're saying the Legion *and* the NCR are after us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说军团*和*NCR在追我们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, man, get ahold of yourself. The degaussing process takes a long time to set up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，老兄，控制住你自己。消磁过程需要很长时间来设置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Help me first, and I promise I'll get you working again, good as new.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先帮我，我保证让你重新工作，焕然一新。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck? Degauss me then!
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？那消磁我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare me your neo-urban academic prattle, you dingbat wino.
ESP.TRADUIT: 省省你那些新城市的学术废话吧，你个傻逼酒鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Raise finger.> Erm, I'm fairly certain that telepathy isn't backed by science!
ESP.TRADUIT: <举起手指>呃，我很确定心灵感应是没有科学依据的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because their bastard alien overlords told them to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们的杂种外型领主让他们这么做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would they do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm talking little green men with ray guns and space suits. They want our goddamn cows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说的是拿着射线枪穿着太空服的小绿人，他们想要我们的牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You believe in aliens?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信有外星人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course you do! I can tell you've got some genius in your bones. Stay in school, now; don't let it go to waste!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当然相信！我能看出来你骨子里是个天才。现在，留在学校里，别浪费了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in aliens, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也相信有外星人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'm not saying I believe in them either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我也不是说我相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I do believe in evidence, and said evidence points to only one conclusion...
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我相信证据，而且我说的证据只指向一个结论...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure that I believe in aliens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定我是否相信外星人的存在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I've seen lots. Some strange folks come into the store on occasion, like you, but sometimes they're extra weird.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我见过很多。偶尔会有一些奇怪的人来店里，比如你，但有时他们特别奇怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: First, you notice their proportions are all wrong. Then you realize they're wearing false faces, and wigs, and dentures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 首先，你注意到它们的比例都是错误的。然后你意识到他们戴着假脸，假发和假牙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they talk at you like they aren't used to speaking our language. Aliens in disguise!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们和你说话的样子就像他们不习惯说我们的语言一样。外星人伪装的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever even seen an alien?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过外星人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: From planet Mars! Isn't it obvious with what those Legion ladies always barking about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自火星！从那些军团的女人们经常说的那些话里，还看不出来吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They come here in flying saucers. I've seen lights in the sky that prove it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们坐着飞碟来到这里，我在天上看到的光就能证明这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you think they're coming from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他们是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Man, I have no idea. That's what fucking terrifies me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，我不知道。这就是他妈的让我害怕的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what would aliens want with our cows?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是外星人要我们的牛做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah? What's that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是吗？那是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell you what I think about all of this...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来告诉你我对这一切的看法...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Holy shit... Like a cow museum for a space general store?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天呐...就像太空杂货店里的奶牛博物馆？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to look into this theory. For now, do not tell *anyone* else what you know, or we'll both be dead meat. Got it, motherfucker?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要研究一下这个理论。现在，不要把你知道的事情告诉*任何人*，否则我们都会死的。明白了吗，混蛋？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think they might be working on a collection of their own?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他们有可能在创作自己的作品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has everything to do with them. All signs point to supernatural forces at work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这和他们有很大关系，所有迹象都表明是超自然力量在起作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The most plausible theory is that these are the doings of restless bovine spirits, trying to save their kind from a fate worse than death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最合理的理论是，这些都是焦躁不安的牛鬼魂的行为，试图拯救它们的同类免于比死亡更糟糕的命运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suspect said spirits were conjured by some kind of ritualistic cow suicide cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑这些鬼魂是被某种牛自杀仪式召出来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it sounds fucking crazy, but it's true!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这听起来很疯狂，但这是真的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would this have anything to do with the mysterious cattle mutilations people are talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这和人们谈论的神秘的肢解牛事件有什么关系吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's just your opinion, man. But if I might say so, I think it takes some *nuts* to own up to the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那只是你的看法，伙计。但如果我可以这么说的话，我认为需要一些*疯子*来承认真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gotta say, it felt good to get all that shit off my chest. Now what were we talking about before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说，把那些破事一吐为快的感觉真好。我们之前说了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, the curio hunting. Are you in or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，猎取古玩。你到底要不要加入？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You. Are. Nuts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，疯，了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell, I'm sorry for popping your truth cherry, but we're both in this together, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 见鬼，抱歉戳破了你的真相幻想，但我们如今同坐一条船了，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gotta say, it felt good to get all that shit off my chest. Now what were we talking about before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说，把那些破事一吐为快的感觉真好。我们之前说了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, the curio hunting. Are you in or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，猎取古玩。你到底要不要加入？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm terrified, frankly. Aliens? Ghosts? Politics? It's all too much for me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白说，我很害怕。外星人？鬼魂？政治？这对我来说太难了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whew, for a second there I thought you were gonna tell me I'm crazy or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呼，我还以为你会说我疯了什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gotta say, it felt good to get all that shit off my chest. Now what were we talking about before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说，把那些破事一吐为快的感觉真好。我们之前说了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, the curio hunting. Are you in or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，猎取古玩。你到底要不要加入？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm impressed that you figured all of this out on your own. It makes perfect sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很佩服你能自己搞清楚这一切，这完全说得通。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I respect that. It's not really about what you think these days, it's about what you *see*.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尊重这一点。这年头，真正重要的不是你怎么想，而是你*看到*了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gotta say, it felt good to get all that shit off my chest. Now what were we talking about before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得说，把那些破事一吐为快的感觉真好。我们之前说了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right, the curio hunting. Are you in or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，猎取古玩。你到底要不要加入？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, I don't think anything of it after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧，我根本没把它当回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can try, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以试试，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was wondering if you could clarify something for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道你能否为我澄清一件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, looks legit to me. Nice work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，在我看来是合法的。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Show certificate.> Bam, officially haunted!
ESP.TRADUIT: <出示证书>嘭，正式闹鬼了！

ESP.ORIGINAL: It could be. Do you have a certificate of authenticity from a licensed divinator?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有可能。你有执照占卜师颁发的真品证书吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this ancient phonautograph that plays sound with no record. That means it's haunted, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了这个古老的留声机，它没有记录就能发出声音。这意味着这里闹鬼了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real or not, I'll leave it to the experts to decide whether or not we can call this thing haunted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论真假，我还是要让专家们来决定，我们是否可以称之为闹鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or else you could dig up something that's already been certified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者你可以挖出一些已经被认证的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dude, ghosts probably aren't even real. Just take the fucking phonautograph, will you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 伙计，鬼魂可能都不是真的。就把他妈的留声机拿去，行吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, what did you just call it? Keep your voice down! I don't think that's an appropriate title to use in a family establishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你刚才叫它什么？小声点！我觉得在家族机构里用这个头衔不太合适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But yeah, man, you did good with this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，伙计，这次你做得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not a lot of legs, though. Guess I'll have to make some personal modifications.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然没有很多腿，看来我得做些个人修改了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see the Pimp Guai made it here in one piece.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到那个皮条怪毫发无损的来到了这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gave you my checkbook, didn't I? Go hire some teamsters to haul it over!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把支票簿给你了，对吧？去找个赶车的把它拖过来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would ask the Tres Leches guys up near Elephant Hill. We don't want White Sands' grubby paws anywhere near this project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问问象山附近的三人行商队，我们不想让白沙商队的肮脏爪子靠近这个项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a stuffed bear you might be interested in, but there's no way I can move it here by myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一个你可能会感兴趣的毛绒熊，但我一个人没法把它搬过来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then go hire some teamsters to haul it over!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去雇几个赶车的把它拖过来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would ask the Tres Leches guys up near Elephant Hill. We don't want White Sands' grubby paws anywhere near this project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问问象山附近的三人行商队，我们不想让白沙商队的肮脏爪子靠近这个项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found a stuffed bear you might be interested in, but there's no way I can move it here by myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到了一个你可能会感兴趣的毛绒熊，但我一个人没法把它搬过来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Show me the goods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我看看货。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were looking for some stylish clothes? I might have something for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在找时髦的衣服吗？我可能有东西给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, wow! Have you done this before? He looks practically unrecognizable with that sheen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，哇！你以前做过吗？他的光泽简直让人认不出来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I must confess, I've grown quite attached to the little fella. I don't think I could stomach to see him devoured for lunch by some mud-crusted yokel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我得承认，我越来越喜欢这小家伙了。我可不想看到他被一个土包子当午餐吃掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I must adopt him. Hope Nixon doesn't get jealous!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我必须收养他，希望尼哥生不会吃醋！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Show rock.> Here. Squeaky clean.
ESP.TRADUIT: <出示石头>给你。一尘不染。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is good. Real good! But, I need to know, have you tasted it for purity?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很好，真的很好！但我需要知道，你检测过它的纯度了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Show rock.> I found this rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: <出示石头>我找到了这块石头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, hurry up, then. Jesus!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就快点。天啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still looking for them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在找呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you or do you not have a certificate of authenticity from a licensed divinator?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是否有执照占卜师颁发的真品证书？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 像什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I see it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能让我看看吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No? Then I'll assume you *don't* actually have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有？那我就假设你“没有”检测。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我检测过了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, I hope this wasn't expensive. If you can't prove that it's actually haunted then it's fucking worthless to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，我希望这不会太贵。如果你不能证明它真的闹鬼，那它对我来说就一文不值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wasn't there someone in town qualified for this? I think his name was Tax. Get his verdict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 镇上就没有合适的人选吗？我想他的名字是塔克斯，得到他的结论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where would I find a licensed divinator?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我到哪里去找有执照的占卜师？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hm... I do see the value in that enigma. Alright, then. I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯...我确实看到了这个谜的价值。好吧，我就要它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, isn't it more mysterious if you don't know whether or not it's really haunted?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，不知道是不是真的闹鬼，不是更神秘吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I empathize with you, man. No, really, I do!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我很同情你，伙计。不，真的，我喜欢！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can't have you bloating up my collection with worthless junk. Sorry!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我不能让你用毫无价值的垃圾来充实我的收藏。对不起！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does it matter to you if it's really haunted or not? I went through hell to get this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你管它是不是真的闹鬼呢？我费了九牛二虎之力才拿到这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back with a certificate, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我会带着证书回来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that's a fucking marvel right there. Would you look at all that tape and fine leather?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈真是个奇迹。你看看那些胶带和精美的皮革？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我收下了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Present Piss-Stained Jacket.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呈上沾满尿渍的夹克>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the NCR flag pin? And the blood stains?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR国旗别针是怎么回事？那些血迹呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm sure it'll make a fine conversation piece. I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我相信这会是一个很好的谈资。我就要它了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Present President Kimball's suit.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呈上金博尔总统的西装>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was hoping for something more inspired than this, but I guess I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望能有比这更有灵感的东西，但我想我还是接受吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Present Dapper Gambler Suit.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呈上整洁赌客服装>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was hoping for something more inspired than this, but I guess I'll take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望能有比这更有灵感的东西，但我想我还是接受吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Present Fancy Gambler Suit.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <呈上花哨赌客服装>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you steal those clothes from an orphanage for mutants? I'm not touching them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些衣服是你从变种人的孤儿院偷来的吗？我不会碰它们的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Rummage through inventory.> Do any of these catch your eye?
ESP.TRADUIT: <翻找背包>这些有吸引你的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then get the fuck out of here!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就给我滚出去！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah forget it, I don't have anything after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，算了吧，我什么也没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以...想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I must have forgotten. <Taste rock.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <品尝石头>哦，我一定是忘了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't give me that crap! Some kind of professional rock poacher you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我说这种废话！你还真是个专业的石头偷猎者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you even licensed? You should be investigated for fraud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有执照吗？你应该因欺诈被调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell no I'm not putting it in my mouth!
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的，我才不要把它放进嘴里！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, so you can poison me and rob my store blind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么，好让你给我下毒然后洗劫我的商店吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice try, asshole. You first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想得美，混蛋。你先来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you taste it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不尝尝呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... thoughts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以...想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, fine. <Taste rock.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <品尝石头>好的，好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see it! Mmm... yes, granite tang with hints of stale urine, species Canis Lupus...
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看！嗯...对，花岗岩的味道中带着不新鲜的尿液，狼种类...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, scratch that, Canis Familiaris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，别这么说，是家犬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This stone has promise, but I can't accept it in this condition. Why, it would be downright unethical for our edible geology exhibit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这块石头很有前途，但在这种情况下我不能接受它。对我们的食用地质学展览来说，这简直是不道德的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Spit take.> Tastes like a fucking dirty rock!
ESP.TRADUIT: <喷出>尝起来就像一块他妈的脏石头！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see it! Mmm... yes, granite tang with hints of stale urine, species Canis Lupus...
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看！嗯...对，花岗岩的味道中带着不新鲜的尿液，狼种类...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, scratch that, Canis Familiaris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，别这么说，是家犬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This stone has promise, but I can't accept it in this condition. Why, it would be downright unethical for our edible geology exhibit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这块石头很有前途，但在这种情况下我不能接受它。对我们的食用地质学展览来说，这简直是不道德的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Lead Belly] Mmm... Yum!
ESP.TRADUIT: [铅肚皮]嗯...好吃！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're unfamiliar? In the Pre-War days, rocks were considered a rare delicacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不熟悉？在战前，石头被认为是一种罕见的美味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They used to sell boxes of them as candy in this very store.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这家店里，经常把它们当糖果卖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I've knocked back enough to know that not all stones are fit for consumption! This one just needs to be cleaned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我已经敲了足够多的石头，知道不是所有的石头都适合食用！这个只需要清洗一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, your *what* exhibit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不好意思，你的“什么”展品？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好嘞。 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had me go through all of that trouble to find this rock... just so you could eat it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我费了那么大劲才找到这块石头...就为了吃它？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you mosey on over to the springhouse and give it a nice bath?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不去温泉屋好好洗个澡呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, for grooming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，梳洗用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what do you want me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你想让我做什么？ ?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I almost hate to say it, but something is still missing here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我不想这么说，但这里还是少了点什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take these. You know what do with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这些，你知道该怎么处理它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So take it, then. Just take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就拿去吧，拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw hell, I suppose I can do this part myself. Give it here, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊见鬼，我想这部分我可以自己做。那就给我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to me kidding me. Nic, just take the fucking rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在跟我开玩笑。尼哥，把那该死的石头拿走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus God almighty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 全能的主耶稣！！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You cheating bastard! I'll kill you! <Attack.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>你这个骗人的混蛋！我要杀了你！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh no, that part was all true. You never can trust those bastards, so stay vigilant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦不，那部分都是真的。你永远不能相信那些混蛋，所以要保持警惕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, so there is no NCR-Legion-Military-Agricultural Complex after all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，所以根本就没有NCR-军团-军事-农业复合体吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sure? What else you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定？你还需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was all I needed to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只需要知道这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually have something similar. I just never expected to see Caesar's. You must be very impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我也有类似的东西，我只是没想到能看到凯撒的。你一定很厉害吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually have something similar. I just never expected to see Caesar's. You must be very impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我也有类似的东西，我只是没想到能看到凯撒的。你一定很厉害吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you're jealous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你在嫉妒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm but a humble general goods trader. The money I make here, I send to my family back home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个不起眼的杂货商。我在这里赚的钱，都寄给家乡的家人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, I'm not from around here. I'm from Fairpark, in the south of Colorado. It's quite a ways away, but you travel pretty quickly on Caesar's roads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我不是这附近的人，我来自科罗拉多州南部的费尔帕克。虽然路途遥远，但在凯撒的道路上走得很快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's your deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你做什么生意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, of course!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们有什么要卖的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize, but I cannot, in good conscience, provide service to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但出于良心，我不能为你提供服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have anything for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们有什么要卖的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed I do. In my possession is the Mark of the Frumentarii. It was gifted to me in recognition of my service to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确是这样，我手上有军团特务的徽记。这是为了表彰我对军团的贡献而赠送给我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you have something similar to the Mark of Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你有类似凯撒徽记的东西？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What more is there to say about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么可说的呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about your Mark of the Frumentarii again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能再谈谈你的军团特务徽记吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The pious kind. A lifetime of prayer and works done in His honor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虔诚的那种。一生的祷告和为他的荣耀所做的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What service did you perform for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为军团做了什么贡献？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You speak the truth. From one servant of Caesar to another, I will tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的是实话。同为凯撒的仆人，我会告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I move goods for the Frumentarii across the great territories of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为特务在军团的广袤领土上运送货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't usually hand out these Marks for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团通常不会无缘无故地发这些徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see no reason I should tell you what I've done to earn Caesar's grace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有理由告诉你我做了什么来赢得凯撒的恩宠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't usually hand out these Marks for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团通常不会无缘无故地发这些徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is more to it than that. You will understand in time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情远不止如此，你迟早会明白的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It isn't that special. I got my Mark just for meeting with the head of a casino.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么特别的。我就是因为见了赌场老板才拿到了我的徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... suppose so? I never stated otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...想是这样？我从来没有说过别的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Mark is better than yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的徽记比你的好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here? I'm praying. To Mars, of course. And His holy son - Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里？我在祈祷，当然是向玛尔斯，还有他的圣子，凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dissolute, not Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放荡者，不是堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are all born Dissolute sinners. If we were not wicked, the Lord God wouldn't have had to send us His son a second time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们生来都是放荡的罪人。如果我们不邪恶，主神就不会把他的儿子第二次送到我们这里来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You believe in Mars? But you're a Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信玛尔斯吗？但你是个堕落者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't know? We're not supposed to speak his name. Though I can tell you that it begins with a J.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不知道？我们不能说出他的名字。不过我可以告诉你是以J开头的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A second time? What was the first?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二次？第一次是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed I am. You're not? What do you believe in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实是。你不是吗？你信仰什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you're one of those people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你就是那种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But not my God? Not Mars? Hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但不是我的神？不是玛尔斯？嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in God.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, fascinating! Brahma, perhaps? You're a rare breed, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太棒了！也许是梵天？你真是个稀有品种，我的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe in multiple Gods.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我信仰多个神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many people feel similarly. I can't understand it, myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多人都有类似的感觉。我自己也不明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm spiritual, but I don't worship a God.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有信仰，但我不崇拜神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. You're free to do that. One day, every nonbeliever, even you, will acknowledge the truth of the Lord God.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你可以这么做。有一天，每一个不信主的人，包括你，都会承认主神的真理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe in any God.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信任何神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It truly breaks my heart to meet people so smugly ignorant, and so sure of their ignorance. I don't expect to change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到如此自鸣得意的无知之人，如此确信自己的无知，我真的很伤心。我不指望能改变你的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That religion crap is all fake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些宗教废话都是假的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most people who say such things really just haven't thought about it very hard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数说这些话的人其实只是没有认真想过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It's hard to say what's out there for certain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。很难说有什么是确定的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever floats your boat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你的便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it. Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了。我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this? Herbal? No thank you. I try to keep my body pure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？草药？不了，谢谢，我尽量保持身体的纯净。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you want to begin with a J? <Offer him a Brush joint.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你想以J开头？<给他一根狐尾草烟>

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man? Let him reign in Hell with his Cainite savages. The sword of God shall come for him eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人？让他和他的迦南野蛮人一起统治地狱吧，神之剑终将为他而来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I am speaking of Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我说的是基督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lord God sent us His son once as a messenger, many years ago. The Profligates of that time turned on God's messenger and crucified him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年前，上帝曾派他的儿子来作使者。当时的放荡者背弃了上帝的使者，将他钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This time, God is not so merciful. As Mars, He sent us the holy Caesar. It is Caesar's job to bring humanity to salvation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一次，上帝不再那么仁慈了。玛尔斯，他给我们送来了神圣的凯撒，拯救人类是凯撒的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then you get to trinitary theory, which is the idea that Jesus Christ *is* Mars, just as Caesar is the second coming of Jesus. But I won't bore you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后是三位一体理论，也就是耶稣基督是玛尔斯，就像凯撒是耶稣的第二次降临一样。不过我就不烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Joshua... Graham?
ESP.TRADUIT: 约书亚...格拉汉姆？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! He was but a false prophet, but one with a very enduring myth. You'll find many of his acolytes out in Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！他只是一个虚假的先知，但却有着一个经久不衰的神话。你可以在科罗拉多找到他的许多追随者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I am speaking of Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我说的是基督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lord God sent us His son once as a messenger, many years ago. The Profligates of that time turned on God's messenger and crucified him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年前，上帝曾派他的儿子来作使者。当时的放荡者背弃了上帝的使者，将他钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This time, God is not so merciful. As Mars, He sent us the holy Caesar. It is Caesar's job to bring humanity to salvation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一次，上帝不再那么仁慈了。玛尔斯，他给我们送来了神圣的凯撒，拯救人类是凯撒的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then you get to trinitary theory, which is the idea that Jesus Christ *is* Mars, just as Caesar is the second coming of Jesus. But I won't bore you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后是三位一体理论，也就是耶稣基督是玛尔斯，就像凯撒是耶稣的第二次降临一样。不过我就不烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Joseph Smith.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约瑟夫·史密斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that would be the one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，就是这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lord God sent us His son once as a messenger, many years ago. The Profligates of that time turned on God's messenger and crucified him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年前，上帝曾派他的儿子来作使者。当时的放荡者背弃了上帝的使者，将他钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This time, God is not so merciful. As Mars, He sent us the holy Caesar. It is Caesar's job to bring humanity to salvation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一次，上帝不再那么仁慈了。玛尔斯，他给我们送来了神圣的凯撒，拯救人类是凯撒的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then you get to trinitary theory, which is the idea that Jesus Christ *is* Mars, just as Caesar is the second coming of Jesus. But I won't bore you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后是三位一体理论，也就是耶稣基督是玛尔斯，就像凯撒是耶稣的第二次降临一样。不过我就不烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus Christ?
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶稣基督？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not say that name. Of all the names you shouldn't say aloud, that is the *most* forbidden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要说那个名字。在所有你不应该大声说出的名字中，这是“最”禁止的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I am speaking of Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我说的是基督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Lord God sent us His son once as a messenger, many years ago. The Profligates of that time turned on God's messenger and crucified him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年前，上帝曾派他的儿子来作使者。当时的放荡者背弃了上帝的使者，将他钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This time, God is not so merciful. As Mars, He sent us the holy Caesar. It is Caesar's job to bring humanity to salvation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一次，上帝不再那么仁慈了。玛尔斯，他给我们送来了神圣的凯撒，拯救人类是凯撒的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then you get to trinitary theory, which is the idea that Jesus Christ *is* Mars, just as Caesar is the second coming of Jesus. But I won't bore you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后是三位一体理论，也就是耶稣基督是玛尔斯，就像凯撒是耶稣的第二次降临一样。不过我就不烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Julius Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利乌斯·凯撒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truly? Mars above, how far we have fallen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？玛尔斯在上，我们已经堕落到什么程度了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a Dissolute, I feel I must tell you. This is for your ears only. Don't go repeating this to everyone you meet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个放荡者，我觉得有必要告诉你。这只是给你听的，不要对你遇到的每个人都重复这句话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thousands of years ago, the Lord God blessed a virgin woman with a child, and that child was born Jesus Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几千年前，上帝赐福给一位处女，让她生下一个孩子，这个孩子就是耶稣基督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Christ performed many miracles and taught people how to honor God, but this angered many of the nonbelievers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 基督施行了许多神迹，教导人们如何尊敬上帝，但这激怒了许多不信教的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These nonbelievers had Jesus nailed to a cross, where he died. Three days later, he returned from the dead and ascended to heaven.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些不信教的人把耶稣钉在十字架上，他在那里死去。三天后，他死而复生，升天了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: While Jesus Christ was indeed God's son, he was also God himself. It's complicated and difficult to explain this part, but it's important. Jesus is God.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然耶稣基督确实是上帝的儿子，但他也是上帝自己。解释这部分很复杂也很困难，但它很重要，耶稣就是上帝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's basically the gist of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是基本的要点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, hold on, I don't know who Jesus Christ is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，等等，我不知道耶稣基督是谁。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think anything. The Holy Bible has predicted everything that has come to pass. Every event is written in ink on those pages.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都不认为。《圣经》预言了一切将要发生的事，每一件事都用墨水写在书页上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Bible warned us of the end of the world. The Tribulations and the End Times are the prerequisite to Christ's Second Coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 《圣经》警告我们世界末日的来临，大灾难和末世是基督再临的先决条件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard of the Seventy Weeks of Daniel? It's a prophecy that there will be a span of seventy 'sevens' in which sinners can repent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过但以理的七十个七吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the end of those seventy sevens, the Tribulations will commence and the world will end. You'll notice that the world ended in the year 2077.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过但以理的七十个七吗？这是一个预言，将会有七十个“七”，罪人可以在其中悔改。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you think Caesar is Jesus Christ?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你认为凯撒是耶稣基督？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They began 200 years ago and are still happening now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们始于200年前，现在仍在发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All this worldly suffering is merely a test. Those who endure will live to see Caesar finally reclaim and rule over His kingdom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世间所有的苦难都只是一种考验，那些坚持下来的人将活着看到凯撒最终夺回并统治他的王国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when Caesar sits on the throne of the Lord, He will pass judgment unto us all. Holy, or unholy? Pious, or Profligate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当凯撒坐上主的宝座的时候，他要审判我们众人。圣洁还是不圣洁？虔诚，还是堕落？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll hear you out. You're saying that these Tribulations already happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我听你说完。你是说这些灾难已经发生了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Bible tells us that Jesus - God, Mars - will return to Earth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣经告诉我们，耶稣——上帝，玛尔斯——将返回地球。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before he does, there will be worldwide hardships and disasters. That period of calamity is called the Tribulations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他成功之前，全球将出现困苦和灾难。那个灾难时期被称为“大灾难”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Jesus returns, he will judge mankind and separate the wicked from the righteous. He will punish the sinners and save the pure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当耶稣再来时，他将审判人类，将恶人与义人分开。他会惩罚罪人，拯救纯洁的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mankind already lived through a period of worldwide Tribulations. Now, the son of God is here. He is judging us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类已经经历了一段世界性的灾难时期。现在，上帝之子来了，他在审判我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every crucifixion Caesar orders is his holy revenge and judgment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒下令的每一次钉十字架都是他神圣的复仇和审判。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's back up. Can you explain it all simply for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们倒回去吧，你能给我简单解释一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely, my friend. It makes the *most* sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我的朋友。这是*最*有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That all makes a lot of sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都很有意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will see the truth soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很快就会知道真相的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are deeply disturbed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你深感不安。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not. But I'd really rather not argue scripture with you. I know what is true, and will not be swayed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有，但我真的不想和你争论圣经。我知道什么是真理，不会动摇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know the scripture you're talking about. You're wildly misinterpreting things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你说的《圣经》，你完全误解了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I understand. Just keep Mars and the Lord Caesar in your heart, and you shall find your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我能理解。只要把玛尔斯和凯撒放在心里，你就会找到你的路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. That's a lot to digest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，这很难消化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Steffie. From Hoover's Hope. You know, in Arizona. You helped me get across the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 史黛菲，来自胡佛希望。你知道的，在亚利桑那，你帮我渡过了大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remind me - who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 提醒我一下...你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm a refugee... again. Ta-da!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我是个难民...又一次。嗒哒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR shook me down at that checkpoint. They took everything, all that money you gave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR在检查站对我进行了盘问。他们拿走了一切，你给我的所有钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know it probably sounds like bullshit. I don't expect you to believe me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这听起来像是胡扯，我不指望你会相信我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, thank you. You've given me more than enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，谢谢。你给我的已经够多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your caps situation...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的瓶盖情况...

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't think I can be trusted with them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我不值得信任。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want more caps?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还要瓶盖吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's really fine. I don't want you to waste your money on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的没事。我不想让你把钱浪费在我身上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your caps situation...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的瓶盖情况...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently I'm 'too young' to have that kind of money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然，我还“太年轻”，不可能有那么多钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They didn't believe it was legit, or that I was gonna commit crimes with it, or something. So they took all of it for 'safe keeping'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不相信这是合法的，也不相信我会用它来犯罪，或者别的什么。所以为了“安全保管”，他们全都拿走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've already cried it all out, so in hindsight it's actually kinda funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经哭过了，所以现在回想起来其实还挺有趣的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would the NCR do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, well, I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The man at the checkpoint said his name was Charlie. He called his officer out and that's who took the money. I think his name was... Wire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 检查站的那个人说他叫查理。他把他的长官叫出来，就是他拿走了钱，我想他的名字是...怀尔？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who took the money? I want a name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁拿了钱？我要知道名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it really is terrible luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，真是太倒霉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still appreciate what you did. I'll get back on my feet some day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是很感激你的。总有一天我会东山再起的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's tough luck. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真倒霉。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，我很抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you're right. I shouldn't give you anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你说得对。我不应该给你任何东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Thank you. You're right. I'm sorry. I shouldn't let people walk all over me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，谢谢你！你说得对，我很抱歉，我不应该让别人欺负我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I appreciate it. Truly. I'll get my shit together, I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！我很感激，真的。我会振作起来的，我保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 100 caps.> Stop wallowing in self-pity. Toughen up. Don't let anyone make a victim of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她100瓶盖>别再自怨自艾了。坚强一点，不要让任何人把你当成牺牲品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thank you. Seriously, I can't thank you enough. I don't deserve you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？谢谢你！说真的，我怎么谢你都不为过。我不值得你这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll never forget you, I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我永远不会忘记你的，我保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 100 caps.> It's not your fault. Pick yourself up and keep keeping on.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她100瓶盖>这不是你的错。振作起来，继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Really? That's incredible!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？真的？太不可思议了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you so much. Seriously, I don't know how I can thank you. I'll never forget you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢。说真的，我不知道该怎么感谢你，我永远不会忘记你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 500 caps.> I got your 500 caps back from Wire. Take them.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她500瓶盖>我从怀尔那里要回了你的500瓶盖，拿去吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fine, I understand. I don't want your money anyway. I don't deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，我理解。反正我也不想要你的钱，我不配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601EBAB] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I could give you something, but I don't have anything to spare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我能给你点什么，但我没有多余的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not at liberty to discuss that with you, and I wouldn't tell you even if I was. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无权和你讨论这件事，即使我可以，我也不会告诉你。抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you confiscate some money from a young woman who passed through the checkpoint?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从一个通过检查站的年轻女子那里没收了一些钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again? I told you, it's within our right as the New California Republic to confiscate suspicious sums of money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来了？我告诉过你，作为新加州共和国，我们有权没收可疑金额的资金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk about that money you confiscated from Steffie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得谈谈你从史黛菲那里没收的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that money was yours? You must be a real high roller if you can throw hundreds of caps around like nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这钱是你的？如果你能毫不吝惜的挥霍数百瓶盖，你一定是一个真正的豪赌客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or maybe you're just a common criminal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者你只是个普通的罪犯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, civilian. I would have to be insane to allow someone to bring half a thousand unaccountable caps over the border from Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，平民。我一定是疯了才会允许有人从亚利桑那带着五百来路不明的瓶盖越过边境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They could be counterfeit, or the carrier could be a Legion spy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是伪造的，也可能是军团的间谍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I gave her that money. I want it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给了她那笔钱，我想要回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I do, maybe I don't. I'm well within my rights to confiscate suspicious materiel coming through the checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我清楚，也许我不清楚。我完全有权没收通过检查站的可疑物品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called 'civil asset forfeiture'. It's one of the best laws Peterson ever signed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这被称为“民事资产没收”，这是彼得森签署的最好的法律之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know just as well as I do that the money is legitimate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和我一样清楚那笔钱是合法的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spare me the sob story. I've heard it all before. You won't move me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我讲这个悲伤的故事了，我都听过了。你感动不了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's an innocent refugee who just lost her mother. Have a heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是个刚失去母亲的无辜难民。发发慈悲吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Very clever. Moore would make me scrub the latrines if I wasted her time with asset forfeiture claim paperwork.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]非常聪明。如果我把摩尔的时间浪费在财产没收申请文件上她会让我去刷厕所的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I get your point. Take the damn money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我明白你的意思。拿着该死的钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Get me the paperwork and I'll file a claim for the money. I'm sure you have the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。把文件给我，我去申请索赔，我相信你有时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] No, I'm not tired of protecting the New California Republic.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不，我还没厌倦保护新加州共和国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't you tired of being a gruff asshole all the time? Lighten up and live a little. That money was super important to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不厌倦一直做个粗鲁的混蛋吗？轻松一点，享受生活。那笔钱对她来说非常重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Fucking hell, don't phrase it like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]该死的，别这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I get your point. Take the damn money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我明白你的意思。拿着该死的钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Using your position to take advantage of a young girl doesn't look good. I'd hate for it to go on your record.
ESP.TRADUIT: 利用你的地位占一个年轻女孩的便宜可不好，我可不想这件事被记录在你的档案里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]滚开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me that money or I'll accuse you of something terrible... so terrible they don't even have a word for it yet!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把钱给我，不然我就指控你做坏事...太糟糕了，他们甚至还没有一个词来形容它！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, you do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Captain Wire [06010194] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll come back another time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我下次再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Steffie. From Hoover's Hope. You know, in Arizona. You helped me get across the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 史黛菲，来自胡佛希望。你知道的，在亚利桑那，你帮我渡过了大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Remind me - who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 提醒我一下...你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know, right? I'm still shocked that I'm here. I just started following a caravan and eventually we made it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，对吧？我还是很惊讶我能来到这里。我只是跟着一个商队，最终我们来到了这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They even gave me a gun! A little peashooter. I think they probably just pitied me, but I it was still nice of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们还给了我一把枪！一把小玩具枪。我想他们可能只是同情我，但他们还是很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's good to see you. You made it a long way from Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴见到你，你从大站大老远赶来了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't. I think I'm alright. I appreciate you asking, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不用，我想我还好。谢谢你的关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything I can do for you? Do you need anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？你需要什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Maybe I'll see if I can become a citizen of California. I'm heading out that way anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许我会看看我是否能成为加州公民，反正我也要往那边走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just know that I'm certainly not staying here. I want to be as far from the Legion as possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道我肯定不会待在这里，我想离军团越远越好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0601CDDC] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's next for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你接下来有什么打算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. Holy shit. It's you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我的天呐。是你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god, it's so good to see you again. How have you been?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，能再见到你真是太好了。你过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're making a serious mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你犯了一个严重的错误。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. Holy shit. It's you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我的天呐。是你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god, it's so good to see you again. How have you been?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，能再见到你真是太好了。你过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring it on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放马过来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. Holy shit. It's you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我的天呐。是你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh my god, it's so good to see you again. How have you been?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，能再见到你真是太好了。你过得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay! I'll do it! Please don't hurt me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧！我会的！请不要伤害我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Steffie. From Hoover's Hope. You know, in Arizona. You helped me get across the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 史黛菲，来自胡佛希望。你知道的，在亚利桑那，你帮我渡过了大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah, but it's only temporary. I just need enough caps to get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的，但只是暂时的。我只是需要足够的瓶盖才能离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this what you're doing now? Robbing people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在就是在做这个吗？抢劫？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else am I supposed to do? Become some prostitute? Gamble all my money away? Vegas isn't somewhere you can make a normal living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能做什么？当妓女？把我所有的钱都赌光？维加斯不是一个可以正常生活的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I even asked those farmers near Freeside if they needed another workhand, but they don't want wastelanders, just NCR citizens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至问了自由城附近的农民是否需要另一个工人，但他们不想要废土人，只要NCR公民。
