ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you doing this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh shit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，见鬼。 !
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care who you are. Time to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎你是谁，该去死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see what you're saying. It'd probably help if I got bigger too, right? Maybe I can steal some Buffout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白你的意思了。如果我也变大点就好了，对吧？也许我可以偷点壮大灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to be a raider, you're going to need a bigger crew. You're not intimidating enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想成为一名掠夺者，你需要一个更大的团队。你不够吓人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you! I'm doing perfectly fine. You would've emptied your pockets if I didn't recognize you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈！?我做得很好。要不是我认出你来，你早就掏空口袋了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knock this shit off. You're going to get yourself killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把这玩意给我拿开，你会害死自己的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you. How dare you bring her up like this? You didn't know her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，?你怎么敢这样提她？你又不认识她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mom would be disappointed to see you doing this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你妈妈看到你这么做会很失望的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] So what? We don't all get what we want. I wanted her to live, and she didn't. Life sucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]那又怎样？不是每个人都能得到自己想要的。我想让她活下去，但她没有。生活糟透了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a real career path for me. This is a chance to make some real money. Why should I stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我来说是一条真正的职业道路，这是个赚大钱的好机会，我为什么要停下来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that she wanted better for you than this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道她希望你过得更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]去你妈的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually knew her quite intimately and she would hate to see that you're a deadbeat thug now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和她很熟，她肯定不愿意看到你现在变成一个游手好闲的恶棍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay. Well, thanks. It was nice seeing you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧，嗯，谢谢。很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe next time we meet, I'll have enough caps to pay you back and still get out of this desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许下次我们见面的时候，我就有足够的瓶盖还你钱还能离开这片沙漠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. It's not my business. Good luck out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧，这不关我的事。祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what you do? You just kill raiders like it's nothing? I guess I didn't even realize.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你的工作吗？你就这么若无其事的杀掉掠夺者吗？我想我甚至没有意识到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a killer. I can't even imagine killing someone and being okay with myself. I guess I'm not as strong as you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是杀人犯，我甚至无法想象杀了人还能坦然面对。看来我还没有你强大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: People like me kill raiders like you. I really don't want to have to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像我这样的人会杀死像你这样的掠夺者，我真的不想杀你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It feels like I've lived my whole life already. What's left for me? This desert that I fucking hate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 感觉我已经度过了我的一生。还剩什么给我？这片我讨厌的该死的沙漠？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone but me just lies and cheats and kills. Why should I be a victim? Why should I stay weak?
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我，每个人都在撒谎，欺骗和杀戮。我为什么要成为受害者？我为什么要保持软弱？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I just need to get out of here. I'm going to die if I stay here. I hate the fucking Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我只是想离开这里，我待在这里会死的，我讨厌该死的莫哈维。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish my mom was here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我妈妈在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have your whole life ahead of you. Don't throw it away just to die young over a handful of caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有大好的人生在等着你，不要因为几个瓶盖而英年早逝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't pretend you have any authority over me just because my mom asked you to deliver me a fucking letter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别因为我妈让你给我送信就假装你对我有什么权力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll keep raiding and robbing as I see fit. And next time we meet, maybe I won't let you walk away with those caps in your pocket.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我觉得合适，我会继续打劫。下次我们见面的时候，也许我不会让你带着那些瓶盖离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll stop because I told you to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫你住手，你就住手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's fine. I don't need you to save me. I'm figuring shit out on my own. Still, it was nice seeing you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好。我不需要你来救我，我在自己摸索。不过，还是很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe next time we meet, I'll have enough caps to pay you back and still get out of this desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许下次我们见面的时候，我就有足够的瓶盖还你钱还能离开这片沙漠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well I don't know how to convince you to stop doing this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧我不知道该怎么说服你别这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... fine. I guess. I'll figure something else out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...好吧，我想是吧。我会想出别的办法的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I'm not cut out for this. My mom wouldn't want this for me and I'm not even very good at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，我不是这块料。我妈妈不会希望我这样的，我也不擅长这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So... that's that. Thanks, I guess. I'll see you around, maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以...就这样，谢谢，我想。也许我们会再见的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please stop robbing people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要再抢劫了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's fine. I don't need you to save me. I'm figuring shit out on my own. Still, it was nice seeing you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好。我不需要你来救我，我在自己摸索。不过，还是很高兴见到你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe next time we meet, I'll have enough caps to pay you back and still get out of this desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许下次我们见面的时候，我就有足够的瓶盖还你钱还能离开这片沙漠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600DC90] (mod) Quest : ([0600DC3D]AZBigStopClariceQuest) Our Love Will Never Go EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't care. Keep robbing people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我不在乎。继续抢劫好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Speculatore. Caesar's intel. It is our job to know who you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个密探，凯撒的情报。了解你是谁是我们的职责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know who I am?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道我是谁吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Observing. I'm a radioman. There are strange things in this area.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正在观察。我是一名通讯员，这个地区有些奇怪的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dead brahmin. Lights in the sky. Easy to ignore. Radio interference, though? Not something to ignore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 死去的婆罗门牛，天空中的光，很容易被忽视。无线电干扰？不容忽视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supposedly something to do with the facility north of here. Hard to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该跟这里北边的设施有关。很难说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the strange things going on around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我这里发生的怪事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should speak to the Frumentarii here. Spirit Chaser and Bellius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该和这里的特务谈谈，逐灵者和伯里乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the facility north of here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里北边的设施是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eviscerated. Not unlike our sacrifices. But they are found out in the sand, the desert. Not a Legionary's doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掏空内脏，就像我们的牺牲一样。但它们是在沙漠中被发现的，这可不是军团士兵的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said something about dead Brahmin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么死去的婆罗门牛？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Maiden here believes they are signs from Mars, but I'm not so sure. We had stories of lights in the sky back at Bitter Lake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的女侍相信这是来自玛尔斯的信号，但我不太确定。我们在比特湖的时候听说过天上有光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the lights in the sky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说天空中的光。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where I'm from, there used to be a people called the Ufo. They were shaped like us, but smaller, and with large black eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我的家乡，曾经有一种叫做幽浮的民族。他们的形状和我们很像，但个子更小，长着黑色的大眼睛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Profligates of the Before-Time seemed to worship these Ufo. It's hard to say for certain. But they were said to have certain rituals... and powers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 前时代的堕落者似乎崇拜这些幽浮，这很难说。但据说他们有特定的仪式...还有超能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What we are seeing now, these cattle mutilations, lights in the sky, seems consistent with the Ufo. That is my belief.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在看到的，这些残害牲畜的景象，天空中的光，似乎与幽浮一致。这是我的看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're familiar with these lights in the sky?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对天空中的这些光很熟悉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: From Mars? I do not believe the Ufo are from Mars. We are from Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自玛尔斯？我不相信幽浮是来自玛尔斯。我们是来自玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, little green men from Mars. I know what you're talking about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，火星来的小绿人。我知道你在说什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Temple of Mars is in Dolan Springs. You will find the Mars Priestesses there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯神殿在多兰泉，那里有玛尔斯的女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Martians. You're talking about Martians. The Ufo are Martians.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火星人，你说的是火星人，幽浮是火星人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is not much more I can say. They were said to be from somewhere else. Another realm, maybe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能说的不多了。据说他们来自其他地方，也许是另一个世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is said that if you devote your life to Caesar and to the Legion, you will be exalted in death, and join Mars above in his celestial kingdom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，如果你献身于凯撒和军团，你将在死后获得崇高的地位，并与玛尔斯会合，进入他的天国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe these Ufo may come from this 'above'. I do not know for certain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信这些幽浮可能来自"上面"，我不确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the Ufo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再跟我说说这个幽浮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mhmm. Other things too. Abductions. Disappearances. Large symbols carved onto the landscape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，还有其他的。绑架、失踪、大地上雕刻着巨大的符号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are the Ufo known for cattle mutilations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 幽浮以残害牲畜而闻名吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mistress of the Dark?
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑暗的女主人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These Ufo are real. They're from Zeta Reticuli and they're really into Elvis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些幽浮是真的，他们来自泽塔星系，他们很喜欢猫王。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the aliens are these small black-eyed people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外星人就是这些小黑眼睛的人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have things confused. UFOs are the spaceships. Aliens are inside piloting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把事情搞混了。幽浮是宇宙飞船，外星人在里面驾驶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like geckos? I didn't think they were smart enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像金蜥蜴？我觉得它们不够聪明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, real aliens look like bipedal lizards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，真正的外星人看起来像双足蜥蜴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I knew a man like that once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经认识一个这样的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, real aliens are tall, pale, and blond.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，真正的外星人是高个，苍白，金发。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, no. Aliens aren't real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，不。外星人不是真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it? It is similar to Joseph. Some in the Legion are trying to phase out the letter J.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？这和约瑟夫很相似，军团中的一些人正试图逐步淘汰字母J。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Iosep Aneth? That's a strange name, even for a Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊奥赛普·阿尼瑟，这个名字很奇怪，即使是对一个军团士兵来说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. It is because of the Burned Man. They say he should have devoted himself by becoming Ioshua. He wouldn't have failed, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，都是因为火烧人。他们说他应该全身心投入成为伊奥舒阿，那么他就不会失败了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think it's foolish, but a name is a name. It doesn't matter to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得这很傻，但名字就是名字。这对我来说无关紧要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're trying to get rid of the letter J?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们想去掉字母J？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a town in Utah. I was stationed there to monitor the tribal Confederacy for a time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是犹他州的一个小镇，我曾驻扎在那里监视部落邦联一段时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Aneth? That doesn't sound like the rest of your language.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那阿尼瑟呢？听起来不像你说的其他语言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you not with them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没和他们一起吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, something is the matter. Can't you tell? What else would keep the Legion from leaving a tired old man in peace?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，出了点事。你看不出来吗？还有什么能让军团不放过一个疲惫的老人呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something the matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A reasonable assumption to make, given that there ain't anything else of interest within fifty miles of us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个合理的假设，因为在我们方圆五十英里内没有任何有趣的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, she's in a sorry state alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，她的状态很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, if you're not Legion, what do you want from me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，如果你不是军团的人，你想从我这里得到什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take it this has to do with the tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜这和塔有关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right, I almost forgot that we had the lights working again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我差点忘了灯又能亮了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm sorry to disappoint you, but you've seen pretty much all there is to this operation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，很抱歉让你失望了，但你已经看到了这次行动的全部内容。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The tower is damaged, so it's useless for transmitting anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信号塔损坏了，无法发送任何信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only came to see what the giant brightly-lit tower was all about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是来看看这座灯火通明的大塔是怎么回事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm sorry to disappoint you, but there isn't anything interesting going on here. The tower is damaged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，很抱歉让你失望了，但这里没有什么有趣的事情。塔损坏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just exploring this mountain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在探索这座山。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers disabled it when they pulled out of the region a few years back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵几年前撤离这一地区时把它瘫痪了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They didn't want it falling into the Legion's hands. Can you blame them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不希望它落入军团之手。这能怪他们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But naturally, Caesar is determined to get it working again, and in light of the literal gun he put to my head, I suppose I am too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但很自然，凯撒决心让它重新运转起来，鉴于他拿枪指着我的头，我想我也是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, turns out, top-of-the-line Pre-War electronic infrastructure generally doesn't weather through a direct hit from an HE warhead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实证明，最顶级的战前电子设施一般无法经受住高爆弹头的直接打击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Also turns out, it isn't practical to fix components that were recycled into molten glass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实也证明，修复那些已被回收熔化成玻璃的组件并不可行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said the tower is damaged? What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说塔损坏了？发生什么事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sherman Ramakrishnan. I've been operating the Atlas Tower for forty-five years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢尔曼·拉马克里希南，我已经操作阿特拉斯塔45年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The responsibility was passed down to me by my father, and to him by my grandfather.
ESP.TRADUIT: 职责由我父亲传给我，由我祖父传给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Historically, I operated the comms equipment to serve various purposes for various people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从历史上看，我操作通信设备为不同的人服务于不同的目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Presently, I guess I'm playing telephone with an army of hare-brained thugs who barely understand what a radio is, much less how one works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我想我是在和一群头脑简单的暴徒玩电话，他们几乎不懂无线电是什么，更不用说无线电是如何工作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't it obvious? The Atlas Tower was built for long-distance military communications.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是很明显吗？阿特拉斯塔是为远距离军事通信而建造的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a repeater station, so it can receive a signal from, for example Phoenix, and re-broadcast it across the entire globe if needed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个中继站，因此它可以接收到来自凤凰城等地的信号，并在需要时向全球转播。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stations of this size were strategic targets during the Great War. It's remarkable that the Atlas went more or less unscathed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种规模的站点在世界大战期间是战略目标。阿特拉斯几乎毫发无损，这是很了不起的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure it wasn't the only one that did, but I haven't heard of any others that can match its range.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信它不是唯一一个，但我还没有听说过其他能与它媲美的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What makes the Legion so interested in this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么让军团对这里这么感兴趣？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Safe travels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 旅途平安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be going, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion *are* impatient. That's their defining characteristic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团*是*不耐烦的，这是它们的典型特征。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, deep down they know it's not my fault I'm not getting those parts. And they know they aren't getting it fixed without me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但在内心深处，他们知道我得不到那些零件不是我的错。他们也知道，没有我，他们没法修好它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's why my head is still attached to my body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么我的头还连着我的身体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are the Legion getting impatient with you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对你不耐烦了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bingo. Only you won't find those parts just lying around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 答对了。只是你不会随便找到那些零件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This was an advanced US Military facility. Replacing anything here means getting your hands on military-grade parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个先进的美国军事设施，在这里更换任何东西都意味着你需要购买军用级别的部件。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you need replacement parts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你需要更换零件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I said, I may as well be the only person alive who knows anything about high-power transmitters. At least on this side of the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我说的，我可能是唯一一个知道高功率发射器的人。至少在河这边是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet your average prospector probably couldn't even tell you the difference between an oscillator and a resonator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我敢打赌，普通的淘金客可能甚至不能告诉你振荡器和共振器之间的区别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hermit [06014E5D] (mod) Quest : ([0600DBB0]AZFreeformAtlasTower) 0600DBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a big interconnected world out there. I'm sure someone can dig up what you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个相互联系的大世界，我肯定有人能找到你需要的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, your powers of perception are truly stunning. Yeah, I guess I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你的感知能力真是惊人。嗯，我想是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a refugee?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是难民吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some Ranger assholes got uppity and decided to start killing people, so now the Legion is 'questioning' everyone who lives there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些游骑兵混蛋变得傲慢，决定开始杀人，所以现在军团正在“询问”住在那里的每个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the NCR will shoot us if we try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为如果我们这么做，NCR会开枪的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a load of crap! I always heard they were the good guys, that they were better than the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 简直是一派胡言！我总是听说他们是好人，他们比军团更优秀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the only time I've ever seen them, they're turning my home into a warzone and fucking shooting at us!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我唯一一次见到他们，他们就把我的家变成了战区，还他妈朝我们开枪！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you cross the Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不穿过大坝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you serious?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why didn't you stay for questioning? Do you have something to hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不留下来接受询问？你有什么要隐瞒的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, just let the gang of savage freaks lock me in a room and 'question' me for as long as they like. I'm sure they'll be reasonable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，就让那帮野蛮的怪物把我锁在一个房间里，想问多久就问多久。我相信他们会讲道理的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm serious. If you're innocent, you shouldn't be afraid of some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的。如果你是无辜的，就不该害怕被问问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, just let the gang of savage freaks lock me in a room and 'question' me for as long as they like. I'm sure they'll be reasonable!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，就让那帮野蛮的怪物把我锁在一个房间里，想问多久就问多久。我相信他们会讲道理的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I was just making conversation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我只是随便聊聊而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. But thanks for admitting it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。但谢谢你承认这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you're right. Dumb question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你说得对。愚蠢的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: God, whatever, I don't care. Talk to Omar if you care so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪，管它呢，我不在乎。既然你这么在乎，就去找奥马尔谈谈吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm gonna die here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会死在这里的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I could try talking to the NCR and seeing if they'd let you cross the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我可以试着和NCR谈谈，看看他们能不能让你穿过大坝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I am. If you're offering, I won't say no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我饿了。如果你提供，我不会拒绝的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want something to eat? You must be hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想吃点什么吗？你一定饿了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I am. If you're offering, I won't say no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我饿了。如果你提供，我不会拒绝的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want something to eat? You must be hungry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想吃点什么吗？你一定饿了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I'll eat slowly to savor it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。我要慢慢吃，细细品味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some food for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带了点吃的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: From mom? How is she? Is she alright? She's still alive, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈妈的？她怎么样了？她还好吗？她还活着，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a letter for you, from your mom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一封信给你，是你妈妈寄来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Is the news that bad?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？消息有那么糟吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Fear

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got some alcohol. You want a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有酒，你想喝一杯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think I'm alright. Thank you, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我想我还好。不过还是谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just prefer to drink before I hear something heavy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想在听到沉重的声音之前先喝一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus Christ. Okay, yeah, sure. I'll have some of whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶稣基督。好吧，是的，当然，随便给我来点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, the news is really bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这个消息真的很糟糕。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Oh God. Gross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，噢天哪，真恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, hit me with the news.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，告诉我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give alcohol.> Drink up.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给酒>喝吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then just hurry up and tell me what happened!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就快点告诉我发生了什么事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, I shouldn't be giving you alcohol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我不该给你酒的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think I'm alright. Thank you, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我想我还好。不过还是谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, but I thought I'd give you the option.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，但我想我应该给你选择权。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I... can I see the letter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能...我能看看那封信吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's alive. She's going to be turned into a slave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她还活着，她就要变成奴隶了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Seriously? I knew she was sick, but...
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？真的吗？我知道她病了，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: What... what does the letter say? Can I see it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么...信上说了什么？能让我看看吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> She's gone. She died before the Legion could question her.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>她死了，军团还没来得及审问她，她就死了。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Yeah that's her alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没错，就是她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. <Hand her the letter.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。<把信递给她>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just... her goodbyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是...她的道别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did the letter say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 信上说了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. We're still stuck here. You can talk to Omar about it. Maybe you could help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我们还被困在这里。你可以和奥马尔谈谈，也许你能帮忙？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even care where I go, you know? I just want to be safe from the fucking Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我根本不在乎去哪里，你知道吗？我只是想远离该死的军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't know what it's like to grow up in a town run by them. They're... I'll just say I'm glad mom was as protective as she was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不知道在一个被他们统治的小镇长大是什么感觉。他们是...我只想说，我很高兴妈妈这么保护我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to do now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在打算做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Sure. Sounds good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，当然可以，听起来不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll talk to Omar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去和奥马尔谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I don't have anything to give you, but thank you. I'll never forget you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，我没有什么可以给你的，不过还是谢谢你。我永远不会忘记你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's all, I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没别的事，我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a good idea. I guess it'll be a lot of walking and a lot of desert. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个好主意，我猜会有很多路要走，还有很多沙漠。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 200 caps.> When you get across the Dam, buy yourself some supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她200瓶盖>过了大坝，给自己买点物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A gun, understood. I guess Nevada's a lot more dangerous than Arizona. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一把枪，明白了，看来内华达比亚利桑那危险多了。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 200 caps.> When you get across the Dam, buy yourself a gun. You'll need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她200瓶盖>过了大坝，给自己买把枪。你会需要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thank you. I don't even know what to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？谢谢你，我都不知道该说什么好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 500 caps.> Here. When you get across the Dam, buy whatever you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她500瓶盖>给。过了大坝，需要什么就买什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Steffie [0600EC8F] (mod) Quest : ([06018CFC]AZFreeformHooversHopeRefugeeCamp) 06018CFC (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You tell me. You were the last slave to touch my laundry, and now my coin purse is missing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说呢。你是最后一个碰过我衣服的奴隶，现在我的零钱包不见了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Is that sanctimony or disgust? Yes, perhaps it would be better if I could fuck some woman and enjoy it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！这是伪善还是厌恶？是，如果我能和一些女人做爱并享受性爱，也许会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would indeed be better, if being sent to the rest camps for my 'holy duty' didn't make me want to crawl out of my skin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果因为我的“神圣职责”而被送到其他集中营不会让我浑身难受，那确实会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid

ESP.ORIGINAL: But that's not the life I was given. What do I see in him? I see gentleness... and wonder. And an eye for details, for beauty. There is no one else like him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这不是我的人生。我看上他什么了？我看到了温柔...和美丽，还有一双捕捉细节和美感的眼睛，没有人能像他一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: And yes, he is weak. That's why it's my duty to protect him. There is no other purpose for strength. It exists to protect the weak from evil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他很弱，所以我有责任保护他。力量的存在就是为了保护弱者免受邪恶的侵害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's my answer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you see in Flemus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看上了弗勒慕斯什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born into the Legion, unlike many. I am a recruit, as you can tell from my armor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我出生在军团，不像很多人。我是个新兵，从我的盔甲就能看出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: More substantial would be nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多一点就好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's all I need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我知道这些就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did not. I was only... maybe sixteen years old?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。我只有...也许是十六岁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most initiates are made into recruits by that age, but I was a late bloomer and still quite small.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数同修都是在那个年龄成为新兵的，但我大器晚成，还很小。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do wish I was there, despite how that battle went.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真希望我也在那里，不管战斗如何。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you fight at the first battle of Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你参加过胡佛水坝的第一次战役吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish to have cut my teeth on a real foe, to have gained that experience. Many recruits returned from that battle as primes, even veterans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望能在真正的敌人身上练练手，获得那样的经验。许多新兵从那场战役中回来以后都成了精英，甚至是老兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, I was made to skirmish with the inbred raiders of Ute. And when Lanius arrived, I was called back west to harrass traders near Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相反，我被安排与犹特的近亲掠夺者冲突。拉尼厄斯到达后，我又被叫回西部去骚扰尤马附近的商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you wish you were there? The Legion lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么希望你在那里？军团输了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is nothing lucky about being repeatedly sabotaged with worthless postings in nowhere wastelands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在毫无价值的废土上反复被毫无价值的岗位摧残并不是什么幸运的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like you've had some lucky breaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你运气不错啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've suspected it several times. Fortunately, my last Decanus died of fever. Syracuse is much more agreeable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑过好几次了。幸运的是，我的最后一个什长死于发烧。叙拉古更容易相处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your commanders must hate you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的指挥官一定很讨厌你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It never crossed my mind, and it won't now. It's a ridiculous idea. I have been ready for nearly five years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我从来没有想过，现在也不会。这是一个荒谬的想法，我已经准备了快五年了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered that maybe you're just not ready for a real assignment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过，也许你还没有准备好接受真正的任务？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sports. Training. I also like to draw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 运动、训练，我也喜欢画画。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do for fun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Studies of fitness. Bodies, and outfits too. The human form is Mars' greatest creation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于健康的研究，还有身体和服装。人类是玛尔斯最伟大的创造。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you draw?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你画什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big talk coming from a Profligate. It's no surprise you and your godless savage people are incapable of understanding beauty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落者的豪言壮语。难怪你和你那些不信神的野蛮人无法理解美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drawing is for weaklings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绘画是弱者的专利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Absolutely. The body is a temple. If you tend to it, keep it in tip-top shape, it will reward you. That is what honors Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]绝对的。身体是一座神庙，如果你悉心照料它，让它保持最佳状态，它会回报你的。这就是玛尔斯的荣耀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I agree. A strong body is a thing of beauty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意，强壮的身体是一件美丽的事物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCESS] Glory, yes, but you must not forget that the body is a weapon. Cultivate it for that purpose, and you will be rewarded.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]荣耀，是的，但你不能忘记身体是一种武器。为此目的培养它，你将得到回报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The body is only as good as its ability to endure pain in the pursuit of glory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 身体的好坏取决于它在追求荣耀时忍受痛苦的能力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only the soldiers. I've seen some absolutely beautiful togas while passing through Flagstaff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有士兵是这样。我经过旗杆市的时候看到了一些非常漂亮的长袍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will admit to being somewhat envious of Liberti fashion. Though our uniforms do have a certain appeal of their own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我承认我有点嫉妒自由民的时尚，不过我们的制服确实有自己的魅力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outfits? But you all wear the same outfits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 服装？但你们都穿一样的衣服。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Preparations are being made for the assault on Hoover Dam. Veterans from Colorado are arriving all the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们正在为袭击胡佛大坝做准备，科罗拉多的老兵们一直在陆续抵达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I heard, the veteran Centurions who worked closest with Lanius are already here, in the Legate's private camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说，和拉尼厄斯合作最密切的老兵百夫长已经在这里了，在特使的私人营地里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Personally, I am excited to see Brutus of Aspen again. I met him very briefly before he was 'of Aspen'. He impressed me greatly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就我个人而言，我很高兴再次见到阿斯彭的布鲁图斯。在他离开阿斯彭之前，我和他见过面，他给我留下了深刻的印象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything interesting going on around camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 营地里有什么有趣的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we must.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果必须的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Name's Desmond.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫德斯蒙德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bitter Springs. It's a refugee camp, if you couldn't tell. It kind of sucks that it's here and not somewhere safer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 苦泉，这是个难民营，如果你看不出来的话。它就在这里，却找不到更安全的地方，真是太糟糕了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if it was somewhere safer, it wouldn't be a refugee camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果是更安全的地方，那就不是难民营了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Follower. We're called that because we follow the sounds of children crying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个天启追随者，我们这么叫是因为我们跟着孩子的哭声走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounded better in my head, but there is plenty of that here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这在我脑海里听起来更好，但这里有很多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a Khan, I know that much. Kids talk about seeing a man with a pointy hat in the hills. I'd check up north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是个大汗帮，我就知道这么多，孩子们说在山上看到一个戴着尖顶帽子的男人。我会去北边看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm investigating your murders problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在调查你谋杀案的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There isn't another way to describe the site of a massacre.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有其他的方式来描述大屠杀的现场了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this a bad place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这地方不好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know back west it's called the "Battle of Bitter Springs," and it's just another battle with the Khans. But, it was a massacre, make no mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道在西部，这被称为“苦泉之战”，这只是与大汗帮的另一场战斗。但毫无疑问，这是一场大屠杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR and the Khans go way back, and there's a lot of bad blood. NCR decided to settle accounts. They killed the men, women and children alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR和大汗帮是老相识了，他们之间有很多恩怨。NCR决定清算，他们把男人、女人和孩子都杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Massacre?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大屠杀？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion territory. The Legion's been rolling through the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团领地，军团一直在莫哈维沙漠肆虐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of them are fleeing slave raids to the north, near Bunkerville. That fell not too long ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们中的大多数人都是为了躲避奴隶掠夺而逃到北部邦克维尔附近。那是不久前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A couple of others fled across the lake from Newt. And Nelson fell to the south of here, so that sent a bunch of people here, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有几个从纽特那儿逃到湖对岸去了。这里南边的纳尔逊陷落了，所以也有一群人来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do the refugees come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 难民来自哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, they accidentally pulled the trigger enough times to kill 33 women and children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错，他们不小心扣了足够多的扳机杀死了33名妇女和儿童。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard it was an accident.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说那是个意外。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Khans used to raid NCR back when Shady was just a little village. They even kidnapped Tandi. NCR's had a blood feud with them ever since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当沙荫镇还是个小村庄的时候，大汗帮经常袭击NCR，他们甚至绑架过坦蒂。从那以后NCR就和他们结下了血海深仇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard the NCR calls it an accident, but there's no way they expect people to believe that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说NCR管这叫意外，但他们不可能指望人们相信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Settle accounts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 清算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Eye for an eye. Everybody says that, these days. The more people that say that, the more people die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，以眼还眼，现在每个人都这么说。说这种话的人越多，死的人就越多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think I want to know why you think 33 women and children had it coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想知道你为什么认为33个女人和孩子是咎由自取。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Khans had it coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大汗帮咎由自取。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Yeah, it does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，对，确实如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn, that sucks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，太糟糕了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure as hell hope not. We'd be easy pickings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然希望不会，我们很容易下手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think the Legion's going to try and raid here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得军团会袭击这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a town right next to Caesar's little fortress. Legion took it a couple months ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个小镇就在凯撒的小堡垒旁边，军团几个月前占领了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of the children here came from there. Can't imagine what their parents are going through right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的很多孩子都来自那里，无法想象他们的父母现在正在经历什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Newt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion took it a while ago. The area around there's been stalemated for a while now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团前阵子占领了，那附近已经僵持了一段时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Nelson?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳尔逊怎么了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion took it. NCR retook it. We still have to clean up the mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团占领了，NCR夺回了它，我们还得收拾残局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Nelson?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳尔逊怎么了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion took it. Forlorn Hope, too. They're using it as a base for raiding along the 95.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团占领了，飘零希望营地也是。他们把这里作为沿95号公路进行突袭的基地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Nelson?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳尔逊怎么了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion took it and then lost it, I think? And then the NCR didn't retake it? No idea, really. A bunch of people are dead, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是被军团占领后又丢了吧？然后NCR有没有夺回它？真的不知道，不过死了不少人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Nelson?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳尔逊怎么了?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mostly, I work on nutrition. If people eat too much after they've eaten too little, their bodies can't handle it, and they die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我主要从事营养方面的工作。如果人们在吃得太少之后又吃得太多，他们的身体会无法承受，他们就会死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The children also need psychological trauma treatment, but I'm no good with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们也需要心理创伤治疗，但我不擅长这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么帮忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. NCR and Followers haven't gotten along for years. Had to get special permission from Gilles to operate here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是，NCR和天启追随者已经不和很多年了，必须得到吉尔斯的特别许可才能在这里工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, they'd turn me away, but they've been having supply issues for months, and they're taking all they can get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常情况下，他们会把我拒之门外，但他们几个月来一直供应不足，所以他们想尽办法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you with the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是NCR的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I, uh, where did you...? It doesn't matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，呃，你从哪里...？不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. I need someone to do something really dangerous, but that Mark there might help you with my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。我需要有人去做一些非常危险的事，但那个徽记可能会帮你找到我的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have this. Why'd you ask? <You show him the Mark of Caesar.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有这个，你为什么这么问？<你出示凯撒的徽记>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a friend in Legion territory, south of the lake. Her name's Natalie. I want to know how she's doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个朋友在军团领地，在湖的南边。她叫纳塔莉，我想知道她怎么样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a pretty dangerous trip, and I can't offer you much, but I just want to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这趟旅行很危险，我也不能给你什么，但我就是想知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm up for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很乐意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just a thing our professor used to say. Tell her that, and she'll know I sent you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这只是我们的教授以前常说的话。告诉她，她就知道是我派你来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, I appreciate this, so thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，我很感激，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion indoctrinates children, and she wanted to try and stop that. She's so headstrong, and I couldn't talk her out of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团教化儿童，她想阻止这一切。她很固执，我无法说服她放弃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's she doing over there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她在那边做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion has some group that indoctrinates children called the 'Cult of Mars', so I'd try looking there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团有一些团体向孩子们灌输所谓的“玛尔斯崇拜”，所以我会试着去那里看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where do you think she is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得她在哪儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar was once a Follower of the Apocalypse, not the son of Mars or whatever crap he's been saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒曾经是天启的追随者，而不是玛尔斯之子或是他说的那些鬼东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He really doesn't want anyone telling the people there the truth. So, for Followers, who can, it's practically shoot on sight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他真的不希望任何人告诉那里的人真相。所以对于天启追随者，他们可以一看到就开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why can't you go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不能去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! If you see her, tell her that 'No good water comes from Oak Creek'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！如果你见到她，告诉她“橡树溪没有好水”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks a bunch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多谢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait? Really? Is she okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等？真的吗？她没事吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I already found her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我已经找到她了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, um, that's great and all, but that's really dangerous. I'll see what I can do, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，嗯，那很好，但那真的很危险。不过我会看看我能做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell her that I'll meet her at Temple Bar Marina with a boat, but she needs to have two or three more ready to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉她我会带着一艘船在圣殿酒吧码头见她，但她需要再准备两到三艘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and here's some supplies for letting me know. I do appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，这是我准备的东西。我真的很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's alive. She's trying to smuggle some children out of Arizona to here, and she needs some help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她还活着。她想把几个孩子从亚利桑那偷运到这里，她需要帮助。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, um, that's great and all, but that's really dangerous. I'll see what I can do, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，嗯，那很好，但那真的很危险。不过我会看看我能做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I'm just happy to know that she's okay. Here's some supplies for letting me know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，知道她没事我很高兴。这些物资是给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's alive. She's trying to smuggle some children out of Arizona to here. She's safe for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她还活着。她想把几个孩子从亚利桑那偷运到这里来，她现在安全了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dead? That's....
ESP.TRADUIT: 死了？这...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not I wanted to hear, but thanks for telling me. Here's some supplies as thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我想听到的，但谢谢你告诉我。这是一些物资作为感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to go back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要回去工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's dead. I'm sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她死了，我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is terrible. Well, thanks for looking into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是太糟了。嗯，谢谢你的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your friend is dead. I found a note she had, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友死了。不过我发现了她留下的一张纸条。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Noctis, first in my contubernium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是诺克提斯，十人队的第一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I help garrison Malpais. It's a very important job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我协助守卫马尔帕斯，这是一项非常重要的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you here? If the Legion had given you a reason to be here, then you wouldn't be asking such questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么会在这里？如果军团给了你存在的理由，你就不会问这样的问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说马尔帕斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate, Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使，马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should know what he does. You have been doing work for him after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该知道他是做什么的，毕竟你一直在为他工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对他了解多少？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the leader of Malpais. He is one of the first legates, one of Caesar's chosen from the Seven Tribes. Killed a bunch of degenerate tribals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是马尔帕斯的首领，他是最早的特使之一，是凯撒从七个部落中挑选出来的，斩杀了一群堕落的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which means that everything he does is in Caesar's name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说，他所做的一切都是以凯撒的名义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you know about the legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对特使了解多少？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He leads his men and disciplines the troops. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他领导部下，纪律严明。就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does the legate do in Caesar's name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使以凯撒的名义做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Optio, Flavius Constantinus. He is a good leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 执行官，弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯，他是一个好领导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who else is in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里还有谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope that will be the case some day. I'm required to be at Malpais for right now, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望有一天会是这样。但我被要求暂时待在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You strike me as an excellent Legionary. Why aren't you on the frontlines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你是个优秀的军团士兵。你为什么不去前线？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope that will be the case some day. I'm required to be at Malpais for right now, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望有一天会是这样。但我被要求暂时待在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A strong Legionary like you should be on the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样强壮的军团士兵应该上前线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope that will be the case some day. I'm required to be at Malpais for right now, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望有一天会是这样。但我被要求暂时待在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A strong Legionary like you should be on the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样强壮的军团士兵应该上前线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope that will be the case some day. I'm required to be at Malpais for right now, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我希望有一天会是这样。但我被要求暂时待在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A strong Legionary like you should be on the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样强壮的军团士兵应该上前线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, the legate needs me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，特使让我在这。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's keeping you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是什么让你留在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. If you say so. Was there anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，如果你这么说的话。还有别的事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's kind of strange.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有点奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was there anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has things he needs me to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有些事需要我去做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? What does the legate need you for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？特使要你做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He wants me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他想让我留在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? I.... Maybe not. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？我...也许没有。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Maybe not so strong after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来如此，也许并没有那么强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of things. Not really the business of a Dissolute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多事，这可不是浪荡子该干的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What things does the legate need you to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使需要你做什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I became a Legionary, they told me that the beatings were normal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我成为一名军团士兵时，他们告诉我挨打是正常的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the legate, he....
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，特使，他...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, it's clear that this bothers you. What's wrong with the legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，很明显这让你很困扰。特使怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I don't want to talk about it, but....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我不想谈这个，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't want to talk about it, then that's fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不想说，那也没关系。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He hurts me more than the others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他比其他人更伤我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on. It's okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，没关系的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it's not my place to say. I shouldn't have it brought it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我没资格说这些。我不该提起这事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to get back to patrol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得回去巡逻了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spit it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说出来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He hurts me like he hurts his slave girls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他像伤害他的女奴一样伤害我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shouldn't have said that. Don't tell my legate I said that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不应该那么说。别告诉我的特使我说了这话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In what way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 用什么方式？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just did. It's clear that this was a mistake. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是这么做的，很明显这是个错误。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you give a straight answer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能直接回答吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you? You understand? I just don't know why this... why he....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吗？明白了吗？我就是不明白为什么会这样...为什么他...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not some capture whore. I'm a soldier. I serve Caesar. But the legate... he....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是什么俘虏妓女，我是军人，我为凯撒效力。但是特使...他...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're supposed to be executing people for this. That's how I was taught.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该为此处决一些人，我就是这样被教导的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I'm just weak. That's why he hurts me. Because I'm weak and I let him, and I let it bother me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是我太弱了，所以他才会伤害我。因为我很软弱，我任由他，让他困扰我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I get the picture. I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我搞清楚状况了，我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't. I don't want....
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不能。我不想...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to go back to patrol. I'm done talking about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要回去巡逻了。我不想再说这些了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you go into more detail?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能说得更详细些吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You probably shouldn't. Best to not talk about this again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能不该掺和，最好不要再提这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was I thinking? Like a Dissolute would understand the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想什么？放荡者能理解军团嘛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to get involved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想掺和进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate was divinely chosen by Caesar himself. He is an acolyte of Mars. He is strength personified. He cannot possibly be wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这位特使是由凯撒亲自任命的，他是玛尔斯的追随者，他是力量的化身。他不可能是错的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he's wrong, then that means Caesar is wrong, and....
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他错了，那就意味着凯撒也错了，还有...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is too much. I need to get to the battlefield. It's much simpler there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太过了。我要去战场，那里要简单得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not weak. This has nothing to do with strength or weakness. It's wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是弱者。这与强弱无关，这是错误的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to be reassigned. The frontlines will make everything clear again, but anywhere's better than here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要被重新分配。前线会让一切重新明朗，但任何地方都比这里好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Optio Flavius Constantinus. He's probably the only person here who could reassign me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去跟执行官弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯谈谈，他可能是这里唯一一个能重新分配我的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you want me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你想让我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, a legate's orders are the backbone of the Legion. If a legate like him can be wrong, but what's a recruit like me supposed to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，特使的命令是军团的支柱。如果像他这样的特使可能是错的，但像我这样的新兵能做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Speech] Everything's already clear. The legate's wrong, and you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: [口才]一切都已经清楚了。特使错了，你是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do.... But, killing a legate, is that even possible?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道...但是，杀掉一名特使，这可能吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's probably much stronger than me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能比我强壮多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a Legionary. You already know how a Legionary would deal with this problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是一名军团士兵，你已经知道军团士兵会怎么处理这个问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Everything is clear, indeed. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。的确，一切都很清楚。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus dies tonight!
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯今晚必死无疑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right makes might. That's the Legion way. Kill the legate, as what Caesar would do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正义造就力量，这就是军团的方式。杀了特使，就像凯撒会做的那样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不要那样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He must not know. If you tell him, then I will kill you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他肯定不知道。如果你告诉他，我就杀了你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can talk to the legate if you'd like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意，我可以和特使谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. That is probably for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。这可能是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I get to the front, that will be all I need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我上了前线，这就是我所需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I'll just talk to the Optio. Get you transferred.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，我还是去和执行官谈谈吧。把你调走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am...sorry. I'm not accustomed to relying on outsiders for anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...对不起，我不习惯依赖外人做任何事。
