ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for your help, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的帮助，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, calm down. I won't talk to him, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，冷静点。那我就不和他说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? You! I'll kill you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你！我要杀了你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> Then, let's skip the part where I tell the legate and cut to the part where I kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>那就跳过我告诉特使的部分，直接说我杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no I don't. I still can't bring myself to eat. The dizzy spells haven't gone away, either, and I still get tremors whenever a superior officer is close to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不我没有。我还是吃不下饭，晕眩的感觉也没有消失，每当上级军官靠近我时，我仍然会颤抖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this what soldier's heart feels like? I haven't been in battle for months, so that can't be right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是士兵心理症的感觉吗？我已经好几个月没上过战场了，不可能是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感觉好点了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I agree. Whatever this fake soldier's heart is, it will only slow me down in battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我同意。不管这个假士兵心理症是什么，它只会让我在战斗中变得迟钝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing that remains is getting it. I could try and see if the Cult would allow me to receive treatment, but I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一剩下的事情就是得到治疗。我可以试着看看教团是否会允许我接受治疗，但我很怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard a rumor a long time from one of the Red Okie that Caesar's first tribe became doctors. Perhaps you could try them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久以前，我从一个红农人那里听到一个谣言说凯撒的第一个部落成为了医生。或许你可以试一试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've helped other soldiers with this before. You need treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前帮助过其他士兵。你需要治疗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it? I guess I survived, but.... The Optio will probably see this soldier's heart as a fictum, a cheap excuse to get a massage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？我想我活了下来，但是...执行官可能会把这个士兵心理症看作是一个谎言，一个得到按摩的廉价借口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What you went through with Sedonus is like a battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和塞多尼乌斯的经历就像一场战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Post-traumatic stress? I'm not familiar with that, but if that's what it's called, then what do you suggest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 创伤后应激障碍？我对这个不太熟悉，但如果是这个名字，那你有什么建议？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This sounds like post-traumatic stress disorder. You have definitely had a trauma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这听起来像是创伤后应激障碍，你肯定有过心理创伤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that, but it doesn't feel like anything's changed. It feels like he's still here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，但我感觉什么都没变，感觉他还在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't get a good night's worth of sleep or focus on my training. If he's gone, then why haven't I gotten over it yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我晚上睡不好觉，也无法集中精力训练。如果他死了，那为什么我还没有释怀？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can't hurt you anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他无法再伤害你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a medical and spiritual disorder. The spirit attempts to leave the body when surrounded by the dead in battle, to join them in the afterlife.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种医学和精神上的紊乱。当战斗中被死者包围时，灵魂试图离开身体，与他们一起进入来世。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a battle condition, though, so it's not what I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这是战场上的情况，所以不是我的情况。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's soldier's heart?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是 "士兵心理症"？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose so. I'm going to ask the Optio to transfer me to the front lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。我要让执行官把我调到前线去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once I die in battle, that will clear everything up. Thank you, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦我死在战场上，一切就都清楚了。谢谢你，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My work here is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里的工作结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think I agree. Whatever this fake soldier's heart is, it will only slow me down in battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我同意。不管这个假士兵心理症是什么，它只会让我在战斗中变得迟钝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing that remains is getting it. I could try and see if the Cult would allow me to receive treatment, but I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一剩下的事情就是得到治疗。我可以试着看看教团是否会允许我接受治疗，但我很怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard a rumor a long time from one of the Red Okie that Caesar's first tribe became doctors. Perhaps you could try them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久以前，我从一个红农人那里听到一个谣言说凯撒的第一个部落成为了医生。或许你可以试一试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need treatment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要治疗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, did you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. I came to help Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，我是来帮助凯撒的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, satisfy it elsewhere. Now, go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那，就去别的地方满足。好了，走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any. Speak to the Optio, or the, uh, legate. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有，去找执行官或者，呃，特使谈谈。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. This is a hub of supply rather than a combat area. It's rather dull. If you're looking for work, I would speak to the Optio or the, uh, the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。这里是补给中心而不是战区，太无聊了。如果你在找工作，我会说去找执行官或者，呃，特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, hurry up and help him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，赶快去帮助他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, that's the mark of a good Legionary. I suppose I could authorize a transfer to a front more active than Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，这就是优秀军团士兵的标志，我想我可以授权把他调到比马尔帕斯更活跃的前线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yuma, perhaps, although it wouldn't be much of an improvement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是尤马，尽管这不会有太大的改善。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does this Legionary have a name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个军团士兵有名字吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the Legionaries is currently requesting a transfer to the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一名军团士兵现在要求调到前线去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis....
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, no, that will be impossible. Sedonus specifically instructed me not to transfer him from Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，不，那是不可能的。塞多尼乌斯特别指示我不要把他从马尔帕斯调走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate obviously feels that Noctis is one of those soldiers that is too vital to the running of Malpais to be sent away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使显然觉得诺克提斯是那些对马尔帕斯的管理至关重要的士兵之一，不能被发派走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have heard the rumors, but it is not my place to question how the legate disciplines his subordinates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到了一些谣言，但我无权质疑特使如何管教他的部下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what the legate has been doing to Noctis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道特使对诺克提斯做了什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have come to talk about Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来谈谈诺克提斯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult of Mars? Very well. I have no objections. Noctis will be sent to them, and then, he will be transferred to Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团？很好，我没有异议。诺克提斯会被送到他们那里，然后，他会被转移到尤马。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aspirant Cassia from the Cult of Mars will be treating Noctis for the next several weeks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自玛尔斯教团的追寻者卡西娅将在接下来的几周内治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arcade? He is a Follower. No, unacceptable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿卡德？他是个天启追随者。不，不可接受。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My companion Arcade will be treating Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的同伴阿卡德会治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one. You are not a Legionary. Do not let that Mark of Caesar deceive you into thinking you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人。你不是军团士兵，别让凯撒的徽记欺骗了你，让你以为自己是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only person with the power to remove Sedonus is Caesar, and Lanius is far too busy to concern himself with the demands of a Recruit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有能力除掉塞多尼乌斯的人只有凯撒，而拉尼厄斯太忙了，根本无暇顾及新兵的要求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who can I talk to in order to remove him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以找谁把他弄走？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one. You are not a Legionary. Do not let that Mark of Caesar deceive you into thinking you are. I almost wonder why we still respect it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人。你不是军团士兵，别让凯撒的徽记欺骗了你，让你以为自己是。我都不知道为什么我们还得尊重这玩意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since the untimely death of our lord Caesar, the only person able to remove him is Lanius, and he is far too busy with preparations for Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从凯撒大帝英年早逝，唯一能让他下台的人就是拉尼厄斯了，而他正忙于胡佛大坝的准备工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It may be unfortunate, but no one below the rank of legate cannot even request that another legate be removed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然这可能很不幸，但低于特使级别的人甚至不能要求解除另一个特使的职务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who can I talk to in order to remove him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以找谁把他弄走？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis did not request anything. You did, and you have the Mark of Caesar that gives you leave to make such requests, even if I cannot grant them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯没有提出任何要求，是你提的。而且你身上有凯撒的徽记，即使我不能答应，你也可以提出这样的请求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pity Noctis, I do, but as long as the legate is here, I can do nothing. Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同情诺克提斯，真的，但只要特使还在，我就无能为力。再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I ask that you not tell the legate that Noctis requested this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能请求你不要告诉特使这是诺克提斯的要求吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whether it bothers me is irrelevant. That is how it is. As long as he has leave to rule, then he will do so until he breathes no longer. Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是否会困扰我是无关紧要的。事情就是这样，只要他还有统治的权力，他就会一直统治下去，直到断气为止。再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate is a criminal by your own standards. Shouldn't that bother you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照你们的标准，特使就是个罪犯。这难道不会困扰你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your tongue! The legate is the legate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说话小心点！特使就是特使。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is the only law that matters. As long as he lives, he is the undisputed matter of all those below him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是唯一重要的法律。只要他活着，他就是所有部下无可争议的权威。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, begone from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，快离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's absurd. The only good thing about the Legion are its laws. Hurry up and enforce them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太荒谬了。军团唯一的优点就是它的法律，赶快执行吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the rank of Optio is inferior to the rank of legate. Now, leave me. There is much work to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而执行官的级别比特使低。现在，离开吧，我还有很多工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, you're the Optio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但，你是执行官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already know what this is about. It's not going to happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经知道这是怎么回事了，这是不可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to speak to you about reassigning Noctis from Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈把诺克提斯从马尔帕斯调离的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's not how it works. Sedonus is a legate. Noctis is a prime, not even a decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是这样的。塞多尼乌斯是特使，诺克提斯是精英，甚至不是什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus can do anything he wants, and if he decides that some Legionary or slave or Liberti needs to be broken, then it's their time to be broken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯可以为所欲为，如果他决定要摧毁某个军团士兵、奴隶或自由人，那就是该摧毁他们的时候了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is the only law that matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是唯一重要的法律。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are aware that Noctis is a man, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道诺克提斯是个男人，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think he doesn't know? Caesar's eyes and ears extend everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得他不知道吗？凯撒的耳目无处不在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's goals are to bring holy salvation to the world, to build a true civilization. Noctis is not even a consideration in that design.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的目标是为世界带来神圣的救赎，建立一个真正的文明。在这个设计中，诺克提斯甚至都不是一个考虑因素。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're through here. I wouldn't bother talking to anyone else about this, especially Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到此为止。我不会和任何人谈论这件事，尤其是凯撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I told Caesar about this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我把这事告诉凯撒呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are working with the Legion when you don't understand how it works?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你都不明白军团是怎么运作的为什么还要和军团合作？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars has blessed Sedonus with the strength necessary to carry out Caesar's vision, and Sedonus has used that power for the good of the Legion for decades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯赐予塞多尼乌斯实现凯撒愿景所需的力量，塞多尼乌斯几十年来一直在为军团的利益而使用这种力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Noctis needs to be broken more forcefully than other Legionaries, then so be it, and if he can't get over it, then he deserves what Sedonus is giving to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果诺克提斯需要比其他军团士兵更狠的手段，那就这样吧，如果他无法克服，那么塞多诺斯给他的一切都是他应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't understand, then we're through here. I wouldn't bother talking to anyone else about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不明白，那我们就到此为止。我不会和任何人谈论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's despicable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太卑鄙了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus doesn't want your currency. He wants to break those under his command, and he will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯不想要你的钱。他想要打败他手下的人，他会做到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, we're done here. I wouldn't bother talking to anyone else about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，事情就到此为止了。我不会和任何人谈论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I pay you to convince Sedonus to leave Noctis alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能付钱让你说服塞多尼乌斯放过诺克提斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not here. Sedonus is a legate, and you are not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里不行。塞多尼乌斯是使节，而你不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's strange to see someone so admired by the rest of the Legion utterly fail to understand it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很奇怪，一个被其他军团如此崇拜的人却完全不能理解这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Power, strength, obedience. You should know them by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 权力，力量，服从。你现在应该了解他们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're done here. I wouldn't bother talking to anyone else about this. Now, drop it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到此为止，我不会和任何人谈论这件事。现在，别说了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a hero of the Legion. Doesn't that account for anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是军团的英雄，这难道不能说明什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one deserves anything. The only people who can't get by in this world are those who are too weak to take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有人应得任何东西。在这个世界上，唯一过不下去的人，就是那些软弱到无力承受的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too weak to deal with it. It's pathetic for a Legionary to go crying to some Dissolute for help. He'd be a disgrace on the battlefield.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太软弱，无力应对。一个军团士兵哭着向一个浪荡子求助太可悲了，他在战场上就是个耻辱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're done here. I wouldn't bother talking to anyone else about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们到此为止。我不会和任何人谈论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He doesn't deserve this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是他应得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it is. We're through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了。我们到此为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, I guess that's that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我想就这样吧。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch the adjutant like the legate asked you to.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <按照特使的要求给副官一拳>

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch the adjutant like the legate asked you to.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <按照特使的要求给副官一拳>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Sedonus's adjutant. I was sent to serve Sedonus at the leisure of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是塞多尼乌斯的副官，我是在凯撒空闲的时候被派去侍奉塞多尼乌斯的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supply runs, concubines, slaves, paperwork, whatever the legate needs. I also deliver messages between him and Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 补给、妻妾、奴隶、文书，特使需要的一切。我还负责他和凯撒之间的信息传递。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was Sedonus's adjutant. However, since his untimely demise, I am now the adjutant for Flavius Constantinus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是塞多尼乌斯的副官。然而，由于他的英年早逝，我现在是弗拉维乌斯·康斯坦提乌斯的副官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's an excellent commander with no discernible flaws.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一名优秀的指挥官，没有明显的缺点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus, yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯，是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说那个特使吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius, yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯，是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about the legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说那个特使吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from one of the earlier tribes liberated by the Legion. The Cococoninos, just outside Flagstaff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自一个早期被军团解放的部落，科科科尼诺，就在旗杆市郊外。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were led by some woman called the 'Dark Mother' who nearly brought the tribe to ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是由一个被称为“黑暗之母”的女人领导的，她几乎毁掉了部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad that they kicked her out long before I was born.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴他们早在我出生前就把她赶出去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know about you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想了解你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, you mean between Sedonus and the Frumentarii, or Sedonus and the Cult? No, I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，你是说塞多尼乌斯和特务，还是塞多尼乌斯和教团？不，我不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you deliver messages to anyone else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会给其他人传递消息吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius and the Optio have no need to deliver messages to the Frumentarii or the Cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯和执行官不需要向特务或教团传递信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you deliver messages to anyone else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会给其他人传递消息吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult of Mars. They're a bunch of freaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团，他们是一群怪胎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar keeps them around because spreading his divine word peacefully is women work. It's basically seduction, and that's really the only thing they're good at.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒让她们留在身边，因为和平传播他的神圣话语是女人的工作。基本上就是诱惑，这也是她们唯一擅长的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frankly, women shouldn't be in charge of anything at all, but if Caesar thinks they should, then they'll stay around for a while longer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坦白说，女人根本不应该负责任何事情，但如果凯撒认为她们应该负责，那么她们就会多待一段时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说教团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're Caesar's chosen, those loyal and skilled enough to operate outside the hierarchia. They report only to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是凯撒的选民，忠诚且有能力在等级制度之外活动。他们只向他汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I like the fact that they aren't subject to the powers of a legate, but they're useful at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能说我喜欢他们不受特使权力的约束，但他们至少是有用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're Caesar's chosen, those loyal and skilled enough to operate outside the hierarchia. They report only to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是凯撒的选民，忠诚且有能力在等级制度之外活动。他们只向他汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I like the fact that they aren't subject to the powers of a legate, but that will change soon enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能说我喜欢他们不受特使权力约束的事实，但这很快就会改变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was the greatest man to ever emerge from the Seven Tribes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是七部落中最伟大的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: While I am saddened by his death, perhaps Mars ordained that it was his time to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然我对他的死感到悲伤，但也许是玛尔斯决定他离开的时候了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the greatest man to ever emerge from the Seven Tribes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是七部落中最伟大的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has borne witness to Caesar's divine vision and is more committed to it than anyone else in the whole of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他见证了凯撒的神圣愿景，并且比整个军团中任何人都更加坚定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a violent and brutal man. I met him once, in the Utah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个暴力而残忍的人。我见过他一次，在犹他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is what Legion commanders aspire to be, and I have no dobut that he will lead us to victory at the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是军团指挥官渴望成为的人，我相信他会带领我们在大坝取得胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，拉尼厄斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a violent and brutal man. I met him once, in the Utah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个暴力而残忍的人。我见过他一次，在犹他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is what Legion commanders aspire to be, and I have no dobut that he will lead us to victory at the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是军团指挥官渴望成为的人，我相信他会带领我们在大坝取得胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，拉尼厄斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have come to talk about Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来谈谈诺克提斯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, him. Why are you wasting my time with this? If I haven't transferred him to the front, then he isn't going to be transferred.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他啊，你为什么要浪费我的时间？如果我没有把他调到前线，那他就不会被调走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The matter is closed. End of discussion. Goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件事已经了结了，结束讨论。再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis. He's a Legionary here at Malpais. He's requesting a transfer to the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯，他是马尔帕斯的一名军团士兵。他要求调到前线去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mark of Caesar doesn't grant you leave to waste my fucking time. Leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的徽记可不允许你浪费我的时间。离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My mistake. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的错，抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Now leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。现在出去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The matter is closed. End of story. Now, begone from here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这件事已经了结了，故事到此结束。现在，离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there any chance I can change your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能不能让你改变主意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He.... Of course he is. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他...他当然是。对不起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And the legate isn't?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He cares about the soldiers. He is a good commander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他很关心士兵，他是一位优秀的指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Noctis [0601ECC0] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC77]AZMalpaisAbuseQuest) It's Bad for Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: She called for a war against the Legion when they were first bringing the light of Mars out of the Grand Caynon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团第一次将玛尔斯之光带出大峡谷时，她曾呼吁与军团开战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank Mars that we kicked her out. She's probably dead in the wastes now, as she deserves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 感谢玛尔斯，我们把她赶了出去。她现在可能已经死在废土上了，这是她应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Dark Mother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个黑暗之母。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Inventory. It's boring and thankless, but it needs to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 库存。这既无聊又吃力不讨好，但必须要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Occasionally, I go to Crimson Caravans to procure additional supplies. Or, really, I go to other smaller caravans because Crimson is too expensive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偶尔会去深红商队购买额外的物资。或者，说真的，我去其他小一点的商队，因为深红太贵了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Other than that, I occasionally do therapy and basic medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除此之外，我偶尔也做一些治疗和基础医学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a slum. Lots of gangs, lots of drugs and lots of violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个贫民窟。帮派林立，毒品泛滥，暴力频发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the product of the Strip's exploitation of the working class and its elite draining away all of the rsources oft he Mojave to fuel its unstable tourist economy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是长街剥削工人阶级和精英阶层的产物，他们耗尽了莫哈维的所有资源，为不稳定的旅游经济提供燃料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and don't eat the food off Gennaro's table.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，别吃格纳罗桌上的食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell about Freeside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能说说自由之城吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, the fort? The Mormons told us about this place when the NCR was expanding into the Mojave. Gave us maps and everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，堡垒？NCR向莫哈维扩张的时候摩门教徒告诉了我们这个地方，给我们地图什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Used to be one of their old waypoints, before the Great War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大战之前，这里曾是他们的一个老歇脚处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说这个地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am. Is this for you or...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。这是你的还是...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you qualified to treat post-traumatic stress?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有能力治疗创伤后应激障碍吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I suppose I can fit some therapy sessions for a month or so, provided that they come to the Old Mormon Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我想我可以在一个月左右的时间里安排一些心理治疗，只要他们来旧摩门要塞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I have a name for our patient and when they can come in?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能告诉我病人的名字和他们什么时候能来吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it's for someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，是别人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais, in Arizona? You want me to provide treatment to an organization that kills Followers on sight? Is this some kind of joke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚利桑那的马尔帕斯？你想让我为一个一见天启追随者就杀的组织提供治疗吗？开什么玩笑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think Caesar or Lanius are going to let me walk into their camps and tell their Legionaries that it's okay for them to be feeling guilt for their actions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得凯撒或拉尼厄斯会让我走进他们的营地告诉他们的士兵为自己的行为感到内疚是正常的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: That they didn't know any better? I'd be crucified in a heartbeat!
ESP.TRADUIT: 难道他们不懂事吗？那我马上就会被钉上十字架！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, please tell me, what trauma could he have possibly experienced that makes him different than any other Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，请告诉我，他到底经历了什么创伤让他和其他军团士兵不同？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis. He is a Legionary in Malpais, so he is not likely to be able to come here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺提克斯。他是马尔帕斯的一名军团士兵，所以他不太可能来这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you "no."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经说过了，不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if you want me to set foot in Legion territory, you are going to have to drag me out kicking and screaming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，如果你想让我踏进军团的地盘，你就得把我拖出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, leave me alone. I have work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，离我远点。我有工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure you can't help Noctis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定不能帮诺克提斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Religious missionaries from New Canaan in Utah. They sometimes came into the cities to preach about God or to offer trade with their caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自犹他新迦南的宗教传教士。他们有时会到城市里来宣讲上帝，或者与商队进行贸易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met one of their members, a missionary named Bert. He seemed nice enough, but I don't particularly care for organized religion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我遇到了他们的一个成员，一个叫伯特的传教士。他看起来还不错，但我不是特别喜欢有组织的宗教。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mormons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 摩门教徒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, you do that. Jesus Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你就这么做。耶稣基督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then I guess I won't bother you with this again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我想我不会再用这个麻烦你了。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, no, that is wrong. No one deserves that, not even a Legionary. I'm sorry for yelling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，不，那是错的。没人应该这样，即使是军团士兵。对不起，我不该吼你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I am not going to Arizona. Way too dangerous for a Follower. I can't help everyone, and I accepted that a long time ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我不会去亚利桑那，那里对一个天启追随者来说太危险了。我不能帮助所有人，我很久以前就接受了这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not about to throw it all away for some Legionary who probably wouldn't hesitate to return that favor to some slave girl.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可不想为了一个可能会毫不犹豫地回报某个奴隶女孩的军团士兵而放弃这一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the victim of one of those unspeakable things you mentioned. By a legate, no less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是你提到的那种难以启齿的事情的受害者，还是特使干的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. No, you wouldn't. No one like you would just get a Follower killed for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，你不会的。像你这样的人不会无缘无故杀掉一个天启追随者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just tell me whenever you're ready to leave, and I guess we'll go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备走的时候告诉我一声，我们就走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Followers] Do you really think I would get a Follower killed for no reason?
ESP.TRADUIT: [天启追随者]你真觉得我会让一个天启追随者无缘无故被杀吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. That's....
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is why I became Follower in the first place. Simple acts of kindness, no matter how unrewarding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我成为天启追随者的初衷。简单的善举，不管值不值得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just tell me whenever you're ready to leave, and I guess we'll go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你准备走的时候告诉我一声，我们就走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The greatest acts of good are never rewarded. If they were, then the apocalypse wouldn't have happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最伟大的善行是不会有回报的。如果有的话，那么世界末日就不会发生了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, but I'm still not going. Don't bother me with this again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，但我还是不去。别再拿这件事来烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the right thing to do, and you know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是正确的做法，你知道的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because you can apparently walk around freely in Legion territory doesn't mean anyone else can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅仅因为你可以在军团领地上自由走动，并不意味着其他人也可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going, and that's final.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不去，就这么定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't change your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能改变你的想法吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awful? Like, what type of question is that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可怕？这是什么类型的问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You shouldn't have to give therapy while troops point a gun at your head, and I had to be careful not to say anything that would piss the Legion off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不应该在军队拿枪指着你的时候接受心理治疗，而且我必须小心翼翼，不能说任何会激怒军团的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, I managed to give Noctis the tools to begin the healing process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是设法给了诺克提斯开始治疗过程的工具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How was it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Recovering from sexual assault is a years-long process, and several weeks of therapy don't automatically fix everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。从性侵中恢复是一个长达数年的过程，几周的治疗不会自动解决所有问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has the tools, but I don't know if he's going to be able to use them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有工具，但我不知道他能不能用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once gis appetite and sleep recovered, the Optio told me that he's transferring Noctis to the frontlines at Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等诺克提斯恢复食欲和睡眠后，执行官告诉我他要把他调到尤马的前线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, I did the best I could, though, I'm certain of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我还是尽了最大努力，这一点我很确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is Noctis okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think so. I've got an appointment with one of our psychiatrists later this week to see if there's any lingering trauma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。这周晚些时候我约了一位精神科医生看看是否有什么挥之不去的创伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I figured. Well, I guess that's that. I'm probably one of the Followers to have set foot in Arizona for decades.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜到了。好吧，我想就是这样了，我可能是几十年来踏足亚利桑那的天启追随者之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a shame we couldn't help Noctis, but some things aren't meant to be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾我们没能帮到诺克提斯，但有些事是命中注定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, it was a bluff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，那是虚张声势。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, fuck!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，操！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> No, I meant it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>不，我是说真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我们走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yep, I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, well, let's not wait too long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，嗯，我们别等太久了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet. I had other things to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没有。我还有别的事要谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the meaning of this? Who is this stranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？这个陌生人是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Halt! Who is your prisoner?
ESP.TRADUIT: 站住！你的俘虏是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the blood, the Profligate asks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这血是怎么回事，浪荡子问道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the blood of my worthless Adjutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我那没用的副官的血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the blood?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这血是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: An inferior whelp that Caesar has given me to help me manage Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个凯撒派来帮我管理马尔帕斯的低级崽子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's worthless, but he can take a beating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他虽然没用，但也能挨一顿揍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's really the only thing he's good for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是他唯一擅长的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll beat the shit out of him later, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以后也会把他揍得屁滚尿流的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's your adjutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的副官是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not? Fuck him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不呢？操他妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go beat him up for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去帮你揍他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你会的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Marcellus Sedonus, legate and master of Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯，马尔帕斯的特使和主人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad to hear that. As for me, I'm doing wonderful, my friend. Thank you for asking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听你这么说我很高兴。至于我，我很好，我的朋友，谢谢你的关心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm doing well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An Aspirant is someone who devotes herself wholeheartedly to the Cult of Mars. To Caesar and his divinity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 追寻者是一个全心全意地献身于玛尔斯教团的人，献给凯撒和他的神性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She dreams of nothing but Caesar and how to spread his good word across the Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她的梦想只有恺撒，以及如何将他的福音传遍整个废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Aspirant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是追寻者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We are Caesar's gift to the Wasteland. We are his chosen disciples to spread the divine message of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是凯撒送给废土的礼物。我们是他所拣选的门徒，来传播玛尔斯的神圣信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sends us out into the world to proselytize the Dissolute, to make Profligates renounce their own profligacy, to shape the world in his image.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他差遣我们到世上去，使淫乱的人改变信仰，使放荡的人放弃自己的放荡，以他的形象重塑世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We enforce his divine will on the children as well, so that they may grow up to be strong enough to carry out his mandate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们也把他的神圣意志强加给孩子们，这样他们就可以成长为足够强大的人来执行他的命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说玛尔斯教团吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Justice, my friend. Justice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正义，我的朋友。正义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not. Caesar is divine, he is holy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不。凯撒是神圣的，他是圣洁的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR proclaims itself to civilized, but without Caesar's guidance, they are nothing but oppressive Profligate mammonists.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR宣称自己是文明的，但没有凯撒的指引，他们只不过是暴虐的、挥霍无度的拜金主义者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't it bother you that the Legion enslaves and oppresses women? You are one, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团对女性的奴役和压迫，你不觉得困扰吗？毕竟，你是其中之一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Terrible. How do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟透了。你觉得呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took a boat to Newt about three months ago. That was before the Cult started recruiting in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三个月前我乘船去纽特，那是教团开始在纽特招募成员之前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were looking for voluntaria. I told them that I truly believed in Caesar's light and was made and Aspirant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在寻找志愿者。我告诉他们，我真的相信凯撒的光芒，并且愿意成为追寻者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They asked what I was best suited for, and I told them that a woman's place was in the home, so they had teach the children, which is what I wanted to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们问我最适合做什么，我告诉他们女人应该待在家里，所以她们要教孩子，这也是我想做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you find yourself in this position?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是如何陷入这种境地的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're true believers in Caesar, the Legion and their fucked up patriarchical way of life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她们是凯撒的忠实信徒，是军团的忠实信徒，也是他们该死的父权生活方式的忠实信徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm honestly shocked that anyone would willingly join an organization that specifically exists to tell them they have no rights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话我真的很震惊，居然有人愿意加入一个专门告诉自己没有任何权利的组织。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess there's always some idiot who thinks that they'll be exempt when the death cult gets bored of their current targets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜总有一些白痴认为当死亡崇拜的邪教厌倦了现在的目标时就会对他们网开一面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an Aspirant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是追寻者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're Caesar's arm of propaganda. Outside the Legion, they go out and preach to some uneducated community about how great Caesar is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是凯撒的宣传武器。在军团之外，他们出去向一些没有受过教育的社区宣讲凯撒是多么伟大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They talk about crop rotation or water filtration, stuff like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们谈论作物轮作或水过滤，诸如此类的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, when the next season brings a good harvest, they can point to Caesar and say that he blessed them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，当下一个季节带来好收成时，他们可以指着凯撒说他祝福了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If people believe it, then Caesar's got a new bunch of collaborators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人们相信了，那么凯撒就有了一群新的合作者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If people don't believe it, it doesn't matter. They are still doing better, so Caesar's still got a new bunch of collaborators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人们不相信，那也没关系。他们的表现还是更好，所以凯撒还是有了一群新的合作者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although the members themselves, the ones who go to the church and stuff, they're pretty normal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管那些成员，那些去教堂的人，他们都很正常。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really different from the Way of Rta in Shady or those Mormon missionaries from New Canaan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与沙荫镇的Rta之道或新迦南的摩门教传教士并没有什么不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说玛尔斯教团吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I was in Malpais when it happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，事情发生时我在马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard the reports for days. The Legionaries were talking about Rangers, and there were some rumors among the slaves that the NCR had begun crossing the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听到这些报道好几天了。军团士兵们在谈论着游骑兵，奴隶们之间也有传言说NCR已经开始越过大坝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last one obviously wasn't true, but the first one might have been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一个显然不是真的，但前一个可能是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Either way, Mr. Rex has been cheerfully butchering the entire town as reprisal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管怎样，勒克斯先生已经兴高采烈的屠杀了整个小镇作为报复。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you see what happened to Big Stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到大站发生什么事了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it has not. The Legion are... morons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没有。军团是...白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know how hard it is to treat gangrene without blood transfusions or Stimpaks? Or how to treat tremors without Steady?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道治疗坏疽不输血也不注射治疗针有多难吗？或者没有稳定剂怎么治疗震颤？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and they don't seem to care that the mortality rate drastically increases when using their herbal remedies instead of Stimpaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他们似乎并不关心当使用他们的草药而不是治疗针时死亡率会急剧增加。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't get me started on therapy for PTSD. The Legion doesn't have it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别让我开始治疗创伤后应激障碍。军团没有这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even if they did, the Cult of Mars would rather spend their time making sure that you know you're weak for using it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使他们有了，玛尔斯教团也宁愿花时间来确保你知道你使用它是一种软弱的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing I'm allowed to use is alcohol for sterilizing wounds, and that's it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一被允许使用的东西就是酒精用于伤口消毒，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly, I'm glad that I've mostly been required to work with children instead of medicine. I would have lost my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我很高兴我大部分时间都被要求与儿童打交道，而不是从事医疗工作。不然我会疯掉的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, has being a Follower helped you with being a Martian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，作为天启追随者对你成为一个火星生物有帮助吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Followers were founded to help clean up the aftermath of the Great War. To promote education, knowledge, peace and personal growth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天启追随者的成立是为了帮助清理大战后的残局。促进教育、知识、和平及个人成长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what it means to follow the apocalypse. Caesar's our own apocalypse, and some has to start cleaning up his mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是追随天启的意义。凯撒就是我们的末日，必须有人开始收拾他的烂摊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I starts with the kids. They're the ones who need help to recover the most.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从孩子们开始，他们是最需要帮助恢复的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you do it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We created him and the Legion, in a way. We give out knowledge to everyone because the more people know some thing, the less likely it is that the knowledge is lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从某种意义上说，是我们创造了他和军团。我们把知识传授给每个人，因为人们知道的东西越多，知识丢失的可能性就越小。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And sometimes, we give it to bad people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时候，我们把它给了坏人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sallow was just some punk in New Adytum who read too much Edward Gibbon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 萨隆只是内城区一个读了太多爱德华·吉本书的小混混。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Instead, he used the library we let him practically live in to use that knowledge to create the Legion all those years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他反倒利用我们让他生活的图书馆，在多年前靠这些知识创建了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, Bill Calhoun took him on a trip to the Grand Canyon, and Sallow used that opportunity to play warlord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，比尔·卡尔霍恩带他去大峡谷旅行，萨隆利用这个机会扮演军阀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, his Legion has annihilated 86 tribes and is preparing for a war against the NCR. Is there any way to describe that other than an apocalypse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，他的军团已经消灭了86个部落，并准备与NCR开战。除了天启，还有什么可以形容吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is Caesar the Followers' apocalypse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒追随者的天启是怎样的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did anyone get punished for letting Caesar make the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人因为让凯撒建立军团而受到惩罚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I didn't. Truth be told, no one really knows where he is anymore. He's probably dead, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不认识。说实话，没有人知道他到底在哪里，不过他可能已经死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you know Bill Calhoun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识比尔·卡尔霍恩吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some moralist from five centuries ago that complained about the decline of the Roman Empire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五个世纪前的某个卫道士，曾抨击过罗马帝国的衰败。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm amazed that Sallow made that his whole personality, especially given that we had dozens of other, more accurate books on that subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信萨隆把那个当成人设，尤其我们明明有几十本更权威的相关书籍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Edward Gibbon?
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱德华·吉本是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Followers don't order people around like that. We keep the knowledge, spread the word and donate to anybody willing to get more information on anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天启追随者们不会那样使唤别人。我们保留知识，传播信息，并捐赠给任何愿意获得更多信息的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not like anyone ordered Bill Calhoun to travel to the Grand Canyon. It was just a little side project.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又没人命令比尔·卡尔霍恩去大峡谷，那只是个小项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And we're an outreach program, not an army, so we had no way of fixing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是一个外展计划，不是军队，所以我们没办法解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We let the NCR know decades ago, and they didn't feel like fixing it, either. Until now, when there was something in it for them, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们早在几十年前就告诉了NCR，他们也不想修复它。直到现在，当然，这对他们来说是有好处的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, you would like to discuss this outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，你想出去讨论一下？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's an awfully big word for someone with Legion education. I don't think you're Legion at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对一个受过军团教育的人来说，这个词太夸张了。我觉得你根本不是军团的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, you would like to discuss this outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，你想出去讨论一下？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mammonists? That's just a fancier way to say "rofligate". No way you learned that in Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜金主义者？这只是“堕落者”的一种更时髦的说法。你不可能在军团的地盘学到这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mammonists? Oh, it just means obsessed with money. Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜金主义者吗？哦，它的意思是痴迷于金钱。不用担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was that third word?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第三个词是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sh-.... Perhaps we can discuss this outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，嘘...要不我们到外面再说？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found that this note. You're a Follower?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了这张纸条，你是个天启追随者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A fight it is, then!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就战斗吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> No. As an enemy of Caesar, your life is forfeit.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>不。作为凯撒的敌人，你将被处死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fuck I am!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈就是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> No. You're coming with me to the nearest Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>不，你和我一起去见最近的什长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Desmond sent you? So, you're with the Followers, then. No way he would have told you otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 德斯蒙德派你来的？那么，你是天启追随者的人了，否则他不可能告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he just wants to know if I'm okay, then you can tell him so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他只是想知道我是否安好，那你就告诉他吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I told you that no good water runs in Oak Creek, what would you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我告诉你橡树溪没有好水，你会怎么说？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, are you mental? The Legion hates the Followers. They shoot them on sight unless they have a Mark of Caesar protecting them or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，你疯了吗？军团痛恨天启追随者。除非有凯撒的徽记或其他什么保护，否则他们一见到追随者就会开枪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with the Followers, and I'm studying the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和天启追随者在一起，我在研究军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, NCR. Them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，NCR，他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then. Meet your local anarchist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧，见见你当地的无政府主义者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with the NCR. I'm infiltrating the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是NCR的，我要潜入军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're terrible, honestly. They are not really as bad as the Legion, but they have a lot of the same root problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 老实说，他们太糟糕了。他们并不真的像军团那么坏，但是他们有很多相同的根源问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corruption, oligarchic tendencies, reactionary sentiment, the works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 腐败，寡头政治倾向，反动情绪，等等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, at least there's a chance that it might get better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，至少还有好转的可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't like the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不喜欢NCR？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is probably a mistake, but....
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可能是一个错误，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just looking to help out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是想帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the word 'mammonist,' and you're not political? I don't buy it. Who are you, really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道“拜金主义者”这个词，而你不关心政治？我才不信呢。你到底是什么人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really with anyone. Too much politics for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不和任何人一起，对我来说政治太多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to die!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会死的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> No, you were right the first time. You definitely have something to hide.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>不，你第一次是对的。你肯定有什么想隐瞒的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well.... It's not like I've had any progress on this, so here's the thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我在这方面并没有什么进展，所以事情是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've given up. The indoctrination is too strong, and I can't be near them enough to truly parent them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经放弃了。他们的教化太强烈了，我无法在他们身边真正的养育他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I'm going to take them far away from here. To Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我要把他们带到离这里很远的地方，去苦泉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Changed your mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 改变主意了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I help?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that is a good start, but it's going to be difficult to convince the children to leave without their own cooperation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是一个很好的开始，但如果没有孩子们的配合，说服他们离开是很难的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's been indoctrinating these kids for years to follow authority figures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团多年来一直在给这些孩子灌输追随权威人物的思想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we can get Agu to tell the children to leave, then we'll be able to get everyone out alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果能叫阿古让孩子们离开，我们就能把大家都活着救出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've talked to Desmond and repaired the rafts. I think we should be good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经和德斯蒙德谈过了，把木筏修好了。我想我们应该没问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any choice, and it's not really kidnapping, since it's for their own good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我别无选择，这也不是真正的绑架，这是为了他们好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're kidnapping them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要绑架他们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it is!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, just talk to the kids. They have a rite of Mars coming up. You'll see how deep it goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，和孩子们谈谈。马上就要举行玛尔斯的仪式了，你会看到有多强烈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're free to make your own decisions, but....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以自己做决定，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, just talk to the kids. They have a rite of Mars coming up. You'll see how deep it goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，和孩子们谈谈。马上就要举行玛尔斯的仪式了，你会看到有多强烈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if I agree with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道我是否同意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, and brainwashing them to fight in the service of some fucking fascist isn't?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，给他们洗脑让他们为法西斯分子效力就不算吗？
