ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, just talk to the kids. They have a rite of Mars coming up. You'll see how deep it goes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，和孩子们谈谈。马上就要举行玛尔斯的仪式了，你会看到有多强烈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely not. Kidnapping children is wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对不行，绑架儿童是错误的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay! Great! That's... I was expecting you to say no, that's all. So, thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！太好了！这是...我还以为你会拒绝，就这样。所以，谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, to get across Lake Mead, I'm going to need help from Desmond to help us ferry them across. He should still be at Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，为了渡过米德湖，我需要德斯蒙德帮我们把他们摆渡过去。他应该还在苦泉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We'll also need boats, probably somewhere at Temple Bar Marina, just out of sight from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还需要船，可能在圣殿酒吧码头的某个地方，就在军团看不到的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me know when you're done, and we'll go from there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了告诉我一声，我们再继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I respect that. All I ask is that you do not tell the Legion who I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尊重这一点。我只求你不要把我的身份告诉军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I 'm not looking to piss off the Legion anytime soon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，我可不想这么快就惹怒军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did he? What happened there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他吗？那里发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a Mark of Caesar, though, see? Caesar wanted to talk to me about an army of robots.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我身上有凯撒的徽记，明白吗？凯撒想和我谈谈机器人军队的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't like House much, either, but that's neither here nor there. Here's the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我也不太喜欢豪斯，但这不是重点。事实是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blew them up. Fuck House.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们炸了。去他妈的豪斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's hope I don't regret this one. Here's the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，希望我不会后悔。事实是这样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blew them up. I am regretting that decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把他们炸了。我对那个决定感到后悔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, shit, you are with the Legion!
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，该死，你是军团的人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I blew them up because Caesar asked me to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我炸了是因为凯撒让我这么做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm no fan of House, but if you've managed to get something over on Caesar, then you're what I need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是豪斯的粉丝，但如果你能骗过凯撒，那你就是我需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't Caesar is going to like what House has planned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为凯撒会喜欢豪斯的计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who the hell is Yes Man? Actually, that's neither here nor there. If you've gotten one over Caesar, then you're what I need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好先生是什么人？实际上，这不重要。如果你能战胜凯撒，那你就是我需要的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Natalie, and I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, and I'm trying to break Legion indoctrination and propaganda at its root.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫纳塔莉，我是天启追随者的一员，我想从根本上打破军团的灌输和宣传。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think Caesar is going to like what Yes Man has planned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为凯撒会喜欢好好先生的计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha, did you hear what happened to Malachi? Moron. He shouldn't have hidden it. Anyways, yeah, you can head back to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈，你听说玛拉基的事了吗？白痴，他不该藏起来的。总之，你可以回去找他了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a slave invoice from Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一张马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯的奴隶发票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A legate, huh? And he's sending you, not a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使，是吧？他派的是你，而不是军团士兵？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, I'm not to going to deny an opportunity to get in good with a legate. You can head on back now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我也不会拒绝一个和特使搞好关系的机会。你现在可以回去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Julius [0600E3B5] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a slave invoice from Marcellus Sedonus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一张马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯的奴隶发票。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Agu. I'm the oldest child here, and that makes me the leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是阿古。我是这里最大的孩子，所以我是领袖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm training to kill evil Profligates. I'm going to be a Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在训练杀死邪恶的堕落者，我要成为什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've been a soldier for a year and three months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当兵已经一年零三个月了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's really cool. You get a gun and some spears and get to shoot people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的很酷。你有一把枪和一些长矛，可以射击敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How long have been with the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你加入军团多久了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arizona. My dad was Painted Rock, I think. He died fighting the NCR a couple years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚利桑那，我想我爸爸是彩绘岩的。几年前，他在与NCR的战斗中牺牲了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am. I'm going to be a future Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是我，我未来要成为什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里谁负责？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Jaw Ripper and Cassia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，下颚撕裂者和卡西娅。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but who are the adults in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但这里的成年人是谁说了算？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which one?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know about the adults here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想了解一下这里的成年人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because Caesar said they are. Duh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为凯撒说他们是，哼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know they're evil?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道他们是邪恶的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jaw Ripper took us on a field trip as a reward for doing well in class.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下颚撕裂者带我们去实地考察作为对我们在课堂上表现好的奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It felt great killing those Profligates! I wish I could go fight at Hoover Dam, but Jaw Ripper says that I'm not old enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀死那些堕落者的感觉太棒了！我希望我能去胡佛水坝战斗，但下颚撕裂者说我还不够老。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened at Solitare?
ESP.TRADUIT: 索利泰尔发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no one else. Knife Eye is from New Mexico, and Vek is from Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，没有其他人。刀眼来自新墨西哥州，维克来自科罗拉多州。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are the other kids from the Painted Rock?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他孩子是从彩绘岩来的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's our field instructor. He's been teaching us how to track animals and stuff, and hunt in the wild.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是我们的野外教官。他一直在教我们如何追踪动物之类的东西，以及如何在野外狩猎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I caught a Blister Beetle a month ago, but Jaw Ripper told me that they're poisonous, so we drained the fluids to make poisons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个月前我抓到一只刺螯甲虫，但下颚撕裂者告诉我它们有毒，所以我们把液体抽干制成毒药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was neat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很巧妙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Jaw Ripper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说下颚撕裂者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's our Aspirant. She taught us how to write Latin and treat wounds and stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是我们的追寻者。她教我们如何写拉丁文，如何治疗伤口等等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's nice, I guess. Gives us treats from time to time. But, she's kind of annoying, talking about how we shouldn't enjoy killing so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想她人不错，时不时地给我们一些款待。但是，她有点烦人，说我们不应该那么享受杀戮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess, maybe, I dunno.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜，也许，我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Cassia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说卡西娅。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I instruct the children in the necessary arts. War, survival, strength. Soon, they'll be ready for battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我教孩子们必要的艺术，战争，生存，力量。很快，他们就会做好战斗的准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All that's left is completing their rite of Mars, fighting a Legionary and going on a raid to the north. They'll miss Hoover Dam, which is a shame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剩下的就是完成他们的玛尔斯仪式，与军团作战，然后向北突袭。他们会想念胡佛大坝的，这真是太遗憾了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They will ready for the war with NCR at least.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们至少会为与NCR的战争做好准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In a way, all soldiers in the Legion are fathers, and all women are their mothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某种程度上，军团里所有的士兵都是父亲，而所有的女人都是他们的母亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything in the Legion is done for the children, so that they can live in the just world of Mars, free of the barbarity of democracy and weakness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团里的一切都是为了孩子们，让他们能够生活在正义的玛尔斯世界，远离民主和软弱的野蛮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you their father?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是他们的父亲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since birth. From the cradle to the grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从出生开始，从摇篮到坟墓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're asking when they begin practical training, it is the age of twelve, sometimes eleven if they show any particularly promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你问他们何时开始实践训练，那是在十二岁，如果他们展现出特别的天赋，有时也会在十一岁开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agu, for instance, he's one of those children who show particular promise. I've raised him since he was four because I knew he would turn out right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如阿古，他就是那些表现出特别前途的孩子之一。我从他四岁起就抚养他，因为我知道他会成功的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When do children start training to become a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们从什么时候开始接受训练成为军团士兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elaborate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 详细说明。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia is not who she says she is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅不是她自称的那个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Again with this nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这种无稽之谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia is not who she says she is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅不是她自称的那个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing an Aspirant in the Cult of Mars is a grave offense. You will be taken out and executed. Especially for corrupting our youths.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在玛尔斯教团中杀死一个追寻者是一种严重的罪行，你会被带走处决。尤其是腐化我们的年轻人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless your reasoning is very satisfactory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你的推理非常令人满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Killing an Aspirant in the Cult of Mars is a grave offense. You will be taken out and executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在玛尔斯教团中杀死一个追寻者是一种严重的罪行，你会被带走处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless your reasoning is very satisfactory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你的推理非常令人满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The children will hunt a Brahmin. They'll starve themselves for three days and then butcher it in the name of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们要猎杀一头婆罗门牛，他们会饿自己三天然后以玛尔斯的名义把它宰了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a rite of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯仪式是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's to measure their progress. If six of them can kill a Legionary, then they're ready for battle alongside the Legionaries as brothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是为了衡量他们的进步。如果他们六个人能杀死一个军团士兵，那么他们就可以像兄弟一样与军团士兵并肩作战了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they have to kill a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么要杀一个军团士兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They need to work as a unit against enemies greater in number than them. War's different from training, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们需要作为一个单位对抗比他们数量更多的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Raids up north?
ESP.TRADUIT: 袭击北方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand children who grow up West of the Colorado only have one father and one mother.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，在科罗拉多西部长大的孩子只有一个父亲和一个母亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's no wonder that the NCR turned out as Profligate as they did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 难怪NCR最终会变成像他们那样的堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, here in the Legion, all of the Legion takes care of all its children. All are fathers, and all are mothers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，在军团里，所有的军团都会照顾所有的孩子。人人都是父亲，人人都是母亲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a superior way of preparing the children for the hardships of this world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是让孩子们为这个世界的艰辛做好准备的一种优越的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not. The Wasteland is harsh, and it would be criminal to not prepare them early.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不。废土是严酷的，如果不及早准备，那将是犯罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it bother you, using children as Legionaries?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把孩子当成军团士兵，你不介意吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely. Children are amazing. They're better than some of the contubernia that had served under my command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对的。孩子们真了不起，他们比我麾下的一些十人队要强。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They follow orders without question, and they're so inventive. They'll come up with solutions no one ever thought of. Competitive, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们毫无疑问地服从命令，而且他们很有创造力，他们会想出没人想过的解决办法。也很有竞争力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe that the best age for any Legionary is between thirteen and fifteen years. After that, most Legionaries stop seeing war as a game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为十三到十五岁是军团士兵的最佳年龄。在那之后，大多数军团士兵不再将战争视为一种游戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which is a shame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很遗憾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do children make good Legionaries?
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子能成为好的军团士兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is from the forsaken tribe. The ones who rejected Caesar's light. The cross marks him as such. Why did you bring him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他来自被遗忘的部落，那些拒绝凯撒之光的人，十字架就是他的标志。你为什么把他带来？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is unacceptable. His tribe denied Caesar's divinity and refused to acknowledge Him as the son of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不可接受的。他的部落否认凯撒的神性，并拒绝承认他是玛尔斯的儿子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They took His knowledge and used it to promote profligacy and degeneracy in the NCR. He must die, and so must Noctis for requesting this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们窃取了他的知识，并利用这些知识在NCR中助长了挥霍和堕落。他必须死，诺提斯也必须死，因为他提出了这样的请求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's here to help treat Noctis's trauma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是来帮诺克提斯治疗创伤的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you won't mind if I execute him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你不介意我处决他吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's no one. Just kind of followed me around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个无名小卒，只是跟着我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is what we were going to do. Step aside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我们要做的，靠边站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you can just kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你可以直接杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's doctor was a forsaken? That is disconcerting. But, if that's the case....
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的医生是被遗忘者？这令人不安。但是，如果是这样的话...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall take on this Follower as a doctor for Noctis. Should he attempt to undermine the Legion in any way, he will be crucified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让这个天启追随者做诺克提斯的医生。如果他企图以任何方式破坏军团，他将被钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you will be held responsible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要为此负责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've come in here with Arcade before. What's the issue?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前和阿卡德一起来过这里，有什么问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arcade? Oh, the companion. We are under the sworn command of Caesar to avoid antagonizing your companions provided that they do not attack us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿卡德？哦，那个同伴。我们接受凯撒的宣誓命令，只要你的同伴不攻击我们，我们就不会与他们对抗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he had been in the position to treat Legionaries, then he also would have been executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他是在治疗军团士兵，那么他也会被处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've come in here with Arcade before. What's the issue?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前和阿卡德一起来过这里，有什么问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You speak with authority on this issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个问题上你说话很有权威。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not happy about this, but if that is the case, then this forsaken will treat Noctis until his weakness is purged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此很不高兴，但如果是这样的话，那么这个被遗忘者会治疗诺克提斯直到他的弱点被清除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis will be not be able to fight at peak performance until his soldier's heart is cured.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯无法以最佳状态作战，直到他的士兵心理症痊愈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] *sighs* That is true. The legate is no longer with us. Perhaps, that is the will of Mars, perhaps it is a test.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]*叹气*确实如此。特使已经不在了，也许，这是玛尔斯的意志，也许这是一种考验。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate could have been wrong, although I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使也可能是错的，尽管我对此表示怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is what will happen: Your prisoner will treat Noctis. After he is done, if there is improvement, then he will returned West.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结果是这样的：你的囚犯将治疗诺克提斯。在他完成之后，如果有改善，他就会回到西部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there isn't, he and Noctis will both die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有，他和诺克提斯都会死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis is a dutiful Legionary. A lesser Profligate soldier would have deserted. There is hope for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克蒂斯是一名尽职尽责的军团士兵，一个有点堕落的士兵早就当逃兵了。他还有希望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] It is absolutely a problem. A legate dies in mysterious circumstances, and a member of the forsaken tribes comes here soon after?
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]这绝对有问题。一名特使在神秘的情况下死亡，一个被遗忘部落的成员不久后来到了这里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. This is clearly a test from Mars. Guards, execute the forsaken and Noctis! Spare the one with the Mark!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这显然是一个来自玛尔斯的测试。卫兵，处决被遗忘者和诺克提斯！放过有徽记的那个！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate's gone, so there shouldn't be a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使已经死了，应该没什么问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it were coming from someone else, then I would have ordered them to be burned alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是别人说的，我会下令把他们活活烧死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, this Follower will follow orders for the time being. He will treat Noctis, and then he will return to his tribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，这个天启追随者暂时会服从命令。他会治疗诺克提斯，然后回到他的部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he attempts to spread sedition of fails to treat his weakness, then both of them will die, and you will held responsible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他试图散布煽动言论而不能解决他的弱点，那么他们俩都会死，而你要为此负责。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] You're in charge now. The Followers can treat Noctis, and then he'll leave. Reasonable?
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]现在你说了算了。天启追随者可以给诺克提斯治疗，然后他就会离开。合理吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is not an option. The legate dies, and Mars brings us a forsaken one? What to do is clear. The Follower dies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是一个选项。特使死了，玛尔斯给我们带来了一个被遗忘的人？该怎么做是很清楚的。天启追随者该死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I could take him back to the Old Mormon Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我可以把他带回旧摩门要塞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Step aside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，靠边站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries, at arms! Kill Noctis as well. Appease Mars, and purge the weakness from Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵，准备战斗！把诺克提斯也杀了。安抚玛尔斯，净化马尔帕斯的弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I won't stand in your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我不会妨碍你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not comfortable with him being here. The sooner he fixes Noctis' weakness, the better, so the answer is yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在这里让我感到不舒服。他越早解决诺克提斯的弱点越好，所以答案是肯定的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When will Gregory be able to return West?
ESP.TRADUIT: 格雷戈里什么时候才能回到西部？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, that's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，就这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在感兴趣了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your friend....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的朋友...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Natalie? Where is she?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳塔莉？她在哪儿？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, so, a person named Natalie sent me looking for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，一个叫纳塔莉的人让我来找你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Desmond [0601EC7C] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC7B]AZFreeformBitterSprings) 0601EC7B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, what about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，关于什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, really? Shouldn't I tell Jaw Ripper?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，真的吗？我不是应该告诉下颚撕裂者吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Cassia is going to send you on a raid before fighting the Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>卡西娅会在和军团作战前派你去突袭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay....
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要我做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it's a secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不行，这是个秘密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, really? Then, okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，真的吗？那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要我做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He already knows. It's part of the game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他已经知道了，这是游戏的一部分。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll meet you there when Cassia tells us to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，卡西娅让我们去的时候我就去那里找你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia will tell you the night to sneak out to Temple Bar Marina. Bring the other children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅会告诉你晚上偷偷去圣殿酒吧码头，把其他孩子也带来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The truth, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实话实说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Guards, execute the forsaken and spare the one with the Mark!
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。卫兵，处死被遗忘者，放过那个有徽记的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, why did you lie? Guards, execute the forsaken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么要撒谎？卫兵，处决被遗忘者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 卫兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为正义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any proof?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有证据吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She was an enemy of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是军团的敌人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Given your past service to the Legion, this is noted. In future, I will not be so lenient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鉴于你过去为军团所做的贡献，这一点值得注意。以后，我不会再这么宽容了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize. I was ignorant of the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我道歉，我对法律一无所知。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An apology is insufficient! Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 仅仅道歉是不够的！卫兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize. I was ignorant of the law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我道歉，我对法律一无所知。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Follower? In Legion territory? Among the Cult, no less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个天启追随者？在军团领地？而且是在教团中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, amicus. This deserves a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，朋友。这值得奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I found this note in her quarters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有，我在她的住处发现了这张纸条。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, your life is forfeit. Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你的生命将被剥夺。卫兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wasting my time. You have no ability to influence this. That's all I have to say about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在浪费我的时间，你没有能力影响这件事。我要说的就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Caesar [00121FEF] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am requesting that you remove Marcellus Sedonus from command in Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我请求你解除马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯在马尔帕斯的指挥权。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That fragile Legionary has no value to me. He's unimportant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个脆弱的军团士兵对我来说毫无价值。他不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Caesar [00121FEF] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need people who are mentally flexible and embody the martial ideals of my Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要的是头脑灵活能体现军团军事理想的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Caesar [00121FEF] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is dedicated to the idea of Rome itself. That's all I need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯致力于罗马的理念，这就是我所需要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Caesar [00121FEF] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is raping one of his Legionaries. That is obviously wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯正在强奸他的一名军团士兵。这显然是错误的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I've heard it's a bad idea to tempt the wrath of Caesar. Change the subject.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说激起凯撒的愤怒不是个好主意。换个话题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Caesar [00121FEF] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard that he is very unpopular with his troops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说他在部队里很不受欢迎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. You see how Caesar runs things. I mean, you can't...help bad people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你知道凯撒是怎么管理的。我是说，你不能...帮助坏人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to treat Noctis. His legate abused him, and he is suffering from post-traumatic stress.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你治疗诺克提斯。他的特使虐待了他，他现在饱受创伤后应激障碍的折磨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why should I help the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要帮助军团？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About Noctis....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We travel at Caesar's pleasure. He may not let me out as easily as he let you in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们随凯撒的意志而行，他放我出去可能不像放你进去那么容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不了谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arcade, I have the Mark of Caesar. You will be fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿卡德，我有凯撒的徽记，你会没事的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Caveat Samaritanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。撒马利亚人警告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I understand your obsession, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt. I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort when I'm done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能说我理解你的执念，但我姑且相信你。干完活我就回旧摩门要塞去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't expect me to do this again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别指望我再这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is so much evil in the world that I can't help but want to fix some of it. Why don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界上有太多的邪恶，我忍不住想要解决其中的一些。你为什么不呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, but no. Count me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但不行。别把我算进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the only person for the job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是唯一适合这份工作的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许这样最好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It isn't enough to mean well if you don't do good. He's a big part of what's happening out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，如果你不做善事，仅仅心怀善意是不够的。他是这里发生的事情的重要组成部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arcade Gannon [0010C767] (file) Quest : ([0601EEA6]AZVanillaDialogueQuest) 0601EEA6 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not his fault.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是他的错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Wait!
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]等等！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, kicking and screaming, it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，拖走吧，就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah, I'm not going anywhere with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]嗯，我哪也不跟你去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't come with me, I'm going to get my dad to beat you up!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不跟我来，我就让我爸揍你一顿！

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I did my residency in the Mar. This is not even the first time I've had guns pointed at me. Buzz off.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我在马尔帕斯驻留过，这已经不是第一次有人拿枪指着我了。走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Point a gun at Gregory.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <拿枪指着格雷戈里>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Gregory has been knocked unconscious.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [格雷戈里被打晕了。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pistol-whip Gregory into unconsciousness.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <用手枪把格雷戈里打晕>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] [Gregory has been knocked unconscious.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功][格雷戈里被打晕了。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Silently position your hands so that his mouth and neck are covered up. Then, press.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <默默地把手放在他的嘴和脖子上。然后，按下。>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Hey, knock that off.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]嘿，别闹了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attempt and fail to sneak up behind Gregory.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <试图从格雷戈里背后偷袭但失败了>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then. Bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，那再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gregory [0601ED95] (mod) Quest : ([0601ED61]AZFreeformOldMormonFort) 0601ED61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can respect your decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以尊重你的决定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They irritated me. Get them out of here, and then we'll talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们激怒了我。把他们弄出去，然后我们再谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going to kill a Brahmin and paint each other with its blood. We'll be real warriors, and Mars will bless us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们要杀掉一头婆罗门牛，然后用它的血互相涂抹。我们会成为真正的战士，玛尔斯会保佑我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia told me that you have a rite of Mars coming up? What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅告诉我你们要举行玛尔斯仪式？这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, this again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About the rite of Mars....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于玛尔斯仪式...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I mean, I dunno, but Caesar says that we have to do it, so we have to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我是说，我不知道，但凯撒说我们必须这样做，所以我们必须这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it bother you? Killing something that can't fight back?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得困扰吗？杀死无法反击的生物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Huh, but you're not a Legionary. I guess if you want to watch, then that's okay. We'll be heading out soon. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，但你不是军团士兵。我觉得如果你想看的话倒是没关系。我们马上就要出发了，你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I join the ritual?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能加入这个仪式吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's go. Follow me, mister.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我们走吧。跟我来，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, let's go. Follow me, miss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我们走吧。跟我来，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, okay. Let me know when you're ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好吧。你准备好了就告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Good. Why didn't I have my adjutant do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，很好。为什么我没有让我的副官这么做？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's right, he was so worthless that I had a Profligate punch his lights out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对了，他太没用了，我让一个堕落者把他打昏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can't get me what I need. He is such a goddamn failure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他给不了我想要的，他真是个该死的失败者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took care of your slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我解决了你的奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need for him to fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要他滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, didn't you beat him up earlier? I did ask you to do that, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你之前不是揍过他吗？是我让你这么做的，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter. I'm telling you to go beat him up now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，我要你现在就去揍他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, good. That's good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，很好，这很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to fetch me a shipment of Sunset Sarsaparilla. It's been delayed multiple times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你去给我拿一批夕阳沙士，已经推迟了好几次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I punched your adjutant again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我又打了你的副官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, again? Well, get it over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，又来？好吧，赶紧打吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate is asking me to beat you up again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使又要我揍你一顿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goddamnit!
ESP.TRADUIT: 可恶！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch the adjutant as hard as you can.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <用你最大的力气打副官>

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck? Is Sedonus asking you to do this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？是塞多尼乌斯让你这么做的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch the adjutant.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <揍副官>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Well, go back to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。好吧，回去找他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He doesn't hate me. This is his way of enforcing discipline. Getting a worthless Profligate like you to agitate his Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不恨我。这是他执行纪律的方式，让你这样一个毫无价值的浪荡子去激怒他的军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why does the legate hate you so much?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使为什么这么恨你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But why? Did you piss him off or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是为什么呢？你是不是惹他生气了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A combat posting. Now, are you going to get this over with or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗岗位。你到底要不要把这事做完？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate said that you couldn't get him what he needs. What does he need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使说你没法帮他弄到他想要的东西。他需要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is asking me to beat you up, but let's make it fair unlike last time. Just you and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯让我揍你，但我们得公平点，别像上次那样。只有你和我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who told you this? These are serious charges.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁告诉你的？这可是严重的指控。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you aware that Sedonus is an addict?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道塞多尼乌斯是个瘾君子吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Yes, that's correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来如此。是的，没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar knows everything about everyone. Yes, he is aware.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒知道每个人的一切。是的，他知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Caesar know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒知道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's vision for the Wasteland cannot come out of thin air. He needs warriors to carry it out, imperfect as they may be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒对废土的设想不可能凭空而来。他需要勇士来执行，尽管他们可能并不完美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is one of those warriors, no matter how flawed he might appear to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯就是这样的勇士，不管他在你看来有多糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all that needs to be said.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我要说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why hasn't Caesar done anything about it yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么凯撒还没有采取任何行动？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? That's inex....
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么啦？这是不可...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for drawing this to my attention. That will be all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你提醒我这一点。就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have evidence of the legate using drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有特使吸毒的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. We are lucky that Sedonus is only involved in logistical manners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我们很幸运，塞多尼乌斯只负责后勤事务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had Sedonus been given a combat posting, things may have been disastrous. Still, this is a matter only for Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果塞多尼乌斯被派到战斗岗位，情况可能会是灾难性的。不过，这是凯撒的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is a legate favored by Caesar and respected by Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯是凯撒宠信的特使，也受到拉尼厄斯的尊敬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only way Sedonus is leaving Malpais is if Lanius gives him a combat posting elsewhere, which he has wanted to do for a while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯离开马尔帕斯的唯一途径是拉尼厄斯给他一个在其他地方的战斗岗位，他已经想了一段时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or if Caesar himself orders it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者凯撒亲自下令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not going to remove him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不打算赶走他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Cassia was one of those weak-willed heretics, these children would have noticed. Do you have any proof of these allegations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果卡西娅是那些意志薄弱的异教徒之一，这些孩子会注意到的。你有证据证明这些指控吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any proof to substantiate these claims.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有任何证据来证实这些说法吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia is actually a Follower of the Apocalypse named "Natalie".
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅实际上是一名天启追随者，名叫“纳塔莉”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Follower? Corrupting the Legion's youth? This... by Mars, I trusted her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个天启追随者？腐蚀军团的年轻人？这...玛尔斯在上，我相信了她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She dies tonight. Thank you, amicus. This deserves a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她今晚就会死。谢谢你，朋友，这值得奖励。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Read this. <Show him Natalie's note.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看这个。<给他看纳塔莉的纸条>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, stop wasting my time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，别再浪费我的时间了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agu's training to be a Decanus. He's consistently shown good leadership skills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿古被训练为什长，他一直表现出良好的领导才能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His devotion to the Legion comes and goes. When it's there, he doesn't ask questions about anything. When it's not, he cries himself to sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: ?他对军团的忠诚时有时无。忠诚在时，他从不质疑任何事，忠诚褪去时，他只能哭着入睡。?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the key. Talk to him, and I think we can pull this off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是关键。跟他谈谈，我觉得我们能搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why Agu?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么是阿古？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are not a Legionary. Hand over the contraband.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是军团士兵，交出违禁品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But Sedonus told me to bring him this shipment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但塞多尼乌斯让我把这批货带给他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How dare you dispect the Legion this way!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你竟敢这样蔑视军团！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. <Hand over the crate.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。<交出板条箱>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have stood in my way for the last time. You, Profligate, kill this fucking adjutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你最后一次妨碍我。你，堕落者，杀了这个该死的副官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You? Did you hear me? Kill this asshole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你？你听见我说的了吗？杀了这个混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gladly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很乐意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not killing him will piss off me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不杀他会激怒我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going to kill him or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底要不要杀他？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't killing him piss off Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了他不会激怒凯撒吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it is. Make up your mind. You can either carry out my orders or die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这是。下定决心吧，你要么执行我的命令，要么去死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't my problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, I will kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Refusing means your death! Legionaries, kill this Profligate and my adjutant!
ESP.TRADUIT: 拒绝就意味着死亡！军团士兵们，杀了这个堕落者和我的副官！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I refuse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我拒绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He irritated me. It took me a while to find out why.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他激怒了我。我花了一段时间才找到原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you've noticed my more... erratic tendencies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你已经注意到我的...不稳定的倾向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will tell you the truth of it. I am not the man I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将告诉你事情的真相。我已经不是以前的我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, why did you have me kill the adjutant?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你为什么要我杀副官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want it anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想要了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's holding me back. It and the adjutant were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它在拖我的后腿，它和副官都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all so pointless, really.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都毫无意义，真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still have the shipment you requested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有你要的那批货。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, my addiction. The cravings were so intense. My body and mind slip further and further from Caesar's grace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我的毒瘾。这种渴望是如此强烈，我的身心离凯撒的恩典越来越远。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am so tired. I have lost so many of my brothers, in the primes of their lives. Yet, here I am, decaying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我太累了。我失去了很多兄弟，在他们风华正茂的时候。然而，我却在这里，在腐烂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This needs to stop. There is a Profligate drug known as Fixer. It is rumored to help cure addiction. We used some of it in the old days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种情况必须停止。有一种堕落者的药物叫做瘾头解，据说它能帮助治疗毒瘾，以前我们用过一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before it was banned of course. Find it, and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是在它被禁止之前。找到它，然后回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you talking about your addiction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在说你的毒瘾吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Who the fuck told you about my addiction?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？谁他妈告诉你我成瘾了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, this must be the addiction I've heard about.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，这就是我听说过的成瘾吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A long time ago, a great warrior rose to become the greatest warrior in the Legion. Six tribes crushed under his heels in less than a month.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很久以前，一位伟大的勇士崛起成为军团中最伟大的战士。不到一个月，六个部落就被他征服了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For years, he is an undisputed chosen of his masters. Victory upon victory. Loved by all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多年来，他一直是主人们无可争议的宠儿。一次又一次的胜利，大家都喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, one day, he can't run as fast as he did. He can't throw spears as far as he could. His youth had gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，有一天，他跑不像以前那么快了，他的长矛扔得不像以前那么远了。他的青春已经逝去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His lord tells him that he is still useful even despite his age. Tells him that he is vital to his Lord's world without war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的主人告诉他，尽管他已经上了年纪，但他仍然是有用的。告诉他，他对主人的没有战争的世界至关重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, the wars continue. The Legion loses to the Profligates. Graham is killed and thrown into the Magnum Chasma. Failure is not tolerated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，战争仍在继续。军团输给了堕落者，格拉汉姆被杀，并被扔进了大裂谷。失败是不能容忍的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The warrior is desperate to do anything to save the Legion, even drink the forbidden nectars to make him strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这位战士不顾一切地要做任何事来拯救军团，甚至喝下被禁的花蜜来让自己变得强壮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was all for nothing. Lanius, a mask, was chosen instead of me. My sacrifice, my duty, it meant nothing to my lord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都是徒劳的。拉尼厄斯，一个面具，代替我被选中了。我的牺牲，我的责任，对我的主人来说都毫无意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The warrior was desperate to do anything to save the Legion, even drinking the forbidden nectars to make him strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这位战士不顾一切地想要拯救军团，甚至喝下被禁止的花蜜来让自己变得强壮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Buffout made me so strong. When I told Caesar of my sacrifice for him, he was so angry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 壮大灵让我变得如此强壮。当我告诉凯撒我为他所做的牺牲时，他非常生气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He ordered me to kick the addiction. I killed my drug runner and moved to purge the Buffout from my system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他命令我戒掉毒瘾。我杀了那个卖药的人然后开始清除我体内的壮大灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I drank the soda to help me focus. I never realized how potent it could be. To my shame, I traded one addiction for another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喝苏打水来帮助我集中注意力，我从来没有意识到它有这么强大。让我羞愧的是，我用一种成瘾替换了另一种成瘾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ordered my adjutant to help me taper the addiction. But, now, he is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我命令副官帮我戒除毒瘾。但是，现在，他死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is an old drug we used before the decimations called Fixer. Find it, and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在十一抽杀之前用过一种叫瘾头解的老药。找到它，然后回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Continue listening.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <继续听>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't fucking interrupt me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别他妈打断我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I did! I had to do something! Was I to wither away and die so that I could no longer serve my lord? Of course not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是当然！我必须做点什么！难道我要枯萎死去，不能再侍奉我的主吗？当然不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Buffout made me so strong, just like the olden days. But, it didn't matter. Caesar did not choose me. He chose the mask, Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 壮大灵让我变得如此强壮，就像过去一样。但是，这并不重要。凯撒没有选择我，他选择了面具，拉尼厄斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told Caesar of my sacrifice for him. What I had done to my body. He was angry. He threatened to behead me if I didn't clean up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉了凯撒我为他所做的牺牲，我对自己的身体做了什么。他很生气，他威胁我，如果我不收拾干净就把我斩首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I kicked the Buffout. I killed my drug runner, and now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我干掉了壮大灵，我杀了我的毒贩，现在呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These accursed soda bottles. I needed them to help me focus, but now I can't focus without them. I recognize the signs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些该死的苏打水瓶，我需要他们来帮助我集中注意力，但现在没有他们我无法集中注意力。我认得这些迹象。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I ordered my adjutant to bar any new shipments. He's dead now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我命令我的副官禁止任何新的货运。他现在死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a Profligate drug called Fixer. We used it before the decimations. Find some and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一种堕落者的药物叫做瘾头解，我们在十一抽杀之前用过。找一些回来给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you blame yourself for the Legion losing at Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为军团在胡佛水坝的失败而自责吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obedience above all else, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，服从高于一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's word is law. I was blind not to see it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的话就是法律。我以前真是瞎了眼，没看到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have much to think about. Now, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多事情要考虑。现在，离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obedience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 服从。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service above all else then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，服务高于一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service eternal. I was blind not to see it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 永恒的服务。我以前真是瞎了眼，没看到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have much to think about. Now, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多事情要考虑。现在，离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone not of the Legion knows. This is a disaster. I can't rest until her and whatever dealer she knows are dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团以外的人知道了，这是一场灾难。除非她和她认识的那个毒贩都死了，否则我不会罢休。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kill them and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀了他们再回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A trader named Jem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫捷姆的商人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, that worthless....
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]哦，那个没用的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, this is my fault. I require the assistance of a drug known as Fixer. Acquire some and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，这是我的错。我需要一种叫瘾头解的药的帮助，买一些回来给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your adjutant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的副官。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] My adjutant warned me of some loose ends. An irritating merchant in Solitare and a chem dealer in Elephant Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我的副官警告过我，还有一些未解决的问题。索利泰尔的烦人商人和象山的毒品贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Loose lips should have their tongues cut out. Kill them, and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多嘴的人应该被割掉舌头。杀了他们，然后回到我身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 某人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good, good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that that's taken care of, here's what I want you to do. Bring me Fixer. It's a Profligate drug that helps cure addiction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然已经解决了这个问题，下面是我想让你做的。把瘾头解带来，这是一种帮助治疗成瘾的堕落者药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, hurry up and kill them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就赶快杀了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The first decimation that Legion ever did was over chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的第一次十一抽杀便是针对化学药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We rode the wave of unearned pride after defeating the army of King Devil. For hours, we celebrated in unholy degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在打败了魔王的军队后，我们获得了不劳而获的自豪感。我们在邪恶堕落中庆祝了好几个小时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We were so dulled that we did not notice the return of King Devil. His reinforcements swept over our camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们太迟钝了，以至于没有注意到魔王回来了。他的援军横扫了我们的营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Malpais Legate, the man known as Graham, executed one-tenth of the Legion that one day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯特使，那个叫格拉汉姆的人，在那天处决了十分之一的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, Caesar arranged the very first crucifixions. A moment to Mars that we would never let something like that happen again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，凯撒安排了第一批钉死在十字架上的人。玛尔斯在上，我们永远不会让类似的事情再次发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bah! I need to focus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呸！我需要集中精神。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is drug use so looked down upon in the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么吸毒在军团中如此被轻视？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] If that's so, then I could just end up in the same position again.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]如果是这样的话，我可能会再次陷入同样的境地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is unacceptable. The only thing left, then, is to halt all potential sources of addiction. Only internal strength can overcome this weakness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不可接受的。那么，剩下的唯一一件事就是阻止所有潜在的成瘾来源，只有内在的力量才能克服这个弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me, servant. What's more important to the Legion? Obedience or service?
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我，仆人。对军团来说，什么更重要？服从还是服务？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fixer is only a temporary cure for addiction. The drug itself has addictive properties of its own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瘾头解只能暂时治疗成瘾，这种药物本身就具有成瘾性。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Idiot! You sound like my blasted adjutant!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]白痴！你说话就像我那该死的副官！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring me Fixer, or I will have you killed as well!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把瘾头解带来，不然我就把你也杀了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring me the Fixer. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把瘾头解给我拿来，就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should just go cold turkey. It's easy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该彻底戒掉。这很简单！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Complete your mission, and then return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。完成你的任务，然后回到我身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will bring you the Fixer that you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会把你需要的瘾头解带来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I am a legate, that is true. It's time for me to start acting like it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我是特使，这是真的。是时候让我重新表现得像以前那样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will steel myself for the coming trial. Tell me, amicus, what do you think the Legion values more? Obedience or servitude?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要为即将到来的试炼做好准备。告诉我，朋友，你觉得军团更看重什么？服从还是奴役？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are a legate! You are the master of your own fate. You don't need Fixer at all!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是一位特使！你是自己命运的主宰，你根本不需要瘾头解！

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I am not a quitter! I am a legate! Remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我不是个半途而废的人！我是特使！记住这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bring me Fixer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把瘾头解带来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马上。
