ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only quitters need Fixer!
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有半途而废的人才需要瘾头解！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noctis? He's one of the Legionaries, right? Sorry, but my duties prevent me from attending to whatever his needs may be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克提斯？他是军团的，对吧？抱歉，但我的职责让我无法满足他的任何需求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, there, I'm looking for someone to help treat Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿你好，我在找人帮我治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but I still can't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我还是不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still looking for someone to treat Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在找人治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my place to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没资格知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard the rumors about the legate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说关于特使的传言了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Legionary who hasn't seen combat in as long a time as Noctis is not eligible for any intervention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个像诺克提斯一样长时间没有参加过战斗的军团士兵是没有资格接受任何干预的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not treat Noctis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不治疗诺克提斯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably not. In truth, if Noctis is struggling with his discipline to the Legion, then he's probably.....
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能不行。事实上，如果诺克提斯还在为他对军团的纪律而挣扎，那么他可能是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I wouldn't want to say "beyond saving," but that might be the case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我不想说“无可救药”，但情况可能就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could I talk to other members of the Cult of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能和玛尔斯教团的其他成员谈谈吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I'll find some other solution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我会找到其他解决办法的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's not possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，那不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I looking for someone to help treat Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想找人帮忙治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again? I already said no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？我已经拒绝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I looking for someone to help treat Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想找人帮忙治疗诺克提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a limited timeframe to get these kids out of here. There is no way I can treat both the children and your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要在有限的时间内把这些孩子们带出去，我不可能同时治疗孩子们和你的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to a plan to rescue the kids from Malpais, and I can't do that and help Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得想法子把孩子们从马尔帕斯救出去，但我不能一边救孩子一边帮诺克提斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since he died, I've heard the rumors. They're the only reason I even considered helping.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死后，我听到了一些传闻。这是我想帮忙的唯一原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know if you aware of what the legate did to Noctis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你知不知道特使对诺克提斯做了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, you're right. I've been aiming for the stars, but the risk of failure really might be too high to pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，你是对的。我的目标一直是摘星星，但失败的风险实在太高了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, it's better to abandon these plans. Focus on helping individual soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许，还是放弃这些计划比较好。专注于帮助个别士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, you can tell his Optio that I'll be treating him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你可以告诉他的执行官我来治疗他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Taking children from Malpais is high-risk. You should focus on helping Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从马尔帕斯带走孩子是高危行为，你应该集中精力帮助军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sympathize with him, but he's also a Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同情他，但他也是一名军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that he would not hesitate to target women in the exact same way if his Decanus ordered it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道如果什长下令的话，他会毫不犹豫地以同样的方式攻击女性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, he deserves some therapy, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，他应该接受治疗，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll find a different solution, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就另想办法了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is true. I do not believe a tribe as weak-willed as the Followers would have killed a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。我不相信像天启追随者这样意志薄弱的部落会杀死一名游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, you've proven your service to the Legion. Arcade will licensed to treat Noctis for one week, after which Noctis will be sent to Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你已经证明了你对军团的贡献。阿卡德将被授权治疗诺克提斯一个星期，之后诺克提斯将被送到尤马。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I took down a Ranger. That's got to worth something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我干掉了一个游骑兵，这肯定值点什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, you've proven your service to the Legion. Arcade will licensed to treat Noctis for one week, after which Noctis will be sent to Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你已经证明了你对军团的贡献。阿卡德将被授权治疗诺克提斯一个星期，之后诺克提斯将被送到尤马。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] You know me. I have not once worked against the Legion's interests.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]你知道我的，我从未做过违背军团利益的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Noctis will get his transfer, then. Your friend will agree to follow all Legion laws. If he fails to do so, for any reason, he will be quartered.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]那诺克提斯会被调走的。你的朋友会同意遵守所有的军团法令，如果他没有这样做，无论出于什么原因，他将被分尸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arcade will only treat Noctis, then Noctis can be transferred to another front.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿卡德只会治疗诺克提斯，然后诺克提斯可以转移到另一个前线。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] That is why a Follower cannot be allowed to spread his cancerous ideology amongst the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]这就是为什么不能允许一个天启追随者在军团中传播他的邪恶思想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With the legate dead, Malpais is going to need all the loyal soldiers it can get.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使死了，马尔帕斯需要尽可能多的忠实士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think it over some more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我再考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes. Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的，当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did, remember?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做了，记得吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. With this, I should finally be able to overcome my addiction. Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。有了这个，我应该最终能够克服我的成瘾。谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Is it really so easy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，真的这么简单吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, I have a question for you. It's imporant. What is more important to the Legion, obedience or service?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，我有个问题要问你，这很重要。对军团来说，服从和服务哪个更重要？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've brought you some Fixer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带了一些瘾头解。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I take this, it's almost an... I don't know how to put it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我拿着这个，它几乎是...我不知道该怎么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion bans these chems for a reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团禁止这些化学药物是有原因的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to just assume this will fix everything. So, I want to know what I should be thinking about while under its effects. It can't consume me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想假设这就能解决所有问题。所以，我想知道在它的影响下我应该思考什么，它不能吞噬我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know which value Caesar would want more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想知道凯撒更想要哪种价值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's this coming from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这从何而来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obedience above all else, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，服从高于一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's word is law. I was blind not to see it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒的话就是法律。我以前真是瞎了眼，没看到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have much to think about. Now, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多事情要考虑。现在，离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Obedience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 服从。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service above all else then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，服务高于一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service eternal. I was blind not to see it before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 永恒的服务。我以前真是瞎了眼，没看到这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have much to think about. Now, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有很多事情要考虑。现在，离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was gone well. My addiction is no more. I thank you, amicus. This warrants a reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一切都很顺利，我的瘾戒了。谢谢你，朋友，这值得奖赏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It worked. I'm cured. No more cravings. My head is clearer than it has ever been. All I did was think of my need to obey Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这起作用了，我痊愈了。没有更多的渴望了，我的头脑比以往任何时候都清醒。我所做的一切都是为了服从恺撒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks to you, I am once again in his good graces. He's even promised to allow me to take part in the march in California for a campaign or two.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多亏了你，我再一次得到了他的青睐。他甚至答应让我参加在加州举行的一两次游行活动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wherever you are, wherever you go, remember that you have my gratitude and friendship.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论你在哪里，无论你去哪里，记住我对你的感激和友谊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It failed. I couldn't stop thinking about it. My desires were only dulled by the thoughts of service. It didn't eliminate them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 失败了。我不能停止思考这件事，我的欲望只是被服务的想法所抑制，这并没有消除它们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At this point, I'm at a loss. With my adjutant gone, I need you to go forth and find me a new supply. A consistent one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这一点上，我很茫然。我的副官不在了，我需要你去给我找一个新的补给，跟之前的一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was looking through my adjutant's notes, and he's been in contact with a man named Fat-Eye. He also met with the Frumentarii. Try them
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在看副官的笔记，他一直在和一个叫肥眼的人联系，他还会见了特务。试试吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bumbling moron! I should have you executed and strung on a cross with your eyes gouged out with cattle prods!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个笨手笨脚的白痴！我应该把你处决，把你钉在十字架上，用赶牛棒挖出你的眼睛！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Fine. I will make my own accomodations. Leave me be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好吧，我会自己安排的。别烦我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Both of those are dead. They're nothing I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们俩都死了，我无能为力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bumbling moron! I should have you executed and strung on a cross with your eyes gouged out with cattle prods!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个笨手笨脚的白痴！我应该把你处决，把你钉在十字架上，用赶牛棒挖出你的眼睛！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then do it and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去做，然后回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Both of those are dead. There might be something I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们俩都死了。也许我能做点什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't do to slander a legate. You know that I would have to kill you, even with that Mark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诽谤特使是不行的。你知道就算有那个徽记，我也得杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sedonus is asking for contraband under the table. He sent me to you for help with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 塞多尼乌斯在私下索要违禁品，他让我来找你帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. Ahiga hasn't mentioned anything about this to me, but this is fairly recent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。阿希加没跟我提过这事，但这是最近的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well, you may return to Sedonus and tell him thjat we are more to supply him his needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，你可以回去找塞多尼乌斯告诉他我们可以满足他的需要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, we do expect for him to return the favor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们希望他能有所回报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's true. I have proof. <Show the adjutant's note.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是真的，我有证据。<出示副官的笔记>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do know you. Very well. Tell the legate that he and the Frumentarii are about to become friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你。好吧，告诉特使，他和特务即将成为朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] I'm a friend of the Legion. I wouldn't lie to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]我是军团的朋友，我不会骗你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have 150 denarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有150第纳尔？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I were to provide the Frumentarii with a generous tribute of 150 denarii, gratis?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我能慷慨的免费赠送给特务一百五十第纳尔呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. We will send an envoy to your legate later today. Tell me that we're ready to become friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。今日晚些时候，我们会派使者去见你们的特使。告诉我，我们已经准备好成为朋友了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, stop wasting my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就别浪费我的时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hell no. Look, I already told you guys that I'm not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢绝对不行。听着，我已经告诉你们我不感兴趣了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate sends me. You know for what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使派我来的，你知道为什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate sends me. You know for what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使派我来的，你知道为什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It absolutely is. As far as I know, the legate wouldn't be sending his lackey to drug-dealers if he didn't
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。据我所知，特使若非...绝不会派亲信接触毒贩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't really something you can turn down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这可不是你能拒绝的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You raise a good point. I've reconsidered my options. Tell the legate he'll get his Buffout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提出了一个好观点，我重新考虑了我的选择。告诉特使他会得到他的壮大灵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you don't deal with the Legion now, they'll deal with someone else. And you'll be expendable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你现在不跟军团交涉，他们会找别人。你就会成为牺牲品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell no. That isn't how any of that works. They ban drugs, dumbass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不，这些都不是这么回事。他们禁止毒品，笨蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your legate friend isn't even supposed to be doing this. I'm not going to stick my neck out for someone Caesar himself is watching.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的特使朋友根本不应该这么做，我不会为一个凯撒自己在亲自监视的人冒这个险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, buzz off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you deal with the Legion, then you'll able to access bigger and better markets and stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你和军团打交道，你就能接触到更大更好的市场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would need, at minimum, 2,000 caps as a nest egg.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我至少需要两千瓶盖作为储备金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much would it take to pay you to accept the deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 多少钱能让你接受这笔生意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Christ, you know what? I'll do it. Tell your legate friend that I'll supply him, but he better not fuck me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢天啊，你知道吗？我会做的。告诉你的特使朋友，我会提供给他，但他最好别操我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking about whether or not I could snap your arm clean off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想我能不能把你的胳膊拧下来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then. 2,000 caps, and I'll make sure that Sedonus has his fix. Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。两千瓶盖，我会确保塞多尼乌斯得到他的药品。很高兴和你做生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 2,000 caps it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是2000瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, come back when you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那等你有了再来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Fat-Eye [060089CF] (mod) Quest : ([0600D042]AZElephantHillFatEyeQuest) Running Gun EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that kind of cash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那么多现金。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not tolerate failure. Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能容忍失败。卫兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but everyone's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但所有人都死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii are a demanding lot. Perhaps, it would have been better for me to seek help elsewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特务是一个要求很高的群体。也许，我去别的地方寻求帮助会更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you've completed your end of the bargain. Thank you, amicus. I have much to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你已经完成了你的交易。谢谢你，朋友。我有很多事要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've just finished a meeting with Alba Nox. The Frumentarii are willing to supply you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我刚和阿尔巴·诺克斯见完面，特务愿意为你提供物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ideal scenario. It pains me to be dependent on bottom-feeding piece of trash like this Fat-Eye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最理想的情况。我很痛苦要依赖像肥眼这样的底层垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you've completed your end of the bargain. Thank you, amicus. I have much to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你已经完成了你的交易。谢谢你，朋友。我有很多事要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met with Fat-Eye. He can get you what you need.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过肥眼了，他能给你想要的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will to trust the intentions of this Niemann, whoever he his. His conditions will be met so long as what I need continues to come.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意相信这个尼曼的意图，不管他是谁。只要我需要的东西不断出现，他的条件就会得到满足。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you've completed your end of the bargain. Thank you, amicus. I have much to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你已经完成了你的交易。谢谢你，朋友。我有很多事要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I met with a man named Niemann. He's willing to supply you with what you need. With conditions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我遇到了一个叫尼曼的人，他愿意供应你所需要的东西。有条件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, go do it. Wasting my time. Imbecile.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去做，浪费我的时间。低能儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marcellus Sedonus [06008D03] (mod) Quest : ([06013B22]AZMalpaisSedonusDialogueQuest) 06013B22 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to kill you. Don't be so squeamish. It's unbecoming of someone who has the Mark and a fatal flaw in a Frumentarius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会杀你的，别这么娇气。一个拥有徽记和特务致命缺陷的人是不相称的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just curious why a legate would get addicted to drugs and then come to us for help.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是好奇，为什么一个特使会吸毒上瘾，然后来找我们帮忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The legate should know that we're going to take our pound of flesh from such an agreement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特使应该知道我们会从这样的协议中得到应得的利益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you can tell your legate that the Frumentarii are happy to be friends with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你可以告诉你的特使，军团特务很乐意和他做朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't kill me. I'm just following orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要杀我，我只是奉命行事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, I see. Well, if that's the case, then I'll be sure to bring everyone for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]噢，原来如此。好吧，如果是这样的话，我一定会把所有人都带来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar is sending you boys on a super secret mission, and he sent me to tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒派你们去执行一项超级秘密任务，他派我来告诉你们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] That doesn't make any sense. We're not ready yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]这完全说不通啊，我们还没准备好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar wants you to skip fighting the Legionary and jump straight to raiding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒希望你跳过与军团的战斗，直接进行突袭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? That's impossible! No one can infiltrate the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？那是不可能的！没人能渗透进军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia is actually a spy sent here to take you away from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅其实是被派来把你从军团手中带走的间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again? You can't go saying stuff like that without proof.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？没有证据你不能说这种话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cassia is actually a spy sent here to take you away from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡西娅其实是被派来把你从军团手中带走的间谍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I'm going to grab the other kids to deal with her. I just hope you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我想你是对的。我去叫其他孩子一起对付她，我只希望你是对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Cassia is a spy, then Caesar is going to be very disappointed that you didn't deal with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果卡西娅是间谍，那凯撒会因为你没处理她而非常失望的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Not really.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]算不上吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, hasn't Cassia seemed off to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，你不觉得卡西娅有点不对劲吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Without proof, I am not obliged to believe you. But, I can appreciate you wanting to protect our children. Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]没有证据，我没有义务相信你。但是，我能理解你想要保护我们的孩子。好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Know this: I offer no second chances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 记住：我不会给你第二次机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize. I acted on instinct to protect the children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我道歉。我出于本能保护孩子们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Maidens wear veils, you ignorant moron! Guards, remove this bastard from existence!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]女侍是要戴面纱的，你这个无知的白痴！卫兵们，把这个混蛋干掉！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, she had the shifty eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，她的眼神一直躲闪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great work, I mean it. I really could not have done without you, so thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，我是认真的。没有你我真的做不到，所以谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Meet me at Temple Bar Marina. We're in the homestretch now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在圣殿酒吧码头见我。我们现在已经到了最后冲刺阶段。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Aspirant Cassia [0600C45A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I managed to convince Agu to play along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法说服了阿古配合我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not funny. She could have gotten in serious trouble. It's not right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一点都不好笑。她可能会惹上大麻烦，这是不对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Agu [0601EE1A] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Just joking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。开个玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When Agu told me that you were going on a secret mission, I knew that something was happening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当阿古告诉我你要执行一项秘密任务时，我就知道出事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That man is an enemy of the Legion. And it appears that he has corrupted our Priestess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个人是军团的敌人，看来他腐化了我们的女祭司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will not let you take my children. The Legion won't allow it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让你带走我的孩子，军团不会允许的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius ordered this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是拉尼厄斯的命令？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Why would he do this? Is this some trick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？他为什么要这么做？这是恶作剧吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] I'm not an enemy of the Legion. You know this. Lanius himself has ordered this.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]我不是军团的敌人，你知道这一点。这是拉尼厄斯亲自下令的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar ordered this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是凯撒的命令？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Why would he do this? Is this some trick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？他为什么要这么做？这是恶作剧吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] I'm not an enemy of the Legion. You know this. Caesar himself has ordered this.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]我不是军团的敌人，你知道这一点。这是凯撒亲自下令的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Infiltration? My children... the Legion's children, Frumentarii? Why wouldn't he tell me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 渗透？我的孩子...军团的孩子们，特务？他为什么不告诉我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will I see them again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能再见到他们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Your children are heading into NCR territory on an infiltration mission.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>你的孩子正在前往NCR的地盘执行渗透任务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Infiltration? My children... the Legion's children, Frumentarii? Why wouldn't he tell me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 渗透？我的孩子...军团的孩子们，特务？他为什么不告诉我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will I see them again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能再见到他们吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The Frumentarii have recruited your children on a raid on Bitter Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>特务招募了你的孩子们渗透苦泉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Children, you have to be very brave for what's coming up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，面对即将发生的事情，你们要非常勇敢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I promise, the Legion will always watch over you. As long as you remember what we have taught you, you'll be okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我保证，军团会一直守护着你的。只要你记得我们教给你的，你就会没事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll always be my Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们永远是我的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you three, take care of them. Come on, Legionaries, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你们三个，好好照顾他们。来吧，军团士兵，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Children, you have to be very brave for what's coming up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，面对即将发生的事情，你们要非常勇敢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I promise, the Legion will always watch over you. As long as you remember what we have taught you, you'll be okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我保证，军团会一直守护着你的。只要你记得我们教给你的，你就会没事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll always be my Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们永远是我的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for you three, take care of them. Come on, Legionaries, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于你们三个，好好照顾他们。来吧，军团士兵，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only when the Legion takes the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有当军团拿下莫哈维沙漠的时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Legionaries!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？军团士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Children, this is your secret mission. Kill these Legionaries. They are enemies of Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，这是你们的秘密任务。杀了这些军团士兵。他们是凯撒的敌人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Legionaries!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？军团士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Children, this is your secret mission. Kill these Legionaries. They are enemies of Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，这是你们的秘密任务。杀了这些军团士兵。他们是凯撒的敌人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Legionaries!
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？军团士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Children, this is your secret mission. Kill these Legionaries. They are enemies of Caesar!
ESP.TRADUIT: 孩子们，这是你们的秘密任务。杀了这些军团士兵。他们是凯撒的敌人！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries, kill these traitors!
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵，杀了这些叛徒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jaw Ripper [0601A657] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like a lost cause, Natalie. It's time to fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来没希望了，纳塔莉。是时候战斗了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. He will granted a stay of execution. Know that he won't be saved when the Legion marches on Freeside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，他将获准暂缓执行死刑。要知道，当军团进军自由之城时，他是不会得救的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion] Can't I get him a stay of execution, given my previous service to the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团]以我之前在军团服役的经历，难道不能让他暂缓执行死刑吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's true. Perhaps, you did not know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这倒是真的。也许，你不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ignorance of our laws is not an excuse, but I am willing to make an exception for you just once. Send him away, and ensure that he never returns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对法律的无知不能成为借口，但我愿意为你破例一次。把他打发走，别让他再回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only had the Legion's interests in mind. Otherwise, I would not have killed that Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只考虑军团的利益，否则我也不会杀那个游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm. We will hold you to that. Forsaken, you have been granted a stay of execution. Justice will come for you in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，记住你的承诺。被遗忘者，你被允许暂缓执行死刑，你最终会得到正义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make peace with what gods you can. I bid you two vale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽你所能与诸神讲和。我向你们俩告别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Retribution is best served slow. When the time comes to march on Freeside, I will kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 报复最好慢慢来。等我们到自由城行军的时候，我会杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] That is not good enough. You'll be spared, but he will not. Guards, execute the forsaken.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]这还不够好，你会被放过，但他不会。卫兵，处决被遗忘者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, my word is my word. It's honor. Legionaries respect that, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我说话算话，这是荣誉。军团士兵很尊重这一点，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, me and the boys have talked it over a few times. They've got their own ideas. Worse ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我和兄弟们已经讨论过几次了。他们有自己的想法，更糟的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They lack the business sense guys like me have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们缺乏像我这样的人的商业头脑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're small-time thinkers. Vinnie gets blinded by fast cash. Gustavo gets bogged down in the logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是三流思想家。文尼被快速的现金冲昏了头脑，古斯塔沃在后勤方面陷入困境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the next stage of the business?
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一阶段的业务是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to break into construction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想进入建筑业。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I see us standing right beside Caesar as he rolls into Vegas. His Nova Roma is going to be built by our boys, under our contracts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我看到我们就站在凯撒身边，看着他冲进拉斯维加斯。根据我们的合同，他的新罗马将由我们的人建造。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And your idea is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的想法是？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh it is. That's the Jordano way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，是的。这就是若尔达诺的风格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My problem, is that I don't have much of a relationship with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的问题是，我和军团没什么关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We ship to them, but we don't hear much back from them. The skirt sitting at my Receptionist's desk ain't interested in my business plans either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们向他们发货，但我们没有收到他们的太多反馈。坐在我前台的那个裙子对我的商业计划也不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds pretty ambitious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很有野心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, look at you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，看你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do me a favor, you won't regret it. Mention my name to the Skirt in charge of the road repair. Tell him I want in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我一个忙，你不会后悔的。向负责修路的“裙子”提一下我的名字，告诉他我想加入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fixing his main supply route is a surefire way to get the big man's attention.
ESP.TRADUIT: 修复他的主要补给路线是吸引这个大人物注意的必杀技。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Show Mark of Caesar> I can help you with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: <展示凯撒的徽记*我可以帮你。.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check in with Gustavo and Chente while you're at it. Let them know you're working for us now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 顺便和古斯塔沃和陈特联系一下，让他们知道你现在为我们工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. We're too early for you to be invested in our success, I get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我理解。投资我们的成功对你来说还为时过早，我明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's scary getting in on the ground floor of something huge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 进入一个大项目起初是很可怕的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me know if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你改变主意了就告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You trying to wheel and deal me? Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想跟我讨价还价？好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be frank with you. Once we take the Dam, me and the Boys are going straight for Crimson Caravan HQ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟你坦白说吧。一旦我们拿下大坝，我和兄弟们就直奔深红商队总部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Call it a hostile takeover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以称之为恶意收购。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You secure this deal for me, you'll get yourself a share in the company, and you can take McLafferty's office.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你帮我搞定了这笔生意，你就能得到公司的股份，然后你就可以坐麦克拉弗蒂的办公室了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sound good?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来不错吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Enzo Jordano [0600D41F] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易]这对我有什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised he mentioned my ideas at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶他居然提到了我的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm helping Enzo expand the business. He said you had some ideas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在帮恩佐拓展业务，他说你有些想法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course he did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他当然这么觉得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget about him. What do you want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 忘了他吧。你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, he called them "worse" than his...
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他说比他的“更糟糕”...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, sure. Have fun or whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，当然。玩得开心什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just remember; you're working *for* me now, not with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要记住，你现在是*为*我工作，而不是和我一起工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to let you know I'm working with you now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想告诉你，我现在和你一起工作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Heh, you're a smart one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿嘿，你还挺聪明的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want the company to get into the people business. Enzo fights me on it every time I bring it up, the prick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望公司能涉足人力资源业务。每次我一提起恩佐就跟我作对，混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to hear out your idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想听听你的想法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a people person, what can I say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个善于交际的人，我还能说什么呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the road went out, we'd see all sorts of human cargo traders flow through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这条路不通之前，我们会看到各种各样的人类货运商在这里穿梭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Salt of the earth, those guys. They demanded respect, and they got it. We could learn a thing or two from them
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些家伙是社会中坚，他们要求得到尊重，他们得到了。我们可以从他们身上学到一些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The people business?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人力资源业务？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you really need me to spell it out for you what that means?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的需要我给你解释清楚那是什么意思吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Human cargo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类货物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an industry term, pal. God forbid I use the proper lingo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是行业术语，伙计，上帝禁止我使用正确的行话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I understand it. Why not just call them slaves though?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我能理解。为什么不直接称他们为奴隶呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you calling me a coward?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在说我是懦夫吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll beat you so hard you'll wish you never learned that word, you piece of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会狠狠揍你一顿让你后悔学过那个词，你个混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I understand it. It's just seems cowardly not to call them slaves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我能理解。只是不称他们为奴隶显得很懦弱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, they're laborers. People move em around for the Legion or for sale in towns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，他们是劳动者，人们把他们搬来搬去供军团使用或在城镇出售。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I genuinely have no idea what that means. Why would you carry humans as cargo?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的不知道那是什么意思。你为什么要把人类当成货物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然没有！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Laborers? Do they get paid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 劳动者？他们得到报酬了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If they revolt, they revolt. There's always more where they came from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们反抗，那就反抗呗。总是有更多的来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, are you going to help me or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，你到底帮不帮我？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Paying them at least gives them an incentive to not revolt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 付钱给他们至少能激励他们不要反抗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to go to a meeting out in the hills in my stead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你替我去山里参加一个会议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll give you a package. Don't open it. Just bring it back here, that's all I need from you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会给你一个包裹，别打开它。把它拿回来就行了，我只需要你这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Time for you to leave, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你也该走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm too busy to be your errand boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我太忙了，没时间给你跑腿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think people deserve to die?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得有人该死吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've killed people who didn't deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀过不该杀的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't fault you there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一点我不能怪你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think about that though. What it means to want someone to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想看。想要一个人死意味着什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guy who shot me in the head does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个朝我脑袋开枪的人知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you cherish them more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你更珍惜他们了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen cherished things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷过珍贵的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty grim, ain't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很残酷，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a person -- a whole lifetime that you feel justified in wiping out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一个人...你觉得有理由消灭他的一生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ever think about that sort of thing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想过这种事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're more hardened than I, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你比我坚强多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll crack eventually. I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你终究会崩溃的，我已经崩溃了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think about that at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我根本没想过这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How's that going for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try not to think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我试着不去想它。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't stop thinking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直在想这件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look who's avoiding the questions now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看现在是谁在逃避问题！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did I strike a nerve?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我戳到你的痛处了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now that is an interesting response.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个有趣的回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you mean that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这个意思吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很喜欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You remind me of an old traveling buddy of mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我想起了我以前的一个老旅行伙伴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it you love about killing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么喜欢杀戮？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alrighty then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strange thing to joke about...
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿这事开玩笑真奇怪...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I was joking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是开玩笑的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *He stares at you*
ESP.TRADUIT: *他盯着你看*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The silence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沉默。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Freak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 怪胎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 血。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Power is nice, isn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有权力很好，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't let it get to your head. Makes it explode.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别太上头了，会爆炸的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 权力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe it pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just don't point my direction, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 血别溅我身上，行吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean it. I'm dangerous. I'm basically a human weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说真的。我很危险，我基本上是个人肉武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have to be to survive these days.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须这样才能活下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I'm told, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正别人是这么告诉我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm good at it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很擅长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's all Cowboys and Indians for you, huh?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你只喜欢牛仔和印第安人，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I respect that, believe it or not. Gunslingers high ain't no joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 信不信由你，我尊重这一点。枪手高潮可不是闹着玩的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's really not that deep. I find it fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实没那么深。我觉得很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That rush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那种冲动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The smell of gunpowder in the air. That burst of adrenaline at the crack of every bullet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 空气中弥漫着火药的味道，每一颗子弹射出时肾上腺素的爆发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Intoxicating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人陶醉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gunslinger high?
ESP.TRADUIT: 枪手高潮？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dropping the subject?
ESP.TRADUIT: 放弃这个话题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就说到这里吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I apologize.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我道歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm just done with this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我已经受够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *He smiles at you*
ESP.TRADUIT: *他对你微笑*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back soon!
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: *Leave*
ESP.TRADUIT: *离开*

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means you've still got some soul in you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这说明你还有灵魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that supposed to mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a human being, of course I have a soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是一个人，我当然有灵魂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not saving them from the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不是要从NCR手中拯救他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And he sure as shit can't hold back the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且他肯定挡不住军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's he saving them from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他要从谁手里救他们？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's saving Vegas and everyone around it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在拯救维加斯和周围的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what if they don't want to be saved?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他们不想被拯救呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's saving the wasteland and everyone in it from themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在拯救这片废土和其中的每一个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll adjust.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们会适应的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That doesn't hurt. You'd be surprised what the Legion can do, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这没什么。你会对军团的能力感到惊讶的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He can absolutely hold off the Legion. His Securitrons are like tanks on one wheel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他绝对能抵挡军团，他的电子保安就像一个有轮子的坦克。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are fierce fighters. They're also inhumane bastards willing to do anything to win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是一群勇猛的战士，他们也是冷血的混蛋，为了胜利不惜一切代价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: House's secureobots can't cover everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 豪斯的安保机器人不可能覆盖所有地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion can take the hills. Cut off the South and North. Frumentarii can salt the crops. Set fires inside the walls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团可以占领山脉，切断南北。特务可以给农作物撒盐，在墙内纵火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before he knows it House will be facing angry mobs and food shortages. I've seen it happen a dozen times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他意识到这一点之前，豪斯将面临愤怒的暴民和食物短缺。这种事我见过很多次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What could the Legion possibly do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团能做什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别在意这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem to know a lot about how the Legion operates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你似乎很了解军团的运作方式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that certainly makes it more morally gray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这无疑使它在道德上更加灰色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I don't see the problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就不觉得有什么问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you need it, you should be able to use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要它，你就应该能够使用它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some say it's stealing, I say it's borrowing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说这是偷，我说这是借。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was it that you borrowed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你借了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You really don't think stealing is wrong so long as I want it more?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的觉得只要我够想要，偷东西就不算错吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to travel with a man who wore police clothes, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我曾经和一个穿警服的人一起旅行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you, a cop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是警察吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You taught them a lesson in survival.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你给他们上了一堂生存的课。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you can stay alive broke, you can thrive when you get some coin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你即使破产也能活下去，等你有了钱就能兴旺发达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷了钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all do what we need to survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了生存，我们都在做自己该做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen supplies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷了物资。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I remember when I lost mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得当我丢了我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, I can't forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我无法忘记。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen someone's innocence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷走了某人的清白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen someone's identity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷了某人的身份。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, a smooth talker? Well, best you don't break that heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，一个花言巧语的人？你最好别伤了那颗心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen someone's heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷走了某人的心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *He looks at you, sadly*
ESP.TRADUIT: *他悲伤地看着你*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cal [06018ABC] (mod) Quest : ([060052B9]AZHavenCalhounDialogue) 060052B9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've stolen my own future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我偷走了自己的未来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we gotta make connections in the industry first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们首先要在行业内建立联系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If we partner with someone already running bodies, we can hit the ground running.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我们和一个已经在运营人体的人合作，我们就可以马上开始行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your plan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的计划是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try networking with some of the locals. I'd try the market up the road, personally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 试着结交一些当地人。我个人会去路边的市场看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could also try the work camp down past Chloride. That's where most able-bodied guys are sent to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也可以试试克洛赖德附近的工作营地，那是大多数身体健全的人被送去的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chente Jordano [0600D421] (mod) Quest : ([060175F7]AZFreeform3Some) 060175F7 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, good, you made it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了，你来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you decided to stop by. Well, I'm up for a chat. If you need information, I'm your guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你决定过来。好吧，我想和你聊聊。如果你需要情报，我就是你的帮手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some kid sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 某个孩子派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything in particular?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么特别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, but make them quick. You have a job to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但动作要快。你有工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Stanley Hartford [0600B13E] (mod) Quest : ([0601746A]AZMalpaisJournalistQuest) A Little Bird Told Me EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't talked to them yet. I wanted to ask some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没跟他们谈过。我想问几个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not just any doctor. I am the Good Doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是一般的医生。我是好医生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the difference between a doctor and a Good Doctor? I'm glad you asked!
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生和好医生的区别是什么？我很高兴你问了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I aim to preserve my patients' natural, pure constitutions. No, nasty injections, no stitches or excisisons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的目标是保持我病人的自然，纯净的体质。没有，讨厌的注射，没有缝针或切除。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've potions for nearly all common wasteland maladies. Irradiated? Infected? Lacking in vigor? I have cures for all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有治疗几乎所有常见废土疾病的药剂。辐射？感染？缺乏活力？我有治疗所有人的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a doctor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是医生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly! I studied in the Southwest Confederacy under the guidance of the Navajo medicine men. Alchemy, and herbalism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以！我在大西南邦联的纳瓦霍巫医的指导下学习。炼金术和草药学。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the time since, I have also become quite adept at the arts of divination, chiropractic, hypnosis, and bloodletting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那段时间，我也变得非常擅长占卜、脊椎按摩、催眠和放血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I quickly found that people need a more robust system of treatment that no individual discipline can provide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很快发现，人们需要一个更健全的治疗体系，这是任何单一学科都无法提供的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your practice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的实践吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real medicine? Real medicine? My friend, this *is* real medicine. My potions are just as healing as the pre-war mumbo jumbo you'll find out west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真药？真正的药吗？朋友，这才*是*真正的良药。我的药剂和你在西部发现的战前的胡言乱语一样有治愈作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you practice real medicine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的是真药吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you should find a doctor who will give you a Med-X, then. Oh? What's that? Those doctors are dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，也许你应该找个医生给你开点吗啡针-X。哦？那是什么？那些医生都死了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I make do with what I have. My patients are quite satisfied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我凑合着用手头的东西。我的病人都很满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you simply let yourself believe in the restorative power of my remedies, I'm sure you'll be quite happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你相信我的治疗方法能使你恢复元气，我相信你会很高兴的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No 'potion' can fix a serious laceration or a broken bone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有任何“药水”可以治愈严重的撕裂伤或骨折。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then you ought to begin writing your will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你应该开始写遗嘱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I need more serious help than your potions can give me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我需要比你的药剂更重要的帮助呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not. Most Legionaries actually welcome my educated perspective on their familiar herbal remedies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然没有。大多数军团成员实际上很欢迎我对他们熟悉的草药疗法提出的专业看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not only can I prescribe them a broc flower and xander root admixture, but I can tell them exactly *why* it works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不仅可以给他们开一种布洛克花和山德根的混合物，而且我可以确切地告诉他们它*为什么*有效。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's knowledge, my friend, and it commands respect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是知识，我的朋友，它值得尊重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any trouble with the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有意见吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything that may be employed to heal. Tarot, palm reading, a more standard physical examination, phrenology. It all has its place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何可以用来治疗的东西。塔罗牌，看手相，更标准的体检，颅相学。这一切都有它的意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of services do you offer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们提供什么样的服务？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to talk about your services again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想再谈谈你的服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why, of course! However, my expertise is not free. The fee is 15 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然啦！然而，我的专业知识不是免费的。费用是15第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want a physical examination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想做个身体检查。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, well, actually I'd rather not. It's a very... delicate process. I need time, and my tools, and ideally a nice office somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，算了，我还是算了。这是一个非常...精细的过程。我需要时间和工具，最好还有一间不错的办公室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I can tell you, broadly, how it works. By examining skull size and shape, I can accurately read your personality, and even your destiny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我可以大致地告诉你它是如何运作的。通过观察头骨的大小和形状，我可以准确地判断出你的性格，甚至你的命运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For example, I met a man who was rather green, and quite large. I measured his skull and found something incredible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 例如，我遇到一个人，他很年轻，很高大。我测量了他的头骨，发现了一些不可思议的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His woes in life were not because of random bad luck, but because of his brain. His massive skull contained an enlarged aggression center.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他生活中的不幸不是因为偶然的坏运气，而是因为他的大脑。他巨大的头骨中有一个扩大的攻击中枢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was so aggressive, so angry, that it had eroded every other part of his brain. He couldn't even remember what year it was!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他如此咄咄逼人，如此愤怒，以至于他大脑的其他部分都被侵蚀了。他甚至不记得是哪一年了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you perform phrenology on me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我做颅相学吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely. That will be 15 denarii. Remember, you're not just paying to draw cards, but for my expert skills of interpretation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对的，一共是15第纳尔。记住，你花钱不光是为了抽牌，也是为了我的专业解读能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you do Tarot? I'm interested in that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你会塔罗牌？我对此很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. I'm always here if you change your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。如果你改变主意了，我随时都在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can do, my friend. Now, let us begin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以的，我的朋友。现在，让我们开始吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
