ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, 15 denarii. Examine me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，15第纳尔。检查我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I'm afraid I cannot help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那恐怕我帮不了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that kind of money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没那么多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! That's good to hear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！听你这么说太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alexander [000E604F] (file) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to discuss that gecko oil again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想再谈谈蜥蜴油的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your musculature is simply remarkable. I think you could outfight any Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的肌肉组织简直不可思议，我觉得你能打败任何军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your eyesight is very impressive. You'd be an excellent spotter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的视力令人印象深刻，你会是一名出色的侦察员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your stamina is incredible. I'm sure your lovers are very satisfied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的耐力令人难以置信，我相信你的爱人一定很满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't a medical observation, but you're very well-spoken. You'd be an excellent salesman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是医学观察，但你说话很得体，你会成为一名优秀的推销员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a very analytical thinker. Perhaps you should have my job? Ha, I'm just kidding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个非常善于分析的思考者，也许你应该接替我的工作？哈，我开玩笑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your reflexes are incredible. I can't imagine you've ever been out-squirreled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的反应能力真是惊人，我简直无法想象你会被什么给比下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow... you are supernaturally fortunate. One might even say blessed. The fates are on your side, friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇...你是超自然的幸运，甚至可以说是有福的。命运站在你这边，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're quite unremarkable. A perfect, shining example of 'average'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还挺不起眼的。一个完美的，闪亮的“普通人”的例子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Clearly, you've managed to overcome this mediocrity. You made it this far, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很明显，你已经克服了这种平庸。毕竟你能走到这一步。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, your brawn is somewhat... lacking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你的肌肉有点...匮乏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your eyesight is quite poor. Might I recommend glasses?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的视力很差，我可以推荐眼镜吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your constitution is very weak. It seems as though a sneeze could kill you. I'm amazed you're still alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的体质很弱，似乎一个喷嚏就能杀死你。我很惊讶你还活着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're quite unpleasant to talk to. I mean no offense. It's just your manner of speaking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟你说话很不愉快。我无意冒犯，这只是你说话的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mental development seems somewhat... stunted. A common wasteland problem, unfortunately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的智力发育似乎有点...不良。很遗憾，这是一个常见的废土问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're incredibly clumsy. Worryingly so. It's a wonder you haven't stepped on some landmine somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你笨得令人难以置信，令人担忧。你还没踩到地雷，真是个奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're perhaps the unluckiest living person I've ever met. Everyone unluckier was dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能是我见过的最倒霉的人了，更倒霉的人都死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing stands out to me as glaringly wrong with you. You're rather well-balanced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，你没有什么明显的毛病。你的平衡能力相当不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's also what appears to be a bullet entrance wound on your forehead. No exit wound, either, so I gather the thing is still inside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的额头上似乎还有一处子弹射入的伤口。也没有出口伤，所以我猜那东西还在里面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That doesn't worry me though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我并不担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, everything I've said is merely an assessment of you as you are now. No individual is set one way forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我所说的一切都只是对你现在的评价。没有人会永远一成不变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're interested in becoming something more. Stronger, faster, better; I have the perfect cure for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你有兴趣成为更好的人，更强、更快、更好。我有最适合你的治疗方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gecko oil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蜥蜴油。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what would that be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's no pitch, I assure you. When I extol the virtues of gecko oil, I do it purely to inform. An informed customer makes informed decisions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我向你保证，这不是推销。当我赞美蜥蜴油的优点时，我这样做纯粹是为了提供信息。知情的客户做出知情的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Extracted from the glands of the great golden gecko, my gecko oil liniment heals all kinds of common ailments. I'm talking miracles for every malady you could imagine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的蜥蜴油搽剂是从大金蜥蜴的腺体中提取的，可以治疗各种常见病。我说的是治愈所有你能想到的疾病的奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leprosy, malaria, arthritis, stupidity, infertility - all have seen benefits from gecko oil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 麻风病、疟疾、关节炎、愚蠢、不孕症——所有这些都能从蜥蜴油中受益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel weak? Slow? Ugly? Stupid? Perhaps you don't feel that way, but you know you could be better than you are now. Irradiated? Fat? My gecko oil is for you, my friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你感到虚弱吗？缓慢？丑？愚蠢？也许你不这么认为，但你知道你可以做得比现在更好。辐射？肥胖？我的蜥蜴油是给你的，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm listening. Pitch it to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在听，跟我说说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh a very modest sum, of course. Only the bare minimum I'm able. It is my job to help my customers, but I also must turn a profit. You understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，当然是很普通的数目，这是我能承受的最低限度。帮助顾客是我的工作，但我也必须盈利，你懂的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 50 denarii is the cost, and that is a steal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 50第纳尔是成本价，这很便宜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And how much are you going to charge me for this gecko oil?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这瓶蜥蜴油你打算收我多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You go to the doctor and groan when he tries to offer you medicine? Please have faith.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去看医生，当他要给你开药时你却唉声叹气？请有点信心吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should've expected you to try selling me some garbage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我早该料到你会卖给我一些垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your loss, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕这是你的损失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is nothing insane about caring for your long-term health.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关心自己的长期健康并不是什么疯狂的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 50 denarii? You're insane.
ESP.TRADUIT: 50第纳尔？你疯了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 30? You're mad. The lowest I could possibly go is 35.
ESP.TRADUIT: 30？你疯了。我能给的最低价是35。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Barter 50] Not good enough. Try 30.
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易50]不够好，30吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You... fucker. You drive a hard bargain. Very good. You're a cutthroat. You'd best watch out that nobody else cut your throat for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你...混蛋，你真会讨价还价，很好。你真是个冷血的家伙，你最好小心别让别人割了你的喉咙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can do 25. It's a deal, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以接受25，那就这么说定了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Barter 65] Because you've wasted my time, 25. That, or nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易65]因为你浪费了我的时间，25。要么这样，要么什么都没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good. And here is your oil. Hold your nose when you drink it, it has quite a smell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的油，喝的时候捏着鼻子，味道挺浓的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds like a deal. <Pay 25 denarii.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付25第纳尔>听起来不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good. And here is your oil. Hold your nose when you drink it, it has quite a smell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的油，喝的时候捏着鼻子，味道挺浓的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, 35 denarii it is. <Pay 35 denarii.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付35第纳尔>好的，这是35第纳尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good. And here is your oil. Hold your nose when you drink it, it has quite a smell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。这是你的油，喝的时候捏着鼻子，味道挺浓的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, 50 denarii. <Pay 50 denarii.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付50第纳尔>好的，50第纳尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely. I will begin by drawing your first card. This card will represent your past. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我先给你抽第一张牌，这张卡片将代表你的过去。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go, 15 denarii. Do my Tarot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你，15第纳尔。算塔罗牌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here goes. Your first draw is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 开始了。你第一次抽到的是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Hanged Man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 倒吊人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It embodies sacrifice, but also a period of reflection, of gathering a sense of your purpose. Contemplation and metamorphosis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它体现了牺牲，但也体现了一段时间的反思，体现了你对目标的认识。沉思与蜕变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At one point you likely found yourself in a rut, or were unsatisfied with your life. But in relinquishing control of yourself, you have gained new perspective.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在某一时刻，你可能发现自己陷入了困境，或者对生活不满意。但在放弃控制自己的过程中，你获得了新的视角。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you ready for your next card? This card shall represent your present.
ESP.TRADUIT: 准备好下一张牌了吗？这张卡片将代表你的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很糟糕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It embodies sacrifice, but also a period of reflection, of gathering a sense of your purpose. Contemplation and metamorphosis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它体现了牺牲，但也体现了一段时间的反思，体现了你对目标的认识。沉思与蜕变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 准备好下一张牌了吗？这张卡片将代表你的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很好，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It embodies sacrifice, but also a period of reflection, of gathering a sense of your purpose. Contemplation and metamorphosis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它体现了牺牲，但也体现了一段时间的反思，体现了你对目标的认识。沉思与蜕变。

ESP.TRADUIT: 准备好下一张牌了吗？这张卡片将代表你的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It embodies sacrifice, but also a period of reflection, of gathering a sense of your purpose. Contemplation and metamorphosis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它体现了牺牲，但也体现了一段时间的反思，体现了你对目标的认识。沉思与蜕变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 在某一时刻，你可能发现自己陷入了困境，或者对生活不满意。但在放弃控制自己的过程中，你获得了新的视角。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
