ESP.TRADUIT: 准备好下一张牌了吗？这张卡片将代表你的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does it mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Your second card is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你的第二张牌是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The reversed Tower. Worrying, but not catastrophic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逆位高塔。令人担忧，但不是灾难性的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The tower represents resistance to change. Avoidance. Imprisonment. You fear the uncertain future, so you cling to faulty presuppositions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座塔代表着对变革的抵制、回避、禁锢。你害怕不确定的未来，所以你坚持错误的假设。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You feel as though you've avoided disaster, or can avoid it still, but things have already changed. You only delay the inevitable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得你已经避免了灾难，或者仍然可以避免灾难，但事情已经发生了变化。你只是在拖延不可避免的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want what's best for yourself, you must embrace change. The tower must fall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想为自己争取最好的，你必须拥抱改变。这座塔一定会倒塌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One last card. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一张牌。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Your second card is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你的第二张牌是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The reversed Justice. Fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逆位正义。真有意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It means that things are off-kilter. There is no justice, no accountability. Not only do liars reign supreme, but you lie to yourself as well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 意思是事情不平衡了。没有正义，没有责任。不仅撒谎者占主导地位，你也会对自己撒谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may have made a mistake that you can't accept. Or you're overlooking someone else's mistakes, perhaps in the hopes that it will fix itself eventually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能犯了一个你无法接受的错误。或者你忽略了别人的错误，也许是希望它最终会自行解决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must take accountability. Be honest with yourself about what is wrong, and try to make amends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须承担责任。诚实面对自己的错误，并努力去弥补。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One last card. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一张牌。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Your second card is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你的第二张牌是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Emperor. A very powerful card, for better or worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 皇帝。一张非常强大的牌，无论好坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It represents structure and discipline. The Emperor himself can also represent a sort of father figure. Is seeking a father figure a common theme in your life?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它代表结构和纪律，皇帝本人也可以代表一种父亲的形象。在你的生活中，寻找一个父亲的角色是一个共同的主题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must continue to pursue your goals with strength and conviction. Perhaps you, too, can become an Emperor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须带着力量和信念继续追求你的目标。或许你也能成为皇帝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One last card. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一张牌。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Your second card is...
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你的第二张牌是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The reversed Fool. Very interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逆位愚者。非常有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This card represents spontaneity and idealism, often innocence. It being reversed is a warning. Your free-spiritedness may be bordering on mania.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这张牌代表自发性和理想主义，通常是天真。它被逆转是一个警告，你的自由精神可能近乎狂热。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The reversed Fool is a powerful force of nature, but lacks wisdom. Be careful that you're not being taken advantage of, because you are prone to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逆位愚者是一种强大的自然力量，但缺乏智慧。小心不要被人利用，因为你很容易被人利用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One last card. Are you ready?
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一张牌。你准备好了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This card shall represent your future. Here goes...
ESP.TRADUIT: 这张卡片将代表你的未来。来了...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A reversed World. A bitter ending, I suppose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逆位世界。我想，这是一个痛苦的结局。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This card forecasts disappointment. Lack of vision will result in an imperfect outcome. You will have to leave things even though they feel incomplete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这张牌预示着失望。缺乏远见会导致不完美的结果，你将不得不放弃一些东西，即使它们感觉不完整。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The silver lining is that this can describe any number of things. Very rarely do we leave things feeling like we've solved them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运的是，这可以用来描述很多事情。我们很少会觉得事情已经解决了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? What do you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你觉得呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A load of bullshit is often fertile ground for something beautiful to sprout. Just look at manure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一堆狗屎往往是美好事物发芽的沃土。看看肥料就知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was a load of bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是一堆狗屎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! That's good to hear!
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！听你这么说太好了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. That was actually pretty accurate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有意思。这实际上是相当准确的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe it did, maybe it didn't. It's up to you to decide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许有，也许没有。由你来决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a cool party trick, but I'm not sure it meant anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个很酷的派对把戏，但我不确定这有什么意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's perfectly understandable. Mull it over. Digest it. I'm sure it will come to mean something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这完全可以理解。仔细考虑一下，消化它，我相信它会有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what to think.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道该怎么想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are no refunds, so don't even think about it. I provided a service. Our transaction is completed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能退款，所以想都别想。我提供了服务，我们的交易完成了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe I wasted 15 denarii on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信我在这上面浪费了15第纳尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know that for a fact, or is that merely your perception? Did you approach the oil with an open mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道这是事实，还是仅仅是你的感觉？你有没有以开放的心态接触油？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your gecko oil doesn't do anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的蜥蜴油一点用都没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered that maybe the oil did work, and you simply didn't notice?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有想过，也许油确实起作用了，只是你没有注意到？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Having an open mind doesn't change anything. Either it works, or it doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拥有开放的心态并不能改变任何事情。要么有用，要么没用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I resent the accusation!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我讨厌这种指责！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cut the crap. You're selling junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 废话少说。你在卖垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, perhaps we can discuss business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，也许我们可以谈谈生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I would like to clarify! There is no scam. I sell remedies. There is no guarantee they will all work. Some customers are very satisfied.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我想澄清一下！没有骗局。我是卖药的，不能保证它们都有效。有些顾客非常满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what did you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你有什么想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bet you're making a lot of money scamming these Legionaries. I want in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打赌你一定靠骗军团士兵赚了不少钱。我想加入。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For what? Selling a product that you don't like? Utterly ridiculous. You're making a fool of yourself!
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了什么？销售你不喜欢的产品？荒谬至极。你这是在出丑！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should turn you over to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该把你交给军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would rather not!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我宁愿不！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever. I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便了。我也不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A great idea. I had a similar arrangement in Tombstone with a lovely young woman. It worked wonders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好主意。我在墓碑镇和一位可爱的年轻女子也有过类似的安排。它创造了奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should go around Chloride and spread the word. Tell them that the Good Doctor Fritter is going to perform miracles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该去克洛赖德宣传一下。告诉他们，好医生弗里特将要创造奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you've finished gathering everyone you can, return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等你把能召集的人都召集好了，再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's put on a demonstration. Test your potions on me, and I'll sell it to the audience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来做个示范吧。在我身上测试你的药剂，我就会说服观众。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A demonstration of some sort. You will drink my potions, and then pretend that you've been miraculously healed. Really sell it to the audience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 某种形式的示范。你喝下我的药剂，然后假装自己奇迹般地痊愈了。真正地向观众推销它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should go around Chloride and spread the word. Tell them that the Good Doctor Fritter is going to perform miracles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该去克洛赖德宣传一下。告诉他们，好医生弗里特将要创造奇迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you've finished gathering everyone you can, return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等你把能召集的人都召集好了，再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. What do you suggest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你有什么建议？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, don't worry about that. I'm quite adept at makeup. Throw some soot in your hair, rub some grime on your skin. You'll look quite sickly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，不用担心。我很擅长化妆。在你的头发上撒点烟灰，在你的皮肤上擦点污垢。你看起来会很虚弱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rest is up to you. You must *act*, my friend. Play a role. Become more than yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 剩下的就交给你了。你必须*行动*起来，我的朋友。扮演一个角色，超越你自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't they recognize me during the demonstration?
ESP.TRADUIT: 示范时他们不会认出我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! But you'll have to be more specific. Who is sick and what are the symptoms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！但你得说得更具体些。谁病了，症状是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need something to cure a disease.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要一种能治病的药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. That's quite grim. A prostitute, you said? Heaven forbid it's the pox. That would be, ahem, syphilis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 原来如此，这是相当严峻的。你说她是个妓女？但愿这不是瘟疫。那就是，咳咳，梅毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Puzzled

ESP.ORIGINAL: A mercury cleanse would be the traditional treatment for this, but I don't have any mercury on me at the moment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 水银排毒是传统的治疗方法，但我现在身上没有水银。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. This is quite the pickle. Mercury. Where might one find mercury?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是相当棘手的问题。水银，在哪里可以找到水银？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Yes, I remember. "Mercury in Mohave." That's a headline from the Kingman Mining Times. I have a habit of reading pre-war newspapers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！是的，我记得。“莫哈维的水银”，这是《金曼矿业时报》的头条。我有阅读战前报纸的习惯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a woman in Chloride who's sick. A prostitute, presenting with a rash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德有个生病的女人，一个得了皮疹的妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well then how am I to help you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我怎么帮你？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd rather not say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是不说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good question. If I recall, there was a lawman around here who was doing some sort of investigation into mercury. I think his name was Donald Springer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问得好。如果我没记错的话，这附近有个执法官正在调查水银的事。我记得他叫唐纳德·施普林格。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, no, I'm sorry. He was in Donald Springs. I would go there. Maybe there's something that could lead you somewhere useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，不，抱歉，是他在唐纳德泉。我会去那里，也许那里有什么东西能把你引向某个有用的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well? Where am I supposed to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？我该去哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Good luck finding them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！祝你好运找到他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about real medicine? Can't I get antibiotics?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真正的药呢？不能给我抗生素吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does anything really ever truly work? Life is full of such mysteries. Some people feel quite helped by mercury treatments!
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么东西真的有用吗？生活中充满了这样的谜团。有些人觉得水银疗法很有帮助！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does mercury actually work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 水银真的有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Best of luck to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Good Doctor Fritter [0600D84C] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Sorry. Is there something you need from me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，抱歉。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Booking and payment for what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么预订和付款？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I need to know what a pretty girl like you is doing in a shithole like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我需要知道像你这样漂亮的女孩在这种鬼地方做什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wanted to ask you some things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是想问你几件事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I needed something from you, I would tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我需要你帮忙，我会告诉你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I don't really think about it. I'm supposed to have sex with the men, so that's what I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我没怎么想过。我应该和男人上床，所以这就是我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of slave are you? You don't look like a laborer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么样的奴隶？你看起来不像劳工。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't remember. One of the men did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不记得了，其中一个人说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hole? That's a cruel name. Who named you that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 洞？这名字太残忍了。谁给你起的这个名字？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a pretty name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字真好听。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. You too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你也一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴认识你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You just have sex all day? Sounds like fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就整天跟男人打炮？听起来很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. I don't know. All slaves have sex. You're required to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，我不知道。所有的奴隶都有性行为，这是必须的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a sex slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个性奴？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Prostitutes make money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妓女赚钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're a prostitute? I thought that was banned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你是个妓女？我认为这是被禁止的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't remember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, it's just kind of a blur. I don't really look at them. I mean, I look at them, but I don't see them. My mind goes somewhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我只是记不清了，我不怎么看他们。我是说，我看着他们，但我看不见他们。我的思绪在别的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are your usual customers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是你的老顾客？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not here. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里不行。跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Winnin' Kid said you're not feeling well. What's the matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胜利之子说你不舒服。怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not here. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里不行。跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The skin at the base of your neck seems really irritated. Are you alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你脖子底部的皮肤似乎受到了刺激。你没事吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look... bad. Are you sick? Or depressed, or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来...不好。你生病了吗？或者抑郁，或者别的什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's the matter? Are you okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那到底是怎么回事？你还好吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sick. And it's... I don't know what to do about it. I'm scared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生病了。而且...我不知道该怎么办，我很害怕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No... what? You're not okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不...怎么？你不好吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sick. And it's... I don't know what to do about it. I'm scared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我生病了。而且...我不知道该怎么办，我很害怕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me what's wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我怎么了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. I feel sick too. I get these fevers, and I'm so tired all the time. I don't know what it is, but I know something is wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是，我也觉得不舒服，我经常发烧，而且一直都很累。我不知道是怎么回事，但我知道有点不对劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you said it's itchy? That's what the problem is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你说它很痒？这就是问题所在？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's embarrassing. Damn it. There are these little warts around my... And I think I'm losing my hair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很尴尬，该死。我的...周围有一些小疣子，我觉得我的头发在掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Looks like a rash. Do you have any other symptoms?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来像是皮疹。你还有其他症状吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's gross. Sounds really bad. Sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，太恶心了。听起来真的很糟糕，很遗憾听到这个消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: How bad is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有多严重？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Likely syphilis. It's a sexually transmitted disease.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能是梅毒，这是一种性传播疾病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus. Is that it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天哪。就这些吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's bad. It may stop showing symptoms, but it'll cause health problems in the future if it's not treated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很严重。它可能会停止表现出症状，但如果不治疗，将来会引起健康问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm very worried!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常担心！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> It's no biggie. Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>没什么大不了的，不用担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I've infected every one of Isaiah's customers with disease. He'll be pissed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我让以赛亚的每一个顾客都染上了疾病。他会生气的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's contagious. Everyone you have sex with is at risk of contracting it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是会传染的，与你发生性关系的每个人都有感染这种病毒的风险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That won't happen. There's no way I'll ever bring a baby into this mess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不会发生的，我绝对不会把孩子卷进这样的烂摊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you get pregnant, it can spread to your baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你怀孕了，它会传染给你的孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so much worse than I feared. God damn it. Why does this happen to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 情况比我担心的要糟糕得多。该死的，为什么这种事会发生在我身上？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, of course not. They'll kill me. Not just Isaiah. The men too. I'm diseased. They'll want revenge. I've seen it happen before.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，当然没有，他们会杀了我的。不只是以赛亚，男人也一样。我病了，他们会报复的，我以前见过这种情况。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you told anyone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你告诉别人了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I hope not. We usually use condoms, these thin ones made from bighorner gut. But someone gave it to me first, and I don't know who.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我希望没有。我们通常用避孕套，这种用大角羊肠制成的薄安全套。但有人先传染了我，我不知道是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think you spread it to anyone else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得你传染给别人了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not allowed out of Cyanide Springs. And who would I go see? The Maidens would just... they'd...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能离开山奈泉。我该去见谁呢？女侍们会...她们会...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you seen a doctor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去看医生了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They wouldn't treat me. I'm not like a normal slave. I'm... dirty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她们不肯给我看病。我不像一个普通的奴隶，我...脏了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's humiliating. I hate them. They look at me with the most horrible glares, like I'm brahmin shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很丢脸。我讨厌她们，她们用最可怕的眼神看着我，好像我是婆罗门牛的屎一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not my fault that I'm not allowed to keep the chastity that they fucking worship. I'm not some coddled Cult princess. I don't have that privilege.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能保持她们所崇拜的贞操又不是我的错。我可不是什么被宠溺的邪教公主，我没有这个特权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Maidens would what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 女侍们会怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. You're from the west, aren't you? The medicine we have here is different. I know most chems are banned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。你是从西边来的吧？我们这里的药物是不同的，我知道大多数化学药品是被禁止的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say that the really good medicine is kept in storage at the creation centers for when important people get sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，真正的好药是保存在生产中心的仓库里，以备重要人物生病时使用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There aren't any creation centers here though, not even any rest camps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是这里没有任何生产中心，甚至没有任何休息营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anywhere I can get medicine for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么地方可以给你买药吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Medicine is kept for important people. Got it. So I'll have to steal medicine from Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 药品是为重要人物准备的。明白了，所以我只能从凯撒那里偷药了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The weaklings die and the strong survive. That's the way it's always been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弱者死亡，强者生存。一直都是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does the Legion function if nobody is allowed to use real medicine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有人被允许使用真正的药物，军团将如何运作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think there's one in Dolan Springs. And there might be one west of here, near the highway - a traveling doctor. That's what I heard, anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰泉应该有一家。在这里西边，在高速公路附近，可能有一个旅行医生。反正我是这么听说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about doctors? Do you know of any doctors?
ESP.TRADUIT: 医生呢？你认识什么医生吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you shouldn't. The penalty for smuggling is death. And I'd have no way to hide whatever you bring me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不应该。走私的惩罚是死刑，我也没办法藏起你带给我的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I bring you real medicine? I can cross the river and get something from a real doctor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能给你拿真正的药吗？我可以过河去找个真正的医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. I can't pay you. I don't make any money, and I can't... well, I wouldn't want to get you sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，我不能付钱给你。我赚不到钱，而且我不能...好吧，我不想让你生病。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I'm... I appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！我...我很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't need payment. I'll try and help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要报酬，我会尽力帮你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Okay. I'll just... um, get back to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好的。那我就...回去工作吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm out of my depth with this. I don't know how to help you. Sorry. Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这个已经无能为力了，我不知道该怎么帮你。抱歉，祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It *might* help? So it also might not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这“也许”有帮助？所以也可能没有？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I brought you some mercury. Drinking it might help cure you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你带了点水银，喝了也许能治好你的病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, if you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，既然你这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Oh my God. That's disgusting. I feel dizzy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。我的天啊，太恶心了，我觉得头晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. Well I hope it's working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，我希望它能起作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for taking the time to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你花时间帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's perfectly healthy. Drink up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个非常健康，喝吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't have much of a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我也别无选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Oh my God. That's disgusting. I feel dizzy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。我的天啊，太恶心了，我觉得头晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. Well I hope it's working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，我希望它能起作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for taking the time to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你花时间帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a gamble. It could cure you, or it could make you sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一场赌博。它可以治愈你，也可以让你生病。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't have much of a choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我也别无选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Oh my God. That's disgusting. I feel dizzy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃。我的天啊，太恶心了，我觉得头晕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. Well I hope it's working.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，我希望它能起作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for taking the time to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你花时间帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't drink it, but it's the closest you'll get to a real cure. Drink it or don't. Your choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是不会喝的，但这是最接近治愈的方法了。喝不喝都行，你自己选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Really? How?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？真的？怎么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found you some antibiotics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你找了些抗生素。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah, really? That must've cost a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，真的吗？那一定花了不少钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those are some big pills. I hope it works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些药片可真够大的，希望它管用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I bought them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我买的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seriously? What the fuck, I can't use this. They'll kill me if they find out I have stolen chems!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？搞什么鬼，我不能用这个。要是让他们知道我偷了药品，他们会杀了我的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I don't have a choice. It's this, or get sicker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我也别无选择。要么这样，要么病得更重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those are some big pills. I hope it works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些药片可真够大的，希望它管用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I stole them from a Legion caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从军团的商队里偷来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm worried, but I'll take your word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很担心，但我相信你的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I hope that works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我希望这有用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for taking the time to help me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你花时间帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心这个。

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it's not my fault!
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这不是我的错！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What am I supposed to do? Tell everyone that I'm diseased? It's humiliating. I feel like a fucking ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我该怎么办？告诉所有人我生病了？这太丢脸了。我觉得自己像个该死的食尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And when people find out, what will they do to me? Kill me? Worse?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人们发现了，他们会怎么处置我？杀了我？更糟？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone should know about your sickness. If it's contagious, people are at risk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该有人知道你的病。如果它具有传染性，人们就处于危险之中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. There's nobody that would care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。没人会在乎的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you could go back across the river and tell the Bear Captain. Have them swoop in and save me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你可以回到河对岸去告诉大熊队长，让他们冲进来救我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aristophontes is the town mayor. Maybe he'll do something. But I think Isaiah works for him, or works for someone who works for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯是镇长，也许他会做点什么。但我认为以赛亚是为他工作的，或者是为他工作的人工作的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or there's the Cult of Mars. Maybe you could have the head crone pray for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者是玛尔斯教团，也许你可以让那个老妪为我祈祷。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just please don't tell Isaiah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要告诉以赛亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were to tell someone, who do you think I should tell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我要告诉别人，你觉得我应该告诉谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do what you think is best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做你认为最好的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to tell someone. If I don't, this could end up spreading and hurting a lot of innocent people too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得告诉别人。如果我不这么做，这件事最终可能会扩散并伤害很多无辜的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Thank you so much. And thank you for the medicine. I'm... I'll find some way to repay you, someday. I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！非常感谢，也谢谢你的药。我...总有一天我会想办法报答你的，我保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I won't tell anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我不会告诉任何人的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it's short for Doctor Dalton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，是道尔顿医生的简称。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc D? That your full name?
ESP.TRADUIT: D医生？这是他的全名？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you probably noticed, this is a cattle town. I do a lot of work with the animals, keeping them healthy and all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能注意到了，这是一个养牛的小镇。我做了很多与动物有关的工作，使它们保持健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I minored in agronomy at the university, so I also try to help the maidens with their crops as best I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在大学时辅修了农学，所以我也会尽我所能帮助女侍们打理庄稼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not all flora and fauna though. I take human clients too. So I can patch you up if you need me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也不全是动植物，我也接待人类客户。如果你需要我，我可以帮你包扎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of work do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, that's be the Universitas Caesaris in Two-Sun. I was lucky to have a benefactor who covered my tuition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，那是凯撒大学的双日城分校。我很幸运有一位赞助人支付我的学费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned a university.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了一所大学。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm in a sort of political exile. It's just what happens when you prove someone important wrong in a public setting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在处于某种政治流放状态。当你在公共场合证明某人的重要错误时就会发生这种事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had my medical license revoked for using stimpaks in the treatment of certain injuries. I argued my case in court and won.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我因为在治疗某些损伤时使用治疗针而被吊销了行医执照。我在法庭上辩论并赢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was granted permission to use stimpaks in the treatment of animals, but I was also sent here, to the frontier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被允许使用治疗针来治疗动物，但我也被派到这里，到边疆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is what it is. The animals are good customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情就是这样。这些动物是好顾客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's an educated man doing in a cattle town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个受过教育的人在这个养牛的小镇干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's a Legion-affiliated university. It's good for the Legion to have skilled, educated tradesmen around. Doctors, engineers and whatnot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是一所隶属于军团的大学。对军团来说，拥有技术娴熟、受过良好教育的商人是件好事，医生，工程师等等。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rumor is that Caesar himself puts funds aside to keep the university going. Wouldn't be surprised. I've heard he really respects knowledge and the arts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传言是凯撒自己拨出资金来维持大学的运转。我不会感到惊讶，我听说他真的尊重知识和艺术。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion has a university?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团有一所大学？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Let's take a look at the animal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。让我们来看看这只动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your doctor services.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的医生服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need your doctor services.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你的医生服务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a veterinarian. I can't be giving stimpaks to people. Animals only.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是兽医。我不能给人使用治疗针，仅限动物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, let's say you've got a little gerbil. In your pocket there. Let's take a look at her, shall we?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，假设你有一只小沙鼠，在你的口袋里。我们来看看她，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Animal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 动物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quick learner, eh? What can I do for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 学得真快啊？我能为您做些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right. Animal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，动物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has to do with perceived notions of naturalness, mostly. That's my view.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这主要与人们对自然的认知有关。这是我的观点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is a stimpak made from? Adrenaline, Generalized PRP, corticosteroids. This is all stuff that's already in your body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 治疗针是用什么做的？肾上腺素，广义富血小板血浆，皮质类固醇。这些都是你身体里已经存在的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, you can't get epinephrine from plants, but that doesn't make it worse, or less natural.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你不能从植物中获取肾上腺素，但这并不会让情况变得更糟，或更不自然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, why are stimpaks banned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，为什么要禁止治疗针？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't too hard. I had my Hippocratic Oath, and the judge was sympathetic to me from the start.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并不太难。我发过希波克拉底誓言，法官从一开始就同情我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You argued your case in court? Tell me about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在法庭上为你的案子辩护？跟我说说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I say judge, but it was the Two-Sun proconsul, Tobías Pérez.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说是法官，但其实是双日城总督，托比亚斯·佩雷斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tobías was a mischievous old fucker. I think he respected that I had the guts to bring the case to court. I did break the law, after all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 托比亚斯是个淘气的老混蛋，我想他尊重我有勇气把案子告上法庭。毕竟我确实触犯了法律。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why was the judge sympathetic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么法官同情你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know exactly what you're talking about. Ephedra viridis. They called it 'Mormon tea'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我完全明白你在说什么。绿麻黄，他们称之为“摩门茶”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's very fascinating, because the ephedra that grew here before the war had very little ephedrine, unlike Asian varieties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很神奇，因为战前生长在这里的麻黄几乎不含麻黄碱，不像亚洲品种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is to say, the American tribals who brewed ephedra tea before the war were likely experiencing a placebo effect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说，在战前泡制麻黄茶的美国部落很可能正在经历一种安慰剂效应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's too bad that our native ephedra don't have much ephedrine. It could help a lot of people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾，我们本土的麻黄中没有多少麻黄碱。它可以帮助很多人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can get ephedrine from plants, and it's similar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以从植物中获得麻黄碱，它们是相似的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Am I the first person who's ever brought up his name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我是第一个提起他名字的人吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He passed a few years back, but he used to be vice-president of Two-Sun before the Legion came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他几年前去世了，但在军团到来之前他曾是双日城的副总统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The president was totally out of her depth with the gang problem. Most of the House was in the gangs' pockets. Crime was uncontrolled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总统对帮派的问题完全无能为力，众议院的大部分席位都在黑帮的口袋里，犯罪不受控制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then there was a coup. The president got hanged and Pérez took her place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后发生了政变。总统被绞死了，佩雷斯取代了她的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Days later, the Legion came through and busted up all the gangs. It was systematic. One after the other, all within the week.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几天后，军团来了，粉碎了所有的帮派。这是系统的，一个接一个，都在一周之内。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me a little more about Tobías Pérez.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再跟我说说托比亚斯·佩雷斯的事吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honestly? No. I've come to like it here. I grew up around farms and cattle, so it just feels like home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话？不想。我开始喜欢这里了，我是在农场和牛群中长大的，所以这里有家的感觉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you ever wish you could go back to Two-Sun?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想过回到双日城生活吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not, sorry to say. I should. I've seen my fair share. But I just can't wrap my head around the mechanical stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我不知道。我应该，我也见过不少，但我就是搞不懂机械的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know anything about cyberdogs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你了解机械犬吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might as well be asking for gold. What do you need antibiotics for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还不如要金子呢。你需要抗生素做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to know where I can get antibiotics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要知道哪里能买到抗生素。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk about Rima's condition again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得再谈谈瑞玛的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Christ. That'd be syphilis, I bet. It's a venereal disease, and highly contagious. Her clients are gambling with life and death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，天哪，我打赌那是梅毒。这是一种传染性很强的性病，她的客户是在拿生死做赌注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Penicillin is what you need. It's possible to make post-war, unlike the fancy synthetic drugs. Doesn't mean it'll be easy to find.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要的是青霉素。它可以在战后制造，不像那些花哨的合成药物。但并不意味着很容易找到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a woman in Chloride who's sick. A prostitute, presenting with a rash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德有个生病的女人，一个得了皮疹的妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I can't help you. Sorry. I understand patient confidentiality, but I simply cannot advise you if I don't know what the situation is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我帮不了你，抱歉。我理解为病人保密，但如果我不了解情况我就不能给你建议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能告诉你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, there is, but I don't expect they'll be willing to barter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然有，但我不认为他们会愿意以物易物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: North of here, there's a road that leads to the Grand Canyon. Specialty caravans come through it from time to time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这里往北，有条路通向大峡谷。专业的商队不时从这里经过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These are small groups of Legionaries. Most of them sailed here all the way from Kaibab, carrying cargo for the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些是军团的小分队。他们大多从凯巴布远道而来，为堡垒运送货物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's always medicine in these shipments. They're storing it in preparation for the big battle at the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这批货里总是有药品。他们在为大坝之战做准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I don't know, I suppose you could steal it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我不知道，我猜你可以偷了它？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There must be someone around here who has antibiotics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这附近肯定有人有抗生素。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? I was only half serious when I said it. It's a bad idea. You don't want to tussle with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？我说的时候只是半当真的。这是个坏主意，你不会想和军团对抗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> Look, this isn't my business. You do what you're gonna do.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>听着，这不关我的事。你想怎么做就怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a Legionary out there. Nice fella. His name was Iosep. I helped him with a... uh, medical issue.
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面有个军团士兵，不错的小伙子，他的名字叫约塞普。我帮他做了一个...呃，医疗问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's also, well, kinda dull. Sharp when he needs to be, but he's a simple man who thinks in simple terms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他也，嗯，有点无趣。他在必要的时候会很敏锐，但他是个简单的人，思考的方式很简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're serious about getting the medicine from those caravans, talk to him and see what you can suss out. Take notes. Plan something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你真的想从商队那里弄到药，跟他谈谈，看看你能查出什么。做笔记，计划一些事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't give you any more help than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只能帮你这么多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rob the Legion caravan? Interesting. Tell me more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抢劫军团的商队？有意思。告诉我更多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said she's a prostitute, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说她是个妓女，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from Benson, south of Two-Sun. Little farm town. All cattle and crops. Still, it was big enough that you could make a living selling sex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来自本森，在双日城的南边。一个农场小镇，全是牛和庄稼。尽管如此，它还是足够大，你可以靠卖淫谋生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My best friend was a prostitute. A 'working girl', she used to say. Sometimes, she got hurt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最好的朋友是个妓女。她过去常说，她是一个“上班女郎”。有时，她会受伤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I patched her up when I could. Just a little farmboy and the town whore, like two peas in a pod.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽我所能给她包扎了。一个农家小子和一个镇上的妓女，形影不离。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I have sympathy for this woman. That's my point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我很同情这个女人。这就是我想说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My words are just words. If you act on what I say, that's your business. Just make sure you do a good thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的话只是说说而已。如果你照我说的做，那是你的事。只要确保你做了一件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're very forthcoming with that information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很乐意提供这些信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, you'd have to go back to Flagstaff for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 靠，你得回旗杆市去才行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you're from out west, aren't you? If Vegas is like what they say on the radio, maybe you'll find a clinic out there. Worth a try, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你是从西部来的吧？如果维加斯真的像广播里说的那样，也许你能在那里找到一家诊所。我想值得一试。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said penicillin can be synthesized? Who might have the capability to do that? I could purchase from them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说青霉素可以合成？谁有这样的能力呢？我可以从他们那里购买。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a lot more involved than that, I'm afraid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 恐怕要比这复杂得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you just make penicillin? It can't be that hard. It's just a bunch of ingredients and a recipe. You can cook, can't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不直接制造青霉素呢？不会那么难的。就是一堆食材和菜谱，你会做饭，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yup. That'd be the standard treatment. It's nasty, dangerous, and it'll make you sick. But it may just get rid of the infection too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是标准的治疗方法。这很恶心，很危险，还会让你生病，但它也可能消除感染。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another doctor suggested I look for mercury.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一个医生建议我去找水银。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hard to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很难说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does mercury actually work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 水银真的有用吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll tell you this. Patients treated with mercury don't usually die from their infection. They die from mercury poisoning instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉你，接受水银治疗的患者通常不会死于感染，而是死于汞中毒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it? So nobody knows if mercury actually works?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样？所以没人知道水银是否真的有效？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck. For you, and the patient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。为了你，也为了病人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Doc D [06020BB2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the info. I'll see what I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的信息。我看看我能做些什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Prostitute? I admit, I did not know there was a prostitute.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妓女？我承认，我不知道有妓女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How disgusting. Aristophontes has sanctioned a return to total degeneracy. And right under my nose? The gall of that man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真恶心。阿里斯托芬提斯竟然纵容这种堕落。而且还是在我的眼皮底下？这家伙真是厚颜无耻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I presume she has some sort of venereal disease, likely given to her by the debauched fools who pay for her service.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜她得了某种性病，可能是那些为她的服务付钱的放荡的傻瓜传染给她的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for telling me. Would you send for her? I cannot leave her there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你告诉我。你能把她叫来吗？我不能把她留在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure you will need to speak to her master first. Tell him whatever you must. Lie, if need be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想你应该先和她的主人谈谈。你该怎么说就怎么说，说谎，如果需要的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The slave prostitute in Chloride is sick with something. Can you help her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德的妓女奴隶得了什么病。你能帮帮她吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not know for sure. I'm considering making her a Maiden, if only to ensure those animals aren't allowed to touch her anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定。我在考虑让她成为女侍，哪怕只是为了确保那些动物不会再碰她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you want with her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找她干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: An enslaved woman was taken advantage of in such a manner that corrupted the very soul of the Legion. There is nothing more serious than that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个被奴役的女人被利用，腐化了军团的灵魂。没有比这更严重的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you care? She's not your problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么关心这个？她不是你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's likely that they will. I will do my best to keep them in line. She's better off here than in Chloide, is she not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她们很可能会这么做，我会尽力让她们守规矩的。她待在这里比待在克洛赖德好，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Won't the Maidens treat her poorly?
ESP.TRADUIT: 女侍们不会虐待她吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pure? Referring to her virginity? Many Maidens are virgins, yes. Aspirants, though? Priestesses?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纯洁？指的是她的童贞？是的，很多女侍都是处女。然而，追寻者呢？女祭司呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Virginity is something that men worry about when taking a concubine. It is not a religious concept. What truly matters is chastity, and the vow you make with Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 童贞是男人在纳妾时所担心的事情，这不是一个宗教概念。真正重要的是贞洁，以及你对玛尔斯许下的誓言。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yes, she will have to become abstinent. I think she'll be rather grateful for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，她必须禁欲。我认为她会相当感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How can she become a Maiden? I thought Maidens had to be pure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她怎么能成为女侍呢？我以为女侍必须是纯洁的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please, I implore you to think of her circumstances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，我恳求你考虑一下她的处境。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure this is the best thing for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定这对她来说是最好的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'll go get Rima.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我去找瑞玛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you must.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你非要问的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to think it over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要仔细考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is Chloride, hun. It's a mining town, and has been for over 400 years. My 10th great grandparents served the miners here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里是克洛赖德，宝贝儿。这儿是个矿镇，已经有400多年的历史了，我的十世祖就曾在这里为矿工们服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These days, it's more of the same. We'll be long dead by the time they stop pulling silver out of these hills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如今，情况大同小异。等他们不再从山上挖银的时候，我们早就死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything in particular you'd like to know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么特别想知道的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you give me a quick rundown on the town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我简要介绍一下这个城镇吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about Chloride again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们再来谈谈克洛赖德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's Aristophontes, he's like the town mayor. His deputy would be Aetius. There's also the traders. The most important are probably Calvin and Julius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有阿里斯托芬提斯，他就像镇长，他的副手是埃提乌斯。还有商人，最重要的可能是加尔文和尤利乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sad to say, but me and Ed Charles aren't major players in much of anything. We're just the old farts who have been here the longest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾地说，我和埃德·查尔斯在很多事情上都不是主要角色。我们只是在这里待得最久的老混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the major players in town I need to know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要了解的镇上的主要人物是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It does now. We're the seat of the regional administrator, and he's always got traders buzzing around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是这样。我们是地区行政长官的所在地，他总是让商人在这里忙碌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are even busier now that he's in the market for an assistant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在更忙了，因为他在找助理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, there's that big open mine south of here. The Pond, they call it. Legion caravans are always coming and going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，南边有个大露天矿场，他们管它叫池塘。军团的商队总是来来往往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, to tell you the truth, I think a lot of these traders are only here because they can't get north anymore, with the Chainway collapsed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，说实话，我认为很多商人来这里只是因为他们无法再往北走了，因为连环道坍塌了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does Chloride see a lot of traffic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德的人流量很大吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, just about everywhere. You'd have a harder time avoiding them than finding them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，几乎到处都是。避开他们比找到他们难多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of them are in Cyanide Springs, that little market at the east end of town. Otherwise, there's Ed Charles in the general store.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们大多数都在山奈泉，那个小镇东端的小市场。除此之外，还有埃德·查尔斯在杂货店。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I find a trader?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以找到商人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right here, of course. We've still got a couple vacancies, but God knows how long they'll last. More traders show up everyday, it seems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然就在这里。我们还有几个空房，但天知道能撑多久，似乎每天都有更多的商人出现。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where can I rent a room?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以租到房间？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there's the war with the NCR, but that's all happening on the other side of the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，虽然有和NCR的战争，但那都发生在河的另一边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's second-in-command is supposed to arrive soon. The Legato Larian, I believe. Or Lacerus, something like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的二把手应该很快就到了。我想是 The Legato Larian，或者Lacerus之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything interesting going on in the rest of Arizona?
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚利桑那其他地方有什么有趣的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sí, ese sería. Thank you. They say Latin's a lot like Spanish, but I hear the Legionaries speak and it sounds like gibberish to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的。谢谢你！他们说拉丁语很像西班牙语，但我听到军团的人说话，我听起来像胡言乱语。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯特使？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like a good idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来是个好主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legato Larian Lacerus - I'll keep an eye out for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: Legato Larian Lacerus，我会留意他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That makes sense, I guess. Agua is a lot like aqua. You know, there's one word that always tickles me, I just think it's so funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这有道理。Agua和aqua很像。你知道，有一个词总是让我觉得很好笑，我只是觉得它很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Love. It's 'amor' in both languages. Just goes to show that love is universal. Except in our language, I guess, because we just call it love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 爱，它在两种语言里都是“amor”。这正好说明了爱是相通的。我猜，在我们的语言里除外吧，因为我们就管它叫爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spanish descends from Latin. That's where the similarities come from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 西班牙语源自拉丁语，这就是相似性的来源。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That true? Aren't you just the smartest cookie? You learn something new everyday!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你不就是最聪明的小甜饼吗？你每天都能学到新东西！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have the word amorous. It has to do with love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们有“多情”这个词，这与爱有关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh well. It is what it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢好吧，就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I don't get it either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我也不明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Fancy that. You're full of surprises.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？真想不到。你真是充满了惊喜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The Legion's language actually makes perfect sense to me. I'm fluent.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>军团的语言对我意义非凡，我说得很流利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hundreds of years ago, miners found silver chloride here. Heat it up, and it turns to pure silver. That silver chloride is where the name comes from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几百年前，矿工在这里发现了氯化银。加热后，它就变成了纯银，氯化银就是这个名字的来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't all sunshine and rainbows, though. The miners got into a scrap with the locals. People got killed. The army came.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也不全是阳光和彩虹。矿工们与当地人发生了争执，有人被杀了，军队来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, the two sides signed a treaty and miners had free reign to get to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，双方签署了一项条约，矿工们可以自由地工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ask me, it just goes to show that things haven't changed much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你问我，这只能说明情况并没有太大变化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why is this place called Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么这个地方叫克洛赖德？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My family's lived here forever. At one point, a great great great great grandmother of mine ran the town's Historical Society.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的家人一直住在这里。有段时间，我的一位曾曾曾曾祖母管理着镇上的历史协会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not to say everyone stayed here. It's a small town. Some of 'em got bored and left. I can't blame them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并不是说所有人都留在了这里。这是个小镇，有些人觉得无聊就离开了，这不能怪他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know one of them hit it big in Vegas, before the war. Another got arrested in Kingman - I'd rather not talk about him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道其中一个在战前在维加斯发了大财。另一个在金曼被捕了，我不想谈论他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A great uncle of mine actually started a raider band around here. I heard he got killed by the Legion, or maybe it was Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一个叔祖父在这附近成立了一个掠夺者团伙。我听说他被军团杀了，也可能是游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I'm sure this is all strange to you. It's just our tradition. My pa kept a book that tracked our family history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我知道这对你来说很陌生。这只是我们的传统，我爸爸有一本记录我们家族历史的书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know so much about this town's history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道这么多这个小镇的历史？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well there you go!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就对了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm grateful for it, though. Knowing my heritage makes me feel like I belong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是很感激。了解自己的血统让我有归属感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whenever times get tough, I just think about how my family got here, and what they fought to overcome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每当遇到困难的时候，我就会想到我的家人是如何来到这里的，以及他们是如何为了克服困难而奋斗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Maybe it's 'old world blues', but someone's always gonna be playing the blues. Better to play it for something that mattered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许这是“旧世蓝调”，但总会有人演奏蓝调。最好是为了重要的事情演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My family did something similar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的家人也做过类似的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可不是吗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm grateful for it, though. Knowing my heritage makes me feel like I belong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是很感激。了解自己的血统让我有归属感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 每当遇到困难的时候，我就会想到我的家人是如何来到这里的，以及他们是如何为了克服困难而奋斗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许这是“旧世蓝调”，但总会有人演奏蓝调。最好是为了重要的事情演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's hardcore. My family never did anything like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是核心。我的家人从没做过这样的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这个消息我很难过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是很感激。了解自己的血统让我有归属感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 每当遇到困难的时候，我就会想到我的家人是如何来到这里的，以及他们是如何为了克服困难而奋斗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
