ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许这是“旧世蓝调”，但总会有人演奏蓝调。最好是为了重要的事情演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I barely remember my family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我几乎不记得我的家人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听到这个消息我很难过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管如此，我还是很感激。了解自己的血统让我有归属感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。也许这是“旧世蓝调”，但总会有人演奏蓝调。最好是为了重要的事情演奏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about my family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想谈论我的家庭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, I'm sorry sweetie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，对不起，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you and your happy family.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的还有你那幸福家庭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, that's not really what I'm in the business of. You understand. There are plenty of traders around, if you want to barter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，这不是我的工作，你懂的。如果你想交易，周围有很多商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you sell anything here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这儿卖东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course! That'll be 20 denarii, and you can keep it as long as you like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然！一共20第纳尔，你想租多久就租多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to rent a room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想租一个房间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 20 denarii, sweetpea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 20第纳尔，小甜豆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much did you say a room was?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说一间房要多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'm sorry to hear that. I'm sure there's someone offering work around here, if you need it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，听到这个消息我很难过。如果你需要的话，这附近肯定有人愿意提供工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that sort of money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有那么多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you! And here's your key. Enjoy your stay!
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！给你钥匙。住得愉快！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's 20 denarii for a room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是20第纳尔的房费。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alrighty then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't pick sides. As long as things don't change too much around here, I'm happy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我不选边站。只要这里不发生太大的变化，我就很高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which side do you favor in the town election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在镇选举中你支持哪一方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing, honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以，亲爱的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Miss Wen [06020BB8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, all the traders. You're not from here. Immigrants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，所有的商人。你不是本地人，移民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Immigrant? What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 移民？你在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just an old man. A boring one. I run the general store. All there is to say. If you want to buy something - do that. If not, don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是个老人，一个无聊的人。我经营一家杂货店，这就是我要说的。如果你想买东西，那就买，如果不想，就不买。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么卖的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask Miss Wen if you want a history lesson. I was taught to say nothing when I've got nothing nice to say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想上历史课，问温小姐。别人教我，无话可说的时候就不要说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说克洛赖德吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love Chloride. Don't love the strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爱克洛赖德，不爱陌生人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bunch of scamming charlatans. And those hoodlums in the red shirts, always shouting and playing crap on the radio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一群坑蒙拐骗的江湖骗子。还有那些穿着红衬衫的流氓，老是大喊大叫，还在收音机里放那些垃圾玩意儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want things to be quiet again. I miss hearing the wind blow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望一切归于平静，我想念风吹的声音。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you don't like Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你不喜欢克洛赖德？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not really. I'm a homebody. I was writing a book, maybe five years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算不上吧。我是一个宅男，我在写一本书，大概五年前吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You must've seen a lot in your time. Any interesting stories?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这辈子肯定见过很多事。有没有什么有趣的故事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I thought very seriously about killing myself. Stopped caring about the book after that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我非常认真地想过自杀。从那以后，我就不再关心这本书了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the book?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那本书怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't recall. I guess I was just bored. I don't really like talking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不记得了，我想我只是无聊了。我不太喜欢谈论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you want to kill yourself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要自杀？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was about an iguana named Tijuana.
ESP.TRADUIT: 讲的是一只叫蒂华纳的鬣蜥。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was the book about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这本书是关于什么的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you brought it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，是你提出来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should've done it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该这么做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry to hear that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很遗憾听到这个消息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know how you feel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你的感受。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ed Charles [06020BBA] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to talk about this anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想再谈这个了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Is that supposed to mean something to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这对我来说意味着什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm &PCName;. This here is the Frumentarius Spirit Chaser.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是&PCName;，这是军团特务逐灵者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Is that supposed to mean something to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这对我来说意味着什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm Zachariah Farris. This here is the Frumentarius Ithica Troy.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我是撒迦利亚·法里斯。这是军团特务伊斯卡·特洛伊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Is that supposed to mean something to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。这对我来说意味着什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm Belinda Farris. This here is the Frumentarius Ithica Troy.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我是贝琳达·法里斯。这是军团特务伊斯卡·特洛伊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that your attempt at humor? Fucking cur. Answer me straightly or I will kill you both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你的幽默吗？混蛋，老实回答我，不然我杀了你们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm Ben Dover and this here is the Frumentarius Biggus Dickus.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我是本·多佛，这位是军团特务比格斯·迪库斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that your attempt at humor? Fucking cur. Answer me straightly or I will kill you both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是你的幽默吗？混蛋，老实回答我，不然我杀了你们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm Alotta Fagina and this here is the Frumentarius Biggus Dickus.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我是阿洛塔·法吉娜，这位是军团特务比格斯·迪库斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think long and hard about whether you want to die today. I'll ask you again - name and business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 仔细思考你是否想在今天死去。我再问你一遍，姓名和目的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't need to know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不需要知道这些。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it? I hear nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？我什么也没看到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see my Mark of Caesar? It speaks for itself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到我的凯撒徽记了吗？这不言自明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] What use could this medicine possibly have to the Kingman Frumentarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]这药对金曼军团特务有什么用？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> We're here on orders from the Kingman Frumentarii. This medicine is being requisitioned.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我们是奉金曼军团特务之命而来。这种药正在被征用。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Lanius is in the Mesa Verde, returning from Colorado. You could not be his messengers.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]拉尼厄斯在梅萨维德，从科罗拉多回来。你们不可能是他的使者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> We're here to pick up some itch cream for Lanius. Hand it over. You don't want to keep the big guy waiting.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我们是来给拉尼厄斯拿点止痒膏的。快交出来，你可不想让大人物久等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Very well. Take the medicine and begone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。好吧，拿着药走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> As I understand it, someone very important is sick, and it's imperative that it be kept under wraps.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>据我所知，一位非常重要的人物生病了，这件事必须保密。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wife? Caesar has no wife. There is no woman who can match him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妻子？凯撒没有妻子。没有女人能配得上他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Caesar's wife is in Kingman and she's fallen ill. We're to deliver the medicine to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>凯撒的妻子在金曼，她病了。我们要给她送药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Typical. Very well. Take the medicine and begone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很经典。好吧，拿着药走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I wasn't told. I was only told to get the medicine and bring it back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，没人告诉我。我只被告知去取药并带回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A Frumentarius succumbing to fever? Pathetic. He does not look sick to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]一位军团特务发烧了？可怜。我看他不像生病了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Frumentarius friend here is sick. He needs that medicine badly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这位军团特务朋友病了，他非常需要那种药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Disgusting. I don't care about your defecation.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]真恶心。我不关心你的排便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have really bad diarrhea and that medicine is the only thing that can cure it. Please help!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的腹泻很严重，只有这种药能治。请帮帮我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: A friend of mine contracted a parasite in Colorado. A terrible way to die. Fine. Take the medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的一个朋友在科罗拉多感染了寄生虫，一种可怕的死法。好吧，把药拿走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's quite sick. It's some sort of parasite. The medicine should clear it up, then he'll be back to normal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他病得很重，是某种寄生虫。这药应该能治好，然后他就会恢复正常。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On what authority?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凭什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck this. We're demanding the medicine. Hand it over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的。我们要的是药，把它交出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well-versed in Legion organizational structure, are you? Fine. Take the medicine. If someone asks who stole the cargo, I will give your names.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团的组织结构很熟悉吧？好吧，把药拿走。如果有人问是谁偷了货物，我会报上你们的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion rep] You're Speculatores, right? You report to the highest authority in the area. That would be us.
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]你们是密探，对吧？你向该地区的最高当局汇报，那就是我们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ha! Maybe. Do you dare to try?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！也许吧。你敢试试吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Might makes right. If you don't hand it over, we'll take it by force.
ESP.TRADUIT: 强权即公理。如果你不交出来，我们就用武力夺取。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Take the medicine. If someone asks who stole the cargo, I will give your names.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，把药拿去。如果有人问是谁偷了货物，我会说出你们的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe I do dare. Do you think you stand a chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我确实敢。你觉得你有胜算吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 别玩了，不然我就把大家都炸成碎片。

ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我受够了。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，好吧，把药拿走。如果有人问是谁偷了货物，我会说出你们的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Cult Rep] The authority of Caesar, and of Mars. My Mark is the blessing of the divine son of war.
ESP.TRADUIT: [教团声望]凯撒的权威，玛尔斯的权威。我的徽记，是战神之子的祝福。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you're telling me this why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要告诉我这些？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a Legion caravan that's going to be coming through here. I need something from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个军团的商队要经过这里，我需要一些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that Legion caravan...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于军团商队...

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a bold and interesting question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多么大胆而有趣的问题啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the Mark of Caesar. You've made yourself useful to the Legion. I trust you as much as I would trust any man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有凯撒的徽记，你为军团做了贡献。我相信你，就像我相信任何人一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? What did you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar entrusted me with his Mark. Do *you* trust me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒把他的徽记托付给我。*你*相信我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a bold and interesting question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多么大胆而有趣的问题啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the Mark of Caesar, but you've been consistently destructive to our efforts here. I cannot trust you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有凯撒的徽记，但你一直在破坏我们的努力。我不能相信你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 多么大胆而有趣的问题啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the Mark of Caesar, but you've been otherwise unhelpful to the Legion. I don't think I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你身上有凯撒的徽记，但除此之外你对军团毫无帮助。我想我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? What did you need?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？你需要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar entrusted me with his Mark. Do *you* trust me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒把他的徽记托付给我。*你*相信我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand. Just this one shipment, yes? Nothing more, nothing less?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。就这批货，对吗？不多不少？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. We shall rob the caravan together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们一起抢劫大篷车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone is very sick in Chloride. I need the medicine on that caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人在克洛赖德病得很重，我需要车上的药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating. You're full of surprises. And you thought it would be a good idea to tell me about this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有意思，你真是充满了惊喜。你觉得把这事告诉我是个好主意吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone is very sick in Chloride. I need the medicine on that caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人在克洛赖德病得很重，我需要车上的药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEDED] I understand. Just this one shipment, yes? Nothing more, nothing less?

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. We shall rob the caravan together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们一起抢劫大篷车。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm being as transparent as I can. I would be stupid to try and deceive a Frumentarius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经尽我所能做到透明了。我要是想欺骗一个军团特务就太傻了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Sorry, but I'm going to have to decline.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]抱歉，但我不得不拒绝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please help me get the medicine? Pretty please?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能帮我搞到药吗？拜托了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an amusing scheme. I'd like to see where it leads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个有趣的计划，我想看看结果会怎样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, you're more likely to survive if you have a Frumentarius backing you up. We'll spin it as official business for Drausus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，如果有一个军团特务的支持，你更有可能生存下来。我们会把它伪装成对德鲁苏斯的公务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Just like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？就这样吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chloride is in a precarious situation. If someone is sick, I would like to avoid that sickness becoming a much bigger issue down the line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德处于危险状态。如果有人生病了，我希望避免这种疾病成为一个更大的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a Frumentarius, these are the problems I have to solve. No one else will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个军团特务，这些都是我必须解决的问题。没有人会这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't be doing this if it was only amusing. What's your real motivation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果只是为了好玩，你不会这么做的。你真正的动机是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How else did you expect to get the supplies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不然你想怎么弄到物资？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, hold on. Robbery? I don't want to rob anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，等等。抢劫？我不想抢劫任何人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Audentes fortuna iuvat. Things do not operate on an 'asking nicely' basis.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命运眷顾勇者。事情不是在“友好请求”的基础上进行的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that the only option? Can't you just ask nicely?
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有这个办法了吗？你就不能好好问一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have the Mark of Caesar. I'm a Frumentarius. From a certain perspective, we outrank them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有凯撒的徽记，我是军团特务。从某种角度来看，我们的地位高于他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They won't be pleased about that, though. Which is why I suggest we dispense with the niceties.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，他们不会对此感到高兴。所以我建议我们省去细节。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about my reputation? And yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我的名声呢？你的呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish. You take the lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。你带头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we can try asking nicely first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们可以先好好问一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish. You take the lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。你带头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's skip asking nicely and just take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咱们别客气了，直接动手拿吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做好准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Let's do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，就这么办吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I need to think on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我需要考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chloride is in a precarious situation. If someone is sick, I would like to avoid that sickness becoming a much bigger issue down the line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德处于危险状态。如果有人生病了，我希望避免这种疾病成为一个更大的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a Frumentarius, these are the problems I have to solve. No one else will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个军团特务，这些都是我必须解决的问题。没有人会这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You wouldn't be doing this if it was only amusing. What's your real motivation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果只是为了好玩，你不会这么做的。你真正的动机是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很怀疑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The Maiden at the gas station north of here wanted to speak to you. You should go talk to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>北边加油站的女侍想跟你谈谈，你应该去和她谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay? Speak up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吗？说出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need something from the Legion caravan that's going to be coming through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要从从这里经过的军团商队那里搞到一些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you mean to steal it? From Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说要偷？偷凯撒？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone is very sick in Chloride. I need the medicine on that caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人在克洛赖德病得很重，我需要车上的药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard nothing of this. And besides, I don't care much for Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听说过这件事。再说了，我不太喜欢克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fate of a town is on the line. People could die if I don't get that medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一座城镇的命运岌岌可危。如果我拿不到药，人们会死的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The idea is appealing. Still, I think I have to pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个想法很有吸引力。不过，我还是不去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd finally get to show Spirit Chaser that you're capable of running your own operations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你终于可以向逐灵者证明你有能力独当一面了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think of a different idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想一个不同的主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I need to think on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我需要考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEDED] Truly? Fine. I'll tell Spirit Chaser, and we'll be off. Behave yourself in the meantime.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]真的吗？好吧。我会告诉逐灵者，然后我们就出发。与此同时，你要规矩一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The Maiden at the gas station north of here wanted to speak to you. You should go talk to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>北边加油站的女侍想跟你谈谈，你应该去和她谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] What? That's not funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]什么？这并不好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Bellius [0601CB93] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have something to do in this area. Please leave. I get shy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这一带有事要做。请离开，我害羞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] A sharp tongue on you. All good points. Fine. I'll report it as some sort of terrible accident. A tragedy, no doubt.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你也太能说了，说得很对。好吧，我会把它报告为一场可怕的事故。毫无疑问，这是一场悲剧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were a willing accomplice, and you failed to apprehend me after the fact. You'd look foolish, or malicious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是自愿的同谋，但事后却没能逮捕我。你会看起来很愚蠢，或者很恶毒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I am a soldier. I must do my duty. Though I can't exactly reveal my role in this here either.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我是一名士兵，我必须履行我的职责。虽然我也不能在这里透露我在其中扮演的角色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A terrible misunderstanding. Those soldiers didn't see your Mark. You killed them. Perhaps it was self defense, perhaps not. We will see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个可怕的误解。那些士兵没有看到你的徽记，你杀了他们。也许是自卫，也许不是，我们拭目以待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Seriously? You're gonna snitch on me? I thought we had something. I thought you were different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？真的？你要告发我？我以为我们之间有点什么，我还以为你与众不同呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A terrible misunderstanding. Those soldiers didn't see your Mark. You killed them. Perhaps it was self defense, perhaps not. We will see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个可怕的误解。那些士兵没有看到你的徽记，你杀了他们。也许是自卫，也许不是，我们拭目以待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do what you have to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做你该做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noble, aren't you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真高尚，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A terrible misunderstanding. Those soldiers didn't see your Mark. You killed them. Perhaps it was self-defense, perhaps not. We will see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个可怕的误解。那些士兵没有看到你的徽记，你杀了他们。也许是自卫，也许不是，我们拭目以待。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Spirit Chaser [0601CB94] (mod) Quest : ([0601CB95]AZFreeformSMARTArray) 0601CB95 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I accept responsibility. File the report.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我承担责任，提交报告。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <The Brahmin snuffles.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <婆罗门牛吸了吸鼻子>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Brahmin [0601F5FF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Take the medicine from the Brahmin's pack.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <从婆罗门牛的包里拿药>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I guess I just keep doing what I've been doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。我想我只能继续做我一直在做的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's next for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你接下来要做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Thank you. I'll find a way to repay you someday, I promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，谢谢你。总有一天我会想办法报答你的，我保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's all, I'll be going. Best of luck to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没别的事，我要走了。祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to talk about Rima.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得谈谈瑞玛的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes. Her. Do you have a complaint? Isaiah would be the man to handle that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对，她。你有什么不满吗？以赛亚会是解决这个问题的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima. The prostitute in Cyanide Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛，山奈泉的妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes. Her. Do you have a complaint? Isaiah would be the man to handle that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对，她。你有什么不满吗？以赛亚会是解决这个问题的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isaiah's whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以赛亚的妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can't expect me to remember every individual who visits town. I'm a busy man. So, refresh my memory and I would be glad to discuss this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不能指望我记得每一个来镇上的人，我是个大忙人。所以，让我回忆一下，我很乐意和你讨论这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seriously don't know who I'm talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的不知道我在说谁吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, that would be wise. Speak to Isaiah. He knows best about the day-to-day visitors of the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这样做很明智。跟以赛亚谈谈，他最了解这个城镇每天的访客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I don't think you're the best person to handle this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我觉得你不是处理这件事的最佳人选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. That's worrying. Something like that could cause quite the panic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，这令人担忧。这种事可能会引起很大的恐慌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Though, it seems nobody has noticed. Isaiah himself certainly didn't bring this to my attention, and he would know Rima's body better than anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，似乎没有人注意到。当然，以赛亚本人并没有让我注意到这一点，而且他比任何人都更了解瑞玛的身体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, wastelander. I'll ruminate on this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，废土客。我会仔细考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is sick. It's probably syphilis. She may have spread it to others.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛病了，可能是梅毒，她可能已经传染给其他人了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps. I'm not sure. Sometimes it's best to do nothing at all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。我不确定，有时候什么都不做是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, I'm glad you brought this to my attention. Here, a reward for your trouble. I trust you'll tell no one else of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我还是很高兴你让我注意到这一点。给，这是对你麻烦的酬谢。我相信你不会把这件事告诉别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's all, I bid you farewell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有别的事，我就向你告别了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Proconsul Aristophontes [0600E4F2] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you going to do something about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你打算做点什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's to say what's out there? Mars' teachings make sense to me. As to whether I believe in Him? Don't really know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁知道外面有什么？玛尔斯的教诲对我来说很有意义。至于我信不信他？真的不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars be with me? Is that just a saying or do you actually believe in Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯与我同在？这只是一种说法，还是你真的相信玛尔斯的存在？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck. That's not good. Julius will be pissed. Shit, every man who touched her will be pissed. That dirty fucking slag.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，这可不妙，尤利乌斯会生气的。该死，每个碰过她的男人都会生气的，那个肮脏的婊子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is sick. It seems like something bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛病了，这似乎是不好的事情。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you insinuating? You think I did that? It was probably some hick trader, coming from God knows where.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在暗示什么？你觉得是我？可能是某个乡巴佬商人，天知道从哪里来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She got sick from somewhere. Do you know who gave it to her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不知从哪里得的病，你知道是谁传给她的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No outbreak here. Not happening. One whore with a toxic snatch isn't justification to grind the whole economy to a halt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有爆发，也不会。不能因为一个得了脏病的婊子，就让整个经济都停摆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A doctor should be called before this becomes an outbreak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在疫情爆发之前应该去找医生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. Maybe not. I feel perfectly fine. If I get sick, I'll just fight it off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧，也许没有。我感觉非常好，如果我生病了，我也会努力抵抗的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you could be sick now too. Aren't you worried?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你现在也可能生病了。你不担心吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll take care of her. Don't worry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会照顾她的，别担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to do about Rima?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算拿瑞玛怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, of course. Thanks for the heads up. I appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，当然。谢谢你的提醒，我很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's all, I'll be going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没别的事，我要走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything a pure heart could desire. Guns, ammo, slaves. All yours for the taking, provided you've got the coin for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一颗纯洁的心所渴望的一切。枪、弹药、奴隶，只要你有足够的钱，一切都是你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might stick around for the election coming up, too. If that interests you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也可以留下来等待即将到来的选举。如果你感兴趣的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do in town?
ESP.TRADUIT: 城里有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'd be Calvin and Luke. They're running for the position of Aristophontes' assistant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是加尔文和卢克，他们在竞选阿里斯托芬提斯的助理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mentioned an election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到了选举？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a trade town, not Gomorrah. Vice is still vice, sin is still sin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个贸易城镇，不是蛾摩拉。恶还是恶，罪还是罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What if I want chems? Can I buy those?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我想要化学药物呢？我能买吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're the town peacekeepers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们是镇里的维和人员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion didn't feel it was necessary to leave soldiers down in these parts, but someone had to keep the law. That's our job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团觉得没有必要把士兵留在这些地方，但必须有人维护法律。这是我们的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the deputies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说那些代理人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not quite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不完全是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're all working here through a contract Julius has with the Legion. With Aristophontes, specifically. That's the proconsul of this region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都是根据尤利乌斯和军团的合同来工作的。特别是阿里斯托芬提斯，那是这个地区的总督。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our sheriff would probably be more like Aetius. He's the local centurion. Very hands-off. He trusts our judgment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的治安官可能更像是埃提乌斯，他是当地的百夫长。非常不干涉，他相信我们的判断。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do the deputies report to a sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 代理人要向治安官汇报吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, no. Only traders can vote. Their votes are allocated based on the size of their operation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，不行，只有商人才能投票。他们的选票是根据他们的经营规模分配的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So a man like Julius, with fingers in many pies, gets a lot more votes than the energy weapons woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，像尤利乌斯这样一个涉足多方的人，得到的选票可比那个能量武器的女人多得多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以投票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a lawman, nothing more. I used to be a raider. Most of us deputies were.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是个执法者，仅此而已。我曾经是一名掠夺者，我们大多数代理人都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fate has a funny way of working. Spent most of my life on one side of the law, now I'm on the other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 命运总是以一种有趣的方式运作。我大半辈子都站在法律的另一边，现在我站在这边了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a wife down in Kingman. Pregnant. Praying to Mars for a second boy. Knock on wood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个妻子在金曼。怀孕了，向玛尔斯祈祷再来一个男孩，老天保佑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself, Isaiah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说说你自己吧，以赛亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You met her? She's a nice piece, isn't she?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你见过她？她很漂亮，不是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with Rima?
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry yourself with that, darling. It's man stuff. You wouldn't understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别担心这个，亲爱的。这是男人的事，你不会明白的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with Rima?
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Men have certain urges that need to be satisfied. A woman ought to be there to satisfy those urges, don't you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 男人有某些需要被满足的欲望。女人应该在那里满足那些欲望，你不觉得吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there were no Rima... Well, men outnumber the women in this town by a lot. I certainly wouldn't want fools making passes at you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有瑞玛...这个镇上男人比女人多很多。我当然不希望傻瓜向你调情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just curious, is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是好奇而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not. You think we're degenerates? You want some whore, find your way to Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不，你觉得我们堕落了？你想要妓女，那就去维加斯吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is property. People pay me for her time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛是财产，人们为她的时间付钱给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're pimping her out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要帮她拉皮条？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Zero. As in, I will not allow you to use her services. Not with that Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 零。意思是，我不会允许你使用她的服务。只要你还带着那个凯撒的徽记就不行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think it's a good idea to let you touch her. Your legal status is unclear to me. Wouldn't want to open myself up to trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得让你碰她不是个好主意，我不清楚你的法律地位。我不想让自己惹上麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much to rent Rima's services?
ESP.TRADUIT: 租用瑞玛的服务要多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not doing anything to her. If not this, she'd be breaking rocks somewhere, or weaving shawls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有对她做任何事。如果不是这样，她可能会在什么地方敲石头，或者编织披肩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Putting aside the natural, fundamental laws of the wasteland, the fact of the matter is that this benefits everyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抛开废土的自然、基本法则不谈，事实是这对每个人都有利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't you feel bad for what you're doing to her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不为你对她做的事感到内疚吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima? Come on, it's just sex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛？拜托，只是打炮而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This benefits everyone except Rima, you mean.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的意思是，除了瑞玛，所有人都能从中受益。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What could the Cult possibly want from a low-down slave nobody?
ESP.TRADUIT: 教团想从一个卑微的无名奴隶身上得到什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's Cult of Mars business now. Priestess Calventia demands Rima's presence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在是玛尔斯教团的事了，女祭司卡文提亚要求瑞玛到场。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe you don't understand how things work here. There is no 'her and you'. Rima is property. I don't like you using someone else's property behind their back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你不明白这里的规矩，没有所谓的“她和你”。瑞玛是财产，我不喜欢你背着别人用别人的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What I say to Rima is between her and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对瑞玛说的话是我和她之间的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡扯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is sick. You're probably sick too, as is everyone who touched her. Happy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛病了，你可能也病了，所有碰过她的人都一样。开心吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What could the Cult possibly want from a low-down slave nobody?
ESP.TRADUIT: 教团想从一个卑微的无名奴隶身上得到什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It doesn't matter now, because the Cult of Mars wants to see her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在无所谓了，因为玛尔斯教团想见她。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. Alright fine. I'll do something. Thanks for letting me know, partner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，好了好了，我会想办法的。谢谢你告诉我，搭档。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's true. She's sick. You should do something about it. She's your responsibility.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是真的，她生病了。你应该做点什么，你得对她负责。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not letting Rima go. You know what deputies get paid? Jack shit. A couple denarii a week. The income Rima brings me is my family's future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让瑞玛走的，你知道代理人拿多少钱吗？狗屎，一周几个第纳尔。瑞玛给我带来的收入是我们家的未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. You'd have to ask Calventia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，你得去问卡文提亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not letting Rima go. You know what deputies get paid? Jack shit. A couple denarii a week. The income Rima brings me is my family's future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让瑞玛走的，你知道代理人拿多少钱吗？狗屎，一周几个第纳尔。瑞玛给我带来的收入是我们家的未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't need to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不需要知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Laughs.> That's a good one. What's next? Make a deathclaw into a midwife?
ESP.TRADUIT: <大笑>这是个好主意。下一步是什么？把死亡爪变成接生婆？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not letting Rima go. You know what deputies get paid? Jack shit. A couple denarii a week. The income Rima brings me is my family's future.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会让瑞玛走的，你知道代理人拿多少钱吗？狗屎，一周几个第纳尔。瑞玛给我带来的收入是我们家的未来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think Rima is being made into a Maiden.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得瑞玛要变成女侍了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you compensate me for the loss, Rima is staying right here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你赔偿我的损失，否则瑞玛就待在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually...
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's getting old anyway. Might be good to get something new, keep the men happy. Can't deny she's become a downright hassle, partly by your doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正她也老了，搞点新东西也好，让男人开心。不可否认，她已经成为一个彻头彻尾的麻烦，部分原因是你的所作所为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this - an eye for an eye. I need a favor, and you're best positioned get it done. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个怎么样，以眼还眼。我需要你帮我个忙，而你是最好的人选。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you really going to defy the Cult of Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要反抗玛尔斯教团吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You need a second source of income? Have your wife come here and take Rima's place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要第二个收入来源？让你的妻子过来代替瑞玛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you compensate me for the loss, Rima is staying right here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你赔偿我的损失，否则瑞玛就待在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually...
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's getting old anyway. Might be good to get something new, keep the men happy. Can't deny she's become a downright hassle, partly by your doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正她也老了，搞点新东西也好，让男人开心。不可否认，她已经成为一个彻头彻尾的麻烦，部分原因是你的所作所为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about this - an eye for an eye. I need a favor, and you're best positioned get it done. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个怎么样，以眼还眼。我需要你帮我个忙，而你是最好的人选。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not leaving without Rima.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有瑞玛我不会走的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on a moment. Maybe there's something you could do for me. Get it done, and Rima's yours. What do you say?
ESP.TRADUIT: 稍等一下。也许你能帮我个忙，搞定，瑞玛就归你了。你说呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck this. I don't care. Keep her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去他妈的。我也不在乎，留着她吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need a loose end tied up. A gangster in Vegas. I want him dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要解决一个问题。维加斯的一个黑帮，我希望他死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this favor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么忙？

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is Chick Hadley. I used to know the man. We were in the same gang for a little while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他叫奇克·哈德利。我以前认识他，有段时间我们是一伙的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He screwed me out of some money I was due for a job in Havasu. Even after all these years, I can't abide by it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他在哈瓦苏的一份工作上坑了我一笔钱。即使过了这么多年，我还是咽不下这口气。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes me sick to know men like that are walking around free.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到那样的人还逍遥法外真让我恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the gangster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说那个黑帮的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed. Called the Rivieras.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确如此，叫做里维埃拉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Julius saw the writing on the wall with the Legion's approach. Switched us from robberies to property management.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利乌斯看到了军团逼近的预兆，把我们从抢劫转到物业管理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seemed to work out pretty well, given that we're still here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到我们还在这里，结果似乎还不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were in a gang together?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们是一伙的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For slaves, yes, but land too. The Pond is registered to Julius by name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对奴隶来说，是的，但也包括土地。池塘登记在尤利乌斯名下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Property management? That a euphemism for something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 物业管理？这是什么东西的委婉说法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the Strip. Anybody dying on the Strip is a big deal. I'll hear about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是长街，任何人死在长街上都是大事。我会听到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How will you know that I've killed Chick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么知道是我杀了奇克？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Try and get that money he owes me. If you can't, just kill the bastard. World would be a little better for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好，把他欠我的钱弄回来。不行的话，就杀了那个混蛋。世界会因此变得更好一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you come back, Rima is yours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等你回来，瑞玛就是你的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll take care of Chick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会解决奇克的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then fuck off. Rima's mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就滚吧。瑞玛是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Isaiah Warren [0600D846] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I might. What do you want with him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能吧。你找他有什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know a guest here by the name Chick Hadley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认识一位叫奇克·哈德利的客人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so. Are you sure you don't want something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想可以。真的不要点别的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we talk about Chick Hadley again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能再谈谈奇克·哈德利吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a great guy. Very selfless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个很棒的人，非常无私。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I know of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知没有。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does he have any vices? Secrets? Anything juicy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他有什么恶习吗？秘密？有什么有趣的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, honey, I don't think he swings that way. Can't fault you for trying, though. The heart wants what it wants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，宝贝儿，我可不觉得他好那口。不过呢，你尝试一下也怪不了你，毕竟，感情这种事是管不住的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has a pretty rigid schedule. He gambles until afternoon, then gets drunk at the bar late into the night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的日程安排得很紧。他赌博到下午，然后在酒吧喝得酩酊大醉直到深夜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, he has to puke it up in the bathrooms, but you'd have to get him really shitfaced for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时，他不得不吐在浴室里，但你得把他弄得烂醉如泥才行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, he sleeps in one of the tents with one of the girls - usually me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，他和一个女孩睡在一个帐篷里...通常是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where might I catch him alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以单独找到他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has a pretty rigid schedule. He gambles until afternoon, then gets drunk at the bar late into the night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的日程安排得很紧。他赌博到下午，然后在酒吧喝得酩酊大醉直到深夜。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes, he has to puke it up in the bathrooms, but you'd have to get him really shitfaced for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时，他不得不吐在浴室里，但你得把他弄得烂醉如泥才行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, he sleeps in one of the tents with one of the girls - usually me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，他和一个女孩睡在一个帐篷里...通常是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where might I catch him alone?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里可以单独找到他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pattern? Hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 规律？唔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If a girl comes up to him wearing those tight little leather clothes and pays him a few compliments, he can't turn her down. That a pattern?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果一个女孩穿着紧身的小皮衣走到他面前，对他说几句恭维话，他就无法拒绝。这是一种规律吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those girls he spends the night with - is there any pattern with them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和他一起过夜的那些女孩，有什么规律吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not usually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there was this one time. He confessed to me that he had gotten his hands on some Psycho. Wanted to try it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有一次。他向我坦白说他染指了某个精神病患者，想尝试一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That night, he got into such a bad fight, I really thought somebody was going to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那天晚上，他打得很凶，我真的以为有人要死了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does he ever get belligerent while drinking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他喝酒的时候会打架吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Sorry, I must have misheard you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？对不起，我一定是听错了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to kill him for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你帮我杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would I do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要那么做？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You didn't mishear me. I need you to kill him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有听错。我要你杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: East? Like those slavers the soldiers are always talking about? I had no idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 东边？就像士兵们常说的那些奴隶贩子一样？我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Okay. You're right. If Chick is hurting innocent girls, we have to stop him.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好吧，你说得对。如果奇克在伤害无辜的女孩，我们必须阻止他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll try and work up the nerve to do something. Come see me in two days or so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会试着鼓起勇气做点什么。过两天再来找我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chick is a bad man. His friend out east is enslaving girls for money. If Chick dies, we can stop that friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奇克是个坏人，他在东部的朋友为了钱奴役女孩。如果奇克死了，我们就能阻止那个朋友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I don't really want to talk about this anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我真的不想再谈这个了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. Please? What, are you in love with him or something? He's a nobody!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，拜托？怎么，你爱上他了还是怎么的？他是个无名小卒！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to bribe me into killing Chick? I couldn't. He's not a bad guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想收买我，让我杀了奇克？我做不到，他不是坏人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll make it worth your while.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会让你觉得值得的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I love it. I get to make money and have fun doing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我喜欢。我既能赚钱，又能从中获得乐趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever been with someone while high on Jet? The feeling is unreal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有嗑杰特磕嗨的时候和别人在一起过？这种感觉是不真实的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like your job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢你的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A hundred caps. But I should warn you - I like to lick everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一百瓶盖。但我得提醒你，我什么都喜欢舔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much for a good time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩得开心多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back for more? I was missing you too. A hundred caps and we can go at it all night.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还想继续吗？我也想你了。一百瓶盖，我们就可以干一整夜了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much for a good time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玩得开心多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, sugar. I can't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，甜心。我不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Check your pockets.> A hundred caps, you said? Uh, crap. Could you do it for less?
ESP.TRADUIT: <检查你的口袋>你说一百瓶盖？呃，糟了，你能少要点钱吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had me at hello, baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一打招呼就把我征服了，宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pay 100 caps.> A hundred caps it is. Let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付100瓶盖>是一百瓶盖。我们走吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I did it. Put a pillow on his face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我做到了。把枕头放在他脸上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was early in the morning, and I couldn't bring myself to sleep next to him, so I waited until sunrise and then found an Omerta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是大清早，我无法在他身边入睡，所以我一直等到日出，然后发现了一个黑手党。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guy came and looked at Chick. He looked at me. Then he went and got backup. They rolled Chick up in something and carried him out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那人走过来看了看奇克，他看着我，然后他去找了后援。他们用什么东西把奇克包起来，抬出去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Slow down. Tell me exactly what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 慢点。告诉我到底发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hysterical?! I just fucking killed Chick! I held a pillow over his face and sat next to his body until morning! All because *you* told me to!
ESP.TRADUIT: 歇斯底里？！我刚刚他妈的杀了奇克！我用枕头捂住他的脸，挨着他的身体一直坐到早上！都是因为*你*让我这么做的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Relax, lady. You're just being hysterical.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放轻松，女士。你太歇斯底里了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because one of their guys came for me later, brought me into a room for questioning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他们的一个人后来来找我，把我带到一间屋子问话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could just tell from his face that he was a psycho. Like he was dead behind the eyes. You don't send someone like that for a simple check-in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我光看他的脸就知道他是个疯子，就好像他眼神空洞。你不会派那样的人去执行一个简单的查看任务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you think the Omertas suspect you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么觉得黑手党怀疑你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Thank you. I'll lie low. Well, as low as you can lie in Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？谢谢你。我会保持低调的，在维加斯能躺多低就多低。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give her 200 caps.> Take this and get out of here. Better to be safe than sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: <给她200瓶盖>拿着这个离开这里。安全总比后悔好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I'm sorry. These guys are just... well, you don't ever see the side of them that us workers have to see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我很抱歉。那些家伙只是...唉，你永远也看不到他们我们这些工人的那一面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Minnie [0601F707] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calm down. It's probably fine. There's no reason to suspect you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冷静点，应该没问题。没有理由怀疑你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Move fast and with sure footing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 动作迅速，站稳脚跟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cicero [0601FE11] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take me across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带我过河。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They have never spotted me. That is why I was chosen. My skin is darker than others. I can hide easier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们从来没有发现过我，这就是我被选中的原因。我的肤色比别人深，我可以更容易地隐藏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cicero [0601FE11] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice spot. Right next to the Ranger Station and Forlorn Hope. NCR give you trouble?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不错的地方，就在游骑兵和飘零希望旁边。NCR给你添麻烦了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would it be cruel? I am a natural Cursor. No sun can burn me, and no eyes can spot me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么会残忍呢？我是天生的传令兵。没有阳光能灼伤我，也没有眼睛能发现我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Cicero [0601FE11] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They stuck you with this job because of your skin color? That seems cruel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让你做这份工作就因为你的肤色？这似乎很残忍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a hike, so be prepared.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一次远足，所以要做好准备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [0601FE0F] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take me across the river.
ESP.TRADUIT: 带我过河。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps you can. Long swim, though. I can get you closer, up through the rocks and cliffs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许你可以，不过要游很长时间。我可以让你靠得更近，穿过岩石和悬崖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [0601FE0F] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would I cross the river with you? I can swim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要和你一起过河？我会游泳。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cursor. A navigator.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传令兵，领航员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Virgil [0601FE0F] (mod) Quest : ([0601FE1F]AZRiverTransportDialogueQuest) 0601FE1F (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a Frumentarius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是军团特务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the gals here. We're close. She likes to surprise me, is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的一个女孩，我们很亲近。她只是喜欢给我惊喜而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Minnie?
ESP.TRADUIT: 明妮是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a lovely name. How about we slip away and get to know each other better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个可爱的名字。不如我们溜出去好好了解下彼此？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi, handsome. I'm &PCName;.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，帅哥，我是&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gladly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很乐意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lead the way. <Kill Chick Hadley.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <杀了奇克·哈德利>带路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, honey. Maybe another time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，亲爱的。也许下次吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not? Buy me a vodka and we'll split it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不呢？给我买瓶伏特加，我们分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a drink?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喝一杯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahh excelente! Here, have a sip. Open your mouth, I'll pour it in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，太棒了！来，喝一口。张开嘴，我倒进去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got your vodka.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你拿了伏特加。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's get back to the booze.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们继续畅饮吧。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There you go. Now, I won't lie. I know it's watered-down. But it ain't too bad regardless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 行了。好了，我不骗你，我知道这是掺了水的，但不管怎么说，也还算不赖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, I'll pour another into a glass for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来，我给你再倒一杯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Open your mouth.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <张开你的嘴>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Well, alright. Buzzkill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？嗯，好吧。扫兴鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just pour it into a glass for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帮我把它倒进杯子里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheers!
ESP.TRADUIT: 干杯！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cheers! <Take a shot.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <喝一杯>干杯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hot damn. That's strong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的，这么猛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another round!
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一轮！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think that's probably enough for us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我们俩都够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ugh. Oh, wow. Alright, let's do another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，哦，哇。好，我们再来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, you sure? Alright.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你确定吗？好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's go, keep it up. Another!
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，坚持下去。再来一轮！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think that's probably enough for us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我们俩都够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, that's disgusting. Okay. Another?
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，太恶心了。好吧，再来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so. Oh. Ugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么说的话。喔，呃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck yeah! Don't wuss out now. Down the hatch!
ESP.TRADUIT: 妈耶！现在别怂，一口闷！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think that's probably enough for us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我们俩都够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Retch.> Fuck, I'm getting dizzy. Alright. Let's go. One more.
ESP.TRADUIT: <反胃>操，我都晕了。好吧，我们开始，再来一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're insane, bud. But, fuck, if you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了，兄弟。但是，操，如果你这么说的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a fucking beast! Keep going, man! Another shot!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我他妈是个野兽！加油啊，伙计！再来一杯！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think that's probably enough for us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我们俩都够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I tihnk I'm gonna puke. Fuuuuck. <Burp.> Get me antoher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得我要吐了，操~<打嗝>再来一杯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ough. Oh my god. I think I'm gonna be sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够了，我的天啊，我觉得我要吐了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm more alhacol than human, mohterfucker! Just! Keep! Dirnking!
ESP.TRADUIT: 比起人类，我更像酒精，混蛋！就这样！坚持住！再喝！

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I think that's probably enough for us both.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我觉得我们俩都够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uhghouh. Wanmore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃啊哈，债来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'd have to fuck Kimball. He's a hard man, a tough man. No-nonsense. He probably just does his business and rolls over, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜我得搞金博尔了。他是个硬汉，一个强硬的家伙，不废话。他很可能就是办完事就翻身了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But House is absolutely loaded. You'd have to marry him to get that sweet inheritance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是豪斯绝对有钱。你得嫁给他才能得到那笔丰厚的遗产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which means I'd have to kill Caesar. You're welcome, Hanlon. I'll take my thanks in cash, Mr. Oliver. Shake hands with the president. Put my face on a dollar bill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说我得杀了凯撒。不用客气，汉隆，我要用现金表示感谢，奥利弗先生。与总统握手，把我的脸印在美钞上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Distract Chick.> Okay. Marry, fuck, kill - Caesar, Kimball, and Mr. House. Go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <分散奇克注意力>好吧。结婚，操，杀人...凯撒，金博尔，豪斯先生。选。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] ...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the stuff. Fuck yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这个。当然了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hold on, you see that guy over there? Is he mean-mugging me? You see that face he's making? What the fuck is that about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你看到那边那个人了吗？他是想抢劫我吗？看到他的表情了吗？这他妈是怎么回事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Spike Chick's drink with Psycho while he's not looking.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <趁奇克不注意的往他的饮料里下疯狂药>

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You alright? You look nervous. Have another shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你还好吗？你看起来很紧张。再来一杯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Take a deep breath and try to work up the nerve to reach for the Psycho you're keeping on you.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <深呼吸鼓足勇气伸手去拿你藏在身上的疯狂药>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking that too. I'll take the fucker right now. Let's throw down. I'll kill that piece of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么想，我现在就去办了那个王八蛋。咱们开干吧，我要宰了那个狗杂碎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral
