ESP.ORIGINAL: I think he wants to fight you, dude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得他想和你决斗，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I guess you're right. Omertas would tie bricks to my ankles and throw me in Lake Mead if I ruined their carpet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我想你是对的。如果我毁了他们的地毯，黑手党会把砖头绑在我的脚踝上，把我扔进米德湖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like shit. Go to the bathroom before you throw up all over the counter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来糟透了。赶紧去洗手间，别吐得满地都是。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Nah, I think I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不，我想我还是算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, let's go to Freeside together, man. Let's just go. Right now. It'll be fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一起去自由城吧，伙计。我们走吧，就现在，会很有趣的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Wait, what? Seriously? Thanks, friend. I'll head there now.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]等等，什么？真的吗？谢谢你，朋友。我现在就去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you remember that last girl you were with? If I were you, I'd go to the Mormon Fort and get checked up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还记得上一个和你在一起的女孩吗？如果我是你，我就去摩门要塞检查一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aye, that'd be me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，就是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you Chick Hadley?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是奇克·哈德利吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isaiah? He's still alive? Vindictive fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以赛亚？他还活着？我真是操了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Havasu job was a waste of time. Yeah I took the money. I took a whole 200 caps. Big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈瓦苏的工作就是浪费时间。是的，我拿了钱，我拿了整整200瓶盖，没什么大不了的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I only bolted because I knew he was fixing to kill me. I figured that money was my best chance to get out of there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我逃跑是因为我知道他准备杀了我，我觉得那笔钱是我离开那里的最好机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isaiah Warren sent me. He wants the money for the Havasu job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以赛亚·沃伦派我来的。他想要哈瓦苏那份工作的钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There was an... indiscretion. I stole something. Or, well, I touched something that belonged to him. I misplaced something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾有过一次...轻率之举。我偷了东西，或者说，呃，我碰了属于他的东西。我把某样东西放错了地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I misplaced myself inside his girlfriend, if you catch my meaning. I hope you catch my meaning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我错把自己放进了他女朋友的身体里，你懂我的意思吧。我希望你明白我的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why was Isaiah going to kill you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么以赛亚要杀你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised anyone still gives a fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶居然还有人在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We used to be soldiers in the NCR. Can you believe it? You're looking at Private Hadley. It sucked. Never join the army.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们以前是NCR的士兵，你能相信吗？我是二等兵哈德利。糟透了，永远不要参军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things fell apart when we got ambushed near Oatman. This must've been 15 years ago. NCR was still fighting tribals at Bullhead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们在奥特曼附近被伏击时，一切都毁了。这应该是15年前的事了，NCR还在布尔海德与部落作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sarge made a bargain, he promised to lead a raid on an NCR convoy, so long as the tribals let us live. It worked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 中士做了个交易，他答应领导一支突袭NCR的队伍，只要部落让我们活下去。它奏效了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we kinda just kept doing it. The tribals joined up with us. We robbed fuckers in Bullhead, in Kingman. Became a gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我们就一直这样做。这些部落加入了我们，我们在布尔黑德和金曼抢劫过那些混蛋，变成了一个帮派。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your time in the Rivieras.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你在里维埃拉的时光。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sergeant Julius Becker. He was crooked from the start. Think he was selling chems to the other soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利乌斯·贝克尔中士。他从一开始就不老实，我认为他在向其他士兵出售毒品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who is this Sarge you mentioned?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到的中士是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's been 15 years. Different war, different administration. Nobody cares anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 已经15年了。不同的战争，不同的政府。没人在乎了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You aren't worried the NCR will come after you for deserting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不担心NCR会因为你当逃兵而来找你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that what they're doing now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们现在这样了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, none of us were really cut out for soldiering. We were out on the wild eastern frontier with training, guns, and gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们都不适合当兵。我们在蛮荒的东部边境接受训练，带着枪和装备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better to live free than as a government slave. And yeah, we made a lot of fucking money doing it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与其做政府的奴隶，不如自由地生活。没错，我们靠这个赚了不少钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did ex-NCR soldiers end up working with the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 前NCR士兵是如何与军团合作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it matter? I'm out of that life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这重要吗？我已经脱离那种生活了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what are you up to these days?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最近在忙什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'm a photographer for the Omertas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我是黑手党的摄影师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, you get some nice photos of the girls, and it's like an advertisement, except people pay for it. You want to meet her in person? Only in Vegas, baby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，你拍了一些漂亮的女孩的照片，就像广告一样，只不过人们花钱买的。你想当面见她吗？只有在拉斯维加斯，宝贝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just curious. You must be making money somehow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是好奇。你一定是在赚钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a problem. I'll tell you what, I'll give you an additional 450 caps if you can bring me the brain of another hound, Caesar will be able to fix it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个问题。这样吧，我再给你四百五十瓶盖，如果你能给我另一只猎犬的大脑，凯撒就能搞定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the other soldiers told me that he came to their village with a machine that could cure anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其他一些士兵告诉我，他带着一台能治百病的机器来到了他们的村庄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sure that Caesar will be able to cure Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信凯撒能治好雷克斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mentioned before that Rex hasn't had a transplant. Is that going to be an issue?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我之前提到过，雷克斯还没有做过移植手术。这是个问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that'll be all, I wanted to talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没别的事的话，我想说点别的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent, here's your payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，这是你的全部报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This dog brain comes from an older house dog from out West. <Give Rey's brain.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 这条狗的大脑来自一条西部的家犬。<给出雷伊的大脑>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we can only hope that Rex's bio med gel is enough to purge its former owner's evil spirits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我们只能希望雷克斯的生物医学凝胶足以净化它前主人的邪恶灵魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的全部报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I rescued this dog brain from a chem Fiend. <Give Violetta's brain.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从瘾君子恶魔帮那里救下了这只狗的大脑。<给出维奥莱塔的大脑>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent! A fellow Legion dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了！一条军团的狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的全部报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I got this dog's brain from the Fort actually. <Give Lupa's brain.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 这条狗的大脑是我从堡垒弄来的。<给出卢帕的大脑>

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fresh, very fresh. And it almost....
ESP.TRADUIT: 很新鲜，非常新鲜。几乎...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. Here's your payment in full.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。这是你的全部报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This dog's brain is pretty fresh. <Give Cerberus's brain.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 这条狗的大脑很新鲜。<给出刻耳柏洛斯的大脑>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cerberus? No, of course not. After all, there's no indication that he's Caesar's dog. I just know a good Cyber-Dog when I see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刻耳柏洛斯？不，当然不。毕竟，没有任何迹象表明它是凯撒的狗，我一看就知道什么是好的机械犬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about your dog I got for you already?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我已经给你准备好的狗呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, did you need something else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你还需要什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't found a new brain for Rex yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没给雷克斯找到新的大脑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll look for a dog's brain for Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去给雷克斯找个狗的大脑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose so. Forget I asked about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是的。当我没问过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested. This is your problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣，这是你的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Very well, I already gave a reward for bringing Cerberus back to me, so don't expect another one. Here, boy!
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好吧，我已经给了你赏金让你把刻耳柏洛斯带回我身边，所以别指望会再给了。来，小子！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, here's a modest pittance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，这只是一笔微薄的收入。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why take a chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要冒险呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Like I said, it's not a guarantee that he's Caesar's dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]就像我说的，不能保证他就是凯撒的狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, but the needs of Caesar, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，但凯撒的需要，你知道吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Bad idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，坏主意。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Laertes [0600C447] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About Rex...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于雷克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this a slave market?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是奴隶市场吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All out right now. But even if I did have any, I'm under contract to send them over to White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在都卖完了。但就算我有，我也有合同要把它们送到白沙商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And White Sands only sells to the Legion, per our 2281 contract. You'd have to try some of the larger contracts in Kingman or Phoenix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据我们的2281号合同，白沙商队只卖给军团。你得去金曼或凤凰城找些大合同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I buy a slave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以买一个奴隶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: White Sands is the biggest caravan in Arizona. It's the only outfit I know of with contractors in the triple digits. We've seen better days, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 白沙是亚利桑那州最大的商队，这是我所知道的唯一一个规模超过100人的商队。不过，他们也有过好日子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: During the Legion's war with the Arizona Rangers, White Sands tried to sell arms to both sides. Dumbshit idea. Legion didn't care for that very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团与亚利桑那游骑兵的战争中，白沙试图向双方出售武器。军团不太喜欢这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion rounded up the board of directors and crucified them. Then, they selected a new board of directors. The message was clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们围捕了董事会成员，把他们钉在十字架上。然后，他们选出了新的董事会，传达的信息很明确。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These days, we have competition from everyone. Not many deal in our slave contracts, though, and that's what pays the salaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如今，我们面临着来自所有人的竞争。 不过，我们的奴隶合同不多，而这正是支付工资的来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about White Sands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说白沙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's really only a couple general goods traders here. You want a bigger stock, I'd try Solitare up north.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里只有几个普通的贸易商。如果你想要更大的库存，我建议你去北方的索利泰尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does this market sell anything other than slaves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个市场除了奴隶还卖别的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really think about them. They're just kind of there. Like, you deal with the weather because there isn't really anything you can do about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不怎么去想他们，他们就在那里。比如，你要应对天气，因为你对它无能为力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, that shit's banned. Which, I mean, whatever, they want to ban stuff, they can, that's their right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，那是被禁止的。我的意思是，无论他们想禁止什么，他们可以，这是他们的权利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was hoping to get in on that market the Legion set up in the Mojave, but they closed the whole thing up after a security breach.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本想加入军团在莫哈维建立的那个市场，但他们因为一个安全漏洞关闭了整个市场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some dude shot a slave right in front of everyone. I don't think they ever caught him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个家伙当着大家的面射杀了一个奴隶。我想他们没有抓到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trader Carlos [06017537] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you sell slaves in the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在NCR卖奴隶吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am overseeing the repair of the Chainway for the Officiorum ab Logsticae.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在监督物流官员对连环道的维修。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is one branch of the Administratio. Surely, the name indicates to you what its purview is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是行政部门的一个分支。当然，这个名字向你表明了它的权限是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like the Treasury, it is staffed by a mix of Liberti and elder Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与财政部一样，它的工作人员既有自由民，也有年长的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Office of Logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个后勤办公室。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think happens if the Chainway isn't repaired in time to support us during Hoover Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果在胡佛大坝战斗期间连环道没有及时修复来支持我们，你认为会发生什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These slaves will simply be moved to some other post. Me? I will be dismissed. If my failure harms us in the battle, I may even be killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些奴隶只会被转移到其他岗位上。我呢？会将被解雇，如果我的失败在对我们的战斗造成了损失，我甚至可能会被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, yes, I am quite stressed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，是的，我压力很大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seem pretty stressed for a guy who gets to sit around and watch others do the work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个坐在那里看着别人干活的人，你看起来压力很大啊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway? A Profligate came along and annoyed it to pieces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道吗？一个堕落者来了，把它弄得支离破碎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It collapsed. You can see that much with your own eyes. My job is only to fix it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。它倒塌了，你可以亲眼看到，我的工作只是修复它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any theories, rumors, mysteries. I don't really care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么理论，谣言，谜团。我才不在乎呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to this overpass?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这座立交桥怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. We're just diverting manpower to repair it for our own amusement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有。我们只是为了自娱自乐，调遣人手来修理而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Idiotic question. Yes, it's important. It was the major supply line into the Mojave from the rest of Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 白痴问题。是的，这很重要，这是从军团的其他领地进入莫哈维的主要补给线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it a big deal that it's broken?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它坏了有什么大不了的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't like your tone, but I will entertain the question. It was all established ad hoc to support our first incursion into the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不喜欢你的语气，但我愿意考虑这个问题。这一切都是为了支持我们第一次入侵莫哈维而设立的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are small hanging bridges along the Chainway. The Tres Leches brothers had them built to support our supply movements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在连环道沿线有一些小吊桥。 是三人行兄弟让人修建了它们，用来支持我们的补给行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As I understand it, that was the deal with Caesar. They would assist with Legion logistics, and in return, they would be allowed to keep their heads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，这是和凯撒的交易。他们将协助军团的后勤，作为回报，他们将被允许保留他们的脑袋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we returned a second time, the brothers had built an office on the Chainway. Caesar obliged to use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们第二次回来时，兄弟们已经在连环道上建了一间办公室。凯撒不得不使用它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see the result.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到结果了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whose idea was it to use a crumbling pre-war bridge as a supply line?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把战前的一座摇摇欲坠的桥用作补给线是谁的主意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the rate these slaves are working, too damn long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 按照这些奴隶的工作速度，时间太长了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know how long it will take for the Chainway to be repaired?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道修复连环道需要多长时间吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a guy in Malpais who wanted me to see if you were real.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯有个人想让我看看你是不是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excuse me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais, the camp just south of here. He's in the roadhouse. Wears a funny hat. He says he's a jernuhlist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯，就在南边的营地。他在旅馆里，戴着一顶滑稽的帽子，他说他是个新闻工作者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Guy in Malpais?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯有个人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll go tell him. Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我去告诉他。一会儿见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll pay him a visit later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一会儿去拜访他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, well, bye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，嗯，再见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, whatever, that. Visit him if you want.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随便啦。如果你想去拜访他的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A journalist?
ESP.TRADUIT: 新闻工作者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's fine. I get a new Grognak either way. Later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那很好，不管怎样我都能得到一本新的古古那。回见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Legion Child [06020865] (mod) Quest : ([0601EDA5]AZFreeformMalpaisChildrensQuarters) 0601EDA5 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't visiting him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会去拜访他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just waiting for the troopers to let me through the checkpoint, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就等着士兵让我通过检查站，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010199] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just waiting for the troopers to let me through the checkpoint, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就等着士兵让我通过检查站，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010199] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010199] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything to hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么要隐藏的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，女士
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010199] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got anything to hide?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么要隐藏的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: New California. I've heard they banned slavery, and I don't ever want to see a slaver ever again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 新加州。我听说他们禁止奴隶制，我再也不想看到奴隶贩子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Refugee [06010199] (mod) Quest : ([0601018F]AZDamNQuest3) Barbarians at the Gates EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you heading?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要去哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Office of Logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 后勤办公室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from its Phoenix office. The Chainway is a much more pressing issue than that factories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是凤凰城办公室的，连环道是一个比工厂更紧迫的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officiorum ab Logisticae?
ESP.TRADUIT: 物流官员？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, thank you. An educated Profligate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，谢谢。一个受过教育的堕落者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm from its Phoenix office. The Chainway is a much more pressing issue than that factories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是凤凰城办公室的，连环道是一个比工厂更紧迫的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Horatio [0601751F] (mod) Quest : ([0601751A]AZFreeformMalpais) 0601751A (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, Office of Logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，后勤办公室。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know. It looks like we beat the hell out of some Gila Monsters. Lost a cow, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道。看来我们打败了一些大毒蜥，不过丢了一头牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, did you want to smoke some Brush?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你想抽点狐尾草吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your earlier offer....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你之前的提议...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't get what his deal is. It's obviously an herbal remedy per our own instructions regarding chem use. No different than Coyote Tobacco Chew or Healing Powder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白他是怎么回事。根据我们自己的药物使用说明，这显然是一种草药，跟郊狼嚼烟或治疗粉没什么区别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ridiculous to think it's as bad as Buffout or Hydra.
ESP.TRADUIT: 认为它跟壮大灵或九头蛇一样糟糕真是荒谬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus is having me look for evidence that Brush is a harmful substance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯让我寻找狐尾草是有害物质的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel more dumb when I'm off the Brush than when I'm on it. I'm usually angry all the time. That's why Ficus gave me some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得不用狐尾草的时候更笨，我总是很生气。所以菲古斯给了我一些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It helps me calm down, helps me focus. It's just like that disgusting packed tobacco chew Quintus sucks on when he wakes up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它能让我冷静下来，集中注意力。就像昆图斯醒来时吸的那种恶心的包装烟草一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus is having me look for evidence that Brush makes you dumb.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯让我找证据证明狐尾草让你变傻了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't remember, to be truthful. We woke up like this, saw the bodies when we awoke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我不记得了。我们就这样醒来，醒来的时候看到了尸体。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you on Brush when this happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这事发生的时候你在抽狐尾草吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, because it's the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，因为这是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you expect me to believe that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为我会相信吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you are not stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你不算蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does my breath smell like raw cow? Of course it doesn't. Don't ask stupid questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的口气有生牛的味道吗？当然不会。不要问愚蠢的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it possible that you just ate the cow and forgot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有可能你吃了牛却忘了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to help Ficus clean up this mess. Why don't you help us, make yourself useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去帮菲古斯收拾烂摊子。你为什么不帮帮我们呢，做点有用的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this hatchet and start chopping at the bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿着这把斧头，开始砍尸体吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no further questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有其他问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to help Ficus clean up this mess. Why don't you help us, make yourself useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要去帮菲古斯收拾烂摊子。你为什么不帮帮我们呢，做点有用的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no further questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有其他问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Callum? Well, I'll tell the truth, he was always a drag. Annoying everyone with his "Caesar demands this, Caesar demands that" nonsense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡卢姆？好吧，说实话，他一直是个累赘。用“凯撒要求这个，凯撒要求那个”的废话惹恼所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We already know what Caesar demands, no need to tell us. Plus, he swore too much. I can't stand swearing. It's Profligate behavior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经知道凯撒的要求了，没必要告诉我们。而且，他经常骂人，我可受不了骂人，这是一种堕落者的行为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a Legionary who's gone missing. Callum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个失踪的军团士兵，卡卢姆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deserted? No, of course not. Legionaries don't desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃跑？不，当然不会，军团士兵是不会逃跑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He probably just got himself killed by Deathclaws or something. You can probably find his corpse somewhere around the Atlas Tower. Or maybe Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能是被死亡爪之类的东西害死了。你可能会在阿特拉斯塔附近找到他的尸体，或者是大晶石矿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think he deserted?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为他逃跑了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He probably just got himself killed by Deathclaws or something. You can probably find his corpse somewhere around the Atlas Tower. Or maybe Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能是被死亡爪之类的东西害死了。你可能会在阿特拉斯塔附近找到他的尸体，或者是大晶石矿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know where he is?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道他在哪儿吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their meat is needed for soldiers fighting on the frontlines. The Dissolute Ranchers can't be trusted to guard their own damn cows from the wildlife, it's infuriating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在前线作战的士兵需要它们的肉。堕落的牧场主不值得信任，他们不能保护自己的牛不受野生动物的伤害，这令人愤怒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing watching these cows?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你盯着这些牛干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, it's terrible. We're supposed to be on the frontlines, exterminating the Profligates and crushing the weak in the name of the son of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，情况很糟糕。我们应该站在最前线，以玛尔斯之子的名义，消灭堕落者，粉碎弱者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, we're guarding cattle in the name of Mars. Not even useful cattle that have hands and know their place, but dumb cattle that get spooked by dust storms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们现在以玛尔斯的名义守卫牛群。甚至不是那些会干活懂规矩的有用的牛，而是那些被沙尘暴吓到的愚蠢牛群。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, this isn't what Mars meant for us to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，这不是玛尔斯让我们做的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it like being a Legionary?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当一名军团士兵是什么感觉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ficus. We're with Decanus Quintus's contubernium, out near Dolan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 菲古斯，我们和昆图斯什长的十人队在多兰附近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's your friend?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的朋友是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, do you have any?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你有吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was curious about smoking some Brush with you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很想和你们一起抽狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, go get some.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去买吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, then let's relax for a bit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我们放松一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ever since you got Quintus to ease up on it, he's been an asshole and just takes it for himself. He just bans us from smoking it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从你让昆图斯放宽限制后，他就像个混蛋，只顾着自己。他只是禁止我们抽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to burn some more Brush with you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还想和你们多烧点呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We would, if Quintus hadn't banned us from smoking it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会的，如果昆图斯不禁止我们抽的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to burn some Brush with you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想和你们一起烧点狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you that Quintus banned us from smoking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉过你昆图斯禁止我们抽。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to burn some more Brush with you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还想和你们多烧点呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to burn some more Brush with you guys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还想和你们多烧点呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I trust your judgment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你的判断。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see your shotgun. I'm going to show you something cool. A new way to smoke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的猎枪。我要给你看个很酷的东西，一种新的抽法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, no way, the other soldier can smoke it from the barrel. Amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，不可能，另一个士兵可以从枪管里抽。太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check this out. Put the Brush in the shotgun chamber. Press this bowl against it and blow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看好了，先把狐尾草塞进霰弹枪膛室，拿这个碗扣紧，然后吹气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, okay....
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me see your shotgun. I'm going to show you something cool. A new way to smoke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看你的猎枪。我要给你看个很酷的东西，一种新的抽法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get that gun away from your mouth! You don't even know if it's loaded!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把枪从你嘴里拿开！你都不知道有没有上膛！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, check this out!
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，看看这个！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, go get some. All we have right now is some low-quality Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就去买吧。我们现在只有一些低质量的狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I don't have any.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实我没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Awesome, amicus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了，朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sure do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Burn the Brush or don't. You can't burn what is ash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 烧不烧狐尾草都行，灰是不能烧的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，算了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not exactly sure. Asher and I woke up with all of this surrounding us. The Gila Monsters we killed, but what mutilated the cow I cannot say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也不太清楚。阿舍和我醒来时周围都是这些东西，我们杀死了大毒蜥，但我不知道是什么残害了那头牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did the Decanus send you for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长派你来干什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus sent me. What happened here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯派我来的。这里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course he did. He's been talking about maybe banning it for a while. That's why he's a garrison Legionary and not a Legionary of action.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了，他说可能要禁止它有一段时间了。这就是为什么他是一个守备军团成员而不是一个行动军团成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He probably could not have survived this battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他可能无法在这场战斗中幸存下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus asked me to investigate your use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯让我调查你使用狐尾草的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, amicus, look around you. A battle occurred here, and we must have fought in it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，朋友们，看看你周围。这里发生了一场战斗，我们肯定参加过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you see weakness, then I don't know what to tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你看到了软弱，那我不知道该怎么跟你说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus wanted me to find evidence that Brush makes you weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯想让我找到狐尾草让你变弱的证据。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't believe so, but it's possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为，但这是可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Were you smoking Brush when this happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 事发时你在抽狐尾草吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that's not possible. The Brush can make you hungry, but it can't just make you want to eat a raw Brahmin. That's unhealthy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，那不可能。狐尾草可以让你感到饥饿，但它不会让你想生吃婆罗门牛。这很不健康。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All those diseases in its gut. Even eating a human is healthier, and I know from experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的疾病都在它的肠道里。甚至吃人都要健康一点，这是我的经验之谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is it possible that you just ate the cow and forgot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有可能你吃了牛却忘了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asher and I have to clean up this mess. We don't want Cazadores swarming the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿舍和我得把这烂摊子收拾干净，我们可不希望猎蜂聚集在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to start chopping up the corpses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得开始肢解尸体了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no further questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有其他问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Asher and I have to clean up this mess. We don't want Cazadores swarming the place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿舍和我得把这烂摊子收拾干净，我们可不希望猎蜂聚集在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no further questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有其他问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, him. I don't know about him, really. He's got just the nastiest temper. Well, maybe not the nastiest, but worse than Asher.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，他啊，我不知道他怎么样，真的。他的脾气是最坏的，也许不是最讨厌的，但比阿舍还糟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I were you, I wouldn't even bother looking for him, but I guess I'm not you, so I would recommend searching around Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是你，我甚至不会费心去找他，但我想我不是你，所以我建议你在大晶石矿周围找找。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a Legionary who's gone missing. Callum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一个失踪的军团士兵，卡卢姆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ficus. The man over there is Asher. We're both with Decanus Quintus's contubernium, near Dolan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 菲古斯，那边那个人是阿舍。我们都属于昆图斯什长的十人队，在多兰附近。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watching the cows. Some of the most beautiful creatures in Mars's creation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看牛，玛尔斯创造的最美丽的生物之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a veteran of the great Colorado Campaign. I have seen scores of my comrades die for so many reasons. The cold, the plague, metal men, the air itself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是科罗拉多战役的老兵，我看到我的许多战友因为各种各样的原因而死去。寒冷、瘟疫、金属人、空气本身。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only way to cope was by seeing the beauty of Mars's creation and not just the hell that we just endure to bring about Caesar's better world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一的解决办法就是看着玛尔斯创造的美丽，而不仅仅是我们为了凯撒的美好世界而忍受的地狱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sand dunes as far as the eye can see, the majesty of the Gunny-son Canyon, the screams as Durango was sacked, the sunset glistening off the Maroon Bells.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一望无际的沙丘，雄伟的甘尼逊峡谷，杜兰戈被洗劫时的尖叫声，褐铃山上闪耀的落日。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of that beauty will stick with me, to bring me peace no matter what hardship comes next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的美好都会伴随着我，给我带来平静，不管接下来会遇到什么困难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like cow-watching?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢看牛吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I... Um, what was that word? Retire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...呃，那个词是什么？退休？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you thinking about becoming a rancher when you retire?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你退休后想成为一名牧场主吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stop being a soldier? What type of nonsense is that? Is that what people in the NCR do? No wonder Western civilization has degenerated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不再当兵？这是什么鬼话？NCR的人就是这么做的吗？难怪西方文明堕落了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thinking about what comes after being a soldier. The moment we start talking about what happens after war is the moment we've succumbed to sin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想当了一名士兵之后会发生什么。当我们开始谈论战争之后会发生什么的时候，就是我们向罪恶屈服的时候。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only fools think wars end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有傻瓜才认为战争会结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Retiring. It's what comes after you stop being a soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退休，就是你不再当兵之后的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that will never happen. I'm going to have died a glorious death long before that happens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那永远不会发生。在那之前我早就光荣的死去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know we're supposed to trust the Centurions and Veterans coming from Arizona, but they're so old that I question whether they actually fought in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道我们应该相信来自亚利桑那的百夫长和军团老兵，但他们太老了，我怀疑他们是否真的参加过战斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I don't trust anybody over thirty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我不相信任何超过30岁的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Retiring. It's when you get old.
ESP.TRADUIT: 退休，当你变老的时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that obviously doesn't count. He's immortal. He can't be killed, end of story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那显然不算。他是不朽的，他不会死的，就这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar's over thirty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒三十多岁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what happened there. We must have pissed off Mars somehow. Probably all those fake Veterans and Centurions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道发生了什么，肯定是我们惹毛了玛尔斯，大概是那些假老兵和百夫长吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we kick the NCR off our throats and purge the Mojave of all these Profligates, it's their turn next.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等我们摆脱NCR的压迫，肃清莫哈维的所有堕落者，下一个就轮到他们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar was over thirty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒已经三十多岁了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius is not over thirty. Not that I've seen, anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼乌斯还不到三十岁。至少我没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Exactly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can respect that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尊重这一点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the manner of your business here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里的生意如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm here on business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来做生意的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not implemented yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 暂未实现
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Where the Turf Meets the Surf]
ESP.TRADUIT: [草皮与海浪相遇之地]

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not all that was done from I gather.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，还不止这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Optio is dead because of your actions. While it is true that I wanted to harm the Legion, I also wanted to inflict damage to all of their units.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你的行为，执行官已经死了。虽然我确实想伤害军团，但我也想对他们所有的单位造成伤害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of them. Not just the commander.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有人，不只是指挥官。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm willing to offer a flat fee of 300 caps. Or I can pay you in with a more general assortment of drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意提供300瓶盖的费用，或者我可以给你一些更普通的药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were seen. The operation was a total failure due to your incompetence. Only a handful of Legionaries were killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被发现了。由于你的无能，这次行动彻底失败了，只有少数军团士兵被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nearly a month of hard work down the drain. If this were anywhere else, you would be a dead woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 将近一个月的辛苦工作付诸东流。如果是在别处，你就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is what's going to happen: you will receive 100 caps as compensation for the legwork, and then our business is finished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情是这样的：你会得到100瓶盖作为跑腿的补偿，然后我们的交易就结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were seen. The operation was a total failure due to your incompetence. Only a handful of Legionaries were killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被发现了。由于你的无能，这次行动彻底失败了，只有少数军团士兵被杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nearly a month of hard work down the drain. If this were anywhere else, you would be a dead man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 将近一个月的辛苦工作付诸东流。如果是在别处，你就死定了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here is what's going to happen: you will receive 100 caps as compensation for the legwork, and then our business is finished.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情是这样的：你会得到100瓶盖作为跑腿的补偿，然后我们的交易就结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard. The Optio has already sent a request out for a new supply of Brush. You have done an exceptional job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说了，执行官已经发出了一个新的狐尾草供应的请求。你做得非常出色。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It goes without saying that I'll be providing you with a discount on any chems you're willing to buy here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用说，只要你愿意在这里购买任何化学药物，我都会给你折扣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for payment for this job, I can pay you in caps or drugs. Which do you prefer?
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于这份工作的报酬，我可以用瓶盖或毒品来支付。你喜欢哪一种？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞定了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is a problem, but not an insurmountable one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个问题，但不是一个无法克服的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if speaking is no longer an option, the Decanus will have to go in a way that doesn't implicate us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果我们不能再谈话了，什长就只能以不牵连到我们的方式离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important that he not just die. He must be seen to have betrayed the Legion in some form.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不能就这么死了，这很重要。他一定要以某种形式背叛了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My personal recommendation is inciting a mutiny against him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我个人的建议是煽动一场针对他的叛乱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if you're not skilled enough to do that, the alternative is to plant drugs on Quintus. Make his anti-chem rhetoric appear to be an attempt at misdirection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果你的技术不足以做到这一点，另一个选择就是在昆图斯身上栽赃毒品，让他的反化学药物言论看起来是一种误导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Return to me when you've completed your task.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你完成任务后再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And do not fail this time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次不要失败。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a problem. The Decanus banned Brush despite my best efforts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个问题。尽管我尽了最大努力，什长还是禁止了狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The next step is to expand the Brush trade. The resident Centurion in Chloride is a bad-tempered man, but not unreasonable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一步是扩大狐尾草贸易。居住在克洛赖德的百夫长是个坏脾气的人，但并非不可理喻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak to him, and we'll see about having the garrison as a whole adopt the use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟他谈谈，我们会考虑让整个驻军都使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus has been removed from power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯被剥夺了权力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good work. Here's your payment. The next stage of the plan is going to require a meeting with the Centurion in charge of the garrison.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得好，这是你的报酬。下一阶段的计划是和负责驻军的百夫长会面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is an ill-tempered man who loathes practically everyone around him due to his non-combat posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个脾气暴躁的人，因为他的非战斗职位，他几乎讨厌身边的每个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is useful to us, as anything that will lead him to a combat posting will make it easier to convince him to authorize the use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我们来说很有用，因为任何能够引导他去战斗的内容都会让我们更容易说服他授权使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go to him and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到他那里去，再回到我这里来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Decanus Quintus has agreed to allow the continued use of Brush among his contubernium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长昆图斯同意在他的十人队中继续使用狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, we just sit back and wait for a couple days for the Brush shipments to make their way through the Legion ranks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们只需要等几天，等待狐尾草的运输进入军团的行列。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me three days, and I'll some more work for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我三天时间，我再给你安排一些工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aetius has agreed that Brush will not be criminalized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃提乌斯同意不将狐尾草定罪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't waste my time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别浪费我的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Niemann.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是尼曼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this a drug den?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是毒品窝点吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy some drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点毒品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Making drugs in Legion territory is illegal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团领地制造毒品是违法的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wish to buy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想买的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I have some?
ESP.TRADUIT: 能给我一些吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guard is Clark. The secretary is Jess. They're not much for conversation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 守卫是克拉克，秘书是杰丝。他们没什么好聊的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are your helpers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是你的帮手？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's the one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a town up north called Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 北边有个小镇叫大站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. It isn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫索利泰尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从没去过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to roll around with some punks that thought we could take on the Legion. We would win because we were right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前和一些小混混混在一起，以为我们能对付军团。我们会赢，因为我们是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I learned real quick that being right is less important than winning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很快就明白，正确没有胜利重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you get into drug-dealing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么开始贩毒的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别操心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What type of punks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪种类型的小混混？

ESP.ORIGINAL: When was I younger, I thought I could make the world a better place by being the better person. Now, I know the only thing you really need is to be better at killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我年轻的时候，我认为我可以成为一个更好的人，让世界变得更美好。现在，我知道你唯一需要做的就是提高杀戮能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I am much better now than I was then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在比以前好多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: South of here, in the distant lands of the Sonora Wasteland.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里的南边，遥远的索诺拉废土。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back then, I was looking for an army I heard was pretty similar to my old crew. I didn't find them. Instead, I found criminals, drug dealers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时候，我在找一支跟我以前的团队很像的军队，我没找到他们。相反，我发现了罪犯、毒贩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They put a gun to my head and took me to Parker. I told them that the Legion was coming. No one cared, they weren't here yet. No need to worry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们拿枪指着我的头，把我带到帕克。我告诉他们军团要来了，没人在意，他们还没来，不需要担心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the dealers, a man named Big River Joe, told me I was asking the wrong question.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中一个叫“大河”乔的商人告诉我，我问错了问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The real question was if there was money in fighting the Legion. When I said yes, he brought me into his crew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的问题是与军团作战是否有利可图。我答应了，他就把我招进了他的团队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you learn to kill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是在哪里学会杀人的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For four months, I was Joe's soldier. I dropped a lot of bodies for that man. But, he had a limited vision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 四个月来，我一直是乔的士兵，我为他杀了很多人。但是，他的眼光有限。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He began to obsess over the new territories I got for him, started wars we had no business fighting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他开始痴迷于我给他的新领土，发动了我们本不该打的战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I realized that most of the crew agreed, so during one of his war council meetings, I snapped his neck and declared that the wars were over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我意识到大多数成员都同意，所以在他的一次战争委员会会议上，我拧断了他的脖子，宣布战争结束了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was wrong. The other crews thought we were weak and kept fighting, but we rallied and broke them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我错了。其他成员认为我们软弱，继续战斗，但我们重振旗鼓，打败了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For the last three years, I have forged an empire over the whole of the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在过去的三年里，我在整个科罗拉多建立了一个帝国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's amazing how a gang of not more than a hundred people solely interested in profit can do more against the Legion than an entire army of Rangers did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人惊讶的是，一个不超过一百人的帮派，仅仅对利润感兴趣，却能比整个游骑兵队做得更多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Continue listening.> What happened next?
ESP.TRADUIT: <继续听>接下来发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about you? Where did you learn to kill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你呢？你在哪里学会杀人的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that answers my questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这就回答了我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, that answers my questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这就回答了我的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To survive this long without taking a life.... It's parasitic. You make others spill the blood but keep your own hands dry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 能活这么久而不杀人...这是寄生。你让别人流血却不让自己的手沾染鲜血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ways are going, though, you won't be a bystander for long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，一切都在继续，你不会做太久的旁观者了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't killed anyone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没杀过人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As good as place as any.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和其他地方一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我想知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I became courier. It's a rough job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我成为邮差的时候，这是一份艰苦的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoever raised you started you on the path of violence young.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抚养你长大的人让你走上了暴力之路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's good. It means they gave you the tools to survive out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很好，这意味着他们给了你在这里生存的工具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我想知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I was a kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我还是个孩子的时候。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I applaud your choices so far. You have the air of a killer. That's good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到目前为止，我为你的选择鼓掌。你有一种杀手的气质，这很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I wanted to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些就是我想知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't even rememember.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我都不记得了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm? Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Power and vice are interconnected.
ESP.TRADUIT: 权力和罪恶是相互关联的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the NCR, vice makes you powerful. In the Legion, power fills you with vice, and the Legion promotes power more than any other "virtue".
ESP.TRADUIT: 在NCR，罪恶让你强大。在军团中，权力让你充满邪恶，而军团对权力的推崇超过了其他任何“美德”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers were, and I mean this in the nicest of possible terms, morons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵，我说得再好听点，都是白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They thought they could keep power and vice away, and be right at the same time. That's why they failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们认为他们可以把权力和罪恶都赶走，同时又保持正确。这就是他们失败的原因。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I understand that, I'll win, and the Legion will lose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我明白，我会赢，而军团会输。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Continue listening.> Why do think that is?
ESP.TRADUIT: <继续听>为什么会这样呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I despise the Legion. They should be all be rounded up and crucified along Route 66, see how they like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我鄙视军团。他们应该在66号公路上被抓起来钉死，看看他们怎么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everything they've done should be returned to them a hundredfold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们所做的一切都应该得到百倍的回报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, do you hate the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你恨军团吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only appropriate response.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一合适的回应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I appreciate the zeal. I hate the Legion, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我欣赏你的热情。我也恨军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are benefits to suicide, too. Obviously not ones you can live with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自杀也有好处，显然不是你能接受的那种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are benefits to the Legion, aren't there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是有好处的，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The trouble with the Legion is that you have to use Legion methods to destroy them. If you can't accept that, you can't win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的麻烦之处在于你必须使用军团的方法去摧毁他们。如果你不能接受这一点，你就赢不了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sound like a Legionary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听起来像个军团士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only opinion that matters is the one held by the person most willing to kill for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唯一重要的意见是愿意为此杀人的人所持的意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone told me that once. Now, I'm telling you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人曾经告诉过我。现在，我告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't agree with such methods, but I respect your opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不同意这种方法，但我尊重你的意见。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of my people feel that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们大多数人都是这么想的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't actually care that much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我其实没那么在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sound like you've been all over. Thoughts on the Wasteland?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你好像去过很多地方。对废土的感想？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only times that I've had to deal with them, they were a partner. An extremely unreliable one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一和他们打交道的时候，他们是我的合伙人。极其不靠谱的家伙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR fights like demons in the Sonora, but can't be assed to put their back into it up now.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR在索诺拉地区打得很猛，但现在却懒得全力投入了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I assume they're better than the Legion, but they don't really seem all that interested in fighting them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为他们比军团强，但他们似乎真的对与军团作战不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think about the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对NCR有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They do, but they're not good at keeping them under control at all. Probably, they don't really want to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们禁止，但他们根本不擅长控制。也许，他们并不是真的想这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does the NCR ban drugs?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR禁止毒品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR requests intel and offers support from time to time on every front I operate on. They demand everything but give me very little.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR要求提供情报，并要求我在运作的每一个方面提供支持。他们什么都要，但给我的很少。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ask for guns, I ask for chems, I ask for cash. I am not likely to receive any of those.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要枪，我要药品，我要现金。我不太可能收到这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want to talk about specifics, then that's not a conversation I'm willing to have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想谈细节，那我就不愿意谈了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've worked with the NCR before?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前和NCR合作过吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen the whole front, from Yuma to Big Stop. All I really have to say about it is that's it bad for business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看过整个前线，从尤马到大站。我要说的是，这对生意不好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR blew up Parker Dam, and had to give up a bunch of runners to the Legion in Dry Wells to get the Frumentarii off my back.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR炸毁了帕克大坝，为了摆脱军团特务，不得不放弃一群走私者给枯井军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And business isn't possible at all in Bullhead. There isn't a Bullhead left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在布尔海德根本不可能做生意，已经没有布尔海德了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the other hand, both sides have been using my runners in the Sonora to keep their operations money out of the hands of both Congress and Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另一方面，双方都在利用我在索诺拉的代理人来避免他们的运营资金落入国会和凯撒的手中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your thoughts on the war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这场战争有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: NCR blew up it up to stop the Legion from coming into California. They blew up Davis Dam near Bullhead, too, from what I hear.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR为了阻止军团进入加州把它炸了。据我所知，他们还炸掉了布尔海德附近的戴维斯大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They won't get the opportunity to blow up Hoover Dam, though, I'm sure of that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，我敢肯定，他们没有机会炸掉胡佛大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why'd the NCR blow up Parker Dam?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR为什么要炸掉帕克水坝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Used to be the NCR's little Bullhead. Nice little gambling and drinking town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前是NCR的小布尔海德，真是个赌博喝酒的好地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a deal with the mayor who ran the place before the Legion rolled through. Dumbass couldn't handle the torture like my soldiers could.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团来之前，我和管理这里的镇长有个协议，这蠢蛋无法像我的士兵那样忍受酷刑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He rolled on a couple of my best lieutenants. I had to sacrifice them to the Legion cross and pay out their families.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他出卖了我的几个得力助手。我不得不把他们牺牲在军团的十字架上，并补偿他们的家人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What was special about Dry Wells?
ESP.TRADUIT: 枯井有什么特别之处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the flooding when the Legion blew up Davis Dam didn't kick the customers out, the non-stop NCR artillery did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团炸毁戴维斯大坝时的洪水没有把客户赶出去的话，NCR不间断的火炮就是罪魁祸首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
