ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't set up anything in that place anymore, and I've been having to send my best runners to Katharine and Big Bend to keep the supply line intact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我再也无法在那里建立任何东西了，我不得不派我最好的走私者去凯瑟琳和大弯保持补给线的完整。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to Bullhead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布尔海德怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii have to make deals with raiders and tribes all the time. They can't always afford to bring in an Auto-Doc as a gift, but chems are always appreciated by whatever tribe or raider they're working with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务总是要和掠夺者和部落做生意，他们不能总是带一个自动医生当礼物，但无论他们与什么部落或掠夺者合作，他们总是很欣赏化学药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of them even think it's a worthwhile endeavor to try and get them to sell drugs in California. I don't know if that's working out for them, but it's certainly working out for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们中的一些人甚至认为，让他们在加州销售毒品是一件值得努力的事情。我不知道这对他们是否有效，但对我来说肯定是可行的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, the Legion bans drugs, but you sell to the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，军团禁止毒品，你却卖给军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never been. It's a thoroughly saturated market, dominated by local traffickers and the New Reno influence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没去过。这是一个完全饱和的市场，由当地毒贩和新里诺的势力主导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Supposedly, it's led by a tyrant, but I'm too busy fighting another right now to care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说，它是由一个暴君领导的，但我现在正忙着与另一个暴君斗争，无暇顾及。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Vegas?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得拉斯维加斯怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am Jess, Niemann's accountant and secretary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是杰丝，尼曼的会计兼秘书。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a high workload, so speak to Niemann if you have business here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的工作量很大，如果你在这里有事，就找尼曼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Niemann believes in a number of fringe anti-Legion ideologies, including a belief that crime in itself is a weapon of resistance against them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尼曼相信一些极端的反军团意识形态，包括相信犯罪本身就是抵抗他们的武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His beliefs are unimportant, but his drive is an advanced force for profit. There are many opportunities under him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的信仰并不重要，但他的动力是一种追求利益的先进力量。在他手下有很多机会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你老板。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was fired from my last job back in New California. Insurance fraud while working for Far-Go. They were mistaken, but the mark on my record remains.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在新加州的上一份工作被解雇了，在为远行商队工作的时候搞保险诈骗。他们搞错了，但我档案上的印记还在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pursued alternative ventures in Dry Wells, which is where I met him. Niemann requested my aid in building up this piece of real estate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在枯井从事其他的冒险活动，在那里我遇到了他。尼曼请我帮忙建这块地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to work for Niemann?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么来尼曼这儿工作的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are an annoying source of high overhead. It would benefit everyone if the Legion was not a problem.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是高开销的恼人来源。如果军团不成问题，大家都会受益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对军团有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It obviously is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Jess [0601DF4F] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this job dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这份工作危险吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Niemann pays me to sit on my ass and look over his drug maker here. If you're looking for runner work, bother him instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尼曼付我钱让我盯着他的制毒商。如果你想找跑腿的工作，那就去烦他吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And no, you can't join me on guard duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有不，你不能和我一起站岗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you seriously asking that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真的要问这个吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like the wandering type, I'm assuming that you've a seen a tough guy who gets paid to hold a big gun and look threatening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来像那种四处游荡的人，我猜你见过一个拿着大枪，看起来很有威胁的硬汉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, in my case, I'm not a good shot, and this gun is for show. I like to get up close when I rough people up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就我而言，我枪法不好，这把枪是用来作秀的。我揍人的时候喜欢近距离接触。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do as a guard?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当警卫要做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since the Chainway collapsed, they've been running around like headless chickens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从连环道坍塌后，他们就像无头鸡一样到处乱跑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The closest we got to a problem was a runaway slave that somehow managed to find our hideout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们最近遇到的问题是一个逃跑的奴隶不知怎么找到了我们的藏身处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you encounter many problems here in Legion territory?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在军团领地遇到的问题多吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I killed the guy. Cut him up a bit so it'd look like wild animals did it. When it was dark enough, I left the body out on the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我杀了那家伙，把他切开一点，这样看起来就像野兽干的。等天黑了，我就把尸体丢在路边了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Figured a Legion patrol could easily find him here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得军团巡逻队在这里很容易找到他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, we can just pay the scouts away, but you never know with slaves. They're all desperate and shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常情况下，我们可以付钱给侦察兵，但如果是奴隶就难说了。他们都很绝望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you do to him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对他做了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dunno. Something Pre-War that was headless, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不晓得，战前那种没头的东西吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's a chicken?
ESP.TRADUIT: 鸡是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every man has his price, even Legionaries. And Niemann is a master at learning that price.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人人都有身价，军团士兵也不例外。而尼曼是了解这个价格的大师。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd have to ask him how he does it, because I don't know and I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你得问他是怎么做到的，因为我不知道，也不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you say you paid off Legion scouts?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你买通了军团的侦察兵？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How should I know? I already told you I'm paid to just wait around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么知道？我已经告诉过你了，我是被雇来在这里等的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How difficult is being a runner?
ESP.TRADUIT: 成为一名走私者有多难？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to escort caravans alongside my brother back in the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前和我哥哥一起在NCR护送商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two years ago, the cheapskate in charge thought he could cut us loose. Violently.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两年前，那个管事的吝啬鬼以为他能甩掉我们，用暴力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He smoked my brother, but I managed to get back at the bastard. I knew nobody would buy the fact that it was self-defense, so I went on the run.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他干掉了我哥哥，但我设法报复了那个混蛋。我知道没人会相信这是正当防卫，所以我逃跑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I managed to sneak past the river. I met one of Niemann's runners, and the rest is history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我设法溜过了那条河。我遇到了尼曼的一名走私者，接下来的事大家都知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What got you involved with the Tipton Gang?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么会跟蒂普顿帮扯上关系？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck?
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're being removed from command. Right now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被解除指挥权了。马上！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you? Yes, actually, you have the Mark. This might be the sign I've been looking for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吗？是的，事实上，你有徽记，这也许就是我一直在寻找的征兆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在感兴趣了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that job...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于那份工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: And?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spoke Asher and Ficus. When I got there, there were two dead Gila Monsters and a mutilated Brahmin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟阿舍和菲古斯谈过了。当我到那里时，有两只死去的大毒蜥和一头被肢解的婆罗门牛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm having a situation with some of my Legionaries. My two best Legionaries have become fascinated with a new herb brought in from the East.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的几个军团士兵出了点状况。我的两个最好的军团士兵迷上了一种从东方带来的新草药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's called Brush. Are you familiar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 叫做狐尾草，你熟悉吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a foul-smelling weed that one of our Legionaries brought back from Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种恶臭的野草，是我们的一个军团士兵从科罗拉多带回来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not something I'm familiar with. We have no laws governing it since it doesn't grow in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我熟悉的东西。我们没有管理它的法律，因为它不在亚利桑那生长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My two best Legionaries believe that it has combat benefits similar to Healing Powder, but they've made unusual comments while under its influence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的两个最好的军团士兵认为它有类似于治疗粉的战斗效果，但他们在它的影响下发表了不寻常的言论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to ban it, but then the only Legionary who opposed it I had to execute for desertion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来打算禁止它的，但后来唯一反对它的军团士兵因为逃兵被我处决了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what Mars wants me to do here. My Centurion has been of no help on this, simply telling me to make my own decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道玛尔斯想让我在这里做什么。我的百夫长也没帮上什么忙，只是让我自己做决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. Can you describe it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。你能描述一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a foul-smelling weed that one of our Legionaries brought back from Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种恶臭的野草，是我们的一个军团士兵从科罗拉多带回来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not something I'm familiar with. We have no laws governing it since it doesn't grow in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我熟悉的东西。我们没有管理它的法律，因为它不在亚利桑那生长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My two best Legionaries believe that it has combat benefits similar to healing powder, but they've made unusual comments while under its influence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的两个最好的军团士兵认为它有类似于治疗粉的战斗效果，但他们在它的影响下发表了不寻常的言论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was going to ban it, but then the only Legionary who opposed got kidnapped by raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本来打算禁止的，但唯一反对的军团士兵被掠夺者绑架了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know what Mars wants me to do here. My Centurion has been of no help on this, simply telling me to make my own decision.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道玛尔斯想让我在这里做什么。我的百夫长也没帮上什么忙，只是让我自己做决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. Can you describe it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许吧。你能描述一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a foul-smelling weed that one of our Legionaries brought back from Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种恶臭的野草，是我们的一个军团士兵从科罗拉多带回来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not something I'm familiar with. We have no laws governing it since it doesn't grow in Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是我熟悉的东西。我们没有管理它的法律，因为它不在亚利桑那生长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need you to speak to my best Legionaries. Their names are Asher and Ficus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要你和我最好的军团士兵谈谈，他们的名字是阿舍和菲古斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've assigned them to the Cow Field up north to respond to an increase in cattle attacks, and to let me think on it in peace.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把他们派到北部的牛场去应对越来越多的牛袭击事件，让我平静的思考一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know they still have some. Investigate it and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他们还有些。调查一下再回来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can help you with that. What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以帮你，你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I suppose it's not an urgent issue. Go about your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我想这不是个紧急的问题。走你的路吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能过几天吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It certainly is. So it didn't impair their fighting ability at all. Good to know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实是，所以这并没有削弱他们的战斗能力。那就好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'll allow its continued use. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我会允许它继续使用，阿舍和菲古斯也会回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They killed two Gila Monsters while under the influence. That's impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在药效作用下杀死了两只大毒蜥，真让人印象深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's true. Especially since we've had reports of mutilations in that region for a while now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此，特别是我们已经有报道称该地区有毁尸事件发生一段时间了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'm going to ban it. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我要禁止它，阿舍和菲古斯也要回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They let a Brahmin get mutilated while under the influence. That's dereliction of duty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在药效作用下肢解了一头婆罗门牛，这是玩忽职守。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The classic signs of chem use and frankly unacceptable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是使用化学药物的典型迹象，坦率的说，这是不可接受的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'm going to ban it. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我要禁止它，阿舍和菲古斯也要回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't remember what happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不记得发生了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you think?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tested Brush for myself with your other Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和你的其他军团士兵一起测试了狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not disqualifying. That just points to you having a weak nose. Did you have anything of substance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是不够格的表现，这只能说明你的嗅觉不灵敏。你有什么实质性的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it smells awful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 闻起来很难闻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The classic signs of chem use and frankly unacceptable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是使用化学药物的典型迹象，坦率的说，这是不可接受的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'm going to ban it. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我要禁止它，阿舍和菲古斯也要回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel dizzy from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得头晕目眩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. So, it's like Healing Powder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。所以，就像治疗粉一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'll allow its continued use. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我会允许它继续使用，阿舍和菲古斯也会回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I felt dizzy from it for a bit, but now I feel more focused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一段时间我觉得头晕，但现在我感觉更专注了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not disqualifying. That just points to you having a weak stomach. Did you have anything of substance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是不够格的表现，这只能说明你肠胃不好。你有什么实质性的东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel like throwing up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想吐。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course they did. What did you talk about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然了。你们都谈了些什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We talked about comics while smoking it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们边抽边聊漫画。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It reminded them of what we're fighting for. In that case, Brush could perhaps temper some of our angrier Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让他们想起了我们为什么而战。在这种情况下，狐尾草可能会缓和一些愤怒的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'll allow its continued use. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我会允许它继续使用，阿舍和菲古斯也会回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We talked about how sad it is that La Fantoma is choosing to be more like a man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈到夜魔侠选择变得更像一个男人是多么悲哀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this degenerate nonsense?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么堕落者的鬼话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That settles it. I'm going to ban it. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here. Here's your payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就解决了。我要禁止它，阿舍和菲古斯也要回来。这是你的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We talked about how La Fantoma had masculine urges.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们讨论了夜魔侠是如何有男性冲动的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is disgusting. You know what, I'm going to ban Brush. This idiocy is clearly a sign from Mars. And Asher and Ficus are coming back here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太恶心了。你知道吗，我要禁止狐尾草，这种愚蠢的行为显然是来自玛尔斯的信号。阿舍和菲古斯也要回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your payment, even if I'm not convinced you deserve it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的报酬，虽然我不认为你配得上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We talked about what Asher was doing to Ficus's Cram.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们讨论了阿舍对菲古斯的饱饱牌午餐肉做了什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My contubenium has been assigned logistics work, that is to say we are protecting the trade routes that the ranchers use to supply cow meat to the soldiers at the front line.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的十人队被分配了后勤工作，也就是说，我们要保护牧场主用来向前线士兵供应牛肉的贸易路线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fun? No, of course not. Service isn't supposed to be fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣？不，当然不是。服务不应该是有趣的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But it is important, even if the only real perk to this posting is that we have a steady supply of beef for our meals. I've been on the frontlines before, and that was no guarantee.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这很重要，即使这个职位唯一的好处是我们有稳定的牛肉供应。我以前也上过前线，并不能保证。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that a fun job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是一份有趣的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is, but while the continuous supply of beef is a welcome change from Hardtack, I long for the frontlines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此，但尽管牛肉的持续供应比硬面包更受欢迎，但我渴望前线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My soldiers are wasted here, babysitting a bunch of Dissolute cattle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的士兵在这里照顾一群放荡的牛，真是浪费。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sounds important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make them quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are correct. This is a processing contubernium that really only exists on paper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的。这是一个只存在于纸上的十人队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries for garrison are transferred to Chloride and then distributed where they are needed. Right now, that's the Chainway and Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 驻守的军团士兵被转移到克洛赖德，然后分配到需要的地方。现在是连环道和马尔帕斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as standing officers, I really only have five.
ESP.TRADUIT: 至于常备军官，我真的只有五个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look a little short of being a full contubernium.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的十人队看起来不完整。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am presently the highest-ranking officer here, but I report to Centurion Aetius in Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在是这里级别最高的军官，但我向在克洛赖德的百夫长埃提乌斯汇报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who runs Dolan Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁经营多兰泉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not a tour guide. Walk around and make your own observations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是导游。四处走走，自己观察一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me about the surrounding area?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我周围的情况吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not necessarily. Chems were everywhere in the Old World. It's one of the reasons Mars blasted it with the fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不一定。在旧世界，化学药物随处可见，这也是玛尔斯用大火摧毁它的原因之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm only concerned about their current, confirmable Brush use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只关心他们当前，可确认的狐尾草使用情况。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found an old ventbox with some chems in nearby. Maybe they were using?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在附近发现了一个装有化学药物的旧通风箱。也许他们在吸毒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, he will be accordingly punished. Chems, chems everywhere. I'll ban Brush. Better safe than sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，他将受到相应的惩罚。化学药物，到处都是化学药物，我会禁用狐尾草，有备无患。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you want a reward, yes? You get to choose how he dies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你想要报酬，对吧？你可以选择他的死法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I found him hiding a stash of drugs in Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我发现他在大晶石矿藏了一批毒品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, he will be accordingly punished. You want a reward, yes? You get to choose how he dies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，他将受到相应的惩罚。你想要报酬，对吧？你可以选择他的死法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I found him hiding a stash of drugs in Big Spar Mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我发现他在大晶石矿藏了一批毒品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, pull up a seat by the fire over the there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，在那边火炉边找个座位坐下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，为什么不呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, then. I guess let the Decanus know what happened here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。我想让什长知道这里发生了什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Callum? He was on a scavenging mission, but he has since gone missing. Should you find him, come back to me so that he may be executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡卢姆？他当时正在执行一项拾荒任务，但后来失踪了。你们若找到他，就回来见我，好把他处死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Callum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说卡卢姆。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes? I do have something for you. Not simple drug running. Are you interested?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？我确实有事情要交给你，不是简单的贩毒。你感兴趣吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you interested now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你现在感兴趣了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About your job offer....
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于你的工作提议...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Merchants and Legionaries from Colorado have brought a new drug known as Brush with them. It's a potent psychoative drug.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。来自科罗拉多州的商人和军团士兵带来了一种被称为狐尾草的新药，这是一种强效的精神药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My goal is to introduce the compound to mass Legion use, and I want your assistance with this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的目标是将这种化合物推广到军团中，希望你能帮助我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It exists in a gray area. Not quite chem, perhaps not quite Healing Powder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它存在于灰色地带。不完全是化学物质，也不完全是治疗粉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's definitely an herb, though, so the chances of adoption are quite high.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，它绝对是一种草药，所以被采用的几率相当高。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tried before with other compounds, but I've never been successful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也试过用其他化合物，但从来没有成功过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Legion bans drugs, how are you expecting them to adopt it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团禁止毒品，你指望他们怎么接受？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对他们来说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Isn't selling drugs directly to the Legion dangerous?
ESP.TRADUIT: 直接把毒品卖给军团不是很危险吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've concluded that the garrison Legionaries in the territory of Dolan Springs and Chloride will likely be the most receptive to Brush use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得出的结论是，多兰泉和克洛赖德地区的驻军军团可能最容易接受狐尾草的使用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My scouts have indicated that the Decanus at Dolan Springs has a number of Legionaries from Colorado under his command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的侦察兵发现在多兰泉的什长手下有很多科罗拉多的军团士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to speak to the man and persuade him that allowing the use of Brush is in the Legion's best interests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想让你和那个人谈谈，说服他为了军团的利益允许使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasant news. That advances the time table considerably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人愉快的消息。这大大推进了时间表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The next step is to expand the Brush trade. The resident Centurion in Chloride is a bad-tempered man, but not unreasonable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下一步是扩大狐尾草贸易。居住在克洛赖德的百夫长是个坏脾气的人，但并非不可理喻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak to him, and we'll see about having the garrison as a whole adopt the use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟他谈谈，我们会考虑让整个驻军都使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and a bonus for working ahead of schedule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有提前完成工作的奖金。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Decanus has actually already authorized the continued use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什长实际上已经授权继续使用狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Well, if speaking is no longer an option, the Decanus will have to go in a way that doesn't implicate us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。好吧，如果谈话不再是一个选项，那么什长就得以一种不会牵连到我们的方式离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's important that he not just die. He must be seen to have betrayed the Legion in some form.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不能就这么死了，这很重要。他一定要以某种形式背叛了军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My personal recommendation is inciting a mutiny against him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我个人的建议是煽动一场针对他的叛乱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if you're not skilled enough to do that, the alternative is to plant drugs on Quintus. Make his anti-chem rhetoric appear to be an attempt at misdirection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果你的技术不足以做到这一点，另一个选择就是在昆图斯身上栽赃毒品，让他的反化学药物言论看起来是一种误导。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Return to me when you've completed your task.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你完成任务后再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's going to be a problem. The Decanus recently banned Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就有问题了。什长最近禁止了狐尾草。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. Remember, it is imperative that the Decanus supports the use of Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了。记住，什长必须支持使用狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会处理的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Thank you for reporting this. You deserve some compensation for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了，谢谢你的举报。你应该为此得到一些补偿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have information regarding a chem distributor at Mount Tipton Cave. He's at this cave here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有关于蒂普顿山山洞的一个毒品经销商的消息，他就在这个山洞里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drug peddlers, distributors, users. All are to be crucified, their bodies made food for the crows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毒贩、分销商、吸毒者，他们都将被钉在十字架上，他们的尸体将成为乌鸦的食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I shall request a force to march and destroy the cave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我将请求一支部队进军并摧毁山洞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you going to do to Niemann?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要对尼曼做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Decanus Quintus [0600C2F7] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be on my way, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就先走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have had contacts with most of the important figures in Chloride. The business of Chloride is business, and I am a businessman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和克洛赖德的大多数重要人物都有过接触。克洛赖德的买卖就是买卖，我是个商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only man I haven't had the displeasure of speaking to is the resident consul, Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一没有不愉快交谈经历的人是常驻执政官阿里斯托芬提斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aetius confided in me that he wishes that he burn the whole of Chloride down some day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 埃提乌斯向我吐露，他希望有一天能把整个克洛赖德都烧掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know Aetius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么认识埃提乌斯的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Speak to him, and then return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。跟他说，然后再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get to it, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就直说了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Optio in Malpais is showing strong resistance to our efforts to introduce Brush to combat units.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯的执行官对我们将狐尾草引入战斗单位的努力表现出强烈的抵制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His overcautiousness is a major problem, so what you are going to do is spike the camp's water supply with Smooch powder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的过分谨慎是个大问题，所以你要做的就是在营地的供水系统里加入污吻粉末。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once some of his Legionaries are suffering from withdrawal, we will swoop in and offer Brush as a care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦他的一些军团正遭受戒断反应的痛苦，我们就会冲过去并提供狐尾草。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, the Brush will be partially spiked with Smooch, and once the Legion becomes more accepting of Brush, we will spike with lethal amounts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我们会先在狐尾草中少量掺入污吻，待军团逐渐接受狐尾草后，再掺入致命剂量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are we poisoning the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要给军团下毒？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Most of my employees don't care for the cause of hurting the Legion, but rest assured, it is a profitable endeavor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。我的大多数员工并不关心伤害军团的原因，但请放心，这是一个有利可图的事业。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Will I still get paid for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还能得到报酬吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, I'll speak to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会跟他说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have our foot in the door. If we don't kick open the door on the Legion's faces now, we will likely not have another chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经迈出了第一步。如果我们现在不一脚踹开军团的门，我们可能不会再有机会了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you need to get this through your head: Hurting the Legion is never wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要记住，伤害军团永远不会错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Legion needs to be reduced to the psychotic, chem-addicted heathens they were before they found Mars, so be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团需要沦为发现玛尔斯之前那种精神错乱、吸毒成瘾的异教徒，那就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This seems wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这似乎是错误的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, of course not. It was chump change that I spent up before I got to Calnevari.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，当然不在。那只是点零钱，我到卡内瓦里之前就花光了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But you're not here for the money. I know it. I know Isaiah. He wants you to kill me. So I'll ask you this: are you gonna?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你不是为了钱来的，我知道。我了解以赛亚，他想让你杀了我。所以我要问你，你会吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, do you have the money or not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那钱到底在不在你手上？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the Centurion of the Orientum Garrison, that is correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是东部驻军的百夫长，没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, given that you are not of the Legion and not under my command, you will more likely need to speak with Proconsul Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，鉴于你不是军团的人也不受我的指挥，你可能更需要和阿里斯托芬提斯总督谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这里的负责人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Business is the province of Aristophontes. I suggest you take it up with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商业是阿里斯托芬提斯的领域，我建议你和他谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have business to discuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有生意要谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Trade. Commerce. The business of the Liberti. They are everywhere here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贸易，商业，自由民的生意。这里到处都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no shortage of work for w... mercenaria. Like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雇佣兵...不缺活儿干，比如你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is there to do in Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在克洛赖德有什么可做的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you should be on the frontlines. Only mercenaries come here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就去前线吧，只有雇佣兵才来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a mercenary.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是雇佣兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. No comment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。无可奉告。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like this posting?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢这个岗位吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aristophontes is the man that Flagstaff has chosen to give power to here. He consorts with Calvin, the leader of White Sands Caravans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯是旗杆市在此地选定的掌权者，此人正与白沙商队首领卡尔文来往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is also Julius, the owner of the Pond, as well as his second, Kemper, who is in charge of the deputy Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有尤利乌斯，池塘的主人，以及他的副手肯珀，他负责军团的代理人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and avoid Cyanide Springs. It is a waste of space.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，还有，不要去山奈泉。这是在浪费空间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the important people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁是这里的重要人物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it did, I wouldn't tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算是，我也不会告诉你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it bother you not being on the frontlines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不在前线工作让你烦恼吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you sure?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I have to say on that is that it's a more difficult mining community to manage than Chloride, New Mexico. Here, there are....
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要说的是，这是一个比新墨西哥州的克洛赖德更难管理的矿业社区。这里是....
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't care for this posting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不喜欢这个职位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, you can tell me if you don't like this place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，如果你不喜欢这里，可以告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a special economic zone. Dissolute and Profligate market techniques are harnessed for the good of the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个经济特区。放荡者和挥霍者的市场技术被用来为军团的利益服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you go, you will interrupt the experiment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你去的话，你会打断实验的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's wrong with Cyanide Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 山奈泉怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll avoid Cyanide Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我会避开山奈泉的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aristophonotes described it as a project of independent commerce and caravan shareholder democracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯将其描述为一个独立商业和商队股东民主的项目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I can see, this experiment is a failure. I can't look at them and know they serve the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我看来，这个实验是失败的。我看不出他们是为军团服务的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then again, perhaps this is why I run the military. It's easier to know when that's the case.
ESP.TRADUIT: 话又说回来，也许这就是我掌管军队的原因。在这种情况下更容易搞清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What type of market techniques?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么类型的市场技术？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It appears so. As you can see, they have not been drawn and quartered, so their Profligacy must only be pretend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来是这样。正如你所看到的，他们没有被分尸，所以他们的堕落只能是假装的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar allowed this experiment to happen?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒允许这个实验发生？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you think so. Why don't you talk to someone else about it that is not me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你这么想。你为什么不和我以外的人谈谈呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很有趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Magnum Chasma. My father was one of the original seven tribes, I don't know which one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大裂谷。我父亲是最初的七个部落之一，我不知道是哪一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't matter anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正也不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My previous Centurion was going to launch a foolhardy attack on a heavily-fortified tribal camp in Roswell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的前任百夫长准备对罗斯威尔的一个戒备森严的部落营地发动一次鲁莽的攻击。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I told him that we did not have enough manpower or supplies to do so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我告诉他，我们没有足够的人力和物资来做这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He disagreed and stabbed me in the eye and broke five of my ribs. So, he led the attack himself and was beheaded when it inevitably failed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不同意，捅了我的眼睛，打断了我的五根肋骨。所以，他自己领导了这次袭击，在不可避免的失败后被斩首。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was subsequently promoted and given enough supplies to bring Roswell to its knees, which I did. They fought fiercely but ultimately surrendered.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我随后得到了晋升，并得到了足够的物资，足以让罗斯威尔屈服，我做到了。他们打得很激烈，但最终还是投降了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, I was transferred here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，我被调到了这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the eyepatch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 眼罩是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is certainly the high point of my life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这无疑是我人生的巅峰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sounds impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来很厉害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your disappointment is noted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我注意到了你的失望。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it? I'm kind of disappointed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这样？我有点失望。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Pity the Centurion. He lost his head. And his life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？可怜百夫长吧，他失去了他的脑子，还有他的生命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry that happened.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉发生了那样的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go talk to Aristophontes about that stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你去找阿里斯托芬提斯谈吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like to discuss politics?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想讨论政治吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told you to talk to Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说了让你去找阿里斯托芬提斯谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would you like to discuss politics?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想讨论政治吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I want to talk to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我就想跟你谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Have fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。玩得开心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think that both candidates are equally terrible and should be drawn and quartered, with their bodies scattered to the Four Corners of the Legion and their bones bleached in the sun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为这两个候选人都同样可怕，应该被分尸，让他们的身体分散到军团的四角，让他们的骨头在阳光下变白。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calvin's head should join the line of pikes we have in Kingman with the rest of those White Sands snakes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加尔文的脑袋该挂上金曼那排刺桩，和白沙商队其他卑鄙小人的头颅作伴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And Luke's body should be strung up from the tops of the windmills to the north, his eyes fed to the crows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卢克的尸体应该被吊在北边的风车顶上，把他的眼睛喂给乌鸦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这次选举有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the New California Republic?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对新加州共和国有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. They're the enemy. That's all there is to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦。他们是敌人，这就是全部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar states that they are degenerate, money-obsessed whores, probably similar to the ones in Cyanide Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒说她们是堕落的，为钱着迷的妓女，可能和山奈泉里的妓女很像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which means, that without Legion guidance, they must be worse than even this lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也就是说，没有军团的指导，他们肯定比这群人还糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the Proconsul of Mojave Orientum, which runs from...
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是莫哈维东部的总督，从...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, the map lines get redrawn all the time, so I'm not sure where its precise borders are. You'd have to ask him about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，地图上的线一直在重新绘制，所以我不确定它的精确边界在哪里。这事你得问他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The previous proconsul was a Decanus, but he's been transfered out to the frontlines. I believe we should go back to military rule, since that's when things were better, but Flagstaff says otherwise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 之前的总督是个什长，但他被调到前线去了。我认为我们应该回到军事统治，因为那时情况更好，但旗杆市不这么认为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm curious about Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对阿里斯托芬提斯很好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not concerned about another potential insurrection like what those fools allowed to happen in Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不担心另一场潜在的暴动，就像那些傻瓜允许在索利泰尔发生的那种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Liberti here are content with their riches and the limited power we give them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的自由民满足于他们的财富和我们给予他们的有限权力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The deputies are erratic but sentient enough to know that we will fucking end them if they revert to their miserable degenerate raider lifestyle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 代理人们很不稳定，但足够清醒，知道如果他们回到他们悲惨堕落的掠夺者生活方式，我们就会杀了他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, if I did find even a trace of anti-Legion activity or resistance, I would burn this whole town to the ground.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果我发现哪怕是一丝反军团抵抗活动的痕迹，我都会把整个小镇夷为平地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds like you don't like Chloride much. Do you think they're disloyal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你不太喜欢克洛赖德，你觉得他们不忠吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries don't vote. Only the Liberti caravans get a say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵不投票。只有自由民商队才有发言权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't believe we're tolerating this deg... this continued conversation. I'm not invested in these Liberti politics, so you should find someone who is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不敢相信我们居然能容忍这种情况...接下来的对话。我对自由民的政治不感兴趣，所以你应该找一个感兴趣的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But who are you voting for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是你要投谁的票呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sanity, at last.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于恢复了理智。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Makes sense to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说很有意义。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not your election to decide. Only the Liberti caravans get a say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是你能决定的，只有自由民商队才有发言权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, why don't you bother them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，你为什么不去打扰他们呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm still undecided.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没决定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It really doesn't matter. Do whatever Caesar permits you to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的不重要。凯撒允许你做什么，你就做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm supporting Calvin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我支持加尔文。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It really doesn't matter to me. Do whatever Caesar permits you to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这对我来说真的无所谓。凯撒允许你做什么，你就做什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm supporting Luke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我支持卢克

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. Joke....
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，笑话...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好的笑话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hurry up and ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快去问问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a drug called Smooch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一种叫“污吻”的药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made it to get ghouls high because most drugs don't work on us. But I've found that humans are a much better market.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我制造这个是为了让尸鬼兴奋，因为大多数药物对我们不起作用。但我发现人类的市场更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These are very diluted, but still high-quality crystals, meant for human consumption.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都是非常稀释，但仍然是高质量的晶体，适合人类食用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what new drug have you made for us?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你为我们研制了什么新药？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not one for pleasure, either. I call this drug here Smooch. Very potent, very nice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也不是一个喜欢消遣的人。我把这种药叫做"污吻"，非常有效，非常好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made it to get ghouls high because most drugs don't work on us. But I've found that humans are a much better market.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我制造这个是为了让尸鬼兴奋，因为大多数药物对我们不起作用。但我发现人类的市场更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look at these very high-quality crystals, meant for human consumption.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来看看这些高质量的晶体，供人类食用的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to get down to business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈正事了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A fellow chemist, yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个化学家同事，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct. It's disgusting. I've tried sweeteners so that it goes down easier, but the market on the Reservation simply doesn't exist.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确，很恶心。我试过用甜味剂让它更容易下咽，但保留地根本就不存在这种市场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I gave it to humans in paste form, it would probably be fatal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我把它以糊状的形式给人类，可能会致命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If humans are getting it as crystals, do ghouls inhale it as paste?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果人类是以晶体的形式获得它，那食尸鬼会以糊状的形式吸入它吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In testing, well over 90% by the third use. Very high addiction rate. Niemann was also interested in the rate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在测试中，第三次使用的人超过90%，成瘾率非常高。尼曼对这个也很感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the addiction rate for this on humans? Must be high. In the 90 percent range.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类对它的成瘾率是多少？一定很高，在90%左右。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you want, here's a free sample. In the interests of your continued ability to do business with me, I should warn you that it's very powerful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要，这里有一个免费的样品。为了让你能继续跟我做生意，我得提醒你这东西很厉害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: May I try it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以试试吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's like death herself is giving you a big old kiss, but to ghouls, it feels more like a smooch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像死神给了你一个大大的吻，但对食尸鬼来说，更像是一个吻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why's it called Smooch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么叫污吻？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. I'm sure those Legionaries will like what you're giving to them very much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。我相信那些军团士兵会非常喜欢你给他们的礼物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just hand me the shipment, and I'll be on my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把货给我，我这就走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead. Be careful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续，小心点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Might as well try it now. Make sure it works.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。不如现在就试试，确保它有效。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, just be careful when you use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以，只是你用的时候要小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. Maybe later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。以后再说吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, just be careful when you use it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以，只是你用的时候要小心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told Niemann it's a good sample.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉尼曼这是个很好的样本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah! That hits hard. Damn!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇噢！这可真够狠的。该死！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told Niemann it's a good sample.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉尼曼这是个很好的样本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Haha. This isn't...uh.... Fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈哈。这不是...呃...操。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already told Niemann it's a good sample.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经告诉尼曼这是个很好的样本。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This feels disgusting, and it feels good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 这感觉很恶心，也很好！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't like getting high? Well, I wouldn't be doing it on the job anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不喜欢嗑药？好吧，反正我也不会在工作中这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I feel awful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我感觉糟透了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell? It's diluted crystal, but not that diluted. You must have an extraordinarily high tolerance to practically all drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搞什么鬼？这是稀释的晶体，但没那么稀释。你对几乎所有的药物都有极高的耐受性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You might as well be a ghoul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还不如当个食尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't bring a bad sample to a first business meeting. I tested it yesterday.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会带坏样品去第一次商务会议。我昨天测试过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Niemann picked a person totally immune to drugs. I can't think of a better possible employee. You should go ahead and get going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尼曼选择了一个对药物完全免疫的人，我想不出比你更好的员工了。你该走了，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyways, take this cannister and head over to Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，带上这个罐子，去马尔帕斯吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't feel anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有任何感觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Try not to show up to Malpais high.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽量别在马尔帕斯嗑药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, whatever. I feel dizzy....
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随便了。我觉得头晕...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two words. Ghoul supremacy. Ghouls are better than humans at everything else, and that's a fact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个词，尸鬼霸权。尸鬼在其他方面都比人类强，这是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The stuff I learned in Resurrection's universities was light-years beyond what I learned in the streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在复苏大学里学到的东西比我在街上学到的要多得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm curious about The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对保留地很好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Albuquerque. Ol' ABQ. Grew up among some gangs on the north side of the the Rio Grande.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔伯克基，老ABQ。我在里奥格兰德北部的帮派里长大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spent a little too long too close to some radiation barrels. Woke up as a ghoul the next day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在辐射桶附近待的时间太长了，第二天醒来就变成了尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That sucked. Couldn't get high anymore, so I spent a decade learning how to fix that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太糟糕了。不能再嗑药了，所以我花了十年时间来学习如何解决这个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He reached out to me about two months ago. Told me that he was looking for drugs capable of getting ghouls for high for a project he was working on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他两个月前联系了我，他告诉我他在为他的一个项目寻找能让食尸鬼兴奋的药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It made sense to speak with someone from The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和保留地的人谈谈是有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have ventures out East, in the Rocky Mountains, but I've met some considerable resistance to market penetration.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在东部的落基山脉进行了投资，但在市场渗透方面遇到了相当大的阻力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How do you know Niemann?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么认识尼曼的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chemistry. Real chemistry. I had access to more equipment than I ever did on the streets. I have entire laboratories dedicated to the production of Smooch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 化学，真正的化学。我能接触到比在街上更多的设备，我有整个实验室专门用来制作污吻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you learn?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你学到了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It does. Niemann's one of the few with the foresight to understand this. That's why he and I are partners.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实如此。尼曼是少数几个有先见之明的人之一，这就是为什么我和他是搭档。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does ghoul supremacy extended to the chem trade?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尸鬼霸权是否延伸到了化学药物贸易领域？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a give-and-take with the guy in charge, but he has a more...ideological bent to this stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和负责的人达成了妥协，但他更...意识形态倾向于这种。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He hates humans. This drug will fuck up humans. He hates the Legion. It'll fuck them up, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他讨厌人类，这种药会毁了人类。他讨厌军团，他们也会完蛋的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is whoever runs the Reservation cool with you being a drug lord?
ESP.TRADUIT: 经营保留地的人对你当毒枭没意见吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I always knew he was unreliable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直都知道他不可靠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you for bringing this to my attention. The Decanus will be pulled from command and executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你告诉我这件事。什长将被解除指挥权并被处决。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose you're expecting a reward. I can spare a couple denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜你在期待报酬，我可以给你几个第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have evidence that Decanus Quintus is using drugs. Search his footlocker.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有证据证明什长昆图斯在吸毒，搜查他的锁柜。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I never liked Quintus. The punk was never really loyal. Always questioned orders. Talked about how he wasn't sure if Caesar wanted this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我一直不喜欢昆图斯。这个小混混从来没有真正忠诚过，总是质疑命令，说他不确定凯撒是否想要这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, we know that was a bold-faced lie. So, I'm fine with decriminalizing Brush.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，我们知道这是一个厚颜无耻的谎言。所以，我不介意让狐尾草合法化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to speak to you about the Brush discussion you've been having.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈你一直在讨论的狐尾草问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mutiny against Decanus Quintus is disturbing. I never would have expected Quintus to be disloyal and a chem user, no less.
ESP.TRADUIT: 针对什长昆图斯的叛变令人不安。我从没想过昆图斯会不忠，还嗑药。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quintus had banned Brush, but I'm considering overturning it given that he was obviously a spy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昆图斯禁止了狐尾草，但鉴于他显然是个间谍，我正在考虑推翻禁令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to speak to you about the Brush discussion you've been having.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈你一直在讨论的狐尾草问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, this is military business. Quintus's reports for its use are interesting. Some combat utility. I have no true opposition to this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，这是军事事务。昆图斯关于其使用的报告很有趣，有一定的战斗效用，我对此并不反对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am, however, concerned about the prospective suppliers. All of them would fit right in with the chem-dealing ilk that we exterminated in the past.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，我担心的是潜在的供应商。他们都和我们过去消灭的那些从事毒品贸易的人很像。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Executing merchants would upset Aristophontes, but drug dealers are a step too far to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 处决商人会让阿里斯托芬提斯感到不安，但对我来说，毒贩就太过分了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would need assurances that Brush is not being sold by chem dealers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我需要确保狐尾草不是由化学药物经销商出售的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to speak to you about the Brush discussion you've been having.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈你一直在讨论的狐尾草问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I congratulate you on your willingness to tell the truth unprompted. Rest assured, the Legion will take care of this immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我祝贺你自愿说出真相。请放心，军团会马上处理这件事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy this reward, preferably away from Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受这个奖励，最好远离克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't guarantee that. The main Brush supplier is a powerful drug dealer at Mount Tipton.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能保证。狐尾草的主要供应商是蒂普顿山一个强大的毒贩。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Caesar trusts you, how could I not? But, let me be clear, if Brush proves harmful to us in any way, I will drag your name through the mud.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果凯撒信任你，我怎么会不信呢？但是，让我说清楚，如果事实证明狐尾草对我们有任何危害，我会把你拖下水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. This is as good as Caesar's word.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，这正是凯撒所说的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Fine. I can appreciate the argument for it. Tell your backers that I will not seek for Brush to be criminalized.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]好吧，我很欣赏这种观点。告诉你的支持者，我不会让狐尾草被定罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But know that should we change our mind, you will be executed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但你要知道，如果我们改变主意，你就会被处决。
