ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that this post must be boring you. This is your chance to get noticed by leadership.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这个岗位一定让你感到厌烦，这是你得到领导注意的机会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I haven't made a decision yet. It's not obvious to me. So why don't leave and don't come back until you actually have something to say?
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败 ]我还没决定呢，对我来说不是很明显。那你为什么不走，等有话要说了再回来呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The benefits of Brush are obvious, aren't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 狐尾草的好处是显而易见的，不是吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get your shit together!
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我振作起来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, let me have some more time to decide.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其实，让我再多花点时间考虑一下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me that!
ESP.TRADUIT: 把那个给我！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've done well to bring this to my attention. I'll contact the garrison and have the cave expunged.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我注意到这件事，做得很好。我会联系守军，让他们把山洞清理掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This, of course, deserves some compensation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，这值得一些补偿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flavius Constantinus [06004BC0] (mod) Quest : ([06004BC3]AZMalpaisOptioDialogue) 06004BC3 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A drug cartel to the south of here at Mount Tipton gave me this to poison Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂普顿山以南的一个贩毒集团给了我这个，让我毒害马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I congratulate you on your willingness to tell the truth unprompted. Rest assured, the Legion will take care of this immediately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我祝贺你自愿说出真相。请放心，军团会马上处理这件事的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enjoy this reward, preferably away from Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 享受这个奖励，最好远离克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Aetius [06016CB0] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have information that a drug dealer is trying to have a Decanus killed. Here's where he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有消息说，有个毒贩想要杀掉一个什长。他就在这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 500 caps is no small sum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 500瓶盖可不是小数目。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你做生意很愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nine pouches of Smooch, just for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 九袋污吻，专为你准备的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你做生意很愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毒品方面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Smart. Okay, here's five Smooch pouches just for you, along with an additional 250 caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 聪明。好吧，这是给你的五袋污吻，外加250瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pleasure doing business with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和你做生意很愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Half in drugs. Half in caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一半毒品，一半瓶盖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 300 caps.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure if you're a reliable business partner, but you are welcome here anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定你是否是一个可靠的商业伙伴，但随时欢迎你来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. I'll tell you what. I have no further use for your services, but I can direct you to people who do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。我告诉你吧，我不再需要你的服务了，但我可以把你介绍给需要的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's got a lot of names. Haven, Freihafen, Moletown, Easytown, Hideaway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它有很多名字，港湾、自由港、鼹鼠镇、安逸镇、藏身处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right now, it's dormant, but you might be just what's needed to get the spark running again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，它处于休眠状态，但你可能就是重新点燃火花所需要的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go to the White Hills. Search the caves. You'll find it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去白山，搜索洞穴。你会找到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and take some spending money with you anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，记得带些零花钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the interest of proving that I am loyal, I am willing to forgo payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了证明我的忠诚，我愿意放弃报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Five pouches of Smooch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 五袋污吻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure if you're a reliable business partner, but you are welcome here anytime.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不确定你是否是一个可靠的商业伙伴，但随时欢迎你来这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Niemann [0601DF4B] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Drugs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毒品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not of the Legion, so I'm going to give you some advice. Legionaries don't do mutinies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是军团的人，所以我要给你一些建议。军团士兵不搞兵变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered taking out your Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有没有考虑过把你的什长干掉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm. You're not wrong. All this talk about what he's allowing us to do in our free time.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，你说得没错。他一直在说他允许我们在空闲时间做点什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Free time. I never had that problem before Quintus. I should be on the frontlines. Yeah, he needs to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 空闲时间，在昆图斯之前，我从未遇到过这种问题，我应该在前线。是的，他必须死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll move against him if you can get another to support it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能找到另一个人支持的话，我就反对他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Decanus can't put down a mutiny from his Legionaries, then he was never fit to command.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果什长不能平息他的军团兵变，那么他就永远不适合指挥。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] We know. Seriously, stop asking these stupid questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我们知道。说真的，别再问这些愚蠢的问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, how do know your Decanus isn't disloyal to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，你怎么知道你的什长是不是对军团不忠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. The word of someone who has actually spoken to Caesar matters more than the word of a fucking Decanus who's making us babysit cows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。一个真正跟凯撒交谈过的人说的话比一个让我们照看奶牛的什长说的话更重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll move against him if you can get another to support it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你能找到另一个人支持的话，我就反对他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have the Mark of Caesar. I have his ear. I'm telling you that this is what you need to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有凯撒的徽记，他听我的。我告诉你，这就是你该做的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Forget I mentioned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 忘了我说的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多次了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered taking out our Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你考虑过干掉我们的什长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you considered taking out our Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你考虑过干掉我们的什长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because he's getting old, and I don't trust weak, elderly men to lead the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为他老了，我不相信孱弱的老人能领导军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The future of the Legion belongs to the young men who carry out Caesar's will.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的未来属于那些执行凯撒旨意的年轻人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not on your advice. Go on, get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是你该提的建议。走吧，离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Negative Legion Rep] Then, you'd consider removing him?
ESP.TRADUIT: [负面军团声望]那么，你会考虑除掉他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you... a Frumentarius or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是...特务还是什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Mixed Legion Rep] Then, you'd consider removing him.
ESP.TRADUIT: [中立军团声望]那么，你会考虑除掉他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know what, sure. I've been looking forward to hearing what that coward sounds like when he's dying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，当然。我一直想听听那个懦夫临死时的声音。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Legion Rep] Then, you'd consider removing him?
ESP.TRADUIT: [军团声望]那么，你会考虑除掉他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's true. Lanius wouldn't disapprove of this....
ESP.TRADUIT: 这倒是真的。拉尼厄斯不会反对这个...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, get one of the others on board, and we'll launch the mutiny on your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，把其他人叫上来，你一发出信号，我们就发动叛变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you think Caesar would have died if Mars was happy? He's demanding Quintus's blood!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得如果玛尔斯高兴，凯撒会死吗？他要昆图斯的血！

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, get one of the others on board, and we'll launch the mutiny on your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，把其他人叫上来，你一发出信号，我们就发动叛变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quintus would have been killed storming Forlorn Hope. I should know. He needs to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昆图斯可能会在突袭飘零希望时被杀。我应该知道的，他该走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't trust you motherfuckers. Always scheming and plotting in the shadows. Yeah, this was a bad idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不相信你们这些混蛋，总是在暗地里策划阴谋。是的，这是个坏主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay....
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh, screw it. The Decanus needs to go. It blows up on us, it's your ass on the cross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，不管了。那个什长非死不可。要是搞砸了，你就会被钉在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, get one of the others on board, and we'll launch the mutiny on your signal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好，把其他人叫上来，你一发出信号，我们就发动叛变。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say no more. I'm in. The Decanus was going to punish me for following his orders. That type of rot should be purged from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用多说了，我加入。因为我听从了什长的命令，他要惩罚我，这种烂人应该从军团中清除出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, I owe you one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说，我欠你个人情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quintus is not fit to be a Decanus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 昆图斯不适合当什长。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I've been told that the raiders we killed were "Selig-Men". I thought we and the Twisted Hairs wiped them out years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人告诉我，我们杀死的掠夺者是塞利格人，我以为我们和卷发部落几年前就把他们消灭了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just goes to show that the Twisted Hairs deserved what they got along the I-40.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这恰恰说明了卷发部落在40号州际公路上的遭遇是罪有应得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did command think of you wiping out those raiders?
ESP.TRADUIT: 指挥官对你消灭那些掠夺者有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's back to watching cows. Boring work, but orders are orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又开始看牛了。无聊的工作，但命令就是命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Callum [06006D92] (mod) Quest : ([06008E4A]AZWhiteHillsMineDialogue) Subterranean Homesick Blues EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's next for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你接下来要做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not on your signal. You ratted us out to the Decanus for no reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 轮不到你发号施令，你无缘无故把我们出卖给了什长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd have to have done something exceptional for the Legion for me to change my mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你为军团做出了非凡的贡献，我才会改变主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you willing to take out the Decanus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你愿意干掉什长吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: How on Earth can you think it's degenerate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么能认为它是堕落的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking about burning my copy of La Fantoma tomorrow. I'm starting to think it's degenerate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我打算明天把我的《夜魔侠》烧掉，我开始觉得这太堕落了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It has a woman fighing villains. How is that not degenerate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 里面有一个女人在和坏人作战，这怎么就不堕落呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，去你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wouldn't that mean the comic is a product of a sick society?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这难道不意味着这部漫画是病态社会的产物吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're just saying that because you like looking at her mamma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么说只是因为你喜欢看她妈妈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't. The only way I can tolerate the comic is because Tongue Biter told me about the secret issue #59, which reveals that that she has a master who wants her to wear tight suits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不是。我能容忍这部漫画的唯一原因是舌咬告诉我秘密的第59期，其中透露了她有一个主人想让她穿紧身套装。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean by that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这话是什么意思？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Asher [060208A3] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She can't win in open battles, she has no allies, she has no connections, and she is depressed all of the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她无法在公开的战斗中获胜，她没有盟友，她没有关系，她一直很沮丧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, listen. She is only a worthy opponent because of her masculine urges, and that is the product of a sick society. It's a reminder of what we're supposed to be fighting for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，听着。她之所以是一个有价值的对手，只是因为她有男性的欲望，这是病态社会的产物。这提醒着我们应该为什么而战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, it's a tragic story of a person in a sick society. That's all I'm saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，听着。她之所以是一个有价值的对手，只是因为她有男性的欲望，这是病态社会的产物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that's why it's sad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么它是悲伤的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not convinced that issue exists. I've spoken with every trader who's passed through here. And "tolerates?" Is that what you call it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不认为这个问题存在，我和每一个经过这里的商人都谈过了。还有“容忍？”你是这么说的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([06020AF1]AZBrushQuest01CampfireQuest) 06020AF1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [You hear nothing.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [你什么也没听到。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, is anyone there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，有人在吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The door's unlocked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 门没锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fat-Eye sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 肥眼派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski?
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基 ?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's no way you're with the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不可能是军团的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The door's unlocked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 门没锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski sent me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The door's unlocked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 门没锁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clark [0601DF51] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Man in Black sent me here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑衣人派我来的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd be thinking about it too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也会考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before we get to it, I have to know. What's your interest in this? Is Isaiah paying you? I highly fucking doubt it, having known the man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们开始之前，我得知道。你为什么对这个有兴趣？以赛亚给你钱了吗？我他妈很怀疑，因为我认识他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm thinking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在考虑呢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'll blow your head -
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会爆头的...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah nah, I got this, man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不不，我能行，伙计！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lucky it jammed. You nearly shot your head off. You nearly shot your head off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你很幸运它卡住了，你差点爆头，你差点打爆自己的头。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me that gun back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把枪还给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah nah, I got this, man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不不，我能行，伙计！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me that shotgun back. What the hell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把猎枪还给我。搞什么鬼？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, you know what, you're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，你知道吗，你是对的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, no way, the other soldier can smoke it from the barrel. Amazing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，不可能，另一个士兵可以从枪管里抽。太神奇了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ficus [060208A4] (mod) Quest : ([060208A1]AZFreeformCowField) 060208A1 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Check this out. Put the Brush in the shotgun chamber. Press this bowl against it and blow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看好了，先把狐尾草塞进霰弹枪膛室，拿这个碗扣紧，然后吹气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes indeed, s'what I just told you. The ol' Chainway bit the dust, it did. Whole overpass went under. Now folks can't safely go nowhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，就像我刚才告诉你的那样。老旧的连环道被毁了，真的，整个立交桥都沉了下去。现在人们无处可去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But if you didn't take the road, where you comin' from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但如果你不走这条路，你从哪里来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The road north is closed?
ESP.TRADUIT: 北边的路关闭了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brave soul, ain't'cha? Must've fought off some nasty critters. How 'bout a drink? S'on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真勇敢，不是吗？肯定击退了一些讨厌的生物。喝一杯怎么样？我请客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, what brings you here? Must've come from somewhere, you did. Where you comin' from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么风把你吹来了？你肯定有什么来头。你从哪里来的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. I hiked through damn desert to get here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道。我穿过该死的沙漠才来到这里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That, I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个，我能做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's skip the small talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们跳过这些闲聊吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, that's no way to treat a friendly face. Wasteland's a cruel place, ain't no need to go barking at strangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，这可不是对待友好面孔的方式。废土是个残酷的地方，没必要对着陌生人狂吠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion didn't get rid of you nasty freaks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团还没除掉你们这些恶心的怪物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never heard of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从来没听说过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodsprings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 清泉镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I hate to be the one to tell you this, but'cha must've come full circle. Hehehe!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我不想告诉你这个，但你肯定又回到了原点。呵呵呵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The grave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坟墓。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Across the river? Must have some powerful friends, you do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 河对岸？你肯定有一些有权有势的朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维加斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Another bounty hunter? Tellin' you now, I got no alcohol.
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是赏金猎人？现在告诉你，我没有酒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 马尔帕斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should've guessed as much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 早该猜到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰泉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say I forgive you, but I can forget you. Now, what'll it be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能说原谅你，但我可以忘记你。现在，你想要什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I didn't mean it. I'm in a bad mood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我不是那个意思。我心情不好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't rightly abide by that. I won't serve you. Get out of my bar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能正确的忍受这件事，我不会为你服务的。滚出我的酒吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I meant it. You eyesores disgust me. The Legion should get rid of you all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的。你们这些讨厌鬼让我恶心，军团应该把你们都除掉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hehehe! Don't'cha get too excited now. Not the fun type o' drinks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呵呵呵！你现在别太激动了。不是那种有趣的饮料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a bar? Do you sell drinks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是酒吧？你们卖饮料吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have on tap?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么可选的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sally? The Handy? Just another old fossil on the Sunset Sarsaparilla contract, like me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莎莉？巧手？跟我一样，只是夕阳沙士合同上的另一个老古董。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Her and I are like two peas in the same pod, we are. Practically sharing a mind. How it goes, given we've been here since before the bombs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和她啊，简直就像一个豆荚里的两颗豌豆，真的。我们几乎心意相通，考虑到我们从核弹爆炸前就一直待在这里了，自然就是这样了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's a little grumpy but she don't bite. Nice gal, actually. She reads to me since I can't no more, on account of my blind eyes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她脾气有点暴躁，但她不咬人，其实是个好女孩。她给我读故事，因为我的眼睛瞎了，不能再读了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the deal with that robot outside?
ESP.TRADUIT: 外面那个机器人是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't need nobody else, don't think. I mix the drinks and she takes care of the rest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不需要别人，不需要思考。我调酒，她负责剩下的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Somebody causes trouble? I reach for my shotty and play like I ain't blind just long enough for her to sneak up and cut 'em down! <Chuckles.>
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人找麻烦了？我伸手去拿我的枪，假装我没有瞎，只是为了让她偷袭，把他们砍倒！<轻笑>
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it's just you and the robot here? Kind of a skeleton crew.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这里只有你和机器人？只是最基本的成员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'sure can. That'd be 5 denarii, and as far as I'm concerned you can keep the room. Lots of vacancies here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你当然可以。五个第纳尔，我认为你可以保留这个房间，这里有很多空房。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I rent a room?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以租一个房间吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: 5 denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 5第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How much was a room?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个房间多少钱？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. And here's your key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！给你钥匙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here you go. <Pay 5 denarii.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <支付5第纳尔>当然，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have 5 denarii? I mean no offense, but that's chump change. Come back when you've got the silver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 5第纳尔都没有？我无意冒犯，但那只是小钱。拿到银子再来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have that kind of money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可没那么多钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okie dokie.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好嘞好嘞。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, just on the other side o' this mountain here you'll find the Atlas Tower. Think there's a soldier or two there, workin' on fixin' it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，就在这座山的另一边，你会发现阿特拉斯塔。我想那里有一两个士兵在修理它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To the south you'll find Dolan Springs and the town of Chloride. Not many soldiers there, jus' folks livin' simple, or trying to get rich.
ESP.TRADUIT: 往南你会发现多兰泉和克洛赖德镇。那里没有多少士兵，只有过着简朴生活的人，或者想发财的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you give me a quick lay of the land? What's going on in this area?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我简要介绍一下这片土地吗？这一带发生了什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean now, or the ancient history?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说现在，还是古代？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Elephant Hill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我讲讲象山吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Couldn't tell you anything but what I see from here, and my eyes went bad long ago. Meanin', I've got nothin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了我在这里看到的，什么都不能告诉你，我的眼睛很久以前就坏了。意思是，我什么都不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Atlas Tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说阿特拉斯塔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's a little farm town. Good place to stop for a meal on your way north, but it ain't much more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是个农场小镇。这是你北上途中停下来吃顿饭的好地方，不过也仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Dolan Springs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说多兰泉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting little town. They deal in silver mostly, but the administrator there is a trailblazer, if I may be so bold. Aristophontes, they call 'im.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣的小镇。他们主要经营白银，但容我冒昧地说，那里的管理者是个先驱，他们叫他阿里斯托芬提斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'see, he's workin' with all the traders in town to turn it into a sort of local democracy. He's lettin' the traders have a say in how he runs things.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，他正在和镇上所有的商人合作，想把它变成一种地方民主。他让商人们对他的经营方式有发言权。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't argue with the results. Folks're makin' real money from it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 结果无可争辩，大家都在从中赚大钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说克洛赖德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Met him once. He had the right kind of attitude. Told me he wasn't interested in no 'shows of force', only makin' sure things're runnin' well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 见过他一次，他的态度很好。他告诉我，他对“炫耀武力”不感兴趣，只对“确保一切顺利”感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it weren't for his blessing, it's hard to say if I'd still be in business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果没有他的祝福，很难说我是否还在做生意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再跟我说说阿里斯托芬提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a humble highway stopover, this is. A place to rest your weary head on the way to somewhere else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是一个不起眼的高速公路中转站。在去往另一个地方的路上，一个可以让你疲惫的脑袋休息的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion don't give us much trouble. Nothin' here worth troublin' over. Just lost traders and sad old fogies like meself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不会给我们带来太多麻烦，这里没有什么值得麻烦的，只有迷路的商人和像我这样的老古董。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Chainway, that big ol' highway goin' north, fell down some time back. Most folk don't feel like bravin' the canyons, so they either stay here or turn back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 连环道，那条向北的大高速公路，一段时间前就塌了。大多数人不想在峡谷里冒险，所以他们要么留在这里，要么返回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back before Legion came, I used to mix drinks. Can't do that no more, but folks still come. Maybe it's 'cause I'm handsome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在军团来之前，我经常调酒。不能再这样了，但还是有人来，也许是因为我帅吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oooh can't you tell? Look around you. Sunset Sarsaparilla e'rywhere. This here hill is a genuine fake ghost town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢你看不出来吗？看看你的周围，夕阳沙士到处都是。这山是一个真正的假鬼镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Y'see, back in the old days, all those ruins you see 'round the desert used to be a curiosity. City folk would come from miles to see a ghost town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，在过去的日子里，你在沙漠周围看到的那些废墟曾经是一种奇景，城里的人会从几英里外赶来看一座鬼镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It must've been the 2060s or so when Sunset Sarsaparilla decided they wanted in on the business. Somethin' to compete with Nuka-Cola's theme parks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大概是在20世纪60年代，夕阳沙士决定要加入这个行业，可以和核子可乐的主题公园竞争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me, I've been here since, oh... I can't remember. But they brought me on as a cast member and had me playin' a bandit. Whistlin' Willie, I was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我，我从，哦...我不记得了。但他们让我当演员，让我演一个强盗，吹口哨的威利，我是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eventually, Whistlin' Willie was no more, and they put me on as a bartender. Damn good at it, too, I tell you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，吹口哨的威利不存在了，他们让我当酒保。我告诉你，我也很擅长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ancient history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古老的历史。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cause I'm a natural bartender, kiddo. We're like roaches, we are. Can't get rid of us even if you wanted to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我是个天生的酒保，孩子。我们就像蟑螂，没错。就算你想摆脱我们，也摆脱不了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, even the raiders loved me. Ne'er-do-wells couldn't harm a hair on my head, 'cause every gun in here would draw.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，连掠夺者都喜欢我。没本事的人伤害不了我一根头发，因为这里的每把枪都会开火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you make a good drink, you're untouchable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你调制出好酒时，你是不可撼动的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, this is my home. My blood, sweat, and tears are in it. No chance I'm leavin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再说，这是我的家，我的血，我的汗，我的泪。我绝对不会走的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you still here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么还在这儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hah! Maybe so. In my shoes, wouldn't you? Pouring Sunset Sarsaparilla and cactus water just ain't the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哈！也许是吧。换做是我，你不会吗？倒夕阳沙士和仙人掌水是不一样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to make a fine spirit called Ghost Venom. Sunset Sarsaparilla, whiskey, and a bark scorpion poison gland. Finest drink this side of the Colorado.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我曾经制造过一种叫鬼毒的好酒，夕阳沙士、威士忌，还有树皮蝎毒腺。科罗拉多河这边最好的饮料。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd love to taste it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很想再尝一次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you miss mixing alcoholic drinks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怀念混合酒精饮料吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Proportions are off. You must've done an even ratio of whiskey and sarsaparilla. Close, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比例不对，你一定是把威士忌和沙士的比例调平了。不过很接近了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Next time, try adding a jalapeno. Gives it an extra kick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 下次，试着加一点墨西哥辣椒。给它一点额外的刺激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't help but miss it. Folks'd come from all over to drink. Rangers and raiders at the same table. This place was alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我忍不住怀念它。人们从四面八方赶来喝酒，游骑兵和掠夺者坐在同一张桌子上。这里充满了生机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that's why it's a ghost town, eh? Me and the town - two old ghosts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这就是为什么这是一个鬼镇，对吧？我和小镇，两个老鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mixed a Ghost Venom Spirit. How's it taste? <Give Ricamore the drink.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把饮料给里卡莫尔>我调制了鬼毒灵。味道怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh... Well, no, they ain't. They're quite behaved. But I have heard some tales of strange happenings to the east of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦...嗯，不，他们不是，他们很乖。但我听说在这里的东边发生了一些奇怪的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said this is a ghost town? Are the ghosts a problem?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说这是个鬼镇？鬼魂是个问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Persona, eh? Look, kiddo, look at my face. Do I look like I'm playin' a part?
ESP.TRADUIT: 角色，嗯？看，孩子，看我的脸。我看起来像在扮演角色吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I couldn't stop doin' this if I tried. I can't remember much else. Alls I know is drinks and gossip and fucking sarsaparilla.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就是想停也停不下来。别的我都不记得了，我只知道喝酒，八卦，还有该死的沙士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can stop playing this persona. This isn't a tourist attraction anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以停止扮演这个角色了，这里已经不是旅游景点了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pshh. Ha! I knew I should've set up the tripwire welcome sign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噗，哈！我就知道我该设个绊线当欢迎标志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't really notice it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我并没有注意到。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahahah. I'm humbled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊哈哈哈，我受宠若惊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's very impressive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人印象非常深刻。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything can be a collection, especially junk. Look, I've collected two junkheads in one spot: you, and me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 任何东西都可以成为收藏品，尤其是垃圾。听着，我在一个地方收集了两个疯子，你和我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This junk is a collection?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些垃圾是收藏品？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That'd be my humble companion and canine life partner. Say hello, Nixon! Well, he's a man of little words.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是我卑微的伙伴和狗狗的生活伴侣。尼哥生，打个招呼！嗯，他是个沉默寡言的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I call him Nixon because he's Nic's son. Get it? I'm Nic and he's like my son.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫他尼哥生，因为他是尼哥的儿子。明白了吗？我是尼哥，他就像我儿子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Nixon?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尼哥生是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, I thought so too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，我也是这么想的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's funny. Clever wordplay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 挺有趣，聪明的双关语。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Whatever. What - the fuck - ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，随便，随...他妈的...便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，随便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We all belong outside, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们都在外面，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gross. Dogs belong outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真恶心，狗应该待在外面。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, bud. Look at the fucking shelves. I sell everything. You want a specialty item, go to Chloride.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，伙计。看看那些该死的架子，我什么都卖。你想要特别的东西，去克洛赖德找。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What exactly do you sell?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底卖什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay! Now we're talking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的！现在我们来谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to buy something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想买点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I get my goods from all over, man. You wouldn't believe the crap people just throw away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的货来自世界各地，伙计。你不会相信人们随手扔掉的垃圾。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those mannequins over there: sexy things, right? Found 'em in a dumpster!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那边的人体模型很性感，对吧？在垃圾桶里捡到的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry though, I gave those lovely ladies a home.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过别担心，我给了那些可爱的女士们一个家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And don't get me started on my taxidermies! It's an artform, not just a hobby. I take it very seriously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别让我开始我的动物标本！这是一种艺术形式，而不仅仅是一种爱好。我对此非常重视。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your collection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的收藏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to hear more? Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想听更多吗？当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your collection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的收藏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. When you look at art, a painting or a photo, you're looking at it from the outside. You're the observer. A voyeur.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。当你看艺术、绘画或照片时，你是在从外面看它。你是观察者，偷窥狂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, there's no place for you *in* it, no place for you to feel it in your body. Things like height and depth can be *seen*, but not experienced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，它没有你的位置，你的身体没有地方去感受它。像高度和深度之类的东西可以“看到”，但不能“体验”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Taxidermy, tableau, whatever the fuck you want to call it - it's that third dimension.
ESP.TRADUIT: 标本制作，群像，不管你他妈怎么叫，这就是第三维度。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When I make something tall, it feels real fucking tall. You feel it loom over you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我把东西做得很高的时候，感觉真的很他妈高。你感到它正在逼近你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Similarly, think of motion. It probably sounds ass-backwards but statue is the best way to convey motion, because every part has real physical mass. It's not a flat canvas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同样，想想运动。这可能听起来很落后，但雕像是传达运动的最好方式，因为每个部分都有真正的物理质量。它不是一张扁平的画布。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Explain the artistic merit to me. I don't get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我解释一下它的艺术价值，我不明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great question! I love a curious customer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问得好！我喜欢有好奇心的顾客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The collection's never finished. I'm always looking for more curios.
ESP.TRADUIT: 收藏永远不会完成，我一直在寻找更多的古玩。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, if you find anything, you should bring it to me. There's money in it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，如果你发现了什么，一定要带给我。你可以从中赚到钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is the collection finished, or are you still building it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 收藏完成了吗，还是你还在做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right? Thank you. I am so glad to meet another aesthete. These townies are fucking plebians, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对吧？谢谢你！我很高兴又认识了一位美学家。这些镇民都是他妈的平民，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess that makes sense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是很有意义的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the difference between art and junk?
ESP.TRADUIT: 艺术和垃圾有什么区别？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could paint you the most beautiful painting in the world and it'd have no actual value except to wipe your ass with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以为你画一幅世界上最美丽的画，但除了用来擦你的屁股外，没有任何实际价值。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, but this shit isn't art. It's junk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但这不是艺术，这是垃圾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You asked, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你问的，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow. I should've asked for the short version.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，我应该要个简短的版本。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dolan Springs. 'The DS', as I like to call it. We're just a little farm town. Radcows and radpigs and radcrops. The whole shebang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰泉，我喜欢叫它“DS”，我们只是个农场小镇。辐射牛、 辐射猪和辐射作物，所有的一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an election going on, but who gives a shit about that, right? As for amenities...
ESP.TRADUIT: 选举正在进行，但谁在乎呢，对吧？至于设施方面...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want food? Harlow at the Big Dog's your man. Doctor? That'd be Doc D. Fine women? None of those here, I'm afraid. Just nuns.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想吃东西吗？大狗的哈洛就是你要找的人；医生？那就是D医生；好女人？这里恐怕没有，只有修女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Dolan Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说多兰泉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion ladies. Cultists of Mars. This place is their command center.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的女士们，玛尔斯的信徒。这里是她们的指挥中心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nuns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 修女？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's some kind of secret club for Legion women.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个为军团女性开设的秘密俱乐部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When they tell you that they're only here to honor their god and work the farms, don't fucking believe them. There's something dark at play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果她们告诉你，她们来这里只是为了崇拜她们的神，在农场干活，别他妈的相信她们。有什么阴暗的东西在作祟。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen the 'santification rituals.' They bleed animals onto the soil - parade 'em around, throat cut.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我见过“圣化仪式”。他们把动物的血洒在地上，然后把它们的喉咙割开，让它们到处游行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that Calventia woman, I talked to her once and I felt like she was trying to kill me with her mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个叫卡文提亚的女人，我跟她谈过一次我觉得她想用意念杀了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch out around them. All I'm saying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小心她们的周围，我只是想说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说玛尔斯教团吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two dickheads competing over something. Thing is, I thought the Legion didn't want our dickheads competing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个白痴在竞争什么。问题是，我以为军团不想让这帮白痴竞争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me, I've got no qualms about competing with another man's dickhead. But the Legion doesn't like it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我呢，跟别的白痴竞争，我一点都不觉得内疚。但是军团不喜欢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, the election? It's Big Business against the Little Guy. Always bet on the Little Guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，选举？这是大企业对抗小人物。总是把赌注押在小人物身上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any thoughts on this election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这次选举有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, I've never actually measured. I'm all in on Luke though. He's a motherfucker who knows business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，我从来没有仔细斟酌过。不过我完全支持卢克，他是个懂生意的混蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, Calvin's only out for himself. Which is a problem, because I'm out for myself too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，加尔文只为自己着想。这是个问题，因为我也只为自己着想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's not to say that Luke isn't out for himself, but I'm a lot more like Luke than I am Calvin. If Luke helps himself, it helps me too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这并不是说卢克不为自己着想，但我更像卢克，而不是加尔文。如果卢克能自助，对我也有帮助。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're backing the little guy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你支持那个小人物？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说对了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nicodemus [06000803] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You as well. Now, did you need something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 见到你也是。现在，你有什么需要吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Nice to meet you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。见到你很高兴。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is reasonable for you to be boastful. But do bear in mind that most Legionaries will find it offensive. Now, did you need something from me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你自吹自擂是合理的。但请记住，大多数军团士兵会觉得这是一种冒犯。你有什么事找我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Finally, someone shows me the respect I deserve.
ESP.TRADUIT: 终于有人对我表示了应有的尊重。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I assure you, it is mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我向你保证，是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: The honor is all mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的荣幸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's very rare for Caesar to grant his Mark to anyone, much less a Profligate. For you to be a woman as well? You must be something truly special.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒很少把他的徽记给任何人，更不用说一个浪荡子了。为了你这个女人吗？你一定很特别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Honored? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 荣幸？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, hello. Did you need something from me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，你好。你需要我做什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. Hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，嗨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just skip the pleasantries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们就不寒暄了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The rough translation is 'Dolan Temple of Mars'. It's our only temple in the Mojave Orientum region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 粗略的翻译是“多兰玛尔斯神殿”，这是我们在莫哈维东部地区唯一的寺庙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From here, our Cultists manage all the Dissolute settlements of the region. Spiritually and logistically.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这里开始，我们的信徒管理着这一地区所有的放荡者定居点。精神上和后勤上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Templum Martis Dolan - tell me about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰玛蒂斯庙堂，给我讲讲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about the Cult of Mars again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我们再来谈谈玛尔斯教团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An incredible number of wastelanders worship some sort of ridiculous myth or Pre-War legend. Snake gods, radiation, reincarnation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大量的废土人崇拜某种荒谬的神话或战前的传说。蛇神、辐射、轮回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These myths are not productive, nor conducive to a functioning, harmonious society. If snake-worshipping savages could live peacefully, they would have done so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些神话没有成效，也不利于社会的运转和和谐。如果崇拜蛇的野蛮人能够和平的生活，他们早就这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the Cult of Mars' task to put these people on the path towards moral, righteous living.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团的任务是让这些人走上道德、正义的生活道路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this spiritual management.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我讲讲这种精神管理吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, often so. Most Wasteland religions, though false and nonsensical, share common traits, which we utilize to bring these savages closer to truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，经常如此。大多数废土上的宗教，尽管是虚假和荒谬的，但都有共同的特征，我们利用这些特征让这些野蛮人更接近真理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For example, almost every Wasteland religion has a great calamity - an earthquake, or a flood. We know that this calamity was the Cleansing Fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 例如，几乎每一个废土宗教都有一场大灾难...地震或洪水。我们知道这场灾难就是净化之火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And? Are you successful?
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后呢？你成功了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what makes that so? Because it was a war? A war cannot be spiritual?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是为什么呢？因为这是一场战争？战争不能是精神上的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am familiar with your Profligate theology. Two great armies fought until the world was destroyed. None of it is incompatible with the truth of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的堕落者神学很熟悉。两支伟大的军队一直战斗到世界毁灭，这一切都与玛尔斯的真相相符。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was ultimately Mars' will that the world be cleansed. You think this was not Him because it was done in war? All great changes occur through war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 净化世界是玛尔斯的最终意志。你觉得这不是他干的，因为这是在战争中？一切伟大的变革都是在战争中发生的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, let me stop you. You mean the Great War? There was nothing spiritual about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，让我打断你一下。你是说战前？这没有任何精神上的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ultimately the task becomes convincing the Profligates that their religion is correct in some ways, and incorrect in others. An easier task than discarding everything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终的任务是说服堕落者相信他们的宗教信仰在某些方面是正确的，而在另一些方面是错误的。这比抛弃一切更容易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep listening.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <保持倾听>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many Profligate settlements are run poorly. They reject a stable economy, instead prioritizing trade and squandering the resources they already have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多堕落者的定居点经营不善。他们拒绝稳定的经济，反而把贸易放在首位，浪费他们已经拥有的资源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult of Mars works to ensure that a settlement's production is robust and bountiful. If the settlers cannot farm, we teach them. If they cannot herd, we teach them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯教团的工作是确保一个定居点的生产是稳健和丰富的。如果移民不会种地，我们就教他们，如果他们不会放牧，我们也教他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We show the Dissolute what devotion can achieve. Fertility, of body and soil. Favorable seasons. Water, be it from rain or Legion caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们向放荡者展示了虔诚所能达到的效果。身体和土壤的肥力，四季宜人，水，无论是来自雨水还是军团商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the end, these settlements cannot afford to reject us. Our assistance is an undeniable and welcome boon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最终，这些定居点承受不起拒绝我们的代价，我们的援助是无可否认的、受欢迎的恩惠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the logistics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说后勤。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to ask you about your religion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想问一下你的宗教信仰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is the veil of a Priestess. It is meant to dehumanize us in the eyes of the Legionaries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是女祭司的面纱，是为了让我们在军团士兵的眼中失去人性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with that mask you're wearing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你戴的面具是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries are taught that women are subordinate to men. We're meant to be homemakers, mothers. For a woman to be a holy agent of Mars? Unfathomable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵们被教导女人要从属于男人，我们注定要成为家庭主妇，母亲。让一个女人成为玛尔斯的神圣使者？难以理解。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is easier to relinquish our womanhood than to get a Legionary to accept us as women with authority. Many of us keep our hair short for this reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放弃我们的女性身份比让一个军团士兵接受我们作为有权威的女性要容易得多。出于这个原因，我们中的许多人都留短发。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To enforce this distinction, there are rules we must follow. Modesty, chastity. Above all - never show a Legion man your weakness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了加强这种区分，我们必须遵守一些规则。谦虚，贞洁，最重要的是，永远不要向军团士兵展示你的弱点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would you want to dehumanize yourselves?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们为什么要让自己失去人性？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it scares you, that means it's working. See nothing in my visage but the black of Tartarus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果它吓到你，那就说明它起作用了。在我的脸上，除了塔耳塔洛斯的黑色，什么也看不见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's scary. Can you take it off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太可怕了，你能把它脱下来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not so bad. You learn to get your release through other means - like penance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没那么糟。你学会通过其他方式获得解脱，比如苦修。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Modesty and chastity? That sounds terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谦虚和贞洁？听起来很可怕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, a man could not be expected to be modest nor chaste.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，不能指望一个男人谦虚或贞洁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Modesty and chastity? That sounds terrible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谦虚和贞洁？听起来很可怕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Perhaps.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]也许吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think fire is the closest we can get to Mars. He cleansed the Earth in fire, and so for us to wield fire, it's like we're wielding a part of Him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为火是我们能到达的最接近玛尔斯的地方。他用火净化了大地，所以我们使用火，就好像在使用他的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before the Legion, I was a chem fiend. Only seventeen years old and already an addict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加入军团之前，我是个恶魔帮。才17岁，就已经是个瘾君子了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars saved me. When I feel lost or confused, I use fire to remind myself of my devotion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯救了我。当我感到迷失或困惑时，我用火来提醒自己我的奉献。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you feel that you need penance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得你需要忏悔吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Do not pry.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不要打探。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, can you elaborate?
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，你能详细说明一下吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, of course not. But you are something special altogether.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，当然不是。但你总的来说很特别。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As a free woman, am I an affront to Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个自由的女人，我是否冒犯了玛尔斯？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Daughter of Mars...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯的女儿...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Chuckles.> Hmm. Maybe you are!
ESP.TRADUIT: <轻笑>嗯，也许你是！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: And what should the Daughter of Mars be christened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯的女儿应该被命名为什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. I am special. I'm the Daughter of Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。我很特别，我是玛尔斯的女儿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Modesty? Hmm, modesty. As is our place, perhaps. You really are perfect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谦虚？嗯，谦虚。也许我们的地方也是如此。你真的很完美。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not special. I'm just a normal woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没什么特别的，我只是一个普通的女人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, but that's where you're wrong. The Legion has had great men. Lanius, the Legate before him. You would only have been another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那你就错了。军团中不乏伟人，拉尼厄斯，他的前任特使。你只会是另一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is special about you is that you are not a man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的特别之处在于你不是一个男人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am special, but my gender has nothing to do with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很特别，但这与我的性别无关。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are truly inspiring.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真会鼓舞人心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: The only thing special about me is my dedication to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的特别之处在于我对军团的奉献。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Then you shall be Venus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。那你就是维纳斯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Venus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维纳斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Then you shall be Concordia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。那你就是孔科耳狄亚了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Concordia.
ESP.TRADUIT: 孔科耳狄亚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Then you shall be Augusta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。那你就是奥古斯塔了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Augusta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯塔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Then you shall be Invicta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。那你就是因维克塔了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Invicta.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因维克塔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny. Blasphemous, too. I'll forgive it, but do not get false notions of your place. You are still a servant to Caesar, and he is second only to Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣，这也是亵渎神明。我可以原谅你，但不要对你的地位有错误的认识。你仍然是凯撒的仆人，而他的地位仅次于玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar II.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒二世。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh? Do you want an advisor, or a chambermaid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢？你想要一个顾问，还是客房服务员？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wouldn't be right. For a myriad of reasons, it wouldn't be appropriate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是不对的。出于种种原因，这并不合适。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I'm to be the Daughter of Mars, I'd want you by my side. You could be my personal advisor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我是玛尔斯的女儿，我会希望你在我身边。你可以做我的私人顾问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The internal affairs of the Cult are not your business. I will not exploit loopholes or technicalities to justify sin. I'm not some common whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 教团的内部事务不关你的事。我不会利用漏洞或技术细节来为罪恶辩护，我不是什么普通的妓女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: These 'friendships' you speak of are pure degeneracy, a slippery slope into full blown Profligacy. That... fucking perversion has no place in the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你所说的这些“友谊”纯粹是一种堕落，一种滑向全面堕落的斜坡。那...该死的变态在军团是没有容身之地的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize, but I've done much thinking on this. It's just wrong. Head Priestess Pompeia made Mars' sentiment quite clear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，但我想了很多。这是错误的，首席女祭司庞培很清楚地表达了玛尔斯的情绪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: I try to honor that sentiment as best I can. I'm not perfect, I stray, but thoughts are not actions. In the eyes of Mars, actions are what truly matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尽我所能尊重这种情感。我不完美，我彷徨，但思想不是行动。在玛尔斯的眼中，行动才是最重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's nothing wrong with friendships, is there? With so many women in the Cult, it must be common.
ESP.TRADUIT: 友谊没什么不好的，不是吗？教团里有这么多女性，这肯定很普遍。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Let us say nothing further on the topic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。关于这个问题我们就不多说了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I understand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. But this stays between us. I don't think the Cult would be amused.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。但这是我们之间的秘密，我不认为教团会觉得好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm honored.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很荣幸。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. Moving on...
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。继续...

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's stupid. Please don't use that name for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太愚蠢了，请不要用那个名字称呼我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is the Father of War and of Creation. War and Creation are one in the same.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是战争和创造之父，战争和创造是一体的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Conflict, death, change - this is the nature of the world. It is only through war that anything new can be born.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冲突、死亡、变化...这就是世界的本质。只有通过战争，新事物才能诞生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since Mars is the Father, men are made in His image. Masculinity is a divine virtue. Feminity is the Venusian counterpart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为玛尔斯是父亲，所以男人都是按照他的形象造出来的。男子气概是一种神圣的美德，女性气质是维纳斯的对应。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From your perspective, what is Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 从你的角度来看，玛尔斯是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a metaphor. Though you can see Mars in the sky, He is not the only thing in the sky. There are others. Jupiter, Mercury, Venus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个比喻。虽然你可以在天空中看到火星，但它并不是天空中唯一的东西，还有其他的。木星、水星、金星。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are not like Mars. Mars is alive and the others are, in a sense, dead. They are not the Father of Creation, but they carry some spiritual meaning to us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们不像火星。火星是活的，而其他的星球，在某种意义上说是死的。它们不是造物之父，但它们对我们仍有一些精神意义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Venus is said to be the planet most connected with femininity.
ESP.TRADUIT: 金星被认为是最能体现女性气质的行星。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, Venusian?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，金星？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar is the son of Mars, as I'm sure you know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒是玛尔斯的儿子，想必你也知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Filled with despair over the Profligacy running rampant in His creation, Mars pierced himself with a holy lance and bled into our mortal world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯对他创造的世界中堕落的行为感到绝望，他用一支神圣的长矛刺穿了自己，血流进了我们这个凡人的世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He roared in agony as He bled, and He used that fury to burn the world. That blood spilled into the oceans and seeded the birth of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他痛苦地咆哮着，流着血，他用他的愤怒烧毁了世界。鲜血洒向海洋，孕育了凯撒的诞生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How does Caesar fit into this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒是如何融入其中的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a theological concept, not necessarily meant to be taken literally, though it should be absorbed as if it were literal regardless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个神学概念，不一定要从字面上理解，尽管它应该被吸收，就像它是字面上的一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before now, the Cult's tradition has been of oral storytelling. Poems and allegories. Songs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在此之前，教团的传统是口头讲故事、诗歌和寓言、歌曲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The spoken word is clumsy and sparse. There was no room for these details to be passed down. It had to be simplified.
ESP.TRADUIT: 口语笨拙而稀疏，这些细节已经没有空间传下去了。它必须被简化。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of this is changing. As we speak, Head Priestess Pompeia communes with Mars and puts His words to paper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都在改变。就在我们说话的时候，女祭司庞培正在和玛尔斯交流，并把他的话写在纸上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When our Legion has Vegas and California under its thumb, the laws of Mars shall be followed to the letter, with no room for error or interpretation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们的军团控制了维加斯和加利福尼亚，玛尔斯的法则必须严格遵守，不能有任何错误和解释的余地。
