ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a revolution in the Cult. These are wonderful times.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是教团的一场革命，这是美好的时代。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the holy lance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我圣矛的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad you're interested. It's rare that I get to discuss these finer aspects of our religion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴你感兴趣。我很少有机会讨论我们宗教的这些更美好的方面。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's really fascinating. I didn't expect the Legion to have such a rich mythology.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这真的很吸引人，我没想到军团会有这么丰富的神话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. That's enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有意思。这就够了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're free to feel that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有这种感觉是自由的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What a crock of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是一派胡言。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does it mean for something to be literal? The only things that are literal are fire and blood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 字面意思是什么？唯一真实的东西就是火和血。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you believe all of this literally happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你相信这一切真的发生了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are those who live lives of debasement, of treachery and self-interest. They lie, cheat, steal. This is degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人过着低俗、背叛和自私自利的生活。他们撒谎、欺骗、偷窃。这就堕落
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Profligate families exist in isolate, with no common cause, no allegiance. A Profligate nation is only a collection of individuals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落的家庭是孤立存在的，没有共同的事业，没有忠诚。 堕落的国家只是个人的集合。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even in the NCR, men are made to fend for themselves. Merchants are allowed to scheme and manipulate, to the detriment of all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 即使在NCR，人们也不得不自谋生路。商人被允许策划和操纵，损害所有人的利益。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Women are forced to the frontlines of war. They're told that they are equal to men, and this false belief drives them to ruin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 妇女被迫奔赴战争前线。她们被告知她们和男人是平等的，而这种错误的信念使她们走向毁灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars finds this all abhorrent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯认为这一切都令人憎恶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you explain the concept of degeneracy to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能给我解释一下堕落的概念吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. It's of utmost importance that they do. Young boys are raised to know His presence, but tribal converts must be indoctrinated into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这是至关重要的。年幼的男孩被教导要知道神的存在，但部落的皈依者必须被灌输这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Without Mars, a soldier is weak and fearful. Only when you know your cause is righteous, can you overcome the fear of death, and learn to love killing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有了玛尔斯，士兵就会变得懦弱和恐惧。只有当你知道自己的事业是正义的时候，你才能克服对死亡的恐惧，学会热爱杀戮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do all Legionaries believe in Mars?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的军团成员都相信玛尔斯吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: From Caesar. His edicts are interpreted by the Head Priestess and put into practice by the Cult.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来自凯撒。他的法令由女祭司解释，并由教团付诸实践。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where does the word of Mars come from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯这个词是从哪里来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a simple and practical one - evil is a corrupting force. Mars' Cleansing Fire was not enough. The evil left untouched simply spread again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个简单而实际的道理——邪恶是一种腐化的力量。玛尔斯的净化之火还不够，未被触及的邪恶只会再次蔓延。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From the very moment the ash cleared, the surviving Profligates resumed their wickedness. Pillaging, gambling, fornicating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从灰烬消散的那一刻起，幸存的堕落者又开始了他们的罪恶。抢劫，赌博，通奸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These people cannot be allowed to keep bringing humanity to ruin. It need not be our fate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不能让这些人继续毁灭人类，这不必是我们的命运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mankind must be something more than a pack of snarling dogs, killing each other for scraps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人类肯定不只是一群咆哮的狗，为了残羹剩饭互相残杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars commands us to be unflinching in our brutality. Every drop of blood spilled for Him is an act of devotion and love.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯命令我们，要在残暴中毫不退缩。为他洒下的每一滴血都是一种奉献和爱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A better world is made possible through the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通过军团，一个更美好的世界成为可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the religious justification for all the atrocities the Legion commits?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对于军团犯下的所有暴行，宗教上的理由是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars says no such thing. Women are not less than men, only different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯没有这么说。女人并不比男人低，只有不同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If a woman were to try and become a soldier? Yes, she would be lesser than a man. She would be weaker, smaller, more vulnerable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果一个女人想要成为一名士兵？是的，她不如一个男人。她会更弱，更小，更脆弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But men are worse at many things women excel at. Men cannot nurture children, for example.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但在许多女人擅长的事情上，男人不如女人。例如，男人不能养育孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a woman. How can you preach a religion that claims you're inferior to men?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个女人，你怎么能宣扬一种声称你不如男人的宗教呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating question. I assume you already know about how we are meant to live - in purity and chastity, honoring strength and loyalty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣的问题。我想你已经知道我们应该如何生活...纯洁和贞洁，尊重力量和忠诚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fallen soldiers are cremated when possible, so as to return to Mars most easily.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阵亡士兵在可能的情况下被火化，以便最容易回到玛尔斯的怀抱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When our soldiers die in great numbers, the site of the battle is consecrated and a rite is given.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们的士兵大量牺牲时，战斗地点就会成为神圣之地，举行仪式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In December we have the Crest Mass in preparation for springtime. We sacrifice bulls and other animals to bless our harvests.
ESP.TRADUIT: 十二月，我们举行波峰弥撒，为春天做准备。我们祭祀公牛和其他动物来祝福我们的丰收。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Beyond sacrificing bulls, bullfighting is common at our festivities. It's always fun to see our soldiers turn into matadors. Some of them are very good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了献祭公牛，在我们的庆祝活动中，斗牛也是很常见的。看到我们的士兵变成斗牛士总是很有趣的，其中有一些非常好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the Legion's religious customs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的宗教习俗是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some years ago, the most devoted of us would celebrate the day of the Cleansing Fire by painting our foreheads with ash.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几年前，我们中最虔诚的人会在额头上涂上灰烬来庆祝净化之火的日子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After Hoover Dam, it became a fad among slaves. They wore ash with no respect to Mars. They said it was the ashes of the Burned Man!
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛大坝之后，它在奴隶中成为一种时尚。他们面带灰烬，不尊重玛尔斯，他们说那是火烧人的骨灰！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were doing it to mock us, as if that traitor still lives because they wear him on their faces. So Caesar banned the practice in its entirety.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们这么做是为了嘲笑我们，就好像那个叛徒还活着，因为他们把他涂在脸上。因此凯撒完全禁止了这种做法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep listening.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <保持倾听>

ESP.ORIGINAL: You would do better to ask the historians at the Universitas Caesaris. As a Priestess, I only know our stories, which I'm sure are incomplete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好去问凯撒大学的历史学家。作为一名女祭司，我只知道我们的故事，我确定这些故事并不完整。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Originally, the Cult was a small council of women - wives of the chieftans of the First Tribe. Head Priestess Pompeia is said to be of this group.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最初，教团是由第一部落酋长的妻子组成的一个小型议会。据说首席女祭司庞培就是这个团体的成员。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were no Maidens, only Priestesses. Together, they codified the Legion's holy doctrine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有女侍，只有女祭司。他们共同编纂了军团的神圣教义。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Cult was small and insular, with little influence. Mars was displeased by this. He demanded the Cult to grow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 教团规模小，思想狭隘，没有什么影响力。玛尔斯对此很不高兴，他要求教团发展壮大。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He struck many women infertile, and Caesar understood this as a sign. Those women were being called to a new purpose. They were made into Maidens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他使许多女性无法生育，凯撒认为这是一个征兆。这些女性被召唤去实现一个新的目标，她们被塑造成女侍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was a lifeline. The war with the ghouls had bled the Legion for months. The Maidens were crucial support in a time when the Legion was in disarray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一条生命线。与食尸鬼的战争已使军团消耗了数月的血汗，在军团陷入混乱的时候，这些女侍起到了至关重要的支撑作用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Cult's history.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说教团的历史。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Far east of here, there is a heavily-fortified compound of mutants, ghouls, and other such abominations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这里的东面，有一个由变种人，食尸鬼和其他令人憎恶的生物组成的戒备森严的建筑群。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They had a very high demand for slaves. The Legion also had a demand for slaves. Naturally, the two clashed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们对奴隶的需求非常大，军团对奴隶也有需求。自然，两者发生了冲突。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those ghouls are Profligate beasts. They use profane weaponry - chemicals, radaition.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些食尸鬼是堕落的野兽。他们使用亵渎的武器...化学武器，辐射武器。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a shame that we parlayed with them. It would be better to remove them from this world completely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 遗憾的是我们和他们讨价还价了，最好将他们从这个世界上彻底清除掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's this 'war with the ghouls'?
ESP.TRADUIT: “与食尸鬼的战争”是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You know nothing. It disgusts me how you people can only see the world through the lens of your Profligacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你什么都不知道。我很厌恶你们这些人只能通过堕落的眼光来看待这个世界。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happens to us is what Mars plans for us. The means by which He brings us to our fate is not important.
ESP.TRADUIT: 发生在我们身上的事情就是玛尔斯为我们计划的，他将我们引向命运的方式并不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said radiation-based weaponry? Radiation can cause infertility. It was no sign from Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的是辐射武器？辐射会导致不孕。这不是来自玛尔斯的信号。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understood. I have more questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了。我还有更多的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two Profligates vie for the Legion's favor. The people here are only concerned with money. I find it sickening.
ESP.TRADUIT: 两个堕落者在争夺军团的青睐。这里的人只关心钱，我觉得这很恶心。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Profligate cannot, and should not, govern.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个堕落者不能也不应该执政。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: From where would his power come? Not from Mars. Not from Caesar. A savage intends to rule over the righteous? Don't make me laugh.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的力量从何而来？不是来自玛尔斯，也不是来自凯撒。一个野蛮人想统治正义的人？别逗我笑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pray that Lanius arrives before this town descends into degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我祈祷拉尼厄斯能在小镇堕落前到达。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any thoughts on the town election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对镇选举有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Proconsul Aristophontes? He is hardly Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯总督？他不是个军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have never seen him pray. I have never seen him fight. I have never seen even an ounce of zeal in him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从未见过他祈祷，我从没见过他打架。我从未在他身上看到一丝热情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems perfectly content smiling and shaking the hands of the merchants who stalk this place. He serves them before he serves the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他似乎非常满足地微笑着，与在这里徘徊的商人握手。他先为他们服务，再为军团服务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the administrator of this region.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个区域的管理员。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have heard tales of him carrying out mass sacrifices of his own slaves in preparation for large battles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说过他在准备大型战役时大规模牺牲自己奴隶的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His capacity for destruction and slaughter is truly breathtaking. Mars surely smiles upon him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的毁灭和屠杀能力确实令人惊叹，玛尔斯一定会对他微笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe he is with Head Priestess Pompeia in Flagstaff now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信他现在和首席女祭司庞培娅一起在旗杆市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对拉尼厄斯特使有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have courage, to speak that name to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有勇气，对我说出那个名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Anger

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some said that the Burned Man was a medicine man for a Profligate religion, before he came to the Legion. Perhaps he was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人说，在他加入军团之前，火烧人是一个为堕落宗教服务的巫医。也许是吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man I knew seemed to worship not Mars, nor some Profligate god, but himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识的火烧人似乎不崇拜玛尔斯，也不崇拜什么堕落的神，只崇拜他自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe that is why he failed the Legion. His supreme arrogance blinded him to Mars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信这就是他让军团失望的原因，他极度的傲慢使他看不到玛尔斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of the Burned Man?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对火烧人有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所愿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Priestess Calventia [0600E68B] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The night is still young. Or maybe it's day. I don't know, haven't been outside in a while. Point is, you've got time to think it over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 夜还早呢，或者是白天，我不知道，有段时间没出门了。重点是，你有时间好好考虑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Before we get to it, I have to know. What's your interest in this? Is Isaiah paying you? I highly fucking doubt it, having known the man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我们开始之前，我得知道。你为什么对这个有兴趣？以赛亚给你钱了吗？我他妈很怀疑，因为我认识他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have my horny... um... horners. Bighorners. Keep me company. Item purchase with Legion. Trade them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有我的脚...嗯...大角，大角羊，陪着我吧。购买军团物品，贸易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing out here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hi. Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗨，好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're a trader? Will you trade with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是商人？你愿意和我交易吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么卖的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cow-tle mutations? Brahmin? I hear nothing. What hampering? Happening?
ESP.TRADUIT: 牛子姐？婆罗门牛？我什么也没听到。花生了什么？发生了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you heard anything about the cattle mutilations?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说牛被肢解的事了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别操心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My are safe. Bighorn are safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的很安全，大角羊很安全。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brahmin are turning up dead in this area. People are worried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 婆罗门牛的尸体在这个地区不断出现。人们很担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk what? Like what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 说什么？像什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you talk like that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么那样说话？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Repeat after me: dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我念：狗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Conducksin asia? No! Sorry. Big hit to my train. Skull. Super sludge. Sledge hammock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 船倒性湿鱼症？不！对不起，我的老子受到重创，头骨，超级带吹，吊力锤。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can understand me, but can't repeat my words. Conduction aphasia?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能听懂我的话，但不能重复我的话。传导性失语症？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I don't know, but there's something wrong with your brain.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不知道，但你的大脑肯定有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Neel. Neel-dle.
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Needle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 针头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billing. Ding. Bill-ding.
ESP.TRADUIT: 煎，煮，煎...煮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Building.
ESP.TRADUIT: 建筑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rerv. Rever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和，和牛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: River.
ESP.TRADUIT: 河流。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone hit you over the head with a Super Sledge?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有人用超级动力锤砸了你的头？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Worst of here. Cauliflower. New Clarifier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个西，角利弗尔聂，新甲胄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lesion nice to me. They're not like Encore. No, um, Enslave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 菌屯对我很好，他们不像安可，不，呃，硬壳卵，
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like it here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢这里吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just like cooking my meek. Um... sheep pink. Meat. Bighorn meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是喜欢煮我的漏。呃...羊粉色，肉，大角羊的肉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Nimrod [0601EB6D] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you following the region's politics?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你关注该地区的政治吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There ain't nothin' ridiculous about winnin', ma'am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胜利没什么可笑的，女士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a ridiculous name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字太可笑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There ain't nothin' ridiculous about winnin', sir.
ESP.TRADUIT: 胜利没什么可笑的，先生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a ridiculous name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字太可笑了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think so? Thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么认为？谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cool name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很酷的名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have a name realer than the one I gave you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有比我给你的名字更真的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about a trade? You give me yours, I'll give you mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 做个交易怎么样？你把你的给我，我就把我的给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. What's your real name?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。你的真名是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No ma'am, I said the Winnin' Kid. The Whatever Kid is someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，夫人，我说的是胜利之子。随便小子是另一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在开玩笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便，小子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No sir, I said the Winnin' Kid. The Whatever Kid is someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，先生，我说的是胜利之子。随便小子是另一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just playing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是在开玩笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便，小子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was born Declan. I don't respond to it no more, so don't try.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我出生时叫德克兰。我已经不回应了，所以别再试了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. I'm &PCName;.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我是&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a travelin' gunslinger. Like Billy the Kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个旅行枪手，就像比利小子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what's your deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你做什么生意？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To make a name for myself. I want to be a hero, like those old Ranger legends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了让自己出名。我想成为英雄，就像那些老游骑兵的传说一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you traveling and gunslinging?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要到处旅行，到处打枪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My hometown, Bagdad, used to be run by slavers. Called themselves the Reichardt Company.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的家乡，巴格达，曾经被奴隶贩子统治。自称为赖夏特公司。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They basically owned everyone and everything. The only job in town was working at the mines. And you couldn't leave. The road out was locked up tight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们基本上拥有所有人和一切。镇上唯一的工作就是在矿上工作，你不能离开，出去的路被封锁得严严实实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This was all before I was born, so I never knew these slavers. My parents did, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些都发生在我出生之前，所以我不认识这些奴隶贩子。不过我父母是这么过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where did you learn so much about the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从哪里知道这么多游骑兵的事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Duels?
ESP.TRADUIT: 决斗吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about your duels.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你的决斗吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was a travelin' gunslinger. He rode around on a ghoul horse, killing and robbing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个旅行枪手。他骑着一匹食尸鬼马，四处杀戮和抢劫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billy the Kid?
ESP.TRADUIT: 比利小子？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pretty certain there was a ghoul horse. The Rangers hanged him. Billy, not the horse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很确定有一匹食尸鬼马。游骑兵绞死了他，绞死了比利，不是马。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Billy the Kid is a Pre-War legend. There was no ghoul horse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比利小子是战前的传奇人物，没有食尸鬼马。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I don't mean to brag, but I'm the quickest draw in Bagdad. Wikieup too. Congress, and Wickenburg. Second quickest in Salome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是想吹牛，但我在巴格达拔枪最快，在威基阿普也是，康格雷斯，还有威肯堡。萨洛米第二快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care about Billy the Kid. Tell me about being a traveling gunslinger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不在乎什么比利小子，跟我说说你是怎么当旅行枪手的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some guy named Chapel Church. He looked old to me, so I figured he was slow. Didn't realize he was the town badass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫查普尔·丘奇的人。我觉得他看起来很老，所以我猜他行动迟缓，没想到他是镇上最厉害的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only the second quickest in Salome?
ESP.TRADUIT: 在萨洛米只是第二快？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't learn. I just picked it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有学过，我刚捡起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where'd you learn to shoot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在哪学的射击？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Damn right. The Rangers know how to live. Kickin' ass and doin' good are all that matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太对了。游骑兵懂得如何生活，打人和做好事才是最重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are a good role model. More people need to follow the Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是一个很好的榜样，需要更多的人追随游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on. Don't say that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拜托，别这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Rangers were worth anything, they wouldn't have lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果游骑兵还有价值，他们就不会输了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe losing ain't so bad if you do it honorably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你光荣的去做，也许失败也没那么糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean it. It's stupid to glorify losers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是认真的，颂扬失败者是愚蠢的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you say that, but I don't know. They really did lose, didn't they? They ain't here no more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你是这么说的，但我不知道。他们真的输了，不是吗？他们已经不在这里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I'll have to think about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我得考虑一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, I didn't mean it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，我不是那个意思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you joking? Is that a trick question? They're badasses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在开玩笑吧？这是个陷阱问题吗？他们是坏蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One man rides into town, hat castin' shade over his face. A silver pistol sits on his hip. He doesn't make no fuss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个人骑着马进城，帽子遮住了他的脸，一把银色的手枪放在他的臀部。他没有大惊小怪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But by the time he rolls out of town, all the thugs and fiends are run off or dead, and the women are hollerin' his name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但当他离开小镇的时候，所有的暴徒和恶魔帮都跑了或死了，女人都在喊他的名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's so good about the Rangers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵有什么好？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, we don't have to pit two great things against each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我们没必要让两个伟大的东西互相对立。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aren't the Rangers the Legion's mortal enemies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵不是军团的死敌吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your point?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想说什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they fought each other in real life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们在现实生活中互相争斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well... I don't know. What's the difference?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯...我不知道。有什么区别？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're opposed to each other. Only one side can represent your values.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是对立的，只有一方可以代表你的价值观。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. I figure they both fight bad guys, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我想他们都是在打坏人，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The difference between the Rangers and the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵和军团的区别是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, don't worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，别在意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。我也不在乎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah. That's how I see it. They keep the little guy safe from raiders and the like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，对，这就是我的看法。他们能保护小家伙不受掠夺者的伤害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But the important part is that they keep us safe without goin' overboard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但重要的是，他们能保证我们的安全，而不会太过火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are the good guys. They fight for freedom and self-determination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是好人，他们为自由和自主而战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so? They don't really intervene unless there's a real reason to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 应该是吧？除非有真正的理由，否则他们不会干预。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But they don't take any shit either. They ain't afraid to kill a bad guy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但他们也不容忍挑衅，他们不害怕杀死坏人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Rangers are the better of the two, because they know how to leave people alone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 游骑兵是两者中更好的，因为他们知道如何不打扰别人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I see that. We can have our freedom, but what about freedom to be a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我看到了。我们可以有我们的自由，但是成为一个掠夺者的自由呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If freedom means freedom to kill and rob each other, maybe folks can't be trusted with freedom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果自由意味着互相残杀和抢劫的自由，也许人们就不能被信任拥有自由。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are the good guys. They ensure safety no matter what.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是好人，他们无论如何都能确保安全。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not sure about that. Degenerates, sure, but what's wrong with weaklings?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太确定。堕落，当然，但软弱的人有什么问题？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My little brother was a weakling. Could hardly walk on his own. In the end he was too weak to go on livin'. But he had a good soul.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的小弟弟是个弱者，他几乎不能自己走路。最后他虚弱得不能再活下去了，但他有一个善良的灵魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion are the best option. They purge the wasteland of degenerates and weaklings.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团是最好的选择。他们清除了废土上的堕落和软弱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sometimes violence is what's called for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有时我们需要暴力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bad guys are gonna use violence no matter what. If good guys don't fight back, the bad guys win.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坏人无论如何都会使用暴力。如果好人不反击，坏人就赢了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're both terrible. They only seek to impose their will on others through violence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们都很糟糕，他们只会通过暴力把自己的意志强加于人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: One day a Ranger rolls into town. He makes like he's there to buy, so the Reichardts take him to their leader.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一天，一个游骑兵来到镇上。他假装是来买东西的，所以赖夏特带他去见他们的首领。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thing is, the Ranger was lying. He blasts King Reichardt, then the guards too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问题是，游骑兵在撒谎。他先是袭击了赖夏特王，然后又袭击了守卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right as this happens, the slaves down in the mines revolt. They start swinging at the guards with their pickaxes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这时，矿井下面的奴隶起义了，他们开始用鹤嘴锄攻击守卫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep listening.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <保持倾听>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, so that's that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess the Ranger felt some sort of affection for us, because he kept visiting long after the Reichardts were gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜那个游骑兵对我们有某种感情，因为在赖夏特完蛋很久之后，他还一直来看我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think his name was Bark... something. Barksdale, maybe. I met him a couple times. He always had great stories.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得他的名字叫巴克...什么的，也许是巴克斯代尔。我见过他几次，他总是有很棒的故事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Keep listening.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <保持倾听>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Yeah, well... I don't actually duel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！是的，嗯...我其实不决斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, people don't really like to duel. Certainly not the people I've met. Most people don't fancy gettin' shot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，人们其实不喜欢决斗，我认识的人肯定不。大多数人不喜欢挨枪子儿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So we usually set up two bottles, stand side-to-side, and draw. Whoever's bottle pops first wins.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我们通常会摆上两个瓶子，并排站着，然后拔枪。谁的瓶子先爆开，谁就赢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you're the quickest draw in Bagdad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你是巴格达最快的枪手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, it ain't. It's dumb. I know it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不是，这很愚蠢。我知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that most people around these parts are normal folks. There ain't any raiders or gangsters for me to duel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是这里的大多数人都是普通人，没有什么掠夺者或黑帮跟我决斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a clever workaround.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是个聪明的变通办法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so. It's nice to show off my aim and my speed, but there ain't no stakes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么想。炫耀我的准头和速度固然不错，但又没有赌注。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that most people around these parts are normal folks. There ain't any raiders or gangsters for me to duel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是这里的大多数人都是普通人，没有什么掠夺者或黑帮跟我决斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is shooting bottles good enough for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 对你来说，打瓶子就够了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know. You're right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道，你说得对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that most people around these parts are normal folks. There ain't any raiders or gangsters for me to duel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是这里的大多数人都是普通人，没有什么掠夺者或黑帮跟我决斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You shouldn't sell yourself as a hero when you've got no experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当你没有经验的时候，你不应该把自己标榜为英雄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not? I'm slingin' the gun around, ain't I? Slingin' in out of my holster. I just ain't a murderer, is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不是？我四处挥舞着枪，不是吗？从我的皮套里弹射出来。我只不过不是杀人犯，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's just that most people around these parts are normal folks. There ain't any raiders or gangsters for me to duel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是这里的大多数人都是普通人，没有什么掠夺者或黑帮跟我决斗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's stupid. You're not a real gunslinger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这太愚蠢了，你不是真正的枪手。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It hadn't crossed my mind. Where do you think I should go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没想过，你觉得我该去哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you thought of going somewhere else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想过去别的地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion's still fightin' up there, right? I've heard there's all sorts of nasty tribals. Like werewolves, and cannibals who eat people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团还在那里战斗，对吧？我听说有各种各样令人讨厌的部落，比如狼人和吃人的食人族。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I wonder if the Heartbreak Hotel is still open, or if the Rangers got those slavers for good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在想“心碎旅馆”是否还在营业，游骑兵是否永远干掉了那些奴隶贩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, friend. I'll put some thought into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，朋友。我会好好考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go north to Utah and Colorado. That land is still lawless and wild.
ESP.TRADUIT: 向北走到犹他和科罗拉多，那片土地仍然是无法无天的荒野。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think so? Way I hear it, it's mostly cattle ranchers and tribals out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么认为吗？据我所知，那里主要是牧场主和部落。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! But the Rangers! The Rangers are from that ways, ain't they? Maybe I could pick up where they left off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢！但是游骑兵！游骑兵就是从那边来的，对吧？也许我可以继承他们的遗志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, friend. I'll put some thought into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，朋友。我会好好考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go east to Texas. Bring law to that wide open desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 往东去德克萨斯，把法律带到那片开阔的沙漠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard bad things about Mexico, to tell you the truth. I was talkin' to some Legionaries and they say the fighting is real nasty.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我听说了很多关于墨西哥的不好的事。我和一些军团士兵聊过，他们说战斗很激烈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently there are Rangers down there, but they're not real Rangers - they joined up as soldiers with the California Republic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然那里有游骑兵，但他们不是真正的游骑兵...他们作为士兵加入了加州共和国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Word is these Rangers are... well... they're killin' folk. Innocent folk. They're working with raiders to do it. Grim stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据说这些游骑兵...嗯...他们在杀人，无辜的人。他们正在和掠夺者合作，可怕的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But maybe that's the kind of place that could use a hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也许那才是需要英雄的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, friend. I'll put some thought into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，朋友。我会好好考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go south to Mexico. The war is even worse down there. People need protecting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 往南去墨西哥。那里的战争更惨烈，人们需要保护。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. That's an idea.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是个主意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To tell you the truth, I'm a little scared of whatever's out there. Profligates and the like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我有点害怕外面的一切。堕落者之类的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everybody robbin' and cheatin' each other, whorin', plus all the chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都在抢劫，互相欺骗，嫖娼，还有所有的化学药品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But maybe that's the kind of place that could use a hero.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但也许那才是需要英雄的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, friend. I'll put some thought into it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，朋友。我会好好考虑的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go west to California. The NCR isn't as safe as they say. A gunslinger could do a lot of good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 往西去加利福尼亚。NCR并不像他们说的那么安全，一个枪手能做很多好事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ain't gonna sit here and be grateful that I'm supposed to die as some miner.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我才不会坐在这里庆幸自己应该以矿工的身份死去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know that's the life that was written for me - something boring and pointless, just like everyone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道这就是为我量身定做的生活...无聊而毫无意义的生活，就像其他人一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It ain't gonna happen. Not doin' it. Fuck that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不会发生的，我不干，去他妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're gonna remember who I am. You're gonna hear about me again. That's a promise.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会记得我是谁的，你会再次听到我的消息的。这是我的承诺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should be grateful that you live somewhere safe. Lots of people aren't so lucky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该庆幸自己住在一个安全的地方，很多人都没有这么幸运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 比如谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are villains around, they're just more mundane than you expect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坏人无处不在，他们比你想象的要平凡得多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand why everyone has problems with the Legion. They seem fine enough to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白为什么每个人都对军团有意见，在我看来已经足够好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, they ain't the friendliest, but they keep things in order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，他们不是最友好的，但他们让事情井井有条。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I've got no problem with Profligates. Can't say I feel the safest around them, but they ain't all bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我对堕落者没有意见。我不能说和他们在一起最安全，但他们也不都是坏人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Profligates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堕落者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think so? Donna seems nice enough to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么认为吗？唐娜在我看来还不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ghouls and mutants.
ESP.TRADUIT: 食尸鬼和变种人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then I guess we're in the belly of the beast, ain't we? Best keep your voice down, before they hear us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我猜我们是在野兽的肚子里了，不是吗？在被他们听到之前，你最好小声点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Traders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 商人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I doubt it. You don't seem that bad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对此表示怀疑，你看起来也没那么坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know... I think I believe you. Christ.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道...我想我相信你。天哪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll just try to stay on your good side, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就尽量站在你这边好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. I'll figure out eventually, probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，也许我最终会知道的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know who. That's for you to determine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道是谁，这要由你来决定。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，我们聊点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I made it down to the town of Quartz. It's a pretty big deal in some of the Ranger legends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我成功到达了阔茨塞特。在一些游骑兵传奇里，这可是很重要的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The story goes that a raider named King Devil lorded over the town. He had everybody payin' tribute to him. He killed for fun and ruled with fear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 传说有一个叫恶魔王的掠夺者统治着这个城镇，他让每个人都向他进贡。他以杀戮为乐，以恐惧统治。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, the Rangers show up. They drive King Devil off, and set up a fort at the town that they use to wage war on the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，游骑兵出现了。他们赶走了恶魔王，并在镇上建立了一个堡垒，用来与掠夺者作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I went to see it for myself. Turned out to be kind of a dump.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我就亲自去看了。结果变成了个垃圾场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See anything interesting on your travels?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在旅行中看到什么有趣的事了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, there were no Rangers to be seen. Just Legionaries and salvagers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没有看到游骑兵，只有军团士兵和拾荒者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's this big radioactive facility a little to the south of Quartz. Think it was called Bloomfield. Apparently it's good pickings, if you survive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在阔茨塞特的南边有一个很大的放射性设施，应该叫布卢姆菲尔德。很显然，如果你能活下来，这是个不错的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Most of the salvagers just sit on their asses, though. Scared of actually salvaging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，大部分的拾荒者都是坐以待毙。害怕真正的拾荒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Quartz was a dump? How so?
ESP.TRADUIT: 阔茨塞特是个垃圾场？怎么会这样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I actually tried to take a look myself. Went with a group of mercs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我自己也试着去看了看，和一群雇佣兵一起去的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We made it maybe a third of the way to Yuma when we started seeing these ghoul things shamblin' up the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们去尤马的路走了三分之一的时候，我们开始看到这些尸鬼在路上游荡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wasn't no ordinary ghoul, though. It was charred black, and parts of its body were cracked open. Inside, was fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过可不是普通的尸鬼。它被烧焦了，身体的一部分裂开了，里面是火。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thing actually left footsteps of fire as it walked.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它走路的时候还留下了带火的脚印。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Apparently they used to be NCR and Legion soldiers. Somebody blew up one of the Bloomfield rockets, and the radiation and rocket fuel turned everybody into monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 显然他们曾经是NCR和军团的士兵。有人炸毁了布卢姆菲尔德的一枚火箭，辐射和火箭燃料把每个人都变成了怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, the monster took a swing at one of the mercs and his shirt caught fire. He survived, but it scared us all off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，怪物朝一个雇佣兵挥了一拳，他的衬衫着火了。他活了下来，但把我们都吓跑了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Bloomfield.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说布卢姆菲尔德。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not really the best person to ask. I ain't been here long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问我这个问题不太合适，我来的时间不长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, hey, you see that letter C up on the hill outside of town? The Chloride C, they call it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，嘿，你看到城外山上的字母C了吗？他们叫它克洛赖德C。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We had one just like it in Bagdad. Well, it was a different letter. The Bagdad B.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在巴格达也有一个类似的，嗯，是一个不同的字母。巴格达B。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can you tell me about Chloride?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能跟我说说克洛赖德吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You seen the energy weapons merchant? What a woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看到那个能量武器商人了吗？多好的女人啊。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think she likes me much, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我觉得她不怎么喜欢我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I like Miss Wen. She's a sweetheart. And I like Harris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我喜欢温小姐，她是个可爱的人。我也喜欢哈里斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's Rima too, but she's... Well, I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有瑞玛，但她...嗯，我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about the people? Lots of interesting people here. Anyone I should look out for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那人呢？这里有很多有趣的人。有什么需要我注意的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm not old enough to vote. I asked, but Aetius told me you have to be at least 20.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我还没到投票的年龄。我问过，但埃提乌斯告诉我至少要20岁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wouldn't get much of a say regardless. Don't have much to my name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 反正我也没多少发言权，名下没有多少财产。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you following the town election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你关注镇选举了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I used to smash skulls like Bear, that was chill. But now I get to keep the crew fed, keep everyone happy. I like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我以前也像大熊一样砸碎头骨，太酷了。但现在我得喂饱成员，让大家开心，我喜欢这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Back when I was out raiding we only had slaves cooking back at camp. None of them were very good. Kyle says my cooking is way better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 以前我外出掠夺的时候，营地里只有奴隶做饭。他们都不太好，凯尔说我的厨艺好得多。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure was! It started back in New Mexico, before we all moved out here. Ask anyone and they'll tell you how crazy I was. It was awesome.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然是！这要从新墨西哥州说起，在我们搬到这里之前。随便问一个人，他们都会告诉你我当时有多疯狂，太棒了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But something happened on the way over here. A tribal arrow, with poison. It made it so I couldn't run so good anymore. So now I cook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是在来的路上发生了一些事情。一支带有毒药的部落箭，这让我再也跑不动了。所以现在我做饭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You used to be a raider?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以前是掠夺者？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's see...
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我看看...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's on the menu today?
ESP.TRADUIT: 今天菜单上有什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah! You ever hear of Gila Monsters?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的！你听说过大毒蜥吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything I can do to help out around here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. They got these big eggs, Bear killed a Gila once and gave me one. I scrambled it up for the whole crew! Kyle said "Good Job, Gristle."
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。它们的蛋有这么大，大熊有一次杀了一只大毒蜥，给了我一个，我给全体成员都炒了一份！凯尔说：“干得好，软骨。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was really cool. I would love to do it again. If you bring me one, I'll let you have some, too. I can even teach you how to make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的很酷，我很想再来一次。如果你给我带一个，我也会给你一些，我甚至可以教你怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those big poisonous lizards?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那些有毒的大蜥蜴？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. They got these big eggs, Bear killed a Gila once and gave me one. I scrambled it up for the whole crew! Kyle said "Good Job, Gristle."
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。它们的蛋有这么大，大熊有一次杀了一只大毒蜥，给了我一个，我给全体成员都炒了一份！凯尔说：“干得好，软骨。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was really cool. I would love to do it again. If you bring me one I'll let you have some, too. I can even teach you how to make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的很酷，我很想再来一次。如果你给我带一个，我也会给你一些，我甚至可以教你怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big lizards.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大蜥蜴嘛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you're lucky then. They are big and mean. And poisonous too, I think. But they have these big eggs. Bear killed a Gila once, gave me one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，那你真幸运，它们又大又凶，而且我觉得有毒。但它们的蛋很大，大熊杀过一只毒蜥，给了我一个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I scrambled it up for the whole crew! Kyle said "Good Job, Gristle."
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给全体成员都炒了一份！凯尔说：“干得好，软骨。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was really cool. I would love to do it again. If you bring me one I'll let you have some, too. I can even teach you how to make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的很酷，我很想再来一次。如果你给我带一个，我也会给你一些，我甚至可以教你怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不这么认为。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah, that's a good one. Why don't you come over here, I'll show you how to scramble it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦对，这个不错。不如你到这边来，我来给你示范一下怎么炒！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a Gila egg for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个毒蜥蛋给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah, that's a good one. Here, let me scramble it up for you and the rest of the gang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦对，这个不错。来，让我帮你和其他人弄一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Gristle [06020D09] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a Gila egg for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有个毒蜥蛋给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Never you mind them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别在意他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just forget I even mentioned them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就当我没提过吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tall Pines?
ESP.TRADUIT: 高松？

ESP.ORIGINAL: For awhile things were good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一阵子情况还不错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We fished the lake, traded guns up and across the Colorado, we were a proper boom town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在湖上钓鱼，在科罗拉多交换枪支，我们是一个繁荣的小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now we're just a component of the Legion's war effort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在我们只是军团战争的一部分。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's happened in the village since then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那之后村子里发生了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're being squeezed for all we've got.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的资源被榨干了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the Legion returned in this area, some folks from town attempted to negotiate with Caesar himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当军团回到这片地区时，镇上的一些人试图与凯撒本人谈判。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A man named Cray sold Caesar on a deal. We'd help him build up the Fort and support his men, he'd spare the village.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个叫克瑞的人跟凯撒做了笔交易。我们帮他建造堡垒，支援他的手下，他就放过村子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cray was worked to death about a month or so later. Selfish bastard sold the town without even consulting us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约一个月后，克瑞被工作累死了。自私的混蛋，没和我们商量就把小镇卖了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We cannot leave, they've got outposts surrounding us. The Fort is right there. All of the men are gone. It's all old farts, kids and cripples left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不能离开，他们在我们周围有岗哨，堡垒就在那里。男人都没了，都是些老家伙，孩子和瘸子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That hasn't stopped them from upping our quota's and shortening our deadlines, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但这并没有阻止他们提高我们的配额，缩短我们的期限。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's right. Peach Springs was a pretty isolated community for quite some time. My Grandmother told me it's been inhabited since long before the War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。在相当长的一段时间里，桃泉是一个相当孤立的社区。我祖母告诉我，早在战前这里就有人居住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After a few generations of that, folks get restless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几代人之后，人们就会变得焦躁不安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just a kid back then. I up and left home without saying a word. Joined the caravan and whisked myself westward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时候我还只是个孩子。我一声不吭的起身离开了家，加入了商队，向西疾驰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone had their own reasons for leaving. I don't even remember mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个人都有自己离开的理由，我甚至不记得我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The first expedition?
ESP.TRADUIT: 第一次探险？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Scipio Yuma. I am responsible for this checkpoint, and that town you see over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫西庇阿·尤马。我负责这个检查站，还有你看到的那个小镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that satisfy you? Do not distract me further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你满意了吗？别再让我分心了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's part of his punishment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是对他的惩罚之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be kept alive by a lowly Dissolute bitch is a great indignity to these boys.
ESP.TRADUIT: 被一个低贱的放荡者婊子养着是对这些孩子极大的侮辱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm surprised they're letting a woman practice medicine on him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很惊讶他们竟然让一个女人在他身上行医。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've noticed the Legion lets you come and go as you please. That's a real benefit for someone like me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我注意到军团允许你自由出入，这对我这样的人来说是实实在在的好处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm expecting a shipment. Don't worry about who it's from. It's our monthly medicine delivery, all contraband under the Legion, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在等货物，别在意是谁寄来的。这是我们每月的药品运输，当然都是军团的违禁物品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally I'd go get it, but I'm stuck here until this asshole wakes up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通常我会去接，但我被困在这里，直到这混蛋醒来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Be a dear and grab that for me. Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 行行好，帮我把那个拿过来。好吧?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我会的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Clay? Right. Didn't realize she was using errand boys now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生？好的。没想到她现在还雇了跑腿的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should speak with Lucille too. She...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也去和露西尔谈谈吧。她...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just... go talk to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是...跟她谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was sent here by Doctor Clay for some medicine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是克雷医生派来拿药的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她离开了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One morning mom found her bed empty. Eventually word got back to us that she ended up with a settlement caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一天早上，妈妈发现她的床空了。最后，我们得到消息说，她加入了一个定居商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once we learned where she was, we sent her letters but seldom heard back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一知道她在哪里，就给她写信，但很少收到回信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The last time I spoke with her was just before the war with the Legion. I came to the village to rally the troops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我最后一次和她说话是在和军团开战之前，我到村里来集结部队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were a lot more of us there back then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那时候我们的人可多着呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She refused the call, a few months later the war was lost. We had retreated to the hills and canyons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她拒绝了征召，几个月后，战争失败了，我们已经撤退到丘陵和峡谷中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I was just had nothing more to say to her until now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到现在，我才发现自己跟她没说过什么话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why haven't you spoken to her in so long?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么久没和她说话？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just give it to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给她就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in the note?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纸条上写了什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's Parker's decision to make.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是帕克的决定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things are getting a little to hot around these parts, and we've already been here too long.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的局势有点紧张了，我们在这里待得太久了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Every day we see more and more Skirts marching down the roads. Fresh troops. I reckon we're days away from the next battle for the Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每天我们都能看到越来越多的裙子在路上走来走去，新军。我估计离下一次大坝之战没几天了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is this the last medicine shipment?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是最后一批药品吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who'd you hear that from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听谁说的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard it'll be any day now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说随时都有可能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You speak with the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和军团沟通过？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what I've heard from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我从军团那边得到的消息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same feeling I've got, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我的感觉一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, it's just a feeling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，只是一种感觉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the even the Republic feels that way, it must be true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果连共和国都这么想，那一定是真的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's what the NCR told me.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR是这么告诉我的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, you're interesting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，你真有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see why Marcia chose you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白玛西娅为什么选择你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak of us to the Legion and we will slit your throat in your sleep.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果在军团面前提起我们，我们会在你睡梦中割断你的喉咙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Show Mark of Caesar] I have an in.
ESP.TRADUIT: [出示凯撒的徽记]我有门路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell her I love her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉她我爱她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Lucille [0600BDD0] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll deliver it as soon as I can.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会尽快送过去的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is a supply caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是补给车队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We run essentials to a handful of communities under the Legion's nose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们在军团的眼皮底下为少数几个社区提供必需品。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Parker. I run this caravan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕克。我经营这个商队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Technically we're nomads.
ESP.TRADUIT: 严格来说，我们是游牧民。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We stay a week or two in most communities until we finish our run. Then we stock back up at Robbers Roost and do it all over again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们会在大多数社区停留一两个星期，直到我们跑完全程。然后我们去强盗窝囤货，再来一遍。
