ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A huge cave network north of here. Most of it hand carved over centuries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里以北有一个巨大的洞穴网络，其中大部分是数百年来人工开凿而成的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Robbers Roost?
ESP.TRADUIT: 强盗窝？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They don't have names nor roads, sorry friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们没有名字也没有路，抱歉朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got to know the land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你必须了解这片土地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What other communities do you serve?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还服务哪些社区？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's none of your business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Parker [0600BDCD] (mod) Quest : ([0600F524]AZFreeformSmugglerCamp) 0600F524 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You can throw that out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以把它扔掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the run, though. Here, for the trouble.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过还是谢谢你的帮忙。给，麻烦你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have it here. Plus this note from Lucille.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这里有，还有露西尔寄来的便条。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are children that need those herbs, you idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些孩子需要那些草药，你个白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I lost it...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我弄丢了...

ESP.ORIGINAL: They call it hardbread.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们称之为硬面包。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd never heard of it before, I have no recipe. A week ago they dragged me in here, gave me my quota and left.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没听说过，也没有食谱。一周前他们把我拖来这里，给了我配额就走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just can't keep up. I'm always running out of flour, water, or botching batches.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟不上了。我总是把面粉、水用光，或者搞砸了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What kind of crackers are those?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那是什么饼干？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wow, you know your stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇，你还挺懂行的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, have some extra as thanks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know hardtack. You don't need to use salt, and it's a 2:1 ratio of water to flour.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道硬面饼。你不需要放盐，水和面粉的比例是2:1。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You'd do that for a lowly slave? Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你会为一个卑微的奴隶这么做吗？谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't pay you, but maybe I can sneak you some extra hardtack for the road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我付不了你钱，但也许我可以偷偷给你带点硬面包路上吃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll ask around for the recipe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去打听一下食谱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're just simple wafers or something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是些简单的华夫饼什么的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never made them myself, but I imagine it's just water and flour?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从没自己做过，但我想应该就是水和面粉吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Corella [06019BAA] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do I look like? A woman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看起来像什么？一个女人？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019BAD] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?

ESP.TRADUIT: 这是种简易生存食品，按两份面粉配一份水的比例混合，在加热表面用明火烹制。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Blacknail [06008A52] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么想知道？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I watched the Legionaries pluck that girl and put her to work in the kitchen a full week ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个星期前，我看着军团士兵把那个女孩抓走，让她去厨房干活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did she not ask for the recipe then, when she started?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那她开始的时候，为什么不向我要配方呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What has she been doing all this time?
ESP.TRADUIT: 她这段时间都在做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is either deliberate sabotage or impeccable uselessness. Either way her fate will be death, most likely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这要么是蓄意破坏，要么就是毫无用处。无论如何，她的命运极有可能是死亡。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll inform the Legionaries right away. Thank you for telling me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这就通知军团，谢谢你告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm helping the girl working in the mess hall. She doesn't know the recipe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在帮助那个在食堂工作的女孩，她不知道配方。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, well, I've only made it a handful of times. But I've always used about a two to one ratio. Lots of salt if you want it to be edible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，好吧，我只做过几次，但我一直使用2比1的比例。如果你想让它能吃，就要放很多盐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trying to remember the recipe. It's equal parts flour and water, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在努力回忆菜谱。面粉和水是等量的，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flour and water, easy as that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 面粉和水，就这么简单。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now go away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在快走开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iulia [06019BA7] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie> I'm just curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我只是好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do? That's great! Let's hear it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你吗？太棒了！让我听听！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got that recipe for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我给你准备了食谱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I already know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经知道了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My problem is I don't know how much of each. My batches keep coming out too dry or not dry enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的问题是我不知道每一种要放多少，我做出来总是太干或不够干。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's simple, just flour and water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很简单，只要面粉和水。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ooh, thank you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，谢谢你！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're saving my ass here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你救了我的命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, they're basically inedible but are better than starving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，它们基本上是不能吃的，但总比饿死好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's a 2:1 ratio.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比例是2:1。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please hurry back!
ESP.TRADUIT: 请快点回来！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : [0601929F] (ID) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, I'll keep asking around.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系，我会继续打听的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh! Oh! I know how to make really yummy Hardbread!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦！哦！我知道怎么做好吃的硬面包！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can show you how if you like?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意，我可以教你怎么做？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't waste your time with that. Survive off the land.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别在那上面浪费时间了，靠土地生存。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hunts Goats [06013D45] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No idea, sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道，抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Flemus [06019BAC] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Flour and water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 面粉和水。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anything more is degenerate bloat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再多就是堕落的膨胀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Finturus [06013D47] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did that useless bitch forget again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个没用的婊子又忘了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Capsarius [060062B1] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I explained it to her multiple times. If she can't get it right, the Legion will beat her until she does.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟她解释了很多次。如果她不能做好，军团会一直打到她做好为止。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Capsarius [060062B1] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚蛋。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Beth [0600A124] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No idea what that is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不知道那是什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where I come from, our food comes with flavor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我的家乡，我们的食物很美味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hank [0600A115] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know the recipe for hardbread?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道硬面包的配方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wish I could help her... but Cent-yor-eeon Thrax is making me a warrior! Warriors don't belong in the kitchen!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望我能帮助她...但百...夫...长色雷斯正在让我成为一名战士！战士不属于厨房！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm asking for the slave-girl working in the mess hall. She doesn't know how to make it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是帮在食堂工作的那个女奴问的，她不知道怎么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. But Thrax would never let me help in the first place...
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]我想你是对的，但色雷斯一开始就不会让我帮忙...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An army runs on its stomach. Making food is very important work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军队是靠胃来运转的，制作食物是非常重要的工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Work for women! Thrax says I'm a killing machine!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]女人的工作！色雷斯说我是杀人机器！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's very important work, kiddo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是很重要的工作，孩子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can lift a machete!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能举起大砍刀！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not a warrior, you look like you can barely lift a machete.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是个战士，你看起来连大砍刀都举不起来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He'll beat you up for sure!
ESP.TRADUIT: 他肯定会揍你的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tix [06019C14] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll go talk to him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去和他谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to speak with Centurion Thrax.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要和百夫长色雷斯谈谈。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The mighty Thrax has no interest in entertaining a child's whims.
ESP.TRADUIT: 强大的色雷斯对孩子的奇思妙想毫无兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's about Tix. He wants to work in the kitchen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是关于蒂克斯的，他想在厨房工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps Thrax should hear you out. Come in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许色雷斯应该听你说完。进来吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's about keeping the Legion fed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是为了让军团吃饱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Better?
ESP.TRADUIT: 更好吃？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is not supposed to *be* anything. It's flour and water. Anything more is degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它不应该*有*任何东西，就是面粉和水。再多就是堕落了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Red Rivers [06013566] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's about making your hardbread better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是为了让你的硬面包更好吃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk to you about Tix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈蒂克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he is a child in the camp, then he should be a soldier. His body is for fighting, not rolling dough. We have slaves for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他是营地里的孩子，那么他应该是一名士兵。他的身体是用来战斗的，不是用来揉面团的，我们有奴隶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A child down in the camp. He wants to work in the mess hall's kitchen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 营地里的一个孩子。他想在食堂的厨房工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you here to waste my time again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你又是来浪费我时间的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk to you about Tix.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想跟你谈谈蒂克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not need a common wastrel to explain the basics of logistics to me. Get to the point or I will nail you to a cross.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不需要一个普通的二流子来给我解释物流的基本原理。说重点，不然我就把你钉死在十字架上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Consider how important it is to keep the soldiers fed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想让士兵吃饱是多么重要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think so? Logistics is the work of the elderly, the crippled, the weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这么认为吗？后勤是老年人、残疾人和弱者的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fighting is the work of the young, and children make such good soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗是年轻人的工作，孩子们是优秀的士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and I both understand that children are more suited to logistics than fighting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你我都明白孩子们更适合后勤而不是战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Leave me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 走开！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Um, let me think about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，让我想想。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good dog.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好狗。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright. <Throw out note.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <扔掉纸条>好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢是吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you care?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么这么关心？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I really think you should read it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我真的觉得你应该读读。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you trying to do? Fix me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想干什么？解决我吗?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Throw it out, keep it, I don't care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 扔了也好，留着也好，我不在乎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've got bigger problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有更大的麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just read it. Please.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就读吧，拜托了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcia bled to death after her eye was gouged out by a man named "Metal Gutz".
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛西娅的眼睛被一个名叫金属古茨的人挖出后，她失血过多而死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Clay has no interest in speaking with her. Thank you for the medicine. Please leave me to my work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生没有兴趣和她说话。谢谢你的药，请让我专心工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcia, Lucille just wants to talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛西娅，露西尔只是想和你说话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, give it here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [Doctor Clay reads.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [克雷医生读了。]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's leaving. I'll never see her again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她要走了，我再也见不到她了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That... pisses me off. She doesn't get to just to run off like that. Who does she think she is, getting the last word like this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这...气死我了。她不能就这么跑了，她以为自己是谁，竟敢这样说最后一句话？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I need to go after her. I want the last word. Even if it's just...goodbye.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得去找她，我想要最后的发言权。即使只是...再见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dr. Clay [06002D5F] (mod) Quest : ([06002D61]AZNewtDrClayDialogue) 06002D61 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a courier, I don't give a shit about what I deliver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个邮差，我不在乎我送的是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Must be desperate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一定很绝望吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, he's paying me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他付我钱了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars looks kindly on your loyalty. We have been anticipating this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯很欣赏你的忠诚。我们已经预料到了这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've known about the medicine woman's operation for several weeks now. A sentry reported her out past curfew last month carrying a satchel into town from the East.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们对那个女药师的行动好几周前就知道了。上个月，一名哨兵报告说，看到她在宵禁后提着一个挎包从东边进了镇子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mars sees all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 玛尔斯能看到一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was just asked to smuggle something into Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是被委托给纽特走私一些东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have. She was questioned, beaten and her contraband was confiscated: Wasteland herbs, profligate old world medicines, and a powder we couldn't identify.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们采取了。她被审问、殴打，她的违禁品也被没收：废土草药、废弃的旧世界药物，以及一种我们无法识别的粉末。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She said she found them under a rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她说她在一块石头下发现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need to determine how she's arranging these pickups and where they're coming from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们得弄清楚她是怎么安排这些东西的以及它们是从哪里来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Centurion has a plan for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的百夫长有个计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why haven't you done anything about it yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么还不采取行动呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A coward recently abandoned his post and attempted to take his own life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最近，一个懦夫放弃了他的岗位，企图自杀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My Centurion has assigned the medicine woman to keep this man alive, against the insistance of every nerve in his body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的百夫长已经指派女药师来维持这个人的生命，不顾他身体每一根神经的坚持。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The coward is pulled back into Caesar's service, saved by a weak old woman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个懦夫被一个虚弱的老妇人救了回来，回到了凯撒的手下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The witch in turn spends every minute of the day tending to him, keeping her under our constant watch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而女巫则每时每刻都在照顾他，让我们时刻监视着她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two problems solved at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 同时解决了两个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All we've had to do is wait for her to make a move; here you are.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一直以来要做的就是等她行动，你出现了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the plan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么计划？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Centurion Thrax. The Goliath of Green Valley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 百夫长色雷斯，绿谷的歌利亚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A master tactician and mighty warrior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个战术大师和强大的战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's your Centurion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的百夫长是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are not aware of me already? Fascinating.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还没注意到我吗？真有意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surely, you've heard of Caesar's mighty colossus. I am Thrax, senior Centurion of the Base Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你一定听说过凯撒的巨像吧。我是色雷斯，大本营的资深百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, it is the mask of a Martian Wraith.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，这是火星魅影的面具。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This particular Wraith came in the form of a Ranger named Twelve Trees, who led a band of raiders known as the Green Valley Rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个特别的魅影以一名名叫十二树的游骑兵的形式出现，他领导了一支被称为绿谷游骑兵的掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In battle, I shattered the glass of his helmet with a single punch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在战斗中，我一拳打碎了他头盔上的玻璃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that second, the Rangers ceased to be a force we could never hope to understand. That day was a most wondrous victory for the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那一刻，游骑兵不再是一支我们永远无法理解的力量。那一天，是军团最辉煌的胜利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's with the mask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 戴着面具干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a trophy and a warning. We Centurions are of a superior stock than the common Legionary. Otherwise, we would not be charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一个战利品，也是一个警告。我们百夫长要比普通的军团士兵更优越。否则，负责的也就不会是我们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: These adornments keep the Legionaries in line and motivate them to advance. But, it is not just them I warn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些装饰可以让军团士兵保持队形，激励他们前进。但是，我要警告的不仅仅是他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This helmet is a warning of all Rangers, Desert, Arizona, NCR, independent. Lake Mead is our domain. Newt is our meat. And the Dam will be ours.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个头盔是对所有游骑兵的警告，沙漠，亚利桑那，NCR，独立。米德湖是我们的地盘，纽特是我们的肉，大坝也将属于我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you still wear the mask?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么还戴着面具？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you find anything, report back to me. Tell her that
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有发现，向我报告。告诉她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll investigate how she's arranging these smuggling runs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会调查她是如何安排走私活动的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Right under our nose.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在我们眼皮底下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thrax will value this information greatly. I will turn it in to him myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 色雷斯会非常重视这个信息的，我会亲自交给他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Clay's been using that old boat as a hideout. She's got a radio in there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生一直用那艘旧船作为藏身处，她在那儿有个无线电。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And that's your business? She's just a whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这关你的事？她只是个妓女。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I deal with you, Isaiah will free a slave woman he's been prostituting out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我解决你，以赛亚就会放了一个卖淫的女奴隶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look around you. See the whips and chains? The girls in those leather collars? It's all a game. Women pretend they're prisoners, men the jailers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你的周围。看到鞭子和锁链了吗？那些戴着皮项圈的女孩？这都是一场游戏。女人假装自己是囚犯，男人假装是狱卒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: At the end of the day, pussy is what's got real power. The woman is always in control.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说到底，女人才是真正有力量的人。女人总是掌控一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is not a whore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛不是妓女。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big secret, then? Must be exciting.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说这是个大秘密？一定很刺激吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's private.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是私事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're insane!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will pluck out your eyes and pour salt in the bleeding cavity. I am your damnation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会挖出你的眼睛，把盐倒进你流血的洞里。我就是你的诅咒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Should I be? You can't do anything to me in here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我应该害怕吗？在这里你不能对我做任何事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't seem afraid to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你似乎不怕死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you saying...?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, shit, I guess I ought to defend myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那真该死，我想我应该保护自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, you must not know who I am. Does the name Benny ring a bell? Leader of the Chairmen. Who do you think killed him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，你一定不知道我是谁。本尼这个名字有印象吗？会长帮的领袖，你觉得是谁杀了他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep running your mouth, punk. It's all you're good for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 小混混，你就闭嘴吧。这就是你全部的本事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You think being on the Strip makes you untouchable? You're just another puffed-up gangster in slacks and wingtips.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你以为在长街就没人敢碰你吗？你不过是另一个穿着休闲裤和翼尖皮鞋的自大黑帮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're insane!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你疯了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, let's get this over with. <Attack.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>好吧，让我们把这事了结吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Think long and hard, pal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好好想想吧，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have to think this over. I'll be back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得好好考虑一下。我马上回来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I really appreciate it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，我真的很感激。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I promise I won't kill you. Goodbye!
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我保证我不会杀你。再见！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Chick Hadley [0601F701] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't play dumb with me, asshole. You and your card-counting dickhead friend are gonna give back every cap you stole.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我装傻，混蛋。你和你那个算牌的白痴朋友要把你偷的每一个瓶盖都还给我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where am I? What's going on?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪里？这是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You fuckers cheated us. Me and Tillis were winning big, like crazy style, just raking in the money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们这群王八蛋耍了我们。我和蒂利什本来正大赢特赢，简直赢疯了，简直就像是在疯狂地捞钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That was until you and your asshole friend came along, talking shit, winning over and over. We know you cheated!
ESP.TRADUIT: 直到你和你的混蛋朋友出现，满嘴胡话，一次又一次地赢。我们知道你作弊了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stolen caps? What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 偷来的瓶盖？你在说什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, boo-hoo. Cry about it, bitch.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，嘘嘘。哭吧，贱人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're supposed to be a soldier? You're a disgrace to your uniform.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不是当兵的吗？你让你的制服蒙羞。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's right there. On the ground, probably passed all the way out. Drunkard piece of shit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他就在那儿。倒在地上，可能已经晕过去了，一个醉鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not even moving. Guy sleeps like a rock. So, this is your problem now. I want my money.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他一动也不动。这家伙睡得像块石头。所以，这就是你现在的问题了，我要我的钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What happened to the guy who was with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 和我在一起的那个人怎么了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, don't be stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，别傻了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tillis, check him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂利什，去看看他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, wait, seriously?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，等等，真的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crap. Holy shit. Oh, fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟了，天呐，噢，操。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is he dead? Did you kill him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他死了吗？是你杀了他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, don't be stupid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，别傻了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tillis, check him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂利什，去看看他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shit, wait, seriously?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死，等等，真的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crap. Holy shit. Oh, fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 糟了，天呐，噢，操。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doesn't look like he's breathing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看起来他没有呼吸了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, look. I have a knife on me. I snuck it in here. You take it. I can't get caught with a weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，听着。我身上有把刀，我偷偷带进来的。你拿着，我不能带着武器被抓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nice going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 干得真漂亮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please don't. Seriously. Please. I'm begging.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请不要，说真的，求你了，我求求你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, look. I have a knife on me. I snuck it in here. You take it. I can't get caught with a weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，听着。我身上有把刀，我偷偷带进来的。你拿着，我不能带着武器被抓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me one good reason not to report you for murder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给我一个不举报你谋杀的理由。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mistakes? Jesus Christ, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 错误？天啊，老兄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, look. I have a knife on me. I snuck it in here. You take it. I can't get caught with a weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，听着。我身上有把刀，我偷偷带进来的。你拿着，我不能带着武器被抓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's fine. Mistakes happen. He was an asshole anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没关系。错误总会发生，反正他就是个混蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tillis, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂利什，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在滚吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tillis, let's go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 蒂利什，我们走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Trooper Pollock [06020ECB] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good luck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你好运。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He opened fire. Our soldiers had to defend themselves. I actually just finished receiving the report from Pappas. A terrible thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他开了枪，我们的士兵必须自卫。其实我刚收到帕帕斯的报告，可怕的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you mean? What happened?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么意思？发生什么事了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: From what I heard on our radio, yes, he is dead. Please don't blame yourself. He made his choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从无线电里听到，是的，他死了。请不要自责，他做出了自己的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's it? He's dead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些吗？他死了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, forgive me. I'm Gary Benowitz, of the NCR Army Criminal Investigation Division. Well, the Mojave branch of it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，原谅我。我是加里·贝诺维茨，NCR陆军刑事调查处。嗯，是莫哈维的分部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Deputy director of what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么副处长？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course. Fire away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some more questions about your work here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对你的工作还有一些疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Certainly. It's our job to chase down any felonies that are happening in the NCR Army. Usually things like sexual assault and chem trafficking. Sometimes desertion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以。我们的工作是追查在NCR军队中发生的任何重罪。通常是性侵犯和毒品走私，有时是逃兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our findings are then presented to the appropriate authorities, who may prosecute as they see fit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，我们的调查结果将被提交给有关当局，他们可能会根据他们认为合适的情况提出起诉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This here is the Mojave office. There are other offices elsewhere. A big one in Mexicali, as I recall. We all work independently of each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是莫哈维的办事处。其他地方也有办事处，我记得在墨西卡利有个大的。我们彼此独立工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We should be getting a new building soon. That's what they're saying, at least. I sure hope so. It's getting pretty cramped here at the embassy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们应该很快就会有新楼了，至少他们是这么说的。我当然希望如此，大使馆这里越来越拥挤了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the Criminal Investigation Division.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说刑事调查处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, yes, I often am. Troop morale is low. People turn to crime out of boredom.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，是的，我经常这样。部队士气低落，人们因为无聊而走上犯罪的道路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's been a lot of pressure on us here ever since Bitter Springs. I was the special investigator on that case. Nightmare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从苦泉事件之后我们就承受了很大的压力。我是那个案子的特别调查员，噩梦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The brass wants us to come back with nothing - no crimes, cover it all up. The folks back at Shady want heads to roll.
ESP.TRADUIT: 上级希望我们回来时什么都没有...没有犯罪，把一切都掩盖起来。沙荫镇的人想要人头落地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So either the army is made to look like criminals, or like corrupt mobsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，军队要么被弄得像罪犯，要么像腐败的暴徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you pretty busy here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这儿很忙吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elsewhere, probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在其他地方，可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's the actual director?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真正的处长在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed, that would be me. Why, do you have something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确，就是我。怎么，你有什么线索吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the person I would speak to about an NCR deserter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是会和我谈论NCR逃兵的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the Gomorrah? That would be stupid of him. Who is this deserter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 蛾摩拉？那他也太蠢了。这个逃兵是谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to report that there's a deserter in the Gomorrah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要报告，有个逃兵在蛾摩拉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm. The name doesn't ring a bell. Was he deployed in the Mojave?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这个名字听起来不熟。他被部署在莫哈维吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: His name is Chick Hadley. Private Chick Hadley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他叫奇克·哈德利。二等兵奇克·哈德利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bullhead? When was this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 布尔海德？这是什么时候的事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He was. Around Bullhead, to be exact.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他确实是。确切地说，在布尔海德附近。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that's ancient. Let me look through our files.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那太古老了。让我看看我们的档案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Interesting. Is this his unit? Sergeant Becker. Corporal Kemper. Private Warren. Right here, Private Hadley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有意思，这是他的部队吗？贝克尔中士、肯珀下士、二等兵沃伦，就在这里，二等兵哈德利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're listed as MIA. The whole unit is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们被列为失踪人员，整个单位都是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About 15 years ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大约15年前。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As raiders? That's certainly not good. We were only in that region to try and clear out the raiders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 掠夺者吗？这当然不好。我们去那个地区只是为了清除那些掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something else. His whole unit operated as raiders around Bullhead after they deserted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有一件事。他们逃跑后，他的整个部队在布尔海德附近当掠夺者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Technically, yes. But he's military-trained, and a former raider.
ESP.TRADUIT: 严格来说，可以。但他受过军事训练，以前还是个掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our officers aren't allowed to carry arms on the Strip. There's a good chance this Hadley fellow would have us outgunned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的军官是不允许在长街上携带武器的，这个叫哈德利的家伙很有可能比我们火力更猛。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, if you could get him off the Strip and into Freeside, yes, I believe we could do something.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，如果你能把他从长街弄到自由城，是的，我相信我们能做点什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, can you arrest him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你能逮捕他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, of course not. I mean, technically, yes there is, but not during wartime, and we've been at war since the 40s.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，当然没有。我是说，严格来说，是有的，但不是在战时，我们从40年代就开始打仗了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there no statute of limitations on desertions? 15 years is a long time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 逃兵没有诉讼时效吗？15年是很长的一段时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not continuously, but yes, we have. First, we had to act against the Enclave. Then the Brotherhood turned on us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是连续的，但是是的，有40年了。首先，我们必须对英克雷采取行动，然后兄弟会背叛了我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Concurrently, we were fighting the Khans and other savage raider gangs. This alone lasted 20 years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与此同时，我们正在与大汗帮和其他野蛮的掠夺者团伙作战。仅这一项就持续了20年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, you know that we're now fighting the Legion, and the Fiends, and still the Brotherhood. It's a handful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你知道我们现在是在对抗军团，恶魔帮，还有兄弟会。这很难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, the NCR has been at war for 40 years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，NCR已经打仗40年了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I'll speak to Pappas and let her know we'll need troops. You just send Chick on his way. Some MPs will be waiting to apprehend him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。我会告诉帕帕斯，让她知道我们需要军队。你把奇克送去，一些议员正等着逮捕他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get Chick into Freeside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会带奇克去自由城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I'll speak to McCarran and let them know we'll need troops. You just send Chick on his way. Some MPs will be waiting to apprehend him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。我会告诉麦卡伦，让他们知道我们需要军队。你把奇克送去，一些议员正等着逮捕他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get Chick into Freeside.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会带奇克去自由城。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？既然你这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind, sorry. I was joking. Just forget I said anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了，抱歉。我是开玩笑的，就当我没说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As you say.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如你所说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Deputy Director Benowitz [0601FF08] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a couple questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就问几个问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, lead the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，带路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't say you did. Just a couple questions, that's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没说你做了。就问几个问题，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I didn't do anything!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我什么都没做！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rather not do it here. Will you come with me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还是不要在这里吧。你愿意跟我来吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, no need for that. We're all friends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别这样，没必要。我们都是朋友。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. Ask your questions here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，就在这里问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Enjoy your stay at the Gomorrah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。祝你在蛾摩拉过得愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Claude [06020F86] (mod) Quest : ([0601F709]AZGOMAssassinationQuest) Never Get Out of This World Alive EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going anywhere. Ask me the questions here, or fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我哪也不去。在这里问，不然就滚蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm glad.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you, Rima. It means a lot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，瑞玛。这意味着很多。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, then I'm glad to have done something useful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我很高兴做了些有用的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, I guess. I'm sure I can find a use for this. Probably.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你，我想。我肯定能找到它的用处，可能吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm... sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很...抱歉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Sad

ESP.ORIGINAL: A flower? I wouldn't have wasted my time if I knew this was going to be my reward.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一朵花？如果我知道这是报酬，我就不会浪费时间了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's better than what I was doing before. Most of the Maidens avoid me, but Calventia is very kind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我以前做的事好多了。大多数女侍都躲着我，但卡文提亚人很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you doing as a Maiden?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你做女侍做得怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To be honest, it's hard to listen to.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，听起来很难。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They say that Mars loves strength, that might makes right. But why did I have to be the weak one? Why does everyone else get to be strong?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们说玛尔斯喜欢力量，强权即公理。但为什么要我做那个弱者？为什么其他人都能变得强大？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is supposed to be virtuous about pinning a teenager down, about beating her? What's virtuous about what happened to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 把一个十几岁的孩子压在地上，打她，这算哪门子美德？发生在我身上的事有什么美德可言？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, fuck! It makes me want to...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，操！这让我想要...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, are you a committed Martian now? Spreading the good word of Mars, and all that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，你现在是一个忠诚的玛尔斯人了吗？传播玛尔斯的福音，诸如此类？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to make people suffer like I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要让人们遭受和我一样的痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Stay silent.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <保持沉默>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to make people suffer like I have.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想要让人们遭受和我一样的痛苦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Want to what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Thank you. Nobody will ever take advantage of me again. I promise it, to you, and to myself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对，谢谢你。再也没有人能占我便宜了，我保证，对你，也对我自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This feeling is the seed of strength. Use it. Never forget what they did to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这种感觉就是力量的种子，使用它。永远不要忘记他们对你做过的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: More than I've already been hurt? No, I think being angry is the least I can do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 比我受到的伤害更严重？不，我觉得生气是我起码能做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's normal to be angry, but holding onto that anger will only hurt you more in the long run.
ESP.TRADUIT: 生气是正常的，但是长此以往只会对你造成更大的伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去你妈的吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who cares? Get over yourself. Life sucks, people suffer. Big fucking deal. Move on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁在乎呢？别自以为是了。生活糟透了，人们在受苦，他妈的有什么大不了的。继续前进。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, tell me about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，跟我说说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's rough. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这很不容易。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's so quiet here. It's eerie. I'm not used to being out in the country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里很安静，这很可怕，我不习惯在乡下生活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Maiden Rima [0601FF41] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like Dolan Springs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢多兰泉吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Wow, I don't know what to say. I'll head there now. Thank you so much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？哇，我都不知道该说什么了。我现在就去，非常感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Rima [0600D844] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Priestess Calventia at Dolan Springs wants you to join her there. Don't worry about Isaiah. I took care of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多兰泉的卡文提亚女祭司想让你去。不要担心以赛亚，我搞定了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Truly? I am Arceus. You helped me at the Base Camp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 认真的？我是阿尔克修斯，你在大本营帮过我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I know you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认识你吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am a Prime Legionary now!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在是军团主力了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have seen more action here than I have seen ever before. It's thrilling. Already, I've taken four kills.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里看到的行动比以往任何时候都多，太令人兴奋了。我已经杀了四个人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arceus! You look different.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔克修斯！你看起来不一样了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，嗨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. Hi.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，嗨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the most important posting I've ever been assigned. We're practically breathing down the necks of the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我被指派的最重要的岗位，我们几乎是紧紧盯着NCR。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Cottonwood Cove?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得棉白杨湾怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I feel free. I no longer suffer from the confusion I felt at Base Camp. Those feelings are gone and I am happier for it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，我觉得很自由，我再也不会有在大本营时的困惑了。那些感觉消失了，我也因此更快乐了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are you doing emotionally?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的情绪怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe so. He was a good friend, but nothing more. Besides, I have purpose now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是吧。他是个好朋友，仅此而已。而且，我现在有了目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My purpose, my duty and my honor, is to die for Mars. To kill and die for him. There is nothing else for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的目标，我的责任，我的荣誉，就是为玛尔斯而死，为他杀戮和牺牲。我别无他求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you saying you've moved on from Flemus?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说你已经离开弗勒慕斯了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do not try and fuck with my head, degenerate. I am not like you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别想扰乱我的头脑，堕落者。我和你不一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take it from me - these feelings you have, can't be pushed away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 相信我...你的这些感觉，是无法被推开的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you. I am quite pleased with my station now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你！我对自己现在的岗位很满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我确实这么说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Arceus [06019D47] (mod) Quest : ([06019BB0]AZBaseCampRomanceQuest) Somethin' Stupid EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you say so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么说的话。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are some specific questions I want to ask you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有几个具体的问题想问你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. The Mars shrine is here, and there are some Frumentarii nearby watching the facility to the south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，玛尔斯神殿就在这里，附近还有一些军团特务在监视南边的设施。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So it's pretty isolated and remote out here, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这里很偏僻，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: There are some big metal frames. Skeletons. The ones that connect to each other with wires.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有一些大的金属框架，骨架。就是那些用电线相互连接的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is the radio jamming most concentrated?
ESP.TRADUIT: 无线电干扰最集中的地方是哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes. From those towers, to the entrance of the facility in the south. That is where the problem is the worst.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。从那些塔，到南边的设施入口，这就是问题最严重的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That stretch is like a wall of silence. No radio can get out. Nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那一段就像一堵沉默之墙，没有无线电能传出去。什么都不能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The transmission towers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 发射塔？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to say. They usually arrive around 6 A.M., because they like to sail while it's still dark.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么好说的。他们通常在早上6点左右到达，因为他们喜欢在天黑的时候行驶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Iosep Aneth [0601CE46] (mod) Quest : ([0601050B]AZFreeformWestRimGas) Warrior's Rest EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the caravans that come through here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说经过这里的商队。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that'd be Milia. She's in Cyanide Springs. You can't miss her. She's always got the big Super Mutant with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那是米莉娅，她在山奈泉。你不会错过她的，她身边总是带着一个超级变种人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's just so strong, like she isn't afraid of anything. I've never seen a woman like that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她很坚强，好像什么都不怕。我从没见过那样的女人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But whenever I try and talk to her, she gets this expression like she wants me to buy something or get out. And I ain't got the money for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但每当我试图和她说话时，她就会表现出一种想让我买东西或滚出去的表情。我可没那么多钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just wish I could get her attention somehow. I really like her, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是希望我能引起她的注意。我真的很喜欢她，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the energy weapons merchant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说那个能量武器商人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I paid to be with her once. A lot of the guys were saying I can't be a real man until I get with a woman, so I tried with her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我花钱跟她在一起过一次。很多男人都说，只有和一个女人在一起，我才能成为一个真正的男人，所以我试着和她在一起。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But when we got into that room together, I just couldn't do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但当我们一起进入那个房间时，我就是做不到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not that I couldn't perform! I just felt bad for her, I guess. And when we got to talking, she told me she thinks she's sick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是说我不会表演！我想我只是为她感到难过。我们聊天的时候，她告诉我她觉得自己病了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. I'm probably just a coward. That's what Isaiah would say - that I'm a pussy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，我可能只是个懦夫。以赛亚也会这么说，说我是个娘们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Rima.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说瑞玛。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It ain't my business. You'd have to talk to her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关我的事。你得跟她谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : The Winnin' Kid [0600D0D6] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rima is sick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑞玛病了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ye mean like poltergeists? In Elephant Hill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说像促狭鬼一样？在象山？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon not, sonny, or I woulda noticed 'em by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想没有，孩子，不然我早就注意到他们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was told there may be some haunted artifacts around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说这附近可能有一些闹鬼的文物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ye mean like poltergeists? In Elephant Hill?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说像促狭鬼一样？在象山？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I reckon not, girlie, or I woulda noticed 'em by now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想没有，姑娘，不然我早就注意到他们了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was told there may be some haunted artifacts around here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听说这附近可能有一些闹鬼的文物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well now, hold on jus' a minute and I'll let you in on a little secret.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，等一下，我告诉你一个小秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ye ever heard tale o' a place to the east called White Hills? Yessir, that's a *real* ghost town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过东边有个地方叫白山吗？是的，先生，那是一个*真正的*鬼镇。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd say you should try yer luck o'er there. Careful though! I also heard o' some nasty critters out that way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得你应该去那里碰碰运气。不过要小心！我还听说那边有些讨厌的生物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's it? You don't know anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些吗？你什么都不知道？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't mention it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 别客气！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks, Ricamore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢，里卡莫尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Customer service isn't exactly my department, but sure, I can put in an invoice for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 客服不是我的部门，但我可以给你开张发票。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you need hauled?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要拉什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's an item I need shipped to Dolan Springs. Can I hire your caravan service?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有件东西要运到多兰泉，我可以租用你们的车队服务吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great! Like I said before, it's going to cost 300 Denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太棒了！就像我之前说的，花费是300第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm ready to hire your caravan now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我准备租用你的车队了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: We can make that happen, but I hope you understand that our delivery service options are tailored for clients with more substantial needs.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们可以做到，但我希望你能理解，我们的送货服务是为有更实质性需求的客户量身定制的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The lowest I can quote you is 300 Denarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能给你的最低报价是300第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's this lodge on Mount Perkins, and inside is a stuffed bear. I need it sent to the Dolan Springs Trading Post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 珀金斯山上有个小屋，里面有只毛绒熊。我需要把它送到多兰泉贸易站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, as long as they're from a Legion bank. Anything we try to cash in California gets bounced.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可以，只要是军团银行的。我们想在加州兑现任何东西都会被退回。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you accept checks?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们接受支票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll be paying via check, then. Do you have a pen I can borrow?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我就用支票付款吧，你有笔可以借我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Much appreciated! I'll get a caravan sent out there right away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 非常感谢！我马上派一辆大篷车过去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, here's the money. <300 Denarii.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <300第纳尔>好的，给你钱。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you? Keep in mind that White Sands was recognized as the best customer-rated caravan company in the Four Corners in 2280, 2279, and 2278!
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？请记住，在2280年、2279年和2278年，白沙被公认为是四角地最受客户好评的商队公司！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, I need some time to weigh my options.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想了想，我需要一些时间来权衡我的选择。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> Okay, let me show you...
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>好吧，我给你看...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what am I supposed to write?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我该怎么写呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I'm sorry! Here, try this one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对不起！来，试试这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh... this doesn't seem to be writing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃...这好像不能写。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> Okay, let me show you...
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>好吧，我给你看...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Calvin [0600E3A8] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So what am I supposed to write?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我该怎么写呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Here, I was using this one a minute ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？给，我一分钟前还在用这个。

ESP.TRADUIT: 对，我是这么认为的，混蛋。滚出我的视线。

ESP.TRADUIT: <出示声波振记器>我在找一个能证明这个东西有鬼魂出没的人。

ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，它应该是一个电唱机，但它能播放声音，即使里面没有唱片。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A ghost town, you say? Then there can be no doubt, this device is haunted by a spirit!

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In the ruins of a ghost town called White Hills, just north of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在一个叫白山的鬼镇废墟里，就在这里的北边。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, keep your secrets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，保守秘密。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As far as I can tell, this object is haunted by a spirit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，这个东西被鬼魂缠住了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tex [0600E4D9] (mod) Quest : ([0600E68C]AZFreeformDolanSprings) 0600E68C (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 这不关你的事。

ESP.TRADUIT: 就我所能读到的而言，它是...中立的。如果是恶魔想要伤害你，你现在应该知道了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Great. Can I have a certificate, please?
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了，可以给我一张证书吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 我从来没听说过这种事。我想我可以写张便条，如果你需要的话。

ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以！东西在哪里？

ESP.TRADUIT: 我有件东西要运到多兰泉，我可以租用你们的车队服务吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 还是200第纳尔，要不要随你便。

ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是问题。我们可以干...200第纳尔。

ESP.TRADUIT: 珀金斯山上有个小屋，里面有只毛绒熊。我需要把它送到多兰泉贸易站。

ESP.TRADUIT: 不接受。文尼不相信银行。

ESP.TRADUIT: 你们接受支票吗？

ESP.TRADUIT: 这他妈不关你的事，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where does the company store its profits, then?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks. I'll get a caravan sent out there right away.

ESP.ORIGINAL: This will cover it. <200 Denarii.>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Suit yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随你便。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On second thought, I need some more time to weigh my options.

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye.

ESP.ORIGINAL: The poor guy is absolutely gutted. He's holed himself up at Cal's cafe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个可怜的家伙彻底崩溃了，他躲在卡尔的咖啡馆里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some want to kill him. Eye-for-an-eye y'know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些人想杀了他，以眼还眼知道吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe it rehabilitative justice, myself. Job's a good man. He was great working down in the ant farm. The community is better off with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我本人相信的是感化司法。约伯是个好人，他在下面的蚂蚁农场工作时表现很棒。有他在，社区会变得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm organizing a vote on the matter. I've run the numbers and I only need to flip two people to spare Job's life.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我正在组织对此事进行投票。我算过了，只要说服两个人就能保住约伯的命。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come back to me once you've spread the word. I'll call the vote and we'll see the fruits of the democratic process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一旦你把消息传播出去，就回来找我。我会召集投票，我们将看到民主进程的成果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Murray [0601B97A] (mod) Quest : ([0601B980]AZFreeformHaven) 0601B980 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will happen to him now?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在他会怎么样呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: People here are decent. They help one another. When a decision is to be made, it's made with everyone's input.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里的人都很正派，他们互相帮助。当要做出一个决定时，它是在每个人的参与下做出的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No Sheriff? How does anything get done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有治安官？那事情要怎么处理？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever riled them up sent them into a frenzy. If they can't calm down, they're a threat to the community and need to be put down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论什么激怒了它们，都会使他们发狂。如果它们不能平静下来，它们就会对社区构成威胁，需要被消灭。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Culled?
ESP.TRADUIT: 剔除？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea. They're normally so calm. This last crop in particular. The community thinks I did it. Ridiculous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也不知道，它们平时都很冷静，尤其是最后一次收成。社区认为是我干的，太荒谬了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something must have happened deeper into the nest.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巢穴深处一定发生了什么事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If I could do one thing before my execution, it'd be investigating what made them go beserk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我能在行刑前做一件事，那就是调查是什么让它们如此愤怒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think riled them up?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你认为是什么激怒了它们？

ESP.ORIGINAL: In most places, it doesn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在大多数地方，它不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The offspring our queen seems to spawn are particularly docile. This makes farming them far more practical.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的蚁后产下的后代似乎特别温顺，这使得蓄养它们更加实际。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So long as we maintain the queen, the ants tend to themselves. They scavenge throughout the cave systems and mines, and feed on mushrooms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只要我们照顾蚁后，蚂蚁就会照顾自己。它们在洞穴系统和矿山中觅食，以蘑菇为食。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When the community needs protein, we butcher the older of the flock. Anything 6 months or older.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当社区需要蛋白质的时候，我们就把年龄较大的宰了。6个月或更大的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're no Brahmin Baron's, but we make do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不是婆罗门大亨，但我们凑合着过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't imagine how Ants make good Livestock. How does that work?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我无法想象蚂蚁是如何成为好的家畜的。这是怎么做到的呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take these, Ant pheromones. They will mask your scent among them for some time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 拿这些，蚂蚁信息素。会在一段时间内掩盖你的气味。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should check on the Queen. I call her Amelie. Something must have happened to her to make them this disregulated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该去看看女王，我叫她艾蜜莉。一定是她出了什么事，才让它们这么不正常。
