ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough
ESP.TRADUIT: 说得对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Job [060192B8] (mod) Quest : ([0601BBB0]AZHavenJobDialogue) 0601BBB0 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Too bad, so sad. I'm not helping a murderer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太糟糕了，太悲伤了。我不会帮一个杀人犯的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Broken? That's interesting, your background is that of courier, is it not? I would have thought you wouldn't have investigated the product yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 坏了？真有意思，你的背景是邮差，对吧？我还以为你不会亲自调查产品呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, that's fortuitous. I would hate for the Confederacy to be blamed for this sort of damage. Still, I don't know, something's off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 话虽如此，那也算是幸运，我可不愿意看到邦联因为这种损坏而受到指责。不过，我还是...不知道，感觉有点不对劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, before I go to Base Camp, I noticed the weapons are broken. Do you still want me to go?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，在我去大本营之前，我注意到武器坏了。你还想让我去吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, I should have realized that you were naturally inquisitive. Yes, in exchange for you helping me, I will still help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，我早该意识到你天生好奇。是的，作为你帮我的交换，我还是会帮你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I take this as an indication that you will assist me on this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我把这当作你会协助我的暗示。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am still looking for information on August. I hope you'll still help me out with that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还在寻找奥古斯特的信息，我希望你还能帮我解决这个问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For now, take the shipment to Base Camp. Whether you inform Red Rivers or not is your province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，把货送到大本营去。你通知不通知红河是你的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The important part is that the delivery is completed. Red Rivers is a specialist on this issue, so I will ask him for further details when the evidence is in his care.
ESP.TRADUIT: 重要的是交货完成了。红河是这方面的专家，所以当证据交给他时，我会向他询问更多细节。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, complete your delivery of the shipment. Tell him or don't, but he'll find out in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，完成你的货物交付。告诉他也好，不告诉他也好，但他最终会发现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure, what do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunate. Then, our business is at an end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真不幸。那么，我们的生意就到此为止了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to be blamed for someone else screwing up a Legion shipment. Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想因为别人搞砸了军团的货运而被指责。不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm? Oh, yes, you did this task in exchange for information for your friend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？对了，你做这个任务是为了给你的朋友交换情报。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for your missing person: Alba Nox served as Dominicus Rex's advisor during the interrogations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于失踪的人，阿尔巴·诺克斯是多米尼库斯·勒克斯审讯时的顾问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If August was interrogated by the Frumentarii, Alba Nox would be the one to have handled it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果奥古斯特是被特务审问的话，那一定是阿尔巴·诺克斯来处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, are you interested in assisting me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，你有兴趣协助我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, before I get roped into all of that, you promised me information on August, remember?
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，在我被扯进去之前，你答应给我奥古斯特的信息，记得吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: All available evidence indicates that Alba Nox is responsible for tampering with the weapons. To what end, I'm not sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有现有证据表明阿尔巴·诺克斯对武器进行了篡改。至于目的，我也不清楚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's possible that he is acting out of some misguided desire to force a conflict between the Legion and the Confederacy, but I cannot be sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有可能他的行为是出于某种误导，想要挑起军团和邦联之间的冲突，但我不能确定。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look through his quarters, find evidence, and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 搜查他的住处，找到证据，再来找我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm interested. What do you need me to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很感兴趣。你需要我做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Then our business is at an end. Oh, by the way....
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我们的生意就到此为止了。哦，顺便说一下...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: As for your missing person: Alba Nox served as Dominicus Rex's advisor during the interrogations.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于失踪的人，阿尔巴·诺克斯是多米尼库斯·勒克斯审讯时的顾问。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If August was interrogated by the Frumentarii, Alba Nox would be the one to have handled it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果奥古斯特是被特务审问的话，那一定是阿尔巴·诺克斯来处理的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I have to say on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我要说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to be involved in this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想卷进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Then our business is at an end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那我们的生意就到此为止了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to be involved in this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想卷进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: An outpost known as 188. Wait long enough, and my man will be there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个被称为188的前哨。等久了，我的人就会出现。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Confederate weapons are some of the best in the land, and there is no way it would have left the factory like this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邦联的武器是这片土地上最好的武器之一，它不可能这样离开工厂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Say, would you be interested in helping me with my investigation into this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说，你有兴趣帮我调查这件事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's off?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I saw. Nox has already been taken away. I'm glad we could work together.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到了，诺克斯已经被带走了。我很高兴我们能一起工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, some caps we Frumentarii use for operating in Wasteland territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，这是一些我们军团特务在废土地区活动时使用的瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take care of yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 照顾好自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I spoke to Rex about Nox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跟勒克斯谈过诺克斯的事。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some questions about the Nox situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对诺克斯的情况有些疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the supply line is easy enough to follow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那条补给线还是很容易追踪的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The weapons factory is located on State Route 191. It was transported by a National Guard caravan to the I-40. Weapons checks were good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 武器工厂位于191号州际公路上，它被警卫队的大篷车运到了40号高速公路上。武器检查很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: From there, it was picked up by a reliable Frumentarii asset and transported to Chloride, with weapons checks in Flagstaff and Kingman.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那里，一个可靠的军团特务线人找到了它并把它运到了克洛赖德，在旗杆市和金曼进行了武器检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After that, it was directly transported by the Frumentarii to this location. The only point at which the chain of custody was broken is here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在那之后，它被军团特务直接运送到这个地方。监管链唯一断裂的地方就是这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The shipment was requested by Nox, but there's a six-hour period after he noted it and when he asked me to deliver it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这批货是诺克斯要求的，但从他记下货到他让我把货送过去，还有六个小时的时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you followed the supply line, right? Any leads there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你沿着补给线走，对吧？有什么线索吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. An interesting point. I wonder is that is part of Nox's plan, to implicate me instead of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这一点很有趣。我怀疑这是诺克斯的计划之一，把我牵连进来而不是他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, that's a good point. You should follow up on that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，这是一个很好的观点。你应该继续跟进。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Based on what you're saying, that means the chain of custody ends at Nox and starts with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 根据你所说的，这意味着监管链在诺克斯结束，从你开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me be clear here: it would be foolish for me to unnecessarily involve some third party if I am responsible for the sabotage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我在这里说清楚：如果我要对损坏负责，那我把不必要的第三方牵扯进来将是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you can think of a really good reason that I would do that, I would advise not pursuing this line of inquiry any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你能想出一个很好的理由让我这么做，否则我建议你不要再继续进行这方面的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you would be a suspect, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那你也会成为嫌疑人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me be clear here: it would be foolish for me to unnecessarily involve some third party if I am responsible for the sabotage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我在这里说清楚：如果我要对损坏负责，那我把不必要的第三方牵扯进来将是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you can think of a really good reason that I would do that, I would advise not pursuing this line of inquiry any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你能想出一个很好的理由让我这么做，否则我建议你不要再继续进行这方面的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you would be a suspect, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那你也会成为嫌疑人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me be clear here: it would be foolish for me to unnecessarily involve some third party if I am responsible for the sabotage.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我在这里说清楚：如果我要对损坏负责，那我把不必要的第三方牵扯进来将是愚蠢的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless you can think of a really good reason that I would do that, I would advise not pursuing this line of inquiry any further.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非你能想出一个很好的理由让我这么做，否则我建议你不要再继续进行这方面的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this key in your house, and the screwdriver in a toolbox in a shed unlocked by this key.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在你家里找到了这把钥匙，螺丝刀在一个工具箱里，工具箱是用这把钥匙打开的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Consider this: if the Legion believes that the Confederacy is actively sabotaging them, the person most likely to be blamed is me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想想看：如果军团认为邦联在蓄意破坏他们，最可能被指责的人就是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would I place a spotlight on myself?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我为什么要把焦点放在自己身上？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that does not persuade you, then consider this: a war between the Legion and the Confederacy at this moment would only benefit the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这还不能说服你，那么请考虑一下：此时此刻军团与邦联之间的战争只会对NCR有利。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I can tell you that for the Confederacy, the NCR is a far greater evil from the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以告诉你，对于邦联来说，NCR是比军团更大的恶魔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All I'm saying is that you and Nox are unaccounted for. I'm just trying to help here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只想说，你和诺克斯都下落不明。我只是想帮忙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't say for certain, but it's possible that Nox is simply opposed to the status quo. Potential enemies must be dealt with now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能确定，但有可能诺克斯只是反对现状。现在必须处理潜在的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Perhaps, it's out of some misguided belief that he's doing the right thing, but it is a very small picture way of thinking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，这是出于某种错误的信念，认为他在做正确的事情，但这是一种非常小的思维方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, so what might the motivation of Nox be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那诺克斯的动机是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That confirms it. Moronic of him to place it in his desk directly, but even the best slip up from time to time. Or perhaps we caught him too early.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就证实了。他居然傻到直接把它放在办公桌里，不过，即使是最厉害的人也难免会一时疏忽。又或者，也许是我们抓到他太早了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any event, I want you to inform Dominicus Rex of these developments so that some action may be taken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我希望你把这些进展告诉多米尼库斯·勒克斯以便采取行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found these weapon parts in his desk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在他桌上找到了这些武器零件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Disturbing, but this is about all the proof I need that Cato's unit needs some cleaning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 令人不安，但我只需要这个证据就能证明加图的小队需要清理了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If he ripped out the pages to cover up his own activities, that's one thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果他撕掉那几页是为了掩盖自己的行为，那是一回事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But this logbook is the only thing that prevents us from accidentally interfering with each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但只有这个日志，才能防止我们不小心互相干扰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In any event, I want you to inform Dominicus Rex of these developments so that some action may be taken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无论如何，我希望你把这些进展告诉多米尼库斯·勒克斯以便采取行动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found the logbook for the weapons. The pages for the date of the delivery were ripped out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到武器的日志了，写着交货日期的那几页被撕掉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In what way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 用什么方式？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something about you is untrustworthy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有些地方不值得信任。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As could you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你也一样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nox and you both could have interfered with the package.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克斯和你俩都有可能干扰包裹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Valid. That said, I could have something that convinces you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 合理。话虽如此，我还是有办法说服你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but I wouldn't have pointed out they were broken if I was the one who broke them, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但如果是我弄坏的我就不会指出它们坏了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know you're trying to be a good infiltrator, so I'll tell you this. I've been keeping it a secret for now, but this is the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我知道你想成为一名优秀的卧底，所以我告诉你。我一直在保守这个秘密，但这是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My current employer is none other than Lanius. He has requested that the Frumentarii be weakened ahead of the Battle of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我现在的雇主不是别人，正是拉尼厄斯。他要求在胡佛水坝战役之前削弱军团特务的力量。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know you've been working for the NCR, so I'll tell you this. I've been keeping it a secret for now, but this is the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我知道你一直在为NCR工作，所以我告诉你。我一直在保守这个秘密，但这是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was an NCR agent, and Nox murdered him to cover it up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特是NCR特工，诺克斯杀了他来掩盖真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I know you're a devoted Legionary, so I'll tell you this. I've been keeping it a secret for now, but this is the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我知道你是一名忠诚的军团士兵，所以我告诉你。我一直在保守这个秘密，但这是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato's unit, that is the cell Nox operates as a part of, has a rat known as Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图的小队，也就是诺克斯所在的小队，有一只叫克渥斯的老鼠。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Several months ago, he disappeared after warning the Chainway was doomed to collapse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几个月前，他在警告连环道要坍塌后失踪了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, the Chainway collapsed. The connection is obvious between the two, but what is less obvious is the connections between Corvus and Nox.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，连环道坍塌了。两者之间的联系是显而易见的，但克渥斯和诺克斯之间的联系就不那么明显了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nox was a friend of Corvus, a close confidant. And Nox, whose procurement speciality is somewhat legendary....
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克斯是克渥斯的朋友，亲密的知己。还有诺克斯，他的采购专长有点传奇...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, where could Corvus gotten his explosives from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，克渥斯的炸药是从哪里来的呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I think. This frivolous investigation into me is you attempting to forestall time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是这么想的，你对我这种无聊的调查是在试图拖延时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This has all of the hallmarks of someone attempting to cover their own tracks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这一切都表明有人想掩盖自己的踪迹。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. You have to be careful to not let your mind do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。你必须小心不要让你的大脑那样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. My mind is playing some tricks on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别介意，我的大脑在跟我开玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if you're trying to cover your tracks, then you are guilty!
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想掩盖自己的痕迹，那你就有罪了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, wha-?
That's what my investigation has yielded. We believe August was connected with the Big Stop Uprising
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我的调查结果，我们认为奥古斯特与大站暴动有关。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nox investigated August, and several days later, he disappeared. He was in Nox's custody.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺克斯调查了奥古斯特，几天后他就消失了，他被诺克斯关押着。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was an NCR agent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特是NCR特工？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Evidence points that way, but I've been holding back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 证据指向那个方向，但我一直在隐瞒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to be on the wrong end of Cato if he decides the reputation of his unit is more important than stopping a traitor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果加图认为他的部队的名誉比阻止叛徒更重要的话我可不想成为他的敌人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This latest debacle with the weapons, I mean, Nox must be stopped. Will you help me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这次的武器风波，我是说，必须阻止诺克斯。你能帮我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're saying that Nox helped the Legion blow up the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说诺克斯帮助军团炸毁了连环道？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He dislikes the Frumentarii. I don't know what I should be doing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不喜欢军团特务，我不知道我该怎么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: On one hand, yes, I sympathize. The Legion needs its purity. But at what cost? This weakens the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一方面，是的，我很同情。军团需要它的纯净，但代价是什么呢？这会削弱军团。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I would appreciate if you didn't tell the leadership about this. I've been delaying it as much as I can. I'll get a clearer answer after Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不把这件事告诉领导层，我会很感激的。我一直在尽可能拖延时间，胡佛大坝之后我会有更明确的答案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lanius is telling you to sabotage the Frumentarii?
ESP.TRADUIT: 拉尼厄斯让你去削弱军团特务？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask, and I'll tell you the truth. The real truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你问，我就告诉你真相。真正的真相。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The truth. I want it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真相。我想要。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not ready to tell you that yet. So, let's start with something simple. Your choice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还没准备好告诉你。那么，让我们从简单的事情开始。你自己选。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I represent a group in the Confederacy that seeks to maintain the status quo between the NCR and Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我代表邦联的一个团体，希望维持NCR和军团之间的现状。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see, both the NCR and Legion are threats to us. So, we will force them to fight each other and strengthen ourselves as they drain each other dry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，NCR和军团都是我们的威胁。所以，我们将迫使他们互相争斗，在他们耗尽彼此能量的同时增强自己。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you with?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁的人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. They are spineless, multicultural fools, not willing to do what needs to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是。他们是懦弱的、多元文化的傻瓜，不愿意做需要做的事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They let the smaller nations lead its policy and attitude. If not for them, we wouldn't have even had to sign the Window Rock treaty abomination.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让较小的国家主导其政策和态度。如果不是他们，我们甚至都不用签署可恶的温多罗克条约。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I am with my own group, real Diné soldiers capable of fighting the Legion and the NCR at every level.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我是和我自己的团体在一起的，真正的迪内人士兵有能力在各个层面与军团和NCR作战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you with the Confederate government, then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么你是邦联政府的人了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's leave names out of it for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们先不提名字。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's just say that we trace a lineage of securing our freedom, our future that dates back centuries.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这么说吧，我们确保我们自由与未来的传承，可以追溯到好几个世纪以前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We have toppled empires on the other side of the world and survived the apocalypse. The Legion and the NCR are just two more obstacles for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们推翻了世界另一端的帝国，并在世界末日中幸存下来。军团和NCR对我们来说只是另外两个障碍。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is your group called?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的团体叫什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's simple. The longer the NCR and the Legion fight, the more time the Confederacy has to prepare, and the weaker the two become.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很简单。NCR和军团战斗的时间越长，邦联准备的时间就越长，两者就会变得越弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: To maintain this status quo, wherever the NCR and Legion are strong, they must become weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为了维持这种现状，NCR和军团在哪里强大，哪里就必须变弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An NCR too powerful would utterly crush the Legion, and a Legion too strong might force the NCR to surrender. These scenarios are not ideal for us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个过于强大的NCR会彻底摧毁军团，而一个过于强大的军团可能会迫使NCR投降。这些情况对我们来说并不理想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big Stop is the nexus of the Legion's war effort of the north. Frumentarii operations and planning. Caesar's personal orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站是军团在北方作战的枢纽，军团特务的运营和计划，凯撒的个人命令。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You couldn't ask for a better place to procure intelligence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你找不到更好的地方来获取情报了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing in Big Stop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在大站做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion, even in peace, wages war on the true nations in the bones of the dead American empire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团，即使在和平时期，也会借着美帝国的尸骨向真正的国家发动战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They levy our children to turn them against us, they steal our gold, drain our water, push the boot against our throats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们让我们的孩子背叛我们，他们偷走我们的金子，榨干我们的水，用靴子顶着我们的喉咙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they make a mockery of us and taint the Tsékooh Hatsoh with their malignance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们嘲笑我们，用他们的恶意玷污Tsékooh Hatsoh。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you hate the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么恨军团？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tsékooh Hatsoh. The Magnum Chasma or Grand Canyon or whatever your Wasteland tongue derives it as.
ESP.TRADUIT: Tsékooh Hatsoh，大峡谷。The Magnum Chasma或者Grand Canyon或者随便你的废土语怎么念的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry, but, uh, what was that word you said? Tsay....
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，但是，你刚才说什么来着？Tsay...

ESP.ORIGINAL: The America that tried to end the world tried to end us first. But they never succeeded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想要毁灭世界的美国先要毁灭我们。但他们从未成功。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR follows in those footsteps. But this time, we won't just be ready. We'll win.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR追随了这些脚步。但这一次，我们不仅准备好了，我们还会赢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How is the NCR a threat to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR对你有什么威胁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, August. Go ahead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，奥古斯特。说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August. Let's start with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特，让我们从他开始。

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was a member of, or associated with, Support Unit Hoover.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特是胡佛支援小队的成员，或者与之有联系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who was he and why did he have to die?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是谁，为什么他必须死？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That is correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It wasn't Alba Nox who killed him, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么不是阿尔巴·诺克斯杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you kill him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你杀了他吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was searching for Haven and required information. I managed to drag him out to the repair shop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在寻找港湾，需要一些信息。我设法把他拖到修理店。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But I couldn't break him, and I did try. He said nothing, even to the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但我没能说服他，我试过了。他什么也没说，直到最后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Noble, but obviously a massive problem for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高尚，但显然对我来说是个大问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you kill him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要杀他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 问他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some more questions about August.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有一些关于奥古斯特的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I sent him, yes. I told him that anyone attempting to open the barrel would have been an NCR agent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，我派他去的。我告诉他，任何试图打开桶的人都是NCR特工。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If it helps, it wasn't personal. It is never personal with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果有帮助的话，这不是针对个人的。对我来说，这从来都不是私人恩怨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guy at the landfill shooting at me? That was you, wasn't it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个在垃圾填埋场朝我开枪的人？是你，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not do it myself, you mean? Because you have the Mark and Caesar's me, and I needed to weaken Cato's unit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说，我为什么不自己动手？因为你有那个徽记而我是凯撒的人，并且我也需要削弱加图的部队。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Caesar's chosen mercenary indicated that one of the best Frumentarii cells was compromised in some way, well...
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果凯撒选中的佣兵表明，最优秀的军团特务小组之一也以某种方式遭到了渗透，那么...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It would lend credibility to my claims to Dominicus Rex that something was rotten in that unit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这会让我对多米尼库斯·勒克斯说的那个小队有问题的说法更加可信。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why did you involve me in this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么把我扯进来？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius, the man without a face. Literally, since you've met him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，那个没脸的人。真的，从你认识他开始。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius, one of Caesar's best field operatives. Ever since Vulpes was killed, Cato is the one who has the ear of the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，凯撒最得力的外勤人员之一。自从沃尔普斯被杀后，加图就成了堡垒的眼线。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato is secretive, even by Frumentarii standards. I have yet to meet him in person. Well, as far as I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图行事诡秘，即使以军团特务的标准来看也是如此，我还没有见过他本人。嗯，据我所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you never do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你从来不这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius, one of Caesar's best field operatives. Ever since Vulpes was killed, Cato is the one who has Caesar's ear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，凯撒最得力的外勤人员之一。自从沃尔普斯被杀后，凯撒就一直在听加图的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato is secretive, even by Frumentarii standards. I have yet to meet him in person. Well, as far as I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图行事诡秘，即使以军团特务的标准来看也是如此，我还没有见过他本人。嗯，据我所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you never do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你从来不这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius, one of Caesar's best field operatives. If Vulpes died, then Cato would have the ear of the Fort.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，凯撒最得力的外勤人员之一。如果沃尔普斯死了，那么加图就会得到堡垒的支持。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato is secretive, even by Frumentarii standards. I have yet to meet him in person. Well, as far as I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图行事诡秘，即使以军团特务的标准来看也是如此，我还没有见过他本人。嗯，据我所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you never do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你从来不这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato Hostilius, one of Caesar's best field operatives. If Vulpes died, then Cato would be the one who would have Caesar's ear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图·奥斯蒂吕斯，凯撒最得力的外勤人员之一。如果沃尔普斯死了，凯撒就会听从加图的意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cato is secretive, even by Frumentarii standards. I have yet to meet him in person. Well, as far as I know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图行事诡秘，即使以军团特务的标准来看也是如此，我还没有见过他本人。嗯，据我所知。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because you never do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你从来不这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Cato?
ESP.TRADUIT: 加图是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A resistance group operating in this region. They were responsible for the first liberation of Big Stop, back during the initial battle for Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在该地区活动的抵抗组织。他们为大站的第一次解放负责，早在胡佛水坝的最初战役中。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since then, they have been quiet. Very quiet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从那以后，他们就安静了。非常安静。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 胡佛支援小队是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some of the colleagues believe they blew up the Chainway in collusion with a rogue Frumentarius agent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些同事认为他们与一个离群的军团特务间谍勾结炸毁了连环道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have my doubts, but I can't rule it out either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有我的怀疑，但我也不能排除这种可能性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think Support Unit Hoover is doing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得胡佛支援小队在干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. A successful slave rebellion in the heart of Legion military operations would be potent, maybe too potent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。在军团军事行动的中心，一场成功的奴隶叛乱将是强有力的，也许会过于有力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Could weaken the Legion much more than we're willing to tolerate, especially if they were responsible for the destruction of the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 可能会大大削弱军团的力量，超出我们的承受范围，尤其如果他们还是破坏连环道的罪魁祸首的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What will you do if you find Support Unit Hoover?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你找到胡佛支援小队，你会怎么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion codename for a potential slave refuge in this region of Arizona. A potential crisis situation waiting to happen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的代号，在亚利桑那州的这个地区，一个潜在的奴隶避难所。即将发生的潜在危机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's Haven?
ESP.TRADUIT: 港湾是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Where?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？哪里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know where Haven is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道港湾在哪里。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had some other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有别的问题要问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That depends. Do you intend to keep this secret?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那得看情况。你打算保守这个秘密吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, what's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，接下来呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct. I want you to find Haven, locate the dissident, kill her and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确。我要你找到港湾，找到那个异见者，杀了她然后回到我身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In Haven.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在港湾。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is worse than the Legion. They have a more stable government, access to more resources and a larger population.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR比军团还糟糕。他们有一个更稳定的政府，可以获得更多的资源和更多的人口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are ambitious and greedy enough to not just send their soldiers to take what they want, but their civilians, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们野心勃勃，贪得无厌，不仅派他们的士兵去夺取他们想要的东西，还派他们的平民去夺取。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Settlers." "Prospectors." All the way, they lull themselves into believing what they are doing is right.
ESP.TRADUIT: “定居者”、“淘金客”。在整个过程中，他们欺骗自己相信他们所做的是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not following.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR is worse than the Legion. They have a more stable government, access to more resources and a larger population.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR比军团还糟糕。他们有一个更稳定的政府，可以获得更多的资源和更多的人口。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are ambitious and greedy enough to not just send their soldiers to take what they want, but their civilians, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们野心勃勃，贪得无厌，不仅派他们的士兵去夺取他们想要的东西，还派他们的平民去夺取。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Settlers." "Prospectors." All the way, they lull themselves into believing what they are doing is right.
ESP.TRADUIT: “定居者”、“淘金客”。在整个过程中，他们欺骗自己相信他们所做的是正确的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elaborate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 详细说明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct. Don't tell Jem the specifics. Fact of the matter is that she is blabbermouth and will her and potentially dozens of other people killed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确，别把细节告诉捷姆。事实是，她是一个长舌妇，她和其他几十个人可能会被杀害。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is August the body in the barrel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特是桶里的尸体吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Correct. It's a shame Jem died without knowing the truth, although knowing her, she would not have survived long after learning it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正确。真可惜捷姆死的时候还不知道真相，不过如果了解她，她知道真相后也活不了多久。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is August the body in the barrel?
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特是桶里的尸体吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. The robot I wasn't concerned about. Its memory tapes are routinely wiped. Clever work extracting visitor numbers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。我并不关心的机器人，它的存储磁带会定期被清除。提取访客数量的聪明工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The robot at Buck's mentioned two people coming in. You and August?
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴克的机器人说有两个人进来了。你和奥古斯特？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, that is a good question. I suppose it's time for you to find who I work for, unless you have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，这是个好问题。我想是时候让你知道我为谁工作了，除非你还有其他问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're working against the Legion, then why are you looking for Haven?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你在对抗军团，那你为什么要找港湾？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yes, of course. I suppose it's time for you to find who I work for.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的，当然。我想是时候让你知道我为谁工作了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not so fast, I still have questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先别急，我还有问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have work for you. I am assuming that you are interested because you now know too much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有工作给你。我假设你感兴趣是因为你现在知道的太多了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a Confederate dissident that has discovered my organization's plans.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有个邦联异见者发现了我组织的计划。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She has successfully avoided my agents and has hidden herself away somewhere in the Mojave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她成功地避开了我的间谍，躲在了莫哈维沙漠的某个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么工作？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are in Legion lands as an enemy of Caesar. Backup!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你作为凯撒的敌人来到了军团的领地。支援！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Then only one of us is leaving here alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。那我们中只有一个人能活着离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. Intelligence indicates somewhere to the southeast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。情报显示是东南方向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii believe it may be in the radio silence zone surrounding the SMART Array, so I'd start your search there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务认为它可能在智能阵列周围的无线电静默区，所以我建议你从那里开始搜索。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where is Haven?
ESP.TRADUIT: 港湾在哪里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ideally, you could simply kill the target and then leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 理想情况下，你可以简单地杀死目标然后离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you want me to kill everyone in Haven?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让我杀了港湾的所有人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Confederate government files refer to her as 'Bodaway'. Real name is Ahote Masayesva-Yatik.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邦联政府档案中称她为“博德维”，真名是阿霍特·马萨耶斯瓦-雅蒂克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is a Hopi-naa'na, not that their features are distinct to you lot. Sorry, you want more relevant information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是一个霍皮人，倒也不是说你们这帮人能分得清他们的特征。抱歉，你想要的是更相关的信息。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She is a terrorist who previously operated in Confederate territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她是一名恐怖分子，曾在邦联境内活动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Typical background for secessionists. College protester. Militia soldier. Drug dealer. Some political connections, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 典型的分裂分子背景，大学抗议者、民兵士兵、毒贩。不过也有一些政治关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me more about the target.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我更多目标的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: She discovered our organization's activities, and she must not inform my government under any circumstances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她发现了我们组织的活动，在任何情况下都不能通知我国政府。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We need her gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们需要她消失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you want to kill her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要杀她？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unpleasant business, but it had to be done. Here's your reward, and the Diné thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不愉快的事，但不得不做。这是你的报酬，还有迪内人的感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so will the Legion once I boost your profile with them, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，只要我提升了你的知名度，军团也会这么做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have my own work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，恕我失陪，我还有自己的工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote is already dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特已经死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Find Haven, find her, kill her, return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。找到港湾，找到她，杀了她，回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No questions? Really? Well, the name of your target is Bodaway, real name of Ahote Masayesva-Yatik.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题吗？真的吗？你的目标叫博德维，真名是阿霍特·马萨耶斯瓦-雅蒂克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She's probably in Haven, so find it, find her, kill her and return.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她可能在港湾，所以找到港湾，找到她，杀了她，然后回来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't know where Haven is, but intelligence indicates somewhere to the southeast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不知道港湾在哪里，但情报显示在东南方向。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii believe it may be in the radio silence zone surrounding the SMART Array, so I'd start your search there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务认为它可能在智能阵列周围的无线电静默区，所以我建议你从那里开始搜索。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'm ready.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我准备好了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are in Legion lands as an enemy of Caesar. Backup!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你作为凯撒的敌人来到了军团的领地。支援！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Then only one of us is leaving here alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。那我们中只有一个人能活着离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yes.... But he did it without proper authorization.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的...但他没有经过授权就这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Frumentarii are just allowed to willy-nilly murder each other's prisoners, things fall apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果允许军团特务随意杀害对方的囚犯，事情就会分崩离析。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, good. If was an NCR spy, then he deserved to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，很好。如果他是NCR间谍，那他该死。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Frumentarii are just allowed to willy-nilly murder each other's prisoners, things fall apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果允许军团特务随意杀害对方的囚犯，事情就会分崩离析。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine if the NCR did that to their own operatives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一下如果NCR对自己的特工也这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want Nox dead because he killed an NCR spy? What sense does that make?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想让诺克斯死就因为他杀了一个NCR间谍？这有什么意义？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Frumentarii are just allowed to willy-nilly murder each other's prisoners, things fall apart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果允许军团特务随意杀害对方的囚犯，事情就会分崩离析。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Imagine if the NCR did that to their own operatives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 想象一下如果NCR对自己的特工也这么做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You bastard. NCR scum.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你这个杂种，NCR渣滓。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've heard enough. You're a traitor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听够了。你是个叛徒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, then have no part in this and leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就别掺和了，离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take this currency for your service. Our business is at an end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 收下这笔钱吧。我们的生意到此为止了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want no part of this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想掺和进来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Excellent. I want you to deal with Nox. Killing him would be too on the nose, so I simply want to get him removed from his current position.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太好了。我要你去对付诺克斯，杀了他太离谱了，所以我只想把他从现在的职位上撤下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An investigation would take too long, so I want you to sneak gun casings into his room instead. Make smoke, and the Legion will see fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 调查会花很长时间，所以我想让你把弹壳偷偷带进他的房间。制造烟雾，军团就会看到火光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, inform Dominicus Rex about the evidence for Nox's crimes, and you may return to me for payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，把诺克斯犯罪的证据告诉多米尼库斯·勒克斯，你就可以回来找我要钱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想帮你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're my contact, then.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那你就是我的联络人了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have the stuff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有那些东西吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But going off the beaten track broadens the mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但不走寻常路能开阔眼界。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing much there except Radscorpions. You should head out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了辐射蝎什么都没有。你该走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for someone here in Searchlight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在探照灯营地找个人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get lost. This is my claim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚开，这是我的地盘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, I'm looking for salvage. Anything good at that airport over there?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，我在找废品。那边机场有什么好东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, that's all for me. For you, take this holotape and put it in a dead drop at these coordinates.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我就到此为止了。对你来说，拿着这卷全息磁带，把它放在这些坐标的情报传递点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus, your handlers not train you right or something? Asking questions about deliveries is not in this business.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天啊，你的联络人没好好训练你吗？在这个行业里，不应该问送货的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thanks for the laugh, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谢谢你的笑声，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have the stuff at least?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你至少拿到东西了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this package?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个包裹是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Keep asking them, and you won't have a tongue to ask them anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再问下去，你就没舌头问了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do have questions, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我确实有些问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, that's all she wrote. Watch yourself going out of Searchlight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，这就是她写的所有东西。小心离开探照灯营地。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck, I knew I recognized you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操，我就知道我认出你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good to see a friendly face out here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴在这里看到友善的面孔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR] Wait, you're an NCR Ranger, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR]等等，你是NCR游骑兵，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? My mistake. I thought you were someone else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？是我的错。我以为你是别人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't understand, I thought I was working for the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不明白，我以为我在为军团工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the fuck are you doing working for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你他妈为什么要为军团工作？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Same here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也一样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I'll take....
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我收下...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, what the fuck are you doing working for the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你他妈为什么要为军团工作？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's your holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是你的全息磁带。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] So? You said that already.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]所以呢？你已经说过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait. You're a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，你是个游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You could track me down and kill me even if you let me go. Give me a chance to say my piece.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就算你放我走，你也能找到我然后杀了我。给我个机会把话说完。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Tch.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]啧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait! Please don't kill me!
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等！请不要杀我！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you've got life in you yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喔，你还挺有活力的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> Your move, soldier boy.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>你该走了，士兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A murder in Big Stop led you all the way to the other side of the Colorado?
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站的谋杀案让你一路跑到科罗拉多河的另一边？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wait, wait, Big Stop, Big Stop....
ESP.TRADUIT: 等等，等等，大站，大站...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the Frumentarii are involved, aren't they?
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，军团特务也参与了，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm investigating the disappearance of a man named August. His friend in Big Stop can't find him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在调查一个叫奥古斯特的人的失踪案，他在大站的朋友找不到他了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You aren't lying, I can tell you that. But you're an idiot.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你没有撒谎，我可以告诉你。但你是个白痴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii are gonna play you. They're playing you right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务会耍你，他们现在就在耍你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, yeah, a Frumentarius sent me here. I do a job, he gives me information.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，是的，一个军团特务派我来的。我做事，他给我情报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's so, you're dumber than you look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是这样的话，那你比看起来还要蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii are gonna play you. They're playing you right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务会耍你，他们现在就在耍你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm no lover of the Legion. I'm only doing this because I need intel from the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是军团的拥护者，我这么做只是因为我需要军团特务的情报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If that's so, you're dumber than you look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果是这样的话，那你比看起来还要蠢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii are gonna play you. They're playing you right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务会耍你，他们现在就在耍你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I'm no lover of the Legion. I'm only doing this because I need intel from the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我不是军团的拥护者，我这么做只是因为我需要军团特务的情报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Good instincts. Yeah, that's right. I'm a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]良好的直觉。嗯，没错，我是游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这关你什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you a Ranger?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是游骑兵吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Yeah, I've been off for a while. Have to be. And so are you. So, you should hand over the holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]是的，我已经离开一段时间了。我不得不这么做，而你也是。所以，你应该把那个全息磁带交出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something about you seems off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好像有些不对劲。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah, that's right. I'm a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]对，你说得没错，我是个游骑兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's it to you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这关你什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The way you carry yourself out here in the radiation. You're tough, Ranger tough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这辐射中走路的样子。你很强，游骑兵强。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have the stuff at least?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你至少拿到东西了吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crazy that you're standing out here in the radiation. Aren't you worried about getting sick?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你站在外面受辐射真是太疯狂了。你不担心会生病吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your choice to make, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这是你的选择。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a risk I'm willing to take.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我愿意冒这个险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Layers upon layers. Someone's running their own game.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一层又一层，有人在玩他们自己的游戏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, why would the Frumentarii send someone to deliver intel to the NCR?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，为什么军团特务派人把情报交给NCR？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe. Maybe not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许是，也许不是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean that the Frumentarii are compromised?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说军团特务违背原则了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. Maybe I don't want to do this exchange after all. Maybe I don't want you leaving here to talk about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说得对。也许我根本就不想做这笔交易，也许我不希望你离开这里谈论这件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's not go down that road.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们不要再往下走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or maybe that's what they want you to think, and whatever I'm giving you is meant to sabotage you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或许他们就是想让你这么想，而我给你的东西就是为了妨碍你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他妈的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're supposed to battle plans for the Parker Campaign, taken straight from Caesar's War Room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们应该是帕克战役的作战计划，直接从凯撒的作战室里拿来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is this holotape supposed to be?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个全息磁带是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: South of the Mojave, another little front along the Colorado. Getting this is a coup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 莫哈维以南，沿着科罗拉多河的另一条小战线。拿到这个可算是一大功劳。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Parker?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕克？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hang on a second. I want you to do something for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 等一下。我想让你为我做一件事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Something's off, real off here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些事不对劲，真的不对劲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I trust you enough to ask this of you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能信任你，让你帮我吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if that's all, I'd like to get this over with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，如果就这些，我想赶快把这事了结了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Then, I'll take this holotape and be on my way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧。那我就带上这个全息磁带走人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's my holotape. Place it in a dead drop in these coordinates. Payment's there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的全息磁带，把它放在这些坐标里的情报传递点。报酬就在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you want me to do, I'm not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管你想让我做什么，我都不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have free reign in Caesar's land, so you're the only one who can do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在凯撒统治的土地上拥有自由，所以你是唯一能做这件事的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to head back across the river. Take a look at those plans inside the War Room. See if they match.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你回到河对岸去。看看作战室里的那些计划，看看它们是否匹配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, absolutely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，绝对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have free reign in Caesar's land, so you're the only one who can do this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在凯撒统治的土地上拥有自由，所以你是唯一能做这件事的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want you to head back across the river. Take a look at those plans inside the War Room. See if they match.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要你回到河对岸去。看看作战室里的那些计划，看看它们是否匹配。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Yes, absolutely.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>是的，绝对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not interested in a transfer to Echo, so meet me at the Mojave Post, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没兴趣转去回声，我们在莫哈维邮政见，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, and I'll be taking that holotape.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对了，我要带走那卷全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You better hope those plans are right then. We won't meet again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你最好祈祷那些计划是正确的，我们不会再见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's my holotape. Place it in a dead drop in these coordinates. Payment's there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我的全息磁带，把它放在这些坐标里的情报传递点。报酬就在那里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't?

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不感兴趣。抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? And what'd you find out?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？你发现了什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reassuring. Well, I'm off. Diné shenanigans just have my head spinning, that's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让人安心。好了，我走了，迪内人的恶作剧只是让我头晕目眩，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, got this note for you. Marking the dead drop on your map. Payment's there, and you can let your friend know same time soon, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，这是给你的便条，在地图上标出情报传递点。付款已经到了，你可以马上通知你朋友，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> The plans were correct. You don't have to worry about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>计划是正确的，你不用担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're playing their own game. Telling us one thing and the Legion another.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们在玩自己的游戏。跟我们说一套，跟军团说另一套。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we're not going to play.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们不玩了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whoever sent you needs to die.
ESP.TRADUIT: 派你来的人必须死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're right. The plans are fake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是对的，这些计划是假的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough. You have done right by the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 合理。你对NCR做得很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your payment's in a sack outside the Boulder City train station.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的报酬在巨石城火车站外的袋子里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't think who sent you going's to be too happy about it, so be on the lookout.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我觉得派你的人不会高兴的，所以你要多加注意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested in murdering for hire. Got you your intel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对受雇杀人不感兴趣。给你情报。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gold. Legion gold. 150 denarii liberated from a caravan near Yuma.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黄金，军团金币，从尤马附近的商队身上搞到的150第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's in it for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: [交易]这对我有什么好处？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Kill this asshole and return to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。杀了这个混蛋，然后回到我身边。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then go and fucking do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就他妈动手吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还没。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. As promised, some Legion clink. Better you use them than the Legion. Oh, and I'm sure some Rangers will be happy with what you did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。就像承诺的，一些军团的叮当声，你用他们总比军团用强。我相信有些游骑兵会对你的所作所为感到满意的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Goodbye. We won't meet again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 再见。我们不会再见面了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他的头。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, what is the meaning of this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，这是什么意思？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you understand that assassinating a Frumentarius comes with the highest penalties? Well, do you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道刺杀军团特务会受到最高的惩罚吗？嗯，你知道吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm. Unusual. He is not quite of the Legion. Maybe, this bears further investigation.
