ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯，不寻常。他不完全是军团的一员。也许，这需要进一步的调查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may go, but your standing with the Legion has decreased. We can't have even Caesar's chosen murdering our own Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以走，但你在军团中的地位下降了。我们不能让凯撒的选民谋杀我们自己的军团特务。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahiga accused me of tampering with a weapons shipment, but I was the one who told him about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加指责我破坏了武器运输，但是我告诉他的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Then, we will go ballistic on you!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]那我们就对你大发雷霆！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. He just went ballistic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他突然暴跳如雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm.... Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]唔...很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This will make the Fort unhappy, but an investigation needs to be done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 虽然会让堡垒不高兴，但还是需要调查一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If one of Cato's Frumentarii are disloyal, then that's bad for everybody, but the Fort needs to know. You may go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果加图的军团特务里有人不忠，那对大家都不好，但堡垒需要知道。你可以走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alba Nox tampered with a weapons shipment sent to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿尔巴·诺克斯篡改了一批运往军团的武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Then, we will go ballistic on you!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]那我们就对你大发雷霆！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. He just went ballistic.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道。他突然暴跳如雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries!
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I'm liberating Big Stop, right here, right now.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我要解放大站，就在此时此地。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's true, but this is essentially my domain. Caesar has entrusted with full powers over who lives and who dies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是对的，但这实际上是我的领域。凯撒已经全权交由我决定谁生谁死。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have a good reason for killing not a valued Frumentarius, but also a representative of one of the Legion's most trusted allies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么充分的理由，不仅杀害了一名宝贵的军团特务，还杀害了一名军团最信任盟友的代表？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, hey, hey, wait. I have the Mark of Caesar. Do you really want to piss off the people upstairs?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂喂喂，等等。我身上有凯撒的徽记，你真的想惹毛上面的人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He sent me to deliver a shipment of Confederate weapons to Base Camp, but they were broken.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他派我把一批邦联武器运到大本营，但武器坏了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Perhaps, his emotions got the better of him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。也许，他的情绪控制了他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You may go. We will carry out our own investigation. In the future, we may not be so lenient.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可以走了，我们将自行调查。将来，我们可能不会这么宽容。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I was investigating who might have been responsible and he accused me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当时在调查谁应该对此负责，他却指控我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll get back to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会回去处理的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you talking about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在说什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm investigating a shipment of broken Confederate weapons. Do you know anything about that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在调查一批损坏的邦联武器。你知道这件事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, yes, those. Well, a shipment did arrive recently, but I don't believe it was my jurisdiction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，对的，就是那些。最近确实有一批货到了，但我想那不是我的管辖范围。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Broken, huh? Do you suspect sabotage then?
ESP.TRADUIT: 坏了，是吧？那你是怀疑有人蓄意破坏？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A shipment. It came here to the police station in the past week for delivery to Base Camp?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一批货。它在过去一周内送到了这里的警察局，是要转送到大本营的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Incredibly bold of you to accuse a Frumentari, one of Caesar's best, by the way, of anti-Legion activities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是胆子真够大的，竟然敢指控一名军团特务。顺便说一句，可是凯撒最优秀的手下之一，从事反军团活动。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to treat this as a joke. Leave me. I have work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我就当这是个玩笑吧。离开我吧，我有工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believe you are responsible for the shipment being broken or at the very least a suspect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我相信你对货物的损坏负有责任或者至少是嫌疑犯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you seri-? Fine, ask.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是认真...？好吧，问吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about my investigation for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于我的调查，我有些问题要问你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This again?
ESP.TRADUIT: 又是这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions about my investigation for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于我的调查，我有些问题要问你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should be annoyed at having to be subject to some Dissolute entering my quarters without permission.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要是有个浪荡子未经允许就进了我的房间，我会很生气的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That said, it looks like an ordinary screwdriver to me. What of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，在我看来，它就是一把普通的螺丝刀。那又如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I found this screwdriver in your house.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在你家里找到了这把螺丝刀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The report I got from Red Rivers today indicates that the gun damage is more like damaged screws and springs that have lost their compression factor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我今天从红河得到的报告显示，枪的损坏更像是损坏的螺丝和弹簧，已经失去了压缩系数。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When we initially looked at the weapons, the damage was subtle. A screwdriver could have been used.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当我们一开始研究这些武器的时候，伤害很小。可能是用了螺丝刀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course I do. I have no reason to hide anything. That is not even my screwdriver.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我当然承认，我没有理由隐瞒任何事。那甚至都不是我的螺丝刀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you admit that someone could have used this screwdriver to damage those guns?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你承认有人可能用这把螺丝刀损坏了那些枪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: This conversation is over. I will not have my loyalty to the Legion questioned.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谈话到此为止。我不会让任何人质疑我对军团的忠诚。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if I told you that I believe that you damaged the weapons?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果我告诉你我相信是你损坏了武器呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They are not mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们不是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fought these gun components in your desk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在你的桌子里发现了这些枪支部件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Everyone in the Frumentarii lies at least twice a day, but in this instance, those are not mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 每个军团特务每天至少要撒两次谎，但这次不是我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were in your desk. Are you lying to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 它们在你的桌子里。你在骗我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not-!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有...！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am not lying when I say that I do not know where those parts could have come from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我说我不知道这些零件可能是从哪里来的，我没有撒谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you lying to me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要骗我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? Now, that is a scandal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？现在，这是一个丑闻。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Frumentarii logbooks are the only tool we have to making sure that Legion operations do not interfere with each other.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团特务日志是唯一的工具，我们必须确保军团的行动不会相互干扰。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You will show me the relevant pages to me at once.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你要马上把相关的页面给我看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Frumentarii logbook at this office has some pages ripped out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这间办公室的军团特务工作日志有几页被撕掉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 做什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that why you did it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你才这么做吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Listen here and listen good. I would sooner convert to the Profligate, money-worshipping religion of the NCR than rip up a Frumentarii logbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，听好了。我宁愿皈依堕落、拜金主义的NCR宗教，也不愿撕掉军团特务的日志。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you ever accuse me of that again, I will kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你再这样指控我，我就杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Rip out pages from the logbook.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从日志上撕下几页。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all I need to know that you are responsible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只需要知道你是负责任的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus? These days, that name is not a welcome one. But before his disappearance, yes I did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯？如今，这个名字已经不受欢迎了。但在他失踪之前，是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know a Corvus by chance?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是不是碰巧认识一个叫克渥斯的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's no secret, but Cato himself assessed me and found that I wasn't a traitor like Corvus was.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这已经不是什么秘密了，但加图亲自对我进行了评估，发现我不像克渥斯那样是叛徒。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We did a lot of operations together, and his investigative ability has been sorely missed now that we have the Solitare Insurrection on our hands.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一起执行过很多行动，特别是现在我们手头上正有索利泰尔叛乱要处理，我们都非常怀念他的调查能力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you do know him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这么说，你认识他？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's something you should know about Ahiga.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有些关于阿希加的事你应该知道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Terrifying information, indeed, if it is true. Do you have any way to substantiate this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果这是真的，确实是可怕的消息。你有什么办法证实这一点吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahiga states that he is working for Legate Lanius to undermine the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加说他在为拉尼厄斯特使工作，以削弱军团特务。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Dominicus Rex about this. It's a serious enough allegation that we cannot ignore it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟多米尼库斯·勒克斯谈谈。这是一个非常严重的指控，我们不能忽视它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrest him now and find the evidence later, if, of course, there is evidence, and you are not lying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在逮捕他，以后再找证据，当然，如果有证据，而且你没有撒谎的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will see if I can't keep Ahiga in one place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看能不能把阿希加关在一个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He told you that August was an NCR agent?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他告诉你奥古斯特是NCR特工吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahiga told me that August was an NCR agent and that you murdered him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加告诉我奥古斯特是NCR特工，是你杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did not murder him, and I am more interested in answering the questions I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有杀他，我更感兴趣的是回答那些我不知道的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was not an NCR agent. The NCR Rangers haven't operated in this part of Arizona for the past three years.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特不是NCR特工。NCR游骑兵已经三年没有在亚利桑那州的这个地区活动了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: August was connected with Support Unit Hoover, but they are not integrated with the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奥古斯特与胡佛支援小队有联系，但他们没有与NCR合并。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's accusing you of murder, and that's your hangup?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他都在指控你谋杀了，而你就在意这个？

ESP.ORIGINAL: If Ahiga is lying to you about August's status, then is it not possible that he is lying to you about me having murdered him?
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果阿希加在奥古斯特的身份上对你撒谎，那么他有没有可能在我谋杀他的事上对你撒谎？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In fact, this whole situation smells of a cover up, possibly by him. Here's what I want you to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，这整件事都有掩盖的嫌疑，可能是他干的。这是我想让你做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Talk to Dominicus Rex about this. It's a serious enough allegation that we cannot ignore it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟多米尼库斯·勒克斯谈谈。这是一个非常严重的指控，我们不能忽视它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Arrest him now and find the evidence later, if, of course, there is evidence, and you are not lying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在逮捕他，以后再找证据，当然，如果有证据，而且你没有撒谎的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will see if I can't keep Ahiga in one place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看看能不能把阿希加关在一个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, go get it!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，去拿吧！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tired Man [06008A7E] (mod) Quest : ([06008A16]AZBigStopAhigaQuest01) Is You Is or Is You Ain't? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, my name is &PCName;.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，我叫&PCName;。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahote. Leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿霍特。走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I'll go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我走了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're here to kill me, aren't you? I should have been this coming.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是来杀我的，对吧？我早该料到的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Code Talkers want to get rid of a loose end. Typical Navajo bullshit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 密码员想要除掉一个后患。典型的纳瓦霍胡扯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're Bodaway, aren't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是博德维，对吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, do you have nothing better to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，没别的事可做吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk about the people who are after you again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想再谈谈那些追杀你的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions before I decide what to do with you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在我决定怎么处置你之前，我有些问题要问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hell if I know. It's a Navajo word, not mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怎么知道。那是纳瓦霍语，不是我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only recognized the language because it isn't a word my nation would use.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只知道这门语言，因为我们国家不会用这个词。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does Bodaway mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 博德维是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You did, or no, you're obviously not Navajo. The people who sign your paycheck did.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你干的，哦不，你显然不是纳瓦霍人。那些给你发工资的人干的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I discovered their activities and made contact with them. First meeting threw up all of the red flags.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现了他们的活动，并与他们取得了联系。第一次会面就暴露了所有的危险信号。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Overheard some of the leaders talking about their plans to take control of the government by any means necessary. I bolted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 无意中听到一些领导人谈论他们计划采取任何必要的手段来控制政府。我逃走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What brought you to this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么风把你吹到这里来了？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agent provocateur for the Confederate government. They paid me to blow up some of our own facilities, a couple Legion ones too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邦联政府的特工。他们付钱让我炸掉一些我们自己的设施，还有一些军团的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What did you do before you came here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你来这里之前做过什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fucking treaty capped our army and put Legion soldiers in some of our cities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个该死的条约限制了我们的军队，把军团的士兵派到了我们的一些城市。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If the Legion and the government can't handle a couple terrorists, then they'd need to uncap the army. Let us start operating militias in the open.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果军团和政府对付不了几个恐怖分子，那他们就需要解除军队的限制。让我们开始在公开场合组织民兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or the Legion could send more resources to the garrison, but they're not going to do that with all the frontier wars the Legion's dealing with.
ESP.TRADUIT: 或者军团可以向守军提供更多的资源，但他们不会这么做，因为军团正在处理所有的边境战争。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they're especially not going to pull them off the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，他们尤其不会把他们从NCR那里撤走。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would your government do that?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你们的政府为什么要这么做？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Navajo secret society. Supposedly, they were founded just before the Great War.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳瓦霍秘密组织。据说，他们是在大战之前建立的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are the Code Talkers?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是密码员？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They believe that the only way for the confederacy to stay viable as a great power is by forcing the other great powers into continuous conflict.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们认为，邦联作为一个大国保持生存的唯一途径是迫使其他大国持续冲突。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That I agree with. It's their belief that the smaller nations need to be kept in line by Navajo leadership that I do not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我同意这一点。他们认为较小的国家需要纳瓦霍人的领导来保持一致，而我不这样认为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do the Code Talkers want?
ESP.TRADUIT: 密码员想要什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I wanted to get the government involved. I mean, we have two rebel movements against the Legion. It just made sense to make them one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我想让政府介入。我是说，我们有两个反抗军团的运动，把它们合二为一是有意义的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But no. It has to be their way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是不行，这必须是他们的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do they want to kill you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们为什么要杀你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a scrap of paper that everybody wants to break and no one wanted to sign, but one everyone must obey for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是一张每个人都想撕毁，没有人想签字的纸片，但现在每个人都必须遵守。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion never wanted us to remain independent, and we never wanted to agree to be subjugated. It's only a matter of time before it breaks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团从来不想让我们保持独立，我们也从来不想屈服。破裂只是时间问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is the Treaty of Window Rock?
ESP.TRADUIT: 温多罗克条约是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of reasons, really. Where to begin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有很多原因，真的。从哪里开始呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The big one is that the Navajo are the biggest nation in the confederacy, so sometimes their crowds drowned our voices. A lot of times, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最重要的一点是，纳瓦霍人是邦联中最大的民族，所以有时他们的人群淹没了我们的声音。事实上，有很多次。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, the smaller nations fought back every way we could. After both sides were bloodied, the Navajo relented, and we got a new constitution.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因此，较小的国家采取了一切可能的方式进行反击。双方都流血之后，纳瓦霍人妥协了，我们有了新宪法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then the Legion came while the wounds were still healing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，在伤口还在愈合的时候，军团来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, why did the Confederacy sign it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，邦联为什么要签署呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Conquest? How insulting. The Legion could never conquer us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 征服？太侮辱人了。军团永远无法征服我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But avoid casualties? Yes. The smaller nations would have been badly mauled and weakened right after we gained full representation in our own government.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是要避免伤亡？是的。那些较小的国家会在我们刚于自己的政府中获得完全代表权之后，就立刻遭到重创和削弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was not a risk we were going to take, especially given the fact that Legion is on borrowed time anyways.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是一个我们打算冒的风险，尤其是考虑到反正军团也是苟延残喘了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And with the NCR right there in California? No way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有加州的NCR呢？不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you surrendered to avoid conquest?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你投降是为了避免被征服？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did we get anything good from the treaty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们从条约中得到什么好处了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the terms crashed our economy and there's Legion thugs in Gallup, but, hey, we can go through Ongtupqa as long as we have an ID.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那些条款搞垮了我们的经济，而且盖洛普还有军团的暴徒，但是嘛，只要我们有身份证件，我们就能通过Ongtupqa。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Utterly foolish statement. Please do not ask something like that again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 完全愚蠢的说法。请不要再问这种问题了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you get anything good from the treaty?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从条约中得到什么好处了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any chance you've come to a decision yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有可能做出决定了吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No more questions about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有问题了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? Well, what are you going to do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？那你打算怎么办？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会杀你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You mean leave Haven, risk being killed or worse, and somehow manage to make it all the way back to Window Rock.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是说离开港湾，冒着被杀甚至更惨的危险，设法回到温多罗克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why would anyone take that risk?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么会有人冒这个险？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should tell the government about the Code Talkers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该把密码员的事告诉政府。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, you have some new argument for this?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么，你有什么新的理由吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You should tell the government about the Code Talkers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该把密码员的事告诉政府。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In what way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 用什么方式？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I'm taking some major risks right now, and I want to hit the Legion from everywhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我现在正冒着很大的风险，我想从各个方面打击军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Fort, like Fortification Hill? Are you serious? Right under Caesar's nose? I... You're telling the truth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒，比如要塞山？你说真的吗？就在凯撒的眼皮底下？我...你说的是实话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With firepower like that, aimed right at the head....
ESP.TRADUIT: 用那样的火力，直接对准头部...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, I'll do it. Don't worry about me. I can make it back. I have some things to take off, but by the time you get back, I'll be gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧，我来吧。别担心我，我能赶回来。我有些东西要处理，但等你回来的时候，我已经走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, this is the turning point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，这就是转折点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is a giant army of robots underneath the Fort, and I'm going to use them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 堡垒下面有一支庞大的机器人军队，我要利用它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] That's a compelling argument. Our way.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]这是一个令人信服的论点。我们的方式。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, I'll do it. Don't worry about me. I can make it back. I have some things to take off, but by the time you get back, I'll be gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧，我来吧。别担心我，我能赶回来。我有些东西要处理，但等你回来的时候，我已经走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, this is the turning point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，这就是转折点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you tell the government about the Code Talkers, it gives them a stronger hand. Rebellion their way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你告诉政府关于密码员的事，会让他们更有优势。以他们的方式反抗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I did step up. I blew up car bombs at the age of 14 and assassinated a Legion Centurion at the age of 25.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]我确实挺身而出了。我14岁时引爆汽车炸弹，25岁时刺杀军团百夫长。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you shut your damn mouth?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能不能闭上你的臭嘴？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There is no chance of success unless you step up first.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你不挺身而出，就没有成功的机会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speaking before you think leads to nothing but koyaanisqatsi. You don't want that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 先说再想，只会让人觉得很不自在。你不会想要那样的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let me think of a good reason.
ESP.TRADUIT: 让我想个好理由。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, okay, whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，好的，随便。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You do that, and this place will hunt you down. So, kill me or don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你这么做，这个地方就会追杀你。所以，要么杀我，要么不杀我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't care anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经不在乎了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am here to kill you, yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是来杀你的，没错。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's comforting that my executioner is so indecisive. Let me know when you've made up your mind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我的刽子手这么优柔寡断，真是令人欣慰。你决定了就告诉我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not sure what I'm going to do with you yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还不知道该拿你怎么办。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you asking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要问这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you know what the Diné are?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道迪内人是什么吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, whatever, it's not like it's hidden knowledge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，管它呢，又不是什么隐秘的知识。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're one of the core nations of the Great Southwest Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是大西南邦联的核心国家之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm following a lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在追查一条线索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, the Navajo. They're the same people. It's just the Navajo that don't call themselves the Navajo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对，纳瓦霍人。他们是同一批人，只是纳瓦霍人不称自己为纳瓦霍人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have no idea where you heard that, but there's no way that's correct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你从哪里听到的，但这肯定是不对的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No way in hell the Navajo would ally with the NCR. Legion? Maybe. NCR? No way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 纳瓦霍人绝对不会和NCR结盟。军团？也许。NCR？不可能。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're allied with the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是NCR的盟友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Navajo are Diné. It means 'our people' in their language.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪内人就是纳瓦霍人，在他们的语言中是“我们的人民”的意思。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was asking about the Diné.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我问的是迪内人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not my people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不是我的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why don't you call them the Diné?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么不叫他们迪内人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not interested in answering.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没兴趣回答。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are your people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hopi, but I'm not particularly peaceable, so maybe I'm a hypocrite.
ESP.TRADUIT: 霍皮人，但我不是特别爱和平，所以也许我是个伪君子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are your people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是什么人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use this for I Have Sinned
ESP.TRADUIT: 使用这个因为我犯了罪。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Use this for I Have Sinned
ESP.TRADUIT: 使用这个因为我犯了罪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You ask a lot of questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你问了很多问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How did you come to be here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是怎么来到这里的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was being hunted, the same as everyone else here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我和这里的其他人一样，都在被追捕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [She rolls her eyes and doesn't even bother answering.]
ESP.TRADUIT: [她翻了个白眼，甚至懒得回答]
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You were being hunted by the Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你被军团追杀了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: East.
ESP.TRADUIT: 东部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I grew up in Munqapi, but I've spent most of my life in Gallup.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在蒙卡皮长大，但我一生中大部分时间都在盖洛普度过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Which ones?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哪一个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are your opinions on the people here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这里的人有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is perhaps too optimistic for the present situation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他对目前的形势也许过于乐观了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Benjamin.
ESP.TRADUIT: 本杰明。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He has one of those faces.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他长着一张“那种”脸。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like I have seen him before, but I can't place him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就像我以前见过他一样，但我不知道他是谁。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He seems sad all the time, life he's live a great life no one remembers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他看起来总是很悲伤，他过着很棒的生活，没人记得。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's that mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I hope his slave collar malfunctions, and his head is removed from his body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我希望他的奴隶项圈出故障，把他的头从身体上取下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have not needed his services yet, so I haven't spoken with him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还不需要他的服务，所以我还没和他谈过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doc.
ESP.TRADUIT: 道格。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mutant. I have no real opinions on him. He keeps to himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变种人。我对他没有什么真正的看法，他独来独往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mutant. I have no real opinions on him. He kept to himself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 变种人。我对他没有什么真正的看法，他独来独往。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 约伯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a lech when he is under the influence of the mushrooms.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他受到蘑菇的影响时，他是一个色狼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: When he is off them, he merely acts foolish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当他不受影响的时候，他只是在做蠢事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Murray.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穆雷。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is a ghoul. I have never much cared for ghouls.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是个尸鬼，我从来就不怎么喜欢尸鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ripley.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雷普利。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any one of them could be a Reservation spy. Or he could go feral and kill us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们中的任何一个都可能是保留地的间谍。或者他会狂化，把我们都杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He acts friendly enough, I suppose. I don't know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想他表现得很友好。我不知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He does not speak much. That is fine by me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他话不多。我没有意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ruce.
ESP.TRADUIT: 鲁思。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The girl reminds me of myself before the fire scared everyone away from me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个女孩让我想起了那场大火把所有人都从我身边吓跑之前的我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She needs to see the surface.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她需要看到地表。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serwa.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瑟尔瓦。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The coma patient? Hmm, I never liked talking to her, but it's sad that she can't talk back anymore.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那个昏迷的病人？嗯，我从来都不喜欢和她说话，但很遗憾她再也不能顶嘴了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What she did to Job is inexcusable. I might hate her worse than Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她对约伯的所作所为是不可原谅的，我可能比维尔茨波夫斯基更恨她。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sharky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 沙尔基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He is surprisingly nice given what he's done. I thought, given what he did in the old days, he would have been some sort of monster.
ESP.TRADUIT: 考虑到他所做的一切，他的人出奇的好。我想，考虑到他以前的所作所为，他一定是个怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, no, just a man. I don't know if I can trust him, but I do feel at ease around him when I probably shouldn't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，不，只是一个人。我不知道我是否可以信任他，但我在他身边确实感觉很自在，虽然我可能不应该这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wierzbowski.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维尔茨波夫斯基。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: My name is Buck, and I programmed to assist customers with car repair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的名字是巴克，我编写的程序是帮助客户进行汽车维修。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you and what is this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁，这是什么地方？

ESP.ORIGINAL: A pleasure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 荣幸之至。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, it's nice to meet you, Buck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，很高兴见到你，巴克。

ESP.ORIGINAL: August 4th, 2256. A visitor from Las Vegas passed over Hoover Dam with a shipment of food for trade in Flagstaff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 2256年8月4日。一名来自拉斯维加斯的游客带着一船食品经过胡佛水坝，准备在旗杆市进行贸易。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know the apocalypse happened, right? When's the last time you even fixed a car?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道世界末日发生了，对吧？你上次修车是什么时候？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dates are never wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的日期永远不会错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You sure you have your dates right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你确定你没记错日期吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My dates are never wrong.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的日期永远不会错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我相信你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I will have you know that I am a top-of-the-line model as good and functional as the day I was unboxed 232 years, six months and five days ago.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要让你知道，我是一款顶级的机型，就像232年6个月零5天前我刚开箱的时候一样优秀，一样实用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you sell anything useful or are you just like every other crap Pre-War robot?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是卖有用的东西还是像其他战前的垃圾机器人一样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I fix cars. I am not a merchant.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我修车。我不是商人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, but do you sell anything?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，但你有卖东西吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Buck's was founded in 2056 by Alexander "Buck" Rodriguez for the express use of helping fix up vehicles passing through the town of Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巴克汽修于2056年由亚历山大·“巴克”·罗德里格斯创立，专门用于帮助修理途经索利泰尔镇的车辆。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was adopted as a son by Mr. Rodriguez in 2076 and renamed "Buck Jr.". However, I simply go by Buck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我于2076年被罗德里格斯先生收养为儿子，并更名为“小巴克”。不过，我只是叫巴克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Out of curiosity, do you know anything about the history of this place?
ESP.TRADUIT: 出于好奇，你知道这个地方的历史吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you have more questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有什么问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some questions about the history of this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对这个小镇的历史有一些疑问。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I was speaking in terms of its relative name in the Pre-War. It was originally known as Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我说的是它在战前的相关名称。它最初被称为索利泰尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's not Solitare, it's Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里不是索利泰尔，这是大站。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh. My apologies. What did you want to know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，我很抱歉。你想知道什么？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was thinking more about the history of the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想的更多的是这个小镇的历史。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why of course!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然啦！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, can you tell me about the post-atomic history of the town at all?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，你能给我讲讲这个小镇后原子时代的历史吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why not guess them? Pick a year, any year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么不猜猜看呢？选一年，随便哪一年。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any particularly interesting years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有特别有趣的年份？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, pick a year, any year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，选一年，任何一年都行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Any particularly interesting years?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有没有特别有趣的年份？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not that old, and I thought you wanted the post-atomic history of Solitare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我还没那么老，我还以为你想知道索利泰尔后原子时代的历史。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not even sure if there was a native settlement here at that time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我甚至不确定当时这里是否有原住民定居。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, um, that would be the year that, um....
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，呃，那一年，呃...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Jesus turned 7!
ESP.TRADUIT: 耶稣7岁了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Look at him expectedly.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <期待地看着他>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, yes, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，是的，当然了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just a joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 开个玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Did you mean 2069, 2169 or 2269?
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No no, just a joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，只是个玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: 2,187 customers were serviced this year, primarily modifications to convert vehicles from inefficient gasoline engines to nuclear fusion engines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年为2187名客户提供了服务，主要是将低效的汽油发动机改装成核聚变发动机。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only three customers and two employees were killed in this process, a record low for Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这一过程中，只有三名客户和两名员工被杀，创下了亚利桑那州的历史新低。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only three customers were recorded this year, although all of them reported 100% satisfaction with their vehicle repair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年只有三名客户被记录在案，尽管他们都表示对他们的汽车维修100%满意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We also logged 1,300 visitors, mostly to commemorate the signing of a treaty to annex the town to Tall Pines rule.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们还接待了1300名访客，主要是为了纪念签署一项条约，将该镇并入高松的统治之下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was in this year that a celebratory gunshot punctured by optical sensors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就在这一年，一声庆祝的枪响被光学传感器击穿了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No customers were recorded this year, although one individual attempted to service a machine gun in this shop, which we sadly could not oblige.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年没有顾客记录，尽管有个人试图在这家商店维修机关枪，但我们很遗憾不能这样做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We recorded 1,021 visitors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们记录了1021名访客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This shop logged the repairs of 835 vehicles from 456 customers between the months of January and October, after which the Great War led to a substantial loss in customers and profits.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从一月到十月，这家商店记录了456位顾客的835辆汽车的维修情况，在此之后，大战导致了顾客和利润的巨大损失。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: However, this building was used as a hideout for town workers when they rose up against the company leadership.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然而，当镇上的工人反抗公司领导时，这座建筑被用作他们的藏身之处。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unfortunately, the remaining bullet holes from that day has since been covered up in the recent Solitare Insurrection.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不幸的是，那天留下的弹孔在最近的索利泰尔暴动中被掩盖了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two customers were recorded this year for assistance with wheel replacement for cattle wagons. 61 visitors were recorded.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年有两名客户要求协助更换牛车的车轮。61名访客被记录在案。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was this year that the community came to be known as 'Last Stop,' in reference to this being the last stop for travelers heading West towards the city of Las Vegas, due to the U.S. Army's continued occupation of Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 正是在这一年，这个社区被称为“最后一站”，因为这是向西前往拉斯维加斯的游客的最后一站，因为美国军队继续占领胡佛水坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One customer was recorded this year. Five visitors, all fleeing Hoover Company's sacking of the town after a tribute payment went poorly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年记录了一名客户。五名访客，都是为了逃离胡佛公司在一笔贡金支付不周后对小镇的洗劫。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The company leader provided some compensation in form of scrap metal and electronics after his soldiers knocked over my shelf.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在他的士兵打翻我的架子后，公司领导提供了一些废金属和电子器件作为补偿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This was also the year when Alexander Rodriguez died.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚历山大·罗德里格斯也是在这一年去世的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The town of Last Stop saw the end of Hoover Company's control of Hoover Dam. Traffic began to increase across the Colorado River, and the Ranger was commemorated with a special medal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最后一站镇见证了胡佛公司对胡佛水坝控制的终结。科罗拉多河上的交通开始增加，游骑兵被授予了一枚特殊的奖章。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The town thereafter came to be known as 'Big Stop'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此后，这个小镇被称为“大站”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The number of visitors increased from the previous year's five to 11, the highest since the Great War. This can largely be attributed to the Tall Pines improving the safety of crossing Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 访客数量从前一年的5人增加到11人，是大战以来的最高水平。这在很大程度上要归功于高松提高了穿越胡佛水坝的安全性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 873 visitors, including four customers, visited Big Stop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 包括4名顾客在内的873名访客参观了大站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Amongst them included a representative of Crimson Caravan, marking Big Stop's first major trading agreement with the Californian government.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中包括深红商队的一名代表，这标志着大站与加州政府签订的第一个重要贸易协议。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Two customers were recorded this year. Repair consisted of one routine checkup and one oil change.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年记录了两名顾客。维修包括一次例行检查和一次换油。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Tall Pines announced that they would no longer be able to protect Big Stop from outside influences and subsequently withdrew from both Big Stop and Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 高松宣布他们将不再能够保护大站不受外部影响，随后撤出了大站和胡佛大坝。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The number of visitors was logged at 560, a major drop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 参观人数为560人，大幅下降。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The town of Big Stop suffered from the NCR's occupation of Hoover Dam and subsequent loss in profits. This was the first year on record in which no customers were recorded in this shop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大站镇遭受了NCR对胡佛大坝的占领和随后的利润损失。这是有记录以来这家店第一次没有顾客。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only 24 visitors passed through, although most said nothing and the others insulted my 'affront to Mars'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只有24名访客经过，尽管大多数人什么也没说，其他人则侮辱我“对玛尔斯的侮辱”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One customer was recorded this year and requested repair for an artillery piece.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年有一位客户被记录，要求修理一门火炮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Earthquakes and tremors rocked the town this year, aftershocks caused by some explosion in Boulder City and artillery fire over Hoover Dam.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年，地震和震颤撼动了这个小镇，巨石城的一些爆炸和胡佛大坝的炮火引发了余震。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pointed them to the Light Aircraft Station to the south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我指给他们看南边的轻型飞机站。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The previous owners of the town asked where a stockpile of mines could be found before the NCR passed through.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在NCR通过之前，小镇的前任主人询问在哪里可以找到地雷的储备。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shortly afterwards, soldiers from an unrecognized state known as "NCR" passed through the town before withdrawing the next year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此后不久，来自一个名为“NCR”的未获承认的政权的士兵们途经了该镇，并在第二年撤离。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 13 visitor and no customers were recorded this year, six of which demanded that I submit to Mars. I agreed, given that I had already done so six years prior.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年有13名访客，没有客户记录，其中6人要求我臣服于玛尔斯。我同意了，因为我六年前就已经这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eight visitors were logged this year, two of them being repeat visits over a three-day period. Neither were interested in car repair.
ESP.TRADUIT: 今年有8名访客被记录在案，其中两人是三天内的重复访问。两人都对汽车修理不感兴趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is possible, yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，这是有可能的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Real quick question. Do you do individual dates?
ESP.TRADUIT: 问个小问题，你们有单独日期吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to talk about visitors on the 16th again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想再谈谈16号的访客。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of this month? Running checks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这个月的？正在进行检查。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral
NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only two visitors were recorded that day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当天只有两名访客被记录下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can you tell me if you saw anything suspicious on the 16th?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你能告诉我你在16号那天看到什么可疑的事吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize, but due to a malfunction in my optical sensor, I am unable to positively ID customers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，由于我的光学传感器故障，我无法确定客户的身份。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was one of them August? Named August, I mean, not the month.
ESP.TRADUIT: 其中有奥古斯特吗？我的意思是名字叫奥古斯特，不是那个八月。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] There are. In fact, if you are able to, I would appreciate you fixing the circuit. Presently, the audio storage is taking up an enormous amount of space, effectively making it junk data.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]有。事实上，如果你能修好电路，我会很感激的。目前，音频存储占用了大量的空间，有效地使其成为垃圾数据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Extracting it would significantly optimize my system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提取它会显著优化我的系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your unit is equipped with audio logs, though, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的单位配备了音频日志，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] I'm afraid not. I really do apologize for the inconvenience.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]恐怕不行。给你带来的不便，我深表歉意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about voice recognition?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么语音识别呢？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, no problem. Let me take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，没问题。让我看看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, that would be why the system has been compiling large amounts of inaccessible data.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]哦，这就是为什么系统一直在编译大量无法访问的数据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Presently, the audio storage is taking up an enormous amount of space, effectively making it junk data.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前，音频存储占用了大量的空间，有效地使其成为垃圾数据。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Extracting it would significantly optimize my system.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提取它会显著优化我的系统。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your audio logger system is mostly intact. I would only need to fix a single short circuit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的音频记录系统基本完好无损，我只需要修理一个短路。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] It would not work retroactively. I really do apologize for the inconvenience.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]它没有追溯效力。给你带来的不便，我深表歉意。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could repair your optical sensor, maybe?
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许我可以修理你的光学传感器？

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, let me fix it for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我来帮你修好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: *clicking sounds*
ESP.TRADUIT: *咔哒声*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Audio Logger Access Command 12/5/6001, run logs for data on the 19th on this month.
ESP.TRADUIT: 音频记录器访问命令12/5/6001，运行本月19日的数据日志。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Reroute data from Node B to Node D. Output log through AV sensor.
ESP.TRADUIT: 将数据从节点B重路由到节点D。通过AV传感器输出日志。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A murder? In my shop? Goodness gracious, you need to take this evidence to the police.
ESP.TRADUIT: 谋杀？在我的店里？天哪，你得把这些证据交给警方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That audio log I pulled out looks like it was the sound of a murder.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我调出的音频日志看起来像是谋杀的声音。

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you wish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你愿意的话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck it. Let's talk politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 去他妈的。我们来谈谈政治吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you think of Caesar's Legion?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你觉得凯撒军团怎么样？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们怎么样？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The... people outside.
ESP.TRADUIT: ...外面的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They have not requested repairs at this shop.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们没有要求到这家店修理。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They currently run this town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们现在管理着这个小镇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you never left the shop?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从来没有离开过这家店吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Romans, in Arizona, in the 23rd century? Is this some kind of joke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗马人，在23世纪的亚利桑那州？开什么玩笑？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If there are people dressing up as Romans outside, though, I will apologize.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，如果外面有人打扮成罗马人，我会道歉的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My optical sensors have been severely damaged since an incident on June 19th, 2169.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的光学传感器在2169年6月19日的一次事故中严重损坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Romans?
ESP.TRADUIT: 罗马人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize, but my optical sensors have been severely damaged since an incident on June 19th, 2169.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很抱歉，我的光学传感器在2169年6月19日的一次事故中严重损坏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The guys in skirts. Haven't you seen them?
ESP.TRADUIT: 穿裙子的人。你没看见他们吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can debate the merits of Pre-War political platforms. For instance, the Rep-.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以讨论战前政治纲领的优点。例如，共和...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, what politics do you know about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你了解什么政治？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough. I respect your opinion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有道理，我尊重你的意见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I don't care about that. They blew up the world.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我不关心这个。他们摧毁了世界。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fair enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说得对。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh, not interested.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，不感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything else?
ESP.TRADUIT: 还有别的事吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Enough about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别说这些了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Diné? Yes, of course. Plenty of the old Reservationites are ex-Diné.
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪内人？是的，当然。以前很多住在保留地的人都是前迪内人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have you ever heard of the Diné?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你听说过迪内人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, some of them are. Truth be told, The Reservation has terrible relations with the Great Southwest Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，有些是。说实话，保留地与大西南邦联的关系很糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Diné are ghouls?
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪内人是尸鬼？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're the largest member nation of the Confederacy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们是邦联最大的成员国。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officially, they are referred to as 'Navajo' by the ex-Diné members of The Reservation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 官方称他们为“纳瓦霍人”，由保留地的前部落成员组成。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Marty [0601DF4D] (mod) Quest : ([060208A2]AZFreeformTiptonCave) 060208A2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do the Diné have to do with the Confederacy?
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪内人和邦联有什么关系？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here you go. One holotape for the 16th for now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你。目前只有16号的全息磁带。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Buck [0600EB1A] (mod) Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey there, Buck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，你好啊，巴克。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, sir, are you here for vehicular repair?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，先生，你是来修车的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, sorry, just meeting someone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，抱歉，只是来见个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, of course, don't let me keep you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，当然，别让我耽搁你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, hey, didn't hear you come in- *sounds of someone being knocked out with a baseball bat*
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，嘿，没听见你进来...*有人被棒球棍打晕的声音*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hello, sir, are you here for vehicular repair?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你好，先生，你是来修车的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: *sounds of a body sliding and grunting, followed by the door opening and closing*
ESP.TRADUIT: *身体滑动和咕噜的声音，随后是门的打开和关闭*
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Have a nice day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 祝你度过愉快的一天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([06024CE4]AZBigStopBuckDialogueQuest) 06024CE4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Diné? You a Legion trader or NCR agent or something?
ESP.TRADUIT: 迪内人？你是军团商人还是NCR特工什么的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because I don't talk to either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我都不跟他们说话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm trying to find information on the Diné.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找有关迪内人的信息。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, whatever. The Diné is what the Navajo call themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随便了。迪内人是纳瓦霍人对自己的称呼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the founding nations of the Great Southwest Confederacy. Quite probably one of the only civilized parts of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大西南邦联的创始国之一，很可能是亚利桑那州仅有的文明地区之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officially, they're an ally of the Legion, but given what the Legion's doing to them, I would not be surprised if they're opening a line to the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 官方上，他们是军团的盟友，但考虑到军团对他们的所作所为，如果他们与NCR建立联系我也不会感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I wouldn't trust the NCR, so they probably don't either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我不会相信NCR，所以他们可能也不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, not either. Following a lead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，也不是。追踪线索。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, whatever. The Diné is what the Navajo call themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，随便了。迪内人是纳瓦霍人对自己的称呼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: One of the founding nations of the Great Southwest Confederacy. Quite probably one of the only civilized parts of Arizona.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大西南邦联的创始国之一，很可能是亚利桑那州仅有的文明地区之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Officially, they're an ally of the Legion, but given what the Legion's doing to them, I would not be surprised if they're opening a line to the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 官方上，他们是军团的盟友，但考虑到军团对他们的所作所为，如果他们与NCR建立联系我也不会感到惊讶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course, I wouldn't trust the NCR, so they probably don't either.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，我不会相信NCR，所以他们可能也不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Barker [060047C4] (mod) Quest : ([060047C2]AZBarkerDialogue) 060047C2 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I heard the name somewhere, and I figure you've heard of them, given your experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在哪儿听说过这个名字，鉴于你的经历，我想你也听说过。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have. Is there some reason you're asking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我听过。你这么问有什么原因吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, you're knowledgeable about the Confederacy. Have you heard of the Diné?
ESP.TRADUIT: 喂，你对邦联很了解啊。你听说过迪内人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. No, it isn't. Very well, they're one of the political factions in the Confederacy, nothing more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，不是。好吧，他们是邦联的政治派系之一，仅此而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever you've heard from the contact is not necessarily reality. We told them a lot of lies to infiltrate their network.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你从联系人那里听到的不一定是事实。为了潜入他们的网络，我们撒了很多谎。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why? Is it important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么？重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What? How did-?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么？你怎么...？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay, I know that you gave bad weapons to the Legion and fake plans to the NCR.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我知道你把劣质武器给了军团，把假计划给了NCR。

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you're playing your own game, and I want to know what it is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你在玩自己的游戏，我想知道是什么。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: After you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你先请。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fascinating. That's what I think of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真有意思。这就是我对你的看法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brothers, the one with the Mark has turned to the other side!
ESP.TRADUIT: 兄弟们，有徽记的人已经投靠了另一边！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Attack.> I think you're a traitor to the Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: <攻击>我认为你是军团的叛徒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The leader of Vegas? There is no way he could have known about this scheme. It's too far from his tower.
ESP.TRADUIT: 维加斯的领袖？他不可能知道这个计划。离他的塔太远了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I'm assuming that you're simply an employee, what's the word, freelancing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我假设你只是一个雇员，那个词叫什么来着，自由职业者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mr. House.
ESP.TRADUIT: 豪斯先生。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, you're a prospective warlord or statesman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，你是未来的军阀还是政治家？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that sense, we have something in common: we're both fighting for independence.
ESP.TRADUIT: 从这个意义上说，我们有一些共同点：我们都在为独立而战。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm aiming to become the leader of Vegas. No NCR or Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的目标是成为维加斯的领袖，没有NCR或军团。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's the height of arrogance to do that with the Frumentarii. Layers upon layers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对军团特务这么做太傲慢了。一层又一层。
