ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Still, you're here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过，你还是来了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one in particular. I just saw a thread and started pulling.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有什么特定的人。我只是看到了一个线头，然后就开始拉了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, joy. I hope not seeing eye to eye with your government means willing to weaken them in the short-term.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，太好了。我希望与你的政府意见不一致意味着你愿意在短期内削弱他们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am with the NCR. I don't see eye to eye with my government all the time. Wanted to hear you out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是NCR的。我和我的政府并不总是意见一致。想听你说完。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, a mercenary. Wonderful. I hope that you operate with the requisite moral flexibility required.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，一个雇佣兵。太好了，我希望你能保持必要的道德灵活性。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I work for whoever you work for. As long as there's money involved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为谁工作，我就为谁工作。只要能赚钱就行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You are in Legion lands as an enemy of Caesar. Backup!
ESP.TRADUIT: 你作为凯撒的敌人来到了军团的领地。支援！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with the Frumentarii, and I found a rat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是军团特务，我发现了一只老鼠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see. Then only one of us is leaving here alive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。那我们中只有一个人能活着离开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm with the Frumentarii, and I found a rat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是军团特务，我发现了一只老鼠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A bribe? That's all? That's nothing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 贿赂？就这些？这没什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suppose that's easy enough. 200 Legion denarii, good bit of silver for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想这很简单。200军团第纳尔，给你点好银。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Our business is done, now leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的事情已经结束了，现在离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm less interested in the truth and more interested in a bribe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我对真相不太感兴趣，对贿赂更感兴趣。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I... believe you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我...相信你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell you what, I'll do it. Don't worry about me. I can make it back. I have some things to take off, but by the time you get back, I'll be gone.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这样吧，我来吧。别担心我，我能赶回来。我有些东西要处理，但等你回来的时候，我已经走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe, this is the turning point.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许，这就是转折点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahote [06024BAF] (mod) Quest : ([06024C73]AZHavenAhoteQuest) 06024C73 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have never lived my life as a slave to any superpower. I'm the only power that matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我这辈子从来没有像个奴隶一样屈服于任何超级大国，我才是唯一重要的力量。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No? Ah, our flag has not yet blessed your home. I suppose if you are an outsider to Arizona, you would not know.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有？啊，我们的旗帜还没有祝福你的家园。我想如果你是亚利桑那州的外地人，你不会知道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I haven't heard of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没听说过你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Important? You dare enter the War Room of Caesar's Legion and ask if I am important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 重要吗？你竟敢走进凯撒军团的作战室问我是否重要？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should have you crucified for such insolence. Only the Mark spares you, remember that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你如此无礼，我真该把你钉死在十字架上。只有徽记能救你，记住。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you supposed to be important?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你应该是重要人物吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thrax of Red Lake. I can see that you have not heard of me, but your servile nature pleases me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 红湖的色雷斯。我知道你没有听说过我，但你的卑躬屈膝令我高兴。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Ah, yes, Thrax of Phoenix, I've heard of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>啊，是的，凤凰城的色雷斯，我听说过你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am the senior Centurion of the Fort's Base Camp, and this is the War Room.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是堡垒大本营的资深百夫长，这里是作战室。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In this room, I plan the great battles of the Legion. Not just the upcoming battle at the Dam, but of the conquests from Freeside to Primm.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在这个房间里，我计划着军团的伟大战役。不仅是即将到来的大坝之战，还有从自由城到普瑞姆的征服。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In addition, all soldiers in the shadow of the Fort report to me. In exchange for their absolute loyalty, I provide them the bounties of Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 此外，所有在堡垒阴影下的士兵都向我报告。作为对他们绝对忠诚的交换，我给他们纽特的奖赏。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is a fishing village to the east of here, along the shores of Lake Mead. They exist to serve us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它是这里东边的一个渔村，沿着米德湖的岸边。他们的存在是为了服务我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where's Newt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 纽特在哪？

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] You think so? It is true that children can oftentimes do the impossible. Tix could probably work them better.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]你这么认为吗？的确，孩子们经常能做不可能的事。蒂克斯可能会做得更好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. Tix will work in the mess hall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。蒂克斯将在食堂工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've seen the inside of your mess hall. The capsarius is a terrible master. Tix would make a better
ESP.TRADUIT: 我去过你们食堂的内部。侍者是一个可怕的主人，蒂克斯会做得更好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] You doubt the strength of the Legion? Bah, leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]你怀疑军团的力量？呸，走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your mess hall can't keep up. Your men don't have enough fuel to fight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的食堂跟不上了。你的人没有足够的燃料去战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that so? How unfortunate for him. He will never see the glory of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是这样吗？他真是太不幸了。他将永远看不到战斗的荣耀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will have the Capsarius informed. Tix will work in the mess hall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我会通知侍者的，蒂克斯将在食堂工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Tix has a congenital defect. He cannot achieve his full potential on the battlefield.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>蒂克斯有先天缺陷，他无法在战场上发挥出他的全部潜能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You expect me to believe you? It was Caesar's will that boys be prepared as warriors in the first place.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你指望我相信你？凯撒的意志就是把男孩培养成战士。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I should kill you where you stand for impersonating his orders.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为你冒用他的命令我就该当场杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> I have orders from Caesar! The boy named Tix is to be assigned in the mess hall.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>我有凯撒的命令，那个叫蒂克斯的男孩将被分配到食堂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Annoying, but true.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]这很烦人，但却是事实。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Very well. I will have the Capsarius informed. Tix will work in the mess hall.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。我会通知侍者的，蒂克斯将在食堂工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Except I have personal access to him, and you don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只不过我可以亲自接触他，而你不行。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Honesty is a not a word associated with liars like you. If you lie to us so easily, what need does Caesar have for you? Guards!
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]诚实这个词和你这样的骗子没有关系。如果你这么轻易地对我们撒谎，凯撒还需要你做什么？卫兵！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Charisma - No, honest!
ESP.TRADUIT: 魅力...不，诚实！

ESP.ORIGINAL: If this happens again, I will rip that Mark from your neck and your arms from your body.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果再发生这种事，我就把你脖子上的徽记和手臂从你身上扯下来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, you're right. My apologies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你说得对。我很抱歉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do not need help with my plan. It is flawless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的计划不需要帮助。它完美无瑕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I wanted to help with your plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想帮你完成计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I am in charge of this camp and all coasts that approach the Fort. This includes any pissant tribal villages that happen to be on it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我负责这个营地以及靠近堡垒的所有海岸，这包括任何碰巧在上面的可怜的部落村庄。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not Vulpes, not Cato, me. I will be the one to rid of it of degeneracy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是沃尔普斯，不是加图，是我。我会是那个使它摆脱堕落的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouldn't you focused on Hoover Dam? Isn't this a Frumentarii operation, anyways?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不应该关注胡佛大坝吗？这不是军团特务的行动吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Parker? That's an entirely different front. What business of it is yours?
ESP.TRADUIT: 帕克？这是一个完全不同的战线。这关你什么事？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have questions regarding the Parker Campaign.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些关于帕克行动的问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Get those papers out of my face.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把那些文件从我面前拿开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you bothering me with this Frumentarii nonsense? The plans are located on the table if you wish to look at them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要拿军团特务这些狗屁东西来烦我？如果你想看的话，计划就在桌子上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have these plans here. I was supposed to deliver them to a Frumentarii contact. Are they right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有这个计划，我应该把它们交给军团特务的联络人。是对的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You claim moral reasons? Moral reasons such as dooming an entire country to ruin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说的是道德原因？道德上的原因，比如让整个国家走向毁灭？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't understand. The government's taking control of the plan. Too many cooks in the kitchen will kill us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白，政府正在控制这个计划。厨房里的厨子太多会害死我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not paying you for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不会付钱给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I believed that killing her was wrong, and so I refused to do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我认为杀她是不对的，所以我拒绝这么做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Money? You did this because of money?
ESP.TRADUIT: 钱？你这么做是因为钱？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't understand. The government's taking control of the plan. Too many cooks in the kitchen will kill us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白，政府正在控制这个计划。厨房里的厨子太多会害死我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the pay's going to be worse now. I'm not paying you for this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，现在的薪水会更低。我不会付钱给你的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I suspected the pay wouldn't be good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我怀疑薪水不会高。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it matter? Of course, it matters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这重要吗？当然，这很重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't understand. The government's taking control of the plan. Too many cooks in the kitchen will kill us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不明白，政府正在控制这个计划。厨房里的厨子太多会害死我们所有人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does it matter?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这重要吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have ruined everything, and you're going to make it right. If the timetable needs to be advanced, then you're going to help advance it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把一切都毁了，你要弥补。如果时间表需要提前，那么你就要帮助提前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Confederacy will need additional stockpiles of guns and explosives. Normally, we'd make them, but if we increase production too quickly, the Legion will notice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 邦联需要更多的枪支和炸药储备。正常情况下，我们会生产，但如果产量增长过快，会被军团发现的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, we need to outsource some of that procurement elsewhere. I've already spoken to other Talkers in the field.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我们需要把一些采购外包到其他地方。我已经和这个领域的其他传话人谈过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Presently, I need someone who's able to make these kinds of deals away from the prying eyes of the rest of the Frumentarii.
ESP.TRADUIT: 目前，我需要一个能够在其他军团特务的监视下进行这种交易的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, we've come this far. What's next?
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们已经走到这一步了。接下来怎么办？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have ruined everything, and you're going to make it right. If the timetable needs to be advanced, then you're going to help advance it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你把一切都毁了，你要弥补。如果时间表需要提前，那么你就要帮助提前。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My work here is done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在这里的工作结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unpleasant business, but it had to be done. Here's your reward, and the Diné thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不愉快的事，但不得不做。这是你的报酬，还有迪内人的感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so will the Legion once I boost your profile with them, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，只要我提升了你的知名度，军团也会这么做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have my own work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，恕我失陪，我还有自己的工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found Haven. It's on the edge of the radio quiet zone. It's over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到港湾了，在无线电静默区的边缘。都结束了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unpleasant business, but it had to be done. Here's your reward, and the Diné thank you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不愉快的事，但不得不做。这是你的报酬，还有迪内人的感谢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And so will the Legion once I boost your profile with them, of course.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，只要我提升了你的知名度，军团也会这么做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have my own work to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，恕我失陪，我还有自己的工作要做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've found Haven. It's on the edge of the radio quiet zone. Ahote is dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我找到港湾了，在无线电静默区的边缘。阿霍特死了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have news on that job you wanted me to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我做的那件事我有消息了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have news on that job you wanted me to do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你让我做的那件事我有消息了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Agh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Grab the Tommy Trout and break Ahiga's arm.> Take this!
ESP.TRADUIT: <抓住汤米鳟鱼打断阿希加的胳膊>尝尝这个！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, so be it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那就这样吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm going to kick the shit out of you. No one puts a knife to my throat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要把你揍得屁滚尿流，没人敢拿刀指着我的喉咙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you're not. No Legion agent, no matter how deep undercover they are, would do the things you've done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不是。军团间谍，不管他们卧底多深，都不会做你做过的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But allies? I don't think so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但盟友呢？我不这么想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I'm not Legion. You know this. So, we're allies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，我不是军团，你知道的。所以，我们是盟友。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I don't think I will. Not until I'm satisfied anyway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我想我不会。至少在我满意之前不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Please put the knife down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 请把刀放下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, no, I guess you wouldn't be a Ranger. Probably not even a Ranger asset. And you're not Frumentarii, so....
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不，我猜你不会成为游骑兵，可能连游骑兵线人都算不上。而且你也不是军团特务，所以...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, let's talk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，我们谈谈。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [06024DCC] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, if I was NCR, then I wouldn't have given those plans to them. I knew they were fake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听着，如果我是NCR，我就不会把那些计划给他们。我知道它们是假的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. The fact of the matter is we can't prove that Nox is responsible, so we'll have to fake evidence in order for him to be removed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。事实是我们无法证明诺克斯是罪魁祸首，所以我们只能伪造证据把他除掉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: An investigation would take too long, so I want you to sneak gun casings into his room instead. Make smoke, and the Legion will see fire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 调查会花很长时间，所以我想让你把弹壳偷偷带进他的房间。制造烟雾，军团就会看到火光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, inform Dominicus Rex about the evidence for Nox's crimes, and you may return to me for payment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，把诺克斯犯罪的证据告诉多米尼库斯·勒克斯，你就可以回来找我要钱了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll help you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会帮你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine, then have no part in this and leave.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，那就别掺和了，离开吧。

ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，两个死去的军团特务，上面写着阿希加发现了诺克斯的背叛。真是一团糟。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus is something of a black mark on the Frumentarii's record. Still, no, this doesn't seem right.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯是军团特务历史上的一个污点。不过，不，这似乎不太对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm taking both of them in for questioning. Come with me.

ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加告诉我诺克斯和克渥斯是一伙的，可能还参与了摧毁连环道的行动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I can't discount the possibility, I will say that much. The Legate is no friend of the Frumentarii, but to weaken us ahead of the great battle?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能否认这种可能性，我只能说这么多。特使不是军团特务的朋友，但在大战前削弱我们？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm taking both of them in for questioning. Come with me.

ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加告诉我他在和拉尼厄斯一起暗中破坏军团特务。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any proof of this?

ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加属于某个纳瓦霍秘密社团，他们试图让NCR与军团的战争永远持续下去。

ESP.ORIGINAL: They infiltrated the Frumentarii? I didn't even think that something like this could even be possible.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们混进了军团特务里？我从没想过会发生这样的事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We're going to take him in for questioning.

ESP.TRADUIT: 他让我把坏掉的武器送到大本营，还让我把假的战争计划交给NCR。然后他坦白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Circumstantial, but if the circumstances are right....
ESP.TRADUIT: 是间接的，但如果情况合适...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dominicus Rex [0600B117] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you pointing a gun at me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么拿枪指着我？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm. Y'ain't one of Julius's boys. Good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你不是尤利乌斯的手下。很好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Little jumpy, that's all. Name's Kemper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有点神经质，就这样。我叫肯珀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck off.
ESP.TRADUIT: 滚蛋。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, do you have a complaint? Because you should really be going to Aetius for that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你有什么不满吗？因为你真的应该去找埃提乌斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unless, it's something personal with the deputies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除非是代理人的私人恩怨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you the sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是治安官吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not... What do you need to talk about?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们不是...你有什么想说的？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can I talk to you about your deputies?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我能跟你谈谈你的代理人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ah, yeah, he's a little, I've had this talk with him before. Trust me, he won't do it again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，是的，他有点，我以前和他谈过这个问题。相信我，他不会再犯了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Titus Killus threatened me earlier, despite my Mark of Caesar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 提图斯·基拉勒斯之前威胁过我，无视我的凯撒徽记。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it. Look, I'm sorry that he bothered you, but I can't really afford to pull any deputies off the streets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些。听着，我很抱歉他打扰了你，但我真的负担不起从街上调遣代理人的费用。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 就这些？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Mmmm..... PLACEHOLDER
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔...占位符。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dickweed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 穷屌。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, if nothing else, you're helping me stay looking busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不出意外的话，你让我看起来很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's the owner of this here mine. Well, on paper anyways. I run everything for him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是这个矿场的老板，嗯，至少在纸面上是这样。我为他管理一切。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It might be better to say that he owns all of the workers at this time. Couple other places, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许更确切地说，他拥有此时所有的工人。还有其他几个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who's Julius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 尤利乌斯是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Old history now. We used to go way back, but he's a businessman now, and I'm doing this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 过去的事了。我们以前是老朋友，但他现在是个商人，而我在做这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Only, he's real close with White Sands these days. Word on the winds is that White Sands wants this mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 只是，他最近和白沙走得很近。有传言说白沙想要这个矿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They'll get it, too. History don't mean much when money's involved.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们也会得到的。当涉及到钱的时候，历史就没有什么意义了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have some sort of problem with Julius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和尤利乌斯之间有什么问题吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Saved his life a couple of times and vice versa. Helped him keep the peace with all the tribals and raiders we kept bringing in.
ESP.TRADUIT: 救过他几次，反之亦然。帮助他与我们不断带来的部落和掠夺者保持和平。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Even helped him get himself a bonafide Santa Cruzer princess, even if it did only last six months.
ESP.TRADUIT: 甚至还帮他追到了一个货真价实的圣克鲁斯公主，尽管那只持续了六个月。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What is your history with Julius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和尤利乌斯有什么过去？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I run this mine on behalf of the Legion, on behalf of Julius. Well, sort of.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是代表军团，代表尤利乌斯经营这个矿场的。嗯，差不多吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion boys do most of the slave guarding and the precious metal transport.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的男孩们负责看守奴隶和运送贵重金属。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I do shitty make-work. Checking the pumps, assess worker morale, sweep the dirt from time to time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我做的都是狗屁工作。检查水泵，评估员工士气，不定期清扫灰尘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What are you doing here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know those deputies out in Chloride and Dolan? They're my insurance policy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道克洛赖德和多兰的代理人吗？他们是我的保险。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I keep them in line, prevent them from just beating on the merchants, making sure they're off the chems, that kind of stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我让他们循规蹈矩，不让他们欺负商人，确保他们不吸毒，诸如此类。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion doesn't mind you just sweeping dirt?
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团不介意你只是打扫灰尘吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that would be Centurion Aetius, although he would never call himself that. You really think the Legionary would accept a non-Legion as sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，那应该是百夫长埃提乌斯，尽管他从不这么称呼自己。你真觉得军团会接受一个非军团的人当治安官吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You and me, we're not Legion, and the Legion knows we're not Legion, but we have uses. And one day, the moment they think we're no longer needed, they will kill us all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你和我，我们不是军团，军团也知道我们不是军团，但我们有用武之地。总有一天，当他们认为不再需要我们的时候，他们会把我们都杀了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've tried doing their new religion, but I'm still stuck doing it the old way in my heart of hearts, and they know that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我尝试过信仰他们的新宗教，但我的内心深处仍然坚持着旧的方式，他们知道这一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's why they're separating me from my old buddies in the deputies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是为什么他们要把我和我当代理人的老朋友分开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They, White Sands, Julius, they're waiting me out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们，白沙，朱利叶斯，他们在等我出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, you *are* the sheriff?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，你*是*治安官？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You see a guy in a redshirt, he used to be a raider for Julius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看那个穿红衬衫的人，他以前是尤利乌斯的掠夺者。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Normally, the Legion would just kill us, but Julius has a tongue so silver that I swear I've seen it glint on the horizon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一般来说，军团会直接杀了我们，但尤利乌斯太能说了，我发誓我看到过它的舌头在地平线上闪闪发光。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legionaries don't really like dealing with merchants or being away from the frontlines in general, so they use us to maintain order. You know, to help the merchants feel safe.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团士兵一般不喜欢和商人打交道，也不喜欢远离前线，所以他们利用我们来维持秩序。你知道的，让商人们有安全感。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the deputies.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说那些代理人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: On the Legion paperwork, it's 'Fossio Chloretum'. We call it the Pond.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团的文件上写的是“克洛勒图姆矿场”。我们叫它池塘。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We dig up more copper, silver and turquoise than anywhere else in Mojave Orientum. Oh, and some of the stone used for the Chainway repairs is quarried here, too.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们挖出的铜、银和绿松石比莫哈维东部任何地方都要多。哦，还有一些用于修路的石头也是在这里开采的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We send the copper to Phoenix for the armor, and the turquose to the artists in Two-Sun. Sells for a nice pretty penny.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们把铜送到凤凰城去做盔甲，把绿松石送到双日城的艺术家那里。能卖个好价钱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But silver's the most important one. It's all refined here and sent south to be minted.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但银是最重要的。都是在这里提炼，然后送到南方铸造。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个矿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You had other questions?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还有其他问题吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about this mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说这个矿。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not my department.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是我的部门。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We just cast the silver into bars and store 'em until one of the caravans come to take it to Scottsdale.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们只是把银子铸造成条，然后储存起来，等其中一个商队来把它运到斯科茨代尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want to know more about the silver minting process.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想更多地了解白银的铸造过程。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, until it's refined at the very least. Why are you asking?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，至少在它被提炼出来之前。为什么要问这个？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All the silver is stored here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有的银都储存在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Curiosity killed the cat. Killed thieves, too. Not that I have many of those.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好奇心害死猫，也害死了贼。倒也不是说我身边有很多贼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the only thief I ever had to deal with, I grabbed him and made him kneel in the dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我对付过的唯一一个小偷，我抓住他，让他跪在地上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pulled out one of the crucibles from the refinery, all that hot liquid copper still in it and made him drink it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从精炼厂里拿出一个坩埚，里面还装着热的液态铜，让他喝了下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I've seen a Legion crucifixion, but what I did, well, I think it's worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我见过军团被钉死在十字架上，但我所做的，我觉得更糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I almost felt bad after it, like I had to apologize, so you know, I'm telling you this now: do not steal from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事后我感觉很糟糕，好像我必须道歉，所以你懂的，我现在告诉你，不要偷我们的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or else, I'll have to kill you dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则，我就得杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was curious.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很好奇。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? You know, there aren't thieves on my watch, you know why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？在我眼皮底下可没有小偷，你知道为什么吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Because the only thief I ever had to deal with, I grabbed him and made him kneel in the dirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 因为我对付过的唯一一个小偷，我抓住他，让他跪在地上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I pulled out one of the crucibles from the refinery, all that hot liquid copper still in it and made him drink it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从精炼厂里拿出一个坩埚，里面还装着热的液态铜，让他喝了下去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, I've seen a Legion crucifixion, but what I did, well, I think it's worse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我见过军团被钉死在十字架上，但我所做的，我觉得更糟糕。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I almost felt bad after it, like I had to apologize, so you know, I'm telling you this now: do not steal from us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事后我感觉很糟糕，好像我必须道歉，所以你懂的，我现在告诉你，不要偷我们的东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Or else, I'll have to kill you dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 否则，我就得杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I was planning on stealing it obviously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，我本来打算偷的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, some of the steps. The cement mixture is all made here. Limestone and gravel, the whole shabang.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，其中一些步骤。水泥混合物全都是在这里制造的，石灰石和砾石，一整套东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We do have to wait for Malpais to send us iron, though. The silver refinery doubles up as where we make iron bars.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我们得等马尔帕斯给我们送铁过来，银矿精炼厂兼作我们生产铁条的地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They also sometimes send us bits of the Chainway rubble itself so they can make big pieces to fit into the holes up top, which is honestly a total waste of time, but if the Legion wants it, they'll get it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们有时也会把连环道的碎石碎片寄给我们，这样他们就可以制造出大的碎片来放进上面的洞里，老实说，这完全是浪费时间，但如果军团想要，他们就会得到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This is where the Chainway repairs are done?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是修理连环道的地方吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know, but I have to do it. Well, I have to make the slaves do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，但我必须这么做。嗯，我必须让奴隶们去做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the point of that? Why not just use the cement mixture you give them on site?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这有什么意义呢？为什么不直接使用现场给他们的水泥混合物呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, in the old days, when I ran with the raiders, I was free. I might have had Julius as a boss, but in a way, we were all our own bosses.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道，在过去，当我和掠夺者一起混的时候，我是自由的。虽然尤利乌斯是我的老板，但在某种程度上，我们都是自己的老板。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And then the Legion came through the first time and I had to help work the mine for them, I thought this wasn't so bad. I knew where I stood.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后军团第一次来了，我不得不帮他们挖矿，我觉得这还不错。我知道自己的立场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But these days? I don't know. I think I'd almost prefer being a slave. At least I'd know where I stand.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是现在呢？我不知道。我想我宁愿做个奴隶，至少我知道自己的立场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you like your job?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你喜欢你的工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to gamble, go to the Horseshoe. Look, I have to at least look busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想赌博，就去马蹄铁酒吧。听着，我至少要看起来很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got off to the wrong start. Fancy a game of Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一开始就错了。想玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh, you've done right by me, so why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你对我很好，为什么不呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: We got off to the wrong start. Fancy a game of Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们一开始就错了。想玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want to gamble, go to the Horseshoe. Look, I have to at least look busy.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想赌博，就去马蹄铁酒吧。听着，我至少要看起来很忙。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, when we first met, we got off | to the wrong start. Fancy a game of Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，当我们第一次见面时，我们一开始就走错了路。想玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Eh, you've done right by me, so why not?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，你对我很好，为什么不呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You know, when we first met, we got off | to the wrong start. Fancy a game of Caravan?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你知道吗，当我们第一次见面时，我们一开始就走错了路。想玩大篷车扑克吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make them fast.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快一点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Kemper [0600B02C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I go by Dickweed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫穷屌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I go by Dickweed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我叫穷屌。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And you are officer....
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是...警官

ESP.ORIGINAL: Long story. Don't really feel like talking about it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很长的故事，我不太想谈这个。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's an odd name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这名字真奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not the first. Won't be the last. At least you're smart enough not to say anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不是第一个，不会是最后一个。至少你很聪明，什么都不说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Suppress a laugh.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <忍住笑>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny. In the old days, I'd beat your ass for saying that, but you honestly don't even have clothes on your back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。要是在以前，我会因为你这么说揍你一顿，但你真的连衣服都没穿。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You probably deserved having your shit took, too. Run along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你可能也活该倒霉，赶紧滚吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来就像。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Funny. In the old days, I'd beat your ass for saying that, but I'll settle for some denarii instead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有趣。要是在以前，我会因为你这么说而揍你一顿，但我还是愿意接受一些第纳尔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Come on, hand it over.
ESP.TRADUIT: 来吧，快交出来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You look like one.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看起来就像。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah... all right. Don't try that again.
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]嗯...好吧。别再这么做了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I apologize. I was just trying to get a laugh out of you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我道歉。我只是想逗你笑一笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] Jokes are funny. Denarii. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]玩笑很好笑。第纳尔，马上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, man, it's just a joke.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，哥们，开个玩笑而已。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Glad we're square. Have a nice day.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很高兴我们扯平了。祝你过得愉快。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Hand over 5 denarii.> Here you go.
ESP.TRADUIT: <交出5第纳尔>给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What the hell's wrong with you? The fuck you think this is, California?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你到底有什么毛病？你他妈以为这是什么地方，加州？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lucky I don't report your ass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没举报你算你走运。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Give me them fucking chems for safekeeping.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把那些该死的药品给我保管。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have some chems. Will that work instead?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有一些化学药品，这样行吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yo, deputies!
ESP.TRADUIT: 哟，代理人！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely not.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对不。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dumbass. Shit's mine, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 笨蛋。现在，这都是我的了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Give him all of your chems.> Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: <把你所有的药都给他>好吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Turn out your pockets. Now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你的口袋翻出来，马上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't have any denarii. I mean it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我没有第纳尔，我是认真的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大错特错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wasting my time with this shit. Go on, get out of here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 浪费我的时间。走吧，离开这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Turn out your pockets.> Look, seriously. See.
ESP.TRADUIT: <把口袋翻出来>你看，是真的。你看。

ESP.ORIGINAL: See, the fuck I tell you? Making it ten denarii now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你看，我他妈怎么跟你说的？现在是10第纳尔了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, run along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Turn out your pockets.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把口袋翻出来>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had to go digging for these.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得去挖这些东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, run along.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，快走吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Turn out your pockets.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <把口袋翻出来>

ESP.ORIGINAL: Big mistake.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大错特错。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course not, I'm the judge in these parts. Jury and executioner, too. Don't you forget it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然不，我才是这里的法官，还有陪审团和刽子手。你可别忘了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No judgment.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不做评判。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The three C's. Keep it orderly. Keep it calm. Keep it moving.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三个C开头的词。 保持秩序，保持冷静， 保持运转。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you do here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在这里干什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then how come it's Caesar? I'm pretty sure that's spelled with a C. Look, this is what the Legion is built on, okay?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那为什么是凯撒？我很确定这词是用C拼的，听着，这就是军团的基础，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All of those begin with K.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所有这些都是K开头的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Three C's. Got it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 三个C，明白了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure. If you're looking for a place to stay, visit Miss Wen's on the south of the town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。如果你想找个地方住，去镇上南边的温小姐家看看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're looking to buy anything, you want Cyanide Springs. Lots of lights. Can't miss it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想买东西，你会想到山奈泉。有很多灯，不会错过的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a local farm store if you need equipment, and a bank if you're doing money stuff.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你需要装备，可以去当地的农贸商店；如果你想理财，可以去银行。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, a, um, , a sex service shop in the springs. Talk to Isaiah about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 噢，啊，呃，泉里的性服务商店，跟以赛亚谈谈吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And if you want political stuff, there's Aristophontes in the big, clean building over there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你想要政治方面的东西，阿里斯托芬提斯就在那边干净的大楼里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like directions around town.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想了解一下镇上的情况。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you going to vote in the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你打算在选举中投票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, was a tribal out near Bullhead. My old tribe got chewed by NCR and Legion.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是布尔海德附近的一个部落，我的老部落被NCR和军团吃掉了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Kind of drifted until Kemper found me, helped me get my head straight.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一直在漂泊直到肯珀找到我，帮我理清思路。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your story?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的故事是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, the Legion has him over at the Pond, that's that big quarry to the east.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，军团把他关在池塘那边，就是东边的那个大采石场。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But, I'll tell you that I look up to the man, more than anything. He tells me that I can do anything if I set my mind to it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，我要告诉你，我尊敬他胜过一切。他告诉我，如果我下定决心，我可以做任何事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm just trying not to disappoint him is all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我只是不想让他失望而已。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Kemper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说肯珀。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lost a bet. Had to use it for a week. Broke some jaws over it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 打赌输了，不得不用了一个星期。还打趴了几个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Had to keep the name because of all of those broken jaws, but if anyone ever made fun of it again, I would get to break some more jaws.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不得不保留这个名字，因为那些断了的下巴，但如果有人再取笑我，我就可以再打断一些下巴了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was asking about the name.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我问的是名字。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make 'em quick.
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Dickweed [0600CE39] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Take a look.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you have for sale?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有什么卖的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? Yeah, I got something....
ESP.TRADUIT: 是吗？嗯，我有些...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Placeholder - I'm looking for work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 占位符 - 我正在找工作。

ESP.ORIGINAL: To keep things cool as a cucumber. Haha, it's a good one, right? It's usually wasted on some of the locals. They've never seen a cucumber.
ESP.TRADUIT: 酷得像根黄瓜。哈哈，这个说法很妙，对吧？可惜用在一些当地人身上通常是对牛弹琴，他们连黄瓜都没见过。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serious answer, though, the Legion loves meat, and you can salt meat, sure, but, uh, the Legion doesn't like the taste much.
ESP.TRADUIT: 严肃的回答，军团喜欢吃肉，当然可以用盐腌肉，但是，呃，军团不太喜欢那种味道。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, this is basically gourmet food for the higher-ups.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，这基本上是给高层的美食。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What does a town need with a refrigeration unit?
ESP.TRADUIT: 一个小镇需要制冷设备做什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: To me, too, partner. To me, too. I have theories, though.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也是，伙计，对我也是。不过我也有自己的理论。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they believe that the raw meat gives them more strength. Maybe it's because they're a bunch of cannibals or used to be a bunch a cannibals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他们认为生肉能给他们带来更大的力量。也许是因为他们是一群食人族或者曾经是一群食人族。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they like cooking it themselves, but the point stands: they love raw meat.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他们喜欢自己做，但重点是：他们喜欢生肉。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And they're willing to pay extra for it instead of just demanding it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们愿意支付额外的费用，而不仅仅是要求。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Legion likes un-salted meat? That seems very strange to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团喜欢不加盐的肉？这在我看来很奇怪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Was a farmer in Yuma. Wasn't really my scene. I like traveling the world, meeting people, trying new food.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是尤马的一个农民。不太适合我，我喜欢周游世界，结识新朋友，尝试新食物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Chloride, well, you won't find another town like this anywhere in the Legion, and I know. Phoenix is awful, Flagstaff is stuffy, Two-Sun is stuck up, but Chloride? Chloride is fun.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克洛赖德，你在军团里再也找不到这样的城镇了，我知道。凤凰城很糟糕，旗杆市很闷，双日城很傲慢，但是克洛赖德？克洛赖德很有趣。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: My only complaint is that there were way more restaurants in Two-Sun, but hey, you can't get everything you want, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我唯一的不满是双日城有更多的餐厅，但是，嘿，你不能得到你想要的一切，对吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Where are you from?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是哪里人？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, the posters? Yeah, both of them paid me some denarii in exchange to put 'em up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，海报？是啊，他们俩都给了我一些第纳尔，让我挂起来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You have posters up. Are you going to vote in the election?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你张贴了海报。你会在选举中投票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, sure, but, right now, I'm kind of undecided. You know, I'm all for being able to vote in Legion territory, you know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然，但现在，我有点犹豫不决。你知道，我完全支持在军团的地盘上投票，你懂吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But like, is it really a choice if both the candidates are the same?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是，如果两个候选人都是一样的，这真的是一个选择吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But are you going to vote?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是你会去投票吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, I don't know....
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我不知道...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do to convince you to vote for Calvin?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要怎么做才能说服你投加尔文的票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hmm, I don't know....
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，我不知道...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What can I do to convince you to vote for Luke?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要怎么做才能说服你投卢克的票？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I mean, look, I like Calvin, he seems nice, you know? But you look at White Sands, and they're just irreversibly linked to the Legion. Which is fine, obviously, you have to stand up to the NCR, but I don't know about him.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是说，我喜欢加尔文，他看起来很好，你懂吗？但你看看白沙，他们与军团有着不可逆转的联系。这没什么，很明显，你得和NCR对抗，但我不了解他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, you look at Luke, and he's kind of a jerk, talking about how he's going to make some changes, but it's the Legion. I don't really know if he's going to be able to do anything.
ESP.TRADUIT: 然后，你看看卢克，他有点混蛋，谈论着他将如何做出一些改变，但这是军团。我真的不知道他是否能做些什么。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How are both candidates the same?
ESP.TRADUIT: 两位候选人为何相同？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, enough about politics.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，政治说够了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Harris [0600D848] (mod) Quest : ([0600D7EA]AZFreeformChloride) 0600D7EA (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had other questions.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还有其他问题。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Of course he was a Ranger. The plans that we're providing to the NCR are fake, and they needed to come from a credible source.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他当然是游骑兵。我们提供给NCR的计划是假的，他们需要有可靠的来源。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I want you to do. Take the holotape and leave it on his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我想让你做的，把全息磁带放在他的尸体上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR will find it and conclude that he died in action recovering this information.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会发现并认定他是在恢复情报的行动中牺牲的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes, he was a Ranger.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的，他是个游骑兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Idiot. Months of preparation. Here's how you will salvage this.
ESP.TRADUIT: 白痴，几个月的准备。以下是你如何挽救它的方法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I want you to do. Take the holotape and leave it on his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我想让你做的，把全息磁带放在他的尸体上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR will find it and conclude that he died in action recovering this information.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会发现并认定他是在恢复情报的行动中牺牲的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Radscorpions managed to kill a R-? It doesn't matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 辐射蝎杀了一个游...？不重要。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's what I want you to do. Take the holotape and leave it on his corpse.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是我想让你做的，把全息磁带放在他的尸体上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The NCR will find it and conclude that he died in action recovering this information.
ESP.TRADUIT: NCR会发现并认定他是在恢复情报的行动中牺牲的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Lie.> Radscorpions got him.
ESP.TRADUIT: <说谎>辐射蝎抓住了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then our business is at an end. Forget about any further information on August.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那我们的事情就告一段落了。忘掉关于奥古斯特的任何进一步信息吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不打算那样做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Then, our business is at end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，我们的生意到此为止了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not going to do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不打算那样做。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good. Be on your way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。走你的路吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Ahiga [060089CE] (mod) Quest : ([06024B19]AZBigStopAhigaDialogueQuest) 06024B19 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A preposterous accusation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 荒谬的指控。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corvus was an irritating man. No one in Solitare was friends with him. And to accuse me of working with him to blow up the Chainway?
ESP.TRADUIT: 克渥斯是个令人恼火的人，在索利泰尔没有一个人是他的朋友。还指控我和他一起炸毁了连环道？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ridiculous.
ESP.TRADUIT: 太荒谬了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahiga states that you helped Corvus blow up the Chainway.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿希加说你帮克渥斯炸毁了连环道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, because it's obvious to me that he's insulting your intellect.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，因为在我看来他显然是在侮辱你的智商。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Alba Nox [060089CD] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't care about the accusation?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不在乎指控吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We've tried.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们已经试过了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: She does not fear death. Were she a man, she'd be a valuable soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 她不怕死。如果她是个男人，她会是个很有价值的士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why go through all this trouble? Can't you force the information out of her?
ESP.TRADUIT: 为什么要费这么大的劲？你就不能逼她说出这个消息吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Your ignorance is palpable. The plan is flawless.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你的无知显而易见。这个计划完美无缺。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Scipio Yuma [06020D30] (mod) Quest : ([06013D35]AZFreeformBaseCamp) 06013D35 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're just going to waste her time until she fesses up? Sounds like a stupid plan.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你打算浪费她的时间，直到她坦白？听起来是个愚蠢的计划。

ESP.ORIGINAL: What of it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那又如何？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know about the smuggling operation in Newt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道纽特的走私活动。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: ...and what? You've come to turn yourself in? Prostrate in front of the mighty Thrax?
ESP.TRADUIT: ...然后呢？你是来自首的？匍匐在强大的色雷斯面前？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Doctor Clay asked me to smuggle something for her.
ESP.TRADUIT: 克雷医生让我帮她走私点东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak to Scipio if you must. Bother me no more.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如有必要，去找西庇阿。别再烦我了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is there anything I can do?
ESP.TRADUIT: 有什么我能做的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Speak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Centurion Thrax [0600DD9F] (mod) Quest : ([060199D9]AZFreeformBaseCampWarRoom) 060199D9 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know why you're acting like this. I came here of my own accord.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道你为什么会这样。我是自愿来这里的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: People? Nah, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 人？不，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I ain't gonna go out like a coward. So do it, or don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 着，我不会像个懦夫一样离开。所以，要么做，要么不做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Is that how you greet people?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你就是这么跟人打招呼的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're the boss.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说了算。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look, I ain't gonna go out like a coward. So do it, or don't.
ESP.TRADUIT: 着，我不会像个懦夫一样离开。所以，要么做，要么不做。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your mouth.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说话客气点。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The fucking mutant, man. Stop wasting my damn time and just pull the trigger, alright?
ESP.TRADUIT: 该死的变种人。别再浪费我的时间了，快扣动扳机，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Green asshole? I'm not following.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绿色混蛋？我没听懂。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, you wanna ask me my whole life story? Mi mamÃ¡ was so mean to me, man. That's why I did all those chems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，你想问我的人生故事吗？我老妈对我太刻薄了，伙计。所以我才做了那么多化学药物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: See the chain on my neck? Nice piece of pre-war bling, right? Should've blown my head clean off, except I'm too lucky.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看到我脖子上的链子了吗？不错的战前首饰，对吧？本应该一枪爆头的，可惜我太幸运了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I ran, but I couldn't hold a gun because that big green fucker broke my hand when he grabbed me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我跑了，但我拿不到枪，因为那个绿色的大混蛋抓住我的时候把我的手弄断了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So I ran and ignored the fact that I couldn't hold a gun. Ran for a while. Then - and this is the funny part - I sprained my ankle. Pretty bad, I guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以我跑了，忽略了我不会持枪的事实。跑了一会儿，然后...这是有趣的部分...我扭伤了脚踝。很糟糕，我想。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So here I am, man. The last Dog of Guadalupe hiding up in a tree. You gonna kill me or what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我就在这儿了，兄弟。最后一只藏在树上的“瓜达卢佩之犬”。你是打算杀了我，还是怎么着？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It was night and the road seemed deserted. Guess it's deserted 'cause it's a dead end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 夜幕降临，路上似乎无人。我猜这里没人住，因为这是条死胡同。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And now, if I look down, I see those same slaver assholes. The Rusty Hooks. It's like they're taunting me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，如果我往下看，我看到的还是那些奴隶贩子混蛋，锈钩帮。就好像他们在嘲笑我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe they're looking for me, maybe not. Maybe we were just headed in the same direction. Doesn't matter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许他们在找我，也许不是，也许我们只是走了同一个方向。没关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Bounty hunters and Legion everywhere, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到处都是赏金猎人和军团，伙计。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Broken hand, ankle don't work, stuck up on high, no food and no water, nowhere to go. Pretty bad luck in the end.
ESP.TRADUIT: 手断了，脚踝不行了，站在高处，没有食物和水，无处可去。真是倒霉透顶。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I still don't understand. Why are you *here* specifically?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我还是不明白，你为什么会在*这里*？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What, a little tribal remedy? You gonna sprinkle some herbs on me? I'll pass.
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么，一个小部落疗法吗？你要在我身上洒些草药吗？我还是算了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't I just get you some medicine?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不能给你拿点药吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Make it quick, yeah?
ESP.TRADUIT: 快点，好吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Okay. I'll kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的，我会杀了你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're not understanding me. I've got no other options. Way it's looking - I'm meeting death soon. The hunger's getting bad and I'm real weak.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不了解我，我没有别的选择。现在的情况是我马上就要死了，饥饿感越来越强，我很虚弱。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd crawl off the side of the overpass here but...
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想从立交桥边上爬下去，但是...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, I'm not going to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我不会杀你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah? Fuck you too, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯？也操你妈，哥们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm sorry. I'm still not going to kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我很抱歉，我还是不会杀你的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm afraid of heights.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我恐高。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Tailhead [06024F99] (mod) Quest : ([060130AD]AZFreeformRustyHooks) 060130AD (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: But what?
ESP.TRADUIT: 但是什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, you wouldn't. This shipment is worth more than your life. I am quite willing to take yours to defend mine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你不会。这批货比你的命还值钱，我很愿意拿你的来捍卫我的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'd like to talk about what you're carrying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想谈谈你带着的东西。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [SUCCEEDED] And, what, I suppose you'll offer to carry these medical supplies on your own?
ESP.TRADUIT: [成功]然后呢，我猜你会主动提出自己拿这些医疗用品？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're wasting pack space on medical supplies. The war's heating up. You need to be carrying ammo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在医疗用品上浪费背包空间。战争正在升温，你得带着弹药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: [FAILED] No.
ESP.TRADUIT: [失败]不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's make a trade - I give you everything I'm carrying, and you give me everything you're carrying.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们做个交易吧，我把我带的东西都给你，你把你带的东西都给我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Take these directly to the Fort, understand?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。把这些直接送到堡垒，明白吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You suggested it, not me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是你建议的，不是我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, there's no way. You cannot be.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，不可能。你不可能是。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Pretend to be the Burned Man.> 'He burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and sacrificed his sons in the fire.'
ESP.TRADUIT: <假装自己是火烧人>他在欣嫩子谷烧香，并在火中焚烧了他的儿子们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Just because you are slow in the head doesn't mean I won't kill you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你脑子迟钝不代表我不会杀了你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hey, look up in the sky! There's a banner that says 'gullible' up there!
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，抬头看天空！上面有个横幅写着“易受骗”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Burned Man. You are his avenging spirit.
ESP.TRADUIT: 火烧人，你是他的复仇之魂。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What do you seek? Why are you here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你在寻找什么？你为什么会在这里？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Recognize me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 认识我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Take them. Just, please leave us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，拿去吧。请...请离开吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Carthage Crusius [0601F5BF] (mod) Quest : ([0601F58D]AZChlorideAntibioticsQuest) One Night With Venus EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hand over the antibiotics you're carrying. I wont ask twice.
ESP.TRADUIT: 把你身上的抗生素交出来，我不会问第二次。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, that? I didn't put the sign up. It's been there since before the war.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，那个？不是我挂的，从战前就在那里了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's some weird radio stuff going on south of here, as I understand it. I've never been, so take this with a grain of salt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 据我所知，这里南面有一些奇怪的无线电信号。我从来没去过，所以你就别抱太大希望了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you make it down to Dolan Springs, there's a road that goes north towards the Grand Canyon - that's where things get fuzzy. Even the Legionaries stay away.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你走到多兰泉，有一条向北通向大峡谷的路...在那里，事情变得模糊了，即使是军团也会远离。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And I guess some cows are getting cut up too, but I don't know how that's related.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我猜一些牛也会被切碎，但我不知道这有什么关系。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Personally I'm more interested in that giant radio tower just off the Chainway, but that one isn't working either. Getting sick of Johnny Guitar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就我个人而言，我对那个巨大的无线电塔更感兴趣，就在连环道旁边，但那个也不能用。厌倦了约翰尼·吉它。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Clinton [06013424] (mod) Quest : ([06017560]AZFreeformBigStop) 06017560 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the 'Pierce Ferry phenomenon'?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是“皮尔斯渡口现象”？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No, that'd be Colonel Cassandra Moore you're lookin' for. I'm just a Major.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，你要找的是卡桑德拉·摩尔上校。我只是个少校。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Are you in charge here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是这里的负责人吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No problems here. She's a fine woman and a qualified Colonel. Nothing like that peacenik, Hsu.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里没有问题。她是个好女人，也是个合格的上校。不像那个反战人士，许。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, I'll be taking her spot once she makes General.
ESP.TRADUIT: 而且，等她升上将军，我就接替她的位置。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You don't have a problem serving under a younger woman?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你不介意在年轻女人手下工作吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't get friendly with me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别对我太友好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm not a hero or nothing. I joined the army after the Bullhead Massacre. Wanted to make my country proud, make those savages pay.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不是什么英雄什么的，我是在布尔海德惨案后参军的。我想让我的国家骄傲，让那些野蛮人付出代价。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I did tours in the Sierra Nevada, mostly. Cut my teeth on the mountain tribals. Got to meet President Kimball when he was just a general.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我大部分时间都在内华达山脉旅行，我是在山区部落里练出来的。在金博尔总统还是将军的时候见过他。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess I did good, 'cause the brass promoted me. Worked my way up to Major. Now, here I am.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想我干得不错，因为上级提拔我了，一步步升到少校。现在，我在这里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I just meant, you must have some pretty big accomplishments, right?
