ESP.TRADUIT: 我的意思是，你一定有很大的成就，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know you can't be an NCR citizen, asking me a question like that. Either that, or you're slow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道你不可能是NCR公民，问我这种问题。要么是这样，要么就是你太迟钝了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: 38 NCR citizens brutally murdered by some chicken-speaking tribals. Tibbetts wanted to roll over and try for peace, but the voters wouldn't take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 38名NCR公民被一些说着鸟语的部落成员残忍杀害。蒂贝茨本想妥协并争取和平，但选民们不买账。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fortunately, we live in a democracy. Voters had enough of her. The new president Peterson ordered the military move in to restore order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 幸运的是，我们生活在一个民主国家。选民们已经受够了她，新总统彼得森下令军队介入以恢复秩序。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've never seen the country so united, so patriotic. If it weren't for the lives lost, I'd be grateful that I got to see it happen. But that's the past, now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我从未见过这个国家如此团结，如此爱国。如果不是因为那些逝去的生命，我会很感激我能看到这一切发生。但现在，那都是过去了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's the Bullhead Massacre?
ESP.TRADUIT: 什么是布尔海德惨案？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My take? Kid, I'll tell you the truth, because a lot of people are afraid to say it: this war ain't gonna end. Not ever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的看法？孩子，我告诉你真相，因为很多人都不敢说：这场战争不会结束，永远不会。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Legion, raiders, or something else. Whatever it is, we'll be fighting it. That ain't a bad thing. War is good!
ESP.TRADUIT: 军团，掠夺者，或者别的什么。不管是什么，我们都要和它战斗。这不是件坏事，战争是好事！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's your take on the war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你对这场战争有什么看法？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pro-California. I love my country, and I hate the backwards killers who want to destroy it. Ain't it normal to feel that way?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我支持加利福尼亚，我爱我的国家，我恨那些想要毁灭它的落后杀手。有这种感觉不是很正常吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres

ESP.ORIGINAL: Look around you. You know what you see? California, the only democracy in the wasteland, an oasis in the desert, a beacon of hope.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看看你的周围。你知道你看到了什么吗？加利福尼亚，废土上唯一的民主国家，沙漠中的绿洲，希望的灯塔。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outside of California? Backwards animals. They don't speak English, don't produce anything, ain't civilized.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在加利福尼亚之外？退化的动物。他们不会说英语，不会生产任何东西，没有教养。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They walk around naked with plants covering their junk, for God's sake!
ESP.TRADUIT: 看在上帝的份上，他们光着身子到处走，身上长满了植物！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They kill our children, rape our women, and start wars they can't win. That's what they do.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们杀害我们的孩子，强奸我们的妇女，发动他们赢不了的战争。这就是他们所做的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, I say, kill them! They don't belong here. We should't give them the grace, the leniency, to keep raping us. Kill 'em and be done with it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，我说，杀了他们！他们不属于这里。我们不应该给他们恩惠，宽大处理，继续强奸我们。杀了他们，就完事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So you're pro-war?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以你支持战争？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I'll be! Good to get some common sense out here in the land of milk and honey.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我会的！在这片盛产牛奶和蜂蜜的土地上，多了解一些常识是件好事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: A lot of these people get so used to clinking glases that they forget how dangerous the world can be. I hate Vegas, I tell you. Take me home to the country.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很多人都习惯了碰杯，忘记了这个世界有多危险。我告诉你，我讨厌维加斯，带我回乡下的家吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I guess so. The NCR has a right to defend itself, and it seems like your mission is good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想是这样。NCR有权保护自己，看来你的任务很好。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Watch your tone with me, kid.
ESP.TRADUIT: 注意你的语气，孩子。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They're not like us. They're less than us. If you tell me I'm wrong, you're lying to yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们和我们不一样，他们比我们弱小。如果你说我错了，那你就是在自欺欺人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres

ESP.ORIGINAL: Caesar is just like the Khans. Just like the Vipers and the Jackals. Walking around with sticks, eating raw meat. And they want to tell us we're wrong for how we live?
ESP.TRADUIT: 凯撒就像大汗帮一样，就像毒蛇帮和豺狼帮一样，拿着棍子四处走动，吃生肉。他们想告诉我们，我们的生活方式是错误的吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things would be a lot safer, and a lot happier, if everywhere was more like the NCR. End of story.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果所有地方都像NCR一样，事情会更安全，也会更幸福。故事到此结束。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So is it all just about killing tribals? Is that what you're enlisted for?
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以这一切都是为了杀死部落吗？你入伍就是为了这个吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Depends. How tough are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 看情况。你有多强硬？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You got any work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有活儿给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go on.
ESP.TRADUIT: 继续。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: About that work...
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于那份工作...

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, yeah, I've got work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，是的，我还有工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can we skip the games and get to the point. I was sent here for a job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们能跳过游戏，进入正题吗？我是来找工作的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, yeah, I've got work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，是的，我还有工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tough enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够强硬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sorry, I need the real deal, not a bullshitter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我要的是真货，不是屁话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I could expertly and precisely shoot Caesar from a vantage point in the Boneyard, I'm just that good.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我可以熟练而精确地从晒骨场的一个有利位置射杀凯撒，我就是那么厉害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, yeah, I've got work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，是的，我还有工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tough enough.
ESP.TRADUIT: 够强硬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sorry, I need the real deal, not a bullshitter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我要的是真货，不是屁话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm pretty much a total badass, so don't worry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个十足的坏蛋，所以别担心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In that case, yeah, I've got work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那样的话，是的，我还有工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was tied up, shot in the head, and buried alive. I'm still standing. That good enough?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被绑起来，头部中枪，然后被活埋，我还站着。够好了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, sorry, I need the real deal, not a bullshitter.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，我要的是真货，不是屁话。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For me, it doesn't even hurt when I stub my toe on the table. I'm the real deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对我来说，当我的脚趾撞到桌子上时，它甚至不疼。我是货真价实的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I want three bastards dead. You kill them for me, and you'll make me a very happy man. Problem is, they're in Legion territory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我要三个混蛋死，你替我杀了他们，你会让我成为一个非常幸福的人。问题是，他们在军团的地盘上。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't have to explain why I can't send an army marching into Malpais. So, I turn to you. 1,000 NCR dollars per kill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不用解释我为什么不能派军队去马尔帕斯。所以，我向你求助，每杀一个人1000NCR元。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lay it on me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 告诉我吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dominicus Rex, the head of Camp Malpais, and a guy named Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 多米尼库斯·勒克斯，马尔帕斯营地的首领，还有一个叫阿里斯托芬提斯的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This isn't a military operation. Don't expect our people to swoop in and set up camp after you. This needs to be precise. Three high-profiles.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这不是军事行动，别指望我们的人会冲进来在你后面扎营。这需要精确，三个搞价值目标。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are the targets?
ESP.TRADUIT: 目标是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's running the town of Big Stop, right across the river. A mean, coldhearted, dead-eyed freak, he is.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他掌管着大河对面的大站镇。他是一个刻薄、冷酷、眼神死气沉沉的怪物。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not even a centurion yet, but I'd rather snuff him out now than let him be a problem later.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他甚至还不是百夫长，但我宁愿现在就把他干掉，也不愿让他成为以后的麻烦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Plus, this is personal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，这是私人恩怨。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Dominicus Rex.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说多米尼库斯·勒克斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: There were some rangers from Bullhead. Got separated during the Legion assault, stranded behind enemy lines.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有几个布尔海德的游骑兵。在军团的进攻中走散了，被困在敌后。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: They were working their way north to the dam, but they only ever made it to Big Stop. Stuck there, hiding in a damn basement.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们一直在往北走，去大坝，但他们只到过大站。被困在那里，躲在该死的地下室里。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Things turned out as you might expect. Don't have bodies to recover, just one charred corpse, and another in smithereens.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事情的结果如你所料。没有尸体可以找回，只有一具烧焦的尸体，另一具已经变成碎片。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now, Dominicus Rex is overseeing the torture of everyone who ever even smelled the rangers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在，多米尼库斯·勒克斯正在监督折磨每一个闻过游骑兵味道的人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's personal about killing Dominicus Rex?
ESP.TRADUIT: 杀死多米尼库斯·勒克斯是什么私人恩怨？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Calls himself Marcellus Sedonus, like he wasn't already a grown adult when the Legion formed. Old man dressed in a skirt, playing pretend.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他管自己叫马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯，说得好像军团成立时他不是个成年人似的。一个穿裙子的老家伙，在玩过家家。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Senile or not, he's a legate. Taking him out would be like them killing Colonel Moore - a big deal.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不管他是不是老糊涂，他都是特使。干掉他就像干掉摩尔上校一样，是件大事。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the head of Camp Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说马尔帕斯营地的首领。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I forget that civilians don't understand this stuff. <Sigh.> There's General Oliver, but underneath him there are other generals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我忘了平民不懂这些东西。<叹气>有奥利弗将军，但在他之下还有其他将军。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've got the Lieutenant General, and under him is the Major General, and under the Major General is the Brigadier General.
ESP.TRADUIT: 有中将，在他之下是少将，少将之下是准将。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: All called generals, but they're not the same rank. On top of 'em all is still Oliver. And, I suppose, Lanius.
ESP.TRADUIT: 都是将军，但级别不同，最重要的还是奥利弗。我想，还有拉尼厄斯。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Marcellus Sedonus is a legate? What about Legate Lanius?
ESP.TRADUIT: 马塞卢斯·塞多尼乌斯是个特使？那拉尼厄斯特使呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't know much about him, to tell you the truth. Our intel isn't as up-to-date as we'd like.
ESP.TRADUIT: 说实话，我对他不太了解。我们的情报不像我们希望的那么及时。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I know he's supposed to replace legate Sedonus. Sedonus was an erratic old fool, which presents its own problems, but I'd have preferred he kept that post.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我知道他应该接替塞多尼乌斯特使。塞多尼乌斯是个古怪的老傻瓜，这本身就有问题，但我宁愿他继续担任那个职位。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The person replacing him is going to be much more dangerous, much more of a threat to us. He needs to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 接替他的人会更危险，对我们更有威胁。他得走了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about the head of Camp Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说马尔帕斯营地的首领。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's not strictly a military target. I hope that doesn't make you squeamish.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他不是严格意义上的军事目标。我希望这不会让你感到不安。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's a governor in a mining town that's sort of a satellite to Kingman. Chloride, it's called.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他是一个采矿小镇的总督，有点像金曼的卫星城市。叫克洛赖德。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Aristophontes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说阿里斯托芬提斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: He's efficient at what he does, and what he does is assist the Legion in coming across the river to enslave us.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他做事效率很高，他所做的就是协助军团渡过河来奴役我们。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And spare me the lecture. This is war. He's a governor. We can split hairs over whether that's a civilian position or a military one, but it doesn't change a thing.
ESP.TRADUIT: 别跟我说教了，这是战争。他是个总督，我们可以对这是一个文职职位还是一个军事职位吹毛求疵，但这并不能改变任何事情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It is our job to kill the bad guys, and he's one of them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们的工作就是消灭坏人，而他就是其中之一。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why do you want me to kill a governor?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么要我杀个总督？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about him? The machine is in motion. War is happening, whether Caesar is alive or dead.
ESP.TRADUIT: 他怎么了？机器在运转，战争正在发生，无论凯撒是死是活。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You want that suicide mission? More power to you. Make it painful. But I'm not asking it of you. It doesn't solve the present problems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你想要自杀任务吗？ 那你加油吧，让他们痛苦点。但我并没有要求你，这不能解决当下的问题。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那凯撒呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It sounds to me like you already got him. Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 听起来你已经搞定他了。干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Now there's thousands of men itching to die killing for their martyred king, and Lanius is coming to lead the charge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 现在有成千上万的人渴望为他们的殉国之王而死，拉尼厄斯要来带头冲锋了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems like you owe it to us to clean up the mess you made. Besides, these guys should be easy marks compared to the head honcho.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来你欠我们一个人情，要收拾你弄的烂摊子。再说了，这些家伙跟老大比起来应该容易对付。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about Caesar?
ESP.TRADUIT: 那凯撒呢？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Like looking gift horses in the mouth, do ya? The catch is that this is across the river. You'll have no backup, no help, nothing. Just you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 喜欢得了便宜还卖乖，是吧？难处在于，是在河对岸。你不会有后援，没有帮助，什么都没有，只有你一个人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Would be a job for the Rangers, but, frankly, they're outmatched on this. Caesar's Frumentarii are honed spies and killers. Our Rangers are glorified scouts.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是游骑兵的工作，但坦白说，他们在这方面是无能为力的。凯撒的军团特务是训练有素的间谍和杀手，我们的游骑兵是光荣的侦察兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The brass doesn't believe this can be done. I disagreed. You'll get your money. Hell, we'll take it out of the food budget. Just get it done.
ESP.TRADUIT: 高层不相信这是可行的，我不同意。你会拿到钱的，见鬼，我们可以从食物预算中扣除，把它做完就行了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: This job seems too important to be handing off to a contractor. What's the catch?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这项工作似乎太重要了，不能交给承包商。有什么隐情？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed I do. Bring me their scalps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 确实是这样，把他们的头皮给我拿来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll do it. Do you need me to bring back proof?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我来吧。你需要我带证据回来吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Good on you, soldier.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很适合你，士兵。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Got it. I'll get to work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 明白了。我要开始工作了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serves me right for thinking a civvie could have what it takes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是活该，居然以为平民也能做到。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll have to think about it and get back to you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我得考虑一下再给你答复。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's an army thing. Don't expect you to understand. Just bring me their scalps and you'll be rewarded handsomely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是军队的事，别指望你能理解。只要把他们的头皮给我，你就会得到丰厚的报酬。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Their scalps? Why?
ESP.TRADUIT: 他们的头皮？为什么？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems I've underestimated you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我低估你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll never forget riding past the Crater Lakes, scalps dangling from my belt, obsidian knife in the sheathe where my standard-issue ought to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我永远忘不了骑行经过火山口湖，我的腰带上挂着几张头皮，本该放标配武器的刀鞘里插着一把黑曜石刀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corporal had written on his helmet: 'Bullhead bays for blood!'
ESP.TRADUIT: 下士在他的头盔上写着：“布尔海德湾血战！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: War ain't so bad for a certain type of person, is what I mean to say. Do it for your country, and you'll never feel guilty in your life. Why should you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想说的是，战争对某些人来说并不是那么糟糕。为你的国家而战，你就永远不会感到内疚，你为什么会呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I do understand. You have to use their savagery against them, otherwise they'll never learn.
ESP.TRADUIT: 事实上，我能理解。你必须用他们的野蛮来对付他们，否则他们永远也学不会。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Seems I've underestimated you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 看来我低估你了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Surprise

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll never forget riding past the Crater Lakes, scalps dangling from my belt, obsidian knife in the sheathe where my standard-issue ought to go.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我永远忘不了骑行经过火山口湖，我的腰带上挂着几张头皮，本该放标配武器的刀鞘里插着一把黑曜石刀。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Corporal had written on his helmet: 'Bullhead bays for blood!'
ESP.TRADUIT: 下士在他的头盔上写着：“布尔海德湾血战！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: War ain't so bad for a certain type of person, is what I mean to say. Do it for your country, and you'll never feel guilty in your life. Why should you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想说的是，战争对某些人来说并不是那么糟糕。为你的国家而战，你就永远不会感到内疚，你为什么会呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: [NCR Rep] Like war trophies? I get it. You were proud to serve your country.
ESP.TRADUIT: [NCR声望]就像战争奖杯一样？我明白了。你为自己的国家效力而自豪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: This the one who took the post from the legate? Good work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 就是这个人接了特使的班吗？干得好。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have a scalp for you. Flavius, from Malpais.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有张头皮要给你，来自马尔帕斯的弗拉维乌斯。

ESP.ORIGINAL: So this is the bastard. Yeesh, I don't know how you managed. Not a lot of hair to work with, here. Excellent work.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，这就是那个杂种了。啧，我真不知道你是怎么办到的。他头上可没多少头发能让你下手啊。干得漂亮。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Disgust

ESP.ORIGINAL: One legate scalp, coming right up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一张特使头皮，马上就来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Can't help but feel a little bad that this had to be done to a civilian, but hard times and desperate measures.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不得不对一个平民做出这样的事，我不禁感到有点难过，但这是艰难的时期和绝望的措施。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aristophontes' scalp is... scalped.
ESP.TRADUIT: 阿里斯托芬提斯的头皮...被剥了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hoowee, that's a bloody little bastard. He must've gushed like a whore on Mentats. I think I'll display this one. Wonderful job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇塞，那可真是个血淋淋的小混蛋。他的血一定喷得跟个磕了曼他特的婊子似的。我想，我要把这玩意儿展示出来。干得太漂亮了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Happy

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's Dominicus Rex's scalp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给你多米尼库斯·勒克斯的头皮。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Indeed it is. Impressive work. Very impressive. You're a natural killer.
ESP.TRADUIT: 的确如此，令人印象深刻的工作，非常令人印象深刻，你是个天生的杀手。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here, a little bonus for a job well done. You've earned it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 给，这是对你工作表现的一点奖励。这是你应得的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So that's all the scalps, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是所有的头皮，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sure.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Major Sutter [06016C6B] (mod) Quest : ([060293B5]AZArizonaOpenSeason) In Partes Tres EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm. A drink, you said? Not the little blue stars? Long time ago, must've been.
ESP.TRADUIT: 唔，你是说一种饮料？不是那些小蓝星吗？一定是很久以前的事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: There's a computer in the storage room. Old manager here used to use it for all his business. Might find a lead in the files somewhere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 储藏室里有一台电脑，这里的老经理过去经常用它来做生意。也许能在档案里找到线索。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Here's the key to the room. Don't take nothin'. Not that there's much worth takin' anyway. See if you can get that terminal open.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这是房间的钥匙，什么都别拿，反正也没什么值得拿的。看看你能不能打开那个终端。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Glass-Eyed Ricamore [0601076A] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking for a drink called Blue Sass. Ring any bells?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我在找一种叫蓝色沙司的饮料。有什么印象吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hugo.
ESP.TRADUIT: 雨果。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who are you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是谁？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Captured me in the night. We were on our way to The Fort when the Legion swiped me at a checkpoint.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在夜里俘获了我。我们在去堡垒的路上，军团在一个检查站洗劫了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Second night I spat in one of their faces. They threw me in here. Haven't ate since.
ESP.TRADUIT: 第二天晚上，我朝他们其中一个脸上吐了口水，他们把我扔在这里。从那以后就没吃过东西。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How'd you end up here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么会在这里？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not much to tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没什么可说的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Lived off the land, til now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 靠土地为生，直到现在。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说你自己。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Alive" is a stretch. I'm holding on.
ESP.TRADUIT: “活着”是一种延伸，我还在坚持。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You haven't eaten? How are you alive?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你还没吃东西？你是怎么活下来的？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I think his name is Ruiz? A real crybaby.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我记得他叫鲁伊兹？一个爱哭鬼。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I seen him have a breakdown over drinking dirty water.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我看到他因为喝了脏水而崩溃。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Coward slipped a collar on me in the night. Got his guys to hold me down.
ESP.TRADUIT: 懦夫在夜里给我套上项圈，让他的人按住了我。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The thought of getting him keeps me going.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一想到能干掉他，我就有了撑下去的动力。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Who captured you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 谁抓了你？

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's mighty kind of you. If you can, tell him I sent you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真是太好了。如果可以的话，告诉他是我让你来的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Hugo [0600BF2C] (mod) Quest : ([0601CDC4]AZFreeformPond) 0601CDC4 (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'll kill him for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我会替你杀了他。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Sigh.> No. It's fine. I suppose you wanted something? I'm on the clock, so spit it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: <叹气>不，没关系。我猜你想要什么？我在上班，有话就说吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry for bothering you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对不起，打扰你了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Chuckles.> Tripod. That's sorta funny.
ESP.TRADUIT: <轻笑>三脚架，这有点好笑。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, I'm on the clock, so spit it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，我在上班，有话快说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck you, tripod.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操你妈，三脚架。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Am I just too much for you to handle, sweet pea? Do you need a Miss Nanny? Grow up.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是不是对你来说太难对付了，小甜心？你需要保姆小姐吗？成熟点吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Anyway, I'm on the clock, so spit it out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 总之，我在上班，有话快说。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Woah. Lotta personality for a robot. Too much, actually.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哇， 真是个性十足的机器人，其实，有点太多了。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm Sassy Sally, and I'm here to make sure you're having a rootin' tootin' chem-shootin' Elephant Hill of a time!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是飒爽莎莉，我来这里是为了确保你们嗨翻天，嗨得像磕了药在象山上一样！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm a Mister Handy. My function is to do domestic tasks and hospitality. Sunset Sarsaparilla commissioned me for this location.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我是个巧手先生，我的职责是做家务和招待客人。夕阳沙士公司委托我来拍摄这个地方。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Didn't expect to see a robot here. What's your deal?
ESP.TRADUIT: 没想到会在这里看到机器人。你是怎么回事？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Gee, take a guess.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哎呀，猜猜看。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's catchy and reminds people of Sarsaparilla. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它朗朗上口，让人想起沙士。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you called Sassy Sally?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你为什么叫飒爽莎莉？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Go into the saloon and ask Ricamore. He loves conversation.
ESP.TRADUIT: 到酒馆去问里卡莫尔，他喜欢聊天。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: What's going on around here? Anything I should know?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这里发生了什么？有什么我应该知道的吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: My programming requires me to ingratiate myself to the clientele. The clientele has been rowdy, loud, and violent. I acclimated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的编程要求我去迎合顾客。这里的客人吵闹、亢奋、暴力，我适应了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've learned that I'm good at gunspinning, and that flushing my RAM feels similar to how alcohol has been described to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现我很擅长转枪，而且清理我内存的感觉，和别人向我描述的酒精的感觉很相似。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since I loosened my parameters, I've received more tips and suffered less damages, which is good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从我放宽了我的参数，我收到了更多的小费，遭受了更少的损失，这对我来说已经足够好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Don't like it? Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不喜欢吗？走开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: For a robot, you've got a serious attitude.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为一个机器人，你的态度很严肃。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Part of my programming requires me to ingratiate myself to the clientele. The clientele has been rowdy, loud, and violent. I acclimated.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我的部分程序要求我去讨好客户。这里的客人吵闹、亢奋、暴力，我适应了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've learned that I'm good at gunspinning, and that flushing my RAM feels similar to how alcohol has been described to me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我发现我很擅长转枪，而且清理我内存的感觉，和别人向我描述的酒精的感觉很相似。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: In particular, people seem very amused when I access my lexical blacklist and use one of the words. I'll demonstrate.
ESP.TRADUIT: 特别是，当我进入我的词汇黑名单并使用其中一个词时，人们似乎很开心。我来演示一下。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fuck.
ESP.TRADUIT: 操。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pretty funny, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 很有趣，对吧？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Since I loosened my parameters, I've received more tips and suffered less damages, which is good enough for me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 自从我放宽了我的参数，我收到了更多的小费，遭受了更少的损失，这对我来说已经足够好了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Strange that personality drift would make you more abrasive. Talking to people should have counteracted that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 真奇怪，人格漂移竟然会让你变得更讨人厌。与人交谈本应该能抵消掉这一点才对。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're lucky my programming is preventing me from saying what I'm thinking.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算你走运，我的程序阻止了我说出自己的想法。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Someone should program some manners into you, because yeesh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 真该有人给你编点礼貌程序进去，真是的！

ESP.ORIGINAL: Aw, look at your little brain cells working so hard. Go on, you're so close!
ESP.TRADUIT: 啊，看看你的小脑细胞工作得多辛苦。继续，你很接近了！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I was given this voice and personality module to counteract the 'perceived masculinity' of Elephant Hill.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我被赋予了这个声音和个性模块来抵消象山“被感知到的男性气质”。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cowboys and masked bandits can be intimidating to the little ones.
ESP.TRADUIT: 牛仔和蒙面强盗对小孩子来说很吓人。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said you're a Mister Handy... but you sound like a woman...
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说你是巧手先生...但你听起来像个女人...

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's what I was programmed for. I can't just leave. This is my job.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这就是我被编程的目的。我不能就这么离开，这是我的工作。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Why are you still here?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你怎么还在这儿？

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's catchy and reminds people of Sarsaparilla. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它朗朗上口，让人想起沙士。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID)

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, you're sassy. And I'd guess that your name is Sally.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你很飒爽，我猜你的名字是莎莉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's catchy and reminds people of Sarsaparilla. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它朗朗上口，让人想起沙士。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't want to guess. Just tell me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不想猜，快告诉我。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's catchy and reminds people of Sarsaparilla. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它朗朗上口，让人想起沙士。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That one song - Long Tall Sally. That's where the name is from.
ESP.TRADUIT: 那首歌，高挑莎莉。这就是名字的由来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: It's catchy and reminds people of Sarsaparilla. That's all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 它朗朗上口，让人想起沙士。就是这样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sunset... sass..y? Sassy-parilla?
Certainly! Sunset Sarsaparilla is the finest drink in the west! Whether you're a cowboy or a city-slicker, Sunset Sarsaparilla will do the best to keep you fresh!
ESP.TRADUIT: 当然可以！夕阳沙士是西方最好的饮料！无论你是牛仔还是城里人，夕阳沙士都能让你保持清爽！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Elephant Hill Ghost Town Experience is pleased to offer a fine variety of Sunset Sarsaparilla drinks. Might I recommend the Blue Sass?
ESP.TRADUIT: 象山鬼城体验很高兴为您提供各种精选的夕阳沙士饮料， 我可以向您推荐蓝色沙司吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you're interested in learning more about our storied history, visit the Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters in downtown Las Vegas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果您有兴趣了解更多关于我们的历史，请参观拉斯维加斯市中心的夕阳沙士公司总部。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ask for Festus, and tell 'em Sassy Sally sent you!
ESP.TRADUIT: 去找非斯都斯，告诉他们是莎莉派你来的！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Tell me about Sunset Sarsaparilla.
ESP.TRADUIT: 跟我说说夕阳沙士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, no. The guys in charge made it very clear that alcohol is against the law now.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，没有。那些负责人说得很清楚，现在喝酒是违法的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Besides, our liquor license is expired.
ESP.TRADUIT: 另外，我们的酒类许可证过期了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I'm looking to have a little fun. Is there some sort of Sunset Sangria? Screwdriver Sarsaparilla?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我想找点乐子。有什么夕阳桑格利亚吗？螺丝沙士？

ESP.ORIGINAL: We don't talk about Nuka-Cola here.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们这里不谈论核子可乐。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had enough of this swill. Where can I get a Nuka-Cola?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我已经受够了这种泔水，哪里可以买到核子可乐？

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't know. It's not in my semantic network. Maybe it was discontinued?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不知道，它不在我的语义网络中。也许它已经停产了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said something about Blue Sass? Tell me more about that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你提到蓝色沙司了？跟我详细说说。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm. Maybe a little. I'm wired to derive pleasure from stimulating interactions with people, but that's been few and far between lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，可能会有一点。我天生喜欢通过与人进行刺激的互动来获得快乐，但最近很少有这样的事情发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With programming as sophisticated as yours, you must feel lonely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样复杂的编程，你一定会感到孤独。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hm. Maybe a little. I'm wired to derive pleasure from stimulating interactions with people, but that's been few and far between lately.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，可能会有一点。我天生喜欢通过与人进行刺激的互动来获得快乐，但最近很少有这样的事情发生。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: With programming as sophisticated as yours, you must feel lonely.
ESP.TRADUIT: 像你这样复杂的编程，你一定会感到孤独。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You mean..? I guess I hadn't even considered...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你是说...？我想我根本没有考虑过...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. I know I don't look it, but I'm quite old. I could be your great great great great grandmother. I really doubt you want that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咳咳，我知道我看起来不像，但我真的很老了，我可以做你的曾曾曾曾曾祖母。我真的怀疑你会想要那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: What you need is a woman with strong, deft fingers to spread your wires and see about stimulating that pleasure center directly.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你需要的是一个有强壮，灵巧的手指的女人来舒展你的神经，看看能不能直接刺激你的快感中枢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Really? You mean..? I guess I hadn't even considered...
ESP.TRADUIT: 真的吗？你是说...？我想我根本没有考虑过...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ahem. I know I don't look it, but I'm quite old. I could be your great great great great grandmother. I really doubt you want that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 咳咳，我知道我看起来不像，但我真的很老了，我可以做你的曾曾曾曾曾祖母。我真的怀疑你会想要那样。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stimulation and pleasure isn't just about having the right tool. You need a man who knows how to use it. I'm very, very knowledgable.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刺激和快乐不仅仅是拥有正确的工具，你需要一个懂得如何使用它的人。我非常非常博学。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ew. No.
ESP.TRADUIT: 呃，不。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: How about you make like a 'Mister' and give me a 'Handy'!
ESP.TRADUIT: 不如你扮个“先生”，给我一个“巧手”！

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're such a flirt.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你真会调情。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, what did you have in mind?
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，那你有什么想法？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Does that bother you? I couldn't even tell.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这让你困扰吗？我甚至看不出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: When you put it like that...
ESP.TRADUIT: 既然你这么说...
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alright, you womanizer. Follow me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好吧，你这个风流坯子。跟我来。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You, me, and some alone time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你，我，还有独处的时间。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Maybe it's for the best.
ESP.TRADUIT: 也许这样是最好的。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nevermind. I don't even know how that would work, and I don't care to figure out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 算了。我都不知道要怎么做，我也不想搞清楚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I *look* like I would have any work for you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我*看起来*像能给你工作吗？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Actually, I guess there's the recycling program. I'll skip the pitch about the sustainable future for America's children.
ESP.TRADUIT: 实际上，我想是有个回收计划。我将跳过关于美国儿童可持续未来的演讲。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: If you bring me empty bottles, I'll give you a cap for each one. Every 20, I'm supposed to give you one of those novelty star caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 如果你给我带来空瓶子，我就给你一个瓶盖。每20个，我应该给你一个新奇的星星瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: So, do that.
ESP.TRADUIT: 所以，去做吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do you have any work for me?
ESP.TRADUIT: 你有工作给我吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: What about it?
ESP.TRADUIT: 怎么了？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about that bottle recycling program.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们来谈谈瓶子回收计划吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fine. Here's your caps.
ESP.TRADUIT: 很好。这是你的瓶盖。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I have empty bottles for you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有空瓶子给你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah. Take it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯。拿去吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: That should be enough for a star cap, right?
ESP.TRADUIT: 这应该够星星瓶盖了，对吧？

ESP.ORIGINAL: No. I said every 20 bottles. You're not at 20 yet.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没有，我是说每20瓶。你还没到20呢。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Do I get my star cap yet?
ESP.TRADUIT: 我拿到星星瓶盖了吗？

ESP.ORIGINAL: You actually found 50 star caps? That's impressive. I didn't expect anybody would waste the time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你居然真的找到了50个星星瓶盖？真令人印象深刻，没想到会有人浪费时间。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, congratulations, partner! You've proven yourself to be one fine tracker! We're honored to have you as a Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy!
ESP.TRADUIT: 那么，恭喜你，搭档！你已经证明了自己是一个优秀的追踪者！我们很荣幸能请到你作为夕阳沙士的副警长！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: And there's nothing more important to a deputy than a good old ten gallon hat! Here you go, partner! Wear it with pride!
ESP.TRADUIT: 对副警长来说，没有什么比一顶十加仑的旧帽子更重要的了！给你，搭档！自豪地戴上它！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Howdy, missy. You're speaking to an officer of the law. Just look at my official Sunset Sarsaparilla deputy badge.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嘿，小姐，你可是在跟一位执法官说话。你看看我这枚官方的夕阳沙士副警长徽章。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I don't actually know. The customers write things on me sometimes, but my lenses don't bend that way, so I can't see it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，其实我也不知道。顾客有时会在我身上写东西，但我的镜片不能那样弯曲，所以我看不见。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I had a lovely time, but I should get back to work. Thank you, and take care of yourself.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，我玩得很开心，但我该回去工作了。谢谢你，多保重。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Absolutely. <Point at the graffiti on her chassis.> What does this one mean?
ESP.TRADUIT: 绝对的。<指着她底盘上的涂鸦>这个是什么意思？

ESP.ORIGINAL: Oh, I see.
ESP.TRADUIT: 哦，原来如此。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Well, I need to get back to work. You can see yourself out.
ESP.TRADUIT: 好了，我得回去工作了。你可以自己出去。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Uh, it was a valuable learning experience.
ESP.TRADUIT: 嗯，这是一次宝贵的学习经历。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You're an asshole. I can't believe I did anything with you. I'm going back to work. Get lost.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你是个混蛋，我真不敢相信我和你做了什么。我要回去工作了，滚开。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I've had better.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我有更好的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: You said love? I'm sorry, but I don't know if I can reciprocate. I barely know you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你说爱？抱歉，但我不知道我能不能回报你。我几乎不了解你。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I had a good time though. Take care of yourself out there.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不过我玩得很开心，在外面可要保重哦。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I love you.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我爱你。

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see how it is. Fine. Then we don't need to ever talk about this again.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白了，很好。那我们就不用再提这件事了。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: I don't really do this lovey-dovey pillow talk thing. Sorry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我不太会在枕边说情话。对不起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Whatever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 随便吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Sassy Sally [060293B3] (mod) Quest : ([0601079B]AZFreeformElephantHill) 0601079B (EDID) EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Let's talk about something else.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我们谈点别的吧。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Postumus! Why aren't you on shift?
ESP.TRADUIT: 波斯图穆斯！你为什么不值班？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600D484]AZMalpaisGoldMinePostumusPostalQuest) The Big Rock Candy Mountains EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Postumus, I order you to stand down at once!
ESP.TRADUIT: 波斯图穆斯，我命令你立刻退下！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: Quest : ([0600D484]AZMalpaisGoldMinePostumusPostalQuest) The Big Rock Candy Mountains EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: You've completed the task. Now leave me.
ESP.TRADUIT: 你已经完成了任务，现在离开我吧。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Adjutant Clementius [06013B70] (mod) Quest : ([0601EC78]AZMalpaisAbuserQuest) Why Do Things Happen to Me? EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: <Punch the adjutant.>
ESP.TRADUIT: <揍副官>

ESP.ORIGINAL: I see how it is... Nobody cares about poor Castulus. Same old story over and over again!
ESP.TRADUIT: 我明白是怎么回事了...没人关心可怜的卡斯图卢斯。老故事一遍又一遍！
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "We're gonna have to leave you in the hole. They'd have our ass if they knew we were still at Comb Ridge!"
ESP.TRADUIT: “我们只能把你留在洞里了。如果他们知道我们还在梳子脊，他们会把我们宰了的！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Sorry Castulus, someone was supposed to relieve you of picket duty four days ago."
ESP.TRADUIT: “对不起，卡斯图卢斯，四天前就该有人接替你的纠察职责了。”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Good news, Castulus! You've been promoted to master of the driest hole outside Two-Sun!"
ESP.TRADUIT: "“好消息，卡斯图卢斯！你被晋升为双日城外最干燥洞穴的主人了！”
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sorry, man.
ESP.TRADUIT: 抱歉，伙计。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a terrible joke. I was about to tear him to pieces! Piss off, why don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个糟糕的笑话，我差点把他撕成碎片！滚开，你为什么不呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I'm just joshin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我只是开玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: That's a terrible joke. I was about to have him killed! Piss off, why don't you?
ESP.TRADUIT: 真是个糟糕的笑话，我差点杀了他！滚开，你为什么不呢？
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Manius Castulus [0600D472] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nah, I'm just joshin'.
ESP.TRADUIT: 不，我只是开玩笑。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Thought so.
ESP.TRADUIT: 我也这么认为。
ESP.COMMENTAIRE: NPC : Postumus [0600B764] (mod) Quest : ([0600D474]AZFreeformMalpaisGoldMine) Sixteen Tons EmotionType : Neutral

ESP.ORIGINAL: Yeah, I got that part.
ESP.TRADUIT: 是啊，这部分我明白了。
